teaching_sense.en_definition: Towards the outside of a place, or farther away in an outward direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示朝某处的外面移动，或沿向外的方向到更远的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fid-direzzjoni ta' barra minn post, jew lejn punt aktar imbiegħed f'dik id-direzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朝外；到某个空间或地方的外面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fid-direzzjoni ta' barra minn kamra, bini jew post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone moves 'il barra, they go towards the outside of a place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 往更外侧；朝外到距离更远的位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lejn punt aktar imbiegħed fid-direzzjoni ta' barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something moves further out, it reaches a more distant position in an outward direction.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-parteċipanti mxew 'il barra mill-bini. Wara, id-dgħajsa tal-grupp baħħret iktar 'il barra fil-baħar.
formal.en: During the exercise, the participants walked outside the building. Afterwards, the group's boat sailed further out to sea.
formal.zh: 演练期间，参与者走到了建筑物外。随后，该组的船驶向了更外面的海域。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ejja mmorru 'il barra. Hawn ġew sħana! Ben: Iva, u npoġġu s-siġġijiet ftit iktar 'il barra, taħt is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Let's go outside. It's hot in here! Ben: Yes, and let's put the chairs a little further out, under the tree.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们到外面去吧，这里面好热！Ben：好，再把椅子往外挪一点，放到树下。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja mmorru 'il barra. Hawn ġew sħana!
messages.mt_standard: Ejja mmorru 'il barra. Hawn ġew sħana!
messages.zh: 我们到外面去吧，这里面好热！
messages.en: Let's go outside. It's hot in here!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u npoġġu s-siġġijiet ftit iktar 'il barra, taħt is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u npoġġu s-siġġijiet ftit iktar 'il barra, taħt is-siġra.
messages.zh: 好，再把椅子往外挪一点，放到树下。
messages.en: Yes, and let's put the chairs a little further out, under the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支从屋内指向屋外的箭头记“向外”；再把箭头延长，就能联想到“往更外侧”的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a direction towards a higher position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 朝着更高的位置或上方，表示移动或视线的方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tindika direzzjoni lejn post jew livell ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向上；朝更高的位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tfisser fid-direzzjoni lejn post jew livell ogħla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something moves upwards, it moves towards a higher position.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向上地；往高处，修饰移动或观看等动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bħala avverbju, din l-espressjoni tindika li moviment jew ħarsa jkunu diretti lejn post ogħla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use upwards to describe movement or a gaze directed towards a higher position.

formal.mt: Il-lift iġorr lill-viżitaturi 'il fuq sal-aħħar sular tal-bini.
formal.en: The lift takes visitors upwards to the top floor of the building.
formal.zh: 电梯将访客向上送至大楼顶层。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-istilla li qed turini? Mark: Ħares 'il fuq, eżatt fuq is-saqaf. Maja: Issa qed naraha!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the star you are showing me? Mark: Look up, just above the roof. Maja: I can see it now!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你指给我看的星星在哪里？马克：往上看，就在屋顶上方。玛雅：现在我看到了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-istilla li qed turini?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-istilla li qed turini?
messages.zh: 你指给我看的星星在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the star you are showing me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 往上看，就在屋顶上方。
messages.en: Look up, just above the roof.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在我看到了！
messages.en: I can see it now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 'il fuq 和向上箭头一起记：抬头看或往高处走时，默念整个短语，建立方向与动作的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: If you move 'il quddiem, you move forwards or continue onward; when referring to time, the expression means in the future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示空间上向前移动或继续前行；用于时间时，表示今后、将来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-espressjoni 'il quddiem tindika moviment lejn in-naħa ta' quddiem jew tkomplija f'dik id-direzzjoni; meta tirreferi għaż-żmien, tfisser fil-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向前，朝前方的方向移动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-espressjoni 'il quddiem tindika moviment lejn in-naħa ta' quddiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you move forwards, you move towards the space in front of you.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 今后，将来，指当前时间之后。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta tintuża b'referenza għaż-żmien, l-espressjoni 'il quddiem tfisser fil-futur, wara ż-żmien preżenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something will happen 'il quddiem, it will happen at a time after the present.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继续向前，沿原来的方向接着前行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-espressjoni 'il quddiem tista' tindika li persuna tkompli miexja fl-istess direzzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you go onward, you continue moving ahead along your route.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jagħmlu pass 'il quddiem u mbagħad ikomplu mexjin 'il quddiem sal-bieb. Aktar 'il quddiem, se jirċievu struzzjonijiet oħra.
formal.en: Participants should take a step forwards and then continue onward to the door. Later on, they will receive further instructions.
formal.zh: 参与者应向前迈一步，然后继续向前走到门口。稍后，他们将收到进一步指示。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nieqaf hawn? Mark: Le, agħmel pass 'il quddiem u kompli miexi sal-bieb. Maja: U meta nitkellmu dwar il-pjan? Mark: Aktar 'il quddiem, wara l-ikla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall I stop here? Mark: No, take a step forwards and keep walking to the door. Maja: And when shall we talk about the plan? Mark: Later on, after the meal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在这里停下吗？马克：不用，向前迈一步，继续走到门口。玛雅：那我们什么时候谈计划？马克：晚些时候，吃完饭再谈。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在这里停下吗？
messages.en: Shall I stop here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, agħmel pass 'il quddiem u kompli miexi sal-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, agħmel pass 'il quddiem u kompli miexi sal-bieb.
messages.zh: 不用，向前迈一步，继续走到门口。
messages.en: No, take a step forwards and keep walking to the door.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们什么时候谈计划？
messages.en: And when shall we talk about the plan?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 晚些时候，吃完饭再谈。
messages.en: Later on, after the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一支指向前方的箭头：脚步沿箭头走是“向前”，接着走是“继续前行”；把箭头画在时间线上，就能联想到“今后”。这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 工具；器具（所给释义与动词标签不一致）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied gloss refers to implements used for practical work; the packet does not establish a corresponding Maltese verb sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给 tools 指用于完成实际工作的工具或器具；原包标为动词，但没有提供足以确定对应马耳他语动词义的信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija tirreferi għal għodod li jintużaw biex isir xogħol prattiku; il-pakkett ma jistabbilixxix tifsira verbali korrispondenti bil-Malti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工具；器具。此处保留原包的动词标签，但该标签与所给名词性释义不一致，不能据此确定动词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodod huma strumenti li jintużaw biex isir xogħol prattiku; għalkemm il-pakkett jagħti tikketta ta' verb, ma jipprovdix tifsira verbali ċara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tools are implements used to perform practical tasks, although the supplied verb label leaves the intended grammatical sense unresolved.

formal.mt: Qabel jibda x-xogħol, il-ħaddiem għandu jiċċekkja li l-għodod kollha jkunu f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Before starting work, the worker should check that all the tools are in good condition.
formal.zh: 开始工作前，工人应检查所有工具是否状态良好。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn qegħdin l-għodod? Lara: Fil-kaxxa l-blu, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are the tools? Lara: In the blue box, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: Mark：工具在哪里？Lara：在门旁边的蓝色箱子里。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 工具在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the tools?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 在门旁边的蓝色箱子里。
messages.en: In the blue box, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“蓝箱里的工具”记所给 tools 的含义和例句中的 għodod；本条键名与释义不匹配，动词标签也有疑点，不要背成马耳他语动词对应关系。

gloss_zh: 弹弓（所给释义；与英文键名不匹配）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small handheld device with elastic bands that are pulled back and released to shoot a small object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种手持的小型发射器具，通过拉伸并松开橡皮筋，将小物体弹射出去；此定义对应原包所给的 slingshot 义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żbandola hija għodda żgħira li tinżamm fl-id u li tuża lastiku miġbud biex tispara oġġett żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弹弓，一种利用拉伸的橡皮筋将小石子等小物体弹射出去的手持器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda żgħira, imsejħa żbandola, b'manku u lastiku li jinġibed u jinħeles biex iwaddab oġġett żgħir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A slingshot is a handheld device that shoots small objects using stretched elastic bands.

collocations.en: the elastic band of the slingshot

formal.mt: L-istampa turi żbandola tal-injam b'lastiku aħmar imwaħħal mal-manku.
formal.en: The picture shows a wooden slingshot with a red elastic band attached to its handle.
formal.zh: 图片展示了一把木制弹弓，手柄上装有红色橡皮筋。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik ħdejn il-kaxxa? Nina: Dik żbandola tal-injam; il-lastiku tagħha nkiser.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that next to the box? Nina: That's a wooden slingshot; its elastic band has broken.
colloquial.zh: Maja：箱子旁边那个是什么？Nina：那是一把木制弹弓，它的橡皮筋断了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 箱子旁边那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that next to the box?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik żbandola tal-injam; il-lastiku tagħha nkiser.
messages.mt_standard: Dik żbandola tal-injam; il-lastiku tagħha nkiser.
messages.zh: 那是一把木制弹弓，它的橡皮筋断了。
messages.en: That's a wooden slingshot; its elastic band has broken.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“木制手柄加橡皮筋”的画面记住弹弓义，并联系例句中的 żbandola；英文键名与所给释义不匹配，不要把键名当作马耳他语词形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The English expression used to tell another person that you love them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英语中向对方表达“我爱你”的话语；此处将整句作为一个表达单位学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni bl-Ingliż li biha persuna tgħid lil persuna oħra li tħobbha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “我爱你”，用于直接向对方表达爱意的英语话语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kliem bl-Ingliż li persuna tuża biex tgħid lil oħra li tħobbha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use the expression 'I love you' to tell someone that you feel love for them.

collocations.en: write 'I love you' on a card

formal.mt: Fil-kartolina tagħha, kitbet 'I love you' biex tesprimi mħabbitha.
formal.en: In her card, she wrote 'I love you' to express her love.
formal.zh: 她在卡片上写下“I love you”，以表达自己的爱意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ktibt fuq il-kartolina għal ommok? Mark: Ktibt 'I love you'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you write on the card for your mother? Mark: I wrote 'I love you'.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在给妈妈的卡片上写了什么？马克：我写了“I love you”。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在给妈妈的卡片上写了什么？
messages.en: What did you write on the card for your mother?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我写了“I love you”。
messages.en: I wrote 'I love you'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按英语词序对应记忆：I 是“我”，love 是“爱”，you 是“你”；再想象把整句写在表达爱意的卡片上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An insulting word for someone regarded as very foolish or as having done something stupid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来辱骂被认为非常愚蠢、缺乏判断力或做了蠢事的人的称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' disprezz għal persuna li titqies iblah ħafna jew li tkun għamlet xi ħaġa stupida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白痴；笨蛋，指被说话者认为非常愚蠢的人，通常带有侮辱意味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li titqies stupida ħafna jew nieqsa mill-ġudizzju; din il-kelma normalment tintuża bħala insult.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you call someone an idiot, you are insulting them because you think they are very foolish.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蠢货；糊涂蛋，侧重嘲笑一个人做事愚笨或缺乏常识。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib ruħha b'mod iblah jew bla sens, imsejħa hekk biex tiġi mċajpra jew insultata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nincompoop is someone you describe mockingly as foolish or lacking common sense.

formal.mt: L-awtur juża l-kelma 'idjota' biex juri r-rabja tal-karattru lejn sieħbu.
formal.en: The author uses the word 'idiot' to show the character's anger towards his companion.
formal.zh: 作者使用“蠢货”一词，表现这个人物对同伴的愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għamilt żball fil-kont. Kemm jien idjota! Lara: M'intix idjota; sempliċement insejt numru.
colloquial.en: Mark: I made a mistake in the calculation. What an idiot I am! Lara: You're not an idiot; you simply left out a number.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我算错了。我真是个笨蛋！Lara：你不是笨蛋，只是漏了一个数字。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt żball fil-kont. Kemm jien idjota!
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt żball fil-kont. Kemm jien idjota!
messages.zh: 我算错了。我真是个笨蛋！
messages.en: I made a mistake in the calculation. What an idiot I am!

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你不是笨蛋，只是漏了一个数字。
messages.en: You're not an idiot; you simply left out a number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 idjota 放进“算错后自嘲笨蛋”的小场景记忆；这个词带贬义，称呼别人时可能构成侮辱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is greatly admired, or an image representing a deity and treated as an object of worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到强烈崇拜或仰慕的人；也指代表神祇、供人崇拜的形象或塑像。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ammirata ħafna, jew xbieha li tirrappreżenta divinità u tkun oġġett ta' qima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偶像，指深受仰慕的人；也可指供人崇拜的神像。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tqanqal ammirazzjoni kbira, jew xbieha ta' divinità li tingħata qima.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An idol is someone people greatly admire, or an image of a deity that people worship.

formal.mt: Fil-wirja hemm idolu tal-ġebel li jirrappreżenta divinità.
formal.en: The exhibition contains a stone idol representing a deity.
formal.zh: 展览中有一尊代表神祇的石制神像。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-kantanta hija l-idolu tiegħi! Nina: Naf, tisma' l-kanzunetti tagħha kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: This singer is my idol! Nina: I know, you listen to her songs every day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这位女歌手是我的偶像！Nina：我知道，你每天都听她的歌。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这位女歌手是我的偶像！
messages.en: This singer is my idol!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我知道，你每天都听她的歌。
messages.en: I know, you listen to her songs every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 idolu：墙上的歌手海报表示“偶像”，供人崇拜的塑像表示“神像”；共同线索是仰慕或崇拜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move continuously as a liquid, as water does along a channel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体连续移动，例如水沿着沟渠流淌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq kontinwament bħala likwidu, bħall-ilma li jgħaddi minn kanal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流动；指水等液体连续地从一处流向另一处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta likwidu jgħaddi kontinwament minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a liquid flows, it moves continuously from one place to another.

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, l-ilma beda jgelgel fil-kanal li jgħaddi ħdejn l-għalqa.
formal.en: After the rain, water began to flow in the channel beside the field.
formal.zh: 雨后，水开始沿着田地旁的沟渠流淌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tisma' l-ilma jgelgel? Pawlu: Iva, ġej mill-kanal wara d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear the water flowing? Pawlu: Yes, it's coming from the channel behind the house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见流水声了吗？保罗：听见了，是房子后面的沟渠传来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见流水声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the water flowing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了，是房子后面的沟渠传来的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the channel behind the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 igelgel 时，想象雨水沿沟渠连续流动，把词义与一条不断延伸的水线联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Caused or forced me to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某个人或某种情况使我做了某事，也可强调迫使我去做。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li persuna jew ċirkustanza wasslitni jew ġegħlitni nagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使我做了某事；迫使我做了某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa ġegħlitni nagħmel azzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone made me do something, they caused or forced me to do it.

formal.mt: L-għalliem ġegħelni nerġa' nikteb ir-rapport sabiex nikkoreġi l-iżbalji.
formal.en: The teacher made me rewrite the report so that I could correct the mistakes.
formal.zh: 老师让我重写报告，以便改正其中的错误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex wasalt tard? Mark: Ix-xufier ġegħelni nistenna għax ix-xarabank kienet mimlija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you arrive late? Mark: The driver made me wait because the bus was full.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么迟到了？马克：司机让我等候，因为公交车已经满了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xufier ġegħelni nistenna għax ix-xarabank kienet mimlija.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xufier ġegħelni nistenna għax ix-xarabank kienet mimlija.
messages.zh: 司机让我等候，因为公交车已经满了。
messages.en: The driver made me wait because the bus was full.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iggieghel 的本条义与“老师让我重写”联系起来：有人或某种情况推动我做事，句子重点是“使我”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try to seize or hold something tightly, especially for support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伸手抓取或紧紧抓住某物，尤其为了支撑身体或避免跌倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprova jaqbad xi ħaġa jew iżommha sew, speċjalment biex isib appoġġ jew ma jaqax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伸手紧抓某物，常指急忙抓取以获得支撑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jipprova jaqbad xi ħaġa b'saħħa, ħafna drabi biex iżomm ruħu jew jevita li jaqa'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you clutch at something, you try to grasp it tightly, often because you need support.

formal.mt: Meta żelaq fuq il-mogħdija, ir-raġel iggranfa mal-ħabel biex ma jaqax.
formal.en: When he slipped on the path, the man clutched at the rope to avoid falling.
formal.zh: 那名男子在小路上滑了一下，连忙伸手紧抓绳子，以免摔倒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil ħuk fuq it-taraġ? Nina: Żelaq u iggranfa ma' driegħi biex ma jaqax.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to your brother on the stairs? Nina: He slipped and clutched at my arm to avoid falling.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你哥哥在楼梯上怎么了？妮娜：他滑了一下，连忙抓住我的手臂，以免摔倒。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥在楼梯上怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your brother on the stairs?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żelaq u iggranfa ma' driegħi biex ma jaqax.
messages.mt_standard: Żelaq u iggranfa ma' driegħi biex ma jaqax.
messages.zh: 他滑了一下，连忙抓住我的手臂，以免摔倒。
messages.en: He slipped and clutched at my arm to avoid falling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 iggranfa 时，想象脚下一滑、手立刻抓紧绳子的画面，用“急忙伸手紧抓”帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expresses that an action is necessary or required.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某个行动是必要的，或因规定、责任而必须完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi li azzjoni hija meħtieġa jew li hemm obbligu li titwettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 必须；表示有必要或有义务做某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħadd għandu obbligu jagħmel xi ħaġa jew li dik l-azzjoni hija meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you must do something, it is necessary or required that you do it.

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant irid jippreżenta dokument ta' identifikazzjoni qabel jidħol fis-sala.
formal.en: Every participant must present an identification document before entering the hall.
formal.zh: 每位参加者进入大厅前都必须出示身份证明文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nħallas għada? Toni: Le, trid tħallas illum biex iżżomm il-post tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I pay tomorrow? Toni: No, you must pay today to keep your place.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以明天付款吗？托尼：不行，你必须今天付款才能保留名额。

messages.speaker: Maja (参加者)
messages.zh: 我可以明天付款吗？
messages.en: Can I pay tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, trid tħallas illum biex iżżomm il-post tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Le, trid tħallas illum biex iżżomm il-post tiegħek.
messages.zh: 不行，你必须今天付款才能保留名额。
messages.en: No, you must pay today to keep your place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定的 Must 义记忆 igijel：想象报名规定写着“今天必须付款”，突出必要性和义务感。

gloss_zh: （汽车等车辆的）点火；点火装置

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or mechanism that starts a vehicle's engine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使汽车或其他车辆的发动机启动的点火过程或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-mekkaniżmu li bih tibda taħdem il-magna ta' karozza jew vettura oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽车或其他车辆用于启动发动机的点火过程或点火装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-apparat li jintuża biex tibda taħdem il-magna ta' vettura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vehicle's ignition is the mechanism or process that allows its engine to start running.

formal.mt: Il-mekkanik sab problema fis-sistema tal-ignixin u spjega għaliex il-magna ma kinitx tibda taħdem.
formal.en: The mechanic found a problem in the ignition system and explained why the engine would not start.
formal.zh: 修理工发现点火系统存在故障，并解释了发动机无法启动的原因。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-karozza mhix tistartja. Taħseb li hemm problema fl-ignixin? Rita: Jista' jkun. Ħa nħares lejha.
colloquial.en: Mark: The car won't start. Do you think there's a problem with the ignition? Rita: There might be. Let me take a look.
colloquial.zh: Mark：车启动不了。你觉得是点火装置出了问题吗？Rita：有可能。我来看看。

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karozza mhix tistartja. Taħseb li hemm problema fl-ignixin?
messages.mt_standard: Il-karozza mhix tistartja. Taħseb li hemm problema fl-ignixin?
messages.zh: 车启动不了。你觉得是点火装置出了问题吗？
messages.en: The car won't start. Do you think there's a problem with the ignition?

messages.speaker: Rita (修理工)
messages.zh: 有可能。我来看看。
messages.en: There might be. Let me take a look.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ignixin 和转动钥匙、发动机启动的画面联系起来，再用“点火系统”和“点火故障”两个搭配巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large lizard, often with a row of pointed scales along its back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种体型较大的蜥蜴，背部通常有一排尖状鳞片，称为鬣蜥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gremxula kbira li spiss ikollha ringiela ta' skwali bil-ponta tul daharha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鬣蜥，一种体型较大的蜥蜴，背部通常有一排尖状鳞片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' gremxula kbira, ħafna drabi b'ringiela ta' skwali bil-ponta fuq daharha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An iguana is a large lizard that often has a row of pointed scales along its back.

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara edukattiva, l-istudenti osservaw igwana u ddeskrivew il-forma ta' denbha u l-iskwali fuq daharha.
formal.en: During the educational visit, the students observed an iguana and described the shape of its tail and the scales on its back.
formal.zh: 在教学参观期间，学生们观察了一只鬣蜥，并描述了它尾巴的形状和背部的鳞片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik l-igwana ħadra! Kemm għandha denbha twil! Pawlu: Iva, qed tistrieħ fuq il-fergħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that green iguana! What a long tail it has! Pawlu: Yes, it's resting on the branch.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看那只绿色鬣蜥！它的尾巴好长啊！Pawlu：是啊，它正在树枝上休息。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik l-igwana ħadra! Kemm għandha denbha twil!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik l-igwana ħadra! Kemm għandha denbha twil!
messages.zh: 看那只绿色鬣蜥！它的尾巴好长啊！
messages.en: Look at that green iguana! What a long tail it has!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，它正在树枝上休息。
messages.en: Yes, it's resting on the branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 igwana 时想象一只背上有尖鳞、尾巴很长的鬣蜥；把“绿色鬣蜥”的词组和这幅画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass solid waste from the body, expressed informally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把粪便排出体外，即口语中的“拉便便”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ l-ippurgar minn ġismu; espressjoni informali għal dan il-bżonn naturali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉便便，指将粪便排出体外，属于非正式说法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-bżonn tiegħu billi joħroġ l-ippurgar minn ġismu; tintuża f'kuntest informali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone poos, they pass solid waste from their body, usually while using a toilet.

formal.mt: Fil-gwida għall-ġenituri, il-kelma informali 'ihit' tintuża biex tispjega li t-tifel għandu bżonn joħroġ l-ippurgar.
formal.en: In the guide for parents, the informal word 'ihit' is used to explain that the child needs to pass a stool.
formal.zh: 在家长指南中，非正式用词 ihit 用来说明孩子需要排便。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Naħseb li Ben irid ihit. Fejn hu t-tojlit? Marija: Hemm, ħdejn il-kċina. Ħa nieħduh hemm.
colloquial.en: Sara: I think Ben needs to poo. Where's the toilet? Marija: Over there, next to the kitchen. Let's take him there.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我觉得 Ben 要拉便便。厕所在哪里？Marija：在那边，厨房旁边。我们带他过去吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li Ben irid ihit. Fejn hu t-tojlit?
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li Ben irid ihit. Fejn hu t-tojlit?
messages.zh: 我觉得 Ben 要拉便便。厕所在哪里？
messages.en: I think Ben needs to poo. Where's the toilet?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm, ħdejn il-kċina. Ħa nieħduh hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm, ħdejn il-kċina. Ħa nieħduh hemm.
messages.zh: 在那边，厨房旁边。我们带他过去吧。
messages.en: Over there, next to the kitchen. Let's take him there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ihit 放进照顾孩子、寻找厕所的生活场景中记忆，对应口语“拉便便”，同时联想到较中性的“排便”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fish considered collectively, either as animals living in water or as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鱼的统称，可以指水中生活的鱼类，也可以指供食用的鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali li jgħixu fl-ilma u jieħdu n-nifs permezz tal-garġi, meqjusa flimkien, jew dawn l-annimali bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鱼；鱼类的统称，也可指作为食物的鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimali akkwatiċi bil-garġi, meqjusa bħala grupp, jew il-laħam tagħhom li jittiekel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fish are animals that live in water, and the same word also refers to them as food.

formal.mt: Il-ħut għandu jinżamm fil-friġġ sakemm jasal il-ħin tat-tisjir.
formal.en: The fish should be kept in the refrigerator until it is time to cook it.
formal.zh: 鱼应放在冰箱中保存，直到准备烹调时再取出。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek ħut frisk illum? Rita: Iva, il-ħut wasal dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh fish today? Rita: Yes, the fish arrived this morning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天有新鲜的鱼吗？丽塔：有，鱼是今天早上送到的。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜的鱼吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh fish today?

messages.speaker: Rita (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 有，鱼是今天早上送到的。
messages.en: Yes, the fish arrived this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用鱼摊画面记住 ħut：先看一摊新鲜鱼，记 ħut frisk；再看盘中的烤鱼，记 ħut mixwi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An affirmative response expressing agreement, acceptance, or confirmation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示同意、接受或确认的肯定答复，相当于“是”或“好的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tweġiba affermattiva li turi qbil, aċċettazzjoni jew konferma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “是”或“好的”这样的肯定答复。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tweġiba li biha persuna taqbel ma' dak li ntqal, taċċetta xi ħaġa jew tikkonferma li xi ħaġa hija vera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A yes is an affirmative answer that expresses agreement, acceptance, or confirmation.

formal.mt: Fit-traskrizzjoni, it-tweġiba tal-parteċipant kienet: 'Ijja, naqbel ma' din il-proposta.'
formal.en: In the transcript, the participant's answer was: 'Yes, I agree with this proposal.'
formal.zh: 在文字记录中，参与者的答复是：“是的，我同意这项提议。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tazza te? Lara: Ijja, grazzi. Mingħajr zokkor, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a cup of tea? Lara: Yes, thank you. Without sugar, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：想喝杯茶吗？拉拉：好的，谢谢。请不要加糖。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 想喝杯茶吗？
messages.en: Would you like a cup of tea?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ijja, grazzi. Mingħajr zokkor, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Ijja, grazzi. Mingħajr zokkor, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。请不要加糖。
messages.en: Yes, thank you. Without sugar, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ijja 和点头动作绑定：别人问要不要茶，你点头说“Ijja, grazzi”，整句记成“好的，谢谢”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Food specially prepared for babies and suitable for their age and stage of development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门为婴儿制作、适合其年龄和发育阶段食用的食品，常指婴儿辅食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel ippreparat apposta għat-trabi, adattat għall-età tagħhom u għall-istadju tal-iżvilupp tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专供婴儿食用的食品，通常包括泥状或其他质地适宜的辅食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul apposta biex jittiekel mit-trabi, spiss mitħun jew mgħaffeġ biex ikollu konsistenza adattata għalihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Baby food is food specially prepared for babies, often with a soft or smooth texture.

formal.mt: Il-ħanut joffri għażla ta' ikel għat-trabi, b'informazzjoni dwar l-ingredjenti fuq kull pakkett.
formal.en: The shop offers a selection of baby food, with information about the ingredients on every package.
formal.zh: 这家商店提供多种婴儿食品，每份包装上都标有配料信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nista' nsib l-ikel għat-trabi? Mark: Fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn il-ħrieqi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can I find the baby food? Mark: On the shelf next to the nappies.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：婴儿食品在哪里？马克：在纸尿裤旁边的货架上。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 婴儿食品在哪里？
messages.en: Where can I find the baby food?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 在纸尿裤旁边的货架上。
messages.en: On the shelf next to the nappies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意思分块记忆：ikel 是“食物”，għat-trabi 是“给婴儿的”；想象婴儿面前的一小罐辅食，再连读整个短语。

gloss_zh: 可怕的；令人毛骨悚然的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frightening or deeply disturbing, especially because of something shocking or horrible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人恐惧或深感不安的，尤指因情景骇人或恐怖而令人毛骨悚然的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tqanqal biża' jew ta' tħassib kbir minħabba li tkun tal-waħx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可怕的；令人极为恐惧或不安的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tqanqal biża' kbira jew tħalli impressjoni kerha ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something dreadful makes you feel very frightened or deeply upset.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人毛骨悚然的；尤指涉及暴力、伤亡等骇人细节而令人惊恐的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa tal-waħx li tqanqal biża' u stmerrija, speċjalment meta turi dettalji ta' vjolenza jew mewt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something gruesome is especially disturbing because it involves horrifying details of injury, violence, or death.

formal.mt: Ix-xhud ta rakkont ikexkex tal-inċident, iżda evita dettalji li setgħu jweġġgħu lill-familji.
formal.en: The witness gave a horrifying account of the accident but avoided details that might distress the families.
formal.zh: 证人对事故作了令人毛骨悚然的叙述，但避开了可能使家属痛苦的细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-film tal-bieraħ? Pawlu: Ikexkex! Kelli ngħatti għajnejja f'xi xeni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was yesterday's film like? Pawlu: Horrifying! I had to cover my eyes during some scenes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：昨天那部电影怎么样？Pawlu：太吓人了！有些场景我都得捂住眼睛。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天那部电影怎么样？
messages.en: What was yesterday's film like?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikexkex! Kelli ngħatti għajnejja f'xi xeni.
messages.mt_standard: Ikexkex! Kelli ngħatti għajnejja f'xi xeni.
messages.zh: 太吓人了！有些场景我都得捂住眼睛。
messages.en: Horrifying! I had to cover my eyes during some scenes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikexkex 与看恐怖片时捂住眼睛的画面绑定：一般的“可怕”对应 dreadful，骇人细节带来的“毛骨悚然”对应 gruesome。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reduce worry, anger, or agitation, or to become more peaceful and relaxed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减轻忧虑、愤怒或激动，使人或局面平静下来，也可指自己恢复平静。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-biża', ir-rabja jew l-aġitazzjoni ta' xi ħadd, jew isir aktar kwiet u rilassat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减轻或消除忧虑、恐惧、疑虑等不安情绪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Inaqqas jew ineħħi l-biża', l-inkwiet jew id-dubji li jkun qed iħoss xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you allay someone's fears or worries, you make those feelings less strong.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安抚；使愤怒或不满的人缓和情绪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Itaffi r-rabja jew in-nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon ta' xi ħadd biex isir aktar kalm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you appease someone who is angry or dissatisfied, you do something that reduces their anger or dissatisfaction.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使平静；使镇定；也指恢复平静或冷静下来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd aktar kwiet u inqas aġitat, jew jerġa' jsir kwiet hu stess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you calm someone, or if they calm, they become less upset, excited, or anxious.

formal.mt: It-tabib ikkalma lill-pazjent billi spjegalu kull pass tal-eżami.
formal.en: The doctor calmed the patient by explaining each step of the examination.
formal.zh: 医生通过解释检查的每一个步骤，使患者平静下来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed ninkwieta ħafna dwar l-eżami ta' għada. Nina: Ikkalma ftit; nistgħu nirrevedu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm really worried about tomorrow's exam. Nina: Take a moment to calm down; we can revise together.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我特别担心明天的考试。Nina：先放松一下，我们可以一起复习。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed ninkwieta ħafna dwar l-eżami ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Qed ninkwieta ħafna dwar l-eżami ta' għada.
messages.zh: 我特别担心明天的考试。
messages.en: I'm really worried about tomorrow's exam.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 先放松一下，我们可以一起复习。
messages.en: Take a moment to calm down; we can revise together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把情绪音量慢慢调低来记 ikkalma：担忧降低是 allay，怒气缓和是 appease，人恢复镇定是 calm。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage someone's reputation by making false and harmful statements about them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过发表有关某人的虚假且有害的言论来损害其名誉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid affarijiet foloz u ta' ħsara dwar xi ħadd biex jagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诽谤；通过虚假且有损名誉的言论中伤他人，尤指口头言论。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' xi ħadd billi jgħid affarijiet foloz dwaru, speċjalment bil-fomm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone slanders another person, they make false statements about that person that damage their reputation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶意诽谤；蓄意散布虚假指控以败坏他人名誉，属正式用语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ixerred akkużi foloz dwar xi ħadd b'mod malizzjuż biex iħammeġ ir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To calumniate someone is to make maliciously false accusations intended to damage that person's reputation.

collocations.mt: ikkalunnja lil xi ħadd b'akkużi foloz
collocations.zh: 用虚假指控恶意中伤了某人

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, id-direttur ikkalunnja lil eks impjegat billi allega, mingħajr ebda bażi, li kien seraq fondi.
formal.en: In his letter, the director calumniated a former employee by alleging, without any basis, that he had stolen funds.
formal.zh: 董事在信中毫无根据地指称一名前雇员盗取资金，恶意损害了他的名誉。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Ġanni jinsab daqshekk irrabjat ma' Toni? Luqa: Għax Toni kkalunnjah; qal lil kulħadd li Ġanni seraq, u dan mhux minnu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is Ġanni so angry with Toni? Luqa: Because Toni slandered him; he told everyone that Ġanni had stolen something, and that isn't true.
colloquial.zh: Marta：Ġanni 为什么对 Toni 这么生气？Luqa：因为 Toni 诽谤了他，跟所有人说 Ġanni 偷了东西，可这根本不是真的。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Ġanni jinsab daqshekk irrabjat ma' Toni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Ġanni jinsab daqshekk irrabjat ma' Toni?
messages.zh: Ġanni 为什么对 Toni 这么生气？
messages.en: Why is Ġanni so angry with Toni?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Toni kkalunnjah; qal lil kulħadd li Ġanni seraq, u dan mhux minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Toni kkalunnjah; qal lil kulħadd li Ġanni seraq, u dan mhux minnu.
messages.zh: 因为 Toni 诽谤了他，跟所有人说 Ġanni 偷了东西，可这根本不是真的。
messages.en: Because Toni slandered him; he told everyone that Ġanni had stolen something, and that isn't true.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“虚假指控→名誉受损”的画面记 ikkalunnja：核心是造假中伤；英语 slander 常用于口头诽谤，calumniate 语气更正式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put someone in prison or keep them confined there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某人关进监狱，或使其继续受到监禁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddaħħal lil xi ħadd il-ħabs jew iżżommu magħluq fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人关进监狱，使其失去人身自由。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iddaħħal lil xi ħadd il-ħabs u ċċaħħdu mil-libertà tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone imprisons a person, they put that person in prison and take away their freedom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某人收监或拘禁于监狱中；属于较正式的表达。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iżżomm lil xi ħadd magħluq il-ħabs; din hija tifsira li tintuża f'kuntesti formali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a person is incarcerated, they are confined in prison and cannot leave freely.

collocations.en: imprisoned the man for two years

formal.mt: Wara li nstabet il-ħtija tiegħu, il-ġudikant ikkalzra lir-raġel għal sentejn.
formal.en: After the man was found guilty, the judge imprisoned him for two years.
formal.zh: 该男子被认定有罪后，法官判处他两年监禁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ġudikant ikkalzra lir-raġel? Mark: Għax instab ħati ta' reat serju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the judge imprison the man? Mark: Because he was found guilty of a serious crime.
colloquial.zh: Maja：法官为什么把那个男子关进监狱？Mark：因为他被认定犯有严重罪行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 法官为什么把那个男子关进监狱？
messages.en: Why did the judge imprison the man?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax instab ħati ta' reat serju.
messages.mt_standard: Għax instab ħati ta' reat serju.
messages.zh: 因为他被认定犯有严重罪行。
messages.en: Because he was found guilty of a serious crime.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikkalzra 和“牢门关上、失去自由”的画面一起记；两个英语义项都围绕监禁，incarcerate 的语体更正式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb whose specific meaning needs clarification before a reliable translation can be given.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个具体含义尚待明确的动词，需先确认其意思才能可靠翻译。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu għad trid tiġi ċċarata qabel ma tkun tista' tingħata traduzzjoni affidabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 该动词的具体含义尚未明确，暂不能确定对应的中文动作义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira speċifika ta' dan il-verb għadha mhix ċara biżżejjed biex tingħata definizzjoni preċiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this verb needs clarification before a reliable translation can be provided.

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-verb 'ikkaninizza' għandha tiġi ċċarata qabel ma tintgħażel traduzzjoni għaċ-Ċiniż.
formal.en: The meaning of the verb 'ikkaninizza' should be clarified before a Chinese translation is selected.
formal.zh: 在选择中文译法之前，应先明确动词 ikkaninizza 的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser il-verb 'ikkaninizza'? Mark: Għadni ma nafx; għandi bżonn sentenza li turi kif jintuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the verb 'ikkaninizza' mean? Mark: I don't know yet; I need a sentence showing how it is used.
colloquial.zh: Maja：动词 ikkaninizza 是什么意思？Mark：我还不知道；我需要一个能说明它如何使用的句子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 动词 ikkaninizza 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb 'ikkaninizza' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx; għandi bżonn sentenza li turi kif jintuża.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx; għandi bżonn sentenza li turi kif jintuża.
messages.zh: 我还不知道；我需要一个能说明它如何使用的句子。
messages.en: I don't know yet; I need a sentence showing how it is used.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 ikkaninizza 放进“动词、词义待确认”的学习卡；不要凭拼写联想硬配中文，等含义明确后再补动作画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut food into small cubes or chop it into very small pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物切成小方丁，或进一步切碎、剁成细小碎末。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqatta' l-ikel f'kubi żgħar jew f'biċċiet żgħar ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将食物切成小方丁。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqatta' l-ikel f'biċċiet żgħar li jkollhom forma ta' kubi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you dice food, you cut it into small pieces shaped like cubes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将食物切碎或剁成非常细小的碎末。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqatta' jew titħan l-ikel sakemm isir f'biċċiet żgħar ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you mince food, you chop or grind it into very small pieces.

formal.mt: Il-kok ikkapulja l-laħam f'biċċiet żgħar ħafna qabel ma żiedu maz-zalza.
formal.en: The cook minced the meat into very small pieces before adding it to the sauce.
formal.zh: 厨师先把肉剁得很细，再将其加入酱汁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se nqatta' l-karrotti għas-soppa? Mark: Ikkapulja l-karrotti f'kubi żgħar biex jissajru malajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: How should I cut the carrots for the soup? Mark: Dice the carrots into small cubes so they cook quickly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：做汤的胡萝卜该怎么切？Mark：把胡萝卜切成小方丁，这样熟得快。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 做汤的胡萝卜该怎么切？
messages.en: How should I cut the carrots for the soup?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkapulja l-karrotti f'kubi żgħar biex jissajru malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkapulja l-karrotti f'kubi żgħar biex jissajru malajr.
messages.zh: 把胡萝卜切成小方丁，这样熟得快。
messages.en: Dice the carrots into small cubes so they cook quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象砧板上的两种结果：整齐小方块对应 dice，细细碎末对应 mince；用这两个厨房画面记住 ikkapulja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a charge of ammunition into a firearm so that it is ready for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给枪械装入弹药，使其处于可以使用的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddaħħal il-munizzjon f'arma tan-nar biex tkun lesta għall-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给枪械装填弹药，使其准备就绪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħabbi arma tan-nar bil-munizzjon meħtieġ biex tkun tista' tintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you charge a firearm, you put ammunition into it so that it is ready for use.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li l-uffiċjal ik الوarga l-arma qabel il-bidu tal-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The report states that the officer loaded the weapon before the exercise began.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该军官在演习开始前给武器装填了弹药。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel l-uffiċjal f'dik ix-xena tal-film? Mark: Ikkarga l-pistola u mbagħad stenna ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the officer do in that scene in the film? Mark: He loaded the pistol and then waited by the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影那个场景里，军官做了什么？Mark：他给手枪装了弹，然后在门边等着。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影那个场景里，军官做了什么？
messages.en: What did the officer do in that scene in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkarga l-pistola u mbagħad stenna ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkarga l-pistola u mbagħad stenna ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 他给手枪装了弹，然后在门边等着。
messages.en: He loaded the pistol and then waited by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikkarga 与电影中“武器装入弹药、准备就绪”的画面相连；这里的 charge 表示装填，阅读时结合宾语确认意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone a penalty or corrective punishment for doing something wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人做错事或违反规则而给予处罚或管教。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti kastig lil xi ħadd minħabba li jkun għamel xi ħaġa ħażina jew kiser xi regola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因过错或违规而惩罚某人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti piena jew kastig lil xi ħadd għal xi ħaġa ħażina li jkun għamel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone punishes a person, they make that person suffer a penalty for something wrong they have done.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为纠正某人的不当行为而责罚或严厉管教。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jikkoreġi l-imġiba ħażina ta' xi ħadd billi jċanfru bis-serjetà jew jagħtih kastig.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone chastizes a person, they reprimand or punish that person in order to correct unacceptable behaviour.

collocations.en: punished someone for breaking the rules
collocations.zh: 因某人违反规则而处罚他

formal.mt: L-għalliem ikkastiga lill-istudent talli kiser ir-regoli tal-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher punished the student for breaking the classroom rules.
formal.zh: 老师因那名学生违反课堂规则而处罚了他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kowċ ikkastiga lil Pawlu? Toni: Għax wasal tard għat-taħriġ tliet darbiet din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the coach punish Pawlu? Toni: Because he arrived late for training three times this week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：教练为什么处罚保罗？托尼：因为他这周训练迟到了三次。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.zh: 教练为什么处罚保罗？
messages.en: Why did the coach punish Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Toni (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax wasal tard għat-taħriġ tliet darbiet din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax wasal tard għat-taħriġ tliet darbiet din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 因为他这周训练迟到了三次。
messages.en: Because he arrived late for training three times this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“违反规则后受到处罚”的情景中记忆，并连读 ikkastiga lill-istudent，记住动作是惩罚，对象是学生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Produced or brought about by a particular event, action, or condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由某个事件、行为或状况引起或造成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li seħħ jew inħoloq minħabba avveniment, azzjoni jew kundizzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由所说明的原因、因素或事件造成的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li seħħ jew inħoloq bħala riżultat ta' kawża jew fattur partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is caused by an event or condition, it happens as a result of that event or condition.

collocations.zh: 由交通拥堵造成的延误
由施工或作业造成的噪声

collocations.en: an accident caused by an error

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-dewmien ikkawżat mit-traffiku fit-toroq ewlenin.
formal.en: The report describes the delay caused by traffic on the main roads.
formal.zh: 报告描述了主要道路上的交通拥堵所造成的延误。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-istorbju kollu huwa ikkawżat mix-xogħol fit-triq? Mark: Iva, qed isewwu l-bankina quddiem id-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is all this noise caused by the roadworks? Mark: Yes, they are repairing the pavement in front of the house.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些噪声都是道路施工造成的吗？马克：是的，他们正在修房子前面的人行道。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-istorbju kollu huwa ikkawżat mix-xogħol fit-triq?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-istorbju kollu huwa ikkawżat mix-xogħol fit-triq?
messages.zh: 这些噪声都是道路施工造成的吗？
messages.en: Is all this noise caused by the roadworks?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed isewwu l-bankina quddiem id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed isewwu l-bankina quddiem id-dar.
messages.zh: 是的，他们正在修房子前面的人行道。
messages.en: Yes, they are repairing the pavement in front of the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“结果＋ikkawżat minn＋原因”这条句子链记忆：先说发生了什么，再接造成它的原因，如“延误由交通造成”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something happen or bring about a particular reaction, often an unpleasant one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事发生，或引发某种反应，常用于不良后果或负面反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib miegħu riżultat jew iqanqal reazzjoni, ħafna drabi xi ħaġa mhux mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成；使某种事件、情况或结果发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel li jiġri avveniment jew li tinħoloq sitwazzjoni bħala riżultat ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something causes an event or situation, it makes that event or situation happen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激起；引发某种反应，尤指愤怒、抗议或争议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqanqal reazzjoni f'xi ħadd, speċjalment rabja, protesta jew nuqqas ta' qbil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something provokes a reaction, it makes people respond, often with anger or strong disagreement.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-għeluq tat-triq ikkaġuna dewmien fis-servizz tat-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: The report indicates that the road closure caused delays to public transport services.
formal.zh: 报告指出，道路封闭造成了公共交通服务延误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex wasalt tard? Mark: Kien hemm inċident fit-triq, u ikkaġuna ħafna dewmien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you arrive late? Mark: There was an accident on the road, and it caused a long delay.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么迟到了？Mark：路上出了事故，耽搁了很长时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm inċident fit-triq, u ikkaġuna ħafna dewmien.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm inċident fit-triq, u ikkaġuna ħafna dewmien.
messages.zh: 路上出了事故，耽搁了很长时间。
messages.en: There was an accident on the road, and it caused a long delay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原因→结果”的箭头记 ikkaġuna：事故造成延误是 cause，言论激起愤怒是 provoke；两义都抓住“引发后果”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange things into groups or assign them to categories according to shared characteristics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据共同特征把事物分成若干组，或将其归入某个类别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqassam affarijiet fi gruppi jew iqegħedhom f'kategoriji skont il-karatteristiċi komuni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依据一定标准对事物进行分类或确定其所属类别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqiegħed affarijiet fi gruppi jew kategoriji differenti skont kriterji jew karatteristiċi partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you classify things, you divide them into groups or identify their categories according to particular characteristics.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ikklassifika d-dokumenti skont is-suġġett biex jiffaċilita l-analiżi.
formal.en: The researcher classified the documents by subject to facilitate the analysis.
formal.zh: 研究人员按主题给文件分类，以便进行分析。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ikklassifika dawn il-kotba skont il-ġeneru? Ben: Jien. Issa tista' ssib ir-rumanzi kollha fuq l-istess xkaffa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who classified these books by genre? Ben: I did. Now you can find all the novels on the same shelf.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把这些书按体裁分类了？本：我分的。现在所有小说都能在同一个书架隔层上找到。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ikklassifika dawn il-kotba skont il-ġeneru?
messages.mt_standard: Min ikklassifika dawn il-kotba skont il-ġeneru?
messages.zh: 谁把这些书按体裁分类了？
messages.en: Who classified these books by genre?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Issa tista' ssib ir-rumanzi kollha fuq l-istess xkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Issa tista' ssib ir-rumanzi kollha fuq l-istess xkaffa.
messages.zh: 我分的。现在所有小说都能在同一个书架隔层上找到。
messages.en: I did. Now you can find all the novels on the same shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一堆书按体裁分别摆放：ikklassifika 表示执行“分类”这个动作，接着用 skont 说明分类依据。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Assigned to a particular group or category according to defined criteria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已根据一定标准分组或归入特定类别的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tqiegħed fi grupp jew kategorija partikolari skont kriterji definiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经过分类处理或被确定所属类别的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie mqassam skont kategoriji jew tqiegħed f'kategorija partikolari abbażi tal-karatteristiċi tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is classified has been assigned to a group or category according to particular criteria.

collocations.en: a book classified as a novel

formal.mt: Il-materjal ikklassifikat skont it-tip jitqiegħed f'kaxxi separati biex ikun aktar faċli li jinstab.
formal.en: The material classified by type is placed in separate boxes so that it is easier to find.
formal.zh: 按类型分类的材料被放入不同的箱子，以便查找。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-ktieb huwa ikklassifikat bħala rumanz? Adam: Iva, għalhekk qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa tar-rumanzi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this book classified as a novel? Adam: Yes, that is why it is on the novels shelf.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这本书被归类为小说吗？亚当：是的，所以它放在小说书架上。

messages.speaker: Nina (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb huwa ikklassifikat bħala rumanz?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb huwa ikklassifikat bħala rumanz?
messages.zh: 这本书被归类为小说吗？
messages.en: Is this book classified as a novel?

messages.speaker: Adam (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalhekk qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa tar-rumanzi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalhekk qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa tar-rumanzi.
messages.zh: 是的，所以它放在小说书架上。
messages.en: Yes, that is why it is on the novels shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikklassifikat 与“已经贴好类别标签”的物品联系起来：重点是分类后的状态；练习 ktieb ikklassifikat bħala rumanz，表示归为小说的书。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of clicking a button, link, or other control to select something or make it work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 点击按钮、链接或其他操作控件，以选中某项内容或执行某个操作的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tagħfas buttuna, ħolqa jew kontroll ieħor biex tagħżel xi ħaġa jew tibda operazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点击或按下按钮、链接等操作控件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħfas buttuna, ħolqa jew kontroll ieħor biex tagħżel xi ħaġa jew tagħti kmand.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you click or press a control, you activate it to select something or carry out an operation.

formal.mt: Biex tiftaħ il-formola tal-applikazzjoni, ikklikkja fuq il-ħolqa fil-qiegħ tal-paġna.
formal.en: To open the application form, click on the link at the bottom of the page.
formal.zh: 要打开申请表，请点击页面底部的链接。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif niftaħ dan id-dokument? Mark: Ikklikkja fuq il-ħolqa blu ħdejn it-titlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I open this document? Mark: Click on the blue link next to the title.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个文档怎么打开？Mark：点击标题旁边的蓝色链接。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个文档怎么打开？
messages.en: How do I open this document?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikklikkja fuq il-ħolqa blu ħdejn it-titlu.
messages.mt_standard: Ikklikkja fuq il-ħolqa blu ħdejn it-titlu.
messages.zh: 点击标题旁边的蓝色链接。
messages.en: Click on the blue link next to the title.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和屏幕上的蓝色链接一起记：看到“ikklikkja fuq”，就想象手指点击后面的目标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remember and honour a person or an important event through a ceremony, activity, or public expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过仪式、活动或公开表达来纪念某个人或某件重要事件，并向其表示敬意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifakkar persuna jew ġrajja importanti u jagħtiha ġieħ permezz ta' ċerimonja, attività jew espressjoni pubblika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过纪念仪式、活动等方式缅怀某人或纪念某件重要事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ifakkar persuna jew ġrajja importanti b'ċerimonja, attività jew ġest li juri rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone commemorates a person or an event, they mark its importance through an activity or expression of respect.

formal.mt: Il-mużew ikkommemora l-anniversarju tal-ftuħ tiegħu b'wirja speċjali dwar l-istorja tal-belt.
formal.en: The museum commemorated the anniversary of its opening with a special exhibition about the city's history.
formal.zh: 博物馆举办了一场关于城市历史的特别展览，纪念开馆周年。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex kien hemm dik iċ-ċerimonja lbieraħ? Pawlu: Il-kunsill ikkommemora l-vittmi tal-inċident.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why was there that ceremony yesterday? Pawlu: The council commemorated the victims of the accident.
colloquial.zh: Lara：昨天为什么举行那个仪式？Pawlu：地方议会举行了仪式，悼念那次事故的遇难者。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kien hemm dik iċ-ċerimonja lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kien hemm dik iċ-ċerimonja lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 昨天为什么举行那个仪式？
messages.en: Why was there that ceremony yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 地方议会举行了仪式，悼念那次事故的遇难者。
messages.en: The council commemorated the victims of the accident.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“纪念仪式”的画面中记忆：周年展览、献花悼念，都可以帮助联想其纪念含义。

gloss_zh: 犯下；做出（错误或违法行为）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do something wrong or illegal, such as making an error or carrying out a crime.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做出错误或违法的行为，例如犯错或犯罪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ħażina jew illegali, bħal żball jew reat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯下错误、罪行等不当或违法行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iwettaq att ħażin jew illegali, jew jagħmel żball.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone commits a crime or an error, they carry out that crime or make that error.

formal.mt: L-awtur ikkommetta żball fil-kalkolu tat-total u ppubblika verżjoni kkoreġuta tar-rapport.
formal.en: The author made an error in calculating the total and published a corrected version of the report.
formal.zh: 作者在计算总数时犯了一个错误，并发布了报告的修订版。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex it-total fuq il-kont huwa ħażin? David: Mark ikkommetta żball fil-kalkolu, imma diġà kkoreġieh.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is the total on the bill wrong? David: Mark made a calculation error, but he has already corrected it.
colloquial.zh: Anna：账单上的总数为什么不对？David：Mark算错了，不过他已经改好了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-total fuq il-kont huwa ħażin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-total fuq il-kont huwa ħażin?
messages.zh: 账单上的总数为什么不对？
messages.en: Why is the total on the bill wrong?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark ikkommetta żball fil-kalkolu, imma diġà kkoreġieh.
messages.mt_standard: Mark ikkommetta żball fil-kalkolu, imma diġà kkoreġieh.
messages.zh: Mark算错了，不过他已经改好了。
messages.en: Mark made a calculation error, but he has already corrected it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个宾语帮助记忆：接“żball”想到犯错，接“reat”想到犯罪，把整个搭配一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To share or exchange information, ideas, or feelings with another person through speech, writing, or other means.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过说话、书写或其他方式，与他人分享或交换信息、想法或感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqsam jew jiskambja informazzjoni, ideat jew sentimenti ma' persuna oħra permezz tal-kliem, tal-kitba jew ta' mezzi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过语言、文字或其他方式传达信息，或与他人交流想法和感受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iwassal informazzjoni, ideat jew sentimenti lil ħaddieħor, jew jiskambjahom miegħu, bil-kliem, bil-kitba jew b'mezzi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you communicate with someone, you share information, thoughts, or feelings with them through words or other signals.

formal.mt: Id-direttur ikkommunika d-deċiżjoni lill-impjegati permezz ta' ittra uffiċjali.
formal.en: The director communicated the decision to the employees through an official letter.
formal.zh: 主管通过正式信函向员工传达了这项决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min tkellem mal-klijenti dwar id-dewmien? Daniel: Pawlu ikkommunika magħhom dalgħodu u spjega kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who spoke to the customers about the delay? Daniel: Pawlu communicated with them this morning and explained everything.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁跟客户说了延误的事？Daniel：Pawlu今天早上跟他们沟通过，把事情都解释清楚了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁跟客户说了延误的事？
messages.en: Who spoke to the customers about the delay?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ikkommunika magħhom dalgħodu u spjega kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ikkommunika magħhom dalgħodu u spjega kollox.
messages.zh: Pawlu今天早上跟他们沟通过，把事情都解释清楚了。
messages.en: Pawlu communicated with them this morning and explained everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象信息从一个人传到另一个人：与客户沟通、向员工传达决定，都用这个词串联记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take part in a contest or try to achieve something that others also want.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加比赛，或与他人争取同一奖项、机会或目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu sehem f'kompetizzjoni jew jipprova jikseb premju, opportunità jew riżultat li oħrajn ukoll jixtiequ jiksbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加竞赛；与他人竞争以争取胜利、机会或其他目标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu sehem f'tellieqa jew kompetizzjoni, jew jagħmel sforz biex jikseb xi ħaġa li oħrajn ukoll qed jippruvaw jiksbu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you compete, you take part in a contest or try to succeed against other people.

collocations.zh: 与其他运动员进行了比赛

formal.mt: L-atleta ikkompeta fit-tellieqa nazzjonali u temmha fit-tielet post.
formal.en: The athlete competed in the national race and finished in third place.
formal.zh: 这名运动员参加了全国赛跑，并获得第三名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk ikkompeta lbieraħ? Mark: Iva, ikkompeta kontra atleti minn tliet klabbs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did your brother compete yesterday? Mark: Yes, he competed against athletes from three clubs.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你兄弟昨天参加比赛了吗？Mark：参加了，他和来自三个俱乐部的运动员同场竞技。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟昨天参加比赛了吗？
messages.en: Did your brother compete yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ikkompeta kontra atleti minn tliet klabbs.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ikkompeta kontra atleti minn tliet klabbs.
messages.zh: 参加了，他和来自三个俱乐部的运动员同场竞技。
messages.en: Yes, he competed against athletes from three clubs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikkompeta 放进赛跑画面：站上起跑线，与其他选手争取好名次，就能记住“参加比赛、竞争”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To create a piece of music by choosing and arranging its notes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过构思和编排音符来创作旋律、歌曲或其他乐曲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħloq melodija, kanzunetta jew biċċa mużika billi jagħżel u jirranġa n-noti tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作曲；创作歌曲或其他音乐作品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jikteb jew joħloq biċċa mużika billi jorganizza n-noti, ir-ritmu u l-melodija tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you compose music, you create it by arranging notes into a musical work.

formal.mt: Il-kompożitur ikkompona biċċa mużika ġdida għall-kunċert tal-iskola.
formal.en: The composer composed a new piece of music for the school concert.
formal.zh: 这位作曲家为学校音乐会创作了一首新乐曲。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ikkompona din il-melodija? Pawlu: Ħija ikkomponieha, u jien ktibt il-kliem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who composed this melody? Pawlu: My brother composed it, and I wrote the lyrics.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这段旋律是谁创作的？Pawlu：我兄弟作的曲，我写的歌词。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这段旋律是谁创作的？
messages.en: Who composed this melody?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ikkomponieha, u jien ktibt il-kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ikkomponieha, u jien ktibt il-kliem.
messages.zh: 我兄弟作的曲，我写的歌词。
messages.en: My brother composed it, and I wrote the lyrics.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己把零散音符排成一段旋律，再配上歌词；用“音符排好，乐曲诞生”的画面记住 ikkompona。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To understand what something means or become aware of a fact or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 理解某事的含义，或意识到某个事实或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifhem it-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa jew jagħraf fatt jew sitwazzjoni li qabel ma kienx konxju tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理解；明白话语、说明、问题等的含义或道理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jifhem it-tifsira ta' kliem, spjegazzjoni jew sitwazzjoni u jagħraf x'qed jiġi espress jew x'inhu jiġri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you understand something, you grasp its meaning or see how and why it happens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意识到；开始察觉或认识到某个事实或情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isir konxju ta' fatt jew sitwazzjoni u jagħraf xi ħaġa li qabel ma kienx induna biha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you realize something, you become aware of a fact that you had not previously recognized.

collocations.en: realized that he had made a mistake

formal.mt: Wara li qara l-istruzzjonijiet, l-istudent ikkomprenda l-proċedura u mbagħad ikkomprenda li kien ħalla barra pass importanti.
formal.en: After reading the instructions, the student understood the procedure and then realized that he had left out an important step.
formal.zh: 读完说明后，这名学生理解了操作流程，随后意识到自己漏掉了一个重要步骤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark ikkomprenda l-ispjegazzjoni tiegħek? Nina: Iva, u mbagħad ikkomprenda li kien uża n-numru ħażin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark understand your explanation? Nina: Yes, and then he realized that he had used the wrong number.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 听懂你的解释了吗？Nina：听懂了，然后他意识到自己用错了数字。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: Mark 听懂你的解释了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark understand your explanation?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u mbagħad ikkomprenda li kien uża n-numru ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u mbagħad ikkomprenda li kien uża n-numru ħażin.
messages.zh: 听懂了，然后他意识到自己用错了数字。
messages.en: Yes, and then he realized that he had used the wrong number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两格漫画记住 ikkomprenda：第一格“听懂解释”，第二格“发现自己算错”；分别对应“理解”和“意识到”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something more concentrated or concise, or to change a gas into liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使内容更精简或使物质更浓缩；也指使气体凝结成液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar ikkonċentrata jew iqassar test mingħajr ma jneħħi l-punti ewlenin; jista' wkoll ibiddel gass f'likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浓缩或精简某物；也指使气体凝结成液体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel sustanza aktar ikkonċentrata, iqassar il-kontenut ta' test, jew ibiddel gass f'likwidu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you condense something, you make it more concentrated or concise, or change it from a gas into a liquid.

formal.mt: L-awtur ikkondensa r-rapport f'żewġ paġni u żamm il-konklużjonijiet ewlenin.
formal.en: The author condensed the report into two pages and retained the main conclusions.
formal.zh: 作者把报告精简为两页，并保留了主要结论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-artiklu twil wisq. Mark: Għall-preżentazzjoni, Pawlu ikkondensa kollox f'ħames punti.
colloquial.en: Maja: This article is too long. Mark: For the presentation, Pawlu condensed everything into five points.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章太长了。Mark：为了做演示，Pawlu把全部内容精简成了五个要点。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文章太长了。
messages.en: This article is too long.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-preżentazzjoni, Pawlu ikkondensa kollox f'ħames punti.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-preżentazzjoni, Pawlu ikkondensa kollox f'ħames punti.
messages.zh: 为了做演示，Pawlu把全部内容精简成了五个要点。
messages.en: For the presentation, Pawlu condensed everything into five points.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长报告缩成两页、把水蒸气凝成水滴这两个画面放在一起，记住它们都体现了“凝聚、浓缩”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Established as true or certain, or definitely arranged after checking or agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过核实而确定属实的，或经确认已正式安排好的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie vverifikat bħala veru jew ċert, jew li ġie stabbilit bħala arranġament definittiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被核实为真实或确定的；已得到明确确认的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie ċċekkjat u aċċettat bħala veru jew ċert, jew li ġie approvat bħala arranġament definittiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is confirmed has been checked and established as true, certain, or definitely arranged.

formal.mt: L-appuntament huwa ikkonfermat għal nhar it-Tlieta fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The appointment is confirmed for Tuesday at ten in the morning.
formal.zh: 预约已确认在星期二上午十点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: L-appuntament ta' għada huwa ikkonfermat? Luqa: Iva, għadni kemm irċevejt il-messaġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is tomorrow's appointment confirmed? Luqa: Yes, I've just received the message.
colloquial.zh: Sara：明天的预约确认了吗？Luqa：确认了，我刚收到消息。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天的预约确认了吗？
messages.en: Is tomorrow's appointment confirmed?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 确认了，我刚收到消息。
messages.en: Yes, I've just received the message.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预约旁边打上一个确认勾：ikkonfermat描述的是“已经确认”的状态，可连同整个短语一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To admit something wrong or embarrassing that one has done, or to acknowledge one's sins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坦白自己做过的错误或令人难堪的事情；也指承认自己的罪过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jammetti xi ħaġa ħażina jew imbarazzanti li jkun għamel, jew jistqarr dnubietu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坦白或承认自己的过错、隐瞒之事或罪过。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jistqarr il-verità dwar xi ħaġa ħażina li jkun għamel jew jammetti dnubietu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone confesses, they admit something wrong they have done or acknowledge their sins.

formal.mt: Fl-istqarrija tiegħu, l-impjegat ikkonfessa li kien biddel iċ-ċifri fir-rapport.
formal.en: In his statement, the employee confessed that he had changed the figures in the report.
formal.zh: 这名员工在声明中坦白，他曾修改报告中的数字。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min kiel l-aħħar biċċa kejk? Ben: Jien! Diġà ikkonfessajt lil ommi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who ate the last piece of cake? Ben: I did! I've already confessed to my mother.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁吃了最后一块蛋糕？Ben：是我！我已经向妈妈坦白了。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 谁吃了最后一块蛋糕？
messages.en: Who ate the last piece of cake?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.zh: 是我！我已经向妈妈坦白了。
messages.en: I did! I've already confessed to my mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象偷吃蛋糕后举手说“是我吃的”：把主动说出自己过错的场景与ikkonfessa联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The relationship between adjoining areas that touch along a shared boundary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个区域边界相接、彼此毗邻的关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-relazzjoni bejn żewġ żoni li jmissu ma' xulxin u għandhom konfini komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与另一地区接壤或毗邻的关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' żona li tmiss ma' żona oħra jew għandha konfini komuni magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If one area borders on another, the two areas touch along a shared boundary.

formal.mt: Skont il-pjanta l-antika, it-terren ikkonfina ma' triq pubblika fuq in-naħa tat-tramuntana.
formal.en: According to the old plan, the plot bordered on a public road on its northern side.
formal.zh: 根据旧平面图，这块土地的北侧与一条公共道路相邻。

colloquial.mt: Rita: It-terren tan-nannu kien imiss mal-ġnien tagħkom? Toni: Iva, ikkonfina mal-ġnien tagħna għal ħafna snin.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did Grandpa's plot adjoin your garden? Toni: Yes, it bordered on our garden for many years.
colloquial.zh: Rita：爷爷的那块地以前挨着你们的花园吗？Toni：对，它与我们花园相邻很多年了。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: It-terren tan-nannu kien imiss mal-ġnien tagħkom?
messages.mt_standard: It-terren tan-nannu kien imiss mal-ġnien tagħkom?
messages.zh: 爷爷的那块地以前挨着你们的花园吗？
messages.en: Did Grandpa's plot adjoin your garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ikkonfina mal-ġnien tagħna għal ħafna snin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ikkonfina mal-ġnien tagħna għal ħafna snin.
messages.zh: 对，它与我们花园相邻很多年了。
messages.en: Yes, it bordered on our garden for many years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画两块共用一条边界的土地，把ikkonfina与“边界相接”的图像联系起来，连同ma'一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take someone's property officially, usually because it is prohibited or connected with an offence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由有权机关正式收走某人的财物，通常因为物品违禁或与违法行为有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li awtorità tieħu mingħand xi ħadd oġġetti jew proprjetà, ġeneralment għax huma pprojbiti jew marbuta ma' ksur tal-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由有权机关没收或扣押某人的财物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li awtorità tieħu u żżomm oġġetti jew proprjetà mingħand xi ħadd minħabba regola jew liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an authority confiscates something, it officially takes it away from the person who possesses it.

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal ikkonfiska l-oġġetti pprojbiti li nstabu fil-bagalja.
formal.en: The officer confiscated the prohibited items found in the suitcase.
formal.zh: 该官员没收了在行李箱中发现的违禁物品。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu s-sikkina li kellek fil-basket? Lara: L-uffiċjal ikkonfiska s-sikkina fid-daħla għax ma setgħetx tidħol biha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the knife you had in your bag? Lara: The officer confiscated the knife at the entrance because you weren't allowed to take it inside.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你包里的那把刀呢？Lara：入口处的官员把刀没收了，因为不允许带进去。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu s-sikkina li kellek fil-basket?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi s-sikkina li kellek fil-basket?
messages.zh: 你包里的那把刀呢？
messages.en: Where is the knife you had in your bag?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-uffiċjal ikkonfiska s-sikkina fid-daħla għax ma setgħetx tidħol biha.
messages.mt_standard: L-uffiċjal ikkonfiska s-sikkina fid-daħla għax ma setgħetx tidħol biha.
messages.zh: 入口处的官员把刀没收了，因为不允许带进去。
messages.en: The officer confiscated the knife at the entrance because you weren't allowed to take it inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“官员收走违禁物品”的画面一起记，重点记住带有权力依据的“没收”动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To plan secretly with other people to do something harmful or unlawful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人秘密商议并策划有害或违法的行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiftiehem bil-moħbi ma' nies oħra biex tagħmel xi ħaġa ta' ħsara jew kontra l-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与他人秘密合谋，策划有害或违法的行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tippjana bil-moħbi ma' persuni oħra biex twettaq xi ħaġa ħażina jew illegali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people conspire, they secretly agree to work together on a harmful or unlawful plan.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-grupp ikkonfoffa biex jisraq dokumenti kunfidenzjali mill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The report describes how the group conspired to steal confidential documents from the office.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该团伙如何合谋窃取办公室里的机密文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex keċċew lil dak l-impjegat? Pawlu: Skont ir-rapport, ikkonfoffa ma' żewġ kollegi biex jisraq flus mill-kumpanija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did they dismiss that employee? Pawlu: According to the report, he conspired with two colleagues to steal money from the company.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他们为什么解雇那个员工？Pawlu：据报告说，他和两名同事合谋盗取公司的钱。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 他们为什么解雇那个员工？
messages.en: Why did they dismiss that employee?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont ir-rapport, ikkonfoffa ma' żewġ kollegi biex jisraq flus mill-kumpanija.
messages.mt_standard: Skont ir-rapport, ikkonfoffa ma' żewġ kollegi biex jisraq flus mill-kumpanija.
messages.zh: 据报告说，他和两名同事合谋盗取公司的钱。
messages.en: According to the report, he conspired with two colleagues to steal money from the company.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“三个人关门商量坏事”的画面记忆；ma' 提示合谋的同伴，kontra 提示密谋针对的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To puzzle someone, mix up different things, or become confused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人难以理解，把不同事物弄混，或自己感到困惑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tħawwad lil xi ħadd, tieħu ħaġa b'oħra, jew titħawwad inti stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人因问题难以理解或解决而困惑；难倒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tħawwad lil xi ħadd tant li ma jkunx jista' jifhem jew isolvi xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something baffles you, it is so difficult or puzzling that you cannot understand or explain it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人弄不清楚，或把不同的人、事物或信息混淆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tagħmel lil xi ħadd ma jibqax jifhem ċar, jew tieħu persuna jew ħaġa b'oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you confuse someone, you make their understanding unclear; if you confuse two things, you mistake one for the other.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己感到困惑或糊涂，无法清楚理解情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tħossok imħawwad u ma tkunx tista' tifhem sew dak li qed jiġri jew jingħad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you feel confused, you find it difficult to understand a situation or think clearly about it.

formal.mt: It-test ikkonfonda lil diversi studenti minħabba l-istruzzjonijiet mhux ċari.
formal.en: The test confused several students because its instructions were unclear.
formal.zh: 这份试卷的说明不清楚，使几名学生感到困惑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark mar fil-kamra l-ħażina? Lara: Ikkonfonda ż-żewġ numri fuq il-biljett u mar fil-kamra tnax minflok fil-kamra wieħed u għoxrin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark go to the wrong room? Lara: He mixed up the two numbers on the ticket and went to room twelve instead of room twenty-one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么去了错误的房间？Lara：他把票上的两个数字弄混了，去了十二号房间，本来应该去二十一号。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么去了错误的房间？
messages.en: Why did Mark go to the wrong room?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkonfonda ż-żewġ numri fuq il-biljett u mar fil-kamra tnax minflok fil-kamra wieħed u għoxrin.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkonfonda ż-żewġ numri fuq il-biljett u mar fil-kamra tnax minflok fil-kamra wieħed u għoxrin.
messages.zh: 他把票上的两个数字弄混了，去了十二号房间，本来应该去二十一号。
messages.en: He mixed up the two numbers on the ticket and went to room twelve instead of room twenty-one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张写着“12”和“21”的房卡串联三义：题目难倒人、把号码弄混、自己感到糊涂；读句子时留意是谁困惑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express pleasure at someone's success or good fortune and offer them good wishes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人取得成就或遇到喜事而向其表达喜悦和祝愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Turi lil xi ħadd li tifraħ bis-suċċess tiegħu jew b'xi ġrajja sabiħa f'ħajtu, u tagħtih l-awguri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某人取得成功或遇到喜事而向其表示祝贺。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti l-awguri lil xi ħadd għal suċċess li kiseb jew għal xi ġrajja sabiħa f'ħajtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you congratulate someone, you tell them that you are pleased about their success or good fortune.

collocations.mt: tikkongratula lil xi ħadd għas-suċċess tiegħu
collocations.en: to congratulate someone on their success
to congratulate the winner of the competition
collocations.zh: 向比赛获胜者表示祝贺

formal.mt: Id-direttur ikkongratula lill-istudenti għar-riżultati eċċellenti tagħhom fl-eżamijiet.
formal.en: The director congratulated the students on their excellent examination results.
formal.zh: 主任祝贺学生们在考试中取得优异成绩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaddejt mill-eżami tas-sewqan! Mark: Prosit! Nifraħlek! Missierek ikkongratulak ukoll? Maja: Iva, u llejla se niċċelebraw flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I passed my driving test! Mark: Well done! Congratulations! Did your father congratulate you too? Maja: Yes, and tonight we're going to celebrate together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我通过驾照考试了！Mark：真棒！恭喜你！你爸爸也祝贺你了吗？Maja：是的，今晚我们还要一起庆祝。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我通过驾照考试了！
messages.en: I passed my driving test!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 真棒！恭喜你！你爸爸也祝贺你了吗？
messages.en: Well done! Congratulations! Did your father congratulate you too?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u llejla se niċċelebraw flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u llejla se niċċelebraw flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，今晚我们还要一起庆祝。
messages.en: Yes, and tonight we're going to celebrate together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友通过驾照考试，你先说一句恭喜，再问候他的家人；把 ikkongratula 和“向某人祝贺某件喜事”这个完整场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reach a judgment after considering information, or to bring an activity or piece of work to an end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 考虑有关信息后作出判断，或使一项活动、工作告一段落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tasal għal ġudizzju wara li tqis l-informazzjoni, jew iġġib attività jew biċċa xogħol fi tmiemha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经思考或分析后得出结论；也可指结束活动或完成工作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tasal għal konklużjoni wara li taħseb fuq il-fatti, jew ittemm attività jew biċċa xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you conclude something, you reach a judgment after considering the facts, or bring an activity to an end.

collocations.en: to conclude that there is a problem
to bring the meeting to a close

formal.mt: Wara li eżamina r-riżultati kollha, il-kumitat ikkonkluda li kien hemm bżonn ta' aktar riċerka.
formal.en: After examining all the results, the committee concluded that further research was needed.
formal.zh: 审查全部结果后，委员会得出结论：还需要进一步研究。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark ikkonkluda r-rapport? David: Iva, bagħtu dalgħodu. Sara: Tajjeb, mela nistgħu naqrawh qabel il-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Mark finished the report? David: Yes, he sent it this morning. Sara: Good, then we can read it before the meeting.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 把报告完成了吗？David：完成了，他今天早上发出去了。Sara：好，那我们可以在开会前读一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: Mark 把报告完成了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark finished the report?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 完成了，他今天早上发出去了。
messages.en: Yes, he sent it this morning.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, mela nistgħu naqrawh qabel il-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, mela nistgħu naqrawh qabel il-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 好，那我们可以在开会前读一下。
messages.en: Good, then we can read it before the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放在两个终点上记：思考走到终点，就是得出结论；报告写到终点，就是完成报告。看到 li 引出的内容时，可留意是否在说明结论。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take part in a competition, or to be present at an organized function or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加比赛或竞争；也可指出席有组织的活动或典礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieħu sehem f'kompetizzjoni jew f'konkors, jew tkun preżenti għal xi attività jew ċerimonja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加比赛或竞争，与其他参与者争取胜出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieħu sehem f'kompetizzjoni jew f'konkors u tipprova tirbaħ kontra parteċipanti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you compete, you take part in a contest and try to do better than the other participants.

sense_translations.en_definition: to attend (e.g. a function or event)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 到场参加某项活动、典礼或其他集会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tmur għal xi attività, ċerimonja jew laqgħa u tkun preżenti waqt li din tkun qed issir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you attend an event, you go to the place where it is held and are present for it.

collocations.en: to compete in a sporting competition
to compete in a singing contest

formal.mt: Il-grupp ikkonkorra għaċ-ċerimonja tal-għoti tal-premjijiet, li saret fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The group attended the awards ceremony, which was held in the main hall.
formal.zh: 该团体出席了在主大厅举行的颁奖典礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ikkonkorra fil-konkors tal-kant ilbieraħ? Sara: Iva, u rebaħ it-tieni premju! Maja: Kemm hu sabiħ! Irrid nifraħlu.
