colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark compete in the singing contest yesterday? Sara: Yes, and he won second prize! Maja: That's lovely! I want to congratulate him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 昨天参加歌唱比赛了吗？Sara：参加了，而且获得了二等奖！Maja：太好了！我要祝贺他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 昨天参加歌唱比赛了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark compete in the singing contest yesterday?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 参加了，而且获得了二等奖！
messages.en: Yes, and he won second prize!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 太好了！我要祝贺他。
messages.en: That's lovely! I want to congratulate him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人先上台参加歌唱比赛，再到礼堂出席颁奖典礼：前一幕是竞争，后一幕是出席。用这两幅画面分别记住 ikkonkorra 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join things together or establish a link between a device and another device, system, or network.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事物相互连接，或使设备与另一设备、系统或网络建立连接。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad affarijiet flimkien jew tagħmel konnessjoni bejn apparat u apparat ieħor, sistema jew netwerk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使两个或多个事物相连，或使设备接入另一设备、系统或网络。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad żewġ affarijiet jew aktar, jew tagħmel konnessjoni biex apparat ikun jista' jaħdem ma' apparat ieħor, sistema jew netwerk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you connect two things, you join them or establish a link that allows them to work together.

collocations.en: to connect the computer to the internet
to connect the phone to the computer
to connect the printer to the network

formal.mt: David ikkonnettja l-istampatur man-netwerk tal-uffiċċju sabiex l-impjegati jkunu jistgħu jistampaw mid-diversi kompjuters tagħhom.
formal.en: David connected the printer to the office network so that employees could print from their various computers.
formal.zh: David 把打印机接入办公室网络，以便员工从各自的电脑发送打印任务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark ikkonnettja t-telefon mal-kompjuter? David: Iva, bil-kejbil. Issa jista' jittrasferixxi r-ritratti. Sara: Tajjeb, għandi xi ritratti x'nibgħatlu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Mark connected the phone to the computer? David: Yes, with the cable. Now he can transfer the photos. Sara: Good, I have some photos to send him.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 把手机连上电脑了吗？David：连上了，用的是连接线。现在他可以传输照片了。Sara：好，我有些照片要发给他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 把手机连上电脑了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark connected the phone to the computer?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bil-kejbil. Issa jista' jittrasferixxi r-ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bil-kejbil. Issa jista' jittrasferixxi r-ritratti.
messages.zh: 连上了，用的是连接线。现在他可以传输照片了。
messages.en: Yes, with the cable. Now he can transfer the photos.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我有些照片要发给他。
messages.en: Good, I have some photos to send him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根连接线把手机和电脑连起来，照片随后传到电脑上。用“两个端点建立连接”的画面记住 ikkonnettja，再练习说清连接什么、连接到哪里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep something in good condition or protect resources from damage and waste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物保持良好状态，或保护资源，使其免遭损坏和浪费。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm xi ħaġa f'kundizzjoni tajba jew jipproteġi r-riżorsi mill-ħsara u mill-ħela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保存或维护某物，使其保持原有状态而不受损坏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iżomm xi ħaġa fl-istat tagħha u jipproteġiha milli ssirilha ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone preserves something, they protect it so that it remains in good condition.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保护并谨慎使用资源，避免消耗过多或造成浪费。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jipproteġi r-riżorsi u jużahom bil-għaqal biex inaqqas il-ħela u l-konsum żejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone conserves resources, they use them carefully to prevent waste or unnecessary loss.

formal.mt: Il-mużew ikkonserva d-dokumenti antiki billi ħażinhom f'kundizzjonijiet xierqa.
formal.en: The museum preserved the old documents by storing them under suitable conditions.
formal.zh: 博物馆通过将旧文献存放在适宜的环境中来保存它们。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tiġbor l-ilma tax-xita? Pawlu: Biex nikkonserva l-ilma; nużah għat-tisqija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you collecting rainwater? Pawlu: To conserve water; I use it for watering.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在收集雨水？保罗：为了节约用水；我用它来浇灌。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么在收集雨水？
messages.en: Why are you collecting rainwater?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 为了节约用水；我用它来浇灌。
messages.en: To conserve water; I use it for watering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把旧文献放进保护盒，再把雨水收进水桶：两个画面分别帮助记住“保存物品”和“节约资源”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To think about something carefully, especially before forming a judgment or making a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认真思考某事，尤其指在作出判断或决定之前加以考虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħseb sew dwar xi ħaġa, speċjalment qabel ma jifforma ġudizzju jew jieħu deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 考虑某事，权衡有关情况后再作判断或决定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaħseb dwar xi ħaġa u jiżen iċ-ċirkostanzi marbuta magħha qabel ma jiġġudika jew jiddeċiedi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you consider something, you think about it before deciding what to do or believe.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 认真回想或反思某件事，以理解其意义或影响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaħseb bir-reqqa dwar xi ħaġa li ġrat jew dwar esperjenza biex jifhem it-tifsira jew l-effetti tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you reflect on something, you think carefully about its meaning or what you can learn from it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某个问题或想法作持续而深入的思考。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaħseb fit-tul u fil-fond dwar mistoqsija, problema jew idea.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you ponder something, you spend time thinking deeply about it.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ikkonsidra l-ispejjeż u l-benefiċċji tal-proposta qabel ma ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee considered the costs and benefits of the proposal before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出决定前考虑了该提议的成本和效益。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se taċċetta x-xogħol il-ġdid? Mark: Għadni ma ddeċidejtx; irrid nikkonsidra l-ħin tal-vjaġġ ukoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you going to accept the new job? Mark: I haven't decided yet; I need to consider the travel time too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你打算接受那份新工作吗？马克：我还没决定；我也得考虑通勤时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算接受那份新工作吗？
messages.en: Are you going to accept the new job?

messages.speaker: Mark (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma ddeċidejtx; irrid nikkonsidra l-ħin tal-vjaġġ ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma ddeċidejtx; irrid nikkonsidra l-ħin tal-vjaġġ ukoll.
messages.zh: 我还没决定；我也得考虑通勤时间。
messages.en: I haven't decided yet; I need to consider the travel time too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作决定前先停一下：权衡选项是“考虑”，回看经历是“反思”，围绕难题久久思索是“深思”。

gloss_zh: 被考虑到的；经过思考的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Taken into account or examined thoughtfully when forming a judgment or making a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在形成判断或作出决定时被纳入考虑，或已经过认真思考的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tqies jew ġie eżaminat bir-reqqa waqt il-formazzjoni ta' ġudizzju jew it-teħid ta' deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被纳入考虑或经过认真思考的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie meqjus jew li sar ħsieb bir-reqqa dwaru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is considered has been taken into account or given careful thought.

formal.mt: L-impatt fuq l-ambjent kien aspett ikkonsidrat bir-reqqa waqt l-evalwazzjoni tal-proġett.
formal.en: The environmental impact was an aspect carefully considered during the evaluation of the project.
formal.zh: 对环境的影响是项目评估过程中经过仔细考虑的一个方面。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-prezz kien l-uniku fattur ikkonsidrat? David: Le, qisna l-kwalità wkoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was price the only factor considered? David: No, we took quality into account too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：价格是唯一被考虑的因素吗？戴维：不是，我们也考虑了质量。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 价格是唯一被考虑的因素吗？
messages.en: Was price the only factor considered?

messages.speaker: David (购买者)
messages.zh: 不是，我们也考虑了质量。
messages.en: No, we took quality into account too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在购物清单的“价格”和“质量”旁画上勾：打勾的项目就是“已被考虑的”，帮助记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a particular activity, quality, or fact as its essential nature or content.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某事的实质或内容在于某种活动、性质或事实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu l-qofol jew il-kontenut tiegħu f'ċerta attività, kwalità jew fatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实质在于某事，或以某种活动、性质等为主要内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollu n-natura essenzjali jew il-kontenut tiegħu f'xi ħaġa jew f'xi attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something consists in an activity or quality, that activity or quality forms its essential nature.

formal.mt: Il-kompitu ikkonsista fil-ġbir u fl-analiżi tad-data dwar l-użu tal-ilma.
formal.en: The task consisted in collecting and analysing data on water use.
formal.zh: 这项任务的内容是收集和分析用水数据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fiex ikkonsista x-xogħol tiegħek illum? Pawlu: Fil-qari tar-rapporti u fil-kitba ta' sommarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did your work consist in today? Pawlu: Reading the reports and writing a summary.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天的工作内容是什么？保罗：阅读报告，再写一份摘要。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天的工作内容是什么？
messages.en: What did your work consist in today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (上班族)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-qari tar-rapporti u fil-kitba ta' sommarju.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-qari tar-rapporti u fil-kitba ta' sommarju.
messages.zh: 阅读报告，再写一份摘要。
messages.en: Reading the reports and writing a summary.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先问“这件事的内容是什么”，再接具体活动：任务在于收集资料，工作在于阅读报告，借此记住“在于”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give comfort to someone who is sad, disappointed, or distressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予悲伤、失望或苦恼的人关怀和支持，使其得到安慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti faraġ u appoġġ lil xi ħadd li jkun imdejjaq, diżappuntat jew imnikket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安慰因悲伤、失望或痛苦而难过的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti faraġ lil persuna li tkun qed tbati minn niket jew diżappunt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you console someone, you comfort them when they are unhappy or disappointed.

formal.mt: Wara li tħabbar ir-riżultat, l-għalliem ikkonsla lill-istudent u fakkru li seta' jerġa' jipprova.
formal.en: After the result was announced, the teacher comforted the student and reminded him that he could try again.
formal.zh: 结果公布后，老师安慰了那名学生，并提醒他还可以再试一次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhi oħtok wara l-eżami? Mark: Kienet imdejqa, imma missieri ikkonslaha. Maja: Tajjeb li sabet lil xi ħadd jismagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your sister after the exam? Mark: She was upset, but my father comforted her. Maja: It's good that she found someone to listen to her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你妹妹考完试后怎么样？马克：她本来很难过，不过我爸爸安慰了她。玛雅：有人愿意听她说说，真好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你妹妹考完试后怎么样？
messages.en: How is your sister after the exam?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 她本来很难过，不过我爸爸安慰了她。
messages.en: She was upset, but my father comforted her.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb li sabet lil xi ħadd jismagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb li sabet lil xi ħadd jismagħha.
messages.zh: 有人愿意听她说说，真好。
messages.en: It's good that she found someone to listen to her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikkonsla 和朋友落泪时递纸巾的画面一起记：先倾听，再安慰，帮助对方缓解难过。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use a supply of something, sometimes until none of it remains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用并消耗某种资源或储备，也可指将其完全耗尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tuża u tnaqqas riżorsa jew provvista, kultant sakemm ma jibqa' xejn minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消耗能源、燃料或其他资源。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tuża ammont ta' enerġija, fjuwil jew riżorsi oħra waqt attività jew proċess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something consumes a resource, it uses an amount of that resource in order to function.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耗尽某种资源或储备，使其不再有剩余。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tuża riżorsa jew provvista kollha sakemm ma jibqa' xejn minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an activity exhausts a supply, it uses all of it so that nothing remains.

formal.mt: Il-ġeneratur ikkonsma ħafna fjuwil matul il-lejl. Sat-tmiem tal-operazzjoni, ikkonsma l-provvista kollha disponibbli.
formal.en: The generator consumed a lot of fuel during the night. By the end of the operation, it had exhausted the entire available supply.
formal.zh: 发电机在夜间消耗了大量燃料。到运行结束时，它已耗尽所有可用的燃料储备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaf il-ġeneratur? Mark: Ikkonsma l-fjuwil kollu li kellna. Maja: Mela rridu nixtru aktar fjuwil.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the generator stop? Mark: It used up all the fuel we had. Maja: Then we need to buy more fuel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：发电机怎么停了？马克：它把我们的燃料全耗光了。玛雅：那我们得再买些燃料。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 发电机怎么停了？
messages.en: Why did the generator stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它把我们的燃料全耗光了。
messages.en: It used up all the fuel we had.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们得再买些燃料。
messages.en: Then we need to buy more fuel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikkonsma 想成不断下降的油量表：下降表示消耗，降到零表示耗尽；用这幅画面区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To seek advice or information from a person or a reference source.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人征求意见或获取信息，或查阅资料以获得所需信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlob parir jew informazzjoni mingħand persuna, jew tfittex informazzjoni f'sors ta' referenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人咨询或征询意见；查阅参考资料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titlob il-parir jew l-opinjoni ta' xi ħadd, jew tirreferi għal ktieb jew dokument biex tikseb informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you consult someone or a reference source, you seek advice or information to help you understand something or make a decision.

formal.mt: Qabel ma ħa deċiżjoni dwar ir-restawr, il-kumitat ikkonsulta espert u eżamina r-rapport tiegħu.
formal.en: Before making a decision about the restoration, the committee consulted an expert and examined his report.
formal.zh: 委员会在就修复工作作出决定之前，咨询了一位专家，并审阅了他的报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sab Mark it-tifsira ta' din il-kelma? Lara: Ikkonsulta d-dizzjunarju li għandna d-dar. Maja: Tajjeb, se nfittex fiha jien ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark find the meaning of this word? Lara: He consulted the dictionary we have at home. Maja: Good, I'll look it up in that dictionary too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克是怎么找到这个词的意思的？拉拉：他查了我们家里的词典。玛雅：好，我也去那本词典里查查。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sab Mark it-tifsira ta' din il-kelma?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sab Mark it-tifsira ta' din il-kelma?
messages.zh: 马克是怎么找到这个词的意思的？
messages.en: How did Mark find the meaning of this word?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他查了我们家里的词典。
messages.en: He consulted the dictionary we have at home.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nfittex fiha jien ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nfittex fiha jien ukoll.
messages.zh: 好，我也去那本词典里查查。
messages.en: Good, I'll look it up in that dictionary too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ikkonsulta 时想象遇到疑问后的两个动作：开口请教专家，翻书查找答案；两者都是寻求信息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dirty, impure, or unsafe by introducing harmful or unwanted substances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使有害或不需要的物质进入某物，导致其受到污染、失去纯净或不再安全。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddaħħal sustanzi ta' ħsara jew mhux mixtieqa f'xi ħaġa u b'hekk tagħmilha mniġġsa, impura jew mhux sigura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使水、食物、土壤等混入有害或不需要的物质而受到污染。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tniġġes ilma, ikel, ħamrija jew xi ħaġa oħra billi ddaħħal fiha sustanzi ta' ħsara jew mhux mixtieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a substance contaminates something, it makes it impure or unsafe by entering it or coming into contact with it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ikkonferma li ż-żejt li nixxa mit-tank ikkontamina l-ħamrija qrib il-maħżen.
formal.en: The report confirmed that oil leaking from the tank had contaminated the soil near the warehouse.
formal.zh: 报告证实，从储油罐泄漏的油污染了仓库附近的土壤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex warrabt dak l-ilma? Mark: Waqa' ftit sapun fih u kkontaminah. Maja: Mela se nġib ilma nadif.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you set that water aside? Mark: Some soap fell into it and contaminated it. Maja: Then I'll get some clean water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把那份水放到一边？马克：有点肥皂掉进去了，把水污染了。玛雅：那我去拿些干净的水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把那份水放到一边？
messages.en: Why did you set that water aside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqa' ftit sapun fih u kkontaminah.
messages.mt_standard: Waqa' ftit sapun fih u kkontaminah.
messages.zh: 有点肥皂掉进去了，把水污染了。
messages.en: Some soap fell into it and contaminated it.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我去拿些干净的水。
messages.en: Then I'll get some clean water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikkонтamina 的含义记成一滴油落入清水的画面：不需要的物质混入，原本干净的东西受到污染。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine financial accounts for accuracy or take responsibility for keeping them in order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 检查财务账目是否准确，或负责整理和管理账务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeżamina l-kontijiet finanzjarji biex jiċċekkja li huma korretti, jew jieħu ħsieb iż-żamma u l-organizzazzjoni tagħhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: to audit or take care of accounts
sense_translations.zh_definition: 审查财务账目，或负责账目的记录、整理和管理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jeżamina l-kontijiet biex jivverifika l-korrettezza tagħhom, jew jieħu ħsieb li jinżammu b'mod ordnat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone audits or takes care of accounts, they check financial records or ensure that those records are properly maintained.

collocations.en: took care of the shop's accounts

formal.mt: L-accountant ikkontja l-kotba tal-assoċjazzjoni u vverifika li kull ħlas kien irreġistrat.
formal.en: The accountant audited the association's books and verified that every payment had been recorded.
formal.zh: 会计审查了协会的账簿，并核实每笔付款都有记录。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ikkontja l-kontijiet tal-ħanut ix-xahar li għadda? Mark: Missieri ħa ħsiebhom; l-irċevuti kollha qegħdin f'dan il-fajl.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who took care of the shop's accounts last month? Mark: My father handled them; all the receipts are in this file.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：上个月是谁管理商店的账务？马克：我爸爸负责的；所有收据都在这个文件夹里。

messages.speaker: Sara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ikkontja l-kontijiet tal-ħanut ix-xahar li għadda?
messages.mt_standard: Min ikkontja l-kontijiet tal-ħanut ix-xahar li għadda?
messages.zh: 上个月是谁管理商店的账务？
messages.en: Who took care of the shop's accounts last month?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri ħa ħsiebhom; l-irċevuti kollha qegħdin f'dan il-fajl.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri ħa ħsiebhom; l-irċevuti kollha qegħdin f'dan il-fajl.
messages.zh: 我爸爸负责的；所有收据都在这个文件夹里。
messages.en: My father handled them; all the receipts are in this file.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“会计翻账簿、逐笔核对收据”的画面中记忆，同时联想审账和管账两个用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To direct or regulate something, or supervise people and activities to ensure that work is done properly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支配或调节某事物，或监督人员及活动，确保工作按要求进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidderieġi jew jirregola xi ħaġa, jew jissorvelja nies u attivitajiet biex jiżgura li x-xogħol isir kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 控制、支配或调节某事物，使其按预期运行或保持在所需状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jidderieġi jew jirregola xi ħaġa biex taħdem jew tibqa' fl-istat mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you control something, you direct how it behaves or regulate the conditions under which it operates.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监督人员或工作过程，确保各项活动正确、有序地进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jissorvelja nies jew xogħol biex jiżgura li l-attivitajiet isiru b'mod korrett u ordnat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you supervise people or an activity, you oversee the work and make sure it is carried out properly.

formal.mt: It-tekniku ikkontrolla t-temperatura tal-magna biex iżommha fil-limiti meħtieġa.
formal.en: The technician controlled the machine's temperature to keep it within the required limits.
formal.zh: 技术员控制了机器的温度，使其保持在规定范围内。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ikkontrolla x-xogħol waqt li kont barra? Mark: Il-kap tat-tim; baqa' mal-ħaddiema sakemm lestew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who supervised the work while I was out? Mark: The team leader; he stayed with the workers until they finished.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我外出的时候，是谁监督工作的？马克：组长；他一直和工人们待在一起，直到他们完工。

messages.speaker: Sara (经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ikkontrolla x-xogħol waqt li kont barra?
messages.mt_standard: Min ikkontrolla x-xogħol waqt li kont barra?
messages.zh: 我外出的时候，是谁监督工作的？
messages.en: Who supervised the work while I was out?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kap tat-tim; baqa' mal-ħaddiema sakemm lestew.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kap tat-tim; baqa' mal-ħaddiema sakemm lestew.
messages.zh: 组长；他一直和工人们待在一起，直到他们完工。
messages.en: The team leader; he stayed with the workers until they finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分词义：调节机器温度是“控制”，在现场查看工人操作是“监督”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change something from one form, type, system, or use into another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某事物从一种形式、类型、体系或用途转变为另一种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibiddel xi ħaġa minn forma, tip, sistema jew użu għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某事物转变为另一种形式、类型、体系或用途。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel bidla f'xi ħaġa sabiex tieħu forma differenti jew tintuża għal skop ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you convert something, you change its form, type, or purpose so that it becomes suitable for a different use or system.

collocations.zh: 把文件转换成了 PDF 格式

collocations.en: converted the garage into an office

formal.mt: L-impjegat ikkonverta d-dokument għal PDF qabel ma bagħtu lill-klijent.
formal.en: The employee converted the document to PDF before sending it to the client.
formal.zh: 员工先把文档转换成 PDF 格式，再发送给客户。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-garaxx għadu jintuża għall-karozza? Mark: Le, missieri ikkonverta l-garaxx f'uffiċċju, u issa jaħdem hemm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the garage still used for the car? Mark: No, my father converted the garage into an office, and now he works there.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：车库还用来停车吗？马克：不用了，我爸爸把车库改成了办公室，现在在那里工作。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 车库还用来停车吗？
messages.en: Is the garage still used for the car?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, missieri ikkonverta l-garaxx f'uffiċċju, u issa jaħdem hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Le, missieri ikkonverta l-garaxx f'uffiċċju, u issa jaħdem hemm.
messages.zh: 不用了，我爸爸把车库改成了办公室，现在在那里工作。
messages.en: No, my father converted the garage into an office, and now he works there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一个“原来形式→新形式”的箭头：文件变成另一格式，车库变成办公室，都能帮助理解转换。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone believe that something is true or agree to do something by giving reasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过提供理由，使某人相信某事属实，或同意采取某项行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jemmen li xi ħaġa hija vera jew jaqbel li jagħmel xi ħaġa billi jagħtih raġunijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用理由或证据使某人信服，或说服某人同意做某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iwassal lil xi ħadd biex jaċċetta idea bħala vera jew jaqbel li jagħmel xi ħaġa permezz ta' raġunijiet jew provi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you convince someone, you give them reasons or evidence that lead them to accept a belief or agree to take action.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ikkonvinċa lill-kumitat li l-proġett kien fattibbli billi ppreżenta provi ċari.
formal.en: The researcher convinced the committee that the project was feasible by presenting clear evidence.
formal.zh: 研究人员提出了明确的证据，使委员会相信该项目可行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ikkonvinċa lil ħuk biex jiġi magħna? Mark: Il-ħabib tiegħu; qallu li se jkun hemm mużika tajba.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who convinced your brother to come with us? Mark: His friend; he told him there would be good music.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：是谁说服你哥哥跟我们一起去的？马克：他的朋友；他说那里会有好听的音乐。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ikkonvinċa lil ħuk biex jiġi magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Min ikkonvinċa lil ħuk biex jiġi magħna?
messages.zh: 是谁说服你哥哥跟我们一起去的？
messages.en: Who convinced your brother to come with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħabib tiegħu; qallu li se jkun hemm mużika tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħabib tiegħu; qallu li se jkun hemm mużika tajba.
messages.zh: 他的朋友；他说那里会有好听的音乐。
messages.en: His friend; he told him there would be good music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象对方听完理由后点头：点头相信一件事是“使信服”，点头答应去做是“说服”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing a large proportion of a particular substance in a relatively small amount of liquid or mixture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体或混合物中某种成分的比例较高、浓度较大的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih proporzjon għoli ta' sustanza partikolari meta mqabbel mal-ammont ta' likwidu jew taħlita li fih tinsab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浓缩的；指某种成分在液体或混合物中含量比例较高的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi likwidu jew taħlita li fiha ammont relattivament kbir ta' sustanza partikolari u ammont iżgħar ta' ilma jew sustanza oħra li tħallatha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concentrated liquid or mixture contains a large proportion of a particular substance relative to its total amount.

formal.mt: Il-meraq ikkonċentrat għandu jitħallat mal-ilma skont l-istruzzjonijiet fuq il-flixkun.
formal.en: The concentrated juice should be mixed with water according to the instructions on the bottle.
formal.zh: 这种浓缩果汁应按照瓶身说明兑水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-meraq lest biex nixorbu? Mark: Le, huwa ikkonċentrat. L-ewwel irridu nżidu l-ilma skont l-istruzzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this juice ready to drink? Mark: No, it is concentrated. First we need to add water according to the instructions.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这果汁可以直接喝了吗？Mark：还不行，这是浓缩的。我们得先按照说明加水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这果汁可以直接喝了吗？
messages.en: Is this juice ready to drink?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa ikkonċentrat. L-ewwel irridu nżidu l-ilma skont l-istruzzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa ikkonċentrat. L-ewwel irridu nżidu l-ilma skont l-istruzzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 还不行，这是浓缩的。我们得先按照说明加水。
messages.en: No, it is concentrated. First we need to add water according to the instructions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一小瓶浓缩果汁兑成一大壶饮料：小瓶里果汁成分比例高，用这个画面记住 ikkonċentrat 表示“浓缩的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join other people in secretly planning a harmful or unlawful action against someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人一起秘密策划针对某人或某事物的有害或违法行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tingħaqad ma' oħrajn biex tippjana bil-moħbi azzjoni ta' ħsara jew kontra l-liġi kontra xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与他人秘密共谋，策划有害或违法的行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tiftiehem bil-moħbi ma' persuni oħra biex twettaq azzjoni ħażina jew illegali, spiss kontra xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone conspires with others, they secretly plan an action intended to cause harm or break the law.

collocations.en: conspire with a group of officials

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-kmandant ikkonġura ma' diversi uffiċjali biex iwaqqa' lis-sultan.
formal.en: In the novel, the commander conspired with several officials to overthrow the sultan.
formal.zh: 在小说中，指挥官与几名官员密谋推翻苏丹。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex arrestaw lill-kmandant fl-aħħar tal-film? David: Għax ikkonġura kontra s-sultan ma' żewġ uffiċjali oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did they arrest the commander at the end of the film? David: Because he conspired against the sultan with two other officials.
colloquial.zh: Nina：电影结尾为什么逮捕了那个指挥官？David：因为他和另外两名官员密谋对付苏丹。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影结尾为什么逮捕了那个指挥官？
messages.en: Why did they arrest the commander at the end of the film?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ikkonġura kontra s-sultan ma' żewġ uffiċjali oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ikkonġura kontra s-sultan ma' żewġ uffiċjali oħra.
messages.zh: 因为他和另外两名官员密谋对付苏丹。
messages.en: Because he conspired against the sultan with two other officials.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“小说人物秘密结伙推翻君主”的情节中记忆；同时练习 ma' 接同谋、kontra 接针对对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work together with another person or group towards a shared purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人或某个团体共同努力，以实现共同的目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdem flimkien ma' persuna oħra jew ma' grupp biex tilħqu għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与他人合作或协同办事，以完成共同任务或实现共同目标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħdem ma' ħaddieħor u tagħti s-sehem tiegħek biex twettqu biċċa xogħol jew tilħqu għan flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you cooperate with someone, you work together and contribute towards achieving a shared aim.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab lil kull dipartiment biex jikkopera fit-tħejjija tar-rapport finali.
formal.en: The committee asked every department to cooperate in preparing the final report.
formal.zh: 委员会要求各部门协作编写最终报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tikkopera magħna biex inlestu l-proġett illum? Mark: Iva, żgur. Intom iktbu t-test u jien inħejji l-istampi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you cooperate with us so we can finish the project today? Mark: Yes, of course. You write the text, and I'll prepare the pictures.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能和我们合作，今天把项目做完吗？马克：当然可以。你们写文字，我来准备图片。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tikkopera magħna biex inlestu l-proġett illum?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tikkopera magħna biex inlestu l-proġett illum?
messages.zh: 你能和我们合作，今天把项目做完吗？
messages.en: Can you cooperate with us so we can finish the project today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żgur. Intom iktbu t-test u jien inħejji l-istampi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żgur. Intom iktbu t-test u jien inħejji l-istampi.
messages.zh: 当然可以。你们写文字，我来准备图片。
messages.en: Yes, of course. You write the text, and I'll prepare the pictures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikkopera 和英语 cooperate 配对记忆，再想象同学分工完成项目，用“共同目标、各出一份力”的画面记住“合作”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making a carbon copy or reproducing a shape by following its lines.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用复写纸复制文字，或沿原有线条描出图形的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel kopja ta' kitba bil-karta tal-karbonju jew li tirriproduċi forma billi ssegwi l-linji tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用复写纸，在书写或打字的同时制成另一份副本的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel kopja ta' dokument billi tqiegħed karta tal-karbonju bejn żewġ folji waqt li tikteb jew tittajpja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Making a carbon copy involves using carbon paper to reproduce writing on another sheet underneath.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿着原图的线条描画，从而复制其形状或轮廓的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tirriproduċi tpinġija billi tqiegħed karta trasparenti fuqha u tgħaddi bil-lapes fuq il-linji li jidhru minn taħt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tracing is the process of copying a drawing by following its lines onto another sheet.

collocations.en: make a copy using carbon paper
trace the outline onto transparent paper

formal.mt: Poġġi karta trasparenti fuq il-mappa u ikkopja l-kontorn tal-gżira bil-lapes.
formal.en: Place transparent paper over the map and trace the outline of the island in pencil.
formal.zh: 将透明纸放在地图上，用铅笔描出岛屿的轮廓。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nagħmel żewġ kopji ta' din in-nota f'daqqa? Mark: Poġġi karta tal-karbonju bejn żewġ folji u ikkopja n-nota fuq il-folja ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I make two copies of this note at once? Mark: Put carbon paper between two sheets and copy the note onto the top sheet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎样才能一次写出这张便条的两份副本？马克：在两张纸之间放一张复写纸，再把便条抄写在上面那张纸上。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nagħmel żewġ kopji ta' din in-nota f'daqqa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nagħmel żewġ kopji ta' din in-nota f'daqqa?
messages.zh: 怎样才能一次写出这张便条的两份副本？
messages.en: How can I make two copies of this note at once?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġi karta tal-karbonju bejn żewġ folji u ikkopja n-nota fuq il-folja ta' fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġi karta tal-karbonju bejn żewġ folji u ikkopja n-nota fuq il-folja ta' fuq.
messages.zh: 在两张纸之间放一张复写纸，再把便条抄写在上面那张纸上。
messages.en: Put carbon paper between two sheets and copy the note onto the top sheet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 ikkopja 的两个画面：纸下垫复写纸复制文字，图上盖透明纸描出轮廓；用“复写文字、描摹线条”区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 给乐器调音；匆忙拼凑、草草准备

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tune a musical instrument, or to put something together hastily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 调整乐器，使其音高准确；也可指匆忙把材料或内容拼凑起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taġġusta strument mużikali biex jagħti n-noti t-tajbin, jew tħejji xi ħaġa malajr u bl-għaġla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给乐器调音，使各音达到正确的音高。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taġġusta strument mużikali sabiex in-noti tiegħu jkunu fl-għoli t-tajjeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone tunes a musical instrument, they adjust it so that it produces notes at the correct pitch.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匆忙拼凑或草草准备某物，没有充分安排或打磨。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħejji jew tiġbor xi ħaġa flimkien bl-għaġla, mingħajr biżżejjed ħin biex tirranġaha bir-reqqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone puts something together hastily, they prepare or assemble it quickly without giving it much care.

collocations.zh: 匆忙拼凑了一篇演讲稿

collocations.en: threw together a plan at the last minute
collocations.zh: 在最后一刻草草拟出了计划

formal.mt: Qabel il-kunċert, il-mużiċist ikkorda l-vjolin bir-reqqa; l-organizzatur, min-naħa tiegħu, ikkorda diskors qasir bl-għaġla.
formal.en: Before the concert, the musician carefully tuned the violin; the organiser, for his part, hastily put together a short speech.
formal.zh: 音乐会开始前，乐手仔细给小提琴调了音；主办人则匆忙拼凑了一篇简短的致辞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark diġà ikkorda l-kitarra? Lara: Iva, u ikkorda wkoll diskors qasir fl-aħħar minuta! Maja: Nispera li tal-inqas il-kitarra tinstema' tajjeb!
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark tuned the guitar yet? Lara: Yes, and he also threw together a short speech at the last minute! Maja: I hope at least the guitar sounds good!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克已经给吉他调好音了吗？拉拉：调好了，而且他还在最后一刻匆忙凑了一篇简短的致辞！玛雅：希望至少吉他的声音是好听的！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克已经给吉他调好音了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark tuned the guitar yet?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ikkorda wkoll diskors qasir fl-aħħar minuta!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ikkorda wkoll diskors qasir fl-aħħar minuta!
messages.zh: 调好了，而且他还在最后一刻匆忙凑了一篇简短的致辞！
messages.en: Yes, and he also threw together a short speech at the last minute!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nispera li tal-inqas il-kitarra tinstema' tajjeb!
messages.mt_standard: Nispera li tal-inqas il-kitarra tinstema' tajjeb!
messages.zh: 希望至少吉他的声音是好听的！
messages.en: I hope at least the guitar sounds good!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：演出前给吉他调音，登台前匆忙拼凑致辞。看到乐器想到“调音”，看到计划或稿件并带有“匆忙”语境想到“草草拼凑”。

gloss_zh: 纠正；纠正某人的误解；训斥；批改、评分

teaching_sense.en_definition: To correct an error or a person's misunderstanding, reprimand someone, or mark a student's work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改正错误、纠正某人的误解、训斥某人，或批改学生作业并作出评价或评分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tirranġa żball, tneħħi fehma żbaljata ta' xi ħadd, iċċanfar lil xi ħadd, jew teżamina xogħol ta' student biex turi l-iżbalji jew tagħti marka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纠正某事物中的错误，使其准确或符合要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tirranġa dak li jkun ħażin f'xi ħaġa sabiex din tkun korretta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you correct something, you change what is wrong in it so that it becomes accurate or right.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人说明实际情况，纠正其错误认识或误解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tispjega lil xi ħadd kif inhuma l-affarijiet tassew sabiex tneħħilu fehma żbaljata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you set someone straight, you explain the facts so that they no longer misunderstand the situation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某人的错误或不当行为而责备、训斥对方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċċanfar lil xi ħadd minħabba żball jew imġiba li tqis ħażina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tell someone off, you speak to them angrily or firmly because they have done something wrong.

sense_translations.en_definition: to mark or grade (e.g. a student's work)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 检查并批改作业或试卷，指出错误或给予分数、等级。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Teżamina xogħol jew tweġibiet ta' student biex tindika l-iżbalji jew tagħti marka skont il-kwalità tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a teacher marks or grades work, they assess its quality and indicate errors or award a score.

collocations.en: corrected an error in the text
collocations.zh: 纠正了文中的一个错误

collocations.en: set his friend straight about the facts
collocations.zh: 向朋友说明事实，纠正了他的误解

collocations.en: told the boy off for shouting
collocations.zh: 因男孩大喊大叫而训斥了他

formal.mt: L-għalliem ikkoreġa l-karti tal-eżami u ta marka lil kull student. Waqt id-diskussjoni tar-riżultati, ikkoreġa wkoll żball fit-tweġiba mudell.
formal.en: The teacher marked the examination papers and gave each student a score. During the discussion of the results, he also corrected an error in the model answer.
formal.zh: 老师批改了试卷，并给每位学生打了分。在讨论考试结果时，他还纠正了参考答案中的一个错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kowċ ikkoreġa lil Mark quddiem kulħadd? Lara: Għax Mark baqa' jgħajjat waqt it-taħriġ. Maja: U dwar il-ħin tal-logħba? Lara: Ikkoreġa lil Mark dwar dak ukoll: il-logħba tibda fis-sitta, mhux fis-sebgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the coach tell Mark off in front of everyone? Lara: Because Mark kept shouting during training. Maja: And what about the match time? Lara: He set Mark straight about that too: the match starts at six, not seven.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：教练为什么当着大家的面训斥马克？拉拉：因为马克在训练时一直大喊大叫。玛雅：那比赛时间的事呢？拉拉：他也纠正了马克的误解：比赛六点开始，不是七点。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kowċ ikkoreġa lil Mark quddiem kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kowċ ikkoreġa lil Mark quddiem kulħadd?
messages.zh: 教练为什么当着大家的面训斥马克？
messages.en: Why did the coach tell Mark off in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Mark baqa' jgħajjat waqt it-taħriġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Mark baqa' jgħajjat waqt it-taħriġ.
messages.zh: 因为马克在训练时一直大喊大叫。
messages.en: Because Mark kept shouting during training.

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.zh: 那比赛时间的事呢？
messages.en: And what about the match time?

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkoreġa lil Mark dwar dak ukoll: il-logħba tibda fis-sitta, mhux fis-sebgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkoreġa lil Mark dwar dak ukoll: il-logħba tibda fis-sitta, mhux fis-sebgħa.
messages.zh: 他也纠正了马克的误解：比赛六点开始，不是七点。
messages.en: He set Mark straight about that too: the match starts at six, not seven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把四义放进课堂记忆：改正文中错误、澄清学生误解、训斥不当行为、批改作业评分。判断具体意思时，先看对象是文字、人的认识、人的行为，还是学生作业。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To communicate with someone in writing, or to match something in meaning, amount, or function.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人通过书信等书面方式联系；或在意义、数量、功能等方面与某事物相符。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkomunika ma' xi ħadd bil-miktub, jew jaqbel ma' xi ħaġa fit-tifsira, fl-ammont jew fil-funzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人通信；与某事物相符或对应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibgħat u jirċievi ittri jew messaġġi bil-miktub mingħand xi ħadd, jew jaqbel ma' xi ħaġa oħra f'aspett partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone corresponds with another person, they exchange written messages; if two things correspond, they match in a particular respect.

formal.mt: Matul ir-riċerka tiegħu, l-istudent ikkorrisponda mal-awtur biex jiċċara xi punti fil-ktieb.
formal.en: During his research, the student corresponded with the author to clarify some points in the book.
formal.zh: 研究期间，这名学生与作者通信，以澄清书中的一些要点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ikkorrisponda mal-għalliema dwar il-kors? Lara: Iva, bagħtilha email u hi wieġbitu lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark correspond with the teacher about the course? Lara: Yes, he emailed her, and she replied yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 跟老师就课程的事通过信吗？Lara：通了，他给她发了邮件，她昨天回复了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Mark 跟老师就课程的事通过信吗？
messages.en: Did Mark correspond with the teacher about the course?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bagħtilha email u hi wieġbitu lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bagħtilha email u hi wieġbitu lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 通了，他给她发了邮件，她昨天回复了。
messages.en: Yes, he emailed her, and she replied yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把通信想成两人一来一回地对应：人与人对应是通信，数字与记录对应就是相符；用这两幅画面区分语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone dishonest or morally worse, or to spoil the purity of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人变得不诚实或道德败坏，包括用利益收买；或玷污某事物的纯洁性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd isir diżonest jew jitħassar moralment, jew itebba' l-purità ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人腐化或道德败坏；以金钱或其他利益收买某人，使其违背职责。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd diżonest jew moralment agħar, pereżempju billi joffrilu flus jew vantaġġ biex jikser dmiru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone corrupts another person, they influence that person to behave dishonestly or abandon proper moral standards.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玷污或污损某事物，使其失去原有的纯洁性或神圣性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Itebba' jew iniġġes xi ħaġa, u b'hekk jagħmel ħsara lill-purità jew lill-qdusija tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone defiles something, they damage its purity or sacred character by treating it in a degrading way.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif in-negozjant ikkorrompa uffiċjal pubbliku billi offrielu flus biex jagħtih kuntratt.
formal.en: The report describes how the businessman corrupted a public official by offering him money to award him a contract.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这名商人如何以金钱收买一名公职人员，让对方把合同授予自己。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jgħidu li dak ir-raġel ikkorrompa lill-uffiċjal? Mark: Għax offrielu flus biex jaqbeż il-lista.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are they saying that man corrupted the official? Mark: Because he offered him money to move ahead of others on the list.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他们为什么说那个男人收买了那名工作人员？Mark：因为他给对方钱，想在名单上插队。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jgħidu li dak ir-raġel ikkorrompa lill-uffiċjal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jgħidu li dak ir-raġel ikkorrompa lill-uffiċjal?
messages.zh: 他们为什么说那个男人收买了那名工作人员？
messages.en: Why are they saying that man corrupted the official?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax offrielu flus biex jaqbeż il-lista.
messages.mt_standard: Għax offrielu flus biex jaqbeż il-lista.
messages.zh: 因为他给对方钱，想在名单上插队。
messages.en: Because he offered him money to move ahead of others on the list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习画面记忆：金钱让人违背职责是收买腐化，墨迹弄脏白纸可比喻玷污纯洁；这是语义联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To build or put something together, or to interpret words or actions in a particular way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过组合材料或要素来建造、构建某物；或以某种方式解释言语或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibni jew jgħaqqad xi ħaġa minn partijiet, jew jinterpreta kliem jew għemil b'mod partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将材料或组成部分组合起来，建造实体事物或构建抽象结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibni xi ħaġa billi jgħaqqad materjali jew partijiet, jew jorganizza elementi biex joħloq struttura jew argument.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone constructs something, they build it by putting materials or separate parts together in an organized way.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对言语、文本或行为作出某种解释；将其理解为具有某种含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jinterpreta kliem, test jew għemil b'mod partikolari u jagħtih tifsira skont kif jifhmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone construes words or actions in a particular way, they understand them as having a particular meaning.

collocations.zh: 构建了一个合乎逻辑的论证

formal.mt: It-tim ikkostruwixxa mudell tal-pont biex juri kif il-partijiet tiegħu jingħaqdu flimkien.
formal.en: The team constructed a model of the bridge to show how its parts fit together.
formal.zh: 团队建造了一座桥梁模型，用来展示各部分如何连接在一起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ikkostruwixxa dan il-mudell? Pawlu: Ħija. Għamlu mill-kartun għall-proġett tal-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who constructed this model? Pawlu: My brother. He made it from cardboard for his school project.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个模型是谁搭建的？Pawlu：我哥哥。他用纸板做的，是学校的项目作业。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个模型是谁搭建的？
messages.en: Who constructed this model?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 我哥哥。他用纸板做的，是学校的项目作业。
messages.en: My brother. He made it from cardboard for his school project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把积木搭成桥记作建造，把句中线索拼成一种理解记作解释；两幅画面帮助记住两个义项，具体意思仍要看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express disapproval of someone or something, or to examine their weaknesses in a reasoned way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事表示不赞同，或通过分析指出其缺点和不足。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi nuqqas ta' qbil jew ta' approvazzjoni dwar xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew jeżamina u juri n-nuqqasijiet tagħhom b'raġunijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 批评某人或某事，表达不满或不赞同；也可指经过分析后指出不足。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħid x'jara ħażin f'xi ħadd jew f'xi ħaġa, billi jesprimi diżapprovazzjoni jew jagħti kummenti dwar nuqqasijiet li jistgħu jitjiebu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone criticizes a person or thing, they express disapproval or explain what they consider to be its faults.

collocations.zh: 对该提议提出了建设性的批评

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, ir-reviżur ikkritika l-proposta għax ma kinitx tinkludi stima ċara tal-ispejjeż.
formal.en: In his report, the reviewer criticized the proposal because it did not include a clear cost estimate.
formal.zh: 审阅者在报告中批评了该提议，因为其中没有明确的费用估算。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-għalliem ikkritika l-preżentazzjoni tiegħek? Mark: Iva, qal li tkellimt malajr wisq, imma tani pariri biex intejjibha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the teacher criticize your presentation? Mark: Yes, he said I spoke too quickly, but he gave me advice on improving it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：老师批评你的展示了吗？Mark：批评了，他说我讲得太快，不过也给了我改进的建议。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 老师批评你的展示了吗？
messages.en: Did the teacher criticize your presentation?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal li tkellimt malajr wisq, imma tani pariri biex intejjibha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal li tkellimt malajr wisq, imma tani pariri biex intejjibha.
messages.zh: 批评了，他说我讲得太快，不过也给了我改进的建议。
messages.en: Yes, he said I spoke too quickly, but he gave me advice on improving it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师在展示后指出语速过快，并给出改进建议：把这个具体场景与词形一起记住，理解批评既能表达不满，也能帮助改进。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes someone or something that has received criticism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人或某事已经受到批评或负面评价。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna jew ħaġa li dwarha ġew espressi opinjonijiet negattivi jew ġew indikati nuqqasijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到批评的；被指出缺点或问题的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li rċieva kritika minħabba nuqqasijiet jew problemi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is criticised, people have expressed disapproval or pointed out faults.

formal.mt: Il-pjan ikkritikat ġie rivedut biex jinkludi aktar dettalji dwar l-ispejjeż.
formal.en: The criticised plan was revised to include more details about the costs.
formal.zh: 这项受到批评的计划经过修订，加入了更多费用细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-film hu daqshekk ikkritikat? Mark: Għax ħafna nies ma għoġbithomx l-istorja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this film so heavily criticised? Mark: Because many people didn't like the story.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这部电影为什么受到这么多批评？Mark：因为很多人不喜欢它的故事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-film hu daqshekk ikkritikat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-film hu daqshekk ikkritikat?
messages.zh: 这部电影为什么受到这么多批评？
messages.en: Why is this film so heavily criticised?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħafna nies ma għoġbithomx l-istorja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħafna nies ma għoġbithomx l-istorja.
messages.zh: 因为很多人不喜欢它的故事。
messages.en: Because many people didn't like the story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份计划旁贴满指出问题的便条，把 ikkritikat 与“已经受到批评的”这一状态联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work land or care for plants so that crops can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 耕作土地或照料植物，使作物能够生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem l-art jew jieħu ħsieb il-pjanti biex jikbru u jagħtu l-prodott tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耕种土地；栽培并照料植物或作物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaħdem l-art u jieħu ħsieb il-pjanti jew l-uċuħ tar-raba' biex jikbru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you cultivate land or crops, you work the soil or care for plants to help them grow.

formal.mt: Ikkultiva din l-għalqa u żomm nota tal-uċuħ tar-raba' li tkabbar fiha.
formal.en: Cultivate this field and keep a record of the crops you grow in it.
formal.zh: 耕种这块田地，并记录你在其中种植的作物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'nista' nkabbar f'din ir-rokna tal-ġnien? Pawlu: Ikkultiva ftit tadam hemm; jien nista' ngħinek.
colloquial.en: Maja: What can I grow in this corner of the garden? Pawlu: Grow some tomatoes there; I can help you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以在花园的这个角落种些什么？Pawlu：在那里种点番茄吧，我可以帮你。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺初学者)
messages.zh: 我可以在花园的这个角落种些什么？
messages.en: What can I grow in this corner of the garden?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkultiva ftit tadam hemm; jien nista' ngħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkultiva ftit tadam hemm; jien nista' ngħinek.
messages.zh: 在那里种点番茄吧，我可以帮你。
messages.en: Grow some tomatoes there; I can help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikkultiva 放进“耕地、种番茄、照料生长”的连续画面中，记住它表示耕作或栽培这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having many different or bright colours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有多种颜色或鲜艳色彩的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li għandha ħafna kuluri differenti jew kuluri jleqqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 色彩丰富的；颜色鲜艳的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi oġġett jew dehra b'ħafna kuluri differenti jew b'kuluri qawwija li jiġbdu l-għajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is colorful has many different colours or bright colours that attract attention.

formal.mt: Il-poster ikkulurit juri l-attivitajiet li se jsiru waqt il-festival.
formal.en: The colourful poster shows the activities that will take place during the festival.
formal.zh: 这张色彩鲜艳的海报展示了节庆期间将举行的活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema ktieb trid, dak blu jew dak ikkulurit? Ben: Dak ikkulurit, jekk jogħġbok; jogħġbuni l-istampi tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which book do you want, the blue one or the colourful one? Ben: The colourful one, please; I like its pictures.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想要哪本书，蓝色的那本还是多彩的那本？Ben：请给我多彩的那本，我喜欢里面的图画。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema ktieb trid, dak blu jew dak ikkulurit?
messages.mt_standard: Liema ktieb trid, dak blu jew dak ikkulurit?
messages.zh: 你想要哪本书，蓝色的那本还是多彩的那本？
messages.en: Which book do you want, the blue one or the colourful one?

messages.speaker: Ben (孩子)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ikkulurit, jekk jogħġbok; jogħġbuni l-istampi tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ikkulurit, jekk jogħġbok; jogħġbuni l-istampi tiegħu.
messages.zh: 请给我多彩的那本，我喜欢里面的图画。
messages.en: The colourful one, please; I like its pictures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本翻开后满是红黄蓝图画的书，用 ktieb ikkulurit 这个画面记住“色彩丰富的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express an opinion or make a remark about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对某件事发表意见、评论或简短看法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi opinjoni jew jagħmel osservazzjoni dwar xi ħaġa, bil-kliem jew bil-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就某事发表评论或表达看法，可通过口头或书面形式进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħid jew jikteb x'jaħseb dwar suġġett, ġrajja jew xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you comment on something, you say or write what you think about it.

formal.mt: Ikkummenta dwar il-proposta u spjega liema aspetti tagħha jistgħu jittejbu.
formal.en: Comment on the proposal and explain which aspects of it could be improved.
formal.zh: 请就该提案发表评论，并说明其中哪些方面可以改进。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tridni ngħidlek x'naħseb dwar l-artiklu tiegħek? Mark: Iva, ikkummenta fuq it-tmiem; għadni mhux ċert dwaru.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like me to tell you what I think of your article? Mark: Yes, comment on the ending; I'm still unsure about it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你想听听我对你这篇文章的看法吗？Mark：想，请说说结尾吧，我对它还不太有把握。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tridni ngħidlek x'naħseb dwar l-artiklu tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Tridni ngħidlek x'naħseb dwar l-artiklu tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你想听听我对你这篇文章的看法吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to tell you what I think of your article?

messages.speaker: Mark (文章作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ikkummenta fuq it-tmiem; għadni mhux ċert dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ikkummenta fuq it-tmiem; għadni mhux ċert dwaru.
messages.zh: 想，请说说结尾吧，我对它还不太有把握。
messages.en: Yes, comment on the ending; I'm still unsure about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读完文章后写下一句自己的看法，把 ikkummenta 与“针对某事发表评论”的动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express strong disapproval of an action or to impose a punishment through a court.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈指责某种行为；也指法院依法对某人判处刑罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi diżapprovazzjoni qawwija għal xi għemil, jew jimponi piena fuq persuna permezz ta' sentenza tal-qorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某种行为或事情表示强烈反对，予以谴责。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jesprimi b'mod qawwi li xi għemil jew xi ħaġa hija ħażina u mhix aċċettabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you condemn an action, you express strong disapproval because you consider it wrong or unacceptable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法院对被裁定有罪的人判处某种刑罚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qorti tistabbilixxi l-piena li għandha tingħata lil persuna li tkun instabet ħatja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a court sentences someone, it formally decides what punishment that person must receive.

collocations.mt: ikkundanna lil xi ħadd għal sentejn ħabs
collocations.en: sentence someone to two years in prison

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ikkundanna l-vjolenza fl-istqarrija tiegħu. F'każ separat, il-qorti kkundannat lill-akkużat għal sentejn ħabs.
formal.en: The committee condemned the violence in its statement. In a separate case, the court sentenced the accused to two years in prison.
formal.zh: 委员会在声明中谴责了暴力行为。在另一起案件中，法院判处被告两年监禁。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Meta tgħid li xi ħadd ikkundanna l-attakk, tfisser li tah piena? Pawlu: Le, hawn tfisser li qal b'mod ċar li l-attakk kien ħażin.
colloquial.en: Marta: When you say someone condemned the attack, do you mean they imposed a punishment? Pawlu: No, here it means they clearly said the attack was wrong.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你说有人谴责了这次袭击，是说他作出了处罚吗？保罗：不是，这里是说他明确表示这次袭击是错误的。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid li xi ħadd ikkundanna l-attakk, tfisser li tah piena?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid li xi ħadd ikkundanna l-attakk, tfisser li tah piena?
messages.zh: 你说有人谴责了这次袭击，是说他作出了处罚吗？
messages.en: When you say someone condemned the attack, do you mean they imposed a punishment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn tfisser li qal b'mod ċar li l-attakk kien ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn tfisser li qal b'mod ċar li l-attakk kien ħażin.
messages.zh: 不是，这里是说他明确表示这次袭击是错误的。
messages.en: No, here it means they clearly said the attack was wrong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记义：声明中指责暴力是“谴责”，法庭上宣布刑期是“判刑”；遇到这个词，先看是否出现法院和刑罚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone or something that has been strongly disapproved of, or someone who has received a court sentence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容已经受到强烈谴责的人或事物，也可形容已经被法院判处刑罚的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna jew ħaġa li tkun ġiet ikkritikata b'qawwa, jew persuna li l-qorti tkun imponiet piena fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到强烈谴责的；在司法语境中，指已被判处刑罚的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie kkritikat b'qawwa bħala ħażin jew mhux aċċettabbli, jew li jkun ingħata piena mill-qorti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something described as condemned has been strongly disapproved of, or, in a legal context, formally sentenced by a court.

collocations.en: an act condemned by the committee
collocations.zh: 受到委员会谴责的行为

collocations.mt: raġel ikkundannat għal ħames snin ħabs
collocations.en: a man sentenced to five years in prison
collocations.zh: 被判处五年监禁的男子

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-att ikkundannat mill-kumitat u jispjega għaliex tqies mhux aċċettabbli.
formal.en: The report describes the act condemned by the committee and explains why it was considered unacceptable.
formal.zh: 报告描述了受到委员会谴责的行为，并解释了该行为被认定为不可接受的原因。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-raġel diġà huwa kkundannat? Mark: Iva, il-qorti tatu piena ta' sentejn ħabs.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has this man already been sentenced? Mark: Yes, the court gave him a two-year prison sentence.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个男子已经被判刑了吗？马克：是的，法院判了他两年监禁。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个男子已经被判刑了吗？
messages.en: Has this man already been sentenced?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-qorti tatu piena ta' sentejn ħabs.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-qorti tatu piena ta' sentejn ħabs.
messages.zh: 是的，法院判了他两年监禁。
messages.en: Yes, the court gave him a two-year prison sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它贴在人物或行为旁边，记成“已经受到谴责或判刑的”状态标签；本条是形容词，重点看被描述者的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To think carefully about an idea, possibility, or relevant fact before making a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作决定前，仔细思考某个想法、可能的选择或有关事实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħseb bir-reqqa dwar idea, għażla jew fatt rilevanti qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 认真思考、权衡某个想法、选择或相关情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jeżamina idea, possibbiltà jew ċirkostanza f'moħħu u jaħseb dwarha bir-reqqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you consider an idea or possibility, you think about it carefully before deciding what to do.

formal.mt: Qabel tieħu deċiżjoni dwar il-proposta, ikkunsidra l-ispiża, il-benefiċċji u l-konsegwenzi possibbli.
formal.en: Before making a decision about the proposal, consider the cost, the benefits, and the possible consequences.
formal.zh: 在就这项提案作出决定之前，请考虑成本、益处和可能的后果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Naċċetta x-xogħol il-ġdid? Toni: Ikkunsidra kemm iddum biex tasal hemm u jekk il-ħinijiet jgħoddux għalik.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should I accept the new job? Toni: Consider how long it takes to get there and whether the hours suit you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我要接受这份新工作吗？托尼：考虑一下去那里要花多久，以及工作时间是否适合你。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要接受这份新工作吗？
messages.en: Should I accept the new job?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkunsidra kemm iddum biex tasal hemm u jekk il-ħinijiet jgħoddux għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkunsidra kemm iddum biex tasal hemm u jekk il-ħinijiet jgħoddux għalik.
messages.zh: 考虑一下去那里要花多久，以及工作时间是否适合你。
messages.en: Consider how long it takes to get there and whether the hours suit you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作决定前在纸上列出成本、好处和后果，逐项打量；把这个词与“先想一想，再作决定”的动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To communicate with a person or organization, for example by telephone, email, or a message.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电话、电子邮件、消息等方式与某人或某个机构取得联系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkomunika ma' persuna jew organizzazzjoni, pereżempju bit-telefown, b'email jew b'messaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人或某个机构取得联系，以传递消息、询问信息或商议事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel kuntatt ma' persuna jew organizzazzjoni biex iwassal messaġġ, jitlob tagħrif jew jiddiskuti xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you contact someone, you communicate with them by calling, writing, or sending a message.

collocations.zh: 通过电子邮件联系某人

formal.mt: Għal aktar tagħrif dwar l-applikazzjoni, tista' tikkuntattja lill-uffiċċju bl-email jew bit-telefown.
formal.en: For further information about the application, you can contact the office by email or telephone.
formal.zh: 如需了解有关申请的更多信息，您可以通过电子邮件或电话联系办公室。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tikkuntattja lil Sara u tistaqsiha x'ħin se tasal? Ben: Iva, nibgħatilha messaġġ issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you contact Sara and ask her what time she is arriving? Ben: Yes, I'll send her a message now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你能联系萨拉，问问她几点到吗？本：可以，我现在给她发消息。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tikkuntattja lil Sara u tistaqsiha x'ħin se tasal?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tikkuntattja lil Sara u tistaqsiha x'ħin se tasal?
messages.zh: 你能联系萨拉，问问她几点到吗？
messages.en: Can you contact Sara and ask her what time she is arriving?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，我现在给她发消息。
messages.en: Yes, I'll send her a message now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“拿起手机，找到联系人，发出消息”的连续画面记住“联系”；练习时同时说清联系谁，以及用电话还是邮件联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To satisfy someone, to feel content with what is available, or to manage with less than one would prefer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人满意，或对已有条件感到满足，也可指在条件有限时将就着应付。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel lil xi ħadd sodisfatt, tkun kuntent b'dak li għandek, jew tinqeda b'dak li hemm meta ma jkollokx dak li tixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人满意；满足某人的愿望、要求或需要。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel lil xi ħadd sodisfatt billi tissodisfa x-xewqat, it-talbiet jew il-ħtiġijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you satisfy someone, you provide what they need or want and make them feel pleased.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对自己已有的东西或所处的情况感到满足。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkun sodisfatt b'dak li għandek jew bis-sitwazzjoni tiegħek, mingħajr ma tħoss il-ħtieġa li titlob aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are content, you feel satisfied with what you have or with your present situation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在缺少理想条件或用品时，利用现有条件将就着应付。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tinqeda b'dak li għandek disponibbli, għalkemm ma jkunx biżżejjed jew ma jkunx eżatt dak li tixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you make do, you manage with what is available even though you would prefer something better.

collocations.zh: 拥有得更少也感到满足了

collocations.en: made do with what he had
collocations.zh: 用自己已有的东西将就应付了

formal.mt: Is-servizz il-ġdid ikkuntenta lill-klijenti għax naqqas il-ħin ta' stennija u tejjeb il-komunikazzjoni.
formal.en: The new service satisfied customers because it reduced waiting times and improved communication.
formal.zh: 新服务缩短了等候时间，也改善了沟通，因此让顾客感到满意。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu sab mejda kbira għall-kċina? Rita: Le, ikkuntenta ruħu b'waħda iżgħar għax ma kienx hemm biżżejjed spazju.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did Pawlu find a large table for the kitchen? Rita: No, he made do with a smaller one because there wasn't enough space.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗找到放在厨房里的大桌子了吗？丽塔：没有，空间不够，他就用一张小一点的将就了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗找到放在厨房里的大桌子了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu find a large table for the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ikkuntenta ruħu b'waħda iżgħar għax ma kienx hemm biżżejjed spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ikkuntenta ruħu b'waħda iżgħar għax ma kienx hemm biżżejjed spazju.
messages.zh: 没有，空间不够，他就用一张小一点的将就了。
messages.en: No, he made do with a smaller one because there wasn't enough space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个连续画面记忆：让顾客满意、自己觉得够了、条件不足也将就；结合语境区分三种意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move goods secretly and illegally, especially across a border to avoid official controls or duties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 秘密而非法地运输货物，尤其指为逃避官方检查或关税而将货物运过边境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddaħħal, toħroġ jew tittrasporta oġġetti bil-moħbi u kontra l-liġi, speċjalment biex tevita kontrolli uffiċjali jew dazji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将货物秘密非法运入、运出或运送，尤指逃避边境检查或关税而走私。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tittrasporta oġġetti bil-moħbi u b'mod illegali, ħafna drabi minn pajjiż għal ieħor biex tevita kontrolli jew ħlas ta' dazji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone smuggles goods, they move them secretly and illegally, often across a national border.

collocations.mt: ikkuntrabanda oġġetti minn pajjiż għal ieħor
collocations.en: smuggled goods from one country to another
collocations.zh: 把货物从一个国家走私到另一个国家

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel ikkuntrabanda sigaretti billi ħbiehom fost merkanzija oħra.
formal.en: According to the report, the man smuggled cigarettes by hiding them among other goods.
formal.zh: 据报告所述，该男子把香烟藏在其他货物中进行走私。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex waqqfu dak it-trakk? Lara: Għax is-sewwieq ikkuntrabanda sigaretti moħbija wara l-kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did they stop that truck? Lara: Because the driver smuggled cigarettes hidden behind the boxes.
colloquial.zh: 马克：他们为什么拦下那辆卡车？拉拉：因为司机走私了藏在箱子后面的香烟。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么拦下那辆卡车？
messages.en: Why did they stop that truck?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax is-sewwieq ikkuntrabanda sigaretti moħbija wara l-kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax is-sewwieq ikkuntrabanda sigaretti moħbija wara l-kaxxi.
messages.zh: 因为司机走私了藏在箱子后面的香烟。
messages.en: Because the driver smuggled cigarettes hidden behind the boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货物藏在箱子后面，偷偷越过检查关口；把“秘密、非法、运输”三个要点连成走私画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of treating animal skins to turn them into durable leather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对动物皮进行处理，使其成为不易腐败、可以使用的皮革的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-ġlud tal-annimali jiġu trattati biex isiru ġilda maħduma li ddum u ma titħassarx malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞣制：通过处理动物皮，使其转变为耐用皮革的工艺过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trattament tal-ġlud tal-annimali biex jinbidlu f'ġilda maħduma, reżistenti u adattata għall-manifattura ta' prodotti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tanning is the process of treating animal skins so that they become durable leather suitable for making products.

formal.mt: L-ikkunzar tal-ġlud huwa stadju importanti fil-produzzjoni tal-ġilda li tintuża għaż-żraben u l-basktijiet.
formal.en: The tanning of animal skins is an important stage in producing the leather used for shoes and bags.
formal.zh: 动物皮的鞣制是生产鞋类和包袋所用皮革的重要环节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-ikkunzar? Toni: Huwa t-trattament tal-ġlud tal-annimali biex isiru ġilda li tista' tintuża, pereżempju għaż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is tanning? Toni: It's the treatment of animal skins to make usable leather, for example for shoes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是鞣制？托尼：就是处理动物皮，把它制成可以使用的皮革，例如用来做鞋。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是鞣制？
messages.en: What is tanning?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa t-trattament tal-ġlud tal-annimali biex isiru ġilda li tista' tintuża, pereżempju għaż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa t-trattament tal-ġlud tal-annimali biex isiru ġilda li tista' tintuża, pereżempju għaż-żraben.
messages.zh: 就是处理动物皮，把它制成可以使用的皮革，例如用来做鞋。
messages.en: It's the treatment of animal skins to make usable leather, for example for shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“动物皮→经过处理→耐用皮革→鞋和包”的顺序联想，把这个名词记成中间的鞣制工序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reproduced from an original, or taken from another person's work and presented as one's own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从原件复制而来的；也可指取自他人作品却被当作自己创作的，即抄袭的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie riprodott minn oriġinal, jew meħud minn xogħol ta' ħaddieħor u ppreżentat bħala xogħol ta' min ħadu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复制的；照着原件或原有内容制作出来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie riprodott minn fajl, test, oġġett jew xogħol oriġinali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is copied has been reproduced from an existing original, such as a document or computer file.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抄袭的；取自他人的文字、观点或作品，却被冒充为自己创作的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ittieħed minn kliem, ideat jew xogħol ta' ħaddieħor u ġie ppreżentat bħala xogħol proprju mingħajr rikonoxximent tas-sors.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Work that is plagiarised has been taken from someone else and presented as original work without proper acknowledgement.

collocations.en: work copied without acknowledging the source
collocations.zh: 未注明来源的抄袭作品

formal.mt: L-għalliem identifika paragrafu ikkupjat minn artiklu u ppreżentat bħala xogħol oriġinali mingħajr rikonoxximent tas-sors.
formal.en: The teacher identified a paragraph copied from an article and presented as original work without acknowledging the source.
formal.zh: 教师发现有一段文字抄自某篇文章，未注明来源，却被当作原创内容提交。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan hu l-fajl oriġinali? Mark: Le, dan hu fajl ikkupjat. L-oriġinal qiegħed fuq il-kompjuter l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this the original file? Mark: No, this is a copied file. The original is on the other computer.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是原始文件吗？马克：不是，这是复制的文件。原件在另一台电脑上。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这是原始文件吗？
messages.en: Is this the original file?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu fajl ikkupjat. L-oriġinal qiegħed fuq il-kompjuter l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu fajl ikkupjat. L-oriġinal qiegħed fuq il-kompjuter l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 不是，这是复制的文件。原件在另一台电脑上。
messages.en: No, this is a copied file. The original is on the other computer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想电脑里的文件副本，记住“复制的”；再想把别人的文章冒充原创，记住“抄袭的”，靠语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone healthy again or cause an illness to end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使患病的人恢复健康，或使疾病得到治愈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib lil persuna lura għas-saħħa jew iwassal biex marda tgħaddi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 治愈病人或疾病，使人恢复健康。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġib lil persuna marida lura għas-saħħa jew ineħħilha l-marda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something cures a person, they make that person healthy again.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif it-trattament ik托ura lill-pazjent u għenu jerġa' jikseb saħħtu.
formal.en: The report describes how the treatment cured the patient and helped him regain his health.
formal.zh: 报告描述了治疗如何治愈病人，并帮助他恢复健康。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-trattament ik托ura lil ħuk? Pawlu: Iva, issa reġa' jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the treatment cure your brother? Pawlu: Yes, he is well again now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：治疗把你哥哥治好了吗？保罗：是的，他现在又恢复健康了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 治疗把你哥哥治好了吗？
messages.en: Did the treatment cure your brother?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他现在又恢复健康了。
messages.en: Yes, he is well again now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义连成“生病—治疗—康复”的画面，重点记住治愈后的健康结果。

gloss_zh: 绗缝；将多层织物缝合固定

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sew layers of fabric and padding together with lines of stitches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用成行或成图案的针脚，把面料和中间的填充层缝合固定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad saffi ta' drapp u materjal artab bejniethom b'ringieli jew disinji ta' ponti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绗缝，用针脚将织物与填充材料的多层结构缝合固定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad żewġ saffi ta' drapp b'materjal artab bejniethom permezz ta' ponti li jżommu s-saffi f'posthom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you quilt fabric, you sew its layers and padding together with patterned or repeated stitches.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikkutunar tal-kutra, il-ponti għandhom jgħaddu mis-saffi kollha biex iżommu l-materjal ta' ġewwa f'postu.
formal.en: When quilting the blanket, the stitches should pass through all the layers to hold the filling in place.
formal.zh: 给毯子绗缝时，针脚应穿过所有层，以固定内部的填充材料。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Se tibda l-ikkutunar tal-kutra llum? Anna: Iva, se nagħmel disinn ta' kwadri biex inżomm is-saffi flimkien.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you going to start quilting the blanket today? Anna: Yes, I will make a square pattern to hold the layers together.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你今天要开始给毯子做绗缝吗？安娜：是的，我要缝出方格图案，把各层固定在一起。

messages.speaker: Rita (缝纫课同学)
messages.zh: 你今天要开始给毯子做绗缝吗？
messages.en: Are you going to start quilting the blanket today?

messages.speaker: Anna (缝纫课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nagħmel disinn ta' kwadri biex inżomm is-saffi flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nagħmel disinn ta' kwadri biex inżomm is-saffi flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，我要缝出方格图案，把各层固定在一起。
messages.en: Yes, I will make a square pattern to hold the layers together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象夹着填充物的两层布，再用方格针脚固定，便能记住绗缝这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone quieter or calmer, including by soothing anger or dissatisfaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人安静或平静下来，也可指通过安抚来平息怒气或不满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd aktar kwiet jew kalm, jew itaffilu r-rabja jew in-nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使安静下来，减少喧闹或躁动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd aktar kwiet billi jwaqqaf jew inaqqas l-għajjat, il-ħsejjes jew l-aġitazzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you quieten someone, you make them less noisy or less agitated.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过安抚、回应要求或作出让步，使愤怒或不满的人平静下来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Itaffi r-rabja jew in-nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon ta' xi ħadd billi jserraħlu moħħu, jilqa' talba tiegħu jew jagħmel konċessjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you appease someone, you reduce their anger or dissatisfaction by responding to their concerns or wishes.

formal.mt: Il-maniġer ikkwieta lill-klijent irrabjat billi sema' l-ilment tiegħu u offrielu soluzzjoni.
formal.en: The manager appeased the angry customer by listening to his complaint and offering him a solution.
formal.zh: 经理听取了那位愤怒顾客的投诉，并提出解决办法，使他平静下来。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif ikkwieta lit-tfal l-għalliem? Pawlu: Beda jaqralhom storja, u waqfu jgħajtu.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did the teacher quieten the children? Pawlu: He started reading them a story, and they stopped shouting.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：老师是怎么让孩子们安静下来的？保罗：他开始给他们读故事，他们就不再喊叫了。

messages.speaker: Marija (家长)
messages.zh: 老师是怎么让孩子们安静下来的？
messages.en: How did the teacher quieten the children?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Beda jaqralhom storja, u waqfu jgħajtu.
messages.mt_standard: Beda jaqralhom storja, u waqfu jgħajtu.
messages.zh: 他开始给他们读故事，他们就不再喊叫了。
messages.en: He started reading them a story, and they stopped shouting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个安静画面：孩子停止喧闹，顾客消了怒气；分别对应使安静和安抚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To repeat someone's exact words or refer to a source as support for a statement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 复述某人的原话，或引用某个来源来支持陈述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirrepeti l-kliem eżatt ta' xi ħadd jew isemmi sors biex isaħħaħ stqarrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引用某人说过或写过的原话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jirrepeti eżatt kliem li xi ħadd qal jew kiteb, filwaqt li juri li l-kliem ġej minn dik il-persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you quote someone, you repeat the exact words that they said or wrote.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引证某项资料、著作或其他来源，以支持观点或说明依据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isemmi ktieb, studju jew sors ieħor bħala evidenza jew appoġġ għal dak li jkun qed jgħid jew jikteb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you cite a source, you identify it as evidence or support for what you say.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur ikkwota studju preċedenti biex isaħħaħ l-argument tiegħu.
formal.en: In his report, the researcher cited an earlier study to support his argument.
formal.zh: 研究人员在报告中引证了一项较早的研究，以支持自己的论点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ktibt dik is-sentenza bejn il-virgoletti? Mark: Għax ridt nikkwota l-kliem eżatt tal-awtriċi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you put that sentence in quotation marks? Mark: Because I wanted to quote the author's exact words.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么给那个句子加上引号？马克：因为我想引用那位女作者的原话。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ktibt dik is-sentenza bejn il-virgoletti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ktibt dik is-sentenza bejn il-virgoletti?
messages.zh: 你为什么给那个句子加上引号？
messages.en: Why did you put that sentence in quotation marks?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ridt nikkwota l-kliem eżatt tal-awtriċi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ridt nikkwota l-kliem eżatt tal-awtriċi.
messages.zh: 因为我想引用那位女作者的原话。
messages.en: Because I wanted to quote the author's exact words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到引号就想引用原话，看到参考来源就想引证依据，用这两个画面区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small amount of food eaten between meals or instead of a larger meal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在正餐之间吃的少量食物，或代替丰盛正餐的简单一餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont żgħir ta' ikel li jittiekel bejn l-ikliet jew minflok ikla ikbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正餐之间吃的少量食物；简单的小餐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftit ikel li wieħed jiekol bejn l-ikliet jew meta jkun irid xi ħaġa żgħira x'jiekol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A snack is a small amount of food that you eat between meals or when you do not want a full meal.

formal.mt: Waqt il-waqfa, il-parteċipanti jistgħu jieħdu ikla ħafifa fis-sala.
formal.en: During the break, participants can have a snack in the hall.
formal.zh: 休息期间，参与者可以在大厅吃些小吃。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi ftit ġuħ. Nieħdu ikla ħafifa? Mark: Iva, nistgħu naqsmu ftira.
colloquial.en: Anna: I'm a little hungry. Shall we have a snack? Mark: Yes, we can share a ftira.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我有点饿。我们吃点东西吧？Mark：好，我们可以分着吃一个马耳他面包。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ftit ġuħ. Nieħdu ikla ħafifa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ftit ġuħ. Nieħdu ikla ħafifa?
messages.zh: 我有点饿。我们吃点东西吧？
messages.en: I'm a little hungry. Shall we have a snack?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们可以分着吃一个马耳他面包。
messages.en: Yes, we can share a ftira.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语和两餐之间的小点心画面绑定：吃一点、分量轻，记作“小吃或简餐”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate a greater quantity, amount, or degree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表示数量、分量或程度增加，相当于“更多”或“更加”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tindika kwantità, ammont jew grad akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更多；更大程度地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li turi li kwantità jew grad huwa akbar minn qabel jew minn dak li qed jitqabbel miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use more to indicate a greater quantity or a higher degree than another amount or level.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更多的数量；更加，表示程度进一步增加。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tfisser ammont ikbar ta' xi ħaġa jew grad ogħla ta' kwalità jew azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you want more of something, you want an additional amount beyond what you already have.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom bżonn iktar ħin biex itemmu dan l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The students need more time to complete this exercise.
formal.zh: 学生需要更多时间完成这道练习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid iktar kafè? Pawlu: Iva, ftit ieħor, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like more coffee? Pawlu: Yes, a little more, thanks.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你还要些咖啡吗？Pawlu：要，再来一点，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还要些咖啡吗？
messages.en: Would you like more coffee?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，再来一点，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, a little more, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“再加一点”的画面记忆：加时间是更多时间，加重要程度就是更加重要。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At or to a greater distance from a person, place, or reference point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离某人、某地或某个参照点更远，或向更远的地方移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'distanza akbar minn persuna, post jew punt ta' referenza, jew lejn post f'distanza akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更远；处于或到达比参照位置更远的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'post li jinsab f'distanza akbar minn punt ta' referenza, jew lejn post bħal dan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is further away, it is at a greater distance from the place you are considering.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru sportiv il-ġdid jinsab iktar 'il bogħod mill-iskola miċ-ċentru l-antik.
formal.en: The new sports centre is further from the school than the old centre.
formal.zh: 与旧体育中心相比，新体育中心离学校更远。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut qiegħed hawn? Luqa: Le, qiegħed ftit iktar 'il bogħod, ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the shop here? Luqa: No, it's a little further away, beside the square.
colloquial.zh: Maja：商店是在这里吗？Luqa：不是，还要再远一点，在广场旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店是在这里吗？
messages.en: Is the shop here?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qiegħed ftit iktar 'il bogħod, ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qiegħed ftit iktar 'il bogħod, ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 不是，还要再远一点，在广场旁边。
