messages.en: No, it's a little further away, beside the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上的目的地又向外移了一格，路程随之增加，把整个短语记成“更远”。

gloss_zh: 活动链的下游环节；活动链中较后的阶段

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stage farther along a chain of connected activities, after earlier operations have taken place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一系列相互关联的活动中，位于前序操作之后、较接近后续成果的环节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stadju aktar tard f'katina ta' attivitajiet marbuta ma' xulxin, wara li jkunu saru operazzjonijiet preċedenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 活动链中处于前序操作之后的下游环节或阶段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' katina ta' attivitajiet li tiġi wara stadji jew operazzjonijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The downstream part of a chain of activities consists of stages that follow earlier operations.

collocations.mt: negozji iktar 'l isfel fil-katina ta' attivitajiet
collocations.en: businesses farther downstream in the chain of activities
collocations.zh: 位于活动链较下游环节的企业

collocations.mt: problemi iktar 'l isfel fil-katina ta' attivitajiet
collocations.en: problems farther downstream in the chain of activities
collocations.zh: 活动链较后环节出现的问题

formal.mt: Dewmien fil-produzzjoni jista' joħloq problemi iktar 'l isfel fil-katina ta' attivitajiet, speċjalment waqt l-ippakkjar u t-tqassim.
formal.en: A production delay can create problems farther downstream in the chain of activities, especially during packaging and distribution.
formal.zh: 生产延误可能在活动链的较后环节引发问题，尤其是在包装和配送阶段。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Jekk il-produzzjoni tieqaf, min jintlaqat? Pawlu: Jintlaqtu wkoll dawk li jaħdmu iktar 'l isfel fil-katina ta' attivitajiet, bħal dawk li jippakkjaw il-prodotti.
colloquial.en: Marta: If production stops, who is affected? Pawlu: People working farther downstream in the chain of activities are affected too, such as those who package the products.
colloquial.zh: Marta：如果生产停下来，谁会受到影响？Pawlu：活动链中较后环节的工作人员也会受到影响，比如负责产品包装的人。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 如果生产停下来，谁会受到影响？
messages.en: If production stops, who is affected?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jintlaqtu wkoll dawk li jaħdmu iktar 'l isfel fil-katina ta' attivitajiet, bħal dawk li jippakkjaw il-prodotti.
messages.mt_standard: Jintlaqtu wkoll dawk li jaħdmu iktar 'l isfel fil-katina ta' attivitajiet, bħal dawk li jippakkjaw il-prodotti.
messages.zh: 活动链中较后环节的工作人员也会受到影响，比如负责产品包装的人。
messages.en: People working farther downstream in the chain of activities are affected too, such as those who package the products.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把活动流程想成一条从上往下排列的链：生产之后还有包装和配送，越往后就是活动链的下游环节。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a smaller height, amount, level, or pitch than something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一事物相比，在高度、数额、水平或音调上更低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun f'għoli, ammont, livell jew ton inqas minn dak li qed jitqabbel miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更低的；高度、数值、水平或音调低于比较对象的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun f'pożizzjoni inqas għolja jew ikollu ammont, livell jew ton inqas minn ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is lower has less height, a smaller amount, or a lower level or pitch than something else.

formal.mt: Il-prezz ta' dan il-prodott huwa iktar baxx mill-prezz tas-sena li għaddiet.
formal.en: The price of this product is lower than last year's price.
formal.zh: 这件产品的价格低于去年的价格。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom mudell bi prezz iktar baxx? Rita: Iva, dan jiswa għoxrin ewro inqas.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a model at a lower price? Rita: Yes, this one costs twenty euros less.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们有价格更低的型号吗？Rita：有，这款便宜二十欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom mudell bi prezz iktar baxx?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom mudell bi prezz iktar baxx?
messages.zh: 你们有价格更低的型号吗？
messages.en: Do you have a model at a lower price?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan jiswa għoxrin ewro inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan jiswa għoxrin ewro inqas.
messages.zh: 有，这款便宜二十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, this one costs twenty euros less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象比较两张价格标签，手指向数值较小的一张，把整个短语记成“更低的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a time after now or after another time being discussed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在现在之后，或在所谈及的另一个时间之后。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi żmien wara l-ħin preżenti jew wara ħin ieħor li jkun qed jissemma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在现在或某个参照时间之后；稍后或更晚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'ħin li jiġi wara issa jew wara ħin ieħor li jkun qed jissemma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens later, it happens after now or after another time already mentioned.

formal.mt: Ir-riżultati tal-istudju se jiġu ppubblikati iktar tard din is-sena.
formal.en: The results of the study will be published later this year.
formal.zh: 该研究的结果将于今年晚些时候公布。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' ċċempilli issa? Mark: Għadni fuq ix-xogħol. Inċempillek iktar tard.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you call me now? Mark: I'm still at work. I'll call you later.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你现在能给我打电话吗？Mark：我还在上班，晚些时候给你打。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在能给我打电话吗？
messages.en: Can you call me now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni fuq ix-xogħol. Inċempillek iktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni fuq ix-xogħol. Inċempillek iktar tard.
messages.zh: 我还在上班，晚些时候给你打。
messages.en: I'm still at work. I'll call you later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在时间线上把事情往右推一点，想到“现在之后再做”，就能记住 iktar tard 表示稍后或更晚。

gloss_zh: 巴赫里亚，马耳他拉巴特附近的一个小村庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a small village near Rabat in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他拉巴特附近一个小村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' raħal żgħir fl-inħawi tar-Rabat, Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: A small village in the environs of Rabat, Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于马耳他拉巴特周边的一个小村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raħal żgħir li jinsab fl-inħawi tar-Rabat, Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Il-Baħrija is a small village situated near Rabat in Malta.

collocations.zh: 到巴赫里亚的一次访问

formal.mt: Il-Baħrija hija raħal żgħir fl-inħawi tar-Rabat, Malta.
formal.en: Il-Baħrija is a small village near Rabat in Malta.
formal.zh: 巴赫里亚是马耳他拉巴特附近的一个小村庄。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-Baħrija? David: Qiegħda fl-inħawi tar-Rabat, Malta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is Il-Baħrija? David: It's near Rabat in Malta.
colloquial.zh: Lara：巴赫里亚在哪里？David：在马耳他的拉巴特附近。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 巴赫里亚在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Il-Baħrija?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.zh: 在马耳他的拉巴特附近。
messages.en: It's near Rabat in Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把地名分成三级位置卡片记忆：“马耳他—拉巴特附近—巴赫里亚小村庄”，用位置关系帮助记住专名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Il-Belt Valletta is the name of Malta's capital city.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瓦莱塔是马耳他的首都；Il-Belt Valletta 是这座城市的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Belt Valletta hija l-belt kapitali ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Valletta, the capital city of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瓦莱塔，马耳他的首都。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Belt Valletta hija l-belt li hija l-kapitali ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Il-Belt Valletta is the Maltese name for Valletta, the capital city of Malta.

formal.mt: Il-Belt Valletta hija l-belt kapitali ta' Malta, u ż-żjara tagħna fiha se ssir nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: Valletta is the capital city of Malta, and our visit there will take place on Monday.
formal.zh: 瓦莱塔是马耳他的首都，我们将于星期一前往参观。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tmur il-Belt Valletta għada? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nimxi fiċ-ċentru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to go to Valletta tomorrow? Mark: Yes, I'd like to walk around the centre.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明天想去瓦莱塔吗？Mark：想，我想在市中心走走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天想去瓦莱塔吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to Valletta tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我想在市中心走走。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to walk around the centre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个名称和地图上的首都标记一起记：看到 Il-Belt Valletta，就联想到马耳他首都瓦莱塔。

gloss_zh: 比尔古（维托里奥萨），马耳他港区三城之一

teaching_sense.en_definition: Il-Birgu is Vittoriosa, one of the Three Cities in Malta's harbour area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Il-Birgu 指比尔古，又称维托里奥萨，是马耳他港区的三城之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Birgu huwa l-belt magħrufa wkoll bħala Vittoriosa, waħda mit-Tliet Ibliet fl-inħawi tal-port ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Vittoriosa, one of the Three Cities in Malta's harbour area
sense_translations.zh_definition: 维托里奥萨，即比尔古，是马耳他港区三城之一。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Birgu huwa l-belt ta' Vittoriosa, waħda mit-Tliet Ibliet fl-inħawi tal-port ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Il-Birgu is the name used for Vittoriosa, one of the Three Cities in Malta's harbour area.

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi mixja fil-Birgu, waħda mit-Tliet Ibliet fl-inħawi tal-port ta' Malta.
formal.en: The visit programme includes a walk in Birgu, one of the Three Cities in Malta's harbour area.
formal.zh: 参观行程包括在比尔古散步；比尔古是马耳他港区三城之一。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid immorru l-Birgu għada? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nagħmel mixja hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go to Birgu tomorrow? Mark: Yes, I'd like to take a walk there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们明天去比尔古好吗？Mark：好啊，我想去那里散散步。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天去比尔古好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to Birgu tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊，我想去那里散散步。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to take a walk there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Il-Birgu 与中文“比尔古”配对，再联想“港区三城之一”；用 żjara fil-Birgu“到比尔古参观”整块记忆地名的用法。

gloss_zh: 比尔古马，马耳他 Naxxar 和 San Pawl tat-Tarġa 一带的地区

teaching_sense.en_definition: Il-Birguma is an area of Malta near Naxxar and San Pawl tat-Tarġa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Il-Birguma 指马耳他的比尔古马地区，位于 Naxxar 和 San Pawl tat-Tarġa 一带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Birguma hija żona f'Malta fl-inħawi tan-Naxxar u ta' San Pawl tat-Tarġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: Birguma, area in Malta in the environs of Naxxar and San Pawl tat-Tarġa
sense_translations.zh_definition: 比尔古马，马耳他境内位于 Naxxar 和 San Pawl tat-Tarġa 一带的地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Birguma hija żona f'Malta li tinsab fl-inħawi tan-Naxxar u ta' San Pawl tat-Tarġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Il-Birguma refers to an area in Malta in the vicinity of Naxxar and San Pawl tat-Tarġa.

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, l-isem Il-Birguma jirreferi għal żona f'Malta fl-inħawi tan-Naxxar u ta' San Pawl tat-Tarġa.
formal.en: In this text, the name Il-Birguma refers to an area in Malta near Naxxar and San Pawl tat-Tarġa.
formal.zh: 在本文中，Il-Birguma 这一名称指马耳他 Naxxar 和 San Pawl tat-Tarġa 一带的地区。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn toqgħod? Pawlu: Noqgħod fil-Birguma, fl-inħawi tan-Naxxar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where do you live? Pawlu: I live in Birguma, near Naxxar.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你住在哪里？Pawlu：我住在比尔古马，在 Naxxar 一带。

messages.speaker: Lara (新同学)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 我住在比尔古马，在 Naxxar 一带。
messages.en: I live in Birguma, near Naxxar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 Il-Birguma 整体记成“比尔古马”，用末尾的 ma 提醒自己别漏掉“马”字；再搭配“住在比尔古马”这一场景，与 Il-Birgu 区分。

gloss_zh: 蓝洞，马耳他南部海岸的一组海蚀洞穴

teaching_sense.en_definition: Il-Blue Grotto is the name of a group of sea caves on Malta's southern coast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Il-Blue Grotto 是马耳他南部海岸一组海蚀洞穴的名称，中文通常称为“蓝洞”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Blue Grotto huwa l-isem ta' grupp ta' għerien tal-baħar fuq il-kosta tan-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: A group of sea caves on the southern coast of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于马耳他南部海岸的一组海蚀洞穴，称为“蓝洞”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Blue Grotto huwa grupp ta' għerien tal-baħar li jinsabu fuq il-kosta tan-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Il-Blue Grotto refers to a group of sea caves situated on the southern coast of Malta.

collocations.en: a visit to the Blue Grotto

formal.mt: Il-Blue Grotto jikkonsisti fi grupp ta' għerien tal-baħar fuq il-kosta tan-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The Blue Grotto consists of a group of sea caves on Malta's southern coast.
formal.zh: 蓝洞由马耳他南部海岸的一组海蚀洞穴组成。

colloquial.en: Nina: Have you seen the photos of the Blue Grotto? David: Yes! I'd like to go there.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看过蓝洞的照片吗？David：看过！我想去那里。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过蓝洞的照片吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the photos of the Blue Grotto?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 看过！我想去那里。
messages.en: Yes! I'd like to go there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Il-Blue Grotto，就联想“马耳他南岸的一组海洞”；特别记住中文虽简称“蓝洞”，这里的地名指一组洞穴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: If something is 'il bogħod, it is a long distance from a person, place, or other point of reference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人或某物离参照的人、地点或其他位置距离较远，意为“远”或“在远处”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-espressjoni 'il bogħod tindika li persuna jew ħaġa tinsab f'distanza kbira minn persuna, post jew punt ieħor ta' riferiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 远；距离某个参照位置较远。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta persuna jew ħaġa tkun 'il bogħod, tkun tinsab f'distanza kbira mill-post jew mill-persuna li qed issir referenza għalihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is far away, they are a long distance from the person or place being considered.

formal.mt: L-iskola tinsab 'il bogħod mid-dar tal-istudent, għalhekk huwa jmur bil-karozza tal-linja.
formal.en: The school is far from the student's home, so he travels by bus.
formal.zh: 学校离这名学生的家很远，因此他乘公共汽车上学。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ħanut qiegħed 'il bogħod minn hawn? Mark: Iva, qiegħed 'il bogħod wisq biex immorru bil-mixi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the shop far from here? Mark: Yes, it's too far for us to walk.
colloquial.zh: Sara：商店离这里远吗？Mark：远，太远了，我们走着去不合适。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店离这里远吗？
messages.en: Is the shop far from here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed 'il bogħod wisq biex immorru bil-mixi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed 'il bogħod wisq biex immorru bil-mixi.
messages.zh: 远，太远了，我们走着去不合适。
messages.en: Yes, it's too far for us to walk.

gloss_zh: 弗古拉，位于马耳他南部的城镇。

messages.en: Where is Fgura?

gloss_zh: 丰塔纳，位于戈佐岛的村庄。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a village on Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戈佐岛村庄丰塔纳的名称。

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他一座毗邻瓦莱塔的城镇的名称，英语称 Floriana。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弗洛里亚纳，马耳他一座毗邻瓦莱塔的城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Furjana hija belt f'Malta li tinsab maġenb il-Belt Valletta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Il-Furjana is the Maltese name for Floriana, a town in Malta next to Valletta.

gloss_zh: 古迪亚，马耳他南部的城镇

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他南部一座城镇的名称。

sense_translations.en_definition: Gudia, a town in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 古迪亚，位于马耳他南部的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Gudja hija belt li tinsab fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 格济拉，位于马耳他中部地区的一座城镇。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卡拉弗拉纳，位于马耳他南部的一个小村庄的名称。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa tar-residenti se ssir fil-Kalafrana nhar is-Sibt filgħodu.
formal.en: The residents' meeting will take place in Kalafrana on Saturday morning.
formal.zh: 居民会议将于星期六上午在卡拉弗拉纳举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada? Mark: Fil-Kalafrana, ħdejn id-dar taz-zija tiegħi. Lara: Tajjeb, ibgħatli l-indirizz.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we meet tomorrow? Mark: In Kalafrana, near my aunt's house. Lara: All right, send me the address.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们明天在哪里见面？马克：在卡拉弗拉纳，我姨妈家附近。拉拉：好，把地址发给我。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在卡拉弗拉纳，我姨妈家附近。
messages.en: In Kalafrana, near my aunt's house.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，把地址发给我。
messages.en: All right, send me the address.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“卡拉弗拉纳”标在想象中的马耳他南部地图上，再记住 fil-Kalafrana 表示“在卡拉弗拉纳”。

gloss_zh: 卡尔卡拉（马耳他南部城镇）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Il-Kalkara is the name of a town in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Il-Kalkara 是马耳他南部一座城镇的名称，中文可译作“卡尔卡拉”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Kalkara hija belt fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Kalkara, a town in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卡尔卡拉，位于马耳他南部的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Kalkara hija belt li tinsab fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Kalkara is a town located in the southern part of Malta.

collocations.zh: 到卡尔卡拉的一次游览

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-iskola jinkludi żjara fil-Kalkara biex l-istudenti jsiru jafu aħjar din il-belt fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The school programme includes a visit to Kalkara so that students can get to know this town in southern Malta better.
formal.zh: 学校的活动安排包括参观卡尔卡拉，让学生更好地了解这座位于马耳他南部的城镇。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejrin il-Ħadd? Mark: Sejrin il-Kalkara. Trid tiġi magħna? Maja: Iva, nixtieq inżurha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we going on Sunday? Mark: We're going to Kalkara. Would you like to come with us? Maja: Yes, I'd like to visit it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们星期天去哪里？马克：我们去卡尔卡拉。你想跟我们一起去吗？玛雅：想，我想去那里看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们星期天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去卡尔卡拉。你想跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: We're going to Kalkara. Would you like to come with us?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我想去那里看看。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to visit it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Il-Kalkara 和“马耳他南部的卡尔卡拉”配成地图词卡，再用 żjara fil-Kalkara“到卡尔卡拉游览”整块记忆。

gloss_zh: 卡帕拉（位于圣瓜恩、圣朱利安和格济拉周边的小村落）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Il-Kappara is the name of a hamlet in the area around San Ġwann, San Ġiljan and Gżira.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Il-Kappara 是一处小村落的名称，位于圣瓜恩、圣朱利安和格济拉周边地区，中文可译作“卡帕拉”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Kappara hija raħal żgħir fl-inħawi ta' San Ġwann, San Ġiljan u l-Gżira.

sense_translations.en_definition: Kappara, a hamlet situated in the environs of San Ġwann, San Ġiljan and Gżira
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卡帕拉，位于圣瓜恩、圣朱利安和格济拉周边地区的一处小村落。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Kappara hija raħal żgħir li jinsab fl-inħawi ta' San Ġwann, San Ġiljan u l-Gżira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Kappara is a small settlement in the area around San Ġwann, San Ġiljan and Gżira.

formal.mt: Il-Kappara hija raħal żgħir fl-inħawi ta' San Ġwann, San Ġiljan u l-Gżira, u hija mmarkata fuq il-mappa mehmuża.
formal.en: Kappara is a hamlet in the area around San Ġwann, San Ġiljan and Gżira, and it is marked on the attached map.
formal.zh: 卡帕拉是位于圣瓜恩、圣朱利安和格济拉周边的一处小村落，已在随附的地图上标出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn toqgħod? Pawlu: Noqgħod fil-Kappara. Sara: Tista' turini fejn hi fuq il-mappa? Pawlu: Iva, ara hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do you live? Pawlu: I live in Kappara. Sara: Can you show me where it is on the map? Pawlu: Yes, look here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你住在哪里？保罗：我住在卡帕拉。萨拉：你能在地图上指给我看吗？保罗：可以，看这里。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 我住在卡帕拉。
messages.en: I live in Kappara.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' turini fejn hi fuq il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' turini fejn hi fuq il-mappa?
messages.zh: 你能在地图上指给我看吗？
messages.en: Can you show me where it is on the map?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 可以，看这里。
messages.en: Yes, look here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Il-Kappara 写在词卡中央，旁边列出三个周边地名；再朗读 Noqgħod fil-Kappara“我住在卡帕拉”，用居住场景记住地名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bank account is an arrangement with a bank for keeping money and recording money paid in or taken out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 银行为客户开立的账户，用来存放资金，并记录存入、支出或转账等资金往来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kont tal-bank huwa kont li persuna jew organizzazzjoni jkollha ma' bank biex iżżomm il-flus u tirreġistra l-flus li jidħlu u joħorġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 银行账户，即客户在银行开立、用于存放资金及记录资金往来的账户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kont tal-bank huwa kont f'isem persuna jew organizzazzjoni li fih jinżammu l-flus u jiġu rreġistrati d-depożiti, il-ġbid u t-trasferimenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have a bank account, the bank holds money for you and keeps a record of money entering and leaving the account.

collocations.en: to deposit money into the bank account

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ivverifika n-numru tal-kont tal-bank qabel tibgħat il-ħlas.
formal.en: Please verify the bank account number before sending the payment.
formal.zh: 请在付款前核实银行账号。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Daħlu l-flus fil-kont tal-bank? Pawlu: Għadni ma ċċekkjajtx. Se niċċekkja issa. Maja: Tajjeb, għidli meta jidħlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the money arrived in the bank account? Pawlu: I haven't checked yet. I'll check now. Maja: Okay, let me know when it arrives.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：钱到账了吗？保罗：我还没查。我现在查一下。玛雅：好，到账了告诉我。

messages.speaker: Maja (妻子)
messages.zh: 钱到账了吗？
messages.en: Has the money arrived in the bank account?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma ċċekkjajtx. Se niċċekkja issa.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma ċċekkjajtx. Se niċċekkja issa.
messages.zh: 我还没查。我现在查一下。
messages.en: I haven't checked yet. I'll check now.

messages.speaker: Maja (妻子)
messages.zh: 好，到账了告诉我。
messages.en: Okay, let me know when it arrives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 il-kont tal-bank 与手机银行里的“银行账户”画面对应，再串起“开户、存钱、查余额”三个动作，整组记住账户的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sacred book of Islam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伊斯兰教的经典《古兰经》。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ktieb qaddis tar-reliġjon Iżlamika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 《古兰经》，伊斯兰教的经典。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ktieb qaddis tal-Iżlam, li huwa test ċentrali għall-fidi Musulmana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Koran is the sacred book of Islam.

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu żewġ traduzzjonijiet tal-Koran waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The students compared two translations of the Koran during the lesson.
formal.zh: 学生们在课堂上比较了《古兰经》的两个译本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Sami: Qed naqra traduzzjoni tal-Koran bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Sami: I'm reading an English translation of the Koran.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读什么？萨米：我在读《古兰经》的英文译本。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Sami (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在读《古兰经》的英文译本。
messages.en: I'm reading an English translation of the Koran.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Il-Koran 当作书名整体记忆，再用“阅读、译本、选段”三个场景串联；看到 tal-Koran 时联想“《古兰经》的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The highest amount, level, or value that is allowed or possible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 允许达到或可能达到的最高数量、水平或数值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ogħla ammont, livell jew valur li hu permess jew possibbli li jintlaħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最高限额；某项金额或数量所规定的最高允许值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ogħla ammont jew kwantità li regola tippermetti u li ma jistax jinqabeż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ceiling is the highest amount or level that a rule allows something to reach.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上限；某个范围、数量或水平的最高界限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ogħla punt ta' firxa jew l-ogħla valur li ammont jew livell jista' jilħaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An upper limit is the highest value or point within a particular range.

formal.mt: Il-limitu massimu tal-għotja huwa ta' elf ewro għal kull applikant.
formal.en: The maximum grant amount is one thousand euros per applicant.
formal.zh: 每位申请人可获得的补助上限为一千欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nonfqu sittin ewro fuq ir-rigal? Pawlu: Le, il-limitu massimu huwa ħamsin ewro. Ejja nagħżlu xi ħaġa orħos.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we spend sixty euros on the gift? Pawlu: No, the upper limit is fifty euros. Let's choose something cheaper.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们可以买六十欧元的礼物吗？保罗：不行，上限是五十欧元。我们选个便宜一点的吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nonfqu sittin ewro fuq ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nonfqu sittin ewro fuq ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 我们可以买六十欧元的礼物吗？
messages.en: Can we spend sixty euros on the gift?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-limitu massimu huwa ħamsin ewro. Ejja nagħżlu xi ħaġa orħos.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-limitu massimu huwa ħamsin ewro. Ejja nagħżlu xi ħaġa orħos.
messages.zh: 不行，上限是五十欧元。我们选个便宜一点的吧。
messages.en: No, the upper limit is fifty euros. Let's choose something cheaper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预算表上方画着一条“最高五十欧元”的横线，把 il-limitu massimu 整体记成“上限”；对应英语 ceiling 时，记的是数值的最高界限。

gloss_zh: Il-Madliena，马耳他东北部的一个小村落

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a hamlet in the north-east of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他东北部一个小村落的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raħal żgħir li jinsab fil-grigal ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Madliena, a hamlet in the north-east of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: Madliena，位于马耳他东北部的一个小村落。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Madliena hija l-isem ta' raħal żgħir fil-grigal ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Madliena is a hamlet situated in the north-eastern part of Malta.

formal.mt: Il-Madliena tinsab fil-grigal ta' Malta u hija raħal żgħir.
formal.en: Madliena is situated in the north-east of Malta and is a small settlement.
formal.zh: Madliena 位于马耳他东北部，是一个小村落。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf fejn tinsab il-Madliena? Mark: Iva, tinsab fil-grigal ta' Malta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know where Madliena is? Mark: Yes, it is in the north-east of Malta.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道 Madliena 在哪里吗？Mark：知道，在马耳他东北部。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 你知道 Madliena 在哪里吗？
messages.en: Do you know where Madliena is?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.zh: 知道，在马耳他东北部。
messages.en: Yes, it is in the north-east of Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象中的马耳他地图右上方放一张写着 Il-Madliena 的小村落标签，把完整地名与“东北部”一起记忆；这只是学习用的地图联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a village in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他一个村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raħal li jinsab f'Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Magħtab，位于马耳他的一个村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Magħtab huwa l-isem ta' raħal f'Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Magħtab is the name of a village located in Malta.

formal.mt: Il-Magħtab huwa raħal f'Malta; f'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom isibuh fuq il-mappa.
formal.en: Magħtab is a village in Malta; in this exercise, students should locate it on the map.
formal.zh: Magħtab 是马耳他的一个村庄；在这项练习中，学生应在地图上找到它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn toqgħod? Mark: Noqgħod fil-Magħtab. Maja: Tista' turini fejn jinsab fuq il-mappa?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you live? Mark: I live in Magħtab. Maja: Can you show me where it is on the map?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你住在哪里？Mark：我住在 Magħtab。Maja：你能在地图上指给我看吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (新朋友)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Mark (村庄居民)
messages.zh: 我住在 Magħtab。
messages.en: I live in Magħtab.

messages.speaker: Maja (新朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' turini fejn jinsab fuq il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' turini fejn jinsab fuq il-mappa?
messages.zh: 你能在地图上指给我看吗？
messages.en: Can you show me where it is on the map?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块写着 Il-Magħtab 的村口路牌，再用 Noqgħod fil-Magħtab 练习“我住在这个村庄”；完整记住地名，并注意保留字母 għ。

gloss_zh: 马尼卡塔，马耳他梅利哈外围的村庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: Il-Manikata is a village in Malta on the outskirts of Mellieħa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马尼卡塔是马耳他的一个村庄，位于梅利哈外围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Manikata hija raħal f'Malta fit-truf tal-Mellieħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: Manikata, a village in Malta on the outskirts of Mellieħa
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马尼卡塔，位于马耳他梅利哈外围的一个村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Manikata hija raħal f'Malta li jinsab fit-truf tal-Mellieħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Manikata is the name of a village situated on the outskirts of Mellieħa in Malta.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħhom, l-istudenti ddeskrivew iż-żjara fil-Manikata, raħal fit-truf tal-Mellieħa.
formal.en: In their report, the students described their visit to Manikata, a village on the outskirts of Mellieħa.
formal.zh: 学生们在报告中描述了他们对马尼卡塔的访问；这个村庄位于梅利哈外围。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejrin illum? Mark: Se mmorru l-Manikata. Maja: Fejn hi? Mark: Hija raħal fit-truf tal-Mellieħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we going today? Mark: We're going to Manikata. Maja: Where is it? Mark: It's a village on the outskirts of Mellieħa.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今天去哪里？马克：我们去马尼卡塔。玛雅：它在哪里？马克：它是梅利哈外围的一个村庄。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去马尼卡塔。
messages.en: We're going to Manikata.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 它在哪里？
messages.en: Where is it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它是梅利哈外围的一个村庄。
messages.en: It's a village on the outskirts of Mellieħa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Il-Manikata 和地图上“梅利哈外围的小村庄”这一画面绑定记忆；练习说 żjara fil-Manikata，记住“到马尼卡塔访问”的搭配。

gloss_zh: 相反的情况；倒转后的次序

teaching_sense.en_definition: The opposite of something, or its order when reversed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某事物相反的情况，或将原有次序倒转后得到的次序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-maqlub huwa dak li jkun oppost għal xi ħaġa, jew l-ordni li tinkiseb meta sekwenza tinqaleb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与原来相反的情况或方向；原有次序倒转后的结果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-maqlub huwa l-oppost ta' xi ħaġa jew ir-riżultat meta l-ordni jew id-direzzjoni tagħha tinqaleb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The reverse of something is its opposite or the result of reversing its order or direction.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jiktbu l-maqlub tas-sekwenza A, B, C, jiġifieri C, B, A.
formal.en: In this exercise, the students should write the reverse of the sequence A, B, C, namely C, B, A.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生应写出序列 A、B、C 倒转后的次序，即 C、B、A。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-maqlub ta' wieħed, tnejn, tlieta? Mark: Tlieta, tnejn, wieħed. Maja: Eżatt! Issa aqra l-bqija bil-maqlub.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the reverse of one, two, three? Mark: Three, two, one. Maja: Exactly! Now read the rest in reverse order.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：一、二、三倒过来是什么？马克：三、二、一。玛雅：对！现在把其余的也倒着读。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu l-maqlub ta' wieħed, tnejn, tlieta?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu l-maqlub ta' wieħed, tnejn, tlieta?
messages.zh: 一、二、三倒过来是什么？
messages.en: What's the reverse of one, two, three?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 三、二、一。
messages.en: Three, two, one.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 对！现在把其余的也倒着读。
messages.en: Exactly! Now read the rest in reverse order.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上写“一二三→三二一”，把倒转后的结果标作 il-maqlub；再记 bil-maqlub 表示“按相反次序”，用数字画面帮助回忆。

gloss_zh: 马尔法，马耳他的一个小海湾

teaching_sense.en_definition: Il-Marfa is the name of a small bay in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马尔法是马耳他一个小海湾的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Marfa huwa l-isem ta' bajja żgħira f'Malta.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天想去哪里？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想去马尔法。
messages.en: I'd like to go to Marfa.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是马耳他的一个海湾吗？
messages.en: Is that a bay in Malta?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，一个小海湾。
messages.en: Yes, a small bay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Il-Marfa 写在一幅小海湾简笔画旁，旁注“马尔法，马耳他的小海湾”；反复读 il-bajja tal-Marfa，让地名与海湾画面一起进入记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The day that was two days before today.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 前天，即以今天为参照，往前数两天的那一天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum ta' qabel ilbieraħ, jiġifieri jumejn qabel illum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前天，即昨天之前的那一天。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-jum li jiġi qabel ilbieraħ, jiġifieri jumejn qabel illum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ilbieraħtlula refers to the day that was two days before today.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前天，指相对于今天而言的两天前。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-jum li kien jumejn qabel illum, eżatt qabel ilbieraħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you refer to ilbieraħtlula, you mean the day immediately before yesterday.

collocations.en: he arrived the day before yesterday
the meeting from the day before yesterday

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa saret ilbieraħtlula, u r-rapport tagħha ntbagħat illum.
formal.en: The meeting took place the day before yesterday, and its report was sent today.
formal.zh: 会议于前天举行，会议报告已于今天发出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta wasal ħuk? Pawlu: Wasal ilbieraħtlula. Sara: Mela ilu hawn jumejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: When did your brother arrive? Pawlu: He arrived the day before yesterday. Sara: So he's been here for two days.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你兄弟什么时候到的？Pawlu：他前天到的。Sara：那他已经在这里两天了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟什么时候到的？
messages.en: When did your brother arrive?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他前天到的。
messages.en: He arrived the day before yesterday.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那他已经在这里两天了。
messages.en: So he's been here for two days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出今天、昨天、前天三个格子，把 ilbieraħtlula 写在前天格里，用往回两格的动作帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A time expression referring to the day two days before today.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示前天的时间表达，即今天之前的第二天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' żmien li tirreferi għall-jum ta' qabel ilbieraħ, jiġifieri jumejn qabel illum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前天，即比昨天再早一天。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-jum ta' qabel ilbieraħ, li kien jumejn qabel illum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ilbiraħtlula identifies the day immediately before yesterday, two days before today.

collocations.en: I bought the book the day before yesterday
it started the day before yesterday

formal.mt: Il-kors beda ilbiraħtlula, u l-ewwel lezzjoni kienet dwar il-qari.
formal.en: The course began the day before yesterday, and the first lesson was about reading.
formal.zh: 课程于前天开始，第一课的内容是阅读。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta xtrajt dan il-ktieb? Nina: Xtrajtu ilbiraħtlula. Lara: Diġà bdejt taqrah?
colloquial.en: Lara: When did you buy this book? Nina: I bought it the day before yesterday. Lara: Have you started reading it already?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你什么时候买的这本书？Nina：我前天买的。Lara：你已经开始读了吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你什么时候买的这本书？
messages.en: When did you buy this book?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 我前天买的。
messages.en: I bought it the day before yesterday.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你已经开始读了吗？
messages.en: Have you started reading it already?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ilbiraħtlula 和前天买书的画面绑定；每次复习先从今天倒数两天，再读出整个词形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The day immediately before yesterday, measured from today.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 前天，即紧接在昨天之前、距离今天两天的那一天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum li jiġi eżatt qabel ilbieraħ, jiġifieri jumejn qabel illum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前天，以今天为基准往前推两天的那一天。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-jum li kien jumejn qabel illum u li jiġi qabel ilbieraħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ilbiraħtlura refers to the day immediately before yesterday, rather than yesterday itself.

collocations.en: I left the day before yesterday
I received the letter the day before yesterday

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju rċieva l-ittra ilbiraħtlura, u bagħat tweġiba illum.
formal.en: The office received the letter the day before yesterday and sent a reply today.
formal.zh: 办公室于前天收到来信，并于今天发出了回复。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta rċevejt l-ittra? Anna: Irċevejtha ilbiraħtlura. Mark: U bgħatt tweġiba? Anna: Iva, illum.
colloquial.en: Mark: When did you receive the letter? Anna: I received it the day before yesterday. Mark: And did you send a reply? Anna: Yes, today.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你什么时候收到信的？Anna：我前天收到的。Mark：那你回信了吗？Anna：回了，今天回的。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 你什么时候收到信的？
messages.en: When did you receive the letter?

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 我前天收到的。
messages.en: I received it the day before yesterday.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 那你回信了吗？
messages.en: And did you send a reply?

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 回了，今天回的。
messages.en: Yes, today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上前天收到一封信，把 ilbiraħtlura 写在那一格；抄写时特别看清结尾的 ra。

gloss_zh: 动词；所给释义“T talljan”含义不明，暂无法可靠译出。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb supplied with the unclear gloss 'T talljan', whose meaning cannot be reliably established from this packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词包标为动词的形式，但所给释义“T talljan”不够清楚，无法据此确定其具体意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma verbali mogħtija bil-glossa 'T talljan', li mhix ċara biżżejjed biex it-tifsira tagħha tiġi stabbilita minn dan il-pakkett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义为“T talljan”；该释义含义不明，无法据此可靠确定中文意义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija hija 'T talljan', iżda din ma tipprovdix tifsira ċara biżżejjed biex il-verb jiġi spjegat b'mod affidabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss is unclear, so this packet does not establish a reliable meaning for the verb.

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jelenka 'ilebbet' bħala verb, iżda l-glossa 'T talljan' teħtieġ kjarifika qabel ma tingħata traduzzjoni preċiża.
formal.en: The packet lists 'ilebbet' as a verb, but the gloss 'T talljan' requires clarification before a precise translation can be given.
formal.zh: 词包将“ilebbet”列为动词，但必须先澄清释义“T talljan”，才能给出准确翻译。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ilebbet'? Rita: Il-pakkett jgħid 'T talljan', imma dik il-glossa mhix ċara. Maja: Mela għalissa nħalli t-tifsira mhux ikkonfermata.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ilebbet' mean? Rita: The packet says 'T talljan', but that gloss is unclear. Maja: Then I'll leave the meaning unconfirmed for now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：ilebbet是什么意思？Rita：词包写的是“T talljan”，但这个释义不清楚。Maja：那我暂时把它的意思标为未确认。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ilebbet是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ilebbet' mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakkett jgħid 'T talljan', imma dik il-glossa mhix ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakkett jgħid 'T talljan', imma dik il-glossa mhix ċara.
messages.zh: 词包写的是“T talljan”，但这个释义不清楚。
messages.en: The packet says 'T talljan', but that gloss is unclear.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għalissa nħalli t-tifsira mhux ikkonfermata.
messages.mt_standard: Mela għalissa nħalli t-tifsira mhux ikkonfermata.
messages.zh: 那我暂时把它的意思标为未确认。
messages.en: Then I'll leave the meaning unconfirmed for now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习卡片先记“动词、释义待核”；不要凭“T talljan”的外形猜词义，以免把猜测记成事实。

gloss_zh: 喝酒；饮用含酒精的饮料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drink alcoholic beverages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饮用含有酒精的饮料，即喝酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tixrob xorb li fih l-alkoħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝酒，饮用含酒精的饮料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tixrob birra, inbid jew xorb ieħor li jkun fih l-alkoħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone drinks alcohol, they consume beverages that contain alcohol.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, Mark ilegleg mal-ħbieb tiegħu waqt il-festa.
formal.en: In the story, Mark drinks alcohol with his friends during the party.
formal.zh: 故事中，Mark在聚会上和朋友们一起喝酒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed jagħmel Mark? Rita: Ilegleg mal-ħbieb tiegħu. Maja: Jien se nieħu ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is Mark doing? Rita: He's drinking alcohol with his friends. Maja: I'll have some water.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark在做什么？Rita：他在和朋友们喝酒。Maja：我喝点水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark在做什么？
messages.en: What is Mark doing?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在和朋友们喝酒。
messages.en: He's drinking alcohol with his friends.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喝点水。
messages.en: I'll have some water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ilegleg与“朋友举杯喝酒”的画面配对，再用“喝啤酒”和“和朋友喝酒”两个搭配巩固；这是场景记忆法。

gloss_zh: 他们／她们已经……一段时间了

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression indicating how long people have been doing something or have been in a particular state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他们或她们做某事或处于某种状态已经持续了一段时间的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi kemm ilu għaddej żmien minn meta grupp ta' persuni beda jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jinsab f'ċerta qagħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们／她们已经做某事或处于某种状态一段时间了。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tindika li xi persuni bdew attività jew daħlu f'ċerta qagħda qabel u għadhom hekk sal-ħin li qed nitkellmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use ilhom to indicate how long people have continued an activity or remained in a particular state.

collocations.zh: 他们已经等了一段时间了

collocations.en: they have been here for an hour
collocations.zh: 他们在这里已经一个小时了

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti ilhom sagħtejn jiddiskutu l-proposta.
formal.en: The participants have been discussing the proposal for two hours.
formal.zh: 与会者讨论这项提案已经两个小时了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tfal għadhom jistennew? Pawlu: Iva, ilhom nofs siegħa jistennew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are the children still waiting? Pawlu: Yes, they have been waiting for half an hour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：孩子们还在等吗？保罗：是的，他们已经等了半个小时了。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子们还在等吗？
messages.en: Are the children still waiting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 是的，他们已经等了半个小时了。
messages.en: Yes, they have been waiting for half an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人一起等车，旁边的计时器一直走：ilhom 强调“他们已经持续多久”，练习时总配上时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very large land mammal with a long trunk, large ears, and thick skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种体型很大的陆生哺乳动物，有长鼻、大耳和厚皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu kbir ħafna li jgħix fuq l-art u għandu tromba twila, widnejn kbar u ġilda ħoxna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大象，一种长着长鼻和大耳的大型陆生哺乳动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu ta' daqs kbir ħafna, b'tromba twila li juża biex jaqbad l-ikel u jiġbed l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An elephant is a very large mammal that uses its long trunk to handle food and draw up water.

formal.mt: L-iljunfant juża t-tromba tiegħu biex jaqbad l-ikel u jwasslu lejn ħalqu.
formal.en: The elephant uses its trunk to pick up food and bring it to its mouth.
formal.zh: 大象用鼻子抓取食物，再把食物送到嘴边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-iljunfant fl-istampa! Ben: Kemm għandu tromba twila! Maja: Iva, qed jaqbad fergħa biha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that elephant in the picture! Ben: What a long trunk it has! Maja: Yes, it's picking up a branch with it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看图片里的那头大象！本：它的鼻子好长啊！玛雅：是啊，它正用鼻子抓一根树枝。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 看图片里的那头大象！
messages.en: Look at that elephant in the picture!

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 它的鼻子好长啊！
messages.en: What a long trunk it has!

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，它正用鼻子抓一根树枝。
messages.en: Yes, it's picking up a branch with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 iljunfant 就想象“大耳朵、长鼻子、厚皮肤”的大象，再配合“鼻子抓树枝”的动作巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ilkoll means all the members of a group, with no one left out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示一个群体的全部成员，强调所有人都包括在内，没有遗漏任何一个人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilkoll tfisser il-membri kollha ta' grupp, mingħajr ma jitħalla barra ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全体；所有人，指某一群体的全部成员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilkoll tfisser il-membri kollha ta' grupp meqjusin flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use ilkoll to refer to all the members of a group together.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每一个人；每一位，强调群体中的任何成员都不例外。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilkoll tfisser kull wieħed mill-membri ta' grupp, mingħajr ebda eċċezzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use ilkoll to emphasize that every individual in a group is included.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti huma mitluba jaslu fil-ħin sabiex ilkoll ikunu jistgħu jieħdu sehem fid-diskussjoni.
formal.en: Participants are asked to arrive on time so that everyone can take part in the discussion.
formal.zh: 请参与者准时到场，以便所有人都能参加讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Waslu l-ħbieb? Mark: Iva, qegħdin hawn ilkoll. Lara: Tajjeb, mela nistgħu nibdew nieklu!
colloquial.en: Lara: Have our friends arrived? Mark: Yes, they're all here. Lara: Great, then we can start eating!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：朋友们到了吗？马克：到了，他们全都在这里。拉拉：好，那我们可以开饭了！

messages.speaker: Lara (聚餐主人)
messages.zh: 朋友们到了吗？
messages.en: Have our friends arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 到了，他们全都在这里。
messages.en: Yes, they're all here.

messages.speaker: Lara (聚餐主人)
messages.zh: 好，那我们可以开饭了！
messages.en: Great, then we can start eating!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚餐点名时每个人都举手，用 ilkoll 对应“全员到齐，一个不少”；再把 aħna lkoll“我们所有人”作为完整词组练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To distil alcohol using an alembic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用曲颈蒸馏器，通过加热和冷凝蒸馏酒精。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddistilla l-alkoħol f'apparat li jsaħħan il-likwidu u jiġbor il-fwar biex ikessaħu u jerġa' jsiru likwidu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to distil alcohol (this verb referred to distillation using an alembic)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒸馏酒精；该动词指使用曲颈蒸馏器进行蒸馏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddistilla l-alkoħol bl-użu ta' apparat b'reċipjent għat-tisħin u b'parti li minnha jgħaddi l-fwar biex jitkessaħ u jinġabar bħala likwidu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone distils alcohol using an alembic, they heat a liquid and collect the vapour after it cools into liquid again.

collocations.en: distil the alcohol using an alembic
collocations.zh: 用曲颈蒸馏器蒸馏酒精

collocations.en: distil the wine using an alembic
collocations.zh: 用曲颈蒸馏器蒸馏葡萄酒

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi kif il-ħaddiem illampika l-inbid u ġabar il-likwidu wara li l-fwar tkessaħ.
formal.en: The text describes how the worker distilled the wine using an alembic and collected the liquid after the vapour cooled.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述了工人如何用曲颈蒸馏器蒸馏葡萄酒，并在蒸气冷却后收集液体。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'illampika' f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Tfisser li ddistilla l-alkoħol b'dan l-apparat.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'illampika' mean in this text? Pawlu: It means that he distilled alcohol using this apparatus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文字里的 illampika 是什么意思？保罗：意思是他用这种设备蒸馏了酒精。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文字里的 illampika 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'illampika' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li ddistilla l-alkoħol b'dan l-apparat.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li ddistilla l-alkoħol b'dan l-apparat.
messages.zh: 意思是他用这种设备蒸馏了酒精。
messages.en: It means that he distilled alcohol using this apparatus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“加热液体、蒸气上升、冷却收集”三幅连续画面，把 illampika 与用蒸馏器蒸馏酒精的动作相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something less tight or less tense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使原本拉紧、绷紧或勒紧的东西变松。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa inqas issikkata jew inqas miġbuda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使松弛；减小拉力或紧度，使绷紧或勒紧的东西变松。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tnaqqas kemm xi ħaġa tkun issikkata jew miġbuda, sabiex issir aktar laxka.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you slacken something, you make it less tight or reduce the tension in it.

formal.mt: Qabel ma ċċaqlaq il-kaxxa, illaxka l-ħabel li qed iżommha f'postha.
formal.en: Before moving the box, slacken the rope that is holding it in place.
formal.zh: 移动箱子之前，先把固定它的绳子放松。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Iċ-ċinturin qed jagħfasni. Lara: Illaxka ċ-ċinturin ftit biex tkun aktar komdu.
colloquial.en: Mark: My belt is digging into me. Lara: Loosen your belt a little so you'll be more comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 马克：腰带勒得我难受。拉拉：把腰带松一点，这样会舒服些。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 腰带勒得我难受。
messages.en: My belt is digging into me.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illaxka ċ-ċinturin ftit biex tkun aktar komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Illaxka ċ-ċinturin ftit biex tkun aktar komdu.
messages.zh: 把腰带松一点，这样会舒服些。
messages.en: Loosen your belt a little so you'll be more comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根绷紧的绳子慢慢垂下来，把 illaxka 记成“把紧的变松”；再用松腰带的日常画面巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not permitted by law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 法律不允许的，或违反法律规定的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhux permess mil-liġi jew li jmur kontra l-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非法的；不符合法律规定的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jmur kontra l-liġi u għalhekk mhux permess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An activity or action that is illegal is forbidden by law.

formal.mt: Huwa illegali li tuża dokumenti foloz biex tikseb permess.
formal.en: It is illegal to use false documents to obtain a permit.
formal.zh: 使用伪造文件获取许可证属于违法行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nsuq mingħajr liċenzja? Mark: Le, huwa illegali li ssuq mingħajr liċenzja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I drive without a licence? Mark: No, it is illegal to drive without a licence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以无证开车吗？马克：不可以，无证驾驶是违法的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以无证开车吗？
messages.en: Can I drive without a licence?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa illegali li ssuq mingħajr liċenzja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa illegali li ssuq mingħajr liċenzja.
messages.zh: 不可以，无证驾驶是违法的。
messages.en: No, it is illegal to drive without a licence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 illegali 和英语 illegal 配对记忆，再联想“无证驾驶”的场景，记住它表示法律禁止，而不只是一般的不合适。

gloss_zh: 字迹难以辨认的；无法辨读的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impossible or very difficult to read because the writing is unclear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因字迹或印刷不清而无法辨读或很难辨认的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jinqara jew li diffiċli ħafna biex jinqara għax il-kitba mhix ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 字迹或印刷模糊到难以辨认、无法读出的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu kitba jew stampar tant mhux ċar li l-kliem ma jistax jinqara jew jingħaraf faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Writing that is illegible is so unclear that you cannot read it, or can read it only with great difficulty.

formal.mt: Jekk il-kitba fuq il-formola tkun illeġibbli, l-uffiċċju jista' jitlob kopja aktar ċara.
formal.en: If the handwriting on the form is illegible, the office may request a clearer copy.
formal.zh: 如果表格上的字迹无法辨认，办事处可能会要求提供更清晰的副本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' taqra din in-nota? Mark: Bilkemm! Il-kitba hija kważi illeġibbli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you read this note? Mark: Barely! The handwriting is almost illegible.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你能看清这张便条吗？马克：勉强能！这字迹几乎无法辨认。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你能看清这张便条吗？
messages.en: Can you read this note?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 勉强能！这字迹几乎无法辨认。
messages.en: Barely! The handwriting is almost illegible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象便条上的字挤成一团，连字母也认不出来；用这幅画面记住 illeġibbli，重点是字迹难辨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To set someone free from confinement, control, or a dangerous situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人摆脱囚禁、控制或危险处境，获得自由或得到解救。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Teħles lil xi ħadd mill-priġunerija, mill-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor jew minn sitwazzjoni perikoluża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解放；释放，使某人摆脱囚禁或他人的控制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Teħles lil xi ħadd mill-priġunerija jew mill-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor biex ikun jista' jgħix fil-libertà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone liberates a person, they free that person from imprisonment or another person's control.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解救；救出，使某人脱离被困或危险的处境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Teħles lil xi ħadd minn post fejn ikun maqbud jew minn sitwazzjoni li tkun ta' periklu għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone rescues a person, they help that person escape from danger or a situation in which they are trapped.

formal.mt: It-tim tas-salvataġġ illibera lir-raġel li kien maqbud fil-karozza wara l-inċident.
formal.en: The rescue team freed the man who was trapped in the car after the accident.
formal.zh: 救援队救出了事故后被困在车内的男子。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ir-raġel għadu maqbud fil-karozza? Sara: Le, it-tim tas-salvataġġ illiberah. Issa jinsab f'post sigur.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the man still trapped in the car? Sara: No, the rescue team freed him. He is somewhere safe now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那名男子还被困在车里吗？萨拉：没有，救援队已经把他救出来了。他现在在安全的地方。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 那名男子还被困在车里吗？
messages.en: Is the man still trapped in the car?

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, it-tim tas-salvataġġ illiberah. Issa jinsab f'post sigur.
messages.mt_standard: Le, it-tim tas-salvataġġ illiberah. Issa jinsab f'post sigur.
messages.zh: 没有，救援队已经把他救出来了。他现在在安全的地方。
messages.en: No, the rescue team freed him. He is somewhere safe now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“打开牢门”和“救出车内被困者”两幅画面记 illibera：前者帮助记住释放、解放，后者帮助记住解救，共同点是使人摆脱束缚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rub or treat a surface so that it becomes smooth and shiny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过擦拭或处理物体表面，使其变得光滑、有光泽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Togħrok jew tittratta wiċċ ta' oġġett biex isir lixx u jleqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦亮；抛光，通过摩擦或使用适当用品使表面光亮。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Togħrok wiċċ ta' oġġett, b'ċarruta jew bi prodott adattat, biex tagħmlu lixx u jleqq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you polish an object, you rub or treat its surface to make it smooth and shiny.

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, il-ħaddiem illostra l-oġġetti tal-fidda b'ċarruta ratba.
formal.en: Before the exhibition, the worker polished the silver objects with a soft cloth.
formal.zh: 展览开始前，工作人员用软布擦亮了银器。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm qed ileqqu ż-żraben tiegħek! Mark: Missieri illostrahom dalgħodu. Issa lesti għat-tieġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Your shoes are so shiny! Mark: My father polished them this morning. Now they are ready for the wedding.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的鞋子真亮！马克：我爸爸今天早上把它们擦亮了。现在可以穿去参加婚礼了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的鞋子真亮！
messages.en: Your shoes are so shiny!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri illostrahom dalgħodu. Issa lesti għat-tieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri illostrahom dalgħodu. Issa lesti għat-tieġ.
messages.zh: 我爸爸今天早上把它们擦亮了。现在可以穿去参加婚礼了。
messages.en: My father polished them this morning. Now they are ready for the wedding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用软布反复擦鞋，直到鞋面反光，把这个动作与 illostra 绑定记忆：重点是把表面擦出光泽，也可用于银器等物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At the present time, especially when describing how things are different from the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示如今或现今，尤其用于说明现在的情况与过去有所不同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser fiż-żmien ta' issa, speċjalment meta wieħed iqabbel il-preżent mal-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 如今；现今，常用于将当前情况与过去作比较。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fiż-żmien preżenti, ħafna drabi b'referenza għal kif l-affarijiet inbidlu mill-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to describe what happens or is true at the present time, often in contrast with the past.

formal.mt: Illum il-ġurnata ħafna studenti jużaw riżorsi diġitali biex jitgħallmu lingwi ġodda.
formal.en: Nowadays many students use digital resources to learn new languages.
formal.zh: 如今，许多学生使用数字资源学习新的语言。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum il-ġurnata tixtri ħafna affarijiet minn fuq l-internet? Mark: Iva, imma l-ħobż għadni nixtrih mill-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you buy many things online nowadays? Mark: Yes, but I still buy bread from the shop.
colloquial.zh: Maja：如今你经常在网上买东西吗？Mark：是的，不过面包我还是去商店买。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum il-ġurnata tixtri ħafna affarijiet minn fuq l-internet?
messages.mt_standard: Illum il-ġurnata tixtri ħafna affarijiet minn fuq l-internet?
messages.zh: 如今你经常在网上买东西吗？
messages.en: Do you buy many things online nowadays?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ħobż għadni nixtrih mill-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ħobż għadni nixtrih mill-ħanut.
messages.zh: 是的，不过面包我还是去商店买。
messages.en: Yes, but I still buy bread from the shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组短语记成“如今这个时代”：想象对比过去购物与现在网购的两幅画面，提醒自己它通常表示“如今”，不只是“今天”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Water containing minerals, consumed as drinking water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有矿物质、供饮用的水，即矿泉水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma li fih minerali u li jintuża għax-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矿泉水，指含有矿物质的饮用水。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilma tax-xorb li fih minerali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mineral water is drinking water that contains minerals.

formal.mt: Għal-laqgħa, jekk jogħġbok ipprepara flixkun ilma minerali għal kull parteċipant.
formal.en: For the meeting, please prepare a bottle of mineral water for each participant.
formal.zh: 请为会议的每位参加者准备一瓶矿泉水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Flixkun ilma minerali, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Tridu kiesaħ? Maja: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: A bottle of mineral water, please. Mark: Would you like it cold? Maja: Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：请给我一瓶矿泉水。Mark：要冰的吗？Maja：要，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一瓶矿泉水。
messages.en: A bottle of mineral water, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 要冰的吗？
messages.en: Would you like it cold?

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ilma 记作“水”，把 minerali 与英语 minerals 联系起来，想象瓶身上的矿物质标签，再连读 flixkun ilma minerali，记成“一瓶矿泉水”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Water that remains still rather than flowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 停留在原处、不流动的水，常指积存的死水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma qiegħed huwa ilma li jibqa' fl-istess post mingħajr ma jiċċirkola jew jgħaddi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不流动、长期停积在原处的水；死水。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilma qiegħed huwa ilma li jibqa' miġbur fl-istess post u ma jiċċirkolax.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Stagnant water stays in one place without flowing or circulating.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-bitħa, instabet għadira ta' ilma qiegħed ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: During the inspection of the yard, a pool of stagnant water was found beside the wall.
formal.zh: 检查院子时，在墙边发现了一洼不流动的积水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tbattal il-barmil? Mark: Fih ilma qiegħed minn ġimgħa ilu. Maja: Imbagħad ejja naħsluh ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you emptying the bucket? Mark: It's had stagnant water in it for a week. Maja: Then let's wash it too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在倒空水桶？马克：里面的水已经积了一星期了。玛雅：那我们也把桶洗一洗吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在倒空水桶？
messages.en: Why are you emptying the bucket?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fih ilma qiegħed minn ġimgħa ilu.
messages.mt_standard: Fih ilma qiegħed minn ġimgħa ilu.
messages.zh: 里面的水已经积了一星期了。
messages.en: It's had stagnant water in it for a week.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那我们也把桶洗一洗吧。
messages.en: Then let's wash it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一桶放着不动的水，把 ilma qiegħed 整体记成“停在原处的水”；再用流动的小溪作对照，突出“积存、不流动”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Water that is suitable or intended for drinking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 适合或供人饮用的水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma li huwa tajjeb għax-xorb jew maħsub biex jinxtorob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饮用水；适合或供人饮用的水。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilma tax-xorb huwa ilma li huwa tajjeb biex in-nies jixorbuh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Drinking water is water that is suitable or intended for people to drink.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kwalità tal-ilma tax-xorb fl-iskola.
formal.en: The report describes the quality of the drinking water at the school.
formal.zh: 该报告描述了学校饮用水的水质。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna biżżejjed ilma tax-xorb għall-vjaġġ? Pawlu: Iva, ħadt żewġ fliexken għal kull wieħed minna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we have enough drinking water for the trip? Pawlu: Yes, I packed two bottles for each of us.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们这趟旅行的饮用水够吗？Pawlu：够，我给我们每个人都装了两瓶。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅伴)
messages.zh: 我们这趟旅行的饮用水够吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough drinking water for the trip?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadt żewġ fliexken għal kull wieħed minna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadt żewġ fliexken għal kull wieħed minna.
messages.zh: 够，我给我们每个人都装了两瓶。
messages.en: Yes, I packed two bottles for each of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语贴在想象中的饮用水瓶上，看到水瓶就说 ilma tax-xorb，再用“饮用水供应”练习搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement expressing dissatisfaction with something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事表示不满的言语或书面陈述，可指投诉或抱怨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stqarrija bil-fomm jew bil-miktub li tesprimi nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon b'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投诉；抱怨；表达对某事不满的陈述。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilment huwa stqarrija li biha persuna tesprimi n-nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon tagħha b'xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A complaint is a statement in which someone expresses dissatisfaction with something.

formal.mt: Il-klijent ressaq ilment bil-miktub dwar id-dewmien fil-kunsinna.
formal.en: The customer submitted a written complaint about the delay in delivery.
formal.zh: 该顾客就送货延误提交了书面投诉。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq nagħmel ilment. L-ordni tiegħi għadha ma waslitx. Rita: Tista' tagħtini n-numru tal-ordni, jekk jogħġbok?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like to make a complaint. My order still hasn't arrived. Rita: Could you give me the order number, please?
colloquial.zh: Mark：我想投诉。我的订单到现在还没送到。Rita：请您提供一下订单编号，好吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nagħmel ilment. L-ordni tiegħi għadha ma waslitx.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nagħmel ilment. L-ordni tiegħi għadha ma waslitx.
messages.zh: 我想投诉。我的订单到现在还没送到。
messages.en: I'd like to make a complaint. My order still hasn't arrived.

messages.speaker: Rita (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini n-numru tal-ordni, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini n-numru tal-ordni, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请您提供一下订单编号，好吗？
messages.en: Could you give me the order number, please?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象订单迟迟未到，向客服说 Nixtieq nagħmel ilment（我想提出投诉）；把 ilment 和具体的不满情境一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express dissatisfaction about something or tell someone that there is a problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事表示不满，或向有关的人反映问题、提出投诉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri li mhuwiex kuntent b'xi ħaġa jew jgħid lil xi ħadd li hemm problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱怨；表示不满；提出投诉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jesprimi nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon dwar xi ħaġa jew jiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' xi ħadd għal problema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone complains, they express dissatisfaction about something or report a problem.

formal.mt: Il-klijent ilmenta dwar id-dewmien, u l-uffiċċju wieġeb bil-miktub.
formal.en: The customer complained about the delay, and the office replied in writing.
formal.zh: 顾客投诉了延误问题，办公室作出了书面回复。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ilmentajt dwar l-istorbju? Mark: Iva, tkellimt mal-ġar u issa hemm inqas storbju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you complain about the noise? Mark: Yes, I spoke to the neighbour, and now there is less noise.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你投诉噪声了吗？马克：投诉了，我跟邻居谈过，现在噪声小些了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你投诉噪声了吗？
messages.en: Did you complain about the noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkellimt mal-ġar u issa hemm inqas storbju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkellimt mal-ġar u issa hemm inqas storbju.
messages.zh: 投诉了，我跟邻居谈过，现在噪声小些了。
messages.en: Yes, I spoke to the neighbour, and now there is less noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象噪声太大时开口抱怨：用 ilmenta 记动作，搭配 dwar 记抱怨的事情，搭配 ma' 记投诉的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of spoken words to express thoughts and communicate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过口头语言表达思想、与人交流的活动或表达方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu tal-kliem mitkellem biex nesprimu l-ħsibijiet tagħna u nikkomunikaw ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话，即用口头语言表达意思、进行交流。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li nużaw il-vuċi u l-kliem biex nesprimu dak li naħsbu jew inħossu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Speaking involves using your voice to express thoughts and communicate with other people.

collocations.zh: 我们清晰而尊重他人的言语表达

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, ilsienna għandu jkun ċar u rispettuz sabiex kulħadd ikun jista' jifhem il-messaġġ.
formal.en: During the discussion, our speech should be clear and respectful so that everyone can understand the message.
formal.zh: 讨论时，我们的言语表达应当清晰并尊重他人，以便每个人都能理解所传达的意思。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif nistgħu ntejbu ilsienna waqt il-preżentazzjoni? Pawlu: Nużaw kliem sempliċi u nitkellmu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marta: How can we improve our speech during the presentation? Pawlu: We can use simple words and speak slowly.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我们怎样才能改善展示时的言语表达？Pawlu：我们可以用简单的词，慢慢说。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nistgħu ntejbu ilsienna waqt il-preżentazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nistgħu ntejbu ilsienna waqt il-preżentazzjoni?
messages.zh: 我们怎样才能改善展示时的言语表达？
messages.en: How can we improve our speech during the presentation?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nużaw kliem sempliċi u nitkellmu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Nużaw kliem sempliċi u nitkellmu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 我们可以用简单的词，慢慢说。
messages.en: We can use simple words and speak slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ilsienna 放进课堂发言的画面中：先想清楚，再用清晰、礼貌的言语表达，借场景记住“说话、言语表达”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: People who are deprived of freedom and treated as the property of others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被剥夺自由、被他人当作财产控制的人，指复数的奴隶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nies li jkunu mċaħħda mil-libertà tagħhom u meqjusa bħala proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奴隶；被剥夺人身自由、被他人当作财产支配的人们。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuni li ma jkunux liberi li jiddeċiedu għalihom infushom u li jkunu taħt il-kontroll ta' oħrajn bħala proprjetà tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Slaves are people who are denied personal freedom and treated as the property of other people.

formal.mt: It-test jiddefinixxi l-ilsira bħala persuni mċaħħda mil-libertà u meqjusa bħala proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: The text defines slaves as people deprived of freedom and treated as the property of others.
formal.zh: 该文本将奴隶定义为被剥夺自由、被他人当作财产的人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser il-kelma ilsira f'dan it-test? Mark: Tfisser nies li kienu mċaħħda mil-libertà u meqjusa bħala proprjetà ta' oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the word ilsira mean in this text? Mark: It means people who were deprived of freedom and treated as the property of others.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这篇文章里的 ilsira 是什么意思？Mark：指被剥夺自由、被他人当作财产的人们。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma ilsira f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma ilsira f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 ilsira 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word ilsira mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser nies li kienu mċaħħda mil-libertà u meqjusa bħala proprjetà ta' oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser nies li kienu mċaħħda mil-libertà u meqjusa bħala proprjetà ta' oħrajn.
messages.zh: 指被剥夺自由、被他人当作财产的人们。
messages.en: It means people who were deprived of freedom and treated as the property of others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 ilsira 时，把“失去自由的一群人”与“奴隶解放”的课堂主题联系起来，同时记住这里表示复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Residential institutions that provide care and accommodation for children whose parents have died.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为失去父母的儿童提供住宿和照护的机构，指复数的孤儿院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Istituzzjonijiet residenzjali li jipprovdu akkomodazzjoni u kura lil tfal li jkunu tilfu lill-ġenituri tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孤儿院；为失去父母的儿童提供居住、照护和生活支持的机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Djar jew istituzzjonijiet fejn jgħixu u jingħataw kura tfal li l-ġenituri tagħhom ikunu mietu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Orphanages are residential institutions where children whose parents have died receive accommodation and care.

formal.mt: Il-proposta titlob aktar finanzjament għall-iltiema sabiex it-tfal ikollhom akkomodazzjoni sigura u kura xierqa.
formal.en: The proposal calls for more funding for orphanages so that children have safe accommodation and appropriate care.
formal.zh: 该提案要求增加孤儿院经费，让儿童获得安全的住所和适当的照护。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għal min qed tiġbru dawn il-kotba? David: Għall-iltiema; irridu li t-tfal ikollhom aktar kotba x'jaqraw.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who are you collecting these books for? David: For orphanages; we want the children to have more books to read.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你们在为谁收集这些书？David：为孤儿院；我们希望孩子们有更多书可以读。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal min qed tiġbru dawn il-kotba?
messages.mt_standard: Għal min qed tiġbru dawn il-kotba?
messages.zh: 你们在为谁收集这些书？
messages.en: Who are you collecting these books for?

messages.speaker: David (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-iltiema; irridu li t-tfal ikollhom aktar kotba x'jaqraw.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-iltiema; irridu li t-tfal ikollhom aktar kotba x'jaqraw.
messages.zh: 为孤儿院；我们希望孩子们有更多书可以读。
messages.en: For orphanages; we want the children to have more books to read.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iltiema 与“为多家孤儿院募集图书和经费”的场景配对，记住此处表示提供住宿照护的机构，且为复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A child whose mother, father, or both parents have died.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 父亲、母亲或双亲已经去世的儿童。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel jew tifla li jkunu tilfu lil wieħed mill-ġenituri tagħhom jew lit-tnejn minħabba l-mewt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孤儿；因父母一方或双方去世而失去父亲、母亲或双亲的儿童。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifel jew tifla li wieħed mill-ġenituri tagħhom jew it-tnejn ikunu mietu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An orphan is a child whose mother, father, or both parents have died.

formal.mt: Il-programm għandu l-għan li jipprovdi lil kull iltim appoġġ edukattiv u ambjent sigur fejn jikber.
formal.en: The programme aims to provide every orphan with educational support and a safe environment in which to grow up.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在为每一名孤儿提供教育支持和安全的成长环境。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu t-tifel fil-bidu tal-istorja? Toni: Huwa iltim li jgħix man-nanna tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is the boy at the beginning of the story? Toni: He is an orphan who lives with his grandmother.
colloquial.zh: Marija：故事开头的那个男孩是谁？Toni：他是个与祖母一起生活的孤儿。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 故事开头的那个男孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is the boy at the beginning of the story?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa iltim li jgħix man-nanna tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa iltim li jgħix man-nanna tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他是个与祖母一起生活的孤儿。
messages.en: He is an orphan who lives with his grandmother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iltim 放进“故事里的一个孤儿与祖母同住”的画面，借一个具体人物记住这个词指儿童个人。

gloss_zh: 管好你自己的事；别多管闲事

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression telling someone to attend to their own affairs and stop interfering in other people's matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于叫对方管好自己的事，不要干涉别人的事情，语气通常比较直接。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tgħid lil xi ħadd jieħu ħsieb affarijietu u ma jindaħalx fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管好你自己的事，不要多管别人的闲事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kliem li tgħid lil persuna biex tieqaf tindaħal fi kwistjonijiet li ma jikkonċernawhiex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tell someone this, you are telling them to stop interfering in matters that do not concern them.

collocations.en: Mind your own business and don't interfere.
collocations.zh: 管好你自己的事，别插手。

formal.mt: F'diskussjoni formali, l-espressjoni 'ilħaq għasstek' tista' tinstema' ħarxa; aħjar titlob lill-persuna tirrispetta l-privatezza tiegħek.
formal.en: In a formal discussion, the expression 'mind your own business' can sound harsh; it is better to ask the person to respect your privacy.
formal.zh: 在正式讨论中，“管好你自己的事”可能显得生硬；最好请对方尊重你的隐私。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed taqra l-messaġġi tiegħi? Lara: Ridt biss nara min kitiblek. Mark: Ilħaq għasstek, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you reading my messages? Lara: I just wanted to see who wrote to you. Mark: Mind your own business, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么在看我的消息？拉拉：我只是想看看谁给你发了消息。马克：请管好你自己的事。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在看我的消息？
messages.en: Why are you reading my messages?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我只是想看看谁给你发了消息。
messages.en: I just wanted to see who wrote to you.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 请管好你自己的事。
messages.en: Mind your own business, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句和“别人偷看手机，我请他别多管闲事”的场景一起记忆；这是直接划清私人界限的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The short, rough facial hair that I have, especially when it has recently grown after shaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指我脸上短而扎手的胡须，尤其是剃须后新长出的胡茬；词义包含“我的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-leħja tiegħi meta x-xagħar tal-wiċċ ikun għadu qasir u jinħass aħrax, speċjalment wara li jerġa' jikber wara t-tqaxxir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我的胡茬，即我脸上短而粗硬的胡须。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xagħar qasir u aħrax tal-leħja tiegħi, bħal dak li jikber ftit wara li nqaxxar wiċċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When I refer to my stubble, I mean the short, rough hair growing on my face after shaving.

collocations.en: run my hand over my stubble

formal.mt: Filgħodu nqaxxar ilħiti qabel ma mmur għax-xogħol biex ikolli dehra pulita.
formal.en: In the morning, I shave my stubble before going to work so that I look neat.
formal.zh: 早上上班前，我会剃掉胡茬，让自己看起来整洁。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Meta ngħaddi idi fuq ilħiti, inħoss ix-xagħar iniggeż. Rita: Trid tqaxxarha qabel ma noħorġu? Pawlu: Iva, se nqaxxarha issa.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: When I run my hand over my stubble, the hairs feel prickly. Rita: Do you want to shave it before we go out? Pawlu: Yes, I'll shave it now.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我用手摸胡茬时，觉得有点扎手。丽塔：你想在我们出门前剃掉吗？保罗：想，我现在就剃。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (伴侣)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ngħaddi idi fuq ilħiti, inħoss ix-xagħar iniggeż.
messages.mt_standard: Meta ngħaddi idi fuq ilħiti, inħoss ix-xagħar iniggeż.
messages.zh: 我用手摸胡茬时，觉得有点扎手。
messages.en: When I run my hand over my stubble, the hairs feel prickly.

messages.speaker: Rita (伴侣)
messages.zh: 你想在我们出门前剃掉吗？
messages.en: Do you want to shave it before we go out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (伴侣)
messages.zh: 想，我现在就剃。
messages.en: Yes, I'll shave it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己摸着下巴说“我的胡茬真扎手”，把 ilħiti 整体记成“我的胡茬”，不要漏掉所属意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money that someone owes to another person or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或机构欠他人、需要偿还的钱款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus li persuna jew organizzazzjoni għandha tagħti lura lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 个人或机构所欠、需要偿还的钱款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma flus li persuna jew organizzazzjoni għandha tħallas lura lil ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A debt is an amount of money that you owe to another person or organization.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija għandha tħallas l-imaxx qabel tmiem is-sena.
formal.en: The company must pay the debt before the end of the year.
formal.zh: 公司必须在年底前偿还这笔债务。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għad għandek l-imaxx? Pawlu: Iva, imma se nħallsu x-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you still have the debt? Pawlu: Yes, but I'll pay it next month.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你还欠着那笔钱吗？保罗：是的，不过我下个月会还清。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还欠着那笔钱吗？
messages.en: Do you still have the debt?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma se nħallsu x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma se nħallsu x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我下个月会还清。
messages.en: Yes, but I'll pay it next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imaxx 放进“借钱后记账、到期要还”的画面，再用 tħallas l-imaxx 练习“偿还债务”的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: After that, as the next action or event in a sequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某个动作或事件之后接着发生另一件事，即“然后、随后”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wara dak li jkun seħħ jew sar, biex tindika l-azzjoni jew il-ġrajja li tiġi wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 然后；随后，表示接下来发生的动作或事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wara azzjoni jew ġrajja msemmija qabel, biex tindika dak li jseħħ wara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use then to introduce something that happens after the action or event you have just mentioned.

formal.mt: L-ewwel aqra l-istruzzjonijiet, imbagħad imla l-formola.
formal.en: First read the instructions, then complete the form.
formal.zh: 先阅读说明，然后填写表格。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se nagħmlu llum? Sara: L-ewwel nixtru l-ħobż, imbagħad immorru d-dar.
colloquial.en: Mark: What are we going to do today? Sara: First we'll buy bread, then we'll go home.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们今天要做什么？萨拉：先买面包，然后回家。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天要做什么？
messages.en: What are we going to do today?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel nixtru l-ħobż, imbagħad immorru d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel nixtru l-ħobż, imbagħad immorru d-dar.
messages.zh: 先买面包，然后回家。
messages.en: First we'll buy bread, then we'll go home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个按顺序排列的动作框，在连接箭头上写 imbagħad；看到箭头就说“然后”，并用“先买面包，然后回家”练习。

gloss_zh: 销售包装；直接销售单元的包装

teaching_sense.en_definition: Packaging that forms a sales unit with a product for the final customer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与商品共同构成向最终顾客出售的一个销售单元的包装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li, flimkien mal-prodott, jifforma unità li tinbiegħ lill-konsumatur finali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一级包装，即与商品共同构成供最终消费者购买的销售单元的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-imballaġġ li jifforma mal-prodott unità waħda għall-bejgħ lill-konsumatur finali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Primary packaging is the packaging that forms an individual sales unit with a product for the final consumer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 销售包装，即商品以一个销售单元提供给最终顾客时所使用的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imballaġġ maħsub biex il-prodott jiġi offrut bħala unità għall-bejgħ lill-klijent finali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sales packaging is packaging designed to present a product as a unit for purchase by the final customer.

collocations.en: the design of the sales packaging
the label on the sales packaging

formal.mt: L-imballaġġ għall-bejgħ għandu juri b'mod ċar l-isem tal-prodott u l-kwantità.
formal.en: The sales packaging should clearly display the product name and quantity.
formal.zh: 销售包装应清楚标明商品名称和数量。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-kaxxa hija l-imballaġġ għall-bejgħ? David: Iva, il-klijent jixtri l-prodott f'din il-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this box the sales packaging? David: Yes, the customer buys the product in this box.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个盒子就是销售包装吗？戴维：是的，顾客买到的商品就装在这个盒子里。

messages.speaker: Anna (店员)
messages.zh: 这个盒子就是销售包装吗？
messages.en: Is this box the sales packaging?

messages.speaker: David (店长)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-klijent jixtri l-prodott f'din il-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-klijent jixtri l-prodott f'din il-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 是的，顾客买到的商品就装在这个盒子里。
messages.en: Yes, the customer buys the product in this box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货架上一个连盒出售的商品，把“商品加包装等于一个销售单元”与 imballaġġ għall-bejgħ 联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Packaging used to protect goods and make them easier to handle and transport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于保护货物并方便搬运和运输的包装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li jipproteġi l-oġġetti u jagħmilha aktar faċli li jiġu mmaniġġjati u ttrasportati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三级包装，即将多个销售单元或成组包装集中起来，以便搬运和运输的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li jiġbor flimkien diversi unitajiet għall-bejgħ jew pakketti raggruppati biex jiffaċilita l-immaniġġjar u t-trasport tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tertiary packaging brings together sales units or grouped packages so that they can be handled and transported more easily.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 运输包装，即为方便货物运输、搬运并减少途中损坏而使用的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imballaġġ użat biex jiffaċilita t-trasport u l-immaniġġjar tal-oġġetti u jnaqqas il-ħsara matul il-vjaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Transport packaging protects goods during their journey and makes them easier to move and handle.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tagħbija, il-ħaddiema għandhom jiċċekkjaw li l-imballaġġ għat-trasport jipproteġi l-kaxxi mill-ħsara.
formal.en: Before loading, workers should check that the transport packaging protects the boxes from damage.
formal.zh: 装货前，工人应检查运输包装是否能保护箱子免受损坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dawn il-kaxxi huma mgeżwra kollha flimkien? Mark: Dak hu l-imballaġġ għat-trasport. Iżommhom flimkien waqt il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are all these boxes wrapped together? Mark: That's the transport packaging. It keeps them together during the journey.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些箱子为什么全都包在一起？马克：那是运输包装，运输途中可以把它们固定在一起。

messages.speaker: Maja (仓库新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dawn il-kaxxi huma mgeżwra kollha flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dawn il-kaxxi huma mgeżwra kollha flimkien?
messages.zh: 这些箱子为什么全都包在一起？
