messages.en: Why are all these boxes wrapped together?

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-imballaġġ għat-trasport. Iżommhom flimkien waqt il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-imballaġġ għat-trasport. Iżommhom flimkien waqt il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 那是运输包装，运输途中可以把它们固定在一起。
messages.en: That's the transport packaging. It keeps them together during the journey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组箱子一起装车的画面记住：这个词组强调包装服务于运输和搬运。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Packaging that groups several sales units together and can be removed without changing the products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将多个销售单元组合在一起、拆除后不改变产品本身的包装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li jiġbor flimkien diversi unitajiet għall-bejgħ u li jista' jitneħħa mingħajr ma jinbidlu l-prodotti nfushom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 组合包装，即将若干销售单元集中成一组，供成组销售或补充货架使用的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li jiġbor għadd ta' unitajiet għall-bejgħ fi grupp, sabiex jinbiegħu flimkien jew biex jimtlew l-ixkafef bihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Grouped packaging holds several sales units together for sale as a group or for restocking shelves.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二级包装，即位于单个销售单元包装之外、用于将多个销售单元组合起来的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li jkun barra mill-imballaġġ tal-unitajiet individwali għall-bejgħ u li jiġbor diversi unitajiet flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Secondary packaging surrounds several individually packaged sales units and keeps them together as a group.

formal.mt: L-imballaġġ kollettiv jiġbor sitt fliexken f'pakkett wieħed u jista' jitneħħa mingħajr ma jinfetħu l-fliexken.
formal.en: The grouped packaging holds six bottles in one pack and can be removed without opening the bottles.
formal.zh: 组合包装将六瓶产品装成一包，拆除时无需打开瓶子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Inneħħi dan il-kartun qabel inpoġġi l-fliexken fuq l-ixkaffa? Pawlu: Iva, dak hu l-imballaġġ kollettiv. Il-fliexken jibqgħu magħluqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Should I remove this cardboard before putting the bottles on the shelf? Pawlu: Yes, that's the grouped packaging. The bottles stay sealed.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：把瓶子放上货架前，要拆掉这层纸板吗？保罗：要，那是组合包装。瓶子仍然保持密封。

messages.speaker: Sara (商店新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Inneħħi dan il-kartun qabel inpoġġi l-fliexken fuq l-ixkaffa?
messages.mt_standard: Inneħħi dan il-kartun qabel inpoġġi l-fliexken fuq l-ixkaffa?
messages.zh: 把瓶子放上货架前，要拆掉这层纸板吗？
messages.en: Should I remove this cardboard before putting the bottles on the shelf?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (商店同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak hu l-imballaġġ kollettiv. Il-fliexken jibqgħu magħluqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak hu l-imballaġġ kollettiv. Il-fliexken jibqgħu magħluqa.
messages.zh: 要，那是组合包装。瓶子仍然保持密封。
messages.en: Yes, that's the grouped packaging. The bottles stay sealed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象纸板把六瓶饮料抱成一组：拆开外层，里面各瓶仍完整，就记住组合包装。

gloss_zh: 一次性包装；非重复使用包装

teaching_sense.en_definition: Packaging designed to be used once rather than repeatedly for the same purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设计为只使用一次，而非为相同用途反复使用的包装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imballaġġ maħsub biex jintuża darba biss u mhux biex jerġa' jintuża ripetutament għall-istess skop.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非重复使用包装，即未设计为可再次用于原有包装用途的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pakkett li mhuwiex iddisinjat biex jerġa' jintuża għall-iskop oriġinali tiegħu bħala imballaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-reusable pack is intended for a single use and is not designed for repeated use as packaging.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 单程包装，即使用后不按设计返回包装循环、再次用于原用途的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imballaġġ maħsub għal użu wieħed, li mhuwiex iddisinjat biex jintbagħat lura u jerġa' jintuża għall-istess skop.
sense_translations.en_explanation: One-way packaging is used once and is not designed to be returned for another use in the same packaging cycle.

collocations.mt: l-użu ta' imballaġġ li jintuża darba

collocations.zh: 一次性包装的替代方案

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qed tnaqqas l-imballaġġ li jintuża darba billi tuża kaxxi li jistgħu jerġgħu jintużaw.
formal.en: The company is reducing single-use packaging by using boxes that can be reused.
formal.zh: 公司正在采用可重复使用的箱子，以减少一次性包装的使用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dawn il-kaxxi nibagħtuhom lura lill-fornitur? Toni: Le, dawn huma imballaġġ li jintuża darba. Għall-ordni li jmiss nistgħu nitolbu kaxxi li jerġgħu jintużaw.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we send these boxes back to the supplier? Toni: No, these are single-use packaging. For the next order, we can ask for reusable boxes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些箱子要寄回供应商吗？托尼：不用，这些是一次性包装。下次订货时，我们可以要求使用可重复使用的箱子。

messages.speaker: Lara (收货员工)
messages.zh: 这些箱子要寄回供应商吗？
messages.en: Do we send these boxes back to the supplier?

messages.speaker: Toni (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dawn huma imballaġġ li jintuża darba. Għall-ordni li jmiss nistgħu nitolbu kaxxi li jerġgħu jintużaw.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dawn huma imballaġġ li jintuża darba. Għall-ordni li jmiss nistgħu nitolbu kaxxi li jerġgħu jintużaw.
messages.zh: 不用，这些是一次性包装。下次订货时，我们可以要求使用可重复使用的箱子。
messages.en: No, these are single-use packaging. For the next order, we can ask for reusable boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“包装只用一次”的完整画面记忆整个词组；是否能回收，与是否设计为重复使用分开理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Packaging that forms a sales unit with a product for the final customer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与产品一起构成供最终顾客购买的销售单元的包装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li, flimkien mal-prodott, jifforma unità għall-bejgħ lill-klijent finali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 初级包装，即在单个销售单元层面容纳或包裹产品、通常直接接触产品的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li jżomm jew jagħlaq il-prodott fil-livell tal-unità individwali għall-bejgħ u li normalment ikun f'kuntatt dirett miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Primary packaging contains or encloses a product as an individual sales unit and is usually in direct contact with it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 销售包装，即设计为与产品一起构成最终顾客在销售点购买的一个单元的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imballaġġ iddisinjat biex, flimkien mal-prodott, jifforma unità li l-klijent finali jixtri fil-punt tal-bejgħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sales packaging forms a unit with the product that the final customer buys at the point of sale.

formal.mt: Għal dan il-meraq, il-flixkun huwa l-imballaġġ primarju: fih il-prodott u jinbiegħ miegħu lill-klijent.
formal.en: For this juice, the bottle is the primary packaging: it contains the product and is sold with it to the customer.
formal.zh: 对于这款果汁，瓶子就是初级包装：它盛装产品，并与产品一起出售给顾客。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-flixkun tal-meraq jgħodd bħala imballaġġ primarju? David: Iva, fih il-meraq u tixtrih miegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does the juice bottle count as primary packaging? David: Yes, it holds the juice, and you buy it together with the juice.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：果汁瓶算初级包装吗？戴维：算，它盛着果汁，你买果汁时也一起买下了瓶子。

messages.speaker: Nina (包装课程学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-flixkun tal-meraq jgħodd bħala imballaġġ primarju?
messages.mt_standard: Il-flixkun tal-meraq jgħodd bħala imballaġġ primarju?
messages.zh: 果汁瓶算初级包装吗？
messages.en: Does the juice bottle count as primary packaging?

messages.speaker: David (包装课程教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih il-meraq u tixtrih miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih il-meraq u tixtrih miegħu.
messages.zh: 算，它盛着果汁，你买果汁时也一起买下了瓶子。
messages.en: Yes, it holds the juice, and you buy it together with the juice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里买到的一瓶果汁：瓶子盛装产品，又随产品一起出售，帮助记住初级包装与销售包装两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Packaging that groups several individually packaged products into one unit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把若干已有各自包装的产品组合成一个单元的外层包装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li jiġbor flimkien diversi prodotti li diġà għandhom l-imballaġġ individwali tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把多个销售单位集中组合起来的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li jiġbor diversi unitajiet għall-bejgħ flimkien fi grupp wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Grouped packaging holds several sales units together as a single group.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于产品直接包装之外、用于组合多个产品单位的第二层包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saff ta' imballaġġ madwar l-imballaġġ individwali ta' diversi prodotti, li jżommhom flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Secondary packaging surrounds individual product packages and keeps several of them together.

formal.mt: Il-kaxxa li tiġbor sitt pakketti individwali sservi bħala imballaġġ sekondarju.
formal.en: The box holding six individual packages serves as secondary packaging.
formal.zh: 装有六个独立包装的盒子充当二级包装。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dawn is-sitt pakketti qegħdin f'kaxxa waħda? Toni: Il-kaxxa hija l-imballaġġ sekondarju; iżżommhom kollha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are these six packages in one box? Toni: The box is the secondary packaging; it keeps them all together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这六个包装为什么装在同一个盒子里？托尼：这个盒子是二级包装，用来把它们集中放在一起。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dawn is-sitt pakketti qegħdin f'kaxxa waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dawn is-sitt pakketti qegħdin f'kaxxa waħda?
messages.zh: 这六个包装为什么装在同一个盒子里？
messages.en: Why are these six packages in one box?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kaxxa hija l-imballaġġ sekondarju; iżżommhom kollha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kaxxa hija l-imballaġġ sekondarju; iżżommhom kollha flimkien.
messages.zh: 这个盒子是二级包装，用来把它们集中放在一起。
messages.en: The box is the secondary packaging; it keeps them all together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象六包各自封好的饼干再装进一个盒子：外面的组合盒就是二级包装。用“单包外面再成组”的画面记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Packaging used to combine and protect goods during handling and transport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为便于搬运和运输而将货物集中固定并加以保护的包装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imballaġġ li jiġbor u jipproteġi l-merkanzija biex ikun aktar faċli li tinġarr u tiġi ttrasportata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将多个已包装的货物单位集中起来，以便搬运和运输的第三层包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saff ta' imballaġġ li jiġbor diversi unitajiet diġà ppakkjati biex jinġarru u jiġu ttrasportati flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tertiary packaging combines already packaged goods into a larger unit for handling and transport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在运输和相关搬运过程中保护、固定货物的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imballaġġ maħsub biex jipproteġi l-merkanzija u jżommha f'postha waqt it-trasport u l-immaniġġjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Transport packaging protects goods and keeps them secure while they are moved.

formal.mt: Il-kaxxi tqiegħdu fuq pallet u ntrabtu flimkien; dan l-imballaġġ terzjarju jżommhom stabbli waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The boxes were placed on a pallet and secured together; this tertiary packaging keeps them stable during transport.
formal.zh: 箱子被放在托盘上并捆扎在一起；这种三级包装使它们在运输过程中保持稳定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex rabattu l-kaxxi kollha mal-pallet? Mark: Dan huwa l-imballaġġ terzjarju; jgħin biex il-kaxxi ma jiċċaqalqux waqt il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you secure all the boxes to the pallet? Mark: This is the tertiary packaging; it helps stop the boxes moving during the journey.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们为什么把所有箱子都固定在托盘上？马克：这是三级包装，有助于防止箱子在运输途中移动。

messages.speaker: Lara (仓库新员工)
messages.zh: 你们为什么把所有箱子都固定在托盘上？
messages.en: Why did you secure all the boxes to the pallet?

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa l-imballaġġ terzjarju; jgħin biex il-kaxxi ma jiċċaqalqux waqt il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa l-imballaġġ terzjarju; jgħin biex il-kaxxi ma jiċċaqalqux waqt il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 这是三级包装，有助于防止箱子在运输途中移动。
messages.en: This is the tertiary packaging; it helps stop the boxes moving during the journey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把记忆画面从单个商品放大到整托货物：多个箱子固定在托盘上准备运输，就联想到三级包装。重点记住“成批搬运和运输”的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unwanted things or assorted small objects kept together, often in a disorderly way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 堆放在一起的不需要的东西或各种零碎物品，常带有杂乱的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Affarijiet mhux mixtieqa jew oġġetti żgħar u differenti miġbura flimkien, spiss mingħajr ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不再需要、没有多少用途或价值的杂物、破烂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Affarijiet li m'għadhomx meħtieġa jew li ftit għandhom użu jew valur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Junk consists of unwanted things that have little practical use or value.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各种零散、不成套的小物品，不一定已经无用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti żgħar ta' tipi differenti li jinsabu flimkien mingħajr ma jiffurmaw sett wieħed, u li jistgħu jkunu għadhom utli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Odds and ends are assorted small items that do not form a matching set.

formal.mt: Qabel ma bdiet it-tiswija, il-ħaddiema neħħew l-imbarazz mill-kamra u żammew biss l-oġġetti utli.
formal.en: Before the repair work began, the workers cleared the junk from the room and kept only the useful items.
formal.zh: 维修开始前，工人们清走了房间里的杂物，只留下有用的物品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'hemm f'dan il-kexxun? Pawlu: Ftit imbarazz: buttuni, ċwievet qodma u biċċiet spag. Forsi xi ħaġa minnhom għadha utli.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's in this drawer? Pawlu: A few odds and ends: buttons, old keys and pieces of string. Perhaps some of them are still useful.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个抽屉里有什么？保罗：一些零碎东西：纽扣、旧钥匙和几段细绳。也许其中还有能用的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个抽屉里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this drawer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit imbarazz: buttuni, ċwievet qodma u biċċiet spag. Forsi xi ħaġa minnhom għadha utli.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit imbarazz: buttuni, ċwievet qodma u biċċiet spag. Forsi xi ħaġa minnhom għadha utli.
messages.zh: 一些零碎东西：纽扣、旧钥匙和几段细绳。也许其中还有能用的。
messages.en: A few odds and ends: buttons, old keys and pieces of string. Perhaps some of them are still useful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个装满纽扣、旧钥匙和细绳的杂物抽屉，用这个画面记住 imbarazz。强调无用时译成“破烂”，强调零散时译成“零碎物品”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel embarrassed, or to burden or obstruct someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到难堪或不自在；也指给人增加负担，或用东西妨碍活动、占碍空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mistħi jew skomdu, jew jgħabbi lil xi ħadd jew jimla post b'affarijiet li jfixklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人感到尴尬、难堪或不自在。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mistħi jew skomdu minħabba xi ħaġa li tingħad jew issir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something embarrasses you, it makes you feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以负担或障碍使人行动不便，或使地方因物品堆放而难以使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħabbi lil xi ħadd b'affarijiet li jfixkluh jew jimla post b'oġġetti li jagħmluha diffiċli biex jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something encumbers a person or place, it creates a burden or obstruction.

collocations.mt: imbarazza lil xi ħadd quddiem in-nies
collocations.en: to embarrass someone in front of others
collocations.zh: 使某人在众人面前难堪

collocations.en: to encumber the room with excess furniture
collocations.zh: 用过多的家具把房间塞得碍事

formal.mt: Il-kumment personali waqt il-laqgħa imbarazza lill-kelliem u fixkel id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: The personal comment during the meeting embarrassed the speaker and disrupted the discussion.
formal.zh: 会议期间针对个人的评论使发言者感到难堪，并打断了讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta semmejt l-iżball tiegħi quddiem kulħadd, imbarazzajtni. Toni: Skużani, ma ħsibtx li kont se tħossok hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you mentioned my mistake in front of everyone, you embarrassed me. Toni: Sorry, I didn't think you would feel that way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你当着大家的面提起我的错误，让我很难堪。托尼：对不起，我没想到你会有这种感受。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta semmejt l-iżball tiegħi quddiem kulħadd, imbarazzajtni.
messages.mt_standard: Meta semmejt l-iżball tiegħi quddiem kulħadd, imbarazzajtni.
messages.zh: 你当着大家的面提起我的错误，让我很难堪。
messages.en: When you mentioned my mistake in front of everyone, you embarrassed me.

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, ma ħsibtx li kont se tħossok hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, ma ħsibtx li kont se tħossok hekk.
messages.zh: 对不起，我没想到你会有这种感受。
messages.en: Sorry, I didn't think you would feel that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景并排记忆：当众提错让人尴尬，家具太多让人走动受阻。两幅画面分别对应 imbarazza 的心理不自在和实际受妨碍两个义项。

gloss_zh: 被拒绝登机；被拒绝登船

teaching_sense.en_definition: A situation in which a passenger is refused permission to board a flight or ship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乘客被拒绝获准登上飞机或船只的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha passiġġier ma jitħalliex jitla' abbord ajruplan jew vapur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拒绝让乘客登机或登船的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni fejn passiġġier jiġi rrifjutat il-permess li jitla' fuq ajruplan jew vapur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Denied boarding occurs when a passenger is refused permission to board a flight or ship.

collocations.zh: 一起拒绝登机或登船事件
拒绝登机或登船的原因

formal.mt: Il-passiġġier talab spjegazzjoni bil-miktub dwar ir-raġuni għall-imbark miċħud.
formal.en: The passenger requested a written explanation of the reason for denied boarding.
formal.zh: 这位乘客要求就拒绝其登机的原因提供书面说明。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ma ħallewnix nitla' fuq l-ajruplan. X'għandi nikteb fil-formola? David: Ikteb 'imbark miċħud' u spjega x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Marta: They wouldn't let me board the plane. What should I write on the form? David: Write 'denied boarding' and explain what happened.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他们不让我上飞机。我该在表格里写什么？戴维：写“被拒绝登机”，再说明发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Marta (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma ħallewnix nitla' fuq l-ajruplan. X'għandi nikteb fil-formola?
messages.mt_standard: Ma ħallewnix nitla' fuq l-ajruplan. X'għandi nikteb fil-formola?
messages.zh: 他们不让我上飞机。我该在表格里写什么？
messages.en: They wouldn't let me board the plane. What should I write on the form?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 写“被拒绝登机”，再说明发生了什么。
messages.en: Write 'denied boarding' and explain what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着机票却在登机口被拦下，把 imbark miċħud 整体记成“登机被拒”这一情况。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go aboard a ship or aircraft in order to travel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为出行而登上船只或飞机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tela' fuq vapur jew ajruplan biex jivvjaġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 登上船只或飞机，准备开始旅程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tela' abbord vapur jew ajruplan sabiex jibda vjaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone embarks, they go aboard a ship or aircraft to begin a journey.

formal.mt: Il-grupp imbarka fuq il-vapur wara li tlesta l-kontroll tal-biljetti.
formal.en: The group embarked on the ship after the ticket check was completed.
formal.zh: 检票完成后，一行人登上了船。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħuk diġà imbarka? Pawlu: Iva, imbarka fuq il-vapur għaxar minuti ilu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has your brother boarded already? Pawlu: Yes, he boarded the ship ten minutes ago.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你哥哥已经登船了吗？保罗：是的，他十分钟前就上船了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥已经登船了吗？
messages.en: Has your brother boarded already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imbarka fuq il-vapur għaxar minuti ilu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imbarka fuq il-vapur għaxar minuti ilu.
messages.zh: 是的，他十分钟前就上船了。
messages.en: Yes, he boarded the ship ten minutes ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imbarka 配上旅客踏上舷梯的画面，再连读 imbarka fuq vapur，记住登上交通工具这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The regular rolling movement of sea waves, especially waves arriving from a distant area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海面上有规律起伏的涌浪，尤其指从远处传来的波浪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċaqliq regolari tal-mewġ tal-baħar, speċjalment mewġ li jasal minn żona mbiegħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海上的涌浪，即有规律地传来、使海面起伏的波浪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mewġ tal-baħar li jimxi b'mod regolari u jġiegħel wiċċ il-baħar jogħla u jinżel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A swell is a regular rolling movement of sea waves that can continue even when the local wind is weak.

formal.mt: L-imbatt qawwi għamel it-tlugħ fuq id-dgħajsa aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: The heavy swell made boarding the boat more difficult.
formal.zh: 强烈的涌浪使登上小船变得更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex id-dgħajsa għadha tiela' u nieżla? Toni: Minħabba l-imbatt. Ir-riħ naqas, imma l-mewġ għadu hemm.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is the boat still rising and falling? Toni: Because of the swell. The wind has eased, but the waves are still there.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：船怎么还在上下起伏？托尼：是涌浪造成的。风已经小了，但浪还在。

messages.speaker: Rita (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-dgħajsa għadha tiela' u nieżla?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-dgħajsa għadha tiela' u nieżla?
messages.zh: 船怎么还在上下起伏？
messages.en: Why is the boat still rising and falling?

messages.speaker: Toni (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-imbatt. Ir-riħ naqas, imma l-mewġ għadu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-imbatt. Ir-riħ naqas, imma l-mewġ għadu hemm.
messages.zh: 是涌浪造成的。风已经小了，但浪还在。
messages.en: Because of the swell. The wind has eased, but the waves are still there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 imbatt 时想象小船随着一排排长浪缓慢升降，把词义固定在海面持续起伏的涌浪上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a pleasantly round and slightly fat appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容身体或外表略胖、圆润而显得可爱的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra tonda u xi ftit ħoxna, b'mod li jidher ħelu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胖乎乎的，指身体略胖而圆润，常带亲切或喜爱的语气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem xi ftit ħoxnin u tond, spiss b'dehra ħelwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is chubby is slightly fat and has a rounded appearance, often in an attractive way.

formal.mt: Fl-illustrazzjoni jidher tifel imbaċċaċ bilqiegħda ħdejn ommu.
formal.en: The illustration shows a chubby boy sitting beside his mother.
formal.zh: 插图中，一个胖乎乎的小男孩坐在母亲身旁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kemm hu ħelu dak it-tifel! Nina: Iva, imbaċċaċ u dejjem jitbissem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how cute that boy is! Nina: Yes, he's chubby and always smiling.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：看那个小男孩多可爱！妮娜：是啊，胖乎乎的，总是笑眯眯的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu ħelu dak it-tifel!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu ħelu dak it-tifel!
messages.zh: 看那个小男孩多可爱！
messages.en: Look how cute that boy is!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，胖乎乎的，总是笑眯眯的。
messages.en: Yes, he's chubby and always smiling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个脸蛋圆圆、笑眯眯的小男孩，把 imbaċċaċ 与中文“胖乎乎”一起记住，重点记圆润的外观。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having loose threads at the edges, or looking worn and shabby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指布料等边缘磨损、纤维散开，也可形容衣物等显得破旧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-truf mikulin u l-ħjut maħlula, jew li jidher qadim u mikul bl-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指布料等边缘因磨损而散开、露出松散线头的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-truf mikulin u l-ħjut maħlula jew ħerġin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If material is frayed, its edges have become worn and its threads have started to come loose.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因长期使用或磨损而显得破旧、不整洁的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher qadim, mikul u mhux pulit minħabba l-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something looks shabby, it appears old and worn because it has been used a great deal.

formal.mt: Il-kowt kien imberfel, b'ħjut maħlula mat-truf tal-kmiem.
formal.en: The coat was shabby, with loose threads along the edges of the sleeves.
formal.zh: 那件大衣已经破旧，袖口边缘有松散的线头。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kowt sar imberfel. Toni: Iva, imma għadu jżommni sħun. Maja: Nista' nsewwilek it-truf tal-kmiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: This coat has become shabby. Toni: Yes, but it still keeps me warm. Maja: I can mend the edges of the sleeves for you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这件大衣都穿旧了。托尼：是啊，不过穿着还暖和。玛雅：我可以帮你把袖口边缘补好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这件大衣都穿旧了。
messages.en: This coat has become shabby.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，不过穿着还暖和。
messages.en: Yes, but it still keeps me warm.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以帮你把袖口边缘补好。
messages.en: I can mend the edges of the sleeves for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imberfel 配上一件袖口露线的大衣：看线头记“磨散”，看整件衣服记“破旧”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slightly open rather than fully closed, especially of a door.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指门等没有完全关上，只微微打开、留着一道缝的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ftit miftuħ u mhux magħluq għal kollox, speċjalment bieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指门等微微打开、没有完全关严的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun miftuħ ftit biss, b'fetħa dejqa, u mhux magħluq għal kollox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a door is ajar, it is slightly open and leaves a narrow gap.

formal.mt: Il-bieb tal-uffiċċju tħalla imbexxaq sabiex l-impjegati jkunu jistgħu jisimgħu l-avviż.
formal.en: The office door was left ajar so that the employees could hear the announcement.
formal.zh: 办公室的门留着一道缝，以便员工能够听见通知。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nagħlaq il-bieb? Mark: Le, ħallih imbexxaq, jekk jogħġbok. Sara: Sewwa, inħallih ftit miftuħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall I close the door? Mark: No, leave it ajar, please. Sara: All right, I'll leave it slightly open.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：要我把门关上吗？马克：不用，请留一道缝。萨拉：好，我让它稍微开着。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 要我把门关上吗？
messages.en: Shall I close the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 不用，请留一道缝。
messages.en: No, leave it ajar, please.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我让它稍微开着。
messages.en: All right, I'll leave it slightly open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 imbexxaq 时想象门缝透出一线光：门只开一点点，就是“微开、留缝”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An insulting term used for someone regarded as extremely foolish or unintelligent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 侮辱性地称呼被认为非常愚蠢或缺乏头脑的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma offensiva użata biex tgħajjar lil xi ħadd li jitqies iblah ħafna jew nieqes mill-intelliġenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蠢人；笨蛋，用于侮辱被认为极其愚蠢的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li titqies iblah ħafna jew nieqsa mill-intelliġenza, imsejħa hekk b'mod offensiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone calls people imbeciles, they are insulting them by suggesting that they are extremely foolish or unintelligent.

collocations.en: to insult people by calling them imbeciles

formal.mt: F'diskussjoni formali, evita li ssejjaħ lill-oħrajn 'imbeċilli'; spjega minflok għaliex ma taqbilx mal-argument tagħhom.
formal.en: In a formal discussion, avoid calling others 'imbeciles'; explain instead why you disagree with their argument.
formal.zh: 在正式讨论中，应避免称别人为“笨蛋”，而应说明自己为何不赞同他们的论点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se ngħidilhom li huma imbeċilli! Mark: Aħjar għidilhom x'għamlu ħażin. Jekk tgħajjarhom, ma ssolvi xejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'm going to tell them they're imbeciles! Mark: Better tell them what they did wrong. Insulting them won't solve anything.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我要告诉他们，他们就是笨蛋！马克：还是说清楚他们哪里做错了吧。骂他们解决不了问题。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要告诉他们，他们就是笨蛋！
messages.en: I'm going to tell them they're imbeciles!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar għidilhom x'għamlu ħażin. Jekk tgħajjarhom, ma ssolvi xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar għidilhom x'għamlu ħażin. Jekk tgħajjarhom, ma ssolvi xejn.
messages.zh: 还是说清楚他们哪里做错了吧。骂他们解决不了问题。
messages.en: Better tell them what they did wrong. Insulting them won't solve anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imbeċilli 放进生气时骂人“笨蛋”的对话来记，同时给它贴上“侮辱性称呼”的语气标签。

gloss_zh: 害怕的（阴性单数）；受惊的人（名词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling fear or alarm, used when describing a female person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容女性感到害怕、惊慌或受到惊吓的状态，是阴性单数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tħoss biża' jew tkun maħsuda; forma femminili singulari li tintuża biex tiddeskrivi persuna femminili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 害怕的、感到恐惧的，用于描述女性的阴性单数形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tħoss biża' jew tħassib minħabba xi ħaġa li tidher perikoluża jew tal-biża'; tintuża fil-femminil singular.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a female person is afraid, she feels fear because something seems dangerous or frightening.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到害怕或受到惊吓的人；此处按名词义理解为对人的指称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħoss biża' jew li tkun ġiet maħsuda minn xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this noun sense, the word refers to a person who feels frightened or alarmed.

collocations.en: afraid of the dark, describing a female person

formal.mt: It-tifla kienet imbeżżgħa wara l-ħoss qawwi, u l-għalliema qagħdet magħha sakemm ikkalmat.
formal.en: The girl was frightened after the loud noise, and the teacher stayed with her until she calmed down.
formal.zh: 巨响过后，小女孩很害怕，老师一直陪着她，直到她平静下来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jien imbeżżgħa mid-dlam. Nina: Nixgħellek id-dawl? Lara: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Hekk inħossni aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm afraid of the dark. Nina: Shall I turn on the light for you? Lara: Yes, please. That makes me feel better.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我怕黑。妮娜：我帮你开灯好吗？拉拉：好呀，麻烦你。这样我感觉好多了。

messages.speaker: Lara (妹妹)
messages.zh: 我怕黑。
messages.en: I'm afraid of the dark.

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 我帮你开灯好吗？
messages.en: Shall I turn on the light for you?

messages.speaker: Lara (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Hekk inħossni aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Hekk inħossni aħjar.
messages.zh: 好呀，麻烦你。这样我感觉好多了。
messages.en: Yes, please. That makes me feel better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一个女孩怕黑”的画面记 imbeżżgħa：把害怕的状态与阴性单数一起记住；名词义则想到受惊的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling fear or alarm, used when describing more than one person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容多个人感到害怕、惊慌或受到惊吓，是复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħossu biża' jew ikunu maħsuda; forma plural li tintuża biex tiddeskrivi aktar minn persuna waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 害怕的、感到恐惧的，用于描述多个人的复数形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħossu biża' jew tħassib minħabba xi ħaġa li tidher perikoluża jew tal-biża'; tintuża fil-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people are afraid, they feel fear because something seems dangerous or frightening to them.

collocations.en: afraid of the storm, describing more than one person
collocations.zh: 害怕暴风雨的（形容多人）

formal.mt: It-tfal kienu imbeżżgħin mill-maltemp, u għalhekk l-għalliem ġabarhom f'kamra kwieta.
formal.en: The children were frightened by the storm, so the teacher gathered them in a quiet room.
formal.zh: 孩子们被暴风雨吓到了，因此老师把他们集中到一个安静的房间里。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Aħna imbeżżgħin mill-maltemp. Anna: Ejjew oqogħdu ħdejja. Hawn ġew ġewwa aħna siguri. Ben: Tista' tibqa' magħna?
colloquial.en: Ben: We're afraid of the storm. Anna: Come and sit beside me. We're safe in here. Ben: Can you stay with us?
colloquial.zh: 本：我们害怕暴风雨。安娜：来，坐到我旁边。我们在屋里很安全。本：你能一直陪着我们吗？

messages.speaker: Ben (孩子，代表几个孩子说话)
messages.zh: 我们害怕暴风雨。
messages.en: We're afraid of the storm.

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejjew oqogħdu ħdejja. Hawn ġew ġewwa aħna siguri.
messages.mt_standard: Ejjew oqogħdu ħdejja. Hawn ġew ġewwa aħna siguri.
messages.zh: 来，坐到我旁边。我们在屋里很安全。
messages.en: Come and sit beside me. We're safe in here.

messages.speaker: Ben (孩子，代表几个孩子说话)
messages.zh: 你能一直陪着我们吗？
messages.en: Can you stay with us?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imbeżżgħin 配上“一群孩子听雷声”的画面：大家都害怕，记住这是描述多个人的复数形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term expressing the direct appeal 'I'm asking you'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达“我在请求你”这一直接请求的用语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terminu li jesprimi talba diretta lil persuna oħra, fis-sens ta' 'qed nitolbok'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我在请求你；表示说话者正在直接向对方提出请求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li biha min jitkellem jgħid lill-persuna l-oħra li qed jitlobha tagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression conveys that the speaker is directly asking the listener to do something.

collocations.en: the expression 'imbiegħda' in a direct appeal

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-espressjoni 'imbiegħda' għandha t-tifsira 'qed nitolbok'.
formal.en: In this exercise, the expression 'imbiegħda' has the meaning 'I'm asking you'.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，表达“imbiegħda”的含义是“我在请求你”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'imbiegħda' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser 'qed nitolbok', jiġifieri talba diretta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'imbiegħda' mean in this exercise? Pawlu: Here it means 'I'm asking you', which is a direct appeal.
colloquial.zh: Maja：在这道练习里，“imbiegħda”是什么意思？Pawlu：这里是“我在请求你”的意思，也就是直接提出请求。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 在这道练习里，“imbiegħda”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'imbiegħda' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser 'qed nitolbok', jiġifieri talba diretta.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser 'qed nitolbok', jiġifieri talba diretta.
messages.zh: 这里是“我在请求你”的意思，也就是直接提出请求。
messages.en: Here it means 'I'm asking you', which is a direct appeal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本条练习词卡与“我在请求你”的对话气泡配对，整句记忆，避免自行拆词推义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Far away from a person, place, or point of reference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 距离某个人、地点或参照位置很远的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab 'il bogħod minn persuna, post jew punt ta' referenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遥远的；与某一参照地点相距很远的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'distanza kbira minn post jew minn persuna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distant place or object is a long way from the position you are considering.

formal.mt: Il-proġett se jtejjeb is-servizz tat-trasport lejn raħal imbiegħed fil-muntanji.
formal.en: The project will improve transport services to a remote village in the mountains.
formal.zh: 该项目将改善通往山中一座偏远村庄的交通服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn joqgħod ħuk? Pawlu: F'raħal imbiegħed; nieħdu sagħtejn biex naslu għandu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does your brother live? Pawlu: In a remote village; it takes us two hours to get to his place.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥住在哪里？Pawlu：住在一个偏远的村庄；我们到他家要花两个小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your brother live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'raħal imbiegħed; nieħdu sagħtejn biex naslu għandu.
messages.mt_standard: F'raħal imbiegħed; nieħdu sagħtejn biex naslu għandu.
messages.zh: 住在一个偏远的村庄；我们到他家要花两个小时。
messages.en: In a remote village; it takes us two hours to get to his place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图边缘的一座小村庄，开车两小时才到：用“raħal imbiegħed”把偏远的画面记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having received a blessing, or regarded as holy in a religious context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到祝福的，或在宗教语境中被视为神圣的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li rċieva barka, jew li jitqies qaddis f'kuntest reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受祝福的；获得宗教祝福或被认为蒙受神恩的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ngħatatlu barka jew li jitqies li għandu l-barka ta' Alla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is blessed has received a blessing or is regarded as enjoying God's favour.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神圣的；因与神或宗教有关而受到尊崇的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jitqies qaddis jew sagru minħabba r-rabta tiegħu ma' Alla jew mar-reliġjon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as holy is regarded with religious reverence because of its connection with God or religious belief.

collocations.zh: 受祝福的地方；神圣之地

formal.mt: Il-parroċċa tawgura Milied imbierek lill-familji kollha tal-komunità.
formal.en: The parish wishes all the families in the community a blessed Christmas.
formal.zh: 堂区祝愿社区所有家庭度过一个蒙福的圣诞节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Milied imbierek, Pawlu! Pawlu: Grazzi, Maja! Lilek ukoll, u lill-familja tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have a blessed Christmas, Pawlu! Pawlu: Thank you, Maja! You too, and your family.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu，祝你圣诞蒙福！Pawlu：谢谢你，Maja！也祝你和你的家人圣诞蒙福。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu，祝你圣诞蒙福！
messages.en: Have a blessed Christmas, Pawlu!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, Maja! Lilek ukoll, u lill-familja tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, Maja! Lilek ukoll, u lill-familja tiegħek.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，Maja！也祝你和你的家人圣诞蒙福。
messages.en: Thank you, Maja! You too, and your family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面区分义项：节日贺卡联想“受祝福的”，宗教圣地联想“神圣的”，都配上 imbierek。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obstruct a passage or prevent something from moving or working.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阻塞通道，或使物体无法移动、机械无法运转。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħlaq jew ixekkel passaġġ, jew iwaqqaf xi ħaġa milli tiċċaqlaq jew taħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阻挡；堵住通道或阻止人、物通过。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħlaq jew jostakola triq, daħla jew passaġġ biex ma jkunx jista' jsir il-passaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something blocks a route or entrance, it prevents people or things from passing through.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使卡住；使机械或活动部件因阻塞而不能正常移动或运转。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iwaqqaf mekkaniżmu jew parti li tiċċaqlaq milli taħdem sewwa billi xi ħaġa teħel fiha jew tostakolaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something jams a mechanism, it stops its moving parts from working by getting stuck in them.

formal.mt: L-eżami tekniku wera li framment tal-metall imblokka l-mekkaniżmu u waqqaf il-magna.
formal.en: The technical inspection showed that a metal fragment had jammed the mechanism and stopped the machine.
formal.zh: 技术检查表明，一块金属碎片卡住了机械装置，导致机器停止运转。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux nidħlu? Pawlu: Xi ħadd imblokka d-daħla b'karrettun. Ejja nċaqalquh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we get in? Pawlu: Someone blocked the entrance with a cart. Let's move it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们为什么进不去？Pawlu：有人用一辆手推车堵住了入口。我们把它移开吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们为什么进不去？
messages.en: Why can't we get in?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd imblokka d-daħla b'karrettun. Ejja nċaqalquh.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd imblokka d-daħla b'karrettun. Ejja nċaqalquh.
messages.zh: 有人用一辆手推车堵住了入口。我们把它移开吧。
messages.en: Someone blocked the entrance with a cart. Let's move it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imblokka 配成两幅阻塞图：大车堵路对应 block，小碎片卡住齿轮对应 jam；共同点都是动不了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act dishonestly by breaking rules or deceiving someone, especially to gain an unfair advantage or obtain money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过违反规则或欺骗他人来获取不正当优势，尤其指作弊或骗取钱财。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tikser ir-regoli jew tqarraq b'xi ħadd biex tikseb vantaġġ inġust jew tieħu l-flus tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作弊；通过违反规则或欺骗取得不公平的优势。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tikser ir-regoli jew taġixxi b'qerq biex tikseb vantaġġ li ma jistħoqqlokx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone cheats, they break rules or deceive others to gain an unfair advantage.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诈骗；用欺骗手段使他人交出钱财或财物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tqarraq b'xi ħadd biex iċedilek flus jew beni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone swindles another person, they use deception to take that person's money or property.

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ imbrolja lill-klijenti billi ħa l-ħlas għal prodotti li qatt ma bagħat.
formal.en: The seller swindled the customers by taking payment for products that he never sent.
formal.zh: 卖家收取货款后始终没有发货，以此诈骗顾客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tilgħab ma' Pawlu? Mark: Għax imbrolja fl-aħħar logħba u mbagħad qal li rebaħ!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to play with Pawlu again? Mark: Because he cheated in the last game and then said he had won!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么不想再和 Pawlu 玩了？Mark：因为他上一局作弊了，还说自己赢了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tilgħab ma' Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tilgħab ma' Pawlu?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想再和 Pawlu 玩了？
messages.en: Why don't you want to play with Pawlu again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax imbrolja fl-aħħar logħba u mbagħad qal li rebaħ!
messages.mt_standard: Għax imbrolja fl-aħħar logħba u mbagħad qal li rebaħ!
messages.zh: 因为他上一局作弊了，还说自己赢了！
messages.en: Because he cheated in the last game and then said he had won!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imbrolja 联想成两个动作画面：考试偷看答案是作弊，收钱却故意不交货是诈骗；共同点是靠欺骗获利。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who deceives other people in order to take their money or property.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过欺骗他人来骗取钱财或财物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqarraq b'nies oħra biex tieħu l-flus jew il-beni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诈骗者；以欺骗手段骗取他人钱财或财物的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tuża l-qerq biex iġġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jagħtiha flus jew beni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A swindler is someone who tricks other people into giving them money or property.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-imbroljun jikkonvinċi lill-vittmi tiegħu jagħtuh il-flus billi jwiegħed qligħ kbir.
formal.en: In the story, the swindler persuades his victims to give him money by promising large profits.
formal.zh: 故事中，骗子以高额收益为诱饵，说服受害者把钱交给他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-raġel talabni nħallas qabel ma nara l-karozza. Toni: Oqgħod attenta, jista' jkun imbroljun.
colloquial.en: Lara: That man asked me to pay before I see the car. Toni: Be careful, he could be a swindler.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那个男人让我还没看车就先付款。Toni：小心，他可能是个骗子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel talabni nħallas qabel ma nara l-karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel talabni nħallas qabel ma nara l-karozza.
messages.zh: 那个男人让我还没看车就先付款。
messages.en: That man asked me to pay before I see the car.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 小心，他可能是个骗子。
messages.en: Be careful, he could be a swindler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 imbroljun 时在脑中给骗局里的那个人贴上“骗子”标签；这个词回答的是“谁在骗钱”，指实施诈骗的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dishonest scheme or act intended to trick someone out of money or property.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以骗取他人钱财或财物为目的的骗局或诈骗行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjan jew att ta' qerq maħsub biex jieħu l-flus jew il-beni ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骗局；通过欺骗手段骗取钱财或财物的行为或计谋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Att jew pjan li bih xi ħadd iqarraq b'persuna oħra biex jeħdilha l-flus jew il-beni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A swindle is a dishonest scheme that tricks people into giving away money or property.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-investigazzjoni tikxef imbroll li fih inbiegħu biljetti għal avveniment li ma kienx jeżisti.
formal.en: In the story, the investigation uncovers a swindle involving tickets sold for an event that did not exist.
formal.zh: 故事中，调查揭露了一场骗局：有人售卖根本不存在的活动的门票。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Sibt telefon ġdid għal għaxar ewro biss! Ben: Jidher wisq irħis. Jista' jkun imbroll.
colloquial.en: Sara: I found a new phone for just ten euros! Ben: That seems too cheap. It could be a swindle.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我找到一部新手机，只要十欧元！Ben：这也太便宜了，可能是个骗局。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt telefon ġdid għal għaxar ewro biss!
messages.mt_standard: Sibt telefon ġdid għal għaxar ewro biss!
messages.zh: 我找到一部新手机，只要十欧元！
messages.en: I found a new phone for just ten euros!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher wisq irħis. Jista' jkun imbroll.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher wisq irħis. Jista' jkun imbroll.
messages.zh: 这也太便宜了，可能是个骗局。
messages.en: That seems too cheap. It could be a swindle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imbroll 想成一整套骗钱圈套：虚假承诺、诱人价格、付款陷阱连成一个“骗局”；记住它指事情或计谋。

gloss_zh: 顽皮的；淘气的；不听话的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaving badly or disobediently, especially in the way a mischievous child does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为顽皮、淘气或不听话的，尤其用来形容孩子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu ħażin jew ma jobdix, speċjalment meta jingħad għal tifel li jagħmel il-praspar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淘气的；顽皮或不服从管教的，尤指孩子的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jobdix jew jagħmel il-praspar u jġib ruħu b'mod li mhux aċċettabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A naughty child behaves badly, disobeys instructions, or does things they know they should not do.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel imbrukkat jaħbi l-ġugarelli ta' ħuh u wara jitlob skuża.
formal.en: In the story, the naughty boy hides his brother's toys and later apologizes.
formal.zh: 故事中，淘气的男孩把弟弟的玩具藏起来，后来又道了歉。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tgħid li l-qattus hu imbrukkat? Omar: Għax reġa' seraq il-ħut minn fuq il-mejda!
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you saying the cat is naughty? Omar: Because he stole the fish from the table again!
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么说这只猫淘气？Omar：因为它又把桌上的鱼偷走了！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li l-qattus hu imbrukkat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li l-qattus hu imbrukkat?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这只猫淘气？
messages.en: Why are you saying the cat is naughty?

messages.speaker: Omar (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax reġa' seraq il-ħut minn fuq il-mejda!
messages.mt_standard: Għax reġa' seraq il-ħut minn fuq il-mejda!
messages.zh: 因为它又把桌上的鱼偷走了！
messages.en: Because he stole the fish from the table again!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 imbrukkat 时想象孩子藏玩具、猫咪偷吃鱼的淘气画面；用“又调皮了”帮助记住这个形容行为的词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attack made by people who hide and wait for someone to approach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先藏在隐蔽处，等待目标接近后突然发动的袭击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attakk għal għarrieda minn persuni li jinħbew u jistennew lil xi ħadd jersaq lejhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伏击；藏起来等待目标接近后突然发动的袭击。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attakk li jsir għal għarrieda minn persuni moħbija li jkunu qed jistennew lil xi ħadd jgħaddi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ambush is an attack in which people hide and wait for someone before suddenly attacking them.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-grupp ħejja imbuskata ħdejn il-pont.
formal.en: The report describes how the group prepared an ambush near the bridge.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该团伙如何在桥边布置伏击。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqfu qabel il-pont fil-film? Mark: Ħasbu li kien hemm imbuskata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did they stop before the bridge in the film? Mark: They thought there was an ambush.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里他们为什么在桥前停下？马克：他们以为那里有埋伏。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里他们为什么在桥前停下？
messages.en: Why did they stop before the bridge in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们以为那里有埋伏。
messages.en: They thought there was an ambush.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imbuskata 配上“桥边藏人、等人经过、突然袭击”的连续画面，记住它表示埋伏或伏击。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moved or forced in a direction by someone pushing, sometimes roughly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到推力而移动或被迫改变位置的，也可指被人用力推搡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie mċaqlaq jew sfurzat f'direzzjoni permezz ta' spinta, xi drabi b'mod goff.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被推动的；受到外力推压而移动或改变位置的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie mċaqlaq minn postu permezz ta' forza li timbotta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is pushed is moved by pressure applied against it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被猛推的；被人粗暴地推搡而移动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie mbuttat b'saħħa jew b'mod goff, ħafna drabi mingħajr attenzjoni għas-sigurtà jew il-kumdità tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is shoved is pushed suddenly or roughly by another person.

collocations.en: a man shoved in the crowd
collocations.zh: 在人群中被推搡的男子

formal.mt: Il-karrettun, imbuttat minn żewġ ħaddiema, iddaħħal fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The cart, pushed by two workers, was brought into the warehouse.
formal.zh: 小车由两名工人推入仓库。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqajt? Mark: Ġejt imbuttat fil-folla, imma ma weġġajtx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you fall? Mark: I got shoved in the crowd, but I wasn't hurt.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么摔倒了？马克：我在人群里被推了一下，不过没受伤。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么摔倒了？
messages.en: Why did you fall?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġejt imbuttat fil-folla, imma ma weġġajtx.
messages.mt_standard: Ġejt imbuttat fil-folla, imma ma weġġajtx.
messages.zh: 我在人群里被推了一下，不过没受伤。
messages.en: I got shoved in the crowd, but I wasn't hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个推的画面记 imbuttat：小车被平稳推动对应 pushed，人在人群里被猛推对应 shoved；粗暴程度由语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something sizeable is fairly large in size, amount, or extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体的尺寸、事物的数量或规模相当大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li hija kbira mhux ħażin fid-daqs, fil-kwantità jew fil-firxa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颇具规模的；在尺寸或数量上相当可观的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li għandha daqs jew kwantità konsiderevoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sizeable object or amount is fairly large and substantial.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相当大的；在大小或数量上达到较大程度的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li hija kbira mhux ħażin, mingħajr ma bilfors tkun enormi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is quite large has a fairly great size or amount.

collocations.zh: 一个人数相当多的群体

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni ġabret ammont imdaqqas ta' flus biex tixtri kotba ġodda għall-librerija.
formal.en: The organisation raised a sizeable amount of money to buy new books for the library.
formal.zh: 该组织筹集了一笔相当可观的款项，为图书馆购买新书。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm se jiġu nies għall-ikla? Toni: Se jiġi grupp imdaqqas, allura għandna bżonn aktar siġġijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: How many people are coming to the meal? Toni: A fairly large group is coming, so we need more chairs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：会有多少人来吃饭？托尼：会来相当多的人，所以我们需要更多椅子。

messages.speaker: Sara (聚餐组织者)
messages.zh: 会有多少人来吃饭？
messages.en: How many people are coming to the meal?

messages.speaker: Toni (聚餐组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jiġi grupp imdaqqas, allura għandna bżonn aktar siġġijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Se jiġi grupp imdaqqas, allura għandna bżonn aktar siġġijiet.
messages.zh: 会来相当多的人，所以我们需要更多椅子。
messages.en: A fairly large group is coming, so we need more chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚餐人数相当多，必须再搬几把椅子：grupp imdaqqas。用“需要加椅子”的画面记住“相当大的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is aged has reached an advanced stage of life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人年龄已大，进入年迈的阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li għandha ħafna snin u tinsab f'età avvanzata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年迈的，已经上了年纪的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal persuna li għandha età avvanzata u li għaddiet minn ħafna snin ta' ħajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is aged is old and has reached an advanced age.

formal.mt: Ir-raġel imdaħħal fiż-żmien irrakkonta l-esperjenzi tiegħu lill-istudenti waqt iż-żjara tagħhom.
formal.en: The elderly man recounted his experiences to the students during their visit.
formal.zh: 学生们来访时，这位年迈的男子向他们讲述了自己的经历。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak ir-raġel imdaħħal fiż-żmien? Pawlu: Dak in-nannu tiegħi. Ejja nsellmulu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that elderly man? Pawlu: That's my grandfather. Let's go and say hello to him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那位年迈的男子是谁？保罗：那是我爷爷。我们去跟他打个招呼吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel imdaħħal fiż-żmien?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel imdaħħal fiż-żmien?
messages.zh: 那位年迈的男子是谁？
messages.en: Who is that elderly man?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是我爷爷。我们去跟他打个招呼吧。
messages.en: That's my grandfather. Let's go and say hello to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imdaħħal fiż-żmien 整体想成一位向晚辈讲述往事的老人，用这个生活画面记住“上了年纪的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone accustomed to something finds it familiar through repeated experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人因经常接触某事或反复做某事，已经习惯或适应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li dara xi ħaġa jew jagħmel xi ħaġa regolarment, u għalhekk ma għadhiex ġdida jew stramba għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 习惯于某事的；因反复经历而已经适应的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa familjari ma' xi ħaġa minħabba li esperjenzaha jew għamilha ħafna drabi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are accustomed to something, it feels familiar because you have experienced it often.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem huwa imdorri jaħdem bil-lejl u jorganizza l-ħin tal-mistrieħ tiegħu skont dan.
formal.en: The worker is accustomed to working at night and arranges his rest time accordingly.
formal.zh: 这名工人习惯了夜间工作，并据此安排自己的休息时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma tħossokx għajjien meta tqum fis-sitta? Mark: Le, jien imdorri nqum kmieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Don't you feel tired when you get up at six? Mark: No, I'm used to getting up early.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你六点起床不会觉得累吗？马克：不会，我习惯早起了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma tħossokx għajjien meta tqum fis-sitta?
messages.mt_standard: Ma tħossokx għajjien meta tqum fis-sitta?
messages.zh: 你六点起床不会觉得累吗？
messages.en: Don't you feel tired when you get up at six?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不会，我习惯早起了。
messages.en: No, I'm used to getting up early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imdorri 连到每天早起后不再觉得困难的感觉，整句记住 jien imdorri nqum kmieni，表示“我习惯早起”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electronic message sent or received over the internet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过互联网发送或接收的电子邮件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Messaġġ elettroniku li jintbagħat jew jasal permezz tal-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子邮件；经互联网传送的电子信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Messaġġ elettroniku li persuna tibgħat lil persuna oħra permezz tal-internet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An email is an electronic message that you send or receive over the internet.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok ibgħat imejl lill-uffiċċju biex tikkonferma l-ħin tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: Please send an email to the office to confirm the time of the meeting.
formal.zh: 请向办公室发送电子邮件，确认会议时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Wasallek l-imejl tiegħi? | Mark: Iva, qrajtu dalgħodu. Se nwieġbek wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you get my email? | Mark: Yes, I read it this morning. I'll reply after work.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你收到我的邮件了吗？ | Mark：收到了，今天早上读过了。我下班后回复你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你收到我的邮件了吗？
messages.en: Did you get my email?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qrajtu dalgħodu. Se nwieġbek wara x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qrajtu dalgħodu. Se nwieġbek wara x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 收到了，今天早上读过了。我下班后回复你。
messages.en: Yes, I read it this morning. I'll reply after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imejl 放进“发送—收到—回复”的邮件流程中记忆，并联想英语 email 的读音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To touch a person or animal gently with the hand, especially to show affection or give comfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手轻拍或轻抚人或动物，尤其用来表达亲昵或给予安慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imiss lil persuna jew annimal bil-mod b'idu, speċjalment biex juri mħabba jew jagħti faraġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用手轻轻拍抚，常用于表示亲昵或安慰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti daqqiet ħfief jew jgħaddi idu bil-mod fuq persuna jew annimal bħala turija ta' mħabba jew faraġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone pats a person or animal, they touch them gently with their hand, often to show affection or offer comfort.

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara, il-voluntier qagħad imelles il-kelb bil-mod biex jgħinu jikkalma.
formal.en: During the visit, the volunteer gently patted the dog to help it calm down.
formal.zh: 探访期间，志愿者轻轻拍抚那只狗，帮助它平静下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed imelles il-kelb? | Pawlu: Għax beża' mill-ħoss. Qed jipprova jikkalmah.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is he patting the dog? | Pawlu: Because it was frightened by the noise. He's trying to calm it down.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他为什么在轻轻拍抚那只狗？ | Pawlu：因为狗被响声吓到了。他在试着让它平静下来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么在轻轻拍抚那只狗？
messages.en: Why is he patting the dog?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax beża' mill-ħoss. Qed jipprova jikkalmah.
messages.mt_standard: Għax beża' mill-ħoss. Qed jipprova jikkalmah.
messages.zh: 因为狗被响声吓到了。他在试着让它平静下来。
messages.en: Because it was frightened by the noise. He's trying to calm it down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手掌轻轻拍抚小狗的画面，用 imelles il-kelb 整个短语记住温柔的动作。

gloss_zh: 过度活跃的；动个不停的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely active and finding it difficult to remain still or quiet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活动特别多、很难安静下来或保持不动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiċċaqlaq ħafna u jsibha diffiċli joqgħod wieqaf jew kwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过度活跃的；精力旺盛到难以安静或停止活动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun attiv iżżejjed, jiċċaqlaq kontinwament u jsibha diffiċli jibqa' kwiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is hyperactive is unusually active and has difficulty staying still or quiet.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel huwa deskritt bħala imferfex għax dejjem jiġri u bilkemm joqgħod bilqiegħda.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is described as hyperactive because he is always running around and hardly ever sits down.
formal.zh: 故事把这个男孩描述为动个不停，因为他总在跑来跑去，几乎坐不下来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem hekk imferfex? | Ben: Iva, jiġri mad-dar kollha anki wara mixja twila!
colloquial.en: Lara: Is your dog always this hyperactive? | Ben: Yes, he runs all around the house even after a long walk!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你的狗总是这么动个不停吗？ | Ben：是啊，就算散了很久的步，回家还是满屋跑！

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 你的狗总是这么动个不停吗？
messages.en: Is your dog always this hyperactive?

messages.speaker: Ben (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jiġri mad-dar kollha anki wara mixja twila!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jiġri mad-dar kollha anki wara mixja twila!
messages.zh: 是啊，就算散了很久的步，回家还是满屋跑！
messages.en: Yes, he runs all around the house even after a long walk!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imferfex 配上“小狗散步回来还满屋跑”的画面，记住它强调活跃到停不下来。

gloss_zh: 未组织好；杂乱无章（名词用法未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry associated with a lack of organization or order; its use as a noun is unclear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达缺乏组织或秩序的概念；本条保留名词标注，但具体名词用法尚不明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma marbuta ma' nuqqas ta' ordni jew organizzazzjoni, iżda l-użu tagħha bħala nom mhuwiex ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未组织好的；杂乱无章的。保留所给名词词性，但该释义未明确其名词用法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tirreferi għal xi ħaġa li mhix organizzata jew f'ordni, iżda l-użu tal-kelma bħala nom mhuwiex ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry describes something that lacks proper order or organization, although its noun usage remains unclear.

collocations.en: the use of 'imgerfex' as a noun

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, 'imgerfex' huwa marbut man-nuqqas ta' organizzazzjoni; l-użu tiegħu bħala nom għad irid jiġi ċċarat.
formal.en: In this lesson, 'imgerfex' is associated with a lack of organization; its use as a noun still needs clarification.
formal.zh: 本课将“imgerfex”与缺乏组织联系起来；它作为名词的具体用法仍需澄清。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Imgerfex' għandu x'jaqsam ma' nuqqas ta' ordni? Mark: Iva, imma għad irridu niċċaraw kif jintuża bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does 'imgerfex' have to do with a lack of order? Mark: Yes, but we still need to clarify how it is used as a noun.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“imgerfex”跟缺乏秩序有关吗？马克：是的，不过我们还得弄清它作为名词怎么用。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Imgerfex' għandu x'jaqsam ma' nuqqas ta' ordni?
messages.mt_standard: 'Imgerfex' għandu x'jaqsam ma' nuqqas ta' ordni?
messages.zh: “imgerfex”跟缺乏秩序有关吗？
messages.en: Does 'imgerfex' have to do with a lack of order?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għad irridu niċċaraw kif jintuża bħala nom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għad irridu niċċaraw kif jintuża bħala nom.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我们还得弄清它作为名词怎么用。
messages.en: Yes, but we still need to clarify how it is used as a noun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“桌面杂乱”的画面记住 imgerfex 的组织秩序概念；另标“名词用法待确认”，避免凭释义猜句法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective whose lexical meaning has not been established in this entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个词义尚未明确的形容词；目前只能确认本条给出的词性标注。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li t-tifsira tiegħu għadha mhix ċara f'din l-entrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未提供可确定的词义，不能据此给出该形容词的语义翻译。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ma tingħatax tifsira ċara li tippermetti li jiġi spjegat x'jiddeskrivi dan l-aġġettiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this adjective cannot be determined from the information provided.

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-aġġettiv 'imgħakkes' għadha mhix ċara; għalhekk, jeħtieġ li tiġi vverifikata qabel jintuża f'eżempju.
formal.en: The meaning of the adjective 'imgħakkes' remains unclear; it therefore needs verification before the word is used in an example.
formal.zh: 形容词“imgħakkes”的含义仍不明确，因此在用它造例句之前需要核实词义。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'imgħakkes'? David: It-tifsira għadha mhix ċara. Ejja niċċekkjawha qabel nużawh.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'imgħakkes' mean? David: The meaning is still unclear. Let's check it before we use the word.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“imgħakkes”是什么意思？戴维：词义还不明确。我们用之前先查清楚吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: “imgħakkes”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'imgħakkes' mean?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifsira għadha mhix ċara. Ejja niċċekkjawha qabel nużawh.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifsira għadha mhix ċara. Ejja niċċekkjawha qabel nużawh.
messages.zh: 词义还不明确。我们用之前先查清楚吧。
messages.en: The meaning is still unclear. Let's check it before we use the word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 imgħakkes 做一张“形容词，词义待核实”的卡片；先认拼写与词性，不把未知释义背成具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A utensil with a handle and a small bowl, used for eating, serving, or stirring food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带柄和凹形勺头的用具，用于进食、舀取或搅拌食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'manku u parti żgħira mħaffra, li tintuża biex tiekol, isservi jew tħawwad l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勺子；具有凹形勺头和柄、用于舀取或搅拌食物的餐具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda tal-ikel b'manku u parti mħaffra li tintuża biex tiġbor, tiekol jew tħawwad l-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spoon is a utensil with a handle and a curved bowl that you use to eat, serve, or stir food.

formal.mt: Ħawwad is-soppa b'imgħarfa tal-injam sakemm l-ingredjenti jitħalltu sew.
formal.en: Stir the soup with a wooden spoon until the ingredients are thoroughly mixed.
formal.zh: 用木勺搅拌汤，直到各种食材充分混合。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tista' tagħtini mgħarfa, jekk jogħġbok? Ben: Żgur, hawn waħda ħdejn il-platt tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you pass me a spoon, please? Ben: Sure, there's one here beside your plate.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：请递给我一把勺子好吗？本：当然，你的盘子旁边这里就有一把。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 请递给我一把勺子好吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me a spoon, please?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, hawn waħda ħdejn il-platt tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, hawn waħda ħdejn il-platt tiegħek.
messages.zh: 当然，你的盘子旁边这里就有一把。
messages.en: Sure, there's one here beside your plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imgħarfa 写在勺子图片旁，边做“舀汤、搅拌”的动作边读；用具体餐具画面记住“勺子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money paid for borrowing money or earned on savings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借用资金时支付，或通过储蓄获得的利息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-imgħax huwa flus li jitħallsu fuq self jew li jinkisbu fuq tfaddil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利息，指借款产生的资金使用费用，或储蓄带来的收益。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-imgħax huwa ammont ta' flus li min jissellef iħallas lil min isellfu, jew li persuna tirċievi fuq il-flus li tfaddal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Interest is money you pay for borrowing money or receive on money you have saved.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jiffirma l-ftehim tas-self, il-klijent għandu jiċċekkja r-rata tal-imgħax u l-ammont totali li jkollu jħallas.
formal.en: Before signing the loan agreement, the customer should check the interest rate and the total amount they will have to pay.
formal.zh: 签署贷款协议前，客户应查看利率和需要偿还的总额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kont jagħti imgħax fuq it-tfaddil? Mark: Iva, imma r-rata hija baxxa. Lara: Allura niċċekkja kontijiet oħra wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this account pay interest on savings? Mark: Yes, but the rate is low. Lara: Then I'll check other accounts too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个账户的储蓄有利息吗？Mark：有，不过利率很低。Lara：那我也看看其他账户。

messages.speaker: Lara (银行顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kont jagħti imgħax fuq it-tfaddil?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kont jagħti imgħax fuq it-tfaddil?
messages.zh: 这个账户的储蓄有利息吗？
messages.en: Does this account pay interest on savings?

messages.speaker: Mark (银行职员)
messages.zh: 有，不过利率很低。
messages.en: Yes, but the rate is low.

messages.speaker: Lara (银行顾客)
messages.zh: 那我也看看其他账户。
messages.en: Then I'll check other accounts too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imgħax 放进“借钱要付、存钱可得”的双向画面中记忆；再搭配 rata tal-imgħax“利率”，区分利息金额与利率。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Interest intended to compensate someone for being deprived of money for a period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为补偿某人在一段时间内未能取得或使用款项而支付的利息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-imgħax kompensatorju huwa imgħax maħsub biex jagħmel tajjeb għaż-żmien li fih persuna ma kellhiex għad-dispożizzjoni tagħha flus li kienu dovuti lilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 补偿性利息，指为弥补应得款项在一段时间内未能供收款人使用而支付的利息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-imgħax kompensatorju huwa ammont ta' imgħax li jingħata bħala kumpens għall-perjodu li matulu persuna ma setgħetx tuża flus dovuti lilha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Compensatory interest is interest paid to make up for a period during which someone was deprived of money due to them.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri separatament l-ammont oriġinali dovut u l-imgħax kompensatorju kkalkulat għall-perjodu tad-dewmien.
formal.en: The report shows separately the original amount due and the compensatory interest calculated for the period of delay.
formal.zh: 报告分别列明了原本应付的金额，以及针对延误期间计算的补偿性利息。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu dan l-imgħax kompensatorju fir-rapport? Pawlu: Huwa kumpens għaż-żmien li fih il-flus dovuti ma kinux għandna. Anna: Issa fhimt għaliex jidher separatament.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is this compensatory interest in the report? Pawlu: It compensates us for the time when we did not have the money owed to us. Anna: Now I understand why it is shown separately.
colloquial.zh: Anna：报告里的这笔补偿性利息是什么？Pawlu：它补偿我们在那段时间里未能拿到应得款项的损失。Anna：现在我明白为什么要单独列出了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 报告里的这笔补偿性利息是什么？
messages.en: What is this compensatory interest in the report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa kumpens għaż-żmien li fih il-flus dovuti ma kinux għandna.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa kumpens għaż-żmien li fih il-flus dovuti ma kinux għandna.
messages.zh: 它补偿我们在那段时间里未能拿到应得款项的损失。
messages.en: It compensates us for the time when we did not have the money owed to us.

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 现在我明白为什么要单独列出了。
messages.en: Now I understand why it is shown separately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“款项迟到，利息补偿”来记整个词组：imgħax 提醒你是利息，kompensatorju 提醒你关注补偿目的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money charged on a loan or paid on savings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借款时须支付，或存款时可获得的利息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-imgħaxx huwa flus li jitħallsu għall-użu ta' flus mislufa jew li jingħataw fuq flus imfaddla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利息，即借款人因使用借入资金而支付的费用，或储蓄者从存款获得的收益。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-imgħaxx huwa ammont addizzjonali ta' flus li jitħallas fuq self jew li jinkiseb fuq tfaddil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Interest is an amount of money charged for a loan or paid to someone who keeps money in a savings account.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jispeċifika li s-self jingħata mingħajr imgħaxx u li l-ammont kollu għandu jitħallas lura fi żmien sena.
formal.en: The agreement specifies that the loan is interest-free and that the full amount must be repaid within one year.
formal.zh: 协议明确规定，这笔贷款不收取利息，且须在一年内全额偿还。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Jekk inselliflek mitt ewro, meta tagħtihomli lura? David: Fl-aħħar tax-xahar. Trid imgħaxx ukoll? Marija: Le, mingħajr imgħaxx!
colloquial.en: Marija: If I lend you a hundred euros, when will you pay me back? David: At the end of the month. Do you want interest too? Marija: No, interest-free!
colloquial.zh: Marija：如果我借给你一百欧元，你什么时候还？David：月底。你还要利息吗？Marija：不要，免息！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk inselliflek mitt ewro, meta tagħtihomli lura?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk inselliflek mitt ewro, meta tagħtihomli lura?
messages.zh: 如果我借给你一百欧元，你什么时候还？
messages.en: If I lend you a hundred euros, when will you pay me back?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 月底。你还要利息吗？
messages.en: At the end of the month. Do you want interest too?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 不要，免息！
messages.en: No, interest-free!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象借出一百欧元，归还时另有一小笔钱，那笔钱就是 imgħaxx；用 mingħajr imgħaxx“免息”作反向记忆，并留意本词末尾写两个 x。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The time before the present and the events that happened then.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 现在以前的时间，以及那段时间里发生的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-imgħoddi huwa ż-żmien ta' qabel il-preżent u l-ġrajjiet li seħħew fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过去，指现在之前的岁月及其中发生的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-imgħoddi huwa ż-żmien li diġà għadda, flimkien mal-esperjenzi u l-ġrajjiet li seħħew matulu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The past is the time before the present, including the events and experiences that belong to that time.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jiġbor ritratti u dokumenti li jgħinu lill-viżitaturi jifhmu aħjar l-imgħoddi tal-belt.
formal.en: The museum collects photographs and documents that help visitors better understand the city's past.
formal.zh: 博物馆收集照片和文献，帮助参观者更好地了解这座城市的过去。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hemm f'dan ir-ritratt qadim? Rita: Jien u ħuti. Fir-raħal konna nilagħbu ħafna barra fil-imgħoddi. Nina: Għidli aktar dwar dawk iż-żminijiet!
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is in this old photograph? Rita: My siblings and I. In the past, we used to play outside a lot in the village. Nina: Tell me more about those days!
colloquial.zh: Nina：这张老照片里是谁？Rita：我和我的兄弟姐妹。过去我们常在村子里到外面玩。Nina：再给我讲讲那时候的事吧！

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.zh: 这张老照片里是谁？
messages.en: Who is in this old photograph?

messages.speaker: Rita (祖母)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien u ħuti. Fir-raħal konna nilagħbu ħafna barra fil-imgħoddi.
messages.mt_standard: Jien u ħuti. Fir-raħal konna nilagħbu ħafna barra fil-imgħoddi.
messages.zh: 我和我的兄弟姐妹。过去我们常在村子里到外面玩。
messages.en: My siblings and I. In the past, we used to play outside a lot in the village.

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.zh: 再给我讲讲那时候的事吧！
messages.en: Tell me more about those days!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 l-imgħoddi 想成一本装着旧照片的相册，表示“过去”；讲照片里的往事时，整块记住 fil-imgħoddi“在过去”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning remains unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个词义尚未明确、暂时无法确定具体所指的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu għadha mhijiex ċara u li għalhekk ma jistax jingħata definizzjoni speċifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未明确；暂不能确定这个名词的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom għadha mhijiex magħrufa biżżejjed biex tingħata definizzjoni ċara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this noun remains unclear, so a specific interpretation cannot yet be assigned.

formal.mt: Qabel tingħata traduzzjoni tal-kelma 'imhabba', jeħtieġ li tiġi ċċarata t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: Before a translation of the word 'imhabba' is given, its meaning needs to be clarified.
formal.zh: 在翻译“imhabba”一词之前，需要先明确它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf xi tfisser 'imhabba'? Mark: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nsibu sentenza li turi kif tintuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know what 'imhabba' means? Mark: I don't know yet. Let's find a sentence showing how it is used.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你知道“imhabba”是什么意思吗？马克：我还不知道。我们找个能展示它用法的句子吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你知道“imhabba”是什么意思吗？
messages.en: Do you know what 'imhabba' means?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nsibu sentenza li turi kif tintuża.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nsibu sentenza li turi kif tintuża.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。我们找个能展示它用法的句子吧。
messages.en: I don't know yet. Let's find a sentence showing how it is used.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把此词暂放进“待确认词义”卡片，先记名词身份，再用语境补充含义；不要把 idk 当成它的实际词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To want something to happen and believe that it is possible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希望某件事发生，并认为它有实现的可能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tixtieq li tiġri xi ħaġa u temmen li hemm il-possibbiltà li sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；盼望某件自己期待的事情能够发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tittama meta tixtieq li tiġri xi ħaġa u taħseb li tista' sseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you hope that something will happen, you want it to happen and think that it is possible.

formal.mt: Biex juri s-sens ta' 'imhadda' bħala verb ta' tama, l-eżerċizzju jagħti din is-sentenza: 'Nittama li l-proġett jirnexxi.'
formal.en: To illustrate the sense of 'imhadda' as a verb expressing hope, the exercise gives this sentence: 'I hope that the project succeeds.'
formal.zh: 为了展示“imhadda”作为表达希望的动词的含义，练习给出这个例句：“我希望项目成功。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nista' niftakar is-sens ta' 'imhadda' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Aħseb f'xi ħaġa li tixtieq li tiġri, bħal meta tgħid: 'Nittama li ngħaddi mill-eżami.'
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I remember the meaning of 'imhadda' in this exercise? Mark: Think of something you want to happen, as when you say: 'I hope I pass the exam.'
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我怎样才能记住这道练习里“imhadda”的含义？马克：想一件你盼望发生的事，就像你说：“我希望考试及格。”

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' niftakar is-sens ta' 'imhadda' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' niftakar is-sens ta' 'imhadda' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 我怎样才能记住这道练习里“imhadda”的含义？
messages.en: How can I remember the meaning of 'imhadda' in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb f'xi ħaġa li tixtieq li tiġri, bħal meta tgħid: 'Nittama li ngħaddi mill-eżami.'
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb f'xi ħaġa li tixtieq li tiġri, bħal meta tgħid: 'Nittama li ngħaddi mill-eżami.'
messages.zh: 想一件你盼望发生的事，就像你说：“我希望考试及格。”
messages.en: Think of something you want to happen, as when you say: 'I hope I pass the exam.'

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“等待考试结果时盼望及格”的画面记住希望这一动词义：事情还没发生，心里期待好结果。例句用于理解含义，不作为词形变化表。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft object placed under your head to support it while you rest or sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 休息或睡觉时放在头部下面、用来承托头部的柔软物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett artab li jitqiegħed taħt ir-ras biex isostniha waqt il-mistrieħ jew l-irqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 枕头；睡觉或休息时垫在头部下面的柔软用品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett artab, normalment b'kisja tad-drapp, li fuqu sserraħ rasek meta tkun mimdud jew rieqed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pillow is a soft object that you rest your head on when you are lying down or sleeping.

formal.mt: Il-kamra kienet mgħammra b'sodda, kutra u imhardda ratba biex il-mistieden ikun jista' jistrieħ.
formal.en: The room was furnished with a bed, a blanket, and a soft pillow so that the guest could rest.
formal.zh: 房间配有床、毯子和柔软的枕头，供客人休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħtini imhardda oħra? Din baxxa wisq. Mark: Iva, hemm waħda fuq is-sodda. Ħudha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you give me another pillow? This one is too low. Mark: Yes, there's one on the bed. Take it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能再给我一个枕头吗？这个太低了。马克：可以，床上有一个。拿去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (住客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini imhardda oħra? Din baxxa wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini imhardda oħra? Din baxxa wisq.
messages.zh: 你能再给我一个枕头吗？这个太低了。
messages.en: Can you give me another pillow? This one is too low.

messages.speaker: Mark (房东)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda fuq is-sodda. Ħudha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda fuq is-sodda. Ħudha.
messages.zh: 可以，床上有一个。拿去吧。
messages.en: Yes, there's one on the bed. Take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象睡前把头轻轻放到柔软枕头上的动作，把此词与“头下承托物”绑定，再配合“软枕头、枕套”两个搭配记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement in which someone risks money or something valuable on an uncertain result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以尚未确定的结果为依据，押上金钱或其他有价值物品的打赌约定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li fih persuna tirriskja flus jew xi ħaġa ta' valur fuq ir-riżultat ta' ġrajja li għadu mhux magħruf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打赌；针对某个不确定结果押上金钱或其他有价值物品的约定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim bejn persuni li fih min ibassar riżultat ħażin jitlef flus jew xi ħaġa oħra skont dak li jkunu qablu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bet is an agreement to risk money or something valuable on the outcome of an uncertain event.

formal.mt: Qabel ma għamlu imhatra fuq ir-riżultat tal-logħba, iż-żewġ ħbieb qablu fuq is-somma u l-kundizzjonijiet.
formal.en: Before making a bet on the result of the match, the two friends agreed on the amount and the conditions.
formal.zh: 两位朋友就比赛结果打赌之前，先商定了金额和条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nagħmlu imhatra fuq min jasal l-ewwel? Min jitlef iħallas il-kafè. Mark: Sewwa, imma nimxu biss, bla ġiri!
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we make a bet on who gets there first? The loser pays for coffee. Mark: All right, but we only walk, no running!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们赌谁先到，好吗？输的人请喝咖啡。马克：好，不过只能走，不能跑！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu imhatra fuq min jasal l-ewwel? Min jitlef iħallas il-kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu imhatra fuq min jasal l-ewwel? Min jitlef iħallas il-kafè.
messages.zh: 我们赌谁先到，好吗？输的人请喝咖啡。
messages.en: Shall we make a bet on who gets there first? The loser pays for coffee.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, imma nimxu biss, bla ġiri!
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, imma nimxu biss, bla ġiri!
messages.zh: 好，不过只能走，不能跑！
messages.en: All right, but we only walk, no running!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁先到，输的人请咖啡”的约定记忆此词：先有不确定结果，再约定输赢代价；搭配“打赌”和“赌赢”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaving or speaking as though one is more important than other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人言行自命不凡，刻意表现得高人一等或很有身份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem jew iġib ruħu bħallikieku huwa aktar importanti minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自命不凡的；言行摆架子、刻意显示自己重要的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti lilu nnifsu wisq importanza u juri dan fil-mod kif jitkellem jew iġib ruħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is pompous speaks or behaves as if they are more important than other people.

formal.mt: Il-kelliem uża ton imkabbar u ta l-impressjoni li l-opinjonijiet tal-oħrajn ma kellhom ebda valur.
formal.en: The speaker used a pompous tone and gave the impression that other people's opinions had no value.
formal.zh: 发言者语气自命不凡，给人的印象是其他人的意见毫无价值。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma ħadtx gost titkellem miegħu? Pawlu: Għax kien imkabbar wisq; lanqas ħallieni nispiċċa sentenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you enjoy talking to him? Pawlu: Because he was so pompous; he wouldn't even let me finish a sentence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么跟他聊得不开心？保罗：因为他太自命不凡了，连一句话都不让我说完。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma ħadtx gost titkellem miegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma ħadtx gost titkellem miegħu?
messages.zh: 你为什么跟他聊得不开心？
messages.en: Why didn't you enjoy talking to him?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien imkabbar wisq; lanqas ħallieni nispiċċa sentenza.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien imkabbar wisq; lanqas ħallieni nispiċċa sentenza.
messages.zh: 因为他太自命不凡了，连一句话都不让我说完。
messages.en: Because he was so pompous; he wouldn't even let me finish a sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人昂着头抢话、觉得自己最重要，把这个画面与 imkabbar 的“自命不凡”义联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Solid waste passed out of the body through the bowels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或动物通过肠道排出体外的固体废物，即便便或粪便。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħmieġ solidu li joħroġ mill-ġisem ta' persuna jew annimal wara li jgħaddi mill-imsaren.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 便便；人或动物排出的粪便。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal solidu ta' skart li persuna jew annimal joħroġ mill-ġisem permezz tal-imsaren.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Poo is the solid waste that people or animals pass out of their bodies.

formal.mt: It-tindif tal-imkabbrin tal-kelb jgħin biex il-bankina tibqa' nadifa għal kull min jgħaddi minnha.
formal.en: Cleaning up dog poo helps keep the pavement clean for everyone who uses it.
formal.zh: 清理狗便便有助于保持人行道清洁，方便所有行人通行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Attent, hemm imkabbrin tal-kelb ħdejn il-bieb! Mark: Rajthom. Se nġib borża u nnaddaf il-post.
colloquial.en: Sara: Watch out, there's dog poo by the door! Mark: I've seen it. I'll get a bag and clean the area.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：小心，门边有狗便便！马克：我看到了。我去拿个袋子，把那里清理干净。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Attent, hemm imkabbrin tal-kelb ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.mt_standard: Attent, hemm imkabbrin tal-kelb ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.zh: 小心，门边有狗便便！
messages.en: Watch out, there's dog poo by the door!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
