messages.mt_spoken: Rajthom. Se nġib borża u nnaddaf il-post.
messages.mt_standard: Rajthom. Se nġib borża u nnaddaf il-post.
messages.zh: 我看到了。我去拿个袋子，把那里清理干净。
messages.en: I've seen it. I'll get a bag and clean the area.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“遛狗时拿袋子清理便便”的场景记住 imkabbrin，并将整词与“粪便”这个名词概念配对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having small lines, folds, or creases on the surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容皮肤、布料等表面有细纹、皱褶或折痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tikmix jew jingħalaq żgħar fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu, bħall-ġilda jew id-drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有皱纹或皱褶的；表面不再平整的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu linji jew jingħalaq żgħar fil-wiċċ tiegħu minħabba l-età, il-pressjoni jew it-tiwi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is wrinkled has small lines or folds on its surface.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, il-wiċċ imkemmex tar-raġel anzjan jidher ċar fid-dawl li jidħol mit-tieqa.
formal.en: In the photograph, the elderly man's wrinkled face is clearly visible in the light coming through the window.
formal.zh: 照片中，窗户透进来的光清楚地照出了老人脸上的皱纹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan id-drapp kollu mkemmex? Nina: Ħallejtu mitwi fil-borża; se ngħaddih bil-ħadida.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this fabric so wrinkled? Nina: I left it folded in the bag; I'll iron it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块布怎么皱成这样？妮娜：我把它折着放在袋子里了；我会把它熨平。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块布怎么皱成这样？
messages.en: Why is this fabric so wrinkled?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejtu mitwi fil-borża; se ngħaddih bil-ħadida.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejtu mitwi fil-borża; se ngħaddih bil-ħadida.
messages.zh: 我把它折着放在袋子里了；我会把它熨平。
messages.en: I left it folded in the bag; I'll iron it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把老人脸上的细纹与袋中布料的皱褶并排想象：两种表面都不平整，都能帮助记住 imkemmex。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protected from wind or bad weather, or comfortably warm and cosy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某处受到遮挡，免受风雨影响；也可形容人或地方温暖、安适。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab protett mir-riħ jew mit-temp ħażin, jew li jinsab f'kumdità u sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有遮蔽的；受到保护而免受风雨等外界影响的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'post fejn hemm xi ħaġa li tipproteġih mir-riħ, mix-xita jew minn temp ħażin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sheltered place is protected from wind or bad weather by something around it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 温暖舒适的；使人感到安适、有包裹感的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab sħun u komdu, b'sens ta' kenn u mistrieħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are snug, you feel comfortably warm and protected where you are.

collocations.en: a garden sheltered from the wind

collocations.zh: 舒舒服服地裹在毯子里

formal.mt: Il-ġnien jinsab imkennen mir-riħ bis-saħħa tal-ħajt għoli li jdawru, u għalhekk joffri post xieraq għall-qari fil-beraħ.
formal.en: The garden is sheltered from the wind by the high wall surrounding it, making it a suitable place for reading outdoors.
formal.zh: 花园四周的高墙挡住了风，因此这里适合在户外阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tħoss il-bard hawn? Pawlu: Le, jien imkennen taħt il-kutra u komdu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you feeling cold here? Pawlu: No, I'm snug under the blanket and very comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在这里觉得冷吗？保罗：不冷，我裹在毯子里暖暖的，非常舒服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在这里觉得冷吗？
messages.en: Are you feeling cold here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jien imkennen taħt il-kutra u komdu ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jien imkennen taħt il-kutra u komdu ħafna.
messages.zh: 不冷，我裹在毯子里暖暖的，非常舒服。
messages.en: No, I'm snug under the blanket and very comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想高墙挡风的花园，再想裹着毯子的人：从“受到遮蔽”联想到“温暖安适”，串起 imkennen 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very eager or enthusiastic about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某件事抱有强烈兴趣或热切期待的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandha ħerqa kbira għal xi ħaġa jew xewqa qawwija li tagħmilha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to been very keen about sth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事非常热衷或充满渴望。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandha interess qawwi ħafna f'xi ħaġa u tħoss ħerqa kbira għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is very keen about something, they feel strong interest in it or eagerly want to take part.

formal.mt: L-istudenta kienet imlebilba biex tieħu sehem fil-proġett u titgħallem ħiliet ġodda.
formal.en: The student was very eager to take part in the project and learn new skills.
formal.zh: 这名女学生非常渴望参与项目并学习新技能。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int imlebilba għall-vjaġġ? Rita: Iva, ilni nistennih! Diġà ħejjejt il-bagalja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you really excited about the trip? Rita: Yes, I've been waiting for it! I've already packed my suitcase.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你很期待这次旅行吗？丽塔：是啊，我一直盼着呢！行李箱都收拾好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你很期待这次旅行吗？
messages.en: Are you really excited about the trip?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilni nistennih! Diġà ħejjejt il-bagalja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilni nistennih! Diġà ħejjejt il-bagalja.
messages.zh: 是啊，我一直盼着呢！行李箱都收拾好了。
messages.en: Yes, I've been waiting for it! I've already packed my suitcase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“旅行还没开始，行李已经收好”的画面绑定，记住它表达强烈期待和热切心情。

gloss_zh: 色彩丰富的；五彩缤纷的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having many different or noticeable colours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有多种颜色，或色彩鲜明丰富的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandha ħafna kuluri differenti jew kuluri li jispikkaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 色彩丰富的；具有多种鲜明颜色的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandha varjetà ta' kuluri u tidher rikka fil-kulur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is colorful has many different colours or colours that attract your attention.

formal.mt: Fuq il-qoxra tal-ktieb hemm stampa imlewna li tiġbed l-attenzjoni tat-tfal.
formal.en: On the book's cover, there is a colourful picture that attracts children's attention.
formal.zh: 书的封面上有一幅色彩丰富的图画，吸引着孩子们的注意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Togħġbok din l-istampa? Nina: Iva, hija imlewna ħafna! Inpoġġuha fil-kamra?
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you like this picture? Nina: Yes, it's very colourful! Shall we put it in the room?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢这幅画吗？妮娜：喜欢，颜色真丰富！我们把它放在房间里好吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这幅画吗？
messages.en: Do you like this picture?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija imlewna ħafna! Inpoġġuha fil-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija imlewna ħafna! Inpoġġuha fil-kamra?
messages.zh: 喜欢，颜色真丰富！我们把它放在房间里好吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's very colourful! Shall we put it in the room?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一幅同时涂有红黄蓝绿的图画，用“眼前好多种颜色”记住这个词的色彩丰富义。

gloss_zh: 穿好衣服的；身着某种衣物的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wearing clothes, sometimes with emphasis on a particular garment or covering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经穿着衣服的，也可强调身上所穿的特定衣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħwejjeġ fuqu, jew li jkun liebes ilbies partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿好衣服的；处于已着装的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħwejjeġ fuqu u jkun lest mill-ilbies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is dressed, they have put clothes on and are wearing them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身着某种衣物的；强调所穿的具体衣装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu fuqu tip partikolari ta' lbies, b'enfasi fuq dak li jkun liebes.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is clad in a particular garment is wearing that garment.

formal.mt: Ir-raġel wasal għall-laqgħa mlibbes pulit, b'ġakketta skura u qmis bajda.
formal.en: The man arrived at the meeting neatly dressed, wearing a dark jacket and a white shirt.
formal.zh: 这名男子衣着整洁地来到会场，身穿深色夹克和白衬衫。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tifel diġà mlibbes? Pawlu: Iva, imlibbes b'kowt oħxon u lest biex joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the boy dressed already? Pawlu: Yes, he's wearing a thick coat and is ready to go out.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：孩子已经穿好衣服了吗？保罗：是的，他穿着厚外套，已经可以出门了。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子已经穿好衣服了吗？
messages.en: Is the boy dressed already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imlibbes b'kowt oħxon u lest biex joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imlibbes b'kowt oħxon u lest biex joħroġ.
messages.zh: 是的，他穿着厚外套，已经可以出门了。
messages.en: Yes, he's wearing a thick coat and is ready to go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“出门前检查衣服是否穿好”的场景记忆；再把镜头移到厚外套上，区分已着装与身着某衣两种表达重点。

gloss_zh: 管理；操持；挥使；搞不正当勾当

teaching_sense.en_definition: To organize or handle something, to wield an implement, or to engage in underhand dealings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组织或处理事务；操持、挥使工具；也可指进行不正当的暗中交易或勾当。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jorganizza jew jieħu ħsieb xi ħaġa, juża għodda b'idejh, jew jidħol f'intriċċi u ftehimiet qarrieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管理、组织或处理事务，使工作或活动得以进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jorganizza, jikkontrolla jew jieħu ħsieb xogħol, attività jew sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you manage something, you organize or handle it so that the necessary work gets done.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持用或挥使工具、武器等物件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iżomm u juża għodda jew arma b'idejh biex iwettaq azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you wield a tool or weapon, you hold and use it to perform an action.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与暗中进行的不正当交易、欺诈性安排或勾当。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jidħol f'intriċċi jew ftehimiet sigrieti u qarrieqa biex jikseb vantaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone indulges in underhand dealings, they take part in secret and dishonest arrangements to gain an advantage.

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur immaniġġa l-proġett b'mod effiċjenti u żgura li x-xogħol jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: The coordinator managed the project efficiently and ensured that the work was completed on time.
formal.zh: 协调员高效地管理了项目，并确保工作按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif immaniġġajt ix-xogħol kollu lbieraħ? Pawlu: Qassamtu mat-tim, u kulħadd għamel il-parti tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did you manage all the work yesterday? Pawlu: I divided it among the team, and everyone did their part.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你昨天是怎么处理完所有工作的？保罗：我把工作分给了团队，大家各自完成了自己的部分。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 你昨天是怎么处理完所有工作的？
messages.en: How did you manage all the work yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qassamtu mat-tim, u kulħadd għamel il-parti tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Qassamtu mat-tim, u kulħadd għamel il-parti tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我把工作分给了团队，大家各自完成了自己的部分。
messages.en: I divided it among the team, and everyone did their part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景分开记：安排项目对应管理，手持斧头对应挥使，暗中串通对应不正当勾当；遇到 immaniġġa 要靠宾语和语境判断。

gloss_zh: 货物装卸与搬运；货运装卸作业

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of loading, unloading, and moving goods during transport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运输过程中对货物进行装载、卸载和搬移的作业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol tat-tagħbija, il-ħatt u ċ-ċaqliq tal-merkanzija waqt it-trasport tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对运输工具所载货物进行装载、卸载及搬移的作业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess tat-tagħbija, il-ħatt u ċ-ċaqliq ta' merkanzija li tinġarr fuq vapur, ajruplan jew vettura oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cargo handling is the work of loading, unloading, and moving goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物运输环节中的装卸、搬运和转移作业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol tat-tagħbija, il-ħatt u ċ-ċaqliq tal-merkanzija fl-istadji differenti tat-trasport tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Freight handling involves loading, unloading, and moving goods as they pass through different stages of transport.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija investiet f'tagħmir ġdid għall-immaniġġar tal-merkanzija biex tħaffef it-tagħbija u l-ħatt fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The company invested in new freight-handling equipment to speed up loading and unloading at the warehouse.
formal.zh: 公司投资购置了新的货物装卸搬运设备，以加快仓库的装卸速度。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jieħu ħsieb l-immaniġġar tal-merkanzija għada? Pawlu: It-tim tagħna. Nibdew inħottu l-kaxxi fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will take care of cargo handling tomorrow? Pawlu: Our team. We'll start unloading the boxes at eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：明天谁负责货物装卸搬运？保罗：我们团队。我们八点开始卸箱子。

messages.speaker: Marija (仓库主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb l-immaniġġar tal-merkanzija għada?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb l-immaniġġar tal-merkanzija għada?
messages.zh: 明天谁负责货物装卸搬运？
messages.en: Who will take care of cargo handling tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (装卸组长)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tim tagħna. Nibdew inħottu l-kaxxi fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: It-tim tagħna. Nibdew inħottu l-kaxxi fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 我们团队。我们八点开始卸箱子。
messages.en: Our team. We'll start unloading the boxes at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一箱货依次经过装车、卸车、搬进仓库三个动作，把整个作业过程一起记作 immaniġġar tal-merkanzija，避免只记成运输本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To injure someone so severely that a part of their body is permanently damaged or lost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人遭受严重身体伤害，导致身体某部位永久受损或缺失。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iweġġa' lil xi ħadd tant serjament li parti minn ġismu ssirilha ħsara permanenti jew tintilef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人受到造成永久性肢体损伤、功能丧失或身体部位缺失的严重伤害。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jikkawża ġrieħi gravi lil persuna li jwasslu għal ħsara permanenti, telf tal-użu ta' parti mill-ġisem jew telf ta' dik il-parti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something maims a person, they cause a serious injury that permanently damages or removes part of that person's body.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif l-inċident immanka lill-ħaddiem u ħallieh bi ħsara permanenti f'siequ.
formal.en: The report describes how the accident maimed the worker and left him with permanent damage to his leg.
formal.zh: 报告描述了事故如何使该工人伤残，并导致其腿部永久受损。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta tgħid li l-inċident immanka lil Pawlu, tfisser li l-ħsara hi permanenti? Ġanni: Iva, tilef l-użu ta' id waħda.
colloquial.en: Marija: When you say the accident maimed Pawlu, do you mean the damage is permanent? Ġanni: Yes, he lost the use of one hand.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你说事故使保罗伤残，是指损伤是永久性的吗？詹尼：是的，他的一只手失去了功能。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid li l-inċident immanka lil Pawlu, tfisser li l-ħsara hi permanenti?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid li l-inċident immanka lil Pawlu, tfisser li l-ħsara hi permanenti?
messages.zh: 你说事故使保罗伤残，是指损伤是永久性的吗？
messages.en: When you say the accident maimed Pawlu, do you mean the damage is permanent?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tilef l-użu ta' id waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tilef l-użu ta' id waħda.
messages.zh: 是的，他的一只手失去了功能。
messages.en: Yes, he lost the use of one hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immanka 和普通擦伤分开记：联想事故后手脚留下永久损伤或失去功能的情景，抓住“严重受伤并造成伤残”这个核心意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being left abandoned or without care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物被弃置、缺乏照管的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li tħallew mitluqa jew mingħajr ħarsien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弃置或无人照管的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' persuna jew ħaġa li tħalliet mitluqa u mingħajr il-ħarsien meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun describes the condition of someone or something left abandoned or without proper care.

collocations.en: the neglected state of the building

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-immantar tal-bini u jitlob li jsiru t-tiswijiet meħtieġa.
formal.en: The report describes the neglected state of the building and calls for the necessary repairs.
formal.zh: 报告描述了建筑物无人照管的状态，并要求进行必要的修缮。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt dik id-dar vojta? L-immantar tagħha jidher mit-twieqi miksura. Pawlu: Iva, għandha bżonn min jieħu ħsiebha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see that empty house? Its neglected state is clear from the broken windows. Pawlu: Yes, it needs someone to look after it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到那栋空房子了吗？从破窗户就看得出它一直无人照管。保罗：是啊，需要有人照料它。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt dik id-dar vojta? L-immantar tagħha jidher mit-twieqi miksura.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt dik id-dar vojta? L-immantar tagħha jidher mit-twieqi miksura.
messages.zh: 你看到那栋空房子了吗？从破窗户就看得出它一直无人照管。
messages.en: Did you see that empty house? Its neglected state is clear from the broken windows.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha bżonn min jieħu ħsiebha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha bżonn min jieħu ħsiebha.
messages.zh: 是啊，需要有人照料它。
messages.en: Yes, it needs someone to look after it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immantar 与一栋破窗空屋的画面配对，记住这里表达的是“被弃置的状态”，并按名词学习。

gloss_zh: 标记；打上品牌标识；留下深刻印象

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put an identifying mark on something, identify it with a brand, or leave a strong impression on someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在事物上做识别标记、加上品牌标识，或给人留下强烈而持久的印象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel sinjal fuq xi ħaġa, tqiegħed fuqha marka kummerċjali, jew tħalli impressjoni qawwija fuq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某物上做标记，以便识别、指示位置或引起注意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel sinjal fuq xi ħaġa biex tingħaraf jew biex tiġbed l-attenzjoni lejha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you mark something, you put a sign on it so that it can be identified or noticed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在产品或其他物品上加上表示品牌、来源或归属的识别标记。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqiegħed marka ta' identifikazzjoni fuq prodott jew oġġett biex turi l-marka kummerċjali, l-oriġini jew ta' min hu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you brand a product or object, you give it an identifying mark that shows its commercial identity, origin, or ownership.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人受到强烈触动，留下深刻或持久的印象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħalli impressjoni qawwija jew dejjiema fuq xi ħadd permezz ta' esperjenza, azzjoni jew kwalità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something impresses someone in this sense, it affects them strongly and leaves a lasting impression.

collocations.en: mark the place on the map
brand the product with the logo
collocations.zh: 在产品上加上品牌标志

collocations.en: leave a lasting impression on his life
collocations.zh: 在他的人生中留下深刻印记

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur immarka l-post ta' kull kampjun fuq il-mappa biex ikun jista' jerġa' jsibu.
formal.en: The researcher marked the location of each sample on the map so that he could find it again.
formal.zh: 研究人员在地图上标出了每份样本的位置，以便日后再次找到。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Immarka l-post fejn se niltaqgħu fuq il-mappa, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Sewwa, u nibgħatlek il-mappa bil-post immarkat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Please mark our meeting place on the map. Mark: All right, and I'll send you the map with the place marked.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请在地图上标出我们见面的地方。马克：好的，我会把标好地点的地图发给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Immarka l-post fejn se niltaqgħu fuq il-mappa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Immarka l-post fejn se niltaqgħu fuq il-mappa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请在地图上标出我们见面的地方。
messages.en: Please mark our meeting place on the map.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, u nibgħatlek il-mappa bil-post immarkat.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, u nibgħatlek il-mappa bil-post immarkat.
messages.zh: 好的，我会把标好地点的地图发给你。
messages.en: All right, and I'll send you the map with the place marked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“留下记号”串联三个义项：地图留下位置记号，商品留下品牌记号，经历在心中留下深刻印记。这只是学习联想。

gloss_zh: 有标记的；带品牌标识的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an identifying mark or displaying a brand mark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经做上识别标记的，或带有品牌标识的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu sinjal ta' identifikazzjoni jew marka kummerċjali fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有标记的；已经通过记号标示出来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li fuqu sar sinjal biex jintgħaraf, jinstab jew jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is marked has a sign on it that helps people identify or notice it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有品牌标识或其他表示来源、归属的识别标记的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu fuqu marka li turi l-identità kummerċjali, l-oriġini jew ta' min hu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A branded item carries an identifying mark that shows its brand, origin, or ownership.

collocations.en: a place marked on the map
a product branded with the logo

formal.mt: Il-punt immarkat bl-aħmar fuq il-pjanta jindika l-post fejn għandu jitqiegħed l-apparat.
formal.en: The point marked in red on the plan indicates where the equipment should be placed.
formal.zh: 平面图上用红色标出的点表示设备应放置的位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema kaxxa għandi nieħu? Toni: Ħu dik bil-ġenb immarkat bl-aħmar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which box should I take? Toni: Take the one with its side marked in red.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我该拿哪个箱子？托尼：拿侧面做了红色标记的那个。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我该拿哪个箱子？
messages.en: Which box should I take?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 拿侧面做了红色标记的那个。
messages.en: Take the one with its side marked in red.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immarkat 配上一只已经贴好标签的箱子：重点记住物品“已有标记”的状态；换成品牌标签，就对应“带品牌标识的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To kill many people brutally, or to slaughter people or animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 残酷地杀害大量人员，或屠杀人、宰杀动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toqtol ħafna nies b'mod brutali, jew toqtol nies jew annimali fi ħerba jew għall-qatla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 残酷地大规模杀害人员，尤指无力抵抗的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Toqtol għadd kbir ta' nies b'mod brutali, speċjalment nies li ma jistgħux jiddefendu ruħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people massacre others, they kill a large number of them brutally, especially when the victims cannot defend themselves.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宰杀动物，尤指供食用；也指残酷地杀害人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Toqtol annimali, speċjalment biex jintużaw għall-ikel, jew toqtol nies b'mod vjolenti u bla ħniena.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone slaughters animals, they kill them, usually for food; the word can also describe the brutal killing of people.

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jiddeskrivi kif il-kmandant immassakra ċ-ċivili minkejja li ma kinux armati.
formal.en: The novel describes how the commander massacred the civilians even though they were unarmed.
formal.zh: 小说描述了指挥官如何屠杀手无寸铁的平民。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel il-kmandant fl-aħħar tal-film? David: Immassakra n-nies tar-raħal. Kienet xena ta' niket kbir.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did the commander do at the end of the film? David: He massacred the villagers. It was a very sad scene.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：电影结尾那个指挥官做了什么？戴维：他屠杀了村民。那一幕让人非常难过。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影结尾那个指挥官做了什么？
messages.en: What did the commander do at the end of the film?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Immassakra n-nies tar-raħal. Kienet xena ta' niket kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Immassakra n-nies tar-raħal. Kienet xena ta' niket kbir.
messages.zh: 他屠杀了村民。那一幕让人非常难过。
messages.en: He massacred the villagers. It was a very sad scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immassakra 与英文 massacre 并排记忆，联想到严重的屠杀行为；再用宾语区分“屠杀人员”和“宰杀动物”，不把拼写联想当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability to form mental pictures or ideas about things that are not present or real.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在脑海中构造眼前不存在或现实中未必存在的形象、情境和想法的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li toħloq f'moħħok stampi, ideat jew sitwazzjonijiet li mhumiex quddiemek jew li ma jeżistux fir-realtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想象力；在脑海中形成未直接感知到的形象或情境的能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħila tal-moħħ li jfassal stampi u ideat ta' affarijiet li wieħed ma jkunx qed jara jew jesperjenza direttament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your imagination is the ability to create mental pictures and ideas about things you are not directly experiencing.

formal.mt: Il-qari ta' stejjer differenti jgħin lit-tfal jiżviluppaw l-immaġinazzjoni u joħolqu ideat ġodda.
formal.en: Reading different stories helps children develop their imagination and create new ideas.
formal.zh: 阅读不同的故事有助于孩子发展想象力并产生新想法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nafx kif se nkompli l-istorja. Mark: Uża l-immaġinazzjoni! Forsi l-qattus isib bieb sigriet.
colloquial.en: Maja: I don't know how to continue the story. Mark: Use your imagination! Maybe the cat finds a secret door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我不知道这个故事接下来怎么写。马克：发挥想象力呀！也许那只猫发现了一扇秘密的门。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx kif se nkompli l-istorja.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx kif se nkompli l-istorja.
messages.zh: 我不知道这个故事接下来怎么写。
messages.en: I don't know how to continue the story.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-immaġinazzjoni! Forsi l-qattus isib bieb sigriet.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-immaġinazzjoni! Forsi l-qattus isib bieb sigriet.
messages.zh: 发挥想象力呀！也许那只猫发现了一扇秘密的门。
messages.en: Use your imagination! Maybe the cat finds a secret door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它与英语 imagination 对照记忆，再想象脑中放映一部自己编的电影：创造画面和情节的能力就是想象力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A visual representation of a person or thing, or the impression that someone or something creates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人物或事物的视觉呈现，也可指某人或某事物给人的印象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rappreżentazzjoni viżiva ta' persuna jew ħaġa, jew l-impressjoni li persuna jew ħaġa tagħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 图像；人物或事物的视觉形象，也可指其在人们心中形成的印象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rappreżentazzjoni viżiva ta' persuna jew ħaġa, bħal ritratt jew stampa, jew l-impressjoni li titħalla f'moħħ in-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An image is a visual representation of someone or something, or the impression that people have of them.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi immaġni ċara tal-bini biex il-qarrej ikun jista' jidentifika d-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The report includes a clear image of the building so that the reader can identify the main entrance.
formal.zh: 报告附有一张清晰的建筑图像，以便读者辨认正门。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din l-immaġni mhix ċara. Għandek oħra? Pawlu: Iva, nibgħatlek immaġni aħjar issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: This image isn't clear. Do you have another one? Pawlu: Yes, I'll send you a better image now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这张图像不清楚。你还有别的吗？保罗：有，我现在给你发一张更清楚的。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-immaġni mhix ċara. Għandek oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-immaġni mhix ċara. Għandek oħra?
messages.zh: 这张图像不清楚。你还有别的吗？
messages.en: This image isn't clear. Do you have another one?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我现在给你发一张更清楚的。
messages.en: Yes, I'll send you a better image now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一张清晰照片和一个人的公众形象并排想象：前者是看得见的图像，后者是留在心里的印象，两者都可用 immaġni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something immediate happens or takes effect without delay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事立即发生、生效或需要马上处理，没有延迟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġri jew jidħol fis-seħħ minnufih, mingħajr dewmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立即发生或生效的；不延迟的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jseħħ minnufih jew li ma jistax jistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An immediate action or effect occurs without any delay.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda intervent immedjat biex tiġi evitata aktar ħsara.
formal.en: The report recommends immediate intervention to prevent further damage.
formal.zh: 报告建议立即干预，以防止进一步损害。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-bidla se jkollha effett immedjat? Pawlu: Iva, se tara d-differenza minnufih.
colloquial.en: Marta: Will this change have an immediate effect? Pawlu: Yes, you will see the difference straight away.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这个改动会立刻见效吗？Pawlu：会，你马上就能看出区别。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-bidla se jkollha effett immedjat?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-bidla se jkollha effett immedjat?
messages.zh: 这个改动会立刻见效吗？
messages.en: Will this change have an immediate effect?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 会，你马上就能看出区别。
messages.en: Yes, you will see the difference straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immedjat 放在 effett 后一起记：effett immedjat 是“即时效果”，用来描述效果来得快。

teaching_sense.en_definition: If something happens immediately, it happens at once without delay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示动作或事件马上发生，中间不等待、不拖延。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li azzjoni jew ġrajja sseħħ minnufih, mingħajr dewmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立即；马上；毫不拖延地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Minnufih, mingħajr ma jgħaddi żmien ta' stennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you do something immediately, you do it at once.

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu jinforma lill-maniġer immedjatament jekk jinstab xi żball.
formal.en: Staff must inform the manager immediately if an error is found.
formal.zh: 如发现任何错误，工作人员必须立即通知经理。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta se ċċempel lil ommok? Mark: Se nċemplilha immedjatament, qabel noħroġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: When are you going to call your mother? Mark: I will call her immediately, before I go out.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你什么时候给你妈妈打电话？Mark：我马上就打，出门之前打。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候给你妈妈打电话？
messages.en: When are you going to call your mother?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我马上就打，出门之前打。
messages.en: I will call her immediately, before I go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“动作＋马上”记 immedjatament：wieġeb immedjatament 就是“马上回答了”，重点是动作发生的时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To merit or deserve something is to be worthy of it because of your actions or qualities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因行为、表现或品质而值得获得某种评价、奖励或待遇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun denju ta' xi ħaġa minħabba l-għemil, l-isforz jew il-kwalitajiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有足够的价值或优点，值得得到某种关注、评价或奖励。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun jistħoqqlu attenzjoni, apprezzament jew premju minħabba l-valur jew il-mertu tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something merits attention or praise, their qualities make that response appropriate.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因所做的事或自身情况而应当得到某种结果或待遇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun jistħoqqlu riżultat jew trattament partikolari minħabba dak li għamel jew iċ-ċirkostanzi tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone deserves something, it is right that they receive it because of what they have done or experienced.

formal.mt: Bil-ħidma bir-reqqa tiegħu, it-tim immerita r-rikonoxximent li ngħata.
formal.en: Through its careful work, the team deserved the recognition it received.
formal.zh: 团队凭借细致的工作，配得上所获得的认可。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li Daniel immerita l-premju? Nina: Iva, ħadem ħafna u għen lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think Daniel deserved the award? Nina: Yes, he worked hard and helped everyone.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得 Daniel 配得上这个奖吗？Nina：配得上，他很努力，还帮助了大家。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你觉得 Daniel 配得上这个奖吗？
messages.en: Do you think Daniel deserved the award?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadem ħafna u għen lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadem ħafna u għen lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 配得上，他很努力，还帮助了大家。
messages.en: Yes, he worked hard and helped everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“努力表现→应得奖励”的场景：immerita premju 表示“理应获奖”，强调得到它是有理由的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something worm-eaten has been damaged by worms that have eaten into it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述被虫蛀蚀、因虫子啃食而出现孔洞或损坏的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu toqob jew ħsara minħabba dud li kiel minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被虫蛀蚀而有孔洞或损坏的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġarrab ħsara jew imtela b'toqob għax id-dud kiel minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is worm-eaten has holes or damage caused by worms eating into it.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab travu immermer b'ħafna toqob żgħar.
formal.en: During the inspection, a worm-eaten beam with many small holes was found.
formal.zh: 检查时发现了一根虫蛀的梁，上面有许多小孔。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dan l-injam għandu tant toqob? Pawlu: Għax hu immermer; id-dud kiel minnu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does this wood have so many holes? Pawlu: Because it is worm-eaten; worms have eaten into it.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这块木头怎么有这么多孔？Pawlu：因为它被虫蛀了，虫子啃过它。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-injam għandu tant toqob?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-injam għandu tant toqob?
messages.zh: 这块木头怎么有这么多孔？
messages.en: Why does this wood have so many holes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu immermer; id-dud kiel minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu immermer; id-dud kiel minnu.
messages.zh: 因为它被虫蛀了，虫子啃过它。
messages.en: Because it is worm-eaten; worms have eaten into it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immermer 和满是小虫孔的木梁画面联系起来：injam immermer 是“虫蛀的木材”，借具体损坏状态记词义。

gloss_zh: 波浪状的；呈波浪起伏的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having curves or bends that resemble waves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像波浪一样弯曲或起伏的，可形容头发、线条或图案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kurvi jew liwjiet li jixbhu l-mewġ, bħal xagħar jew disinn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呈波浪形弯曲或起伏的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex dritt iżda għandu sensiela ta' kurvi li jixbhu l-mewġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is wavy has a series of curves or bends resembling waves.

formal.mt: Il-purtiera għandha disinn immewweġ li jagħti sens ta' moviment lill-kamra.
formal.en: The curtain has a wavy design that gives the room a sense of movement.
formal.zh: 窗帘上的波浪形图案为房间增添了动感。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xagħrek dritt jew immewweġ? David: Immewweġ, imma llum iddrittajtu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is your hair straight or wavy? David: Wavy, but I straightened it today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的头发是直的还是波浪卷的？戴维：波浪卷的，不过我今天把它拉直了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的头发是直的还是波浪卷的？
messages.en: Is your hair straight or wavy?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 波浪卷的，不过我今天把它拉直了。
messages.en: Wavy, but I straightened it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和波浪卷发的画面一起记：一绺头发连续弯曲，就是 immewweġ 所描述的形状。

gloss_zh: 移民；从外国迁入并居住的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who comes to another country to live there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从另一个国家迁来，打算在迁入国居住的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġi minn pajjiż ieħor biex tgħix fil-pajjiż fejn tasal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从外国迁入某国居住的人；外来移民。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li titlaq minn pajjiżha u tmur tgħix f'pajjiż ieħor, meqjusa mill-perspettiva tal-pajjiż li tilħaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An immigrant is someone who moves to another country in order to live there.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jirrakkonta l-esperjenza ta' immigrant li beda ħajja ġdida f'Malta.
formal.en: The article recounts the experience of an immigrant who began a new life in Malta.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讲述了一位在马耳他开始新生活的移民的经历。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif iltqajt ma' Daniel? Mark: Iltqajt miegħu f'kors tal-Malti; hu immigrant bħali.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you meet Daniel? Mark: I met him on a Maltese course; he's an immigrant like me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是怎么认识丹尼尔的？马克：我在马耳他语课程上认识了他；他和我一样，也是移民。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是怎么认识丹尼尔的？
messages.en: How did you meet Daniel?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iltqajt miegħu f'kors tal-Malti; hu immigrant bħali.
messages.mt_standard: Iltqajt miegħu f'kors tal-Malti; hu immigrant bħali.
messages.zh: 我在马耳他语课程上认识了他；他和我一样，也是移民。
messages.en: I met him on a Maltese course; he's an immigrant like me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物画面记忆：一个人带着行李来到另一个国家生活，他就是 immigrant；这个词指人。

gloss_zh: 移民迁入；外国人口迁入某国居住的过程或现象

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of people coming to another country to live there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们从外国迁入某个国家居住的过程或社会现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-fenomenu ta' nies li jiġu minn pajjiżi oħra biex jgħixu f'pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外国人口迁入某国居住的过程或现象；移民迁入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' persuni minn pajjiżi oħra lejn pajjiż fejn ikunu se jgħixu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Immigration is the process in which people enter another country in order to live there.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta statistika dwar l-immigrazzjoni u jiddiskuti l-ħtiġijiet ta' dawk li jaslu biex jgħixu fil-pajjiż.
formal.en: The report presents statistics on immigration and discusses the needs of those arriving to live in the country.
formal.zh: 报告提供了移民迁入的统计数据，并讨论了来到该国居住的人们的需求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuq xiex se tagħmel il-proġett? Luka: Fuq l-immigrazzjoni; se nintervista nies li ġew jgħixu hawn minn pajjiżi oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: What will your project be about? Luka: Immigration; I'll interview people who came here from other countries to live.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的课题准备研究什么？卢卡：移民迁入；我要采访从其他国家搬来这里生活的人。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你的课题准备研究什么？
messages.en: What will your project be about?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-immigrazzjoni; se nintervista nies li ġew jgħixu hawn minn pajjiżi oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-immigrazzjoni; se nintervista nies li ġew jgħixu hawn minn pajjiżi oħra.
messages.zh: 移民迁入；我要采访从其他国家搬来这里生活的人。
messages.en: Immigration; I'll interview people who came here from other countries to live.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两张学习卡并排记：immigrant 对应迁入的人，immigrazzjoni 对应人们迁入居住的过程和现象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say or indicate that you will harm someone or cause something bad to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以言语或行动表示将伤害某人或造成不利后果，使对方害怕或迫使其做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħid jew turi lil xi ħadd li se tagħmillu ħsara jew tikkawża xi ħaġa ħażina, biex tbeżżgħu jew iġġiegħlu jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 威胁或恐吓某人，表示将伤害对方或造成某种不利后果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħid jew tagħti x'tifhem li se tagħmel ħsara lil xi ħadd jew li se tagħmel xi ħaġa ħażina jekk ma jsirx dak li trid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone threatens another person, they say or indicate that they will harm them or cause an unwelcome consequence.

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel imminaċċa lill-ġar tiegħu waqt argument.
formal.en: The witness said that the man threatened his neighbour during an argument.
formal.zh: 证人说，那名男子在争吵中威胁了他的邻居。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher daqshekk inkwetat? Alex: Raġel imminaċċa lil ħija bit-telefon, u issa se mmur miegħu għand il-pulizija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look so worried? Alex: A man threatened my brother over the phone, and now I'm going with him to the police.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么看起来这么担心？亚历克斯：一个男人在电话里威胁了我兄弟，我现在要陪他去找警察。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么看起来这么担心？
messages.en: Why do you look so worried?

messages.speaker: Alex (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Raġel imminaċċa lil ħija bit-telefon, u issa se mmur miegħu għand il-pulizija.
messages.mt_standard: Raġel imminaċċa lil ħija bit-telefon, u issa se mmur miegħu għand il-pulizija.
messages.zh: 一个男人在电话里威胁了我兄弟，我现在要陪他去找警察。
messages.en: A man threatened my brother over the phone, and now I'm going with him to the police.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用情境记忆：听见有人说出带有伤害后果的狠话，就联想到 imminaċċa 的威胁、恐吓含义。

gloss_zh: 即将发生的；迫在眉睫的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expected to happen very soon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预计很快就会发生的，常用于描述即将到来的事件、变化或危险。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mistenni jseħħ fi żmien qasir ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 即将发生的；迫在眉睫的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li mistenni jiġri dalwaqt ħafna, speċjalment meta jkun hemm sinjali li qed joqrob.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an event is imminent, it is expected to happen very soon.

formal.mt: Minħabba l-periklu imminenti, l-awtoritajiet ordnaw li l-bini jitbattal minnufih.
formal.en: Because of the imminent danger, the authorities ordered the building to be evacuated immediately.
formal.zh: 由于危险迫在眉睫，当局下令立即疏散楼内人员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iċċaqalqu l-imwejjed kollha? Lara: Hemm bidla imminenti fit-tqassim tal-kamra; għada se jibda x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are they moving all the tables? Lara: A change to the room's layout is imminent; work starts tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么把所有桌子都搬来搬去？拉拉：房间马上要重新布置了，明天就开工。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 他们为什么把所有桌子都搬来搬去？
messages.en: Why are they moving all the tables?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm bidla imminenti fit-tqassim tal-kamra; għada se jibda x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm bidla imminenti fit-tqassim tal-kamra; għada se jibda x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 房间马上要重新布置了，明天就开工。
messages.en: A change to the room's layout is imminent; work starts tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imminenti 配上“倒计时只剩几秒”的画面，记住它强调事情马上发生；搭配 periklu 就是“危险迫在眉睫”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Directed towards a particular person, group, purpose, or result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以特定的人、群体、目的或结果为目标的；有针对性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun maħsub jew indirizzat għal persuna, grupp jew għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对某人、某个群体或某项目标的；旨在实现某种结果的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun indirizzat lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew maħsub biex jilħaq għan speċifiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is aimed at a person, group, or goal, it is directed towards them or designed to achieve that goal.

collocations.en: a programme aimed at young people

formal.mt: Il-programm huwa mmirat lejn adulti li jixtiequ jtejbu l-ħiliet tagħhom fil-qari.
formal.en: The programme is aimed at adults who wish to improve their reading skills.
formal.zh: 该项目面向希望提高阅读能力的成年人。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-kors jgħodd għalija jekk għadni qed nibda? Sara: Iva, huwa mmirat lejn min għadu jibda, u kollox jiġi spjegat pass pass.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this course suitable for me if I'm just starting out? Sara: Yes, it's aimed at beginners, and everything is explained step by step.
colloquial.zh: 马克：如果我才刚开始学，这门课适合我吗？萨拉：适合，这门课面向初学者，所有内容都会一步一步讲解。

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kors jgħodd għalija jekk għadni qed nibda?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kors jgħodd għalija jekk għadni qed nibda?
messages.zh: 如果我才刚开始学，这门课适合我吗？
messages.en: Is this course suitable for me if I'm just starting out?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa mmirat lejn min għadu jibda, u kollox jiġi spjegat pass pass.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa mmirat lejn min għadu jibda, u kollox jiġi spjegat pass pass.
messages.zh: 适合，这门课面向初学者，所有内容都会一步一步讲解。
messages.en: Yes, it's aimed at beginners, and everything is explained step by step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immirat 想成课程介绍上的一支箭头，箭头指向谁，课程就针对谁；连着 lejn 一起记，便于表达“面向某群体”。

gloss_zh: 想念；思念；因不在身边而怀念

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel the absence of someone or something and wish they were present again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人不在身边或某事物不再伴随自己而感到想念，希望再次相聚或拥有。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħoss in-nuqqas ta' persuna jew ta' xi ħaġa u tixtieq li terġa' tkun miegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想念不在身边的人，或怀念暂时失去、无法享有的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħoss li persuna jew xi ħaġa qed tonqsok u jkollok xewqa li terġa' taraha jew tesperjenzaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you miss someone or something, you feel their absence and wish you could be with them or experience them again.

collocations.en: missed his former way of life

formal.mt: Matul is-sena li qatta' barra minn Malta, Pawlu immisja ħafna lill-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: During the year he spent away from Malta, Pawlu missed his family very much.
formal.zh: 在离开马耳他的那一年里，保罗十分想念家人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nimmisja lil oħti minn meta marret tgħix barra. Maja: Nifhmek. Għaliex ma ċċemplilhiex illejla?
colloquial.en: Nina: I miss my sister since she moved abroad. Maja: I understand. Why don't you call her tonight?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：姐姐搬到国外以后，我一直很想她。玛雅：我理解。你今晚给她打个电话怎么样？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nimmisja lil oħti minn meta marret tgħix barra.
messages.mt_standard: Nimmisja lil oħti minn meta marret tgħix barra.
messages.zh: 姐姐搬到国外以后，我一直很想她。
messages.en: I miss my sister since she moved abroad.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我理解。你今晚给她打个电话怎么样？
messages.en: I understand. Why don't you call her tonight?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immisja 放进“看着家人的空座位，心里盼着重聚”的场景；本词条记的是情感上的想念，而不是错过一班车。

gloss_zh: 监测；持续观察；跟踪检查

teaching_sense.en_definition: To observe or check something regularly in order to follow its condition or progress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过持续或定期观察、测量和检查，了解某事物的状态、变化或进展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tosserva jew tiċċekkja xi ħaġa regolarment biex issegwi l-kundizzjoni tagħha jew il-progress tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监测某事物的状态或变化；定期检查并跟踪其进展。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Issegwi xi ħaġa permezz ta' osservazzjonijiet, kejl jew kontrolli regolari biex tkun taf kif qed tinbidel jew tiżviluppa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you monitor something, you observe or check it regularly to see how it changes or develops.

formal.mt: It-tim immoniterja l-kwalità tal-ilma kull ġimgħa u rreġistra r-riżultati f'rapport.
formal.en: The team monitored water quality every week and recorded the results in a report.
formal.zh: 团队每周监测水质，并将结果记录在报告中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dak l-iskrin daqshekk spiss? Mark: Qed nimmoniterja t-temperatura tal-kamra biex niżgura li tibqa' stabbli.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you looking at that screen so often? Mark: I'm monitoring the room temperature to make sure it stays stable.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么这么频繁地看那个屏幕？马克：我在监测室温，确保温度保持稳定。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dak l-iskrin daqshekk spiss?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dak l-iskrin daqshekk spiss?
messages.zh: 你为什么这么频繁地看那个屏幕？
messages.en: Why are you looking at that screen so often?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nimmoniterja t-temperatura tal-kamra biex niżgura li tibqa' stabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nimmoniterja t-temperatura tal-kamra biex niżgura li tibqa' stabbli.
messages.zh: 我在监测室温，确保温度保持稳定。
messages.en: I'm monitoring the room temperature to make sure it stays stable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immoniterja 想成每隔一段时间查看温度曲线并记下读数的动作；抓住“反复检查、跟踪变化”，就能记牢监测的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Covered with mould, or having the stale smell associated with damp, poorly aired places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长了霉菌的，或带有潮湿、空气不流通所产生的陈腐霉味的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fuqu kibret il-moffa, jew li għandu riħa ta' moffa minħabba l-umdità jew in-nuqqas ta' arja friska.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发霉的；表面长了霉菌的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li fuqu kibret il-moffa, bħal ikel li tħalla għal żmien twil f'kundizzjonijiet umdi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is mouldy has mould growing on its surface.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有霉味的；带有潮湿、久未通风所产生的陈腐气味的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu riħa magħluqa ta' moffa jew umdità, anki jekk il-moffa ma tkunx tidher.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is musty smells stale and damp, often because it has lacked fresh air.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab ħobż immuffat, li tneħħa minnufih mill-ħażna.
formal.en: During the inspection, mouldy bread was found and immediately removed from storage.
formal.zh: 检查时发现了发霉的面包，并立即将其移出了储藏区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-armarju għandu riħa stramba. Mark: Iva, għandu riħa ta' magħluq; jidher li hu immuffat. Maja: Ejja niftħuh u nħalluh jieħu l-arja.
colloquial.en: Maja: This cupboard smells strange. Mark: Yes, it smells stale; it seems to be musty. Maja: Let's open it and let it air out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个柜子的气味怪怪的。马克：是啊，有股闷了很久的味道，好像有霉味。玛雅：我们把它打开透透气吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个柜子的气味怪怪的。
messages.en: This cupboard smells strange.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu riħa ta' magħluq; jidher li hu immuffat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu riħa ta' magħluq; jidher li hu immuffat.
messages.zh: 是啊，有股闷了很久的味道，好像有霉味。
messages.en: Yes, it smells stale; it seems to be musty.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niftħuh u nħalluh jieħu l-arja.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niftħuh u nħalluh jieħu l-arja.
messages.zh: 我们把它打开透透气吧。
messages.en: Let's open it and let it air out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immuffat 配成两幅记忆画面：面包上看得见霉点，旧柜子里闻得到霉味，分别对应两个义项。

gloss_zh: 作斜切处理的；形成斜面的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing an operation, tool, or finish that forms a sloping face along an edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容沿边缘切削或加工出倾斜面的工序、工具或表面处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi xogħol, għodda jew finitura li tifforma wiċċ immejjel tul tarf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作斜切加工的；将边缘加工成斜面的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaqta' jew jaħdem tarf b'angolu biex joħloq wiċċ immejjel minflok kantuniera dritta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bevelling tool or operation produces a sloping face along the edge of a material.

formal.mt: Id-disinn jispeċifika finitura immullatura tul it-tarf ta' fuq tal-pannell.
formal.en: The design specifies a bevelled-edge finish along the upper edge of the panel.
formal.zh: 设计规定在面板的上边缘作斜面处理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema għodda nuża biex nagħmel dan it-tarf immejjel? Pawlu: Uża l-għodda immullatura; l-ewwel ipprovaha fuq biċċa żejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which tool should I use to make this edge slope? Pawlu: Use the bevelling tool; try it on a spare piece first.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我要把这条边做成斜面，该用哪件工具？保罗：用斜切工具，先拿一块多余的材料试试。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema għodda nuża biex nagħmel dan it-tarf immejjel?
messages.mt_standard: Liema għodda nuża biex nagħmel dan it-tarf immejjel?
messages.zh: 我要把这条边做成斜面，该用哪件工具？
messages.en: Which tool should I use to make this edge slope?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-għodda immullatura; l-ewwel ipprovaha fuq biċċa żejda.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-għodda immullatura; l-ewwel ipprovaha fuq biċċa żejda.
messages.zh: 用斜切工具，先拿一块多余的材料试试。
messages.en: Use the bevelling tool; try it on a spare piece first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 immullatura 时画一个直角，再把角切去一小块；新出现的倾斜小面，就是斜切加工的视觉提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The first-person singular form used to say that I go somewhere, habitually or in a contextually understood future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“我去、我前往”的第一人称单数形式，可描述习惯性行动，也可在适当语境中表示将来的安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-ewwel persuna singular li biha ngħid li jien sejjer f'post, bħala drawwa jew għal ħin fil-futur li jkun ċar mill-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我去；我前往某处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża meta l-kelliem jgħid li hu stess imur f'xi post, regolarment jew f'ħin indikat mill-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this form to say that you go somewhere, either regularly or at a time understood from context.

formal.mt: Kull nhar ta' Tnejn immur il-librerija biex niġbor il-materjal meħtieġ għar-riċerka.
formal.en: Every Monday I go to the library to collect the material needed for the research.
formal.zh: 每周一我都去图书馆收集研究所需的材料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif tmur ix-xogħol? David: Normalment immur bil-mixi, imma meta tagħmel ix-xita naqbad il-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do you get to work? David: I usually go on foot, but when it rains I take the bus.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么去上班？戴维：我通常走路去，不过下雨时会坐公交车。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么去上班？
messages.en: How do you get to work?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Normalment immur bil-mixi, imma meta tagħmel ix-xita naqbad il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Normalment immur bil-mixi, imma meta tagħmel ix-xita naqbad il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 我通常走路去，不过下雨时会坐公交车。
messages.en: I usually go on foot, but when it rains I take the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 immur 当作完整的“我去”来记：指着自己，再指向目的地，练习“我去上班、我步行去”两个句块。

gloss_zh: 变得说不出话；使某人惊得无言

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become unable to speak, or to leave someone unable to respond because of surprise or shock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因惊讶、震惊等而说不出话，或使别人惊得无法开口回应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' bla kliem minħabba sorpriża jew xokk, jew iħalli lil xi ħadd ieħor bla kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得说不出话；因惊讶、震惊等而一时无言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibqa' bla kliem u ma jkunx jista' jitkellem jew iwieġeb għal xi ħin minħabba sorpriża jew xokk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone becomes speechless, surprise or shock leaves them temporarily unable to say anything.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人目瞪口呆；使某人惊讶得说不出话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jissorprendi jew jaħsad lil xi ħadd tant li jħallih bla kliem u bla tweġiba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something dumbfounds someone, it surprises or shocks them so much that they cannot respond.

collocations.zh: 他使所有人都惊得无言

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat mhux mistenni immuta lill-membri tal-kumitat, li għal ftit mumenti baqgħu bla tweġiba.
formal.en: The unexpected result dumbfounded the committee members, who were unable to respond for a few moments.
formal.zh: 出乎意料的结果使委员会成员惊得说不出话，他们一时无法回应。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta ra s-sorpriża? Lara: Immuta għal mument, imbagħad beda jidħak u jirringrazzjana.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Mark react when he saw the surprise? Lara: He was speechless for a moment, then he started laughing and thanking us.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克看到这个惊喜时有什么反应？拉拉：他一时说不出话，接着就笑了起来，还不停地感谢我们。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta ra s-sorpriża?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta ra s-sorpriża?
messages.zh: 马克看到这个惊喜时有什么反应？
messages.en: How did Mark react when he saw the surprise?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Immuta għal mument, imbagħad beda jidħak u jirringrazzjana.
messages.mt_standard: Immuta għal mument, imbagħad beda jidħak u jirringrazzjana.
messages.zh: 他一时说不出话，接着就笑了起来，还不停地感谢我们。
messages.en: He was speechless for a moment, then he started laughing and thanking us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“惊得张口却没声音”的画面记 immuta：自己无言对应不及物义，使别人无言对应及物义。

gloss_zh: 自命不凡、看不起别人的人；势利眼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who considers themselves superior to others and treats them with disdain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为自己比别人优越，并因此轻视别人或不愿与别人来往的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqis lilha nnifisha aqwa mill-oħrajn u tittrattahom b'disprezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自视高人一等、轻视他人的人，尤指因社会地位、财富或品味而看不起别人的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħseb li hija aqwa minn ħaddieħor, speċjalment minħabba l-pożizzjoni soċjali, il-ġid jew il-gosti tagħha, u tħares lejn l-oħrajn b'disprezz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A snob is someone who considers themselves superior to other people, especially because of social position, wealth, or taste.

collocations.zh: 表现得自命不凡、看不起人

collocations.mt: imnaffar li jħares lejn kulħadd minn fuq
collocations.en: a snob who looks down on everyone
collocations.zh: 一个看不起所有人的势利眼

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-imnaffar jirrifjuta li joqgħod mal-mistednin li jqis inferjuri għalih.
formal.en: In the novel, the snob refuses to sit with guests whom he considers inferior to himself.
formal.zh: 在小说中，那个自命不凡的人拒绝与他认为低自己一等的客人同坐。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma riedx joqgħod magħna? Pawlu: Għax hu imnaffar; jaħseb li hu aqwa minn kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why didn't he want to sit with us? Pawlu: Because he's a snob; he thinks he's better than everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：他为什么不愿意和我们坐在一起？保罗：因为他自命不凡，觉得自己比谁都强。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么不愿意和我们坐在一起？
messages.en: Why didn't he want to sit with us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu imnaffar; jaħseb li hu aqwa minn kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu imnaffar; jaħseb li hu aqwa minn kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他自命不凡，觉得自己比谁都强。
messages.en: Because he's a snob; he thinks he's better than everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imnaffar 和聚会上昂着头、看不起别人的人物画面配对记忆；这里指这种人，而不只是描述一种态度。

gloss_zh: 雕刻的；刻有文字或图案的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having letters, designs, or pictures cut into the surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面刻有文字、图案或图像的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandha ittri, disinji jew xbihat maqtugħin fil-wiċċ tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表面以雕刻方式刻有文字、图案或图像的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandha kliem, disinji jew xbihat maqtugħin fil-wiċċ tagħha permezz tat-tinqix.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An engraved object has words, designs, or pictures cut into its surface.

collocations.en: a stone engraved with a name

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi kaxxa tal-injam imnaqxa b'disinji ta' fjuri.
formal.en: The museum displays a wooden box engraved with floral designs.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出一个刻有花卉图案的木盒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara din il-kaxxa! Kemm hi sabiħa! Mark: Iva, hi imnaqxa b'fjuri żgħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at this box! It's so beautiful! Mark: Yes, it's engraved with little flowers.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：看这个盒子！真漂亮！马克：是啊，上面刻着小花。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara din il-kaxxa! Kemm hi sabiħa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara din il-kaxxa! Kemm hi sabiħa!
messages.zh: 看这个盒子！真漂亮！
messages.en: Look at this box! It's so beautiful!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，上面刻着小花。
messages.en: Yes, it's engraved with little flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 imnaqxa 时，想象用指尖摸到木盒表面刻出的花纹；重点是图案刻进表面，而非仅用颜料画上去。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stand or support on which a lamp is placed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于放置或支撑灯具的架子或底座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bażi jew struttura li fuqha titqiegħed lampa biex iżżommha f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承托灯具、使其保持在适当位置的灯架或灯座。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett li jservi ta' bażi jew appoġġ għal lampa u jżommha f'pożizzjoni xierqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lampstand is a support that holds a lamp in position.

collocations.en: put the lamp on the lampstand

formal.mt: L-imnara tal-metall iżżomm il-lampa f'pożizzjoni stabbli fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: The metal lampstand holds the lamp in a stable position on the table.
formal.zh: 金属灯架使灯稳固地立在桌上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inpoġġi din il-lampa? David: Fuq l-imnara ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where should I put this lamp? David: On the lampstand beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这盏灯放在哪里？戴维：放在窗边的灯架上。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 这盏灯放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this lamp?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 放在窗边的灯架上。
messages.en: On the lampstand beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imnara 想成灯下面负责承托的架子：学习时画一盏灯，再圈出支撑部分，并把这个词写在旁边。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loose outer garments worn over the shoulders and body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 披在肩上并覆盖身体的宽松外衣，指多件斗篷或披风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħwejjeġ wesgħin ta' barra li jintlibsu fuq l-ispallejn u jgħattu l-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 披在肩部、覆盖身体的宽松斗篷或披风，通常没有袖子；此处为复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħwejjeġ ta' barra wesgħin, ġeneralment mingħajr kmiem, li jintlibsu fuq l-ispallejn u jgħattu l-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cloaks are loose outer garments, usually without sleeves, that cover the shoulders and body.

formal.mt: Fil-wirja teatrali, l-atturi jilbsu imnatar twal u skuri.
formal.en: In the theatrical performance, the actors wear long, dark cloaks.
formal.zh: 在这场戏剧演出中，演员们穿着深色长斗篷。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn huma l-imnatar għall-atturi? Toni: Fil-gwardarobba; ħu dawk is-suwed għax ix-xena tibda dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are the cloaks for the actors? Toni: In the wardrobe; take the black ones because the scene starts soon.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：演员们的斗篷在哪里？托尼：在衣柜里；拿那些黑色的，这场戏马上就开始了。

messages.speaker: Rita (剧组服装助理)
messages.zh: 演员们的斗篷在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the cloaks for the actors?

messages.speaker: Toni (剧组服装管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-gwardarobba; ħu dawk is-suwed għax ix-xena tibda dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-gwardarobba; ħu dawk is-suwed għax ix-xena tibda dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 在衣柜里；拿那些黑色的，这场戏马上就开始了。
messages.en: In the wardrobe; take the black ones because the scene starts soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 imnatar 时，想象后台挂着一排演员用的长斗篷；用“一排多件”的画面提醒自己，这个词条表达复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The openings of the nose, or the nose itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鼻子供空气进出的开口，也可指鼻子本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fetħiet tal-imnieħer li minnhom tidħol u toħroġ l-arja, jew l-imnieħer innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻孔，或鼻子这一身体部位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fetħiet li minnhom tgħaddi l-arja waqt in-nifs, jew l-imnieħer bħala parti tal-wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This word refers to the nostrils or to the nose itself.

formal.mt: Waqt in-nifs, l-arja tidħol u toħroġ mill-imnifsejja.
formal.en: During breathing, air enters and leaves through the nostrils.
formal.zh: 呼吸时，空气经鼻孔进出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn tidħol l-arja meta nieħdu n-nifs mill-imnieħer? Toni: Mill-imnifsejja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does the air enter when we breathe through the nose? Toni: Through the nostrils.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们用鼻子呼吸时，空气从哪里进去？托尼：从鼻孔进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn tidħol l-arja meta nieħdu n-nifs mill-imnieħer?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn tidħol l-arja meta nieħdu n-nifs mill-imnieħer?
messages.zh: 我们用鼻子呼吸时，空气从哪里进去？
messages.en: Where does the air enter when we breathe through the nose?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 从鼻孔进去。
messages.en: Through the nostrils.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imnifsejja 配在鼻部示意图旁：先指两个鼻孔，再圈整个鼻子，记住本词条涵盖这两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The openings in the nose through which air passes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻部供呼吸时空气进出的开口，即鼻孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fetħiet tal-imnieħer li minnhom tidħol u toħroġ l-arja waqt in-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻孔，即鼻子供空气进出的开口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fetħiet fl-imnieħer li jħallu l-arja tgħaddi 'l ġewwa u 'l barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your nostrils are the openings through which air enters and leaves your nose.

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-imnifsejn u l-passaġġ tal-arja lejn ġewwa l-imnieħer.
formal.en: The diagram shows the nostrils and the passage of air into the nose.
formal.zh: 示意图展示了鼻孔以及空气进入鼻腔的路径。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nikteb 'imnifsejn' fuq din l-istampa? Mark: Ħdejn iż-żewġ fetħiet tal-imnieħer.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I write 'nostrils' on this picture? Mark: Beside the two openings of the nose.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张图上的“鼻孔”应该标在哪里？马克：标在鼻子的两个开口旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这张图上的“鼻孔”应该标在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I write 'nostrils' on this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 标在鼻子的两个开口旁边。
messages.en: Beside the two openings of the nose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 imnifsejn 时，想象鼻子下方两个进出空气的小门；本词条只给出“鼻孔”义，联想应集中在开口处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling or showing sadness and sorrow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到悲伤、忧愁，或在神情与表现中流露出哀伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss jew juri dwejjaq u niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲伤的；显露哀愁或忧伤的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli niket jew li juri dwejjaq fid-dehra jew fl-imġiba tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is doleful feels sad or shows sadness in their expression or behaviour.

formal.mt: Wara li qara l-ittra, Pawlu baqa' sieket u deher imnikket.
formal.en: After reading the letter, Pawlu remained silent and looked sorrowful.
formal.zh: 读完信后，保罗一直沉默着，显得很忧伤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Illum tidher imnikket. Trid titkellem? Pawlu: Iva, irċevejt aħbar ħażina u għandi bżonn nitkellem ma' xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: You look sad today. Do you want to talk? Pawlu: Yes, I received some bad news and need to talk to someone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天看起来很忧伤。想聊聊吗？保罗：想，我收到了坏消息，需要找个人说说。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天看起来很忧伤。想聊聊吗？
messages.en: You look sad today. Do you want to talk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irċevejt aħbar ħażina u għandi bżonn nitkellem ma' xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irċevejt aħbar ħażina u għandi bżonn nitkellem ma' xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 想，我收到了坏消息，需要找个人说说。
messages.en: Yes, I received some bad news and need to talk to someone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imnikket 写在一张垂下嘴角的表情卡上，联想到收到坏消息后沉默、忧伤的神情；这是情境记忆法。

gloss_zh: 善；好的事物（本词条所列名词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goodness or that which is good, as the noun sense assigned in this entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条给出的名词义：善，或好的事物这一概念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġid jew dak li hu tajjeb, skont it-tifsira bħala nom mogħtija f'din l-entrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 善；好的事物。此处按所列名词义理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġid jew dak li hu tajjeb, meqjus bħala kunċett imsemmi b'nom f'din l-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, the noun denotes goodness or that which is good.

collocations.en: the meaning of 'imorru' in this entry

formal.mt: F'din l-entrata, 'imorru' huwa elenkat bħala nom bit-tifsira ta' ġid jew ta' dak li hu tajjeb.
formal.en: In this entry, 'imorru' is listed as a noun meaning goodness or that which is good.
formal.zh: 在本词条中，“imorru”列为名词，意思是善或好的事物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'imorru' f'din l-entrata? Mark: Hawnhekk huwa elenkat bħala nom, bit-tifsira ta' ġid jew ta' dak li hu tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'imorru' mean in this entry? Mark: Here it is listed as a noun meaning goodness or that which is good.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“imorru”在这个词条里是什么意思？马克：这里把它列为名词，意思是善或好的事物。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “imorru”在这个词条里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'imorru' mean in this entry?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk huwa elenkat bħala nom, bit-tifsira ta' ġid jew ta' dak li hu tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk huwa elenkat bħala nom, bit-tifsira ta' ġid jew ta' dak li hu tajjeb.
messages.zh: 这里把它列为名词，意思是善或好的事物。
messages.en: Here it is listed as a noun meaning goodness or that which is good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 imorru 单独制作“本条：名词 Good＝善”的记忆卡，把词形、词性和本条释义一起记住；例句限定在词条讨论中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The effect of something on a person or situation, or the force of one object striking another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事对人或情况产生的影响，或物体碰撞时产生的冲击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-effett li xi ħaġa tħalli fuq persuna jew sitwazzjoni, jew il-forza li tinħoloq meta oġġett jaħbat ma' ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某事造成的影响，或物体相撞时的冲击。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Effett li xi ħaġa jkollha fuq xi ħadd jew fuq xi ħaġa oħra, jew daqqa qawwija li tirriżulta minn ħabta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The impact of something is the effect it has, or the force produced when objects collide.

collocations.zh: 强烈的影响；强烈的冲击

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-impatt tal-proġett fuq l-ambjent u fuq ir-residenti tal-inħawi.
formal.en: The report examines the project's impact on the environment and on local residents.
formal.zh: 报告分析了该项目对环境及当地居民的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-bidla fil-ħinijiet kellha impatt fuqek? Mark: Iva, issa nasal id-dar aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the change in hours affected you? Mark: Yes, I get home later now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：时间调整对你有影响吗？马克：有，我现在回家更晚了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 时间调整对你有影响吗？
messages.en: Has the change in hours affected you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nasal id-dar aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nasal id-dar aktar tard.
messages.zh: 有，我现在回家更晚了。
messages.en: Yes, I get home later now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 impatt 配上石头入水后的涟漪图：碰撞的一下是“冲击”，扩散开的变化是“影响”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A serious promise to do something, or a responsibility that someone agrees to take on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认真作出的承诺，或同意承担的责任与任务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wegħda serja li tagħmel xi ħaġa, jew responsabbiltà li taċċetta li tieħu fuqek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 郑重作出的承诺，或答应承担的事项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wegħda li twettaq xi ħaġa, jew biċċa xogħol jew responsabbiltà li taċċetta li twettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An undertaking or pledge is a serious promise to do something or accept a responsibility.

formal.mt: L-għaqda ħadet impenn li tipprovdi għajnuna lill-familji matul ix-xitwa.
formal.en: The organisation made a commitment to provide assistance to families during the winter.
formal.zh: 该组织承诺在冬季为家庭提供援助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tiġi tgħinna nhar is-Sibt? Pawlu: Iva, nieħu impenn li nkun hemm fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you come and help us on Saturday? Pawlu: Yes, I promise to be there at nine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你星期六能来帮我们吗？保罗：能，我保证九点到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你星期六能来帮我们吗？
messages.en: Can you come and help us on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nieħu impenn li nkun hemm fid-disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nieħu impenn li nkun hemm fid-disgħa.
messages.zh: 能，我保证九点到。
messages.en: Yes, I promise to be there at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 impenn 记成在日历上郑重圈定一项任务：说好要做，就有了需要履行的“承诺”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A commitment by a seller or supplier to apply an agreed price or follow agreed pricing conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 卖方或供应方就执行约定价格或遵守约定定价条件所作的承诺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wegħda minn bejjiegħ jew fornitur li japplika prezz miftiehem jew li jħares kundizzjonijiet miftiehma dwar il-prezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就商品或服务的价格作出的承诺，要求承诺方遵守约定的价格条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Impenn li bih bejjiegħ jew fornitur jaċċetta li jħares ċerti kundizzjonijiet dwar il-prezz ta' prodott jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A price undertaking is a commitment to comply with specified conditions concerning the price charged.

collocations.en: to comply with the price undertaking

formal.mt: Il-fornitur ta impenn fuq il-prezz li skontu l-prezz jibqa' l-istess sal-aħħar tas-sena.
formal.en: The supplier gave a price undertaking under which the price would remain unchanged until the end of the year.
formal.zh: 供应商作出价格承诺，保证价格在年底前保持不变。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-prezz jista' jogħla x-xahar id-dieħel? David: Skont l-impenn fuq il-prezz, għandu jibqa' l-istess sal-aħħar tas-sena.
colloquial.en: Anna: Could the price go up next month? David: Under the price undertaking, it should stay the same until the end of the year.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：下个月价格可能上涨吗？戴维：按照价格承诺，价格应该到年底都保持不变。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 下个月价格可能上涨吗？
messages.en: Could the price go up next month?

messages.speaker: David (销售员)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont l-impenn fuq il-prezz, għandu jibqa' l-istess sal-aħħar tas-sena.
messages.mt_standard: Skont l-impenn fuq il-prezz, għandu jibqa' l-istess sal-aħħar tas-sena.
messages.zh: 按照价格承诺，价格应该到年底都保持不变。
messages.en: Under the price undertaking, it should stay the same until the end of the year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语画成贴在价签上的承诺书：impenn 是承诺，fuq il-prezz 把承诺的内容限定在价格上。

gloss_zh: 机组组合；发电机组启停安排

teaching_sense.en_definition: The scheduling of which electricity-generating units will operate during particular periods to meet demand within operating constraints.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在运行约束下，为满足电力需求而安排各时段哪些发电机组投入运行的调度过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ippjanar ta' liema unitajiet ta' ġenerazzjoni tal-elettriku se jitħaddmu f'perjodi partikolari biex tintlaħaq id-domanda fil-limiti operattivi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电力系统中的机组组合，即确定各发电机组在指定时段开机或停机的运行安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess fl-ippjanar tas-sistema tal-elettriku li jiddetermina liema unitajiet ta' ġenerazzjoni għandhom ikunu mixgħula jew mitfija f'kull perjodu biex tintlaħaq id-domanda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Unit commitment is the process of scheduling generating units to be on or off over specified periods.

formal.mt: L-istudju tal-impenn fuq unità jiddetermina liema unitajiet ta' ġenerazzjoni għandhom jitħaddmu matul kull siegħa tal-jum ta' wara.
formal.en: The unit commitment study determines which generating units should operate during each hour of the following day.
formal.zh: 机组组合研究确定次日每个小时应投入运行的发电机组。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma nixegħlux l-unitajiet kollha għada? Mark: L-ippjanar tal-impenn fuq unità jgħinna nagħżlu liema unitajiet neħtieġu biex nilħqu d-domanda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why don't we switch on all the units tomorrow? Mark: Unit commitment planning helps us choose which units we need to meet demand.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们明天为什么不把所有机组都开起来？马克：机组组合规划能帮助我们选出满足需求所需的机组。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nixegħlux l-unitajiet kollha għada?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nixegħlux l-unitajiet kollha għada?
messages.zh: 我们明天为什么不把所有机组都开起来？
messages.en: Why don't we switch on all the units tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (电力调度工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ippjanar tal-impenn fuq unità jgħinna nagħżlu liema unitajiet neħtieġu biex nilħqu d-domanda.
messages.mt_standard: L-ippjanar tal-impenn fuq unità jgħinna nagħżlu liema unitajiet neħtieġu biex nilħqu d-domanda.
messages.zh: 机组组合规划能帮助我们选出满足需求所需的机组。
messages.en: Unit commitment planning helps us choose which units we need to meet demand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张发电机组值班表：每小时给各机组标上“开”或“停”，用这个画面记住整个术语“机组组合”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An emperor is a ruler who governs an empire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 统治一个帝国的君主，称为皇帝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imperatur huwa ħakkiem li jmexxi imperu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皇帝；统治帝国的君主。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imperatur huwa l-ħakkiem ta' imperu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An emperor is a monarch who rules an empire.

formal.mt: Fit-test, l-imperatur jordna li jinbena palazz ġdid fil-belt kapitali.
formal.en: In the text, the emperor orders a new palace to be built in the capital city.
formal.zh: 文中，皇帝下令在首都建造一座新宫殿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dan fir-ritratt? Mark: Huwa l-imperatur tal-istorja li qed naqraw.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is this in the picture? Mark: He is the emperor in the story we are reading.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片里这人是谁？马克：他是我们正在读的故事里的皇帝。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 图片里这人是谁？
messages.en: Who is this in the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-imperatur tal-istorja li qed naqraw.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-imperatur tal-istorja li qed naqraw.
messages.zh: 他是我们正在读的故事里的皇帝。
messages.en: He is the emperor in the story we are reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imperatur 配上戴皇冠的人物图来记：这个词指统治帝国的“皇帝本人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone or something impertinent shows a rude lack of respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人、言语或行为缺乏应有的尊重，显得无礼或唐突。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna, kelma jew imġiba impertinenti turi nuqqas ta' rispett u ta' edukazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无礼的；言行唐突、不尊重他人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa impertinenti juri nuqqas ta' rispett lejn ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is impertinent, they speak or behave without proper respect.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, il-president talab lill-parteċipanti jevitaw kummenti impertinenti.
formal.en: During the meeting, the chair asked participants to avoid impertinent comments.
formal.zh: 会议期间，主席要求与会者避免发表无礼的评论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tweġiba tiegħi kienet impertinenti? Lara: Iva, ftit. Ipprova wieġeb b'aktar rispett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was my reply impertinent? Lara: Yes, a little. Try to answer more respectfully.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的回答很无礼吗？拉拉：是的，有一点。试着回答得更尊重别人一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的回答很无礼吗？
messages.en: Was my reply impertinent?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit. Ipprova wieġeb b'aktar rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit. Ipprova wieġeb b'aktar rispett.
messages.zh: 是的，有一点。试着回答得更尊重别人一些。
messages.en: Yes, a little. Try to answer more respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人用冒犯的口气提问，把 impertinenti 和“说话欠尊重、态度很无礼”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An empire is a group of countries or territories governed by one ruler or central power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由同一君主或中央权力统治多个国家或地区而形成的帝国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imperu huwa grupp ta' pajjiżi jew territorji taħt it-tmexxija ta' ħakkiem wieħed jew ta' poter ċentrali wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帝国；多个国家或地区受同一最高权力统治的政治实体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imperu huwa entità politika li tinkludi diversi pajjiżi jew territorji mmexxija minn awtorità waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An empire consists of several countries or territories controlled by one ruling authority.

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi kif l-imperu kien maqsum f'diversi provinċji.
formal.en: The chapter describes how the empire was divided into several provinces.
formal.zh: 这一章描述了该帝国如何划分为多个行省。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-mappa turi l-imperu kollu? Maja: Iva, u hawn tinsab il-kapitali tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this map show the whole empire? Maja: Yes, and its capital is here.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张地图展示了整个帝国吗？玛雅：是的，它的首都就在这里。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 这张地图展示了整个帝国吗？
messages.en: Does this map show the whole empire?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u hawn tinsab il-kapitali tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u hawn tinsab il-kapitali tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，它的首都就在这里。
messages.en: Yes, and its capital is here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用地图记 imperu：把同一统治权下的大片地区圈起来，就是“帝国”；再配人物词 imperatur 区分记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning has not been established for this exercise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本练习中尚未确定具体词义的名词，暂不赋予实义释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu għadha mhix stabbilita għal dan l-eżerċizzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未确定；此处暂不提供具体语义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom għadha mhix determinata f'dan l-eżerċizzju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this noun remains undetermined in this exercise.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'impika' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira tagħha għadha trid tiġi ċċarata.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'impika' is listed as a noun, but its meaning still needs to be clarified.
formal.zh: 本练习将“impika”列为名词，但其含义仍待明确。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'impika' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Għadna ma nafux. Għalissa nżommuha mingħajr tifsira speċifika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'impika' mean in this exercise? Mark: We do not know yet. For now, we will leave it without a specific meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里的“impika”是什么意思？马克：我们还不知道。暂时先不给它指定具体含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“impika”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'impika' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna ma nafux. Għalissa nżommuha mingħajr tifsira speċifika.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna ma nafux. Għalissa nżommuha mingħajr tifsira speċifika.
messages.zh: 我们还不知道。暂时先不给它指定具体含义。
messages.en: We do not know yet. For now, we will leave it without a specific meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 impika 写在待查词卡上，旁边标注“名词，词义待定”；先记词形，避免把猜测当成释义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An installation of equipment, or an industrial plant, used for a particular process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为特定工艺或作业安装的一套设备，也可指使用这些设备进行工业生产或处理的厂站。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett ta' magni u tagħmir installati għal proċess partikolari, jew il-post industrijali fejn isir dan il-proċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为特定用途安装并配套使用的设备装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' tagħmir imqiegħed u mqabbad f'post biex jaqdi funzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An installation is a set of equipment fitted in a place for a particular purpose.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用机器设备进行工业生产或处理作业的工厂或厂站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post industrijali mgħammar b'magni u tagħmir fejn isiru prodotti jew jiġu pproċessati materjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An industrial plant is a place where machinery is used to manufacture products or process materials.

formal.mt: L-impjant tat-trattament tal-ilma għandu jiġi spezzjonat regolarment biex jiġi żgurat li jaħdem sew.
formal.en: The water treatment plant must be inspected regularly to ensure that it operates properly.
formal.zh: 水处理厂必须接受定期检查，以确保正常运行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hawn daqshekk sħana fl-uffiċċju? Mark: L-impjant tal-arja kkundizzjonata mhux qed jaħdem illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is it so hot in the office? Mark: The air-conditioning installation isn't working today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：办公室里怎么这么热？Mark：今天空调系统不工作了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 办公室里怎么这么热？
messages.en: Why is it so hot in the office?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-impjant tal-arja kkundizzjonata mhux qed jaħdem illum.
messages.mt_standard: L-impjant tal-arja kkundizzjonata mhux qed jaħdem illum.
messages.zh: 今天空调系统不工作了。
messages.en: The air-conditioning installation isn't working today.
