cognitive_memory_aid: 把 impjant 联想成一整套正在运转的机器：装在楼里是设备系统，用于工业生产或处理则是厂站。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone paid work in a business or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聘请某人为企业或机构工作，并向其支付报酬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta xogħol bi ħlas lil persuna f'negozju jew f'organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雇用某人，让其从事有报酬的工作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ta impjieg lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel xogħol bi ħlas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a person or organization employs someone, they give that person paid work.

formal.mt: Is-sid impjega żewġ tekniċi ġodda biex jieħdu ħsieb il-manutenzjoni tat-tagħmir.
formal.en: The owner employed two new technicians to maintain the equipment.
formal.zh: 业主聘用了两名新技术员，负责设备维护。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sid il-ħanut sab lil xi ħadd biex jgħinu? Mark: Iva, impjega assistent il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the shop owner found someone to help him? Mark: Yes, he employed an assistant last week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：店主找到帮手了吗？Mark：找到了，他上周聘用了一名助理。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sid il-ħanut sab lil xi ħadd biex jgħinu?
messages.mt_standard: Sid il-ħanut sab lil xi ħadd biex jgħinu?
messages.zh: 店主找到帮手了吗？
messages.en: Has the shop owner found someone to help him?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, impjega assistent il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, impjega assistent il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 找到了，他上周聘用了一名助理。
messages.en: Yes, he employed an assistant last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“老板付薪请人来工作”的画面记住 impjega；例句里老板做出的动作就是“雇用了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person paid to work for an employer, including someone who handles routine office or service tasks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受雇并领取报酬的工作人员，也可具体指处理日常文书或服务事务的办事员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem għal min iħaddimha u titħallas, inkluż min jieħu ħsieb xogħol ta' uffiċċju jew servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受雇于某个雇主并领取工资的雇员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem għal persuna oħra jew għal organizzazzjoni u tirċievi paga għax-xogħol tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An employee is someone who is paid to work for another person or an organization.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责文书、记录或柜台等日常事务的办事员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel xogħol ta' uffiċċju jew ta' servizz, bħal iżżomm rekords, timla dokumenti jew taqdi lin-nies mal-bank.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clerk is someone whose work involves routine office duties or helping customers at a service counter.

formal.mt: Kull impjegat għandu jirċievi taħriġ dwar il-proċeduri tas-sigurtà qabel jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: Every employee must receive training in safety procedures before starting work.
formal.zh: 每位员工在开始工作前都必须接受安全操作程序培训。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jgħinni nimla din il-formola? Mark: Staqsi lill-impjegat tal-bank; hu jispjegalek x'għandek tagħmel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can help me fill in this form? Mark: Ask the bank clerk; he'll explain what you need to do.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁能帮我填这张表？Mark：问问银行办事员吧，他会告诉你该怎么做。

messages.speaker: Maja (银行顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jgħinni nimla din il-formola?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jgħinni nimla din il-formola?
messages.zh: 谁能帮我填这张表？
messages.en: Who can help me fill in this form?

messages.speaker: Mark (陪同的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lill-impjegat tal-bank; hu jispjegalek x'għandek tagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lill-impjegat tal-bank; hu jispjegalek x'għandek tagħmel.
messages.zh: 问问银行办事员吧，他会告诉你该怎么做。
messages.en: Ask the bank clerk; he'll explain what you need to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 impjegat 记成戴着工作证的人：谈雇佣关系时是“雇员”，在银行或办公室办事时可译为“办事员”。

gloss_zh: 日程安排；已安排的事务

teaching_sense.en_definition: The commitments and activities that make up someone's schedule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成某人日程的各项已安排事务，如工作、会议或约定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attivitajiet, il-laqgħat u d-dmirijiet li persuna għandha ppjanati għal żmien partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某段时间内已安排的各项活动或事务所构成的日程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġabra ta' attivitajiet u obbligi li persuna għandha tagħmel f'ħinijiet jew ġranet partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your schedule consists of the activities and commitments arranged for particular times or days.

formal.mt: L-impjeni ta' din il-ġimgħa jinkludu żewġ laqgħat mal-klijenti u sessjoni ta' taħriġ.
formal.en: This week's schedule includes two meetings with clients and a training session.
formal.zh: 本周的日程包括两次客户会议和一次培训。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ħin għal kafè għada? Mark: Filgħodu għandi ħafna impjeni, imma wara t-tlieta nkun liberu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have time for coffee tomorrow? Mark: I have lots of commitments in the morning, but I'll be free after three.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明天有空喝杯咖啡吗？Mark：我上午安排了很多事，不过三点以后有空。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天有空喝杯咖啡吗？
messages.en: Do you have time for coffee tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Filgħodu għandi ħafna impjeni, imma wara t-tlieta nkun liberu.
messages.mt_standard: Filgħodu għandi ħafna impjeni, imma wara t-tlieta nkun liberu.
messages.zh: 我上午安排了很多事，不过三点以后有空。
messages.en: I have lots of commitments in the morning, but I'll be free after three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上填好的会议、工作和约定：这些一项项排好的事务就是 impjeni，合起来构成你的日程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Understood from words, actions, or context without being directly stated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有直接说出，但可以从言语、行为或上下文中理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinftiehem mill-kliem, mill-imġiba jew mill-kuntest mingħajr ma jingħad b'mod dirett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐含于表达或情境之中，而非明确说出的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jingħadx espressament, iżda jinftiehem minn dak li jingħad jew miċ-ċirkostanzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is implicit is understood from the situation even though nobody states it directly.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħarsiet bejn il-karattri jwasslu messaġġ implicit ta' fiduċja.
formal.en: In the story, the glances between the characters convey an implicit message of trust.
formal.zh: 在故事中，人物之间的眼神交流传达了信任这一隐含的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qalet li għada għandha ħafna xogħol, iżda ma qaletx direttament li ma tiġix. Lara: Jidher li kien rifjut implicit tal-istedina.
colloquial.en: Maja: She said she has a lot of work tomorrow, but she didn't directly say she wasn't coming. Lara: It seems that was an implicit refusal of the invitation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：她说她明天有很多工作，但没有直接说不来。拉拉：看来那是在含蓄地拒绝邀请。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalet li għada għandha ħafna xogħol, iżda ma qaletx direttament li ma tiġix.
messages.mt_standard: Qalet li għada għandha ħafna xogħol, iżda ma qaletx direttament li ma tiġix.
messages.zh: 她说她明天有很多工作，但没有直接说不来。
messages.en: She said she has a lot of work tomorrow, but she didn't directly say she wasn't coming.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher li kien rifjut implicit tal-istedina.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher li kien rifjut implicit tal-istedina.
messages.zh: 看来那是在含蓄地拒绝邀请。
messages.en: It seems that was an implicit refusal of the invitation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 implicit 联想成“话没说满，意思已到”：练习从上下文找出未明说的信息。

gloss_zh: 被牵涉的；被指与某事有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Linked to involvement in an incident or wrongdoing, especially by evidence or an allegation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因证据或指控而被认为与某事件有关的，尤指牵涉不当行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun hemm provi jew allegazzjonijiet li jorbtu lilu ma' każ jew ma' xi għemil ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被证据或指控牵涉其中的，尤指被认为与不当行为有关。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun marbut ma' każ jew ma' għemil ħażin permezz ta' provi jew allegazzjonijiet dwar l-involviment tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is implicated is linked by evidence or allegations to an incident, often involving wrongdoing.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport isemmi uffiċjal implikat fil-każ, iżda ma jistabbilixxix li wettaq reat.
formal.en: The report mentions an official implicated in the case, but does not establish that he committed a crime.
formal.zh: 报告提到一名被牵涉进该案件的官员，但并未认定他实施了犯罪。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qrajt li Pawlu hu implikat fl-iskandlu. Nina: Iva, imma għadna ma nafux eżatt x'kien ir-rwol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: I read that Pawlu is implicated in the scandal. Nina: Yes, but we still don't know exactly what his role was.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我读到保罗被牵涉进那起丑闻了。妮娜：是啊，但我们还不知道他具体起了什么作用。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt li Pawlu hu implikat fl-iskandlu.
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt li Pawlu hu implikat fl-iskandlu.
messages.zh: 我读到保罗被牵涉进那起丑闻了。
messages.en: I read that Pawlu is implicated in the scandal.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadna ma nafux eżatt x'kien ir-rwol tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadna ma nafux eżatt x'kien ir-rwol tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，但我们还不知道他具体起了什么作用。
messages.en: Yes, but we still don't know exactly what his role was.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 implikat 放进“某人被一条线连到事件”的画面中记忆：表示受到牵涉，本身不等于已经定罪。

gloss_zh: 雄伟的；气势宏大的；令人赞叹的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Commanding attention or admiration through size, appearance, strength, or achievement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因体量、外观、力量或成就而引人注目、使人敬畏或赞叹的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġbed l-attenzjoni jew iqanqal ammirazzjoni minħabba l-kobor, id-dehra, is-saħħa jew il-kisbiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因体量庞大、外观庄严或气势强大而使人敬畏的；雄伟的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jolqot lil min jarah bil-kobor, bid-dehra maestuża jew bil-preżenza qawwija tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is imposing commands attention because of its large size, grand appearance, or powerful presence.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因出色的品质、表现或成就而令人赞叹、留下深刻印象的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħalli impressjoni qawwija u jqanqal ammirazzjoni minħabba l-kwalità, il-ħila jew ir-riżultat tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is impressive makes you admire its quality, skill, or achievement.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jinsab f'bini imponenti, u l-wirja tiegħu tippreżenta ġabra imponenti ta' xogħlijiet tal-arti.
formal.en: The museum occupies an imposing building, and its exhibition presents an impressive collection of works of art.
formal.zh: 博物馆坐落在一座雄伟的建筑内，其展览呈现了一批令人赞叹的艺术作品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt kemm hu kbir dak il-palazz? Luca: Iva, tassew imponenti! U l-ġabra tal-pitturi ġewwa fih hi imponenti wkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see how big that palace is? Luca: Yes, it's really imposing! And the collection of paintings inside is impressive too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到那座宫殿有多大了吗？卢卡：看到了，真雄伟！里面的绘画收藏也很令人赞叹。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kemm hu kbir dak il-palazz?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kemm hu kbir dak il-palazz?
messages.zh: 你看到那座宫殿有多大了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how big that palace is?

messages.speaker: Luca (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tassew imponenti! U l-ġabra tal-pitturi ġewwa fih hi imponenti wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tassew imponenti! U l-ġabra tal-pitturi ġewwa fih hi imponenti wkoll.
messages.zh: 看到了，真雄伟！里面的绘画收藏也很令人赞叹。
messages.en: Yes, it's really imposing! And the collection of paintings inside is impressive too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 imponenti：仰头看宫殿是“雄伟”，看完精彩表演鼓掌是“令人赞叹”。

gloss_zh: 非常重要的；极其重要的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having very great significance or a very strong effect on a situation or result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有重大意义，或对某种情况、结果有很大影响的；极其重要的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu importanza kbira ħafna jew li jista' jaffettwa bil-kbir sitwazzjoni jew riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常重要的；具有重大意义或影响的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu valur jew sinifikat kbir ħafna u jistħoqqlu attenzjoni kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is very important matters a great deal because of its significance or possible effects.

formal.mt: It-taħriġ tal-għalliema għandu rwol importantissimu fit-titjib tal-kwalità tat-tagħlim.
formal.en: Teacher training plays a very important role in improving the quality of teaching.
formal.zh: 教师培训对提高教学质量起着极其重要的作用。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Għandi nġib il-passaport miegħi għada? Emma: Iva, importantissimu li ġġibu! Għandek bżonnu għall-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Daniel: Should I bring my passport with me tomorrow? Emma: Yes, it's very important that you bring it! You need it for the trip.
colloquial.zh: 丹尼尔：我明天要带上护照吗？埃玛：要，带上它非常重要！这次旅行要用到。

messages.speaker: Daniel (旅伴)
messages.zh: 我明天要带上护照吗？
messages.en: Should I bring my passport with me tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Emma (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, importantissimu li ġġibu! Għandek bżonnu għall-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, importantissimu li ġġibu! Għandek bżonnu għall-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 要，带上它非常重要！这次旅行要用到。
messages.en: Yes, it's very important that you bring it! You need it for the trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 importantissimu 写在出行清单的“护照”旁，再画三个感叹号，记住它强调“非常重要”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being significant or having a strong effect on a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物值得重视或能够对情况产生较大影响的性质或程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li xi ħaġa għandha valur, jistħoqqilha attenzjoni jew tista' tħalli effett qawwi fuq sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重要性，指某人或某事值得重视、具有意义或影响的程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-grad ta' valur, sinifikat jew influwenza li għandu persuna, fatt jew ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The importance of something is the degree to which it matters or affects a situation.

collocations.zh: 非常重要的；具有重大意义的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-importanza ta' komunikazzjoni ċara bejn l-għalliema u l-ġenituri.
formal.en: The report emphasises the importance of clear communication between teachers and parents.
formal.zh: 报告强调教师与家长之间清晰沟通的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tiċċekkja l-ħin mill-ġdid? Pawlu: Għax nagħti importanza lill-puntwalità u ma rridx nasal tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you checking the time again? Pawlu: Because punctuality matters to me, and I don't want to arrive late.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么又在看时间？Pawlu：因为我很重视守时，不想迟到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么又在看时间？
messages.en: Why are you checking the time again?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nagħti importanza lill-puntwalità u ma rridx nasal tard.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nagħti importanza lill-puntwalità u ma rridx nasal tard.
messages.zh: 因为我很重视守时，不想迟到。
messages.en: Because punctuality matters to me, and I don't want to arrive late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 importanza 与“重要性”配对记忆；整块记住 nagħti importanza lil，意思是“我重视……”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The importation of goods before a specified time, stage, or related event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在指定时间、阶段或相关事件之前进行的货物进口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dħul ta' merkanzija minn pajjiż ieħor qabel żmien, stadju jew avveniment relatat li jkun ġie speċifikat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先进口，指相对于某个指定时间、阶段或相关事件而言提前进行的进口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Importazzjoni ta' merkanzija li ssir qabel iż-żmien, l-istadju jew l-avveniment li jservi bħala punt ta' riferiment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Prior importation occurs when goods are imported before a specified time or related event.

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipprevedi l-importazzjoni antiċipata tal-materja prima qabel il-bidu tal-produzzjoni.
formal.en: The plan provides for the prior importation of raw materials before production begins.
formal.zh: 该计划安排在生产开始之前预先进口原材料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex se nġibu l-materjal minn barra daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Qed nippjanaw importazzjoni antiċipata biex il-materjal ikun hawn qabel tibda l-produzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we bringing in the materials from abroad so early? Mark: We're planning prior importation so the materials will be here before production starts.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们为什么这么早就从国外运进材料？Mark：我们计划提前进口，好让材料在开工前就到位。

messages.speaker: Lara (生产主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex se nġibu l-materjal minn barra daqshekk kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex se nġibu l-materjal minn barra daqshekk kmieni?
messages.zh: 我们为什么这么早就从国外运进材料？
messages.en: Why are we bringing in the materials from abroad so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nippjanaw importazzjoni antiċipata biex il-materjal ikun hawn qabel tibda l-produzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nippjanaw importazzjoni antiċipata biex il-materjal ikun hawn qabel tibda l-produzzjoni.
messages.zh: 我们计划提前进口，好让材料在开工前就到位。
messages.en: We're planning prior importation so the materials will be here before production starts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先进口，后到指定环节”的时间顺序记住整组词：importazzjoni 是进口，antiċipata 提示提前。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Imported goods sold at prices below their normal value in the exporting country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以低于出口国正常价值的价格出售的进口货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti importati li jinbiegħu bi prezzijiet aktar baxxi mill-valur normali tagħhom fil-pajjiż esportatur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以低于出口国正常价值的价格出售的进口货物；倾销进口货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jiġu importati u jinbiegħu bi prezzijiet aktar baxxi mill-valur normali tagħhom fil-pajjiż minn fejn jiġu esportati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dumped imports are goods brought into a country and sold at prices below their normal value in the exporting country.

collocations.mt: investigazzjoni dwar importazzjoni oġġett ta' dumping
collocations.zh: 针对倾销进口货物的调查

collocations.mt: miżuri kontra importazzjoni oġġett ta' dumping
collocations.zh: 针对倾销进口货物的措施

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-importazzjoni oġġett ta' dumping u l-effett tagħha fuq il-produtturi lokali.
formal.en: The report analyses dumped imports and their effect on local producers.
formal.zh: 该报告分析了倾销进口货物及其对本地生产商的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'importazzjoni oġġett ta' dumping' f'dan ir-rapport? Pawlu: Tfisser oġġetti importati li jinbiegħu bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħhom fil-pajjiż esportatur.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'dumped imports' mean in this report? Pawlu: It means imported goods sold at a price below their normal value in the exporting country.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份报告中的“倾销进口货物”是什么意思？保罗：指以低于出口国正常价值的价格出售的进口货物。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'importazzjoni oġġett ta' dumping' f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'importazzjoni oġġett ta' dumping' f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 这份报告中的“倾销进口货物”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'dumped imports' mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser oġġetti importati li jinbiegħu bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħhom fil-pajjiż esportatur.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser oġġetti importati li jinbiegħu bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħhom fil-pajjiż esportatur.
messages.zh: 指以低于出口国正常价值的价格出售的进口货物。
messages.en: It means imported goods sold at a price below their normal value in the exporting country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成一箱进口商品，标签写着“价格低于出口国正常价值”，帮助记住倾销进口货物这一含义。

gloss_zh: 多次进口；各项进口；进口货物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Acts of bringing goods into a country from abroad, or the goods brought in.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从国外将货物输入本国的多次或各项进口活动，也可指输入的货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-atti ta' dħul ta' merkanzija f'pajjiż minn barra, jew il-merkanzija li tidħol b'dan il-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多次或各项进口活动，侧重将货物从国外输入的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Atti jew operazzjonijiet li bihom tiddaħħal merkanzija f'pajjiż minn pajjiż ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Importations are separate acts or operations of bringing goods into a country from abroad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口货物；也可统指一个国家从国外输入的货物及其数量或价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prodotti u l-merkanzija li pajjiż idaħħal minn barra, meqjusa waħda waħda jew flimkien skont il-kwantità jew il-valur tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A country's imports are the goods it brings in from other countries.

collocations.zh: 进口额；进口货物的价值

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel il-valur tal-importazzjonijiet ta' din is-sena ma' dak tas-sena li għaddiet.
formal.en: The report compares the value of this year's imports with that of last year's imports.
formal.zh: 报告将今年的进口额与去年的进口额作比较。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dawn il-prodotti kollha ġejjin minn barra? Toni: Iva, huma importazzjonijiet; dawk fuq l-ixkaffa l-oħra huma prodotti lokali.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do all these products come from abroad? Toni: Yes, they're imports; the ones on the other shelf are local products.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些产品全都来自国外吗？Toni：是的，都是进口货；另一个货架上的是本地产品。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-prodotti kollha ġejjin minn barra?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-prodotti kollha ġejjin minn barra?
messages.zh: 这些产品全都来自国外吗？
messages.en: Do all these products come from abroad?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma importazzjonijiet; dawk fuq l-ixkaffa l-oħra huma prodotti lokali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma importazzjonijiet; dawk fuq l-ixkaffa l-oħra huma prodotti lokali.
messages.zh: 是的，都是进口货；另一个货架上的是本地产品。
messages.en: Yes, they're imports; the ones on the other shelf are local products.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象多批货物进入港口：既能数“几次进口”，也能看“哪些进口货”，帮助区分行为义与货物义。

exact_key: importazzjonijiet li jkunu s-suġġett ta' dumping jew ta' sussidji
gloss_zh: 倾销或受补贴的进口货物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Imported goods sold below their normal value or benefiting from subsidies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以低于正常价值的价格出售，或获得补贴支持的进口货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Merkanzija importata li tinbiegħ bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħha jew li tibbenefika minn sussidji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾销或受补贴的进口货物，即以低于正常价值的价格出售或获得补贴支持的进口产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodotti li jidħlu f'pajjiż minn barra u li jinbiegħu bi prezz taħt il-valur normali tagħhom jew li jibbenefikaw minn għajnuna fil-forma ta' sussidji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dumped or subsidised imports are imported goods sold below their normal value or supported by subsidies.

collocations.mt: investigazzjoni dwar importazzjonijiet li jkunu s-suġġett ta' dumping jew ta' sussidji
collocations.en: an investigation into dumped or subsidised imports
collocations.zh: 针对倾销或受补贴进口货物的调查

collocations.mt: l-effett tal-importazzjonijiet li jkunu s-suġġett ta' dumping jew ta' sussidji
collocations.en: the effect of dumped or subsidised imports
collocations.zh: 倾销或受补贴进口货物的影响

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-effett tal-importazzjonijiet li jkunu s-suġġett ta' dumping jew ta' sussidji fuq il-produtturi lokali.
formal.en: The study examines the effect of dumped or subsidised imports on local producers.
formal.zh: 该研究考察倾销或受补贴的进口货物对本地生产商的影响。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ifisser hawn 'importazzjonijiet li jkunu s-suġġett ta' dumping jew ta' sussidji'? David: Jiġifieri prodotti importati li jinbiegħu taħt il-valur normali tagħhom jew li jirċievu sussidji.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'dumped or subsidised imports' mean here? David: It means imported products sold below their normal value or receiving subsidies.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里的“倾销或受补贴的进口货物”是什么意思？David：就是以低于正常价值的价格出售，或者获得补贴的进口产品。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser hawn 'importazzjonijiet li jkunu s-suġġett ta' dumping jew ta' sussidji'?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser hawn 'importazzjonijiet li jkunu s-suġġett ta' dumping jew ta' sussidji'?
messages.zh: 这里的“倾销或受补贴的进口货物”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'dumped or subsidised imports' mean here?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri prodotti importati li jinbiegħu taħt il-valur normali tagħhom jew li jirċievu sussidji.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri prodotti importati li jinbiegħu taħt il-valur normali tagħhom jew li jirċievu sussidji.
messages.zh: 就是以低于正常价值的价格出售，或者获得补贴的进口产品。
messages.en: It means imported products sold below their normal value or receiving subsidies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三块记：importazzjonijiet 是进口货物，dumping 是倾销，sussidji 是补贴；jew 表示“或”，连接两种情况。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To send a letter, document, or parcel through the postal service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过邮政服务寄送信件、文件或包裹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibgħat ittra, dokument jew pakkett permezz tas-servizz postali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过邮政系统寄送信件或包裹。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tibgħat ittra jew pakkett lil xi ħadd permezz tas-servizz postali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you mail a letter or parcel, you send it to someone through the postal service.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投寄信件或包裹，将其交由邮政系统寄送。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tpoġġi ittra f'kaxxa tal-ittri jew tħalli ittra jew pakkett fl-uffiċċju postali biex jintbagħtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you post a letter or parcel, you put it in a postbox or hand it over at a post office to be sent.

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jimposta l-formola mimlija sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The applicant must mail the completed form by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 申请人必须在月底前寄出填好的表格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se timposta l-ittra llum? Mark: Iva, se nimpostaha wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to post the letter today? Mark: Yes, I'll post it after work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天会把信寄出去吗？马克：会，我下班后寄。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天会把信寄出去吗？
messages.en: Are you going to post the letter today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，我下班后寄。
messages.en: Yes, I'll post it after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imposta 和“贴邮票、投信箱”的动作连在一起记；本条的两个英语义项都表示邮寄。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A charge on goods crossing a border that has an effect equivalent to a customs duty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对跨境货物征收、具有与关税同等效力的费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas impost fuq oġġetti li jaqsmu fruntiera u li jkollu effett ekwivalenti għal dazju doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有与关税同等效力的收费，指因货物跨境而征收、效果相当于关税的费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas li jintalab minħabba li oġġetti jaqsmu fruntiera u li jkollu effett ekwivalenti għal dak ta' dazju doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A charge having equivalent effect is a payment imposed on goods crossing a border that has an effect equivalent to a customs duty.

collocations.en: the imposition of a charge having equivalent effect
collocations.zh: 征收具有同等效力的费用

collocations.en: the removal of a charge having equivalent effect
collocations.zh: 取消具有同等效力的收费

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina jekk il-ħlas fuq l-oġġetti importati jikkostitwixxix imposta b'effett ekwivalenti għal dazju doganali.
formal.en: The study examines whether the payment on imported goods constitutes a charge having equivalent effect to a customs duty.
formal.zh: 该研究考察对进口货物收取的费用是否构成具有与关税同等效力的收费。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi imposta b'effett ekwivalenti? Mark: Hija ħlas fuq oġġetti li jaqsmu fruntiera, b'effett bħal dak ta' dazju doganali.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is a charge having equivalent effect? Mark: It's a charge on goods crossing a border, with an effect like that of a customs duty.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么是具有同等效力的收费？马克：就是对跨境货物收取、效果类似关税的费用。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是具有同等效力的收费？
messages.en: What is a charge having equivalent effect?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija ħlas fuq oġġetti li jaqsmu fruntiera, b'effett bħal dak ta' dazju doganali.
messages.mt_standard: Hija ħlas fuq oġġetti li jaqsmu fruntiera, b'effett bħal dak ta' dazju doganali.
messages.zh: 就是对跨境货物收取、效果类似关税的费用。
messages.en: It's a charge on goods crossing a border, with an effect like that of a customs duty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货物过关时多付一笔钱，再把“效力相当于关税”写在旁边，记住整个短语的核心是同等效力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A levy intended to compensate copyright holders for private copying of their works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为补偿著作权人的作品被私人复制而征收的费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas impost biex jikkumpensa lid-detenturi tad-drittijiet tal-awtur għall-ikkopjar privat tax-xogħlijiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 私人复制补偿费，即为补偿著作权人的作品被私人复制而征收的费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas maħsub biex jagħti kumpens lid-detenturi tad-drittijiet tal-awtur meta jsiru kopji tax-xogħlijiet tagħhom għall-użu privat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A private copy levy is a charge intended to compensate copyright holders when copies of their works are made for private use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 私人复制补偿费，指针对作品的私人复制而设置、用于补偿著作权人的征费。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imposta marbuta mal-ikkopjar ta' xogħlijiet għall-użu privat, li għandha l-għan li tikkumpensa lid-detenturi tad-drittijiet tal-awtur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A private copying levy is a charge associated with copying works for personal use and intended to provide compensation to copyright holders.

collocations.en: the collection of the private copying levy
collocations.zh: 私人复制补偿费的征收

collocations.en: the rate of the private copying levy
collocations.zh: 私人复制补偿费的费率

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif l-imposta għall-ikkopjar privat tintuża biex jingħata kumpens lid-detenturi tad-drittijiet tal-awtur.
formal.en: The report explains how the private copying levy is used to provide compensation to copyright holders.
formal.zh: 该报告说明了私人复制补偿费如何用于向著作权人提供补偿。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għal xiex tintuża l-imposta għall-ikkopjar privat? Pawlu: Biex jingħata kumpens lid-detenturi tad-drittijiet tal-awtur meta jsiru kopji tax-xogħlijiet tagħhom għall-użu privat.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is the private copying levy used for? Pawlu: To compensate copyright holders when copies of their works are made for private use.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：私人复制补偿费用来做什么？保罗：当作品被复制供私人使用时，用来向著作权人提供补偿。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex tintuża l-imposta għall-ikkopjar privat?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex tintuża l-imposta għall-ikkopjar privat?
messages.zh: 私人复制补偿费用来做什么？
messages.en: What is the private copying levy used for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jingħata kumpens lid-detenturi tad-drittijiet tal-awtur meta jsiru kopji tax-xogħlijiet tagħhom għall-użu privat.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jingħata kumpens lid-detenturi tad-drittijiet tal-awtur meta jsiru kopji tax-xogħlijiet tagħhom għall-użu privat.
messages.zh: 当作品被复制供私人使用时，用来向著作权人提供补偿。
messages.en: To compensate copyright holders when copies of their works are made for private use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“私人使用时复制作品，再向权利人提供补偿”的场景记忆；把私人、复制、补偿费三个意思串起来。

gloss_zh: 金钱征费；以金钱缴纳的费用

teaching_sense.en_definition: A charge imposed on someone that must be paid in money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人征收、须以金钱缴纳的费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas impost fuq persuna li jrid jitħallas fi flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以金钱形式征收或缴纳的费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus li persuna tkun obbligata tħallas bħala ħlas impost fuqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pecuniary charge is an amount of money that someone is required to pay.

formal.mt: L-avviż jindika l-ammont tal-imposta monetarja u d-data sa meta għandha titħallas.
formal.en: The notice states the amount of the pecuniary charge and the deadline for payment.
formal.zh: 通知列明了这笔征费的金额及缴纳期限。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din l-imposta monetarja rrid inħallasha llum? Mark: Le, għandek sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I have to pay this charge today? Mark: No, you have until the end of the month.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这笔费用我今天就得交吗？Mark：不用，月底之前交就行。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-imposta monetarja rrid inħallasha llum?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-imposta monetarja rrid inħallasha llum?
messages.zh: 这笔费用我今天就得交吗？
messages.en: Do I have to pay this charge today?

messages.speaker: Mark (办事员)
messages.zh: 不用，月底之前交就行。
messages.en: No, you have until the end of the month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和缴费通知联系起来：看到金额、期限和付款要求，就联想到“须用金钱缴纳的征费”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave in an affected way in order to impress other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了给别人留下某种印象而装腔作势，表现出刻意做作的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod affettwat biex jimpressjona lil ħaddieħor jew jidher aktar importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了显得重要、有能力或立场坚定而故意摆出某种姿态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Juri atteġġjament jew imġiba artifiċjali biex jagħti impressjoni partikolari tiegħu nnifsu lil ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone postures, they behave in an affected way to make other people think they are important or impressive.

collocations.en: postured in front of the cameras

collocations.zh: 为了显得重要而故作姿态

formal.mt: Matul id-dibattitu, il-kelliem impostura biex jidher deċiż, iżda ma ppreżenta ebda proposta konkreta.
formal.en: During the debate, the speaker postured to appear decisive but presented no concrete proposal.
formal.zh: 辩论期间，发言人故作果断，却没有提出任何具体方案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex impostura daqshekk quddiem il-kameras? Mark: Ried jidher importanti, imma ma qal xejn ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he posture so much in front of the cameras? Mark: He wanted to look important, but he said nothing new.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么在镜头前那么装腔作势？Mark：他想显得重要，可说的全是老话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么在镜头前那么装腔作势？
messages.en: Why did he posture so much in front of the cameras?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jidher importanti, imma ma qal xejn ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jidher importanti, imma ma qal xejn ġdid.
messages.zh: 他想显得重要，可说的全是老话。
messages.en: He wanted to look important, but he said nothing new.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人在镜头前刻意摆出重要人物的架势，用“为了让别人看而做作”这个画面记住动词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who starts and organizes a business and takes on its risks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创办并组织经营企业，同时承担相关风险的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li twaqqaf u tmexxi negozju u tieħu r-riskji marbuta miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发现商业机会、创办和经营企业并承担经营风险的创业者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tara opportunità kummerċjali, twaqqaf negozju u torganizza r-riżorsi tiegħu filwaqt li tieħu r-riskji meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An entrepreneur is someone who starts and organizes a business, accepting financial risks in the hope of making a profit.

formal.mt: L-imprenditur ippreżenta pjan ta' negozju li jispjega l-ispejjeż inizjali u kif se jsib l-ewwel klijenti.
formal.en: The entrepreneur presented a business plan explaining the initial costs and how he would find his first customers.
formal.zh: 这位创业者提交了一份商业计划，说明启动成本以及如何找到首批客户。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk għadu jaħdem mal-istess kumpanija? Mark: Le, issa hu imprenditur u fetaħ negozju tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your brother still work for the same company? Mark: No, he is an entrepreneur now and has opened his own business.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥还在原来那家公司上班吗？Mark：没有，他现在自己创业，开了自己的公司。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥还在原来那家公司上班吗？
messages.en: Does your brother still work for the same company?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa hu imprenditur u fetaħ negozju tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa hu imprenditur u fetaħ negozju tiegħu.
messages.zh: 没有，他现在自己创业，开了自己的公司。
messages.en: No, he is an entrepreneur now and has opened his own business.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“发现机会、创办企业、承担风险”三个连续动作记住这个人：他就是创业者 imprenditur。

gloss_zh: 早期国际化企业；天生全球化企业

teaching_sense.en_definition: A business that begins operating in international markets at an early stage of its development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在创立初期或发展早期便开始面向国际市场经营的企业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Impriża li tibda topera fi swieq internazzjonali fi stadju bikri tal-iżvilupp tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创立之初或成立后不久便以国际市场为经营方向的企业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Impriża li mill-bidu tagħha jew ftit wara t-twaqqif tagħha tkun orjentata lejn swieq internazzjonali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A born global firm is a business that pursues international markets from its beginning or very soon after it is established.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在创业早期便面向多个国家的客户或开展跨国业务的初创企业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Impriża ġdida li fl-ewwel stadji tal-attività tagħha timmira lejn klijenti f'diversi pajjiżi jew tibda topera bejn pajjiżi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A global start-up is a newly established business that targets customers or conducts activities across national borders early in its development.

collocations.en: the establishment of a born global firm
collocations.zh: 早期国际化企业的创立

collocations.en: the growth of a global start-up
collocations.zh: 早期国际化初创企业的成长

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina impriża b'internazzjonalizzazzjoni bikrija li bdiet tbigħ is-servizzi tagħha fi tliet pajjiżi fl-ewwel sena.
formal.en: The study examines a born global firm that began selling its services in three countries during its first year.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察了一家早期国际化企业，该企业在成立第一年就开始向三个国家销售服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kumpanija tagħkom għadha ġdida u diġà għandkom klijenti barra minn Malta? Mark: Iva, hija impriża b'internazzjonalizzazzjoni bikrija; mill-bidu ħsibna fi swieq ta' diversi pajjiżi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your company is still new, and you already have customers outside Malta? Mark: Yes, it is a global start-up; we planned for markets in several countries from the beginning.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing unwanted substances or mixed with material that reduces its purity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有杂质或混入其他不需要的物质，因而不纯净的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih impuritajiet jew sustanzi oħra li jnaqqsulu l-purità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不纯的；含有杂质或其他不需要的成分的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex pur għax fih impuritajiet jew sustanzi oħra mħallta miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substance that is impure contains other substances that reduce its purity.

formal.mt: L-analiżi wriet li l-materjal kien impur u kien fih traċċi ta' sustanzi oħra.
formal.en: The analysis showed that the material was impure and contained traces of other substances.
formal.zh: 分析显示，该材料并不纯净，含有微量的其他物质。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw dan il-materjal? Pawlu: Għax huwa impur; hemm sustanzi oħra mħallta miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't we use this material? Pawlu: Because it is impure; other substances are mixed into it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们为什么不能用这种材料？Pawlu：因为它不纯，里面混有其他物质。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw dan il-materjal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw dan il-materjal?

messages.en: Why can't we use this material?

messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa impur; hemm sustanzi oħra mħallta miegħu.
messages.zh: 因为它不纯，里面混有其他物质。
messages.en: Because it is impure; other substances are mixed into it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯清水混入沙粒，用“含杂质的材料”这个画面记住 impur；搭配阴性名词 sustanza 时记作 impura。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The allocation of a payment to a particular debt or amount owed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将一笔付款归入某项债务，用来抵偿该项欠款的处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-allokazzjoni ta' ħlas lil dejn partikolari jew lil ammont dovut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 付款抵充；将所付款项归抵某项债务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attribuzzjoni ta' somma mħallsa lil dejn partikolari sabiex titħallas dik l-obbligazzjoni kollha jew parti minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Imputation of payment is the allocation of money paid to a particular outstanding debt.

collocations.en: the rules concerning the allocation of payment
the criteria for allocating a payment

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-imputazzjoni tal-ħlas u jindika għal liema dejn ġie allokat l-ammont imħallas.
formal.en: The report explains the allocation of the payment and identifies the debt to which the amount paid was allocated.
formal.zh: 报告说明了这笔付款的抵充情况，并指出已付款项归抵的是哪一项债务。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tispjegali l-imputazzjoni tal-ħlas? Rita: Iva, hawn tfisser li dan il-ħlas ġie allokat għad-dejn fuq din il-fattura.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you explain the allocation of payment to me? Rita: Yes, here it means that this payment was allocated to the debt on this invoice.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你能给我解释一下付款抵充吗？Rita：可以，这里是说这笔付款被用来抵偿这张发票上的欠款。

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.zh: 你能给我解释一下付款抵充吗？
messages.en: Can you explain the allocation of payment to me?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn tfisser li dan il-ħlas ġie allokat għad-dejn fuq din il-fattura.
messages.zh: 可以，这里是说这笔付款被用来抵偿这张发票上的欠款。
messages.en: Yes, here it means that this payment was allocated to the debt on this invoice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上有几张欠款单，把付款凭证放到其中一张上：重点是“这笔钱抵哪笔债”，据此记住整个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Looking worn, neglected, or in poor condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因磨损、疏于照料等而显得破旧、寒酸的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher mikul, traskurat jew fi stat ħażin minħabba l-użu jew in-nuqqas ta' kura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破旧的；因磨损或缺乏照料而显得寒酸、不整洁的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra fqira jew traskurata għax huwa mikul jew ma ngħatax kura biżżejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is shabby looks worn or neglected and is in poor condition.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, ir-raġel jidher liebes kowt imqabar bi kmiem mikula.
formal.en: In the photograph, the man is wearing a shabby coat with worn sleeves.
formal.zh: 照片中，这名男子穿着一件破旧的大衣，袖子已经磨损。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tilbes dak il-kowt imqabar għall-festa? Toni: Le, nilbes ieħor; dan inżommu għax-xogħol fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to wear that shabby coat to the party? Toni: No, I'll wear another one; I keep this one for working in the garden.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要穿那件破旧的大衣去聚会吗？Toni：不，我穿另一件；这件留着在花园干活时穿。

messages.mt_standard: Se tilbes dak il-kowt imqabar għall-festa?

teaching_sense.en_definition: Regarded as holy or treated with deep reverence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被视为神圣的，或受到深切敬重与崇敬的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meqjus qaddis jew denju ta' qima u rispett profond.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神圣的；因宗教意义而被视为应受敬奉的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu sinifikat reliġjuż u jitqies qaddis jew marbut mal-qima.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is sacred is considered holy and worthy of religious respect.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 备受崇敬的；被赋予神圣地位、受到深切敬重的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jitqies qaddis jew jingħata qima u rispett profond minħabba l-importanza speċjali tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A place or thing described as hallowed is regarded with deep reverence and respect.

formal.mt: F'dan il-post imqaddes, il-viżitaturi huma mitluba jżommu s-skiet bħala sinjal ta' rispett.
formal.en: In this sacred place, visitors are asked to remain silent as a sign of respect.
formal.zh: 在这处神圣的地方，访客被要求保持安静，以示尊重。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed nitkellmu bil-mod? David: Għax dan huwa post imqaddes, u rridu nuru rispett.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are we speaking quietly? David: Because this is a sacred place, and we want to show respect.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们为什么要轻声说话？David：因为这里是神圣的地方，我们要表示尊重。

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要轻声说话？
messages.en: Why are we speaking quietly?

messages.speaker: David (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan huwa post imqaddes, u rridu nuru rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan huwa post imqaddes, u rridu nuru rispett.
messages.zh: 因为这里是神圣的地方，我们要表示尊重。
messages.en: Because this is a sacred place, and we want to show respect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进入神圣场所时自然放轻声音，用“肃静以表敬意”的画面记住 imqaddes，并关联 sacred 与 hallowed 两种释义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be awake means to be conscious and not sleeping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指处于清醒、没有睡着的状态；此处按所给词性标为动词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tkun imqajjem ifisser li ma tkunx rieqed u li tkun konxju ta' dak li jkun qed jiġri madwarek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 醒着，处于没有睡着的清醒状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tkun imqajjem ifisser li ma tkunx rieqed u li tkun tista' tinduna b'dak li jiġri madwarek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are awake, you are conscious and are not sleeping.

formal.mt: L-istudent baqa' imqajjem sa tard biex itemm il-qari.
formal.en: The student stayed awake until late to finish the reading.
formal.zh: 这名学生一直熬到很晚，把阅读任务完成了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek imqajjem, Mark? Mark: Iva, għadni imqajjem. Qed naqra ktieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you still awake, Mark? Mark: Yes, I'm still awake. I'm reading a book.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark，你还醒着吗？Mark：是的，我还没睡。我正在看书。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark，你还醒着吗？
messages.en: Are you still awake, Mark?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni imqajjem. Qed naqra ktieb.
messages.zh: 是的，我还没睡。我正在看书。
messages.en: Yes, I'm still awake. I'm reading a book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象夜里仍睁眼读书的人，用 għadu imqajjem 记住“他还醒着”；重点记清醒状态，避免把例句理解成刚刚醒来的动作。

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制成短管状的意大利面食，通常用沸水煮熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġin f'forma ta' tubi qosra, li normalment jissajjar fl-ilma jagħli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通心粉，一种短管状的意大利面食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' għaġin f'forma ta' tubi qosra li jista' jittiekel biz-zalza jew jissajjar fil-forn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Macaroni is pasta shaped into short tubes, often served with sauce or baked.

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, il-kċina tal-iskola se sservi imqarrun biz-zalza tat-tadam u insalata.
formal.en: For lunch, the school kitchen will serve macaroni with tomato sauce and a salad.
formal.zh: 午餐时，学校食堂将供应番茄酱通心粉和沙拉。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi trid għall-ikla llejla? Pawlu: Nixtieq imqarrun il-forn. Fadal minn tal-bieraħ?
colloquial.en: Marija: What would you like for dinner tonight? Pawlu: I'd like baked macaroni. Is there any left from yesterday?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你今晚想吃什么？保罗：我想吃焗通心粉。昨天的还有剩吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 你今晚想吃什么？
messages.en: What would you like for dinner tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq imqarrun il-forn. Fadal minn tal-bieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq imqarrun il-forn. Fadal minn tal-bieraħ?
messages.zh: 我想吃焗通心粉。昨天的还有剩吗？
messages.en: I'd like baked macaroni. Is there any left from yesterday?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imqarrun 和一盘短管状通心粉的画面绑定，再用 imqarrun il-forn 联想烤箱里热腾腾的焗通心粉。

gloss_zh: 已被分享的；已被分配的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that something has been shared or allocated among people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物已经由多人分享，或已经分配给不同的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tesprimi li xi ħaġa ngħatat lil diversi persuni jew tqassmet bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被分享或分配，表示有关事物已经分给多人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa ngħatat lil aktar minn persuna waħda jew li diversi persuni ngħataw sehem minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If things have been shared, they have been divided among people so that each receives a part.

collocations.en: the tasks were shared among the members
collocations.zh: 各项任务已分配给成员

formal.mt: Ir-responsabbiltajiet ġew imqassma b'mod ġust bejn il-membri tat-tim.
formal.en: The responsibilities were shared fairly among the team members.
formal.zh: 各项职责已公平地分配给团队成员。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħidmiet għall-festa diġà ġew imqassma? Mark: Iva, int tieħu ħsieb l-ikel u jien nieħu ħsieb il-mużika.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have the tasks for the party already been shared out? Mark: Yes, you'll take care of the food and I'll take care of the music.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：聚会的任务已经分配好了吗？马克：是的，你负责食物，我负责音乐。

messages.speaker: Lara (聚会组织者)
messages.zh: 聚会的任务已经分配好了吗？
messages.en: Have the tasks for the party already been shared out?

messages.speaker: Mark (聚会组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, int tieħu ħsieb l-ikel u jien nieħu ħsieb il-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, int tieħu ħsieb l-ikel u jien nieħu ħsieb il-mużika.
messages.zh: 是的，你负责食物，我负责音乐。
messages.en: Yes, you'll take care of the food and I'll take care of the music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会任务表上每个人都分到一项工作，用 ġew imqassma 记住“已经被分配”的结果状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a rip or tear in its material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料上有撕裂口或破损的，常用于描述衣物、布料或纸制品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tiċrita jew aktar fil-materjal tiegħu, bħal drapp jew karta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕破的；扯裂的，指材料因撕扯而出现裂口或破损。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġarrab ħsara minħabba tiċrita, b'mod li l-materjal tiegħu nfetaħ jew infired f'xi parti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is ripped or torn has a split or opening in its material caused by tearing.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li d-drapp tal-purtieri kien imqatta' f'diversi postijiet.
formal.en: During the inspection, the curtain fabric was found to be torn in several places.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，窗帘布料有多处撕裂。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-flokk imqatta'. X'ġara? Ġanni: Qbadtu ma' fergħa waqt li kont fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Anna: This T-shirt is torn. What happened? Ġanni: I caught it on a branch while I was in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这件T恤破了。怎么回事？詹尼：我在花园里时，衣服被树枝钩住了。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.zh: 这件T恤破了。怎么回事？
messages.en: This T-shirt is torn. What happened?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Qbadtu ma' fergħa waqt li kont fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Qbadtu ma' fergħa waqt li kont fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 我在花园里时，衣服被树枝钩住了。
messages.en: I caught it on a branch while I was in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imqatta' 放进 flokk imqatta' 一起记，想象T恤被树枝钩出裂口，突出“已经撕破”的外观。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Demanding that rules are followed and allowing little freedom to break them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求严格遵守规则、不轻易容许违规的；形容人时可指严厉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsisti li r-regoli jiġu osservati u ma jippermettix faċilment li jinkisru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严格的；严厉的，指坚持规则或要求，不轻易放宽标准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jitlob li l-oħrajn jimxu mar-regoli u jżommu mal-livell ta' mġiba jew xogħol mistenni minnhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is strict expects rules to be obeyed and does not readily excuse failures to follow them.

formal.mt: L-għalliem huwa imqit dwar il-puntwalità u jitlob li l-istudenti jaslu fil-ħin għal kull lezzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher is strict about punctuality and requires students to arrive on time for every lesson.
formal.zh: 这位老师对守时要求严格，要求学生每节课都准时到达。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu l-għalliem il-ġdid? Luqa: Imqit ħafna dwar ix-xogħol tad-dar, imma jispjega sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's the new teacher like? Luqa: He's very strict about homework, but he explains things well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：新老师怎么样？卢卡：他对家庭作业要求很严格，不过讲解得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 新老师怎么样？
messages.en: What's the new teacher like?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Imqit ħafna dwar ix-xogħol tad-dar, imma jispjega sew.
messages.mt_standard: Imqit ħafna dwar ix-xogħol tad-dar, imma jispjega sew.
messages.zh: 他对家庭作业要求很严格，不过讲解得很清楚。
messages.en: He's very strict about homework, but he explains things well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 għalliem imqit 联想一位坚持按时交作业的老师，把“严格执行要求”的场景与词义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A part of an object that you hold when using, lifting, or moving it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体上供人握住，以便使用、提起或移动该物体的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti ta' oġġett li taqbad b'idek biex tużah, terfgħu jew iċċaqilqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把手；手柄，即物体上供手握持的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti ta' oġġett magħmula biex taqbadha b'idek meta tuża jew iċċaqlaq l-oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The handle of an object is the part that you hold when using or moving it.

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-għodda, iċċekkja li l-imradd ikun imwaħħal sew.
formal.en: Before using the tool, check that the handle is firmly attached.
formal.zh: 使用工具之前，请检查手柄是否固定牢靠。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn naqbad din l-għodda? Mark: Aqbadha mill-imradd, hawnhekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I hold this tool? Mark: Hold it by the handle, here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这件工具该握哪里？马克：握住手柄，就这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 这件工具该握哪里？
messages.en: Where should I hold this tool?

messages.speaker: Mark (指导老师)
messages.zh: 握住手柄，就这里。
messages.en: Hold it by the handle, here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imradd 和手握工具的画面连起来：手指抓住的那一段，就是把手或手柄。

gloss_zh: 词义待核实（原包未提供确定译义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose exact meaning and translation remain to be verified in the supplied packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原包标为名词，但确切词义及译法仍待核实的词条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira u t-traduzzjoni eżatti tiegħu għadhom iridu jiġu vverifikati skont il-pakkett mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确切译义待核实；此处为核实提示，未给出该名词的实际词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din hija nota li titlob verifika tat-traduzzjoni eżatta u ma tagħtix it-tifsira tan-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry flags this noun for verification without providing an established meaning or translation.

collocations.zh: “imramma”一词的含义（讨论词条的表达）
对“imramma”译义的核实（讨论词条的表达）

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-kelma 'imramma' għadha trid tiġi vverifikata qabel ma tintuża fit-traduzzjoni.
formal.en: The meaning of the word 'imramma' still needs to be verified before it is used in the translation.
formal.zh: 在译文中使用“imramma”之前，仍须核实该词的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'imramma'? Mark: Il-pakkett ma jagħtix tifsira ċerta; irridu nivverifikawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'imramma' mean? Mark: The packet does not give a definite meaning; we need to verify it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“imramma”是什么意思？马克：资料包没有给出确定词义，我们需要核实。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: “imramma”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'imramma' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakkett ma jagħtix tifsira ċerta; irridu nivverifikawha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakkett ma jagħtix tifsira ċerta; irridu nivverifikawha.
messages.zh: 资料包没有给出确定词义，我们需要核实。
messages.en: The packet does not give a definite meaning; we need to verify it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 imramma 做一张带问号的名词卡，记住“译义待核实”；不要把原包的核实提示背成词义。

gloss_zh: 酸败的；哈喇的（指油脂等变质）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an unpleasant smell or taste because fat or oil has gone bad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指油脂等变质后产生难闻气味或异味，呈酸败、哈喇状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi żejt jew xaħam li mar ħażin u żviluppa riħa jew togħma ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酸败的；有哈喇味的，指油脂等变质后气味或滋味变坏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xaħam jew żejt li jkun mar ħażin u jkollu riħa jew togħma spjaċevoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If fat or oil is rancid, it has gone bad and developed an unpleasant smell or taste.

collocations.zh: 变质发出哈喇味的脂肪

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, instab li ż-żejt kien imranġat u ma kienx adattat għall-użu fl-ikel.
formal.en: During the inspection, the oil was found to be rancid and unsuitable for use in food.
formal.zh: 检查发现，该油已经酸败，不适合用于食品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina? Mark: Naħseb li hu imranġat. Tużahx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this oil smell bad? Mark: I think it is rancid. Don't use it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这油为什么有股难闻的味道？马克：我觉得它已经酸败了，别用了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina?
messages.zh: 这油为什么有股难闻的味道？
messages.en: Why does this oil smell bad?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我觉得它已经酸败了，别用了。
messages.en: I think it is rancid. Don't use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imranġat 配上打开旧油瓶闻到哈喇味的画面，记住它描述油脂变质后的气味和滋味。

gloss_zh: 词义待核实（原包仅提示译成英语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun for which the supplied packet requests an English translation but gives no established meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原包标为名词、要求译成英语，但未提供确定词义的词条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li għalih il-pakkett mogħti jitlob traduzzjoni bl-Ingliż iżda ma jipprovdix tifsira ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 请译成英语；此处为翻译任务提示，未给出该名词的实际词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din hija talba biex il-kelma tiġi tradotta bl-Ingliż u ma tagħtix it-tifsira tan-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry requests an English translation of this noun without stating what the noun means.

collocations.zh: “Imrejkba”的英语译法（讨论词条的表达）
“Imrejkba”一词的含义（讨论词条的表达）

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jitlob traduzzjoni bl-Ingliż ta' 'Imrejkba', iżda t-tifsira tal-kelma għadha trid tiġi vverifikata.
formal.en: The packet requests an English translation of 'Imrejkba', but the meaning of the word still needs to be verified.
formal.zh: 资料包要求将“Imrejkba”译成英语，但该词的含义仍须核实。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'nikteb bl-Ingliż għal 'Imrejkba'? Mark: L-ewwel irridu nkunu nafu t-tifsira; il-pakkett ma jagħtihiex.
colloquial.en: Maja: What should I write in English for 'Imrejkba'? Mark: First we need to know the meaning; the packet does not provide it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“Imrejkba”该用英语怎么写？马克：我们得先知道它的意思，资料包没有提供。

messages.speaker: Maja (翻译学员)
messages.zh: “Imrejkba”该用英语怎么写？
messages.en: What should I write in English for 'Imrejkba'?

messages.speaker: Mark (翻译老师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu nkunu nafu t-tifsira; il-pakkett ma jagħtihiex.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu nkunu nafu t-tifsira; il-pakkett ma jagħtihiex.
messages.zh: 我们得先知道它的意思，资料包没有提供。
messages.en: First we need to know the meaning; the packet does not provide it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Imrejkba 的学习卡留一个空白译义框，旁注“先核实，再翻译”，避免把翻译任务提示误记成词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object used to move air towards someone to help them feel cooler.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过扇动空气使人感到凉快的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex iċċaqlaq l-arja lejn persuna u tgħinha tħoss inqas sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扇子；通过扇动产生气流、帮助人凉快的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imrewha hija għodda li biha persuna tagħmel ir-riħ biex tħoss inqas sħana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fan is an object that you use to move air towards yourself when you feel hot.

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività fis-sajf, kull mistieden ingħata imrewha tal-karti biex itaffi s-sħana.
formal.en: During the summer event, each guest was given a paper fan to help relieve the heat.
formal.zh: 在夏季活动期间，每位来宾都获赠了一把纸扇，用来消暑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi ħafna sħana. Għandek imrewha? Rita: Iva, ħu din u agħmel ftit riħ biha.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm really hot. Do you have a fan? Rita: Yes, take this one and fan yourself a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我好热。你有扇子吗？丽塔：有，拿这把扇一扇吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我好热。你有扇子吗？
messages.en: I'm really hot. Do you have a fan?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din u agħmel ftit riħ biha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din u agħmel ftit riħ biha.
messages.zh: 有，拿这把扇一扇吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this one and fan yourself a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imrewha 和夏天拿纸扇扇风的画面绑定，再连读 imrewha tal-karti，记住这里表示扇风工具。

gloss_zh: 他被殴打；遭到殴打的男性

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe a male person who is beaten or has suffered a beating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述男性遭到殴打或处于被殴打后的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tiddeskrivi raġel jew tifel li jkun qala' d-daqqiet jew ikun ġie msawwat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他遭到殴打；他处于被打后的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li raġel jew tifel ikun qala' d-daqqiet minn xi ħadd u jkun sofra swat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a man is beaten, someone hits him repeatedly or violently.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li r-raġel instab imsawwat ħdejn id-dar tiegħu.
formal.en: The report indicates that the man was found beaten near his home.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这名男子在自家附近被发现，当时已遭到殴打。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark qiegħed l-isptar? Pawlu: Ġie imsawwat ilbieraħ, u qed jieħdu ħsiebu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is Mark in hospital? Pawlu: He was beaten yesterday, and they're looking after him.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克为什么住院了？保罗：他昨天遭到了殴打，现在有人在照顾他。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么住院了？
messages.en: Why is Mark in hospital?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġie imsawwat ilbieraħ, u qed jieħdu ħsiebu.
messages.mt_standard: Ġie imsawwat ilbieraħ, u qed jieħdu ħsiebu.
messages.zh: 他昨天遭到了殴打，现在有人在照顾他。
messages.en: He was beaten yesterday, and they're looking after him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mark ġie imsawwat 整句记成“马克遭到了殴打”，用男性人物帮助记住这个形式和被动含义。

gloss_zh: 被殴打的；遭到殴打的女性

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe a female person who is beaten or has suffered a beating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述女性遭到殴打或处于被殴打后的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tiddeskrivi mara jew tifla li tkun qalgħet id-daqqiet jew tkun ġiet imsawwta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被殴打的；此处用于描述女性遭到殴打后的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi mara jew tifla li tkun sofriet swat u tkun qalgħet id-daqqiet minn xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A woman who has been beaten has been hit repeatedly or violently by someone.

collocations.en: brutally beaten, referring to a female person
collocations.zh: 遭到残酷殴打的，指女性

collocations.en: was found beaten, referring to a female person
collocations.zh: 被发现时已遭殴打，指女性

formal.mt: Il-mara waslet l-isptar imsawwta u ngħatat il-kura meħtieġa.
formal.en: The woman arrived at the hospital after being beaten and received the necessary care.
formal.zh: 这名女子遭到殴打后抵达医院，并接受了必要的治疗。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ġara lil Lara? Maja: Ġiet imsawwta lbieraħ. Oħtha qiegħda magħha l-isptar.
colloquial.en: Rita: What happened to Lara? Maja: She was beaten yesterday. Her sister is with her at the hospital.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：拉拉怎么了？玛雅：她昨天遭到了殴打。她姐姐正在医院陪着她。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 拉拉怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Lara?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġiet imsawwta lbieraħ. Oħtha qiegħda magħha l-isptar.
messages.mt_standard: Ġiet imsawwta lbieraħ. Oħtha qiegħda magħha l-isptar.
messages.zh: 她昨天遭到了殴打。她姐姐正在医院陪着她。
messages.en: She was beaten yesterday. Her sister is with her at the hospital.

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对朗读 Mark ġie imsawwat 和 Lara ġiet imsawwta，用男女两个人物对照记住这两个形式，特别留意 imsawwta 的结尾。

gloss_zh: 阴天的；天空被云层覆盖的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing weather in which clouds cover all or most of the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容天空全部或大部分被云层覆盖的天气状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi temp li fih is-sema jkun kollu jew fil-biċċa l-kbira tiegħu miksi bis-sħab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴沉的；天空全部或大部分被云层遮盖的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta t-temp ikun imsaħħab, is-sema jkun miksi kollu jew kważi kollu bis-sħab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When the weather is overcast, clouds cover all or most of the sky.

formal.mt: It-temp se jkun imsaħħab matul il-ġurnata, iżda mhux mistennija xita.
formal.en: The weather will be overcast throughout the day, but no rain is expected.
formal.zh: 全天将是阴天，但预计不会下雨。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm hu imsaħħab illum! Taħseb li se tagħmel ix-xita? Lara: Jista' jkun. Ħu umbrella miegħek.
colloquial.en: Mark: It's so overcast today! Do you think it's going to rain? Lara: Maybe. Take an umbrella with you.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天真阴啊！你觉得会下雨吗？拉拉：有可能。带把伞吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu imsaħħab illum! Taħseb li se tagħmel ix-xita?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu imsaħħab illum! Taħseb li se tagħmel ix-xita?
messages.zh: 今天真阴啊！你觉得会下雨吗？
messages.en: It's so overcast today! Do you think it's going to rain?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有可能。带把伞吧。
messages.en: Maybe. Take an umbrella with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象整片天空盖上厚厚的云被，把 imsaħħab 记成这种阴天画面；有云遮天并不表示一定下雨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not specified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料标为名词、但未提供实际词义的词；目前只能学习其拼写，不能确定其指称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mogħtija bħala nom, iżda mingħajr tifsira fil-materjal ipprovdut; għalhekk ma nistgħux niddeterminaw għal xiex tirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原材料未提供该名词的词义，无法据此确定准确释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhijiex mogħtija fil-materjal ipprovdut, u għalhekk tibqa' mhux magħrufa f'dan il-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun appears without a stated meaning in the supplied material.

formal.mt: Il-materjal jelenka 'imserka' bħala nom, iżda ma jagħtix it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The material lists 'imserka' as a noun but does not give its meaning.
formal.zh: 材料将“imserka”列为名词，但没有给出其含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'imserka'? Mark: Hawn m'hemmx tifsira; għalissa nniżżlu biss il-kelma.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'imserka' mean? Mark: There is no definition here; for now, let's just write down the word.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：imserka是什么意思？马克：这里没有释义；我们先只把这个词记下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: imserka是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'imserka' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn m'hemmx tifsira; għalissa nniżżlu biss il-kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn m'hemmx tifsira; għalissa nniżżlu biss il-kelma.
messages.zh: 这里没有释义；我们先只把这个词记下来。
messages.en: There is no definition here; for now, let's just write down the word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“待核实”词卡栏：先记拼写与名词标签，不凭字形猜测词义。

gloss_zh: 毛发蓬乱的；长毛凌乱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having long, rough, untidy hair or fur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容毛发较长、粗蓬而不整齐的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi dehra b'xagħar jew pil twil, imħabbel u mhux pulit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛发长而蓬乱的；毛茸茸且不整齐的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna jew annimal b'xagħar jew pil twil u mhux pulit, jew ix-xagħar jew il-pil innifsu meta jkollu din id-dehra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If hair or fur is shaggy, it is long, rough, and untidy.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher kelb imsewwef bilqiegħda ħdejn sidu.
formal.en: The photograph shows a shaggy dog sitting beside its owner.
formal.zh: 照片中，一只长毛蓬乱的狗坐在主人身旁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kemm hu msewwef dan il-kelb! Mark: Iva, għandu pil twil u għandu bżonn jitfarfar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how shaggy this dog is! Mark: Yes, it has long fur and needs brushing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看这只狗的毛多蓬乱！马克：是啊，它的毛很长，需要梳一梳。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu msewwef dan il-kelb!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu msewwef dan il-kelb!
messages.zh: 看这只狗的毛多蓬乱！
messages.en: Look how shaggy this dog is!

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu pil twil u għandu bżonn jitfarfar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu pil twil u għandu bżonn jitfarfar.
messages.zh: 是啊，它的毛很长，需要梳一梳。
messages.en: Yes, it has long fur and needs brushing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只刚睡醒的长毛狗，毛发向四周蓬开；用这个画面记住“长而蓬乱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Damaged by worms or insects eating into it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体被虫啃食内部或表面，因而出现孔洞或受到损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li saritilha ħsara għax id-dud jew l-insetti kielu minnha, u spiss ħallew toqob fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被虫蛀蚀而受损的，常指木材等出现蛀孔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi materjal jew oġġett li d-dud jew l-insetti kielu partijiet minnu u għamlulu l-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is worm-eaten has been damaged by worms or insects eating into it.

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni sabet injam imsewwes f'parti mill-armarju l-antik.
formal.en: The inspection found worm-eaten wood in part of the old cupboard.
formal.zh: 检查发现，这个旧柜子的部分木材已经被虫蛀蚀。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm dawn it-toqob żgħar fis-siġġu? Mark: L-injam imsewwes; irridu naraw kemm saret ħsara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are there these little holes in the chair? Mark: The wood is worm-eaten; we need to see how much damage there is.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：椅子上为什么有这些小孔？马克：木头被虫蛀了；我们得看看损坏有多严重。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawn it-toqob żgħar fis-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawn it-toqob żgħar fis-siġġu?
messages.zh: 椅子上为什么有这些小孔？
messages.en: Why are there these little holes in the chair?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: L-injam imsewwes; irridu naraw kemm saret ħsara.
messages.mt_standard: L-injam imsewwes; irridu naraw kemm saret ħsara.
messages.zh: 木头被虫蛀了；我们得看看损坏有多严重。
messages.en: The wood is worm-eaten; we need to see how much damage there is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到旧木椅上的一排小蛀孔，就联想到这个词；重点记“虫蛀造成损坏”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An insect that produces a visible glow in the dark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能在黑暗中发出可见微光的昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett li jipproduċi dawl ħafif minn ġismu, li jkun jidher fid-dlam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萤火虫，一种身体能发出微光、在黑暗中容易观察到其光亮的昆虫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Insett li joħroġ dawl minn ġismu u li d-dawl tiegħu jista' jidher fid-dlam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A glow worm is an insect that produces light from its body, visible in the dark.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw id-dawl tal-imsiebaħ il-lejl fid-dlam.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw the light of glow worms in the dark.
formal.zh: 学生们在花园进行观察时，看到了萤火虫在黑暗中发出的光。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhuma dawk id-dwal żgħar fil-ħaxix? Mark: Dawk huma msiebaħ il-lejl. Ejja nħarsu lejhom minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are those little lights in the grass? Mark: Those are glow worms. Let's watch them from here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：草丛里的那些小亮点是什么？马克：那些是萤火虫。我们就在这里看它们吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 草丛里的那些小亮点是什么？
messages.en: What are those little lights in the grass?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk huma msiebaħ il-lejl. Ejja nħarsu lejhom minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Dawk huma msiebaħ il-lejl. Ejja nħarsu lejhom minn hawn.
messages.zh: 那些是萤火虫。我们就在这里看它们吧。
messages.en: Those are glow worms. Let's watch them from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条表达配上“夜晚草丛里的小亮点”画面来记忆，让微光与萤火虫的形象相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Being abroad, away from one's own country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身处国外，离开自己国家而在海外。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab barra minn pajjiżu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在国外；身处自己国家以外的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun jinsab f'pajjiż ieħor, barra minn pajjiżu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is abroad is in a country other than their own.

formal.mt: Id-direttur jinsab imsiefer fuq xogħol u se jirritorna nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The director is abroad on business and will return on Monday.
formal.zh: 主任正在国外出差，将于星期一返回。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għadu imsiefer? Lara: Iva, jiġi lura għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark still abroad? Lara: Yes, he's coming back tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克还在国外吗？拉拉：是的，他明天回来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克还在国外吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still abroad?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他明天回来。
messages.en: Yes, he's coming back tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imsiefer 配上朋友在海外打来电话的画面，记住它表示人身在国外。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression indicating that something is only moderately good or satisfactory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示情况一般、不算好也不算差的说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa hija hekk u hekk, la tajba ħafna u lanqas ħażina ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一般般、马马虎虎的评价，表示好坏程度居中或仅勉强令人满意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tweġiba jew espressjoni li turi li sitwazzjoni jew esperjenza mhijiex tajba ħafna iżda lanqas ħażina ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when something is neither particularly good nor particularly bad.

formal.mt: Meta ntalab jevalwa s-servizz, il-parteċipant wieġeb: "Imsomma, jista' jkun aħjar."
formal.en: When asked to evaluate the service, the participant replied, "So-so, it could be better."
formal.zh: 在被要求评价服务时，参与者回答：“一般般，还可以更好。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-film? Mark: Imsomma. Kien twil wisq għalija.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the film? Mark: So-so. It was too long for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影怎么样？马克：一般般。我觉得太长了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影怎么样？
messages.en: How was the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 一般般。我觉得太长了。
messages.en: So-so. It was too long for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 说 imsomma 时想象手掌左右轻轻摆动：不好不坏，就是“一般般”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lie in a resting position or to put one's body into that position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体平躺或斜躺着，或使身体进入这样的姿势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun mimdud f'pożizzjoni ta' mistrieħ jew jieħu dik il-pożizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躺着；身体平放或斜靠在某个表面上。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun mimdud, b'ġismu mistrieħ fuq sodda, sufan jew wiċċ ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone lies somewhere, their body rests in a flat or reclining position.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躺下；从站立或坐着等姿势转为平躺或斜躺。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu pożizzjoni mimduda billi jniżżel ġismu fuq sodda, sufan jew wiċċ ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you lie down, you move your body into a flat or reclining position.

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, ir-raġel imtedd fuq is-sufan biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After the long walk, the man lay down on the sofa to rest.
formal.zh: 长时间步行之后，那个男人躺到沙发上休息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għajjien? Imtedd ftit fuq is-sufan. Mark: Iva, se nistrieħ għal għaxar minuti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Tired? Lie down on the sofa for a bit. Mark: Yes, I'll rest for ten minutes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：累了吗？在沙发上躺一会儿吧。马克：好，我休息十分钟。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 累了吗？在沙发上躺一会儿吧。
messages.en: Tired? Lie down on the sofa for a bit.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nistrieħ għal għaxar minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nistrieħ għal għaxar minuti.
messages.zh: 好，我休息十分钟。
messages.en: Yes, I'll rest for ten minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imtedd 和身体慢慢放平的动作一起记：强调姿势是“躺”，强调动作是“躺下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Was thrown away or disposed of as unwanted or no longer needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物因不再需要或不想保留而被扔掉、丢弃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie mormi għax ma kienx għadu meħtieġ jew ma riedux iżommuh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被丢弃了；某物因不再需要或不值得保留而被扔掉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġie mormi jew tneħħa minn dak li kien jinżamm, għax ma kienx għadu meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something was discarded, it was thrown away because it was no longer wanted or needed.

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tal-uffiċċju, dokument importanti imtrema bi żball.
formal.en: During the office clean-up, an important document was discarded by mistake.
formal.zh: 清理办公室时，一份重要文件被误扔了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-kartun vojt? Mark: Imtrema dalgħodu. Ma kellniex bżonnu aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the empty cardboard box? Mark: It was thrown away this morning. We didn't need it anymore.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个空纸箱在哪里？马克：今天早上扔掉了。我们已经用不着它了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那个空纸箱在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the empty cardboard box?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Imtrema dalgħodu. Ma kellniex bżonnu aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Imtrema dalgħodu. Ma kellniex bżonnu aktar.
messages.zh: 今天早上扔掉了。我们已经用不着它了。
messages.en: It was thrown away this morning. We didn't need it anymore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给空纸箱贴上 imtrema 的想象标签，记住叙述的是物品“被扔掉了”的经历。

gloss_zh: 词包释为“Scaled”；具体中文义项待核。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective supplied with the gloss 'Scaled', without enough context to establish the intended meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词包中标为形容词、英文释义为“Scaled”的词；现有信息不足以确定其具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li fil-pakkett għandu l-glossa Ingliża 'Scaled', mingħajr kuntest biżżejjed biex jiġi stabbilit is-sens maħsub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英文释义为“Scaled”；该英语词可涉及比例调整或鳞片，但词包未说明此处所指，无法确定准确中文词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija hija 'Scaled', iżda l-pakkett ma jispeċifikax liema sens ta' din il-kelma Ingliża huwa maħsub.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss 'Scaled' has more than one possible interpretation, so this packet does not establish a precise meaning for the adjective.

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-vokabularju, 'imwarrab' huwa mmarkat bħala aġġettiv bil-glossa 'Scaled'; hemm bżonn ta' kuntest biex jiġi ċċarat is-sens.
formal.en: In the vocabulary list, 'imwarrab' is marked as an adjective with the gloss 'Scaled'; context is needed to clarify its meaning.
formal.zh: 词汇表把“imwarrab”标为形容词，释义为“Scaled”；需要语境才能明确其含义。

colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'imwarrab' mean here? Mark: The list gives 'Scaled', but we need more context.

gloss_zh: 词包释为“困境”，但所标形容词词性与英文释义不对应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as an adjective but supplied with the noun gloss 'plight', leaving its adjectival meaning unresolved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词包中标为形容词、却以表示“困境”的英语名词 plight 作释义的词；其形容词含义尚无法确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mmarkata bħala aġġettiv, iżda mogħtija bil-glossa nominali Ingliża 'plight', u għalhekk it-tifsira aġġettivali tagħha mhijiex ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困境；艰难或不幸的处境。此为英文释义 plight 的含义，尚不能据此确定该马耳他语形容词的准确用法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa Ingliża 'plight' tfisser qagħda diffiċli jew ta' tbatija, iżda ma tiċċarax it-tifsira tal-kelma mmarkata bħala aġġettiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plight is a difficult or unfortunate situation, but this noun gloss does not establish how the adjective in this entry should be used.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'imwiegħer' teħtieġ kjarifika: hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv, filwaqt li l-glossa Ingliża 'plight' hija nom.
formal.en: The entry 'imwiegħer' requires clarification: it is labelled as an adjective, whereas its English gloss 'plight' is a noun.
formal.zh: “imwiegħer”这一词条需要澄清：它被标为形容词，而英文释义“plight”是名词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex 'imwiegħer' hu mmarkat bħala aġġettiv? Pawlu: Ma nafx; 'plight' huwa nom bl-Ingliż, allura rridu niċċaraw l-entrata.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is 'imwiegħer' marked as an adjective? Pawlu: I don't know; 'plight' is a noun in English, so we need to clarify the entry.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么“imwiegħer”被标为形容词？Pawlu：我不知道；“plight”在英语里是名词，所以我们需要把这个词条弄清楚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun entry given as 'Imxamar', with no independent explanation identifying what it denotes.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata nominali mogħtija bħala 'Imxamar', li l-glossa tagħha tirrepeti l-istess forma mingħajr ma tispjega għal xiex tirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Imxamar：词包仅重复该词的写法，没有提供可据以确定中文含义的信息。

gloss_zh: 湿的；被水或其他液体弄湿的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having water or another liquid on its surface or within it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面有水或其他液体，或内部含有这些液体的；湿的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ilma jew xi likwidu ieħor fuqu jew ġo fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 湿的；表面沾有水或其他液体，或已被液体浸湿的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun imxarrba meta jkollha l-ilma jew likwidu ieħor fuqha jew ġo fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is wet has water or another liquid on its surface or absorbed into it.

formal.mt: L-art ħdejn id-daħla hija mxarrba; jekk jogħġbok oqgħod attent meta tidħol.
formal.en: The floor near the entrance is wet; please take care when entering.
formal.zh: 入口附近的地面是湿的；进入时请小心。

colloquial.zh: Maja：这条毛巾还是湿的吗？Mark：是的，我刚才用过这条。去柜子里拿一条干的吧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied gloss, which reads 'i dontknw'.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala sym li t-tifsira tagħha ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-glossa mogħtija, 'i dontknw'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给文本表示词义尚不明确，无法据此确定该词的中文释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija ma tagħtix tifsira ċara tal-kelma u għalhekk ma tippermettix definizzjoni preċiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss does not establish what this entry means.

formal.mt: It-tifsira ta' 'imxarreb' għadha mhix ċara mill-informazzjoni mogħtija.
formal.en: The meaning of 'imxarreb' is still unclear from the information supplied.
formal.zh: 根据所给信息，“imxarreb”的含义仍不明确。
