gloss_zh: 歪斜、不对称；原条目标为名词

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as a noun and supplied with the meaning of being uneven or tilted to one side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条按所给资料保留名词标签；释义表示向一侧歪斜，或两侧不均衡的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom li ngħatat it-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa mxaqilba lejn naħa waħda jew mhux indaqs fuq iż-żewġ naħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向一侧歪斜的；两侧不均衡或不对称的。本条保留资料中的名词标签。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija tirreferi għal xi ħaġa li xxaqleb lejn naħa waħda jew li ż-żewġ naħat tagħha mhumiex indaqs; l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as lopsided is uneven or leans more towards one side than the other.

collocations.mt: 'imxattar' u l-idea ta' nuqqas ta' simetrija

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, 'imxattar' huwa mmarkat bħala nom u jingħata t-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa mxaqilba lejn naħa waħda.
formal.en: In this list, 'imxattar' is labelled as a noun and given the meaning of something tilted to one side.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，“imxattar”被标为名词，所给含义是某物向一侧歪斜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'imxattar' f'din il-lista? Mark: Immaġina stampa mdendla li naħa tagħha hija aktar baxxa mill-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I remember the meaning of 'imxattar' in this list? Mark: Imagine a hanging picture with one side lower than the other.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份词表里 imxattar 的意思怎么记？Mark：想象一幅挂歪的画，一边比另一边低。

gloss_zh: 俯卧的；或容易出现某种情况的，所给英文未区分

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry supplied with the English gloss 'prone', which can describe lying face down or being likely to experience something; the packet does not specify which meaning applies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给英文 prone 可以表示脸朝下俯卧，也可以表示容易发生某种情况；资料未明确本条采用哪一种含义，词性亦未指定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata bil-glossa Ingliża 'prone', li tista' tfisser mimdud b'wiċċu 'l isfel jew li x'aktarx jiġrilu xi ħaġa; l-informazzjoni mogħtija ma tispeċifikax liema tifsira tapplika jew il-kategorija grammatikali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英文释义可指俯卧的、脸朝下躺着的，也可指易于发生某种情况的；仅凭资料无法确定此处所指。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa Ingliża tista' tirreferi għal pożizzjoni b'wiċċ il-persuna 'l isfel jew għal tendenza li tiġri xi ħaġa, iżda l-informazzjoni mogħtija ma tagħżilx bejn dawn it-tifsiriet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied English word can describe someone lying face down or someone likely to experience a particular condition, but the packet does not identify the intended meaning.

formal.mt: Għall-kelma 'imxejjer', il-glossa 'prone' waħedha ma tiċċarax jekk it-tifsira tirreferix għal pożizzjoni tal-ġisem jew għal tendenza.
formal.en: For 'imxejjer', the gloss 'prone' alone does not clarify whether the meaning concerns a body position or a tendency.
formal.zh: 对于“imxejjer”，单凭 prone 这一释义，无法确定所指的是身体姿势还是某种倾向。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn 'imxejjer' għandu l-glossa 'prone'. Ifisser b'wiċċu 'l isfel? Mark: Jista' jkun, imma għandna bżonn aktar kuntest biex inkunu ċerti.

gloss_zh: 他曾渴望、他曾强烈盼望；原条目标为名词

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as a noun whose supplied gloss expresses that a male person strongly wanted someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条按所给资料保留名词标签；释义表达“他曾渴望某人或某事”，强调强烈的愿望或盼望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom li l-glossa tagħha tesprimi li hu kellu xewqa qawwija għal xi ħadd jew għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他曾渴望、他曾强烈盼望某人或某事；所给短语没有说明渴望的具体对象。本条保留名词标签。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa tesprimi li hu xtaq ħafna lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, mingħajr ma tispeċifika lil min jew xiex; l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he longed for someone or something, he felt a strong desire to see that person or to have or experience that thing.

formal.mt: F'din l-entrata, 'imxennaq' għandu glossa li tesprimi xewqa qawwija li hu kellu għal xi ħadd jew għal xi ħaġa, għalkemm huwa mmarkat bħala nom.
formal.en: In this entry, 'imxennaq' has a gloss expressing a strong desire that he felt for someone or something, although it is labelled as a noun.
formal.zh: 在本条中，“imxennaq”的释义表达他曾对某人或某事怀有强烈渴望，尽管条目被标为名词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif niftakar il-glossa ta' 'imxennaq'? Mark: Aħseb f'xi ħadd li kien ilu 'l bogħod u xtaq ħafna jerġa' jara lill-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I remember the gloss for 'imxennaq'? Mark: Think of someone who had been away for a long time and strongly wished to see his family again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：imxennaq 的释义怎么记？Mark：想象一个离家很久的人，非常盼望再次见到家人。

gloss_zh: 有雾的；不透明的；昏暗的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes something affected by mist, lacking transparency, or appearing dim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述有雾而朦胧、不能清楚透光，或光线昏暗而看不清的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tkun imċajpra biċ-ċpar, ma tħallix id-dawl jgħaddi b'mod ċar, jew tidher mudlama u bla ċarezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有雾的；因雾气笼罩而显得朦胧、看不清的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun fih iċ-ċpar jew ikun mgħotti biċ-ċpar, b'mod li ma jkunx jista' jidher ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A misty place has mist in the air that makes things difficult to see clearly.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不透明的；不能让人透过它清楚看见另一侧物体的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jħallix id-dawl jgħaddi b'mod ċar u għalhekk ma jippermettix li wieħed jara sew minn ġo fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An opaque material does not allow you to see clearly through it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 昏暗的；光线微弱，或因光线不足而显得模糊不清的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit dawl jew jidher bla ċarezza minħabba dawl dgħajjef.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is dim gives little light or is difficult to see because the light is weak.

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ imċajpar fit-tieqa ma jippermettix li wieħed jara ċar minn ġo fih.
formal.en: The opaque glass in the window does not allow anyone to see clearly through it.
formal.zh: 窗户上的不透明玻璃使人无法透过它看清另一侧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistax nara l-għoljiet sew? Mark: Il-pajsaġġ imċajpar dalgħodu; hemm ħafna ċpar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't I see the hills clearly? Mark: The landscape is misty this morning; there's a lot of mist.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我为什么看不清那些山丘？马克：今天早晨景色雾蒙蒙的，雾很大。

messages.zh: 今天早晨景色雾蒙蒙的，雾很大。
messages.en: The landscape is misty this morning; there's a lot of mist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看不清”串联 imċajpar 的三个义项：雾遮住景物、玻璃挡住视线、暗光使细节难辨，再按具体名词选择中文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adverb whose meaning remains unconfirmed in this entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条目中词义尚未确认的副词，暂不能赋予具体的动作方式或状态含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avverbju li t-tifsira tiegħu għadha mhix ikkonfermata f'din l-entrata u għalhekk għadu ma jistax jingħata spjegazzjoni semantika preċiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未确定；此处的问号表示释义尚缺，不能据此推定具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan l-avverbju għadha mhix magħrufa f'din l-entrata; il-punt interrogattiv jindika li għad hemm bżonn ta' kjarifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this adverb remains unconfirmed, so a specific interpretation cannot yet be taught.

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-avverbju 'imċerċer' trid tiġi ċċarata qabel ma jintuża f'eżempju li juri t-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The meaning of the adverb 'imċerċer' must be clarified before it is used in an example illustrating its meaning.
formal.zh: 副词“imċerċer”的词义需要先得到澄清，才能用例句展示其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'imċerċer'? Mark: Għadni ma nafx; irridu niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'imċerċer' mean? Mark: I don't know yet; we need to clarify the meaning before using it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“imċerċer”是什么意思？马克：我还不知道；我们得先弄清词义再使用。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “imċerċer”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'imċerċer' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx; irridu niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx; irridu niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 我还不知道；我们得先弄清词义再使用。
messages.en: I don't know yet; we need to clarify the meaning before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 imċerċer 做一张“副词，词义待确认”的学习卡；问号是释义空缺标记，不要凭字形相似联想并记成其他词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is poor has very little money or few material resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人缺少钱财或生活资源，生活贫困。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit flus jew mezzi materjali u jsibha diffiċli jlaħħaq mal-ħtiġijiet tal-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贫穷的，缺少满足生活需要的钱财或物质条件的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma għandux biżżejjed flus jew mezzi biex jgħix u jissodisfa l-ħtiġijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is poor has little money and may struggle to meet everyday needs.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi raġel imċewlaħ li jeħtieġ għajnuna biex iħallas għall-ikel u l-kera.
formal.en: The report describes a poor man who needs help paying for food and rent.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一位需要援助来支付食物和房租费用的贫困男子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed niġbru l-ikel? Mark: Biex ngħinu lil raġel imċewlaħ li jgħix ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we collecting food? Mark: To help a poor man who lives near us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么在募集食物？马克：为了帮助住在我们附近的一位贫困男子。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们为什么在募集食物？
messages.en: Why are we collecting food?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ngħinu lil raġel imċewlaħ li jgħix ħdejna.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ngħinu lil raġel imċewlaħ li jgħix ħdejna.
messages.zh: 为了帮助住在我们附近的一位贫困男子。
messages.en: To help a poor man who lives near us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imċewlaħ 和需要食物及房租援助的人联系起来，整组记住 raġel imċewlaħ，表示生活贫困的男子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that has been demolished or reduced to ruins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经被拆毁、推倒或毁成废墟的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li twaqqgħet jew inqerdet u ma għadhiex sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拆毁或毁成废墟的事物，尤指建筑物或其他结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa, bħal binja jew struttura oħra, li twaqqgħet jew inqerdet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as demolished has been knocked down or destroyed so that it no longer stands intact.

collocations.en: a demolished wall and demolished houses
collocations.zh: 一堵被推倒的墙和被拆毁的房屋

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi ritratti tad-djar imġarrfa u jindika fejn kienu jinsabu qabel twaqqgħu.
formal.en: The report includes photographs of the demolished houses and indicates where they stood before they were knocked down.
formal.zh: 报告收录了被拆毁房屋的照片，并标明这些房屋拆除前所在的位置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dik hi d-dar li kont tgħix fiha? | Toni: Iva, imma issa hija imġarrfa. Fadal biss ftit ġebel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is that the house you used to live in? | Toni: Yes, but it's demolished now. Only a few stones are left.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那就是你以前住的房子吗？ | Toni：是的，不过现在已经被拆毁了，只剩下一些石头。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi d-dar li kont tgħix fiha?
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi d-dar li kont tgħix fiha?
messages.zh: 那就是你以前住的房子吗？
messages.en: Is that the house you used to live in?

messages.speaker: Toni (原住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma issa hija imġarrfa. Fadal biss ftit ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma issa hija imġarrfa. Fadal biss ftit ġebel.
messages.zh: 是的，不过现在已经被拆毁了，只剩下一些石头。
messages.en: Yes, but it's demolished now. Only a few stones are left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“完整房屋变成碎石堆”的前后画面对照记忆 imġarrfa，重点记住已经被拆毁的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way a person acts or conducts themselves in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人在某种情境中的行为方式或举止表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna taġixxi jew iġġib ruħha f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为；举止，指一个人如何行动或待人处事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna taġixxi, tittratta lil ħaddieħor jew iġġib ruħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's behaviour is the way they act and conduct themselves around other people.

formal.mt: L-għalliem faħħar l-imġieba tajba tal-istudenti waqt iż-żjara fil-mużew.
formal.en: The teacher praised the students' good behaviour during the museum visit.
formal.zh: 老师表扬了学生们参观博物馆时的良好表现。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif kienet l-imġieba tat-tfal illum? Pawlu: Tajba ħafna! Stennew min imisshom u għenu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Marija: How was the children's behaviour today? Pawlu: Very good! They waited their turn and helped each other.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：孩子们今天表现怎么样？保罗：很好！他们轮流等候，还互相帮助。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子们今天表现怎么样？
messages.en: How was the children's behaviour today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajba ħafna! Stennew min imisshom u għenu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Tajba ħafna! Stennew min imisshom u għenu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 很好！他们轮流等候，还互相帮助。
messages.en: Very good! They waited their turn and helped each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imġieba 和“课堂表现”联系起来：轮流发言、帮助同学都是行为举止的具体例子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made known through a public or official announcement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经通过公开或正式通知让人知晓的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun sar magħruf permezz ta' avviż pubbliku jew uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已宣布的；已通过通知公布的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie mgħarraf lin-nies permezz ta' avviż jew dikjarazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is announced has been made known through a statement or notice.

formal.mt: L-avveniment imħabbar fuq is-sit uffiċjali se jsir fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The event announced on the official website will take place in the main hall.
formal.zh: 官方网站上公布的活动将在主厅举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kunċert diġà ġie mħabbar? Mark: Iva, huwa mħabbar fuq is-sit tat-teatru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the concert already been announced? Mark: Yes, it is announced on the theatre's website.
colloquial.zh: Maja：音乐会已经公布了吗？Mark：是的，剧院网站上已经公布了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会已经公布了吗？
messages.en: Has the concert already been announced?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa mħabbar fuq is-sit tat-teatru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa mħabbar fuq is-sit tat-teatru.
messages.zh: 是的，剧院网站上已经公布了。
messages.en: Yes, it is announced on the theatre's website.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张已经贴出的活动公告，把 imħabbar 和“消息已经公开”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 被围绕；处于被包围的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being surrounded by people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 四周有人或事物围绕的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min ikun imdawwar b'nies jew b'affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人或事物围绕；处于其包围之中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda li fiha persuna jew ħaġa tkun imdawra minn nies jew affarijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Being surrounded by people or things means that they are positioned all around you.

collocations.zh: 对 imħabbat 一词的解释

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'imħabbat' jirreferi għall-qagħda ta' persuna mdawra b'nies jew b'affarijiet.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'imħabbat' refers to the condition of a person surrounded by people or things.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，imħabbat 指一个人被人或事物围绕的状态。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'imħabbat' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Il-qagħda ta' min ikun imdawwar b'nies jew b'affarijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'imħabbat' mean in this exercise? Pawlu: The condition of someone surrounded by people or things.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这道练习里的 imħabbat 是什么意思？Pawlu：指一个人被人或事物围绕的状态。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的 imħabbat 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'imħabbat' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qagħda ta' min ikun imdawwar b'nies jew b'affarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qagħda ta' min ikun imdawwar b'nies jew b'affarijiet.
messages.zh: 指一个人被人或事物围绕的状态。
messages.en: The condition of someone surrounded by people or things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个中心人物，再在四周画一圈人或物，用这幅“被围绕”的图记住本义项。

gloss_zh: 打结的；凌乱的；毛发蓬乱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having knots, a disturbed arrangement, or long and untidy hair or fur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈现打结、被弄乱，或毛发较长而蓬乱的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu l-għoqiedi, li jkun tħarbat mill-ordni tiegħu, jew li jkollu xagħar jew pil twil u mħarbat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打了结的；缠结在一起的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun fih għoqda jew diversi għoqiedi, bħal ħabel jew ħajt li jkun intrabat fih innifsu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is knotted has one or more knots in it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄乱的；原本平顺整齐的排列受到扰动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun tħarbat u ma baqax lixx jew irranġat, bħal xagħar li jkun ħarbtu r-riħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is ruffled has been disturbed so that it is no longer smooth or neatly arranged.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛发长而蓬乱的；长着浓密凌乱毛发的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu xagħar jew pil twil, folt u mħarbat li ma jidhirx irranġat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shaggy animal or person has long hair or fur that looks thick and untidy.

formal.mt: Qabel l-attività, l-għalliem talab lill-istudenti jħollu l-għoqiedi fil-ħabel imħabbel.
formal.en: Before the activity, the teacher asked the students to undo the knots in the knotted rope.
formal.zh: 活动开始前，老师要求学生解开那根缠结绳子上的绳结。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex xagħrek daqshekk imħabbel? Toni: Ir-riħ ħarbtu waqt li kont miexi. Għandek moxt?
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is your hair so ruffled? Toni: The wind messed it up while I was walking. Do you have a comb?
colloquial.zh: Nina：你的头发怎么这么乱？Toni：我走路时被风吹乱了。你有梳子吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的头发怎么这么乱？
messages.en: Why is your hair so ruffled?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riħ ħarbtu waqt li kont miexi. Għandek moxt?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riħ ħarbtu waqt li kont miexi. Għandek moxt?
messages.zh: 我走路时被风吹乱了。你有梳子吗？
messages.en: The wind messed it up while I was walking. Do you have a comb?

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象打结的绳子、风吹乱的头发和蓬毛小狗，分别对应三个义项，帮助区分具体场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of concern about a problem or an uncertain outcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因问题或尚不确定的结果而产生的不安与担忧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' inkwiet dwar problema jew dwar riżultat li għadu mhux magħruf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忧虑；对可能出现的问题或不利结果感到不安的心情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-inkwiet li persuna tħoss meta taħseb li jista' jkun hemm problema jew li jista' jiġri xi ħaġa ħażina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Worry is the uneasy feeling you have when you think about problems or possible unpleasant events.

collocations.zh: 对 imħassba 一词的解释

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, 'imħassba' tirreferi għall-inkwiet li jinħass meta r-riżultat ta' sitwazzjoni jkun għadu mhux magħruf.
formal.en: In this lesson, 'imħassba' refers to the worry felt when the outcome of a situation is still unknown.
formal.zh: 在本课中，imħassba 指情况的结果尚未明朗时产生的忧虑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'imħassba' f'din il-lezzjoni? Marija: L-inkwiet li tħoss, pereżempju, waqt li tistenna r-riżultat ta' eżami.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'imħassba' mean in this lesson? Marija: The worry you feel, for example, while waiting for an exam result.
colloquial.zh: Sara：本课里的 imħassba 是什么意思？Marija：就是你心里的担忧，例如等待考试结果时的那种心情。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 本课里的 imħassba 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'imħassba' mean in this lesson?

messages.speaker: Marija (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-inkwiet li tħoss, pereżempju, waqt li tistenna r-riżultat ta' eżami.
messages.mt_standard: L-inkwiet li tħoss, pereżempju, waqt li tistenna r-riżultat ta' eżami.
messages.zh: 就是你心里的担忧，例如等待考试结果时的那种心情。
messages.en: The worry you feel, for example, while waiting for an exam result.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等待考试结果时心里悬着一块石头，把 imħassba 与这种忧虑的心情联系起来。

gloss_zh: 名词；所给释义“opjk”无法明确解释，词义待核实。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied gloss 'opjk'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个在所给材料中标为名词的词；由于英文释义“opjk”无法明确解释，暂不能确定其具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-glossa mogħtija 'opjk'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义为“opjk”，含义不明；仅能确认材料将此义项标为名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal jagħti 'opjk' bħala tifsira ta' dan in-nom, iżda din il-glossa ma tippermettix li jiġi identifikat sens ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss does not establish a clear meaning for this noun.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'imħatra' hija mmarkata bħala nom fil-materjal mogħti, iżda l-glossa 'opjk' ma tagħtix tifsira ċara.
formal.en: The word 'imħatra' is marked as a noun in the supplied material, but the gloss 'opjk' does not provide a clear meaning.
formal.zh: 所给材料将“imħatra”标为名词，但释义“opjk”没有提供明确含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'imħatra' hawn? Pawlu: Ma nistgħux ngħidu minn din il-glossa; hemm bżonn tifsira aktar ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'imħatra' mean here? Pawlu: We cannot tell from this gloss; we need a clearer definition.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“imħatra”是什么意思？Pawlu：单凭这条释义无法确定，需要更清楚的定义。

gloss_zh: 弓着背的；背部向前弯曲的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the back bent forward, giving the body a hunched posture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容背部向前弯曲、身体呈弓背姿态的状态；所给材料未明确标注词性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li għandha daharha mgħawweġ 'il quddiem u ġisimha f'qagħda milwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弓着背的，指背部向前弯曲、身体蜷曲的姿态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd b'dahru mgħawweġ 'il quddiem, b'mod li ġismu jidher milwi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is hunched has their back bent forward.

formal.mt: Ir-raġel kien bilqiegħda mħatteb fuq il-mejda waqt li kien jaqra d-dokument.
formal.en: The man sat hunched over the table while reading the document.
formal.zh: 那名男子读文件时，弓着背坐在桌前。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed toqgħod daqshekk imħatteb? Mark: Il-kitba żgħira wisq; se nressaq il-karta eqreb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you sitting so hunched over? Mark: The writing is too small; I'll bring the paper closer.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么坐得这么弓着背？Mark：字太小了，我把纸拿近一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么坐得这么弓着背？
messages.en: Why are you sitting so hunched over?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kitba żgħira wisq; se nressaq il-karta eqreb.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kitba żgħira wisq; se nressaq il-karta eqreb.
messages.zh: 字太小了，我把纸拿近一点。
messages.en: The writing is too small; I'll bring the paper closer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人凑近纸面读小字，背部弯成弧线；用“弓背读字”的画面记住这个姿态词。

gloss_zh: 困倦的；昏昏欲睡的。另有动词记录，但其释义未明确。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling sleepy and having difficulty remaining fully awake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到困倦、难以保持完全清醒的状态；默认词性标签保留为材料所给的“x”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jħoss in-ngħas u jsibha diffiċli jibqa' kompletament imqajjem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困倦的，昏昏欲睡的；此义项的词性在材料中标为“x”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi stat ta' ngħas li fih persuna ma tkunx għadha rieqda iżda ssibha diffiċli tibqa' mqajma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are drowsy, you feel sleepy and find it difficult to stay fully awake.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 此项标为动词，但原释义仅为问号，无法据此确定其动作含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala verb, iżda l-mistoqsija '?' flok tifsira ma tippermettix li jiġi stabbilit x'azzjoni tesprimi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry is labelled as a verb, but its meaning is not established by the supplied question mark.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困倦的，指感到想睡、清醒程度下降的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li jiddeskrivi persuna li għandha n-ngħas u tkun qrib li torqod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A drowsy person feels sleepy and may be close to falling asleep.

formal.mt: Wara lejl bi ftit irqad, l-istudent deher imħeddel waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: After a night with little sleep, the student looked drowsy during the lesson.
formal.zh: 前一晚睡眠不足后，那名学生在课堂上显得昏昏欲睡。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tidher imħeddel. Irqadt biżżejjed? Mark: Le, irqadt ftit ħafna. Se nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: You look drowsy. Did you get enough sleep? Mark: No, I slept very little. I'm going to rest for a bit.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看起来很困，睡够了吗？Mark：没有，我睡得很少，打算休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看起来很困，睡够了吗？
messages.en: You look drowsy. Did you get enough sleep?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irqadt ftit ħafna. Se nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irqadt ftit ħafna. Se nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 没有，我睡得很少，打算休息一会儿。
messages.en: No, I slept very little. I'm going to rest for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象熬夜后眼皮下垂、快要睡着的学生，把这个画面与“困倦”相连；问号标注的动词义单独留待核实。

gloss_zh: 热情的；热忱的；积极投入的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing strong enthusiasm or eager commitment to an activity, aim, or cause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某项活动、目标或事业怀有强烈热情，并表现出积极投入的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ħeġġa kbira u interess qawwi f'attività, f'għan jew f'kawża, u jkun lest li jaħdem għalihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热情强烈的，指对某人、某事或某项事业怀有深厚而热烈的情感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu sentimenti qawwija u ħeġġa kbira lejn persuna, attività jew kawża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ardent person feels or expresses very strong enthusiasm or devotion.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热忱投入的，指为某项目标或事业积极努力、表现出强烈支持的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaħdem b'ħeġġa kbira biex jilħaq għan jew jappoġġa kawża li jemmen fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is zealous puts great energy into supporting a cause or achieving an aim.

collocations.zh: 一位热忱投入的志愿者

formal.mt: Bħala voluntier imħeġġeġ, Pawlu ddedika ħafna ħin għall-proġett tal-komunità u ħeġġeġ lil oħrajn biex jieħdu sehem.
formal.en: As a zealous volunteer, Pawlu devoted considerable time to the community project and encouraged others to take part.
formal.zh: 作为一名热忱投入的志愿者，Pawlu为社区项目付出了大量时间，并鼓励其他人参与。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int dejjem imħeġġeġ meta nitkellmu dwar it-teatru! Pawlu: Inħobbu ħafna. Trid tiġi għar-reċta miegħi?
colloquial.en: Maja: You're always so enthusiastic when we talk about theatre! Pawlu: I love it. Would you like to come to the play with me?
colloquial.zh: Maja：每次聊到戏剧，你都特别有热情！Pawlu：我很喜欢戏剧。你想和我一起去看这出戏吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int dejjem imħeġġeġ meta nitkellmu dwar it-teatru!
messages.mt_standard: Int dejjem imħeġġeġ meta nitkellmu dwar it-teatru!
messages.zh: 每次聊到戏剧，你都特别有热情！
messages.en: You're always so enthusiastic when we talk about theatre!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħobbu ħafna. Trid tiġi għar-reċta miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Inħobbu ħafna. Trid tiġi għar-reċta miegħi?
messages.zh: 我很喜欢戏剧。你想和我一起去看这出戏吗？
messages.en: I love it. Would you like to come to the play with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位谈到热爱的话题就双眼发亮、主动投入的朋友：热烈的感情帮助记住 ardent，积极的行动帮助记住 zealous。

gloss_zh: 羊毛线头脱出；毛线散出

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes wool with threads coming out of its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述羊毛织物的线头从表面脱出或散出的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi suf li minnu jkunu ħerġin ħjut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指羊毛织物的线头正在脱出或散出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li l-ħjut tas-suf ikunu ħerġin mid-drapp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When wool is described this way, threads are coming out of the fabric.

collocations.en: woollen fabric with threads coming out

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li d-drapp tas-suf kien imżarrat u kellu ħjut ħerġin minn wiċċu.
formal.en: The inspection found that the woollen fabric had threads coming out of its surface.
formal.zh: 检查发现，这块羊毛织物表面有线头脱出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dan is-suf imżarrat; il-ħjut qed joħorġu. Marija: Tiġbidhomx. Ħa naraw kif nistgħu nsewwuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at this wool; the threads are coming out. Marija: Don't pull them. Let's see how we can repair it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看这块羊毛，线头都散出来了。玛丽娅：别拉它们。我们看看能怎么修补。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan is-suf imżarrat; il-ħjut qed joħorġu.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan is-suf imżarrat; il-ħjut qed joħorġu.
messages.zh: 看这块羊毛，线头都散出来了。
messages.en: Look at this wool; the threads are coming out.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiġbidhomx. Ħa naraw kif nistgħu nsewwuh.
messages.mt_standard: Tiġbidhomx. Ħa naraw kif nistgħu nsewwuh.
messages.zh: 别拉它们。我们看看能怎么修补。
messages.en: Don't pull them. Let's see how we can repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和毛衣表面冒出的线头一起记：看到羊毛线头散出，就回想 suf imżarrat；这是场景联想，不是词源分析。

gloss_zh: 爱管闲事的人；喜欢插手的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who interferes in other people's affairs without being asked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经邀请便插手别人事务、爱管闲事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tindaħal fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr ma tintalab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱管闲事的人，指喜欢擅自干涉别人事务的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha d-drawwa li tindaħal fi kwistjonijiet li ma jikkonċernawhiex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A meddlesome person interferes in other people's affairs when their involvement is unwanted.

collocations.en: a meddler who interferes in everything
collocations.zh: 什么都要插手的多事者

collocations.en: a meddler in other people's affairs

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-imżattat jindaħal kontinwament fil-kwistjonijiet tal-ġirien, anki meta ħadd ma jitlob l-opinjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the meddler constantly interferes in the neighbours' affairs, even when nobody asks for his opinion.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个爱管闲事的人不断插手邻居的事务，即使根本没人征求他的意见。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dak l-imżattat reġa' daħal fil-kwistjoni tagħna. Pawlu: Għidlu li nistgħu nsolvuha aħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: That meddler has interfered in our business again. Pawlu: Tell him we can sort it out ourselves.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那个爱管闲事的人又插手我们的事了。保罗：告诉他，我们自己能解决。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-imżattat reġa' daħal fil-kwistjoni tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-imżattat reġa' daħal fil-kwistjoni tagħna.
messages.zh: 那个爱管闲事的人又插手我们的事了。
messages.en: That meddler has interfered in our business again.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 告诉他，我们自己能解决。
messages.en: Tell him we can sort it out ourselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人正在商量，旁边一个人总要插话：把这个多事的人记作 imżattat，本条按名词记忆，表示人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes something decorated or displaying a variety of colours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述经过装饰的事物，或具有多种颜色、呈现斑斓色彩的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa mżejna jew li fiha diversi kuluri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过装饰的；添加了装饰物或装饰细节的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li żdiedulha tiżjin jew dettalji biex issebbaħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is decorated has ornaments or other attractive details added to it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有多种颜色的；色彩斑斓或颜色相间的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li turi diversi kuluri f'partijiet differenti tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is variegated displays different colours across its surface.

formal.mt: Is-saqaf imżewwaq tal-kamra juri disinji tal-fjuri, filwaqt li d-drapp imżewwaq tal-purtieri jgħaqqad l-aħmar, il-blu u l-aħdar.
formal.en: The room's decorated ceiling displays floral designs, while the variegated curtain fabric combines red, blue and green.
formal.zh: 房间里装饰过的天花板绘有花卉图案，窗帘的斑斓布料则结合了红、蓝、绿三种颜色。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Jogħġbok dan id-drapp imżewwaq? Luqa: Iva, jogħġobni kif il-kuluri jmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you like this colourful fabric? Luqa: Yes, I like how the colours go together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你喜欢这块色彩斑斓的布吗？卢卡：喜欢，我觉得这些颜色搭配得很好。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这块色彩斑斓的布吗？
messages.en: Do you like this colourful fabric?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jogħġobni kif il-kuluri jmorru flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jogħġobni kif il-kuluri jmorru flimkien.
messages.zh: 喜欢，我觉得这些颜色搭配得很好。
messages.en: Yes, I like how the colours go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面区分两个义项：有花纹装饰的天花板对应 decorated，多种颜色相间的布料对应 variegated，都联想到 imżewwaq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Refers to constructing a building or another structure by putting materials together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指通过组合建筑材料来建造房屋或其他构筑物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirreferi għall-bini ta' dar jew struttura oħra billi jitqiegħdu materjali flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建造；使用材料建起房屋或其他构筑物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel dar jew struttura oħra billi tgħaqqad materjali bħal ġebel, injam jew ħadid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people build a structure, they make it by putting suitable materials together.

formal.mt: Il-pont inbena bil-ġebel sabiex jgħaqqad iż-żewġ naħat tal-wied.
formal.en: The bridge was built of stone to connect the two sides of the valley.
formal.zh: 这座桥用石头建成，用于连接山谷两侧。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta nbena dan il-ħajt? Rita: Inbena s-sena l-oħra, meta rranġajna l-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Mark: When was this wall built? Rita: It was built last year, when we renovated the garden.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这面墙是什么时候建的？丽塔：去年建的，当时我们整修了花园。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 这面墙是什么时候建的？
messages.en: When was this wall built?

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Inbena s-sena l-oħra, meta rranġajna l-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Inbena s-sena l-oħra, meta rranġajna l-ġnien.
messages.zh: 去年建的，当时我们整修了花园。
messages.en: It was built last year, when we renovated the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象石块一层层垒成一座桥，再记整句 Il-pont inbena bil-ġebel，把 inbena 与桥梁建成的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become different or to have something about it altered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得与原来不同，或其某个方面被改变。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir differenti minn kif kien qabel jew issir bidla fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被改变；变得与先前不同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Issir bidla f'xi ħaġa u din ma tibqax kif kienet qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is changed, it becomes different from how it was before.

formal.mt: Il-ħin tal-laqgħa inbidel mid-disgħa għall-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting time changed from nine to ten in the morning.
formal.zh: 会议时间由上午九点改为上午十点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadna se niltaqgħu fid-disgħa? Mark: Le, il-ħin inbidel. Issa se niltaqgħu fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we still meeting at nine? Mark: No, the time changed. We're meeting at ten now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们还是九点见吗？Mark：不是，时间改了。现在十点见。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还是九点见吗？
messages.en: Are we still meeting at nine?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-ħin inbidel. Issa se niltaqgħu fl-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-ħin inbidel. Issa se niltaqgħu fl-għaxra.
messages.zh: 不是，时间改了。现在十点见。
messages.en: No, the time changed. We're meeting at ten now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上的九点被改成十点，用“原来如此、现在变了”的前后对比记住 inbidel。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make the short, sharp sound that a dog makes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指狗发出短促而响亮的叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li kelb jagħmel il-ħoss qasir u qawwi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吠叫，指狗发出叫声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li kelb joħroġ il-leħen karatteristiku tiegħu, ġeneralment f'ħsejjes qosra u qawwija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a dog barks, it makes its characteristic short, sharp sound.

formal.mt: Meta jisma' ħoss ħdejn il-bieb, il-kelb jibda jinbaħ.
formal.en: When it hears a sound near the door, the dog starts barking.
formal.zh: 狗听到门边有声音时，就开始吠叫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kelb qed jinbaħ? Pawlu: Sema' lil xi ħadd ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the dog barking? Pawlu: It heard someone near the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：狗为什么在叫？Pawlu：它听到门边有人。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 狗为什么在叫？
messages.en: Why is the dog barking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Sema' lil xi ħadd ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Sema' lil xi ħadd ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 它听到门边有人。
messages.en: It heard someone near the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义配上小狗“汪汪叫”的画面，重点记住发出犬吠这一动作；例句用 jinbaħ 表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb listed as 'incedi' whose lexical meaning is not specified in the supplied packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词包中列为动词的 incedi；词包未提供可确定其具体含义的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb mogħti bil-forma 'incedi', li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex speċifikata fil-pakkett ipprovdut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅为大写形式“INCEDI”，未说明该动词的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pakkett jagħti biss 'INCEDI' bħala definizzjoni, mingħajr ma jispjega t-tifsira ta' dan il-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry identifies this form as a verb but provides no explanation of its lexical meaning.

collocations.zh: 动词“incedi”的含义（用于讨论词义）

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jikklassifika 'incedi' bħala verb, iżda jagħti biss 'INCEDI' bħala definizzjoni; għalhekk ma nistgħux niddeterminaw it-tifsira tiegħu minn din l-informazzjoni.
formal.en: The packet classifies 'incedi' as a verb but gives only 'INCEDI' as its definition; therefore, we cannot determine its meaning from this information.
formal.zh: 词包将“incedi”归为动词，但释义栏仅写有“INCEDI”；因此，无法根据这些信息确定其含义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser il-verb 'incedi' hawn? Toni: Ma nafux minn dan il-pakkett; id-definizzjoni tgħid biss 'INCEDI'.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the verb 'incedi' mean here? Toni: We cannot tell from this packet; the definition only says 'INCEDI'.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的动词“incedi”是什么意思？托尼：从这个词包看不出来；释义只写了“INCEDI”。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的动词“incedi”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb 'incedi' mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafux minn dan il-pakkett; id-definizzjoni tgħid biss 'INCEDI'.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafux minn dan il-pakkett; id-definizzjoni tgħid biss 'INCEDI'.
messages.zh: 从这个词包看不出来；释义只写了“INCEDI”。
messages.en: We cannot tell from this packet; the definition only says 'INCEDI'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 incedi 暂记为“词义待补的动词”：先记准确拼写和词性，不凭外形猜义，也不要与含 ċ 的词混记。

gloss_zh: 国际贸易术语；规定货物交付责任的贸易规则

teaching_sense.en_definition: Commercial terms that specify the responsibilities, costs, and risks of buyers and sellers when goods are delivered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于货物贸易、明确买卖双方在交付过程中各自责任、费用承担及风险划分的一组术语和规则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-Incoterms huma termini kummerċjali li jispeċifikaw ir-responsabbiltajiet, l-ispejjeż u r-riskji tax-xerrej u tal-bejjiegħ waqt il-kunsinna tal-merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国际贸易中用于界定买卖双方交货责任、费用承担和风险划分的贸易术语及规则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-Incoterms huma regoli kummerċjali li jgħinu biex jiġu definiti l-obbligi tax-xerrej u tal-bejjiegħ dwar il-kunsinna tal-merkanzija, inklużi l-ispejjeż u r-riskji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Incoterms are commercial terms used to define how buyers and sellers divide responsibilities, costs, and risks when delivering goods.

collocations.zh: 按照国际贸易术语规则

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt għandu jispeċifika l-Incoterms magħżula sabiex ir-responsabbiltajiet tax-xerrej u tal-bejjiegħ ikunu ċari.
formal.en: The contract should specify the selected Incoterms so that the responsibilities of the buyer and seller are clear.
formal.zh: 合同应注明所选用的国际贸易术语，以明确买卖双方的责任。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema Incoterms se nużaw għal din l-ordni? Mark: Ejja niċċekkjaw min se jħallas għat-trasport qabel nagħżlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which Incoterms are we going to use for this order? Mark: Let's check who will pay for transport before we choose.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这笔订单我们要采用哪种国际贸易术语？马克：我们先核实由谁支付运输费用，再作选择。

messages.speaker: Lara (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema Incoterms se nużaw għal din l-ordni?
messages.mt_standard: Liema Incoterms se nużaw għal din l-ordni?
messages.zh: 这笔订单我们要采用哪种国际贸易术语？
messages.en: Which Incoterms are we going to use for this order?

messages.speaker: Mark (供应商)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw min se jħallas għat-trasport qabel nagħżlu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw min se jħallas għat-trasport qabel nagħżlu.
messages.zh: 我们先核实由谁支付运输费用，再作选择。
messages.en: Let's check who will pay for transport before we choose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与一张交货分工表联系起来，表上写清谁负责运输、谁付费用、谁承担风险。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To seek facts or answers by investigating, examining, or searching carefully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为查明事实或找到答案而进行调查、仔细检查或搜寻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfittex fatti jew tweġibiet billi tiġbor informazzjoni, teżamina xi ħaġa bir-reqqa jew tagħmel tfittxija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 调查某一事件或情况，通过搜集资料查明事实、原因或经过。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiġbor u tivverifika informazzjoni dwar każ jew ġrajja sabiex tistabbilixxi x'ġara u għaliex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you investigate a case or event, you collect and check information to establish what happened and why.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仔细检查或审视某事物，以了解其细节、状况或问题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħares lejn xi ħaġa jew tistudjaha bir-reqqa sabiex tifhem id-dettalji, il-qagħda jew il-problemi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you examine something, you consider its details carefully in order to understand it or identify a problem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为找到所需的人、物或资料而进行搜寻或查找。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel tfittxija sabiex issib persuna, oġġett jew informazzjoni li tkun qed tfittex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you search for something, you look carefully in places where you think it may be found.

collocations.en: investigated the cause of the damage

formal.mt: L-ispettur indaga l-każ billi eżamina d-dokumenti u tkellem max-xhieda.
formal.en: The inspector investigated the case by examining the documents and speaking to the witnesses.
formal.zh: 调查员通过审查文件和询问证人调查了该案件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kompjuter għadu ma jaħdimx? Pawlu: It-tekniku indaga l-problema dalgħodu, imma għadu ma sabx il-kawża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the computer still not working? Pawlu: The technician investigated the problem this morning, but he still hasn't found the cause.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电脑怎么还不能用？保罗：技术员今天上午查过这个问题，但还没有找到原因。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 电脑怎么还不能用？
messages.en: Why is the computer still not working?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tekniku indaga l-problema dalgħodu, imma għadu ma sabx il-kawża.
messages.mt_standard: It-tekniku indaga l-problema dalgħodu, imma għadu ma sabx il-kawża.
messages.zh: 技术员今天上午查过这个问题，但还没有找到原因。
messages.en: The technician investigated the problem this morning, but he still hasn't found the cause.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象调查员先搜寻线索，再检查细节，最后查明事实，用这一连串动作记住三个相关义项。

gloss_zh: 楼梯平台；一段连续的楼梯

teaching_sense.en_definition: A landing on a staircase, or a continuous flight of stairs between landings or floors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 楼梯中供人停步或转向的平坦平台，也可指两个平台或楼层之间连续的一段楼梯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Indana hija pjan ċatt fit-taraġ fejn wieħed jista' jieqaf jew idur, jew medda ta' turġien bejn żewġ pjanijiet jew sulari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 楼梯平台，即楼梯途中或楼层入口处供人停步、转向的平坦部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Indana hija parti ċatta tat-taraġ, bejn medda ta' turġien u oħra jew fid-daħla ta' sular, fejn wieħed jista' jieqaf jew jibdel id-direzzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A landing is a flat area on a staircase where people can pause or change direction between flights.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一段楼梯，指两个平台或楼层之间连续排列的一组阶梯。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Indana hija medda kontinwa ta' turġien li twassal minn pjan jew sular għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flight of stairs is a continuous series of steps connecting one landing or floor to another.

collocations.en: to climb a flight of stairs

formal.mt: L-indana bejn iż-żewġ meded tat-taraġ għandha tibqa' ħielsa mill-ostakli biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jgħaddu.
formal.en: The landing between the two flights of stairs should remain free of obstacles so that people can pass.
formal.zh: 两段楼梯之间的平台应保持畅通，以便人们通行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għad fadlilna ħafna biex naslu fl-appartament? Toni: Indana taraġ oħra biss, imbagħad naslu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have we still got far to go before we reach the apartment? Toni: Just one more flight of stairs, then we're there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：离公寓还有很远吗？托尼：再上一段楼梯就到了。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadlilna ħafna biex naslu fl-appartament?
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadlilna ħafna biex naslu fl-appartament?
messages.zh: 离公寓还有很远吗？
messages.en: Have we still got far to go before we reach the apartment?

messages.speaker: Toni (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Indana taraġ oħra biss, imbagħad naslu.
messages.mt_standard: Indana taraġ oħra biss, imbagħad naslu.
messages.zh: 再上一段楼梯就到了。
messages.en: Just one more flight of stairs, then we're there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象上楼时走完一段阶梯，再到平台停步转弯；用同一幅楼梯画面分别记住一段楼梯和楼梯平台。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To descend and reach the ground when landing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从空中下降并到达地面，完成降落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżel mill-ajru u jasal fuq l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 降落，着陆；从空中下降到地面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jinżel mill-ajru u jasal fuq l-art fi tmiem it-titjira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When an aircraft lands, it comes down from the air and reaches the ground.

formal.mt: L-ajruplan indani bla periklu wara titjira twila.
formal.en: The aircraft landed safely after a long flight.
formal.zh: 飞机经过长途飞行后安全着陆。

colloquial.mt: Marta: L-ajruplan indani diġà? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-art u l-passiġġieri qed jinżlu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has the plane landed already? Pawlu: Yes, it is on the ground and the passengers are getting off.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：飞机已经降落了吗？保罗：是的，已经到地面了，乘客们正在下飞机。

messages.speaker: Marta (接机的朋友)
messages.zh: 飞机已经降落了吗？
messages.en: Has the plane landed already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-art u l-passiġġieri qed jinżlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-art u l-passiġġieri qed jinżlu.
messages.zh: 是的，已经到地面了，乘客们正在下飞机。
messages.en: Yes, it is on the ground and the passengers are getting off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indani 和飞机从天空降到跑道的画面一起记，再用“安全着陆”这个完整搭配复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become extremely angry about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事变得非常愤怒，勃然大怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirrabja ħafna minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得非常愤怒；大发雷霆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jirrabja ħafna u juri rabja qawwija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone becomes very angry, they begin to feel intense anger about something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配偶的母亲；岳母或婆婆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-omm tar-raġel jew tal-mara li persuna tkun miżżewġa lilha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your mother-in-law is the mother of the person you are married to.

collocations.en: became very angry when he heard the news

formal.mt: Ir-raġel indanna meta sar jaf li xi ħadd kien kiser il-ftehim.
formal.en: The man became very angry when he learned that someone had broken the agreement.
formal.zh: 那名男子得知有人违反了协议后勃然大怒。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min ġej għall-ikel il-Ħadd? Toni: L-indanna tiegħi; hi omm marti.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is coming for lunch on Sunday? Toni: My mother-in-law; she is my wife's mother.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：星期天谁来吃午饭？托尼：我岳母，就是我妻子的母亲。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 星期天谁来吃午饭？
messages.en: Who is coming for lunch on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Toni (已婚的朋友)
messages.zh: 我岳母，就是我妻子的母亲。
messages.en: My mother-in-law; she is my wife's mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 indanna 分开做两张词卡：动词卡画怒气表情，名词卡画配偶的母亲；两个词性分别记忆，不把亲属身份和愤怒联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter or become involved in someone's space, conversation, or affairs, especially when unwelcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入别人的空间、谈话或事务，尤指未经邀请或不受欢迎地闯入、插手或干预。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tidħol fl-ispazju, fil-konversazzjoni jew fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor, speċjalment meta ma tkunx mistieden jew l-involviment tiegħek ma jkunx mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未经邀请或不合时宜地闯入别人的空间、私人活动或谈话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tidħol f'post, f'attività privata jew f'konversazzjoni ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr stedina jew f'ħin mhux xieraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you intrude, you enter someone's space or activity when your presence is unwanted or inappropriate.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多管闲事，擅自插手本不需要自己参与的他人事务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tinvolvi ruħek bla bżonn fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor, speċjalment meta ma jkunux talbuk tagħmel dan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you meddle in someone's affairs, you involve yourself unnecessarily in matters that are their responsibility.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 介入他人的行动或某一过程，并对其造成干扰或不受欢迎的影响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tinvolvi ruħek f'azzjoni jew fi proċess b'mod li jfixkel jew jinfluwenza dak li jkun qed isir mingħajr ma jkun mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you interfere, you become involved in a situation in a way that disrupts or undesirably influences what happens.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif uffiċjal indaħal fil-proċess tal-għażla u influwenza d-deċiżjoni tal-kumitat.
formal.en: The report describes how an official interfered in the selection process and influenced the committee's decision.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一名官员如何干预遴选过程，并影响委员会的决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Jekk jogħġbok, tindaħalx fl-affarijiet tiegħi. Luka: Sewwa, ridt biss ngħin. Nistenna sakemm titlobni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Please don't meddle in my affairs. Luka: All right, I only wanted to help. I'll wait until you ask me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：请别插手我的事。卢卡：好，我只是想帮忙。我会等你开口再帮。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 请别插手我的事。
messages.en: Please don't meddle in my affairs.

messages.speaker: Luka (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, ridt biss ngħin. Nistenna sakemm titlobni.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, ridt biss ngħin. Nistenna sakemm titlobni.
messages.zh: 好，我只是想帮忙。我会等你开口再帮。
messages.en: All right, I only wanted to help. I'll wait until you ask me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一条私人边界来记忆：越过空间边界是闯入，越过事务边界是插手，影响事情进展就是干预。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To agree to do something that one considers beneath one's dignity or importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 屈尊做自己认为有失身份或不值得做的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaċċetta li jagħmel xi ħaġa li jqisha taħt id-dinjità jew l-importanza tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 屈尊，俯就；愿意做自认为不符合身份的事，常带讽刺意味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaċċetta li jagħmel xi ħaġa minkejja li jqisha taħt id-dinjità tiegħu, spiss b'ton ironiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone deigns to do something, they agree to do it although they consider it beneath their dignity.

formal.mt: Wara diversi talbiet, id-direttur fl-aħħar indenja jwieġeb għall-mistoqsija.
formal.en: After several requests, the director finally deigned to answer the question.
formal.zh: 在多次请求之后，主任终于屈尊回答了这个问题。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Mark wieġbek fl-aħħar? Lara: Iva, wara ġimgħa indenja jwieġeb!
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Mark finally reply to you? Lara: Yes, after a week he deigned to reply!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克终于回复你了吗？拉拉：是啊，过了一个星期，他总算肯屈尊回复了！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克终于回复你了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark finally reply to you?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，过了一个星期，他总算肯屈尊回复了！
messages.en: Yes, after a week he deigned to reply!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个自视甚高的人终于肯开口回答，用“总算肯屈尊回答”记住 indenja 的态度和常见讽刺语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of interest, concern, or emotional involvement in someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人、某事或某种情况缺乏兴趣、关心或情感投入的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-indifferenza hija nuqqas ta' interess, tħassib jew involviment emozzjonali lejn persuna, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对人或事不感兴趣、不关心或无动于衷的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-indifferenza hija attitudni ta' persuna li ma turix interess jew tħassib dwar xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Indifference is the attitude you show when you have little interest in or concern about someone or something.

collocations.zh: 对他人的问题漠不关心

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-indifferenza lejn il-ħtiġijiet tar-residenti u jitlob attenzjoni akbar għal dawn il-ħtiġijiet.
formal.en: The report describes indifference to residents' needs and calls for greater attention to those needs.
formal.zh: 报告描述了对居民需求漠不关心的现象，并呼吁更加重视这些需求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għedtlu bil-problema tiegħi, imma lanqas staqsieni kif jien. Lara: Dik l-indifferenza tweġġa'. Trid titkellem miegħi dwarha?
colloquial.en: Maja: I told him about my problem, but he didn't even ask how I was. Lara: That indifference hurts. Do you want to talk to me about it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我跟他说了我的问题，可他连我怎么样都没问。拉拉：这种冷漠很伤人。你想跟我聊聊吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtlu bil-problema tiegħi, imma lanqas staqsieni kif jien.
messages.mt_standard: Għedtlu bil-problema tiegħi, imma lanqas staqsieni kif jien.
messages.zh: 我跟他说了我的问题，可他连我怎么样都没问。
messages.en: I told him about my problem, but he didn't even ask how I was.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik l-indifferenza tweġġa'. Trid titkellem miegħi dwarha?
messages.mt_standard: Dik l-indifferenza tweġġa'. Trid titkellem miegħi dwarha?
messages.zh: 这种冷漠很伤人。你想跟我聊聊吗？
messages.en: That indifference hurts. Do you want to talk to me about it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indifferenza 放进“别人求助，我却毫无反应”的画面，记住它表达的是冷漠或漠不关心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single measure formed by combining several individual indicators.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将多个单项指标组合起来，用于概括某种整体状况的单一指标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Indikatur kompost huwa kejl wieħed li jinħoloq billi jingħaqdu diversi indikaturi individwali biex jagħti stampa ġenerali ta' qagħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由若干单项指标合成、用于反映整体情况的综合性指标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Indikatur kompost huwa indikatur li jiġbor fih diversi indikaturi separati u jgħaqqadhom f'kejl wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A composite indicator is a single measure that combines several individual indicators to summarize a broader condition or level of performance.

collocations.en: a composite indicator of quality of life

formal.mt: L-istudju juża indikatur kompost li jgħaqqad data dwar is-saħħa, l-edukazzjoni u d-dħul biex jiddeskrivi l-kwalità tal-ħajja.
formal.en: The study uses a composite indicator combining data on health, education, and income to describe quality of life.
formal.zh: 该研究采用一个结合健康、教育和收入数据的综合指标来描述生活质量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm numru wieħed biss għal dawn it-tliet oqsma? Pawlu: Għax dan huwa indikatur kompost. Jiġbor it-tliet indikaturi f'kejl wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there only one number for these three areas? Pawlu: Because this is a composite indicator. It combines the three indicators into one measure.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这三个方面为什么只有一个数值？保罗：因为这是综合指标。它把三个指标合成一个衡量值。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm numru wieħed biss għal dawn it-tliet oqsma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm numru wieħed biss għal dawn it-tliet oqsma?
messages.zh: 这三个方面为什么只有一个数值？
messages.en: Why is there only one number for these three areas?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan huwa indikatur kompost. Jiġbor it-tliet indikaturi f'kejl wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan huwa indikatur kompost. Jiġbor it-tliet indikaturi f'kejl wieħed.
messages.zh: 因为这是综合指标。它把三个指标合成一个衡量值。
messages.en: Because this is a composite indicator. It combines the three indicators into one measure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indikatur kompost 想成“几条小指标汇入一个总指标”：indikatur 记指标，kompost 在这里记组合而成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Measures used to assess how effectively security is maintained during operations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于评估业务或作业运行过程中安全保障成效的一组衡量指标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-indikaturi tal-prestazzjoni ta' sigurtà operazzjonali huma miżuri li jintużaw biex jiġi vvalutat kemm tinżamm b'mod effettiv is-sigurtà waqt l-operazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于衡量和评估运营过程中安全保障表现与成效的指标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-indikaturi tal-prestazzjoni ta' sigurtà operazzjonali huma miżuri li jgħinu biex jiġu segwiti u evalwati r-riżultati tal-ħidma marbuta mas-sigurtà waqt l-operazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Operational security performance indicators are measures that an organization uses to monitor and evaluate how effectively it maintains security during its operations.

collocations.mt: monitoraġġ tal-indikaturi tal-prestazzjoni ta' sigurtà operazzjonali
collocations.zh: 监测运营安全绩效指标

collocations.mt: analiżi tal-indikaturi tal-prestazzjoni ta' sigurtà operazzjonali
collocations.en: analysis of operational security performance indicators
collocations.zh: 运营安全绩效指标分析

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ta' kull xahar jippreżenta l-indikaturi tal-prestazzjoni ta' sigurtà operazzjonali u jqabbel ir-riżultati mal-miri stabbiliti.
formal.en: The monthly report presents the operational security performance indicators and compares the results with the established targets.
formal.zh: 月度报告列出了运营安全绩效指标，并将结果与既定目标进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għad jonqos fir-rapport? Mark: L-indikaturi tal-prestazzjoni ta' sigurtà operazzjonali. Għandi d-data, imma għad irrid inqabbel ir-riżultati ma' dawk tax-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's still missing from the report? Mark: The operational security performance indicators. I have the data, but I still need to compare the results with last month's.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：报告里还缺什么？马克：运营安全绩效指标。数据我有了，但还得把结果与上个月的进行比较。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 报告里还缺什么？
messages.en: What's still missing from the report?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-indikaturi tal-prestazzjoni ta' sigurtà operazzjonali. Għandi d-data, imma għad irrid inqabbel ir-riżultati ma' dawk tax-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: L-indikaturi tal-prestazzjoni ta' sigurtà operazzjonali. Għandi d-data, imma għad irrid inqabbel ir-riżultati ma' dawk tax-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: 运营安全绩效指标。数据我有了，但还得把结果与上个月的进行比较。
messages.en: The operational security performance indicators. I have the data, but I still need to compare the results with last month's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分三段记：indikaturi 是“指标”，tal-prestazzjoni 是“绩效的”，ta' sigurtà operazzjonali 是“运营安全方面的”；想象月报里的一组安全绩效数据。

gloss_zh: 健康声称；关于健康益处的宣称

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement suggesting that a product or ingredient has a beneficial effect on health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声称或暗示某种产品或成分对健康具有益处的表述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stqarrija li tgħid jew tissuġġerixxi li prodott jew ingredjent għandu effett ta' benefiċċju fuq is-saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 健康声称，指宣称某种产品或成分与健康益处有关的表述。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stqarrija dwar prodott jew ingredjent li tippreżentah bħala wieħed li jista' jkun ta' benefiċċju għas-saħħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A health claim is a statement that says or suggests that a product or ingredient provides a health benefit.

collocations.en: a health claim on the label

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-indikazzjoni dwar is-saħħa fuq it-tikketta u l-informazzjoni li fuqha hija bbażata.
formal.en: The report examines the health claim on the label and the information on which it is based.
formal.zh: 这份报告审查了标签上的健康声称及其所依据的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajtha din l-indikazzjoni dwar is-saħħa fuq il-kaxxa? Mark: Iva, imma ejja naqraw ukoll il-bqija tat-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see this health claim on the box? Mark: Yes, but let's read the rest of the label too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到盒子上的这项健康声称了吗？Mark：看到了，不过我们也读读标签上的其他内容吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha din l-indikazzjoni dwar is-saħħa fuq il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha din l-indikazzjoni dwar is-saħħa fuq il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你看到盒子上的这项健康声称了吗？
messages.en: Did you see this health claim on the box?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja naqraw ukoll il-bqija tat-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja naqraw ukoll il-bqija tat-tikketta.
messages.zh: 看到了，不过我们也读读标签上的其他内容吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's read the rest of the label too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词联想成包装上的一句健康宣传语；其中 dwar 表示“关于”，is-saħħa 表示“健康”，帮助记住它指的是健康声称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that does not depend on another person's help, control, or decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不依赖他人帮助、控制或决定的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li ma jiddependix fuq l-għajnuna, il-kontroll jew id-deċiżjonijiet ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独立地；不依靠他人的帮助或不受他人支配地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod awtonomu, mingħajr ma wieħed jiddependi fuq l-għajnuna jew il-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone acts independently, they act without relying on another person's help or being controlled by them.

formal.mt: Kull membru tat-tim evalwa l-proposta indipendentement qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Each team member evaluated the proposal independently before the meeting.
formal.zh: 每位团队成员都在会议前独立评估了这项提案。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tridni ngħinek b'dan l-eżerċizzju? Luca: Grazzi, imma nixtieq nipprova naħdmu indipendentement l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like me to help you with this exercise? Luca: Thanks, but I'd like to try doing it independently first.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你想让我帮你做这道练习吗？Luca：谢谢，不过我想先试着独立完成。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你想让我帮你做这道练习吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to help you with this exercise?

messages.speaker: Luca (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, imma nixtieq nipprova naħdmu indipendentement l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, imma nixtieq nipprova naħdmu indipendentement l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 谢谢，不过我想先试着独立完成。
messages.en: Thanks, but I'd like to try doing it independently first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“他独立地工作”记这个副词，把 indipendentement 紧贴“工作、生活、判断”等动作，记住它回答“怎样做”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Free to act or make decisions without depending on or being controlled by others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够自主行动或作出决定，不依赖他人或不受他人控制的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jaġixxi jew jieħu deċiżjonijiet għalih innifsu mingħajr ma jiddependi fuq ħaddieħor jew ikun ikkontrollat minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独立的；能够自主行动、作决定或维持自身运作的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-libertà li jaġixxi u jieħu d-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu stess, mingħajr dipendenza fuq ħaddieħor jew kontroll minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is independent can act or function without depending on others or being controlled by them.

formal.mt: L-istituzzjoni talbet lil espert indipendenti biex jevalwa r-riżultati tal-istudju.
formal.en: The institution asked an independent expert to evaluate the study's results.
formal.zh: 该机构请一位独立专家评估这项研究的结果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sejra fil-post il-ġdid? Lara: Tajjeb! Issa jien aktar indipendenti u nieħu ħsieb ix-xiri u t-tisjir waħdi.
colloquial.en: Nina: How are you getting on in your new place? Lara: Well! I'm more independent now and handle the shopping and cooking myself.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你在新住处过得怎么样？Lara：挺好的！我现在更独立了，买菜和做饭都自己安排。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在新住处过得怎么样？
messages.en: How are you getting on in your new place?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Issa jien aktar indipendenti u nieħu ħsieb ix-xiri u t-tisjir waħdi.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Issa jien aktar indipendenti u nieħu ħsieb ix-xiri u t-tisjir waħdi.
messages.zh: 挺好的！我现在更独立了，买菜和做饭都自己安排。
messages.en: Well! I'm more independent now and handle the shopping and cooking myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indipendenti 配上“独立的人、独立的国家”，记住它描述人或事物的性质；中文先补一个“的”，就容易认出形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being able to act, decide, or govern without depending on or being controlled by others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够自主行动、作决定或治理自身，不依赖他人或不受他人控制的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min jista' jaġixxi, jieħu deċiżjonijiet jew imexxi l-affarijiet tiegħu mingħajr dipendenza fuq ħaddieħor jew kontroll minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独立、自主的状态，指个人、组织或国家能够自行决定和管理自身事务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-libertà u l-kapaċità ta' persuna, organizzazzjoni jew pajjiż li jieħu d-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu u jmexxi l-affarijiet tiegħu stess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Independence is the freedom or ability to manage your own affairs without relying on others or being controlled by them.

formal.mt: Il-programm jgħin liż-żgħażagħ jiżviluppaw il-ħiliet meħtieġa biex jiksbu indipendenza finanzjarja.
formal.en: The programme helps young people develop the skills needed to achieve financial independence.
formal.zh: 该项目帮助年轻人培养实现经济独立所需的技能。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex trid issib xogħol matul is-sajf? Elena: Irrid naqla' flus tiegħi u jkolli aktar indipendenza.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why do you want to find a job during the summer? Elena: I want to earn my own money and have more independence.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：你为什么想在暑假找份工作？Elena：我想自己挣钱，让自己更独立一些。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid issib xogħol matul is-sajf?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid issib xogħol matul is-sajf?
messages.zh: 你为什么想在暑假找份工作？
messages.en: Why do you want to find a job during the summer?

messages.speaker: Elena (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid naqla' flus tiegħi u jkolli aktar indipendenza.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid naqla' flus tiegħi u jkolli aktar indipendenza.
messages.zh: 我想自己挣钱，让自己更独立一些。
messages.en: I want to earn my own money and have more independence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“获得独立、保持自主”记 indipendenza：这里把“独立”当作一种可以获得或保持的状态，帮助区分名词与“独立的、独立地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The address of the place where a person lives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人居住地点的地址，通常包括街道、门牌号码和城镇等信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-indirizz tal-post fejn tgħix persuna, li normalment jinkludi t-triq, in-numru tad-dar u l-lokalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 个人住所的地址，用于说明住在哪里或接收寄往住所的邮件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-indirizz li jidentifika fejn tinsab id-dar ta' persuna u li jista' jintuża biex tintbagħat posta hemmhekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your home address is the address of the house or other place where you live.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok ikteb l-indirizz tad-dar tiegħek fuq il-formola, inkluż il-kodiċi postali.
formal.en: Please write your home address on the form, including the postcode.
formal.zh: 请在表格上填写您的家庭住址，包括邮政编码。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi l-indirizz tal-uffiċċju tiegħek. Tista' tibgħatli l-indirizz tad-dar ukoll? Pawlu: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun taf fejn tiġi għall-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have your office address. Can you send me your home address too? Pawlu: Yes, I will send it now so you know where to come for the meal.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我有你的办公室地址，也可以把家庭住址发给我吗？Pawlu：可以，我现在就发给你，这样你就知道来哪里吃饭了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-indirizz tal-uffiċċju tiegħek. Tista' tibgħatli l-indirizz tad-dar ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-indirizz tal-uffiċċju tiegħek. Tista' tibgħatli l-indirizz tad-dar ukoll?
messages.zh: 我有你的办公室地址，也可以把家庭住址发给我吗？
messages.en: I have your office address. Can you send me your home address too?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友兼主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun taf fejn tiġi għall-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun taf fejn tiġi għall-ikel.
messages.zh: 可以，我现在就发给你，这样你就知道来哪里吃饭了。
messages.en: Yes, I will send it now so you know where to come for the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与表格里的“家庭住址”一栏对应，想象填写街道、门牌和邮编。

gloss_zh: 写给某人的；寄给某人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Written or directed to a particular recipient or audience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指信件、信息或文件以某个特定的人或群体为接收对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun miktub jew mibgħut lil persuna jew lil grupp partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以某人或某个群体为收件人或接收对象的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun maħsub biex jasal għand persuna jew grupp speċifiku bħala r-riċevitur tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a letter or message is addressed to someone, that person is its intended recipient.

collocations.en: a report addressed to the director

formal.mt: Dan ir-rapport huwa indirizzat lid-direttur u fih ir-riżultati tal-istħarriġ.
formal.en: This report is addressed to the director and contains the survey results.
formal.zh: 这份报告呈交给主管，内容包括调查结果。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għal min hu indirizzat dan il-pakkett? Lara: Huwa indirizzat lilek; ismek qiegħed fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is this parcel addressed to? Lara: It is addressed to you; your name is on the label.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个包裹是寄给谁的？Lara：寄给你的，标签上写着你的名字。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal min hu indirizzat dan il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Għal min hu indirizzat dan il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 这个包裹是寄给谁的？
messages.en: Who is this parcel addressed to?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa indirizzat lilek; ismek qiegħed fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa indirizzat lilek; ismek qiegħed fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 寄给你的，标签上写着你的名字。
messages.en: It is addressed to you; your name is on the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象包裹标签上写着你的名字，把 indirizzat lilek 整块记成“寄给你的”。

gloss_zh: 不可摧毁的；无法毁坏的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impossible to destroy or break.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法被摧毁或弄坏的；日常表达中也可用来夸张形容极其坚固。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jinqered jew jitkisser; fil-kliem ta' kuljum jista' jiddeskrivi wkoll xi ħaġa b'saħħitha ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不能被摧毁或破坏的，也可夸张地指非常结实耐用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi meqrud jew imkisser, jew li jidher tant b'saħħtu li diffiċli ħafna ssirlu ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is indestructible, it cannot be destroyed, or is so strong that it seems impossible to damage.

collocations.zh: 看起来怎么也玩不坏的玩具

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tarka hija indistruttibbli u tipproteġi lill-eroj minn kull daqqa.
formal.en: In the story, the shield is indestructible and protects the hero from every blow.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这面盾牌无法被摧毁，能够保护英雄抵挡每一次攻击。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-ġugarell waqa' kemm-il darba u għadu sħiħ! Jidher indistruttibbli. Karl: Veru, imma xorta għandna noqogħdu attenti bih.
colloquial.en: Nina: This toy has fallen so many times and is still in one piece! It seems indestructible. Karl: True, but we should still take care of it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个玩具摔了那么多次还完好无损！看起来怎么也弄不坏。Karl：确实，不过我们还是应该爱惜它。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ġugarell waqa' kemm-il darba u għadu sħiħ! Jidher indistruttibbli.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ġugarell waqa' kemm-il darba u għadu sħiħ! Jidher indistruttibbli.
messages.zh: 这个玩具摔了那么多次还完好无损！看起来怎么也弄不坏。
messages.en: This toy has fallen so many times and is still in one piece! It seems indestructible.

messages.speaker: Karl (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, imma xorta għandna noqogħdu attenti bih.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, imma xorta għandna noqogħdu attenti bih.
messages.zh: 确实，不过我们还是应该爱惜它。
messages.en: True, but we should still take care of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里永远打不碎的盾牌，把 indistruttibbli 与“不可摧毁”这个画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to one person or thing considered separately, or done by one person alone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与单独一个人或事物有关的，或由一个人独自完成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda persuna jew ħaġa waħda meqjusa għaliha, jew li jsir minn persuna waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 属于或针对单个人或事物的；由个人单独进行的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' persuna jew ħaġa waħda separatament mill-oħrajn, jew li jitwettaq minn persuna waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Individual activities, needs, or arrangements concern one person or thing considered separately from others.

collocations.zh: 个人独立完成的作业或工作

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi laqgħat individwali biex kull student ikun jista' jiddiskuti l-progress tiegħu mal-għalliem.
formal.en: The course includes individual meetings so that each student can discuss their progress with the teacher.
formal.zh: 课程安排了单独面谈，让每位学生都能与老师讨论自己的学习进展。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ix-xogħol nagħmluh fi grupp? Ben: Le, huwa xogħol individwali. Kull wieħed minna jrid jagħmel tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we do this assignment in a group? Ben: No, it is individual work. Each of us has to do our own.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这份作业要小组一起做吗？Ben：这是个人作业，我们每个人都得自己完成一份。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这份作业要小组一起做吗？
messages.en: Do we do this assignment in a group?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa xogħol individwali. Kull wieħed minna jrid jagħmel tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa xogħol individwali. Kull wieħed minna jrid jagħmel tiegħu.
messages.zh: 这是个人作业，我们每个人都得自己完成一份。
messages.en: No, it is individual work. Each of us has to do our own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师给每个人各发一张作业纸，用 xogħol individwali 记住“个人独立完成的作业”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outlook that emphasizes each person's independence, choices, and interests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强调个人独立、个人选择及个人利益的观念或思想倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fehma li tagħti importanza lill-indipendenza, lill-għażliet u lill-interessi tal-persuna bħala individwu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 个人主义；重视个人自主、个人选择和个人利益的思想倾向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod ta' ħsieb li jenfasizza l-libertà u l-indipendenza tal-individwu u l-importanza tal-għażliet personali tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Individualism is the belief that people's independence and personal choices should be given considerable importance.

formal.mt: L-esej jiddiskuti kif l-individwaliżmu jista' jsaħħaħ l-għażla personali, filwaqt li l-kooperazzjoni tibqa' meħtieġa għall-ġid komuni.
formal.en: The essay discusses how individualism can strengthen personal choice while cooperation remains necessary for the common good.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讨论个人主义如何增强个人选择的自主性，同时指出合作对于共同利益仍然必不可少。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum tkellimna dwar l-individwaliżmu fil-klassi. Mark: Jiġifieri li kull persuna għandha tkun tista' tagħmel l-għażliet tagħha? Maja: Iva, iżda dan ma jfissirx li ma tistax taħdem ma' ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Today we talked about individualism in class. Mark: Does that mean each person should be able to make their own choices? Maja: Yes, but that doesn't mean you can't work with other people.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天我们在课堂上讨论了个人主义。Mark：意思是每个人都应该能够自己作选择吗？Maja：是的，但这并不表示不能与别人合作。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 今天我们在课堂上讨论了个人主义。
messages.en: Today we talked about individualism in class.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li kull persuna għandha tkun tista' tagħmel l-għażliet tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li kull persuna għandha tkun tista' tagħmel l-għażliet tagħha?
messages.zh: 意思是每个人都应该能够自己作选择吗？
messages.en: Does that mean each person should be able to make their own choices?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda dan ma jfissirx li ma tistax taħdem ma' ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda dan ma jfissirx li ma tistax taħdem ma' ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 是的，但这并不表示不能与别人合作。
messages.en: Yes, but that doesn't mean you can't work with other people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义放进“我自己作选择”的画面中记忆：这里指强调个人自主的思想观念，不直接等于自私。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single person considered separately from other people or from a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为独立单位来考虑的一个人，区别于群体或其他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna waħda meqjusa għaliha, separatament mill-oħrajn jew mill-grupp li tagħmel parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 个人；作为独立单位看待的一个人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna waħda li titqies bħala unità separata minn persuni oħra jew minn grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An individual is one person considered separately from the other people in a group or society.

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' taħriġ iqis il-ħtiġijiet ta' kull individwu u joffri appoġġ skont il-livell tiegħu.
formal.en: The training programme considers each individual's needs and offers support according to their level.
formal.zh: 这项培训计划考虑每个人的需求，并按照各自的水平提供支持。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Niktbu tweġiba waħda għall-grupp kollu? Pawlu: Le, kull individwu għandu jikteb it-tweġiba tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we write one answer for the whole group? Pawlu: No, each individual should write their own answer.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们全组写一个答案吗？Pawlu：不，每个人都应该写自己的答案。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们全组写一个答案吗？
messages.en: Shall we write one answer for the whole group?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kull individwu għandu jikteb it-tweġiba tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kull individwu għandu jikteb it-tweġiba tiegħu.
messages.zh: 不，每个人都应该写自己的答案。
messages.en: No, each individual should write their own answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把集体照片中的一个人单独圈出来：individwu 就是作为独立单位来看待的“个人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Offensive because it violates accepted standards of decency, especially in relation to sex or the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不符合公认的得体或端庄标准、令人反感的，尤其涉及性或身体方面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jmur kontra dak li jitqies deċenti u jista' joffendi, speċjalment dwar is-sess jew il-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不雅的，有伤风化的；尤指涉及性或身体、违反公认得体标准的言语或行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jikser ir-regoli aċċettati tad-deċenza, speċjalment fi kliem jew imġiba marbuta mas-sess jew mal-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something indecent offends accepted standards of decency, especially because it concerns sex or the body in an inappropriate way.

formal.mt: Ir-regolamenti tal-avveniment jipprojbixxu kliem indiċenti u ġesti li jistgħu joffendu lill-pubbliku.
formal.en: The event regulations prohibit indecent language and gestures that may offend the public.
formal.zh: 活动规定禁止使用不雅言语，以及做出可能冒犯公众的手势。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tlabtni nneħħi dak il-messaġġ? Ben: Għax fih kliem indiċenti; jekk jogħġbok, ibdlu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you ask me to remove that message? Ben: Because it contains indecent language; please change it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么让我删掉那条消息？本：因为里面有不雅言语，请修改一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (聊天群成员)
messages.zh: 你为什么让我删掉那条消息？
messages.en: Why did you ask me to remove that message?

messages.speaker: Ben (聊天群管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fih kliem indiċenti; jekk jogħġbok, ibdlu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fih kliem indiċenti; jekk jogħġbok, ibdlu.
messages.zh: 因为里面有不雅言语，请修改一下。
messages.en: Because it contains indecent language; please change it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indiċenti 配上“不雅言语”和“不雅手势”两幅提示图，记住它描述触犯得体标准、可能令人反感的内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lacks sufficient money or resources to meet basic needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏足够金钱或生活资源，难以满足基本生活需要的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Indiġent huwa bniedem li ma għandux biżżejjed flus jew mezzi oħra biex jissodisfa l-ħtiġijiet bażiċi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经济贫困、缺乏基本生活所需资源的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Indiġent huwa persuna fqira li ma għandhiex mezzi biżżejjed għall-ħtiġijiet essenzjali tal-ħajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An indigent is a person who has very little money and lacks the resources needed for basic living expenses.

collocations.en: the needs of an indigent person

formal.mt: Is-servizz joffri lill-indiġent ikel, ħwejjeġ u għajnuna biex isib akkomodazzjoni xierqa.
formal.en: The service offers an indigent person food, clothing, and help finding suitable accommodation.
formal.zh: 该服务为贫困者提供食物、衣物，并帮助其寻找合适的住所。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser il-kelma indiġent f'dan l-avviż? Sara: Tfisser persuna fqira li ma għandhiex biżżejjed mezzi għall-ħtiġijiet bażiċi tagħha.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does the word indiġent mean in this notice? Sara: It means a poor person who does not have enough resources to meet their basic needs.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这则通知里的 indiġent 是什么意思？萨拉：指缺乏足够资源来满足基本生活需要的贫困者。

messages.speaker: Mark (社区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma indiġent f'dan l-avviż?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma indiġent f'dan l-avviż?
messages.zh: 这则通知里的 indiġent 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word indiġent mean in this notice?

messages.speaker: Sara (社区工作人员)
