messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser persuna fqira li ma għandhiex biżżejjed mezzi għall-ħtiġijiet bażiċi tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser persuna fqira li ma għandhiex biżżejjed mezzi għall-ħtiġijiet bażiċi tagħha.
messages.zh: 指缺乏足够资源来满足基本生活需要的贫困者。
messages.en: It means a poor person who does not have enough resources to meet their basic needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indiġent 和“需要基本生活援助的人”联系起来；本条按名词记，指贫困者这个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From India, or connected with India, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自印度的，或与印度、印度人民及印度文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Indja jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Indja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印度的；与印度、印度人民或印度文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni lill-Indja jew li għandu rabta man-nies, mal-kultura jew mat-tradizzjonijiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Indian comes from India or is connected with its people or culture.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to India
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自印度的；涉及印度或与印度有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-oriġini tiegħu fl-Indja jew li jirrigwarda lil dan il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described this way originates in India or has a connection with that country.

formal.mt: Il-klabb taċ-ċinema se juri film indjan u wara jorganizza diskussjoni dwar it-temi tiegħu.
formal.en: The cinema club will screen an Indian film and then hold a discussion about its themes.
formal.zh: 电影社将放映一部印度电影，随后组织一场关于影片主题的讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid nippruvaw ikel indjan illejla? David: Iva, hemm ristorant indjan ħdejn l-istazzjon.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we try Indian food tonight? David: Yes, there's an Indian restaurant near the station.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今晚我们尝尝印度菜好吗？David：好，车站附近有一家印度餐馆。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚我们尝尝印度菜好吗？
messages.en: Shall we try Indian food tonight?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ristorant indjan ħdejn l-istazzjon.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ristorant indjan ħdejn l-istazzjon.
messages.zh: 好，车站附近有一家印度餐馆。
messages.en: Yes, there's an Indian restaurant near the station.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“印度电影、印度食物”两幅画面记住 indjan；本条是修饰名词的形容词，表示来自印度或与印度有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Laziness or an unwillingness to make an effort or do work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不愿付出努力或从事工作的懒惰、懒散状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ħeġġa jew rieda biex wieħed jaħdem jew jagħmel sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒散；因不愿活动、工作或付出努力而表现出的懒惰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għażż jew nuqqas ta' rieda li wieħed ikun attiv, jaħdem jew jagħmel sforz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Indolence is a state of laziness in which someone is unwilling to work or make an effort.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怠惰；不愿工作或用力的懒惰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għażż li jidher meta persuna tevita x-xogħol jew ma tkunx trid tagħmel sforz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sloth is laziness that makes a person unwilling to work or exert themselves.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-karattru prinċipali jegħleb l-indolenza billi jistabbilixxi għanijiet żgħar u jaħdem fuqhom kuljum.
formal.en: In the story, the main character overcomes laziness by setting small goals and working on them every day.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人公通过设定小目标并每天努力实现这些目标，克服了懒惰。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadni ma bdejtx l-eżerċizzji, għalkemm kelli ħin. Toni: Minħabba l-indolenza? Nina: Iva, ma kellix aptit nagħmilhom. Se nibda b'wieħed issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: I still haven't started the exercises, even though I had time. Toni: Because of laziness? Nina: Yes, I didn't feel like doing them. I'll start with one now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：虽然有时间，我还是没开始做练习。Toni：是因为懒惰吗？Nina：对，我就是不想做。现在我先做一道。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma bdejtx l-eżerċizzji, għalkemm kelli ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma bdejtx l-eżerċizzji, għalkemm kelli ħin.
messages.zh: 虽然有时间，我还是没开始做练习。
messages.en: I still haven't started the exercises, even though I had time.

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 是因为懒惰吗？
messages.en: Because of laziness?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma kellix aptit nagħmilhom. Se nibda b'wieħed issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma kellix aptit nagħmilhom. Se nibda b'wieħed issa.
messages.zh: 对，我就是不想做。现在我先做一道。
messages.en: Yes, I didn't feel like doing them. I'll start with one now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象练习本已经摊开，却因为懒得动手而一直拖着：indolenza 记作“懒散、怠惰”；这里的 sloth 指懒惰，不指动物树懒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin layer of gold or a gold-coloured finish applied to decorate a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖在物体表面、用于装饰的薄金层或金色饰面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saff irqiq tad-deheb jew kisi lewn id-deheb li jitqiegħed fuq wiċċ oġġett biex iżejnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物体表面的镀金层或金色装饰饰面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kisi tad-deheb jew lewn id-deheb fuq il-wiċċ ta' oġġett, magħmul għal skop dekorattiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The gilding on an object is the thin gold or gold-coloured covering that decorates its surface.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tar-restawr jindika li l-induratura fuq il-qafas għandha titnaddaf b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The restoration report indicates that the gilding on the frame should be cleaned carefully.
formal.zh: 修复报告指出，画框上的镀金饰面应当小心清洁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-qafas kollu tad-deheb? Pawlu: Le, għandu biss induratura fuq il-wiċċ. Marija: Mela rridu noqogħdu attenti meta nnaddfuh.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this frame made entirely of gold? Pawlu: No, it only has gilding on the surface. Marija: Then we need to be careful when we clean it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个画框全是金子做的吗？Pawlu：不是，只是表面有镀金层。Marija：那我们清洁的时候得小心。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个画框全是金子做的吗？
messages.en: Is this frame made entirely of gold?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandu biss induratura fuq il-wiċċ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandu biss induratura fuq il-wiċċ.
messages.zh: 不是，只是表面有镀金层。
messages.en: No, it only has gilding on the surface.

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rridu noqogħdu attenti meta nnaddfuh.
messages.mt_standard: Mela rridu noqogħdu attenti meta nnaddfuh.
messages.zh: 那我们清洁的时候得小心。
messages.en: Then we need to be careful when we clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画框外面薄薄的一层金色，把 induratura 记成表面镀金饰面，而不是整件物体都是黄金。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In physics, the production of an electrical voltage by a changing magnetic field.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物理语境中，指变化的磁场产生电压的现象，即电磁感应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-fiżika, il-fenomenu li fih kamp manjetiku li jinbidel joħloq vultaġġ elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感应；在此处的物理教学语境中，特指变化的磁场产生电压的电磁感应现象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan il-kuntest tal-fiżika, proċess li bih bidla f'kamp manjetiku tipproduċi vultaġġ elettriku f'konduttur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this physics context, induction occurs when a changing magnetic field produces an electrical voltage in a conductor.

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, iċ-ċaqliq ta' kalamita ħdejn il-kolja pproduċa vultaġġ permezz tal-induzzjoni elettromanjetika.
formal.en: In the experiment, moving a magnet near the coil produced a voltage through electromagnetic induction.
formal.zh: 实验中，在靠近线圈的位置移动磁铁，通过电磁感应产生了电压。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed iċċaqlaq il-kalamita ħdejn il-kolja? Mark: Biex nurik l-induzzjoni. Ara kif jinbidel il-qari tal-vultaġġ. Lara: Iva, qed jinbidel meta ċċaqlaqha!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you moving the magnet near the coil? Mark: To show you induction. Look at how the voltage reading changes. Lara: Yes, it changes when you move it!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么在线圈旁边移动磁铁？Mark：给你演示感应现象。看看电压读数怎么变化。Lara：对，你一移动它，读数就变了！

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iċċaqlaq il-kalamita ħdejn il-kolja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iċċaqlaq il-kalamita ħdejn il-kolja?
messages.zh: 你为什么在线圈旁边移动磁铁？
messages.en: Why are you moving the magnet near the coil?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nurik l-induzzjoni. Ara kif jinbidel il-qari tal-vultaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nurik l-induzzjoni. Ara kif jinbidel il-qari tal-vultaġġ.
messages.zh: 给你演示感应现象。看看电压读数怎么变化。
messages.en: To show you induction. Look at how the voltage reading changes.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 对，你一移动它，读数就变了！
messages.en: Yes, it changes when you move it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用移动磁铁、观察线圈电压变化的实验画面记住 induzzjoni；再把整组 induzzjoni elettromanjetika 对应到电磁感应。

gloss_zh: 固有的；内在的；本身具有的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Existing as a natural or essential part of something, even when it is not immediately noticeable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为某事物本身的自然属性或基本组成而存在的，即使这种属性并不明显。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel parti min-natura jew mill-karatteristiċi essenzjali ta' xi ħaġa, anki jekk ma jkunx jidher minnufih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 固有的；属于事物自身性质的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'xi ħaġa bħala parti min-natura tagħha stess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A quality that is inherent in something belongs to its own nature.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 构成某事物不可分割的基本组成部分或本质特征的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jikkostitwixxi parti essenzjali jew karatteristika fundamentali ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inherent element or characteristic forms an essential part of what something is.

sense_translations.en_definition: in the nature of something though not necessarily apparent
sense_translations.zh_definition: 存在于某事物本性之中的，即使未必显露出来或容易察觉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħmel parti min-natura ta' xi ħaġa, għalkemm mhux bilfors ikun evidenti jew faċli biex wieħed jinduna bih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inherent quality can belong to something even when it is not readily apparent.

collocations.en: a limitation inherent in the method

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi limitazzjoni inerenti fil-metodu li tista' taffettwa l-preċiżjoni tar-riżultati.
formal.en: The report describes a limitation inherent in the method that may affect the precision of the results.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该方法本身固有的一项局限，这项局限可能影响结果的精确度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan il-metodu ma jagħtiniex numru eżatt? David: Għandu limitazzjoni inerenti: jagħti biss stima. Sara: Mela l-limitazzjoni ġejja mill-metodu nnifsu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why doesn't this method give us an exact number? David: It has an inherent limitation: it only gives an estimate. Sara: So the limitation comes from the method itself.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个方法为什么不能给我们一个确切数字？David：它有个固有局限：只能给出估计值。Sara：所以这个局限来自方法本身。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-metodu ma jagħtiniex numru eżatt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-metodu ma jagħtiniex numru eżatt?
messages.zh: 这个方法为什么不能给我们一个确切数字？
messages.en: Why doesn't this method give us an exact number?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu limitazzjoni inerenti: jagħti biss stima.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu limitazzjoni inerenti: jagħti biss stima.
messages.zh: 它有个固有局限：只能给出估计值。
messages.en: It has an inherent limitation: it only gives an estimate.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 所以这个局限来自方法本身。
messages.en: So the limitation comes from the method itself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inerenti 和“本身就有”绑在一起记：特点藏着也可能存在，风险或局限若来自事物自身，就可以用这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 合成惯量；模拟惯量；虚拟惯量

teaching_sense.en_definition: A controlled power response that imitates the inertial behaviour of rotating generators to help stabilise electricity-grid frequency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过控制电力输出来模拟旋转发电机惯性响应、帮助稳定电网频率的技术或响应能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rispons ikkontrollat tal-qawwa elettrika li jimita l-effett tal-inerzja ta' ġeneraturi li jduru biex jgħin jistabbilizza l-frekwenza tan-network tal-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 模拟惯量；通过控制系统模仿旋转发电设备的惯性响应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Effett ta' inerzja maħluq permezz ta' sistema ta' kontroll li timita r-rispons ta' ġeneraturi li jduru meta tinbidel il-frekwenza tan-network.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Emulated inertia is a controlled response that imitates how rotating generators resist changes in grid frequency.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合成惯量；由控制策略产生、用于支持电网频率稳定的等效惯性响应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rispons ekwivalenti għall-inerzja li jinħoloq permezz ta' kontroll tal-qawwa elettrika biex jgħin inaqqas il-bidliet fil-frekwenza tan-network.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Synthetic inertia uses controlled changes in electrical power to provide a response resembling the inertia of rotating generators.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚拟惯量；通过电力电子设备及其控制方式实现的惯性模拟效果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Effett li jimita l-inerzja ta' ġeneraturi li jduru u li jiġi pprovdut permezz ta' apparat elettroniku tal-qawwa u l-kontroll tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Virtual inertia is an inertia-like response produced through power-electronic equipment and its control system.

formal.mt: L-istudju jevalwa kif l-inerzja sintetika tista' tgħin tnaqqas ir-rata tal-bidla fil-frekwenza tan-network wara telf f'daqqa ta' ġenerazzjoni.
formal.en: The study evaluates how synthetic inertia can help reduce the rate of change of grid frequency after a sudden loss of generation.
formal.zh: 该研究评估了合成惯量如何在发电量突然损失后，帮助降低电网频率的变化率。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tagħmel l-inerzja sintetika f'din is-sistema? Anton: Il-kontroll ibiddel il-qawwa malajr biex jgħin jistabbilizza l-frekwenza. Nina: Jiġifieri s-sistema timita l-effett tal-inerzja ta' ġeneratur li jdur.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does synthetic inertia do in this system? Anton: The controller changes the power quickly to help stabilise the frequency. Nina: So the system imitates the effect of inertia in a rotating generator.
colloquial.zh: Nina：合成惯量在这个系统里起什么作用？Anton：控制器快速调整功率，帮助稳定频率。Nina：也就是说，系统模拟了旋转发电机的惯性效果。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习生)
messages.zh: 合成惯量在这个系统里起什么作用？
messages.en: What does synthetic inertia do in this system?

messages.speaker: Anton (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kontroll ibiddel il-qawwa malajr biex jgħin jistabbilizza l-frekwenza.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kontroll ibiddel il-qawwa malajr biex jgħin jistabbilizza l-frekwenza.
messages.zh: 控制器快速调整功率，帮助稳定频率。
messages.en: The controller changes the power quickly to help stabilise the frequency.

messages.speaker: Nina (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri s-sistema timita l-effett tal-inerzja ta' ġeneratur li jdur.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri s-sistema timita l-effett tal-inerzja ta' ġeneratur li jdur.
messages.zh: 也就是说，系统模拟了旋转发电机的惯性效果。
messages.en: So the system imitates the effect of inertia in a rotating generator.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“控制器模拟大转轮的稳频效果”记住 inerzja sintetika：抓住快速调功率、模拟惯性响应这两个画面，联想到合成惯量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing light that repeatedly changes in brightness instead of shining steadily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容光线反复变亮、变暗，不能持续稳定地发亮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi dawl li jibqa' jitqawwa u jiddgħajjef minflok jiddi b'mod stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪烁的；光线忽明忽暗、不稳定的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi dawl li l-qawwa tiegħu tinbidel ripetutament u li ma jiddix b'mod stabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flickering light repeatedly becomes brighter and dimmer instead of shining steadily.

collocations.en: the flickering light of the candle

formal.mt: Id-dawl inewnem tal-lampa għamilha diffiċli biex il-qarrej jara l-kliem fuq il-paġna.
formal.en: The flickering light of the lamp made it difficult for the reader to see the words on the page.
formal.zh: 灯光忽明忽暗，使读者难以看清书页上的文字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iżżomm il-ktieb daqshekk qrib? Pawlu: B'dan id-dawl inewnem ma nistax naqra sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you holding the book so close? Pawlu: I can't read properly in this flickering light.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把书拿得这么近？保罗：这光忽明忽暗的，我看不清。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iżżomm il-ktieb daqshekk qrib?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iżżomm il-ktieb daqshekk qrib?
messages.zh: 你为什么把书拿得这么近？
messages.en: Why are you holding the book so close?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: B'dan id-dawl inewnem ma nistax naqra sew.
messages.mt_standard: B'dan id-dawl inewnem ma nistax naqra sew.
messages.zh: 这光忽明忽暗的，我看不清。
messages.en: I can't read properly in this flickering light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inewnem 和蜡烛光联系起来：眼前的光一会儿亮、一会儿暗，记住它描述的是闪烁的状态。

gloss_zh: 诽谤；以不实言论损害名誉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say or spread false statements about someone that damage that person's reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说出或传播关于某人的不实言论，从而损害其名誉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħid jew ixxerred affarijiet foloz dwar xi ħadd li jagħmlu ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诽谤；用虚假的言论损害他人的名誉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħid affarijiet foloz dwar persuna quddiem oħrajn u b'hekk tagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone slanders another person, they make false statements about that person which damage their reputation.

collocations.mt: infama lil xi ħadd b'akkużi foloz
collocations.en: he slandered someone with false accusations
collocations.zh: 他以虚假指控诽谤某人

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif impjegat infama lil kollega billi xerred akkużi li kien jaf li kienu foloz.
formal.en: The report describes how an employee slandered a colleague by spreading accusations that he knew were false.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一名员工如何传播自己明知不实的指控，诽谤一位同事。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Lara ma tridx tkellem lil Mark? Nina: Għax Mark infama lil ħuha quddiem il-ħbieb tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why doesn't Lara want to speak to Mark? Nina: Because Mark slandered her brother in front of their friends.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：拉拉为什么不想跟马克说话？妮娜：因为马克当着他们朋友的面诽谤了她的兄弟。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Lara ma tridx tkellem lil Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Lara ma tridx tkellem lil Mark?
messages.zh: 拉拉为什么不想跟马克说话？
messages.en: Why doesn't Lara want to speak to Mark?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Mark infama lil ħuha quddiem il-ħbieb tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Mark infama lil ħuha quddiem il-ħbieb tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为马克当着他们朋友的面诽谤了她的兄弟。
messages.en: Because Mark slandered her brother in front of their friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 infama 时想象有人散布假话，让别人的名誉受损；把“虚假言论加名誉损害”作为记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: I remove dust from furniture or other surfaces by wiping or brushing it away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我用擦拭或掸扫的方式清除家具或其他表面的灰尘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inneħħi t-trab minn fuq l-għamara jew minn uċuħ oħra billi nimsaħhom jew nuża xkupilja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我给物品除尘；我擦去或掸去表面的灰尘。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Inneħħi t-trab minn fuq oġġetti jew uċuħ, bħal imwejjed u xkafef, billi nimsaħhom jew infarfarhom b'xkupilja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When I dust, I remove the dust that has collected on furniture or other surfaces.

formal.mt: Kull nhar ta' Ġimgħa, infarfar l-għamara tal-uffiċċju qabel ma naħsel l-art.
formal.en: Every Friday, I dust the office furniture before washing the floor.
formal.zh: 每周五，我先给办公室的家具除尘，再清洗地板。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tista' tnaddaf is-salott illum? Toni: Iva, infarfar l-għamara issa, u mbagħad ngħaddi l-vacuum cleaner.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you clean the living room today? Toni: Yes, I'll dust the furniture now and then vacuum.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你今天能打扫客厅吗？托尼：可以，我现在给家具除尘，然后用吸尘器打扫。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 你今天能打扫客厅吗？
messages.en: Can you clean the living room today?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, infarfar l-għamara issa, u mbagħad ngħaddi l-vacuum cleaner.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, infarfar l-għamara issa, u mbagħad ngħaddi l-vacuum cleaner.
messages.zh: 可以，我现在给家具除尘，然后用吸尘器打扫。
messages.en: Yes, I'll dust the furniture now and then vacuum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infarfar 记成自己拿着掸子清理书架的画面，并配着说“我来除尘”，记牢这个形式包含“我”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who feels unhappy, or someone or something affected by bad fortune.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可描述人的不快乐心情，也可描述遭遇不幸的人或令人遗憾的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi persuna li ma tħossx ferħ, jew persuna jew ġrajja milquta minn xorti ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不快乐的；感到难过或不满足的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi persuna li ma tkunx kuntenta u li tħoss dwejjaq jew nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is unhappy, they feel sad or dissatisfied with their situation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不幸的；遭遇坏运气的，或因结果不好而令人遗憾的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi persuna li ġarrbet xorti ħażina, jew ġrajja li kellha riżultat ħażin u ta' dispjaċir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An unfortunate person or event is affected by bad luck or involves a regrettable outcome.

formal.mt: Wara l-inċident infeliċi, l-istudenta qalet li kienet tħossha infeliċi u talbet appoġġ mill-iskola.
formal.en: After the unfortunate incident, the student said that she felt unhappy and requested support from the school.
formal.zh: 那起不幸的事件发生后，这名女学生表示自己感到不快乐，并向学校寻求支持。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Illum qed inħossni infeliċi għax tlift iċ-ċans li mmur magħkom. David: X'kumbinazzjoni infeliċi! Nistgħu nerġgħu nippjanaw xi ħaġa għall-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Elena: I'm feeling unhappy today because I missed the chance to go with you. David: What an unfortunate coincidence! We can plan something again for next week.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我今天心情不好，因为错过了跟你们一起去的机会。戴维：真是不巧！我们可以再安排下周一起做点什么。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum qed inħossni infeliċi għax tlift iċ-ċans li mmur magħkom.
messages.mt_standard: Illum qed inħossni infeliċi għax tlift iċ-ċans li mmur magħkom.
messages.zh: 我今天心情不好，因为错过了跟你们一起去的机会。
messages.en: I'm feeling unhappy today because I missed the chance to go with you.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kumbinazzjoni infeliċi! Nistgħu nerġgħu nippjanaw xi ħaġa għall-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.mt_standard: X'kumbinazzjoni infeliċi! Nistgħu nerġgħu nippjanaw xi ħaġa għall-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.zh: 真是不巧！我们可以再安排下周一起做点什么。
messages.en: What an unfortunate coincidence! We can plan something again for next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 infeliċi：一个人低着头，表示“不快乐”；一场出游被意外打断，表示“不幸”。看上下文区分心情和遭遇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trained healthcare professional who cares for people who are ill or need medical support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受过专业训练、照护病人并提供护理服务的人员；此词为阳性形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Professjonist tas-saħħa mħarreġ biex jieħu ħsieb il-morda u jagħtihom il-kura li jeħtieġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受过护理训练、负责照护病人的护士；此处为阳性形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa fil-qasam tal-infermiera li tieħu ħsieb il-pazjenti u tipprovdilhom kura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nurse is someone trained to care for people who are ill or need medical assistance.

formal.mt: L-infermier irreġistra t-temperatura tal-pazjent u aġġorna r-rapport tal-kura.
formal.en: The nurse recorded the patient's temperature and updated the care report.
formal.zh: 护士记录了病人的体温，并更新了护理报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-infermier? Pawlu: Qiegħed fil-kamra ta' ħdejna; insejjaħlu jien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the nurse? Pawlu: He's in the room next door; I'll call him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：护士在哪里？保罗：他在隔壁房间，我来叫他。

messages.speaker: Lara (病人)
messages.zh: 护士在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the nurse?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (陪护家属)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed fil-kamra ta' ħdejna; insejjaħlu jien.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed fil-kamra ta' ħdejna; insejjaħlu jien.
messages.zh: 他在隔壁房间，我来叫他。
messages.en: He's in the room next door; I'll call him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infermier 与病房里量体温、照护病人的男护士画面绑定，整句记住：L-infermier jieħu ħsieb il-pazjent（护士照护病人）。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone or something to become infected or contaminated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或其他生物受到感染，或使物品、环境等受到污染。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikkawża li persuna jew ħaġa tintlaqat minn mikrobi jew tiġi kkontaminata minn materjal li jagħmel il-ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人、动物或身体部位受到病原体感染。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daħħal jew xerred mikrobi f'persuna, f'annimal jew f'parti tal-ġisem, b'mod li jikkawża infezzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a germ infects someone, it enters their body and causes an infection.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物质、物品或环境混入病菌或其他有害成分而受到污染。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħammeġ sustanza, oġġett jew ambjent b'mikrobi jew b'materjal ieħor li jagħmel il-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something contaminates a substance or object, it introduces germs or other harmful material into it.

formal.mt: L-investigazzjoni wriet li l-virus infetta diversi persuni fl-istess bini.
formal.en: The investigation showed that the virus infected several people in the same building.
formal.zh: 调查表明，该病毒感染了同一栋建筑内的数人。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif infetta l-kampjun dak l-ilma maħmuġ? David: Daħal fil-kontenitur meta waqa' l-għatu.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did that dirty water contaminate the sample? David: It got into the container when the lid fell off.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：那些脏水怎么污染了样本？戴维：盖子掉下来时，脏水进了容器。

messages.speaker: Marta (实验室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif infetta l-kampjun dak l-ilma maħmuġ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif infetta l-kampjun dak l-ilma maħmuġ?
messages.zh: 那些脏水怎么污染了样本？
messages.en: How did that dirty water contaminate the sample?

messages.speaker: David (实验室同事)
messages.zh: 盖子掉下来时，脏水进了容器。
messages.en: It got into the container when the lid fell off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infetta 记成“感染或污染这个动作”：病毒感染人，脏水污染样本。用两个受事对象区分义项，不把动作和感染后的状态混在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Affected by an infection or made contaminated by germs or other harmful material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经受到感染的，或已经被病菌等有害成分污染的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih infezzjoni jew li ġie kkontaminat minn mikrobi jew minn materjal ieħor li jagħmel il-ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到病原体感染的；有感染的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ntlaqat minn mikrobi u għandu infezzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is infected has an infection caused by germs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到病菌或其他有害物质污染的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li fih mikrobi jew materjal ieħor li jagħmel il-ħsara minħabba kontaminazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is contaminated contains germs or harmful material that should not be there.

formal.mt: Il-kampjun infettat ġie mwarrab, u l-laboratorju talab kampjun ġdid għall-analiżi.
formal.en: The contaminated sample was set aside, and the laboratory requested a new sample for analysis.
formal.zh: 受到污染的样本已被另行放置，实验室要求提供新样本进行分析。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qiegħed f'kamra għalih dak il-pazjent? Mark: Għax huwa infettat b'virus li jittieħed.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is that patient in a room on his own? Mark: Because he is infected with a contagious virus.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那个病人为什么单独住一间病房？马克：因为他感染了一种具有传染性的病毒。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qiegħed f'kamra għalih dak il-pazjent?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qiegħed f'kamra għalih dak il-pazjent?
messages.zh: 那个病人为什么单独住一间病房？
messages.en: Why is that patient in a room on his own?

messages.speaker: Mark (带教护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa infettat b'virus li jittieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa infettat b'virus li jittieħed.
messages.zh: 因为他感染了一种具有传染性的病毒。
messages.en: Because he is infected with a contagious virus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infettat 当作物品或人物身上的“已感染／已污染”状态标签：pazjent infettat 是受感染的病人，kampjun infettat 是受污染的样本。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of blowing air, or forcing air noisily through the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吹出空气的动作；也指从鼻子用力喷气、发出响鼻声的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed jonfoħ l-arja, jew li joħroġ l-arja bil-qawwa mill-imnieħer u jagħmel ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹气；把空气吹出的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed joħroġ l-arja minn ħalqu biex iċaqlaq xi ħaġa, jitfi fjamma jew jimla xi ħaġa bl-arja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Blowing is the act of sending air out of your mouth towards something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从鼻子猛地喷气并发出声音；喷鼻息或打响鼻。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li persuna jew annimal joħroġ l-arja bil-qawwa mill-imnieħer u jagħmel ħoss qasir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Snorting is the act of forcing air noisily through the nose.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ġie rreġistrat il-ħoss tal-infieħ taż-żiemel hekk kif ħareġ l-arja bil-qawwa mill-imnieħer.
formal.en: During the observation, the sound of the horse's snorting was recorded as it forced air through its nostrils.
formal.zh: 观察期间，记录下了马从鼻孔用力喷气时发出的响鼻声。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għad fadal ħafna bżieżaq? Toni: Iva, u għejjejt bl-infieħ. Għandna pompa?
colloquial.en: Sara: Are there still many balloons left? Toni: Yes, and I'm tired from all the blowing. Do we have a pump?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：还剩很多气球吗？托尼：是啊，我吹得都累了。我们有打气筒吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (筹备聚会的朋友)
messages.zh: 还剩很多气球吗？
messages.en: Are there still many balloons left?

messages.speaker: Toni (帮忙布置的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għejjejt bl-infieħ. Għandna pompa?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għejjejt bl-infieħ. Għandna pompa?
messages.zh: 是啊，我吹得都累了。我们有打气筒吗？
messages.en: Yes, and I'm tired from all the blowing. Do we have a pump?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个呼气画面记 infieħ：嘴对气球吹气，对应 blowing；马从鼻孔喷气打响鼻，对应 snorting。共同抓住“空气被吹出”的动作画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The English language, as designated in this entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条中指英语这一语言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Ingliża, kif indikata f'din l-entrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英语；本词条中所指的语言名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Ingliża li għaliha tirreferi din l-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, the noun refers to the English language.

collocations.en: the entry 'infitex' in the vocabulary list

formal.mt: F'din il-lista tal-kliem, l-entrata 'infitex' tingħata t-tifsira 'il-lingwa Ingliża'.
formal.en: In this vocabulary list, the entry 'infitex' is given the meaning 'the English language'.
formal.zh: 在这份词汇表中，“infitex”词条的释义为“英语”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'infitex' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser il-lingwa Ingliża.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'infitex' mean in this list? Pawlu: Here it means the English language.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份表里的“infitex”是什么意思？Pawlu：这里指英语。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这份表里的“infitex”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'infitex' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 这里指英语。
messages.en: Here it means the English language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本词条做成双面词卡：正面写 infitex，背面写“英语”；按给定释义配对记忆，不从拼写推断词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reaction in a part of the body that can cause redness, swelling, heat, or pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体某部位出现的炎症反应，可表现为发红、肿胀、发热或疼痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reazzjoni f'parti tal-ġisem li tista' tikkawża ħmura, nefħa, sħana jew uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炎症；身体组织出现的反应，可伴随红、肿、热、痛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reazzjoni fit-tessuti tal-ġisem li tista' tidher bħala ħmura, nefħa, sħana jew uġigħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Inflammation is a bodily reaction that can make an affected area swollen, red, hot, or painful.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi infjammazzjoni fil-ġog tal-irkoppa.
formal.en: The medical report describes inflammation in the knee joint.
formal.zh: 医疗报告描述了膝关节内的炎症。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek l-irkoppa minfuħa? Pawlu: It-tabib qalli li għandi infjammazzjoni fil-ġog.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is your knee swollen? Pawlu: The doctor told me I have inflammation in the joint.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的膝盖怎么肿了？Pawlu：医生说我的关节发炎了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的膝盖怎么肿了？
messages.en: Why is your knee swollen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tabib qalli li għandi infjammazzjoni fil-ġog.
messages.mt_standard: It-tabib qalli li għandi infjammazzjoni fil-ġog.
messages.zh: 医生说我的关节发炎了。
messages.en: The doctor told me I have inflammation in the joint.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infjammazzjoni 和“红、肿、热、痛”的身体部位图配在一起，再用“关节发炎”的短语帮助回忆。

gloss_zh: 流行性感冒；流感；影响（动词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An infectious illness commonly called flu that can cause fever, body aches, and tiredness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流行性感冒，简称流感，是一种可引起发热、全身酸痛和疲倦的传染性疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda li tittieħed u li tista' tikkawża deni, uġigħ fil-ġisem u għeja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流行性感冒；一种可引起发热、全身酸痛和疲倦的传染性疾病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda infettiva li tista' tikkawża deni, uġigħ fil-ġisem u għeja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Influenza is an infectious illness that can cause fever, aching muscles, and considerable tiredness.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流感；流行性感冒的常用简称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-marda magħrufa bħala influwenza, li tista' ġġib deni, uġigħ fil-ġisem u għeja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Flu is the common everyday name for the illness called influenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 影响；对某人的想法、行为或某事的结果产生作用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollu effett fuq il-ħsieb jew l-imġiba ta' xi ħadd, jew fuq ir-riżultat ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something influences a person or outcome, they affect how that person thinks or how events develop.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar l-influwenza influwenza d-deċiżjoni tal-kumitat li jorganizza kampanja ta' informazzjoni.
formal.en: The report on influenza influenced the committee's decision to organize an information campaign.
formal.zh: 这份关于流感的报告影响了委员会开展宣传活动的决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex bqajt id-dar illum? Pawlu: Għandi l-influwenza. Il-parir tat-tabib influwenza d-deċiżjoni tiegħi li nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stay home today? Pawlu: I have flu. The doctor's advice influenced my decision to rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天为什么待在家里？Pawlu：我得了流感。医生的建议影响了我休息的决定。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天为什么待在家里？
messages.en: Why did you stay home today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-influwenza. Il-parir tat-tabib influwenza d-deċiżjoni tiegħi li nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-influwenza. Il-parir tat-tabib influwenza d-deċiżjoni tiegħi li nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 我得了流感。医生的建议影响了我休息的决定。
messages.en: I have flu. The doctor's advice influenced my decision to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 influwenza 画两张卡：体温计代表名词“流感”，推动决定的箭头代表动词“影响”；两个名词释义指同一种疾病。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Affected in thought, behaviour, or character by another person, thing, or circumstance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在思想、行为或特征上受到他人、事物或环境影响的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-ħsieb, l-imġiba jew il-karattru tiegħu jkun ġie affettwat minn persuna, ħaġa jew ċirkostanza oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受影响的；思想、行为、判断或特征受到外界作用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie affettwat fil-ħsieb, fl-imġiba, fil-ġudizzju jew fil-karatteristiċi tiegħu minn xi ħadd jew minn xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is influenced, their thoughts, behaviour, or characteristics are affected by another person or thing.

formal.mt: Il-ġudizzju tar-riċerkatur kien influwenzat mill-esperjenza tiegħu fil-qasam.
formal.en: The researcher's judgment was influenced by his experience in the field.
formal.zh: 这位研究者的判断受到了他在该领域的经验的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan l-istil? Pawlu: Kont influwenzat mill-ħbieb tiegħi, għax huma wkoll iħobbuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this style? Pawlu: I was influenced by my friends, because they like it too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么选这种风格？Pawlu：我受了朋友们的影响，因为他们也喜欢这种风格。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这种风格？
messages.en: Why did you choose this style?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont influwenzat mill-ħbieb tiegħi, għax huma wkoll iħobbuh.
messages.mt_standard: Kont influwenzat mill-ħbieb tiegħi, għax huma wkoll iħobbuh.
messages.zh: 我受了朋友们的影响，因为他们也喜欢这种风格。
messages.en: I was influenced by my friends, because they like it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 influwenzat 时想象朋友的建议指向一个人的选择，用“受朋友影响的”整块短语记住它描述受影响的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone information or knowledge about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某件事的消息、情况或相关知识告诉某人，使其知晓或理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd aħbar, tagħrif jew għarfien dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某事的消息或情况告诉某人；通知；告知。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħarraf lil xi ħadd b'fatt, b'aħbar jew b'xi żvilupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you inform someone about something, you tell them facts or news that they need to know.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把知识或相关认识传达给他人，使其有所了解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti tagħrif jew għarfien lil persuna oħra biex din titgħallem jew tifhem xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you impart knowledge, you pass what you know to another person so that they can learn.

collocations.en: informed the customers about the changes
collocations.zh: 把变动情况通知了顾客

collocations.en: gave the students information about the city's history
collocations.zh: 向学生介绍了这座城市的历史知识

formal.mt: Id-direttur informa lill-impjegati li l-laqgħa kienet se ssir it-Tnejn filgħodu.
formal.en: The director informed the employees that the meeting would take place on Monday morning.
formal.zh: 主管通知员工，会议将于星期一上午举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi ħadd informa lil Pawlu dwar il-bidla fil-ħin? Mark: Iva, ċempiltlu jien. Issa jaf li se niltaqgħu fis-sitta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did anyone inform Pawlu about the change of time? Mark: Yes, I called him. He now knows we're meeting at six.
colloquial.zh: Maja：有人告诉Pawlu时间改了吗？Mark：有，我给他打过电话了。他现在知道我们六点见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd informa lil Pawlu dwar il-bidla fil-ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd informa lil Pawlu dwar il-bidla fil-ħin?
messages.zh: 有人告诉Pawlu时间改了吗？
messages.en: Did anyone inform Pawlu about the change of time?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ċempiltlu jien. Issa jaf li se niltaqgħu fis-sitta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ċempiltlu jien. Issa jaf li se niltaqgħu fis-sitta.
messages.zh: 有，我给他打过电话了。他现在知道我们六点见。
messages.en: Yes, I called him. He now knows we're meeting at six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成“把信息交到别人手里”的动作：告诉开会时间是通知，介绍历史知识是传授；核心都是让对方知道。

gloss_zh: 知情的；了解情况的；已获告知的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having relevant knowledge or having been told about a particular matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 掌握相关信息、了解情况的，或已经被告知某件具体事情的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tagħrif rilevanti jew li ġie mgħarraf dwar xi kwistjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掌握相关知识或信息、对事情有了解的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu biżżejjed tagħrif jew għarfien dwar suġġett biex jifhmu jew jagħti opinjoni dwaru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is informed has enough relevant knowledge to understand a subject or discuss it sensibly.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经被告知某事、因而知晓该事的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie mgħarraf b'xi ħaġa u għalhekk jaf biha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is apprised of something, they have been told about it and are aware of it.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu jiżgura li kull membru jkun informat dwar il-proposti qabel il-votazzjoni.
formal.en: The committee must ensure that every member is informed about the proposals before the vote.
formal.zh: 委员会必须确保每位成员在表决前都了解各项提案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int informat dwar il-bidla fil-post tal-laqgħa? Pawlu: Iva, qrajt il-messaġġ. Se niltaqgħu fil-librerija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you been informed about the change of meeting venue? Pawlu: Yes, I read the message. We're meeting at the library.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你知道见面地点改了吗？Pawlu：知道，我看了消息。我们在图书馆见。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int informat dwar il-bidla fil-post tal-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Int informat dwar il-bidla fil-post tal-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 你知道见面地点改了吗？
messages.en: Have you been informed about the change of meeting venue?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qrajt il-messaġġ. Se niltaqgħu fil-librerija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qrajt il-messaġġ. Se niltaqgħu fil-librerija.
messages.zh: 知道，我看了消息。我们在图书馆见。
messages.en: Yes, I read the message. We're meeting at the library.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“消息已经收到，情况已经知道”的画面记住这个形容词：既可形容有相关知识的人，也可强调某人已获通知。

gloss_zh: 市场情报；有关市场的信息

teaching_sense.en_definition: Information about customers, competitors, and market conditions that helps guide business decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为经营决策收集和使用的市场信息，包括顾客需求、竞争对手活动、价格及市场状况等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħrif dwar il-klijenti, il-kompetituri, il-prezzijiet u l-kundizzjonijiet tas-suq li jgħin fit-teħid ta' deċiżjonijiet kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于了解市场和支持商业决策的情报，涉及客户、竞争对手、需求、价格及市场变化等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħrif miġbur u analizzat dwar is-suq, bħall-ħtiġijiet tal-klijenti u l-attività tal-kompetituri, biex jgħin lin-negozji jieħdu deċiżjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market intelligence is information that a business gathers and analyses about its market to help it make decisions.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ġabret informazzjoni dwar is-suq biex tivvaluta d-domanda għall-prodott il-ġdid u tqabbel il-prezzijiet tal-kompetituri.
formal.en: The company gathered market intelligence to assess demand for the new product and compare competitors' prices.
formal.zh: 公司收集了市场情报，以评估新产品的需求并比较竞争对手的价格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandna biżżejjed informazzjoni dwar is-suq biex niffissaw il-prezz? David: Għad le. Irridu naraw kemm qed jitolbu l-ħwienet l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do we have enough market intelligence to set the price? David: Not yet. We need to see how much the other shops are charging.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们掌握的市场信息够定价了吗？David：还不够。我们得看看其他店卖多少钱。

messages.speaker: Nina (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna biżżejjed informazzjoni dwar is-suq biex niffissaw il-prezz?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna biżżejjed informazzjoni dwar is-suq biex niffissaw il-prezz?
messages.zh: 我们掌握的市场信息够定价了吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough market intelligence to set the price?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad le. Irridu naraw kemm qed jitolbu l-ħwienet l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għad le. Irridu naraw kemm qed jitolbu l-ħwienet l-oħra.
messages.zh: 还不够。我们得看看其他店卖多少钱。
messages.en: Not yet. We need to see how much the other shops are charging.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记：“informazzjoni 信息＋dwar 关于＋is-suq 市场”。想象开店前查看顾客需求与同行价格，就是收集市场情报。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Business information whose disclosure could harm commercial interests or competitive advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一旦披露便可能损害企业商业利益或竞争优势的信息，例如未公开的定价计划、成本或交易条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħrif tan-negozju li, jekk jinkixef, jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-interessi kummerċjali jew lill-vantaġġ kompetittiv ta' kumpanija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 披露后可能损害企业商业利益或竞争地位的信息，如内部成本、未公开价格或谈判条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħrif bħal spejjeż interni, prezzijiet mhux ippubblikati jew kundizzjonijiet ta' negozjati, li l-iżvelar tiegħu jista' jagħmel ħsara lin-negozju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Commercially sensitive information is business information that could harm a company's interests or help its competitors if disclosed.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport fih informazzjoni kummerċjalment sensittiva dwar l-ispejjeż tal-produzzjoni u l-prezzijiet ippjanati għall-prodott il-ġdid.
formal.en: The report contains commercially sensitive information about production costs and the planned prices for the new product.
formal.zh: 该报告包含有关生产成本和新产品拟定价格的商业敏感信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nibgħat din it-tabella lill-fornitur? Mark: Fiha informazzjoni kummerċjalment sensittiva. Ejja nneħħu l-ispejjeż interni qabel nibagħtuha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I send this table to the supplier? Mark: It contains commercially sensitive information. Let's remove the internal costs before sending it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我可以把这张表发给供应商吗？Mark：里面有商业敏感信息。我们先把内部成本删掉再发吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (采购员)
messages.zh: 我可以把这张表发给供应商吗？
messages.en: Can I send this table to the supplier?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fiha informazzjoni kummerċjalment sensittiva. Ejja nneħħu l-ispejjeż interni qabel nibagħtuha.
messages.mt_standard: Fiha informazzjoni kummerċjalment sensittiva. Ejja nneħħu l-ispejjeż interni qabel nibagħtuha.
messages.zh: 里面有商业敏感信息。我们先把内部成本删掉再发吧。
messages.en: It contains commercially sensitive information. Let's remove the internal costs before sending it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成一张标有“内部成本、尚未公开价格”的表：informazzjoni 是信息，后面说明它在商业上敏感，外传可能影响竞争。

gloss_zh: 订立合同前提供的信息；缔约前信息

teaching_sense.en_definition: Information provided before a contract is entered into, explaining the proposed terms and relevant details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在订立合同之前提供的、说明拟议合同条款及相关细节的信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Informazzjoni mogħtija qabel ma jiġi konkluż kuntratt, li tispjega l-kundizzjonijiet proposti u d-dettalji rilevanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在合同订立之前向相关方提供的有关合同条款及交易细节的信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Informazzjoni dwar il-kundizzjonijiet ta' kuntratt u d-dettalji tat-tranżazzjoni, mogħtija lill-partijiet qabel ma jiġi konkluż il-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pre-contractual information is information you receive before entering into a contract so that you can understand the proposed agreement.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jiffirma l-kuntratt, il-klijent għandu jaqra l-informazzjoni prekuntrattwali dwar il-prezz, it-tul tas-servizz u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-ħlas.
formal.en: Before signing the contract, the customer should read the pre-contractual information about the price, the duration of the service and the payment terms.
formal.zh: 签署合同之前，客户应阅读有关价格、服务期限及付款条件的缔约前信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se niffirma dan il-kuntratt illum. Pawlu: Qrajt l-informazzjoni prekuntrattwali? Lara: Għadni le. Se naqraha qabel niffirma.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm going to sign this contract today. Pawlu: Have you read the pre-contractual information? Lara: Not yet. I'll read it before I sign.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我今天要签这份合同。保罗：你读过缔约前信息了吗？拉拉：还没有。我会先读完再签。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 我今天要签这份合同。
messages.en: I'm going to sign this contract today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 你读过缔约前信息了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the pre-contractual information?

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Se naqraha qabel niffirma.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Se naqraha qabel niffirma.
messages.zh: 还没有。我会先读完再签。
messages.en: Not yet. I'll read it before I sign.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词放进“签字前先读资料”的画面：桌上有合同，旁边是解释价格和条件的缔约前信息。

gloss_zh: 连衣裙的衬里；裙装内衬

teaching_sense.en_definition: A layer of fabric sewn inside a dress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缝在连衣裙内部的一层布料，用作衬里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saff ta' drapp meħjut fuq in-naħa ta' ġewwa ta' libsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缝在连衣裙里面、作为内衬的一层布料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saff ta' drapp li jkun meħjut ġewwa libsa u jgħatti n-naħa ta' ġewwa tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The lining of a dress is the layer of fabric sewn inside it, often to make it more comfortable or less transparent.

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata se tissostitwixxi l-inforra mqatta' tal-libsa b'drapp artab tal-istess kulur.
formal.en: The dressmaker will replace the dress's torn lining with soft fabric of the same colour.
formal.zh: 裁缝将用同色的柔软布料更换这条连衣裙破损的衬里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-libsa togħġobni, imma l-inforra ddejjaqni. Rita: Tridni nibdilha b'drapp aktar artab? Nina: Iva, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Nina: I like this dress, but the lining bothers me. Rita: Would you like me to replace it with softer fabric? Nina: Yes, please.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我喜欢这条连衣裙，但衬里让我不舒服。丽塔：要我用更柔软的布料换掉它吗？妮娜：好的，麻烦你了。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-libsa togħġobni, imma l-inforra ddejjaqni.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-libsa togħġobni, imma l-inforra ddejjaqni.
messages.zh: 我喜欢这条连衣裙，但衬里让我不舒服。
messages.en: I like this dress, but the lining bothers me.

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.zh: 要我用更柔软的布料换掉它吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to replace it with softer fabric?

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 好的，麻烦你了。
messages.en: Yes, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把连衣裙翻到里面，手指摸到贴身的那层布；把 inforra 和这个“裙子里面的一层”画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing radiation with wavelengths longer than visible red light, or something that uses this radiation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容波长比可见红光更长的辐射，或利用这种辐射的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiddeskrivi radjazzjoni b'tul ta' mewġa itwal minn dak tad-dawl aħmar viżibbli, jew xi ħaġa li tuża din ir-radjazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 属于或涉及红外辐射的；这种辐射的波长比可见红光更长。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandha x'taqsam ma' radjazzjoni b'tul ta' mewġa itwal minn dak tad-dawl aħmar viżibbli, jew li tuża din ir-radjazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Infrared radiation has wavelengths longer than visible red light, and infrared equipment detects or uses this radiation.

formal.mt: It-tim uża kamera infra-ħamra biex jidentifika żoni fil-ħajt fejn it-temperatura kienet differenti.
formal.en: The team used an infrared camera to identify areas of the wall where the temperature was different.
formal.zh: 团队使用红外摄像机找出墙面上温度不同的区域。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed tuża kamera infra-ħamra? Toni: Biex nara fejn il-ħajt huwa aktar kiesaħ. Marta: Mela tista' turini d-differenzi fit-temperatura?
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you using an infrared camera? Toni: To see where the wall is colder. Marta: So can you show me the temperature differences?
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么用红外摄像机？托尼：看看墙面哪里更冷。玛尔塔：那你能给我看看温度差异吗？

messages.speaker: Marta (住户)
messages.zh: 你为什么用红外摄像机？
messages.en: Why are you using an infrared camera?

messages.speaker: Toni (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nara fejn il-ħajt huwa aktar kiesaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nara fejn il-ħajt huwa aktar kiesaħ.
messages.zh: 看看墙面哪里更冷。
messages.en: To see where the wall is colder.

messages.speaker: Marta (住户)
messages.zh: 那你能给我看看温度差异吗？
messages.en: So can you show me the temperature differences?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用红外摄像机的温度画面记忆：普通眼睛看不见的红外辐射，经设备呈现为不同颜色；把 infra-ħamra 与这个场景相连。

gloss_zh: 获悉情况的；知情的；知晓的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having received information about something or knowing about a particular fact or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经获得有关某事的信息，或知晓某个事实或情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun irċieva tagħrif dwar xi ħaġa jew li jkun jaf b'fatt jew b'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经获得有关某事的信息、因而了解相关情况的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ingħata jew kiseb tagħrif dwar suġġett jew sitwazzjoni u għalhekk ikun jaf id-dettalji rilevanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are informed about something, you have received or obtained information that helps you understand it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 知道某个事实或情况的；知情的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun jaf b'fatt jew b'sitwazzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are aware of a fact or situation, you know that it exists or that it has happened.

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur għandu jżomm lill-klijent infurmat dwar il-progress tal-proġett u kull bidla fl-iskeda.
formal.en: The coordinator should keep the customer informed about the project's progress and any changes to the schedule.
formal.zh: 协调员应让客户随时了解项目进展及任何日程变动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int infurmat li l-laqgħa nbidlet għall-Ġimgħa? Mark: Le, kont għadni naħseb li se ssir għada. Sara: Iva, bagħtu messaġġ dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you aware that the meeting has been moved to Friday? Mark: No, I still thought it was happening tomorrow. Sara: Yes, they sent a message this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你知道会议改到星期五了吗？马克：不知道，我还以为明天开呢。萨拉：是的，他们今天早上发了消息。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Int infurmat li l-laqgħa nbidlet għall-Ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Int infurmat li l-laqgħa nbidlet għall-Ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 你知道会议改到星期五了吗？
messages.en: Are you aware that the meeting has been moved to Friday?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kont għadni naħseb li se ssir għada.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kont għadni naħseb li se ssir għada.
messages.zh: 不知道，我还以为明天开呢。
messages.en: No, I still thought it was happening tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，他们今天早上发了消息。
messages.en: Yes, they sent a message this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infurmat 记成读完通知后点头说“我知道了”的状态：既可以强调已获得信息，也可以强调已经知情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone information about a fact, decision, or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某个事实、决定或事件的相关信息告诉某人，使其知情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti lil xi ħadd tagħrif dwar fatt, deċiżjoni jew ġrajja biex ikun jaf biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 告知；向某人传达信息，使其了解某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħarraf lil xi ħadd b'xi ħaġa billi tagħtih l-informazzjoni dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you inform someone about something, you give them information so that they know about it.

collocations.en: informed the public about the changes
collocations.zh: 向公众告知了有关变更

formal.mt: L-organizzaturi infurmaw lill-parteċipanti permezz ta' ittra li l-laqgħa kienet se tibda siegħa qabel.
formal.en: The organisers informed the participants by letter that the meeting would begin an hour earlier.
formal.zh: 组织者通过信函通知参与者，会议将提前一小时开始。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sirt taf li nbidel il-ħin? Mark: Infurmawna lbieraħ b'messaġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you find out that the time had changed? Mark: They informed us yesterday by message.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么知道时间改了？马克：他们昨天发消息通知了我们。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sirt taf li nbidel il-ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sirt taf li nbidel il-ħin?
messages.zh: 你怎么知道时间改了？
messages.en: How did you find out that the time had changed?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们昨天发消息通知了我们。
messages.en: They informed us yesterday by message.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infurmaw 配上“工作人员发出通知”的画面来记：信息传到别人那里，对方就知情了。例句中的 infurmaw 表示“他们通知了”，infurmawna 则把“我们”也接进了表达。

gloss_zh: 加有内衬；已加衬里的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of an item that has been fitted with an inner layer of material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指衣物等物件内部已经加上一层衬里的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' oġġett, bħal biċċa ħwejjeġ, li jkollu saff ta' drapp jew materjal ieħor minn ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已加内衬的；指物件内部设有一层衬里的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li oġġett ikun miksi minn ġewwa b'saff ta' drapp jew materjal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an item is lined, it has an additional layer of material fitted inside it.

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-prodott tispeċifika li l-ġakketta hija infurrata b'drapp tal-qoton.
formal.en: The product description specifies that the jacket is lined with cotton fabric.
formal.zh: 产品说明明确指出，这件夹克配有棉布内衬。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din il-ġakketta għandha xi ħaġa minn ġewwa? Lara: Iva, hija infurrata. Ħares lejn dan id-drapp.
colloquial.en: Marija: Does this jacket have anything on the inside? Lara: Yes, it is lined. Look at this fabric.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这件夹克里面有加一层东西吗？拉拉：有，它有内衬。你看这层布。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-ġakketta għandha xi ħaġa minn ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-ġakketta għandha xi ħaġa minn ġewwa?
messages.zh: 这件夹克里面有加一层东西吗？
messages.en: Does this jacket have anything on the inside?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija infurrata. Ħares lejn dan id-drapp.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija infurrata. Ħares lejn dan id-drapp.
messages.zh: 有，它有内衬。你看这层布。
messages.en: Yes, it is lined. Look at this fabric.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infurrata 和“翻开夹克看见里层布”的画面绑定：重点是里面另有一层衬里。反复读 ġakketta infurrata，看到这个搭配就想到“有内衬的夹克”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make sure that a law, rule, or requirement is obeyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采取措施确保法律、规则或要求得到遵守和执行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiżgura li liġi, regola jew rekwiżit jiġi osservat billi tieħu l-miżuri meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 执行或强制落实法律、规则等，使有关人员遵守。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil min hu kkonċernat josserva liġi jew regola permezz tal-miżuri meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a person or authority enforces a rule, they take action to make sure that people obey it.

formal.mt: Id-direttur infurza r-regoli tas-sigurtà billi waqqaf ix-xogħol sakemm il-ħaddiema libsu t-tagħmir meħtieġ.
formal.en: The director enforced the safety rules by stopping work until the workers put on the required equipment.
formal.zh: 主管暂停了工作，直到工人穿戴好规定的装备，以此落实安全规则。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ħadd ma daħal mingħajr biljett? Pawlu: Il-maniġer infurza r-regola u ċċekkja l-biljetti kollha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did nobody get in without a ticket? Pawlu: The manager enforced the rule and checked every ticket.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么没有人能不拿票就进去？保罗：经理执行了规定，检查了每一张票。

messages.speaker: Nina (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħadd ma daħal mingħajr biljett?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħadd ma daħal mingħajr biljett?
messages.zh: 为什么没有人能不拿票就进去？
messages.en: Why did nobody get in without a ticket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maniġer infurza r-regola u ċċekkja l-biljetti kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-maniġer infurza r-regola u ċċekkja l-biljetti kollha.
messages.zh: 经理执行了规定，检查了每一张票。
messages.en: The manager enforced the rule and checked every ticket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 infurza 时想象入口处逐张验票：墙上有规则，工作人员还采取行动让大家遵守。把“规则真正落实”这个动作与 infurza r-regoli 一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 强制落实付款；付款义务的强制执行

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of formal measures to make sure that money owed is paid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过正式措施促使欠款人履行付款义务、支付应付款项的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' miżuri formali biex jiġi żgurat li jitħallas ammont ta' flus dovut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 付款义务的强制执行；采取措施确保应付款项得到支付。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jittieħdu miżuri biex persuna jew entità tħallas il-flus li għandha tagħti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Enforcement of payment is the process of taking formal action to make someone pay money that they owe.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċeduri għall-infurzar tal-ħlas meta l-ammont dovut jibqa' ma jitħallasx.
formal.en: The report describes the procedures for enforcement of payment when the amount owed remains unpaid.
formal.zh: 该报告说明了在应付款项持续未付时，强制执行付款的相关程序。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi jfisser infurzar tal-ħlas f'din l-ittra? David: Ifisser li jittieħdu passi formali biex min għandu jħallas jagħmel dan.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does enforcement of payment mean in this letter? David: It means taking formal steps to make the person who owes the money pay it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这封信里的“强制执行付款”是什么意思？戴维：意思是采取正式措施，让欠款的人把钱付清。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser infurzar tal-ħlas f'din l-ittra?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser infurzar tal-ħlas f'din l-ittra?
messages.zh: 这封信里的“强制执行付款”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does enforcement of payment mean in this letter?

messages.speaker: David (财务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jittieħdu passi formali biex min għandu jħallas jagħmel dan.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jittieħdu passi formali biex min għandu jħallas jagħmel dan.
messages.zh: 意思是采取正式措施，让欠款的人把钱付清。
messages.en: It means taking formal steps to make the person who owes the money pay it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infurzar tal-ħlas 想成“未付账单进入正式执行程序”的画面：整组表达强调采取措施让应付的钱实际到账。连读整个词组，并用“付款义务的强制执行”对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The gradual introduction of a liquid into the body, especially through a vein.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将液体逐渐输入体内的过程，尤其指通过静脉输入药液。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dħul gradwali ta' likwidu fil-ġisem, speċjalment ta' mediċina minn ġo vina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 输注，即将液体逐渐输入体内，尤其通过静脉输入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li bih likwidu jiddaħħal gradwalment fil-ġisem, ħafna drabi minn ġo vina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An infusion is a process in which liquid is introduced gradually into the body, usually through a vein.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irċieva l-mediċina permezz ta' infużjoni ġol-vina.
formal.en: The patient received the medicine through an intravenous infusion.
formal.zh: 患者通过静脉输注接受了药物治疗。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm se ddum l-infużjoni? Pawlu: Madwar siegħa; tista' toqgħod bilqiegħda hawn.
colloquial.en: Marija: How long will the infusion take? Pawlu: About an hour; you can sit here.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：输液要多久？保罗：大约一个小时，你可以坐在这里。

messages.speaker: Marija (患者)
messages.zh: 输液要多久？
messages.en: How long will the infusion take?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar siegħa; tista' toqgħod bilqiegħda hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Madwar siegħa; tista' toqgħod bilqiegħda hawn.
messages.zh: 大约一个小时，你可以坐在这里。
messages.en: About an hour; you can sit here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和输液袋缓慢滴注的画面一起记，再用 ġol-vina 提醒自己是静脉输注。

gloss_zh: 使鸟类或爬行动物的卵受精

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fertilise the eggs of a bird or reptile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使鸟类或爬行动物的卵受精。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-bajd ta' għasfur jew ta' rettilu fertili billi ċ-ċellula riproduttiva maskili tingħaqad ma' dik femminili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使鸟类或爬行动物的卵受精。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-bajd ta' għasfur jew ta' rettilu fertili billi ċ-ċellula riproduttiva maskili tingħaqad ma' dik femminili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a male bird or reptile fertilises eggs, its reproductive cells unite with the female reproductive cells.

formal.mt: L-istudju eżamina jekk is-serduk ingallax il-bajd li t-tiġieġa biedet aktar tard.
formal.en: The study examined whether the rooster had fertilised the eggs that the hen laid later.
formal.zh: 该研究考察了公鸡是否使母鸡后来产下的卵受精。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Dan is-serduk ingalla l-bajd? Pawlu: Ma nafx; irridu niċċekkjaw jekk il-bajd huwiex fertili.
colloquial.en: Lina: Did this rooster fertilise the eggs? Pawlu: I don't know; we need to check whether the eggs are fertile.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这只公鸡使这些卵受精了吗？保罗：我不知道；我们得检查这些卵是否受精。

messages.speaker: Lina (养鸡人)
messages.zh: 这只公鸡使这些卵受精了吗？
messages.en: Did this rooster fertilise the eggs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养鸡人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; irridu niċċekkjaw jekk il-bajd huwiex fertili.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; irridu niċċekkjaw jekk il-bajd huwiex fertili.
messages.zh: 我不知道；我们得检查这些卵是否受精。
messages.en: I don't know; we need to check whether the eggs are fertile.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ingalla 放进“公鸡使卵受精”的画面里记忆，重点记住它表示受精这一动作，不是孵化。

gloss_zh: 已受精的（鸟类或爬行动物的卵）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a bird's or reptile's egg that has been fertilised.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容鸟类或爬行动物的卵已经受精的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi bajda ta' għasfur jew ta' rettilu li fiha ċ-ċellula riproduttiva maskili ngħaqdet ma' dik femminili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已受精的，用于描述鸟类或爬行动物的卵。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi bajda ta' għasfur jew ta' rettilu li fiha ċ-ċellula riproduttiva maskili ngħaqdet ma' dik femminili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bird's or reptile's egg that is fertilised contains a female reproductive cell that has united with a male reproductive cell.

formal.mt: Kull bajda ingallata tqiegħdet fl-inkubatur, u l-iżvilupp tagħha ġie osservat kuljum.
formal.en: Each fertilised egg was placed in the incubator, and its development was observed daily.
formal.zh: 每枚受精卵都被放入孵化器，并每天接受发育观察。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din il-bajda ingallata? Toni: Iva, u diġà tidher fiha xibka żgħira ta' vini.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this egg fertilised? Toni: Yes, and you can already see a small network of blood vessels inside it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这枚卵受精了吗？托尼：是的，而且里面已经能看到细小的血管网。

messages.speaker: Marija (养鸡人)
messages.zh: 这枚卵受精了吗？
messages.en: Is this egg fertilised?

messages.speaker: Toni (养鸡人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u diġà tidher fiha xibka żgħira ta' vini.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u diġà tidher fiha xibka żgħira ta' vini.
messages.zh: 是的，而且里面已经能看到细小的血管网。
messages.en: Yes, and you can already see a small network of blood vessels inside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bajda ingallata 整组记成“已经受精的一枚卵”，用卵的状态帮助记住这是形容词。

gloss_zh: 欺骗；欺诈手段；背信弃义

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dishonest behaviour used to mislead someone, including a betrayal of trust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为误导他人而采取的欺骗行为或手段，也可指背叛信任的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba diżonesta maħsuba biex tqarraq b'xi ħadd, jew att li bih tinkiser il-fiduċja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为误导他人而使用的诡计、骗术或欺诈手段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-użu ta' qerq jew ta' mezzi diżonesti biex persuna titwassal temmen xi ħaġa falza jew tagħmel dak li jrid min iqarraq biha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Trickery is the use of dishonest methods to mislead people or gain an advantage over them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 背信弃义；背叛信任自己的人或违背对其应尽的忠诚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Att ta' tradiment li bih persuna tikser il-fiduċja jew il-lealtà lejn xi ħadd li kien jafda fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Treachery is behaviour in which someone betrays the trust or loyalty that another person expects from them.

collocations.en: an act of deception or treachery
collocations.zh: 欺骗或背信弃义的行为

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ikkundanna l-ingann tas-sieħeb li għadda informazzjoni kunfidenzjali lill-kompetituri.
formal.en: The committee condemned the treachery of the partner who passed confidential information to competitors.
formal.zh: 委员会谴责了那位向竞争对手泄露机密信息的合伙人的背信行为。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qaluli li rbaħt premju, imma jridu l-flus qabel jagħtuhuli. Mark: Dan ingann; tħallas xejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: They told me I'd won a prize, but they want money before giving it to me. Mark: That's a scam; don't pay anything.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他们说我中奖了，但要我先交钱才给我奖品。马克：这是骗局；一分钱也别付。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaluli li rbaħt premju, imma jridu l-flus qabel jagħtuhuli.
messages.mt_standard: Qaluli li rbaħt premju, imma jridu l-flus qabel jagħtuhuli.
messages.zh: 他们说我中奖了，但要我先交钱才给我奖品。
messages.en: They told me I'd won a prize, but they want money before giving it to me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是骗局；一分钱也别付。
messages.en: That's a scam; don't pay anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ingann 记成可以被指出的“骗局或背信行为”：听到 Dan ingann，就联想“这是欺骗”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act dishonestly towards someone or make them believe something false.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不诚实的手段欺诈他人，或使他人相信不真实的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd billi jaġixxi b'mod diżonest jew iġiegħlu jemmen xi ħaġa li mhijiex vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺诈；用不诚实的手段占他人便宜或损害他人利益。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd billi juża mezzi diżonesti biex jikseb vantaġġ jew iċaħħdu minn dak li jkun jistħoqqlu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone cheats another person, they use dishonest methods to gain an advantage or deprive that person of something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；使他人相信虚假的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jemmen xi ħaġa falza billi jgħid il-gideb, jaħbi l-verità jew jagħti impressjoni żbaljata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone deceives you, they make you believe something that is false by misleading you or hiding the truth.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-bejjiegħ inganna lill-klijent billi biegħlu prodott falz bħala wieħed oriġinali.
formal.en: The report shows that the seller cheated the customer by selling him a counterfeit product as a genuine one.
formal.zh: 报告显示，卖家把假冒产品当作正品出售，欺诈了顾客。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qalli li l-biljett kien validu, imma ma ħallewnix nidħol. David: Mela inganna lilek ukoll; lili qalli l-istess.
colloquial.en: Nina: He told me the ticket was valid, but they wouldn't let me in. David: So he deceived you too; he told me the same thing.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他告诉我票是有效的，但他们不让我进去。戴维：那他也骗了你；他跟我说的也是一样的话。

messages.speaker: Nina (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li l-biljett kien validu, imma ma ħallewnix nidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li l-biljett kien validu, imma ma ħallewnix nidħol.
messages.zh: 他告诉我票是有效的，但他们不让我进去。
messages.en: He told me the ticket was valid, but they wouldn't let me in.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela inganna lilek ukoll; lili qalli l-istess.
messages.mt_standard: Mela inganna lilek ukoll; lili qalli l-istess.
messages.zh: 那他也骗了你；他跟我说的也是一样的话。
messages.en: So he deceived you too; he told me the same thing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“卖家骗了顾客”的完整动作记 inganna，再与名词 ingann 对照：一个说欺骗动作，一个说欺骗行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loop in a rope that tightens when the rope is pulled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绳子上拉动后会收紧的环形绳套。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħolqa f'ħabel li tissikka meta jinġibed il-ħabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉动绳子时会收紧的绳套。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħolqa magħmula f'ħabel li tissikka meta jinġibed il-ħabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A noose is a loop in a rope that becomes tighter when the rope is pulled.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦去或抹去写下的内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tneħħi kitba billi timsaħha minn fuq il-wiċċ fejn tkun miktuba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone erases something written, they remove it from the surface on which it appears.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在文字上划线，表示将其删去。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaddi linja minn fuq kelma jew kitba biex turi li għandha titħassar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone strikes through writing, they draw a line across it to show that it should be disregarded.

collocations.en: he struck through the word with a line
collocations.zh: 他用一条线划去了那个词

formal.mt: L-għalliem wera lill-istudenti kif ingassa f'ħabel tissikka meta jinġibed it-tarf tal-ħabel.
formal.en: The teacher showed the students how a noose in a rope tightens when the end of the rope is pulled.
formal.zh: 老师向学生演示了拉动绳子末端时，绳套如何收紧。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din l-ingassa ssikkat wisq. Pawlu: Ħollha ftit qabel terġa' tuża l-ħabel.
colloquial.en: Marta: This noose has become too tight. Pawlu: Loosen it a little before using the rope again.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个绳套收得太紧了。保罗：再用这根绳子之前，先把它松开一点。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 这个绳套收得太紧了。
messages.en: This noose has become too tight.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħollha ftit qabel terġa' tuża l-ħabel.
messages.mt_standard: Ħollha ftit qabel terġa' tuża l-ħabel.
messages.zh: 再用这根绳子之前，先把它松开一点。
messages.en: Loosen it a little before using the rope again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ingassa 配上两张学习卡：一张画收紧的绳套，另一张画被擦去或划去的文字；用词性区分名词与动词义。

gloss_zh: 戒指上固定宝石的镶槽

teaching_sense.en_definition: The groove or hollow in a ring that holds a gemstone in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戒指上容纳并固定宝石的凹槽或凹座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kanal jew il-ħofra f'ċurkett li fiha tinżamm ħaġra prezzjuża f'postha.

sense_translations.en_definition: bezel (the groove or hollow in which holds a gem in place on a ring)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 戒指上用来容纳并固定宝石的凹槽或凹座。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kanal jew ħofra f'ċurkett fejn titqiegħed ħaġra prezzjuża u tinżamm f'postha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The bezel of a ring is the groove or hollow that holds its gemstone securely in position.

formal.mt: Il-ġojjellier eżamina l-ingast taċ-ċurkett biex jiżgura li l-ħaġra prezzjuża kienet miżmuma sew f'postha.
formal.en: The jeweller examined the ring's bezel to ensure that the gemstone was held securely in place.
formal.zh: 珠宝匠检查了戒指的镶槽，确保宝石稳固地固定在原位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tiċċaqlaq il-ħaġra taċ-ċurkett? Mark: Forsi hemm problema fl-ingast; ħudha għand il-ġojjellier.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the stone in the ring moving? Mark: Perhaps there is a problem with the bezel; take it to the jeweller.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：戒指上的宝石为什么会晃动？马克：可能是镶槽出了问题；拿去给珠宝匠看看吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 戒指上的宝石为什么会晃动？
messages.en: Why is the stone in the ring moving?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi hemm problema fl-ingast; ħudha għand il-ġojjellier.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi hemm problema fl-ingast; ħudha għand il-ġojjellier.
messages.zh: 可能是镶槽出了问题；拿去给珠宝匠看看吧。
messages.en: Perhaps there is a problem with the bezel; take it to the jeweller.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象戒指上的宝石坐进一个小凹座：宝石是乘客，ingast 是固定它的座位，重点记住镶槽。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having formally joined or been recruited into the armed forces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经正式加入军队，或已被征募进入军队的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li daħal formalment fis-servizz militari jew ġie reklutat biex iservi fil-forzi armati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已正式入伍或已被征募服兵役的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ngħaqad formalment mal-forzi armati jew ġie reklutat għas-servizz militari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is enlisted has formally joined or been recruited into the armed forces.

formal.mt: Kull suldat ingaġġat ġdid għandu jattendi t-taħriġ bażiku qabel jibda d-dmirijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: Every newly enlisted soldier must attend basic training before beginning his duties.
formal.zh: 每名新入伍的士兵都必须先参加基础训练，再开始履行职责。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk diġà ingaġġat fl-armata? Mark: Iva, u għada jibda t-taħriġ. Maja: Nawguralu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother already enlisted in the army? Mark: Yes, and he starts training tomorrow. Maja: I wish him well!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你兄弟已经入伍了吗？Mark：是的，他明天开始训练。Maja：祝他顺利！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟已经入伍了吗？
messages.en: Is your brother already enlisted in the army?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他明天开始训练。
messages.en: Yes, and he starts training tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 祝他顺利！
messages.en: I wish him well!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ingaġġat fl-armata 整组记成“已经入伍”，想象新兵办完手续、明天开始训练的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The English language, referred to as a language that people speak, read, or study.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英语，即人们用来交谈、阅读或作为科目学习的一种语言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Ingliża, li n-nies jużaw biex jitkellmu, jaqraw u jiktbu, jew jitgħallmu bħala suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英语；作为交际语言或学习科目的英语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Ingliża, meqjusa bħala mezz ta' komunikazzjoni jew bħala suġġett ta' studju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: English is the language that people use when they speak, read, or write in English.

formal.mt: L-istudenti jitgħallmu l-Ingenwa permezz tal-qari, tal-kitba u ta' eżerċizzji ta' konversazzjoni.
formal.en: The students learn English through reading, writing, and conversation exercises.
formal.zh: 学生通过阅读、写作和会话练习学习英语。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed titgħallem l-Ingenwa? David: Iva, u nixtieq nipprattika ftit kuljum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you learning English? David: Yes, and I would like to practise a little every day.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在学英语吗？戴维：是的，我想每天练习一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在学英语吗？
messages.en: Are you learning English?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u nixtieq nipprattika ftit kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u nixtieq nipprattika ftit kuljum.
messages.zh: 是的，我想每天练习一点。
messages.en: Yes, and I would like to practise a little every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把给定词形 Ingenwa 写在英语课本的想象封面上，再配上听、说、读、写四幅小图，联想其语言名词义。

gloss_zh: 抱怨声；动词所给释义“il mamma”含义不明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb supplied with the unclear gloss 'il mamma', which does not establish the intended action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给释义为“il mamma”的动词；该释义未能明确说明具体动作，因此无法据此确定动词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb mogħti bit-tifsira mhux ċara 'il mamma', li ma tispeċifikax liema azzjoni jfisser.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给动词释义为“il mamma”，其具体含义无法从所给材料确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan il-verb mhijiex ċara, għax il-kliem mogħti, 'il mamma', ma jidentifikax azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This verb has the supplied gloss 'il mamma', whose intended meaning cannot be determined from the available information.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示不满的抱怨声或嘟囔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilment jew tgergir li bih persuna turi li mhijiex kuntenta b'xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A grumble is a complaint or a low expression of dissatisfaction about something.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, 'ingergru' bħala nom jindika lment li jesprimi nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon; it-tifsira verbali mogħtija bħala 'il mamma' tibqa' mhux ċara.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, 'ingergru' as a noun denotes a complaint expressing dissatisfaction; the verb gloss supplied as 'il mamma' remains unclear.
formal.zh: 在这项词汇练习中，ingergru 的名词义表示表达不满的抱怨；所给动词释义“il mamma”仍不明确。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'ingergru' bħala nom? Toni: Ifisser ilment jew tgergir, bħal meta xi ħadd ma jkunx kuntent bl-istennija.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'ingergru' mean as a noun? Toni: It means a complaint or grumble, as when someone is unhappy about waiting.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：ingergru 作名词是什么意思？托尼：意思是抱怨或嘟囔，比如有人因为等待而不满时发出的抱怨。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: ingergru 作名词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ingergru' mean as a noun?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser ilment jew tgergir, bħal meta xi ħadd ma jkunx kuntent bl-istennija.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser ilment jew tgergir, bħal meta xi ħadd ma jkunx kuntent bl-istennija.
messages.zh: 意思是抱怨或嘟囔，比如有人因为等待而不满时发出的抱怨。
messages.en: It means a complaint or grumble, as when someone is unhappy about waiting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用排队时不满的嘟囔记住名词义；动词栏另贴“释义待明确”的便签，避免把名词义直接移到动词上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obstruct a space or hinder movement by occupying room.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因占据空间而造成阻碍，使通行、移动或使用某处变得困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu spazju f'post u b'hekk ifixkel il-mogħdija, il-moviment jew l-użu ta' dak il-post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用占地方的物品堵塞或妨碍，使移动或使用变得困难。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jimla post b'oġġetti li jieħdu spazju u jagħmlu l-moviment jew l-użu tiegħu aktar diffiċli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something encumbers a place, it occupies space and makes movement or use more difficult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处在妨碍别人通行或做事的位置；挡路；碍事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun f'pożizzjoni li tostakola l-mogħdija ta' xi ħadd jew tfixklu milli jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is in the way, its position prevents someone from passing or doing something easily.

formal.mt: L-armar ingombra l-kuritur u għamel il-passaġġ tal-ħaddiema aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: The scaffolding obstructed the corridor and made it more difficult for the workers to pass.
formal.zh: 脚手架堵占了走廊，使工人通行更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan is-siġġu ingombra l-bieb. Tista' tmexxih ftit? Pawlu: Iva, inpoġġih ħdejn il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Marija: This chair has blocked the doorway. Can you move it a little? Pawlu: Yes, I'll put it beside the table.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这把椅子挡住门口了。你能挪一下吗？Pawlu：可以，我把它放到桌子旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-siġġu ingombra l-bieb. Tista' tmexxih ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-siġġu ingombra l-bieb. Tista' tmexxih ftit?
messages.zh: 这把椅子挡住门口了。你能挪一下吗？
messages.en: This chair has blocked the doorway. Can you move it a little?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 可以，我把它放到桌子旁边。
messages.en: Yes, I'll put it beside the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象椅子横在门口：占空间便会碍事。把 ingombra 与“挡住通道”的画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A solid block of metal, such as gold or silver, cast into a convenient shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将金、银等金属熔化后浇铸成的整块金属锭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Blokka solida ta' metall, bħad-deheb jew il-fidda, magħmula billi l-metall imdewweb jitferra' f'forma u jitħalla jibbies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由金、银等金属浇铸而成的锭块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa solida ta' metall bħad-deheb jew il-fidda, iffurmata f'blokka wara li l-metall ikun ġie mdewweb.
