sense_translations.en_explanation: An ingot is a solid block of metal, such as gold or silver, formed by casting.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li kull ingott tad-deheb ġie miżun qabel ma tqiegħed fil-kaxxa tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: The report indicates that each gold ingot was weighed before being placed in the safe.
formal.zh: 报告指出，每块金锭在放入保险箱前都经过了称重。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ingott tad-deheb jew tal-fidda? Mark: Tal-fidda. Ara x'hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that a gold ingot or a silver one? Mark: A silver one. Look at what the label says.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那是金锭还是银锭？Mark：银锭。你看看标签上写的内容。

messages.speaker: Lara (博物馆参观者)
messages.zh: 那是金锭还是银锭？
messages.en: Is that a gold ingot or a silver one?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tal-fidda. Ara x'hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Tal-fidda. Ara x'hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 银锭。你看看标签上写的内容。
messages.en: A silver one. Look at what the label says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ingott 想成柜中整齐码放的金属块；搭配 tad-deheb 记金锭，搭配 tal-fidda 记银锭。

gloss_zh: 费力不讨好的；不知感恩的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing work that receives little appreciation, or a person who does not show gratitude.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容工作费力却少有感谢或认可，或形容人对得到的帮助不知感恩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xogħol li ftit iġib apprezzament, jew persuna li ma turix gratitudni għall-għajnuna jew il-ġid li tirċievi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指工作或任务费力而很少得到感谢、认可或回报的；吃力不讨好的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xogħol jew kompitu li jitlob sforz iżda ftit iġib ringrazzjament jew apprezzament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A thankless task requires effort but brings little gratitude or appreciation from other people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对他人的帮助、善意或给予不表示感谢的；不知感恩的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li ma jurix gratitudni għall-għajnuna, il-qalb tajba jew il-ġid li jirċievi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is ungrateful does not show appreciation for help or kindness they have received.

formal.mt: Il-koordinament tal-ilmenti jista' jkun xogħol ingrat, għax jitlob ħafna paċenzja iżda ftit iġib apprezzament.
formal.en: Coordinating complaints can be thankless work because it requires considerable patience but brings little appreciation.
formal.zh: 协调处理投诉可能是一项吃力不讨好的工作，因为它需要很大的耐心，却很少得到认可。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għent lil David ilbieraħ, u lanqas qalli grazzi. Marija: Kien ingrat miegħek. Messu rringrazzjak.
colloquial.en: Anna: I helped David yesterday, and he didn't even say thank you. Marija: He was ungrateful to you. He should have thanked you.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我昨天帮了 David，他连谢谢都没说。Marija：他对你太不知感恩了。他应该向你道谢。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għent lil David ilbieraħ, u lanqas qalli grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Għent lil David ilbieraħ, u lanqas qalli grazzi.
messages.zh: 我昨天帮了 David，他连谢谢都没说。
messages.en: I helped David yesterday, and he didn't even say thank you.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 他对你太不知感恩了。他应该向你道谢。
messages.en: He was ungrateful to you. He should have thanked you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“感谢没有出现”串起两义：修饰工作是费力不讨好，修饰人是不知感恩；记住要先看它形容谁。

gloss_zh: 木节；木头上突出的硬节或残枝

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hard knot in wood or a projecting woody knot or branch stub.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 木材中的坚硬节疤，或木头表面突出的硬节、短残枝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għoqda iebsa fl-injam, jew parti iebsa u mqabbża fuq l-injam li tista' tkun fdal ta' fergħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a knot in a piece of wood
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块木材中因原有树枝部位而形成的坚硬节疤；木节。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għoqda iebsa f'biċċa injam fil-post fejn kienet tikber fergħa tas-siġra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A knot in wood is a hard area where a branch once grew from the tree.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木头或树干上突出的硬节、短枝桩或残枝。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għoqda ta' injam li toħroġ 'il barra minn zokk jew biċċa injam, jew fdal qasir ta' fergħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A knag is a projecting woody knot or a short branch stub on a trunk or piece of wood.

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa identifika ingropp fl-injam u eżamina ż-żona ta' madwaru qabel ma qata' t-tavla.
formal.en: The carpenter identified a knot in the wood and examined the surrounding area before cutting the board.
formal.zh: 木匠发现木材中有一处节疤，并在切割木板前检查了它周围的部位。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex din il-biċċa injam mhix lixxa hawn? Ġużeppi: Għax għandha ingropp. Għaddi subgħajk bil-mod u tħossu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why isn't this piece of wood smooth here? Ġużeppi: Because it has a knot. Run your finger over it gently and you'll feel it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这块木头这里为什么不平滑？Ġużeppi：因为这里有个木节。用手指轻轻摸过去，你就能感觉到。

messages.speaker: Nina (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-biċċa injam mhix lixxa hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-biċċa injam mhix lixxa hawn?
messages.zh: 这块木头这里为什么不平滑？
messages.en: Why isn't this piece of wood smooth here?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (木匠师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandha ingropp. Għaddi subgħajk bil-mod u tħossu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandha ingropp. Għaddi subgħajk bil-mod u tħossu.
messages.zh: 因为这里有个木节。用手指轻轻摸过去，你就能感觉到。
messages.en: Because it has a knot. Run your finger over it gently and you'll feel it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指沿木纹滑动，碰到一处硬节：藏在木板里是节疤，向外凸出则是硬节或残枝，都可联系 ingropp 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coverings worn on the hands to keep them warm or protect them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在双手上，用于保暖或保护手部的物品；此处为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jintlibsu fuq l-idejn biex iżommuhom sħan jew jipproteġuhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手套；戴在手上以保暖或保护双手的用品，此处为复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jgħattu l-idejn u jintlibsu għall-protezzjoni jew biex l-idejn jibqgħu sħan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gloves are coverings that you wear on your hands to keep them warm or protect them.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema għandhom jilbsu ingwanti biex jipproteġu jdejhom waqt it-tindif.
formal.en: Workers should wear gloves to protect their hands while cleaning.
formal.zh: 工作人员清洁时应戴手套，以保护双手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn huma l-ingwanti tiegħi? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-kowt tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are my gloves? Mark: On the table, next to your coat.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的手套在哪里？Mark：在桌子上，就在你的外套旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的手套在哪里？
messages.en: Where are my gloves?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在桌子上，就在你的外套旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to your coat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前把两只手都套好，再连读 par ingwanti，把“一副手套”的画面与整组表达一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A preparation applied to the skin, such as an ointment or lotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂抹在皮肤上的制剂，可指膏状的软膏，也可指液状的护肤液。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preparazzjoni li titqiegħed fuq il-ġilda, bħal krema ħoxna jew likwidu għall-kura tal-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 软膏；涂在皮肤上的膏状制剂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Preparazzjoni ħoxna jew żejtnija li titqiegħed fuq il-ġilda biex tipproteġiha jew tittratta problema fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ointment is a thick preparation that you apply to the skin to protect it or treat a problem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 护肤液；涂在皮肤上用于护理或舒缓的液状制剂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Preparazzjoni likwida li titqiegħed fuq il-ġilda biex tieħu ħsiebha jew ittaffi l-irritazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lotion is a liquid preparation that you put on your skin to care for it or soothe irritation.

collocations.en: an ointment or lotion for the skin

formal.mt: It-tikketta tiddeskrivi l-ingwent u tagħti struzzjonijiet dwar kif għandu jinżamm.
formal.en: The label describes the ointment and gives instructions on how it should be stored.
formal.zh: 标签介绍了这种软膏，并说明了应如何保存。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt l-ingwent? Pawlu: Fil-kexxun tal-kamra tal-banju, ħdejn is-sapun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the ointment? Pawlu: In the bathroom drawer, next to the soap.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你把软膏放在哪里了？Pawlu：在浴室的抽屉里，就在肥皂旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 你把软膏放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the ointment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 在浴室的抽屉里，就在肥皂旁边。
messages.en: In the bathroom drawer, next to the soap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ingwent 配上“打开容器、涂到皮肤”的动作记忆；看到膏状质地联想软膏，看到液状质地联想护肤液。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Being shocked or startled, here expressing a female person's reaction to something unexpected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示女性因突如其来的事情而受惊或感到震惊；标准马耳他语写作 inħasdet。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kelma inħasdet tfisser li mara jew tifla ħasset xokk jew biża' f'daqqa minħabba xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她受惊了或感到震惊，指女性对意外情况产生的突然反应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li mara jew tifla ħasset xokk jew twerwret meta ġrat xi ħaġa li ma kinitx qed tistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a woman or girl was shocked, she felt sudden surprise, distress, or alarm at something unexpected.

collocations.en: she was startled by the noise
she was shocked by the news
collocations.zh: 她听到消息后感到震惊

formal.mt: Meta semgħet il-ħoss qawwi, l-għalliema inħasdet u waqfet titkellem għal mument.
formal.en: When she heard the loud noise, the teacher was startled and stopped speaking for a moment.
formal.zh: 听到巨响时，那位女教师吓了一跳，停下来说话片刻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sara inħasdet bil-ħoss? Mark: Iva, iżda issa kollox sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Sara startled by the noise? Mark: Yes, but everything is fine now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Sara 被那个声音吓到了吗？Mark：是的，不过现在已经没事了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Sara 被那个声音吓到了吗？
messages.en: Was Sara startled by the noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，不过现在已经没事了。
messages.en: Yes, but everything is fine now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 Sara 听见巨响后突然一惊，配着画面说 Sara inħasdet；把整句记成“她刚才吓了一跳”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expresses the speaker's love for someone or liking for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话者“我爱某人”或“我喜欢某物、某事”；标准马耳他语写作 inħobb。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kelma inħobb tintuża mill-kelliem biex jgħid li jħoss imħabba għal xi ħadd jew li xi ħaġa togħġbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我爱；我喜欢。用于表达说话者对人、事物或活动的喜爱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta l-kelliem jgħid inħobb, ikun qed jesprimi mħabba lejn xi ħadd jew gost f'xi ħaġa jew attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use inħobb when you want to say that you love someone or like something.

formal.mt: Inħobb il-letteratura għax tgħinni nifhem aħjar l-esperjenzi ta' nies oħra.
formal.en: I love literature because it helps me better understand other people's experiences.
formal.zh: 我热爱文学，因为它帮助我更好地理解他人的经历。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tħobb tagħmel fil-ħin liberu? Pawlu: Inħobb naqra u nisma' l-mużika.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you like doing in your free time? Pawlu: I like reading and listening to music.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你空闲时喜欢做什么？Pawlu：我喜欢阅读和听音乐。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你空闲时喜欢做什么？
messages.en: What do you like doing in your free time?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢阅读和听音乐。
messages.en: I like reading and listening to music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 指着自己，再指向喜爱的书或音乐，说 inħobb；把“我喜欢”的动作和整词绑定，再接具体对象练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the beginning or first stage of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某事的开始或第一阶段有关的；最初的、初始的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-bidu jew mal-ewwel fażi ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生于开始时或属于第一阶段的；最初的、初始的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jseħħ fil-bidu jew li jappartjeni għall-ewwel stadju ta' proċess, attività jew żvilupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An initial action, condition, or stage occurs at the beginning of something.

formal.mt: Matul il-fażi inizjali tal-proġett, it-tim se jiġbor l-informazzjoni meħtieġa qabel ma jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: During the initial phase of the project, the team will collect the necessary information before starting the work.
formal.zh: 在项目的初始阶段，团队将在开始工作之前收集必要的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadna se mmorru bil-karozza? Mark: Dak kien il-pjan inizjali, imma issa se nieħdu l-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we still going by car? Mark: That was the initial plan, but now we're taking the bus.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还是开车去吗？马克：那是最初的计划，不过我们现在坐公交车去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还是开车去吗？
messages.en: Are we still going by car?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kien il-pjan inizjali, imma issa se nieħdu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kien il-pjan inizjali, imma issa se nieħdu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 那是最初的计划，不过我们现在坐公交车去。
messages.en: That was the initial plan, but now we're taking the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inizjali 与英语 initial 配对记忆，脑中画出时间线的起点，再用“初始阶段、最初计划”两个搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An action or plan introduced to achieve something, or the ability to act without waiting to be told.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为实现某个目标而提出的行动或计划；也指不等他人指示便采取行动的主动性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni jew pjan li jitressaq biex jintlaħaq għan, jew il-ħila li wieħed jaġixxi minn jeddu mingħajr ma jistenna li jgħidulu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为解决问题或实现目标而发起的倡议、行动或计划；也指主动采取行动的能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proposta, pjan jew azzjoni li tibda biex tindirizza ħtieġa jew tilħaq għan; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll il-ħila li tieħu l-ewwel pass minn jeddek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An initiative is a new action or plan intended to achieve a purpose, while showing initiative means acting without waiting for instructions.

formal.mt: Il-kunsill nieda inizjattiva ġdida biex iħeġġeġ lir-residenti jżommu l-pjazza nadifa.
formal.en: The council launched a new initiative to encourage residents to keep the square clean.
formal.zh: 议会发起了一项新倡议，鼓励居民保持广场清洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadna ma ddeċidejniex min se jorganizza l-ikla. Lara: Nieħu l-inizjattiva jien u nistaqsi lil kulħadd meta jista' jiġi.
colloquial.en: Maja: We still haven't decided who will organize the meal. Lara: I'll take the initiative and ask everyone when they can come.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还没决定谁来组织聚餐。拉拉：我来主动安排，问问大家什么时候能来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna ma ddeċidejniex min se jorganizza l-ikla.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna ma ddeċidejniex min se jorganizza l-ikla.
messages.zh: 我们还没决定谁来组织聚餐。
messages.en: We still haven't decided who will organize the meal.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieħu l-inizjattiva jien u nistaqsi lil kulħadd meta jista' jiġi.
messages.mt_standard: Nieħu l-inizjattiva jien u nistaqsi lil kulħadd meta jista' jiġi.
messages.zh: 我来主动安排，问问大家什么时候能来。
messages.en: I'll take the initiative and ask everyone when they can come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inizjattiva 想成大家还在等待时有人先迈一步：提出计划是“倡议”，自己先行动是“主动性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting a substance into the body with a needle and syringe; also, a hypodermic syringe used for this purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针头和注射器将某种物质注入体内的操作；也可指用于这种操作的皮下注射器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' sustanza fil-ġisem permezz ta' labra u siringa; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għas-siringa ipodermika użata għal dan il-għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 注射，即使用针头和注射器将药物或其他物质送入体内。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' mediċina jew sustanza oħra fil-ġisem permezz ta' labra u siringa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An injection is the act of introducing medicine or another substance into the body using a needle and syringe.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮下注射器，即用于通过针头将液体注入皮下的注射器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Siringa b'labra li tintuża biex iddaħħal likwidu taħt il-ġilda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hypodermic syringe is a medical instrument used to inject liquid beneath the skin through a needle.

formal.mt: L-infermiera fetħet il-pakkett ta' injezzjoni sterili qabel ma tat l-injezzjoni lill-pazjent.
formal.en: The nurse opened the package containing a sterile hypodermic syringe before giving the patient the injection.
formal.zh: 护士先打开装有无菌皮下注射器的包装，然后为患者实施注射。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se tagħtini l-injezzjoni issa? Sara: Iva, l-ewwel se nipprepara kollox.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you going to give me the injection now? Sara: Yes, I'll prepare everything first.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你现在要给我打针吗？萨拉：是的，我先把东西准备好。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.zh: 你现在要给我打针吗？
messages.en: Are you going to give me the injection now?

messages.speaker: Sara (护士)
messages.zh: 是的，我先把东西准备好。
messages.en: Yes, I'll prepare everything first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 injezzjoni 与英语 injection 配对记忆，再想象“拿起注射器、完成注射”两个画面，区分器具义和操作义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pay no attention to someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不理会某人，或不对某事给予注意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinjora lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa meta ma tagħtix kas tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忽视某人或某事；不予理会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tinjora lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa meta ma tagħtix kashom jew ma tirreaġixxix għalihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them or do not respond.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat injora t-twissija dwar l-ispejjeż u kompla bil-proġett.
formal.en: The committee ignored the warning about costs and continued with the project.
formal.zh: 委员会无视了有关成本的警告，继续推进项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex injorajt il-messaġġ tiegħi? Mark: Ma injorajtux; kont għadni ma rajtux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you ignore my message? Mark: I didn't ignore it; I hadn't seen it yet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么不理我的消息？Mark：我没有不理你；我当时还没看到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不理我的消息？
messages.en: Why did you ignore my message?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma injorajtux; kont għadni ma rajtux.
messages.mt_standard: Ma injorajtux; kont għadni ma rajtux.
messages.zh: 我没有不理你；我当时还没看到。
messages.en: I didn't ignore it; I hadn't seen it yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 injora 和手机上看见消息却不回应的画面连起来，记住核心意思是“不予理会”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing a lack of knowledge, understanding, or good judgement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容缺乏知识、理解力或正确判断的；可带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tkun deskritta bħala injorant meta turi nuqqas ta' għarfien, fehim jew ġudizzju tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愚蠢的；表现得缺乏理解力或判断力的，带贬义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bħala aġġettiv, injorant jiddeskrivi persuna, kliem jew imġiba li juru nuqqas ta' fehim jew ġudizzju tajjeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe someone or their behaviour as injorant, you mean that they show foolishness or poor understanding.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无知的人；缺乏相关知识或理解的人，常带贬义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Injorant huwa persuna li ma għandhiex għarfien jew fehim dwar suġġett jew sitwazzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An injorant is a person who lacks knowledge or understanding, especially about the subject being discussed.

formal.mt: L-awtur iddeskriva l-kumment bħala injorant għax kien ibbażat fuq informazzjoni żbaljata.
formal.en: The author described the comment as ignorant because it was based on incorrect information.
formal.zh: 作者认为这条评论很无知，因为它以错误信息为依据。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu qal li jien injorant għax ma kontx naf it-tweġiba. Maja: Li ma tkunx taf tweġiba ma jfissirx li int injorant.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pawlu said I was ignorant because I didn't know the answer. Maja: Not knowing an answer doesn't mean you're ignorant.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 说我无知，就因为我不知道答案。Maja：不知道一个答案，并不代表你就是无知的人。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qal li jien injorant għax ma kontx naf it-tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qal li jien injorant għax ma kontx naf it-tweġiba.
messages.zh: Pawlu 说我无知，就因为我不知道答案。
messages.en: Pawlu said I was ignorant because I didn't know the answer.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li ma tkunx taf tweġiba ma jfissirx li int injorant.
messages.mt_standard: Li ma tkunx taf tweġiba ma jfissirx li int injorant.
messages.zh: 不知道一个答案，并不代表你就是无知的人。
messages.en: Not knowing an answer doesn't mean you're ignorant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 injorant 放进“无知的评论”和“一个无知的人”两个框架，分别记形容词与名词用法；评价别人时语气较重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of knowledge or understanding about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事缺乏知识、认识或理解的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-injoranza hija n-nuqqas ta' għarfien jew fehim dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无知；对某个问题、事实或领域缺乏知识或了解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-injoranza hija l-qagħda ta' min ma jkollux l-għarfien jew il-fehim meħtieġ dwar suġġett jew sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ignorance is a state in which someone lacks knowledge or understanding about a particular subject or situation.

formal.mt: Il-programm edukattiv għandu l-għan li jnaqqas l-injoranza dwar il-ħarsien tal-ambjent.
formal.en: The educational programme aims to reduce ignorance about environmental protection.
formal.zh: 该教育项目旨在减少公众对环境保护的知识缺乏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ma kontx naf li din il-pjanta teħtieġ daqshekk ilma. Sara: Jien ukoll kont naħseb hekk; l-injoranza dwar il-pjanti naqset meta bdejt naqra fuqhom.
colloquial.en: Mark: I didn't know this plant needed so much water. Sara: I used to think the same; my ignorance about plants decreased when I started reading about them.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我不知道这种植物需要这么多水。Sara：我以前也这么想；开始读有关植物的书以后，我对它们的了解就多了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma kontx naf li din il-pjanta teħtieġ daqshekk ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Ma kontx naf li din il-pjanta teħtieġ daqshekk ilma.
messages.zh: 我不知道这种植物需要这么多水。
messages.en: I didn't know this plant needed so much water.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll kont naħseb hekk; l-injoranza dwar il-pjanti naqset meta bdejt naqra fuqhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll kont naħseb hekk; l-injoranza dwar il-pjanti naqset meta bdejt naqra fuqhom.
messages.zh: 我以前也这么想；开始读有关植物的书以后，我对它们的了解就多了。
messages.en: I used to think the same; my ignorance about plants decreased when I started reading about them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 injoranza 想成知识地图上的空白区域：它指“缺乏了解的状态”，再用 dwar 接上不了解的主题。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To roast food, such as nuts or coffee beans, using dry heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用干热烘烤或焙炒食物，例如坚果或咖啡豆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinkalja ikel, bħal lewż jew kafè, meta ssaħħnu bis-sħana niexfa biex jissajjar u jiżviluppa t-togħma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烘烤；焙炒，使食物在干热作用下熟化或产生烘焙香味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tinkalja xi ħaġa tal-ikel meta ssajjarha jew issaħħanha bis-sħana niexfa, bħalma jsir bil-lewż jew bil-kafè.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you roast nuts or coffee beans, you heat them using dry heat to develop their flavour.

formal.mt: Il-kok inkalja l-lewż qabel żiedu mat-taħlita tal-kejk.
formal.en: The chef roasted the almonds before adding them to the cake mixture.
formal.zh: 厨师先将杏仁烘烤，再把它们加入蛋糕混合料中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inkalja ftit lewż għall-insalata, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Tajjeb, noqgħod attent biex ma jinħaraqx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Roast some almonds for the salad, please. Mark: All right, I'll keep an eye on them so they don't burn.
colloquial.zh: Maja：请烤一点杏仁放进沙拉里。Mark：好，我会看着，免得烤焦。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inkalja ftit lewż għall-insalata, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Inkalja ftit lewż għall-insalata, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请烤一点杏仁放进沙拉里。
messages.en: Roast some almonds for the salad, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, noqgħod attent biex ma jinħaraqx.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, noqgħod attent biex ma jinħaraqx.
messages.zh: 好，我会看着，免得烤焦。
messages.en: All right, I'll keep an eye on them so they don't burn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkalja 和杏仁受热后散发香气的画面绑定，配合“烘烤杏仁、烘焙咖啡豆”两组搭配记忆。

gloss_zh: 咖啡豆等豆类的烘焙者；烘豆设备

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or device that roasts coffee beans or other beans.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烘焙咖啡豆或其他豆类的人或设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew apparat li jinkalja l-kafè jew tipi oħra ta' fażola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烘焙咖啡豆或其他豆类的人或设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew apparat li jinkalja l-kafè jew tipi oħra ta' fażola.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inkaljatur is a person or device that roasts coffee beans or other beans.

collocations.zh: 咖啡烘焙者；咖啡烘焙机

formal.mt: Il-ħanut juża inkaljatur elettriku biex jinkalja l-kafè f'kwantitajiet żgħar.
formal.en: The shop uses an electric roaster to roast coffee in small quantities.
formal.zh: 这家店使用电动烘豆机小批量烘焙咖啡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-inkaljatur ġdid? Mark: Iva, nużawh biex ninkaljaw il-kafè kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this roaster new? Mark: Yes, we use it to roast coffee every morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这台烘豆机是新的吗？马克：是的，我们每天早上用它烘焙咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这台烘豆机是新的吗？
messages.en: Is this roaster new?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nużawh biex ninkaljaw il-kafè kull filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nużawh biex ninkaljaw il-kafè kull filgħodu.
messages.zh: 是的，我们每天早上用它烘焙咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, we use it to roast coffee every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和咖啡店里翻滚的豆子、飘出的烘焙香气一起记；看语境判断指烘焙的人还是设备。

gloss_zh: 无能力；不能胜任；失能或残障

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of ability or capacity to do something, including a disabling limitation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏完成某事所需的能力或条件，也可指限制活动能力的失能或残障。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ħila jew kapaċità biex wieħed jagħmel xi ħaġa, li jista' jkun marbut ukoll ma' diżabilità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺乏承担某项职责或进行某种活动所需的能力；无行为能力或失能状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat li fih persuna ma jkollhiex il-kapaċità meħtieġa biex twettaq attività jew tassumi responsabbiltà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Incapacity is a state in which someone lacks the capacity needed to perform an activity or fulfil a responsibility.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不能做成某件具体事情；缺乏完成该事情的能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ħila jew kapaċità li jwassal biex persuna ma tkunx tista' tagħmel xi ħaġa partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's inability to do something means that they cannot do that particular thing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 限制身体或精神功能、影响某些活动能力的失能或残障。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni fiżika jew mentali li tillimita l-kapaċità ta' persuna li twettaq ċerti attivitajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disability is a physical or mental condition that limits a person's ability to carry out certain activities.

collocations.zh: 无法阅读；缺乏阅读能力

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi inkapaċità temporanja li żammet lill-ħaddiem milli jwettaq ċerti kompiti.
formal.en: The report describes a temporary incapacity that prevented the worker from carrying out certain tasks.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一种暂时失能状态，使该员工无法执行某些任务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadni ma nistax nuża idi sew wara l-inċident. Mark: Din l-inkapaċità qed taffettwa x-xogħol tiegħek? Maja: Iva, bħalissa ma nistax nikteb bil-pinna.
colloquial.en: Maja: I still can't use my hand properly after the accident. Mark: Is this incapacity affecting your work? Maja: Yes, I can't write with a pen at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：事故之后，我的手还是不能正常使用。马克：这种失能状态影响你的工作了吗？玛雅：是的，我现在还不能用笔写字。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nistax nuża idi sew wara l-inċident.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nistax nuża idi sew wara l-inċident.
messages.zh: 事故之后，我的手还是不能正常使用。
messages.en: I still can't use my hand properly after the accident.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-inkapaċità qed taffettwa x-xogħol tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-inkapaċità qed taffettwa x-xogħol tiegħek?
messages.zh: 这种失能状态影响你的工作了吗？
messages.en: Is this incapacity affecting your work?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bħalissa ma nistax nikteb bil-pinna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bħalissa ma nistax nikteb bil-pinna.
messages.zh: 是的，我现在还不能用笔写字。
messages.en: Yes, I can't write with a pen at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“能力受限，事情做不了”的画面记忆：具体某事做不了对应 inability，整体失能状态对应 incapacity，功能性障碍对应 disability。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To assign someone a task or entrust them with responsibility for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把任务交给某人，或托付某事并让其承担责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd kompitu jew jafdalu r-responsabbiltà ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指派某人执行一项任务；责成某人办理某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti lil persuna kompitu speċifiku li tkun mistennija twettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you charge someone with a task, you give them that task and expect them to carry it out.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出于信任，把某项事务托付给某人处理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jafda lil xi ħadd b'xi ħaġa biex jieħu ħsiebha jew iwettaqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you entrust someone with something, you place it in their care because you trust them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让某人负责某事，并承担相应的管理或执行责任。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti lil persuna r-responsabbiltà li tmexxi jew tieħu ħsieb xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you give someone responsibility for something, you make them answerable for managing it or ensuring it is done.

collocations.mt: inkariga lil xi ħadd biex jorganizza laqgħa
collocations.en: put someone in charge of organizing a meeting
collocations.zh: 委派某人负责组织会议

collocations.mt: inkariga lil xi ħadd bit-tmexxija tal-proġett
collocations.en: entrust someone with managing the project

formal.mt: Id-direttur inkariga lil Marija biex tħejji r-rapport u tippreżentah fil-laqgħa li jmiss.
formal.en: The director assigned Marija to prepare the report and present it at the next meeting.
formal.zh: 主管委派玛丽娅准备报告，并在下次会议上进行汇报。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jorganizza l-laqgħa? Maja: Il-kap inkariga lili. Mark: Tajjeb, għidli jekk għandek bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who's going to organize the meeting? Maja: The boss put me in charge. Mark: Great, let me know if you need help.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁来组织会议？玛雅：负责人委派了我。马克：好，需要帮忙就告诉我。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 谁来组织会议？
messages.en: Who's going to organize the meeting?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 负责人委派了我。
messages.en: The boss put me in charge.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, għidli jekk għandek bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, għidli jekk għandek bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 好，需要帮忙就告诉我。
messages.en: Great, let me know if you need help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主管把任务卡交到某人手中：既是“交办任务”，也是“托付事情”，还意味着“由此人负责”。

gloss_zh: 忧心；烦恼；为某事焦虑不安

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep worrying or feeling upset about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某事反复忧虑，感到烦恼或心神不安。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss tħassib jew dwejjaq u jibqa' jaħseb fuq xi ħaġa li qed tinkwetah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某事持续忧虑或烦恼，难以安心。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibqa' jinkwieta jew iħossu mdejjaq minħabba xi ħaġa li ma tħallihx bi kwietu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you fret about something, you keep worrying about it and find it difficult to feel calm.

formal.mt: L-istudent m'għandux għalfejn jinkedd jekk ma jifhimx kollox mill-ewwel; jista' jitlob spjegazzjoni oħra.
formal.en: The student need not fret if he does not understand everything immediately; he can ask for another explanation.
formal.zh: 学生如果不能马上理解全部内容，也不必忧心；他可以请人再解释一次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tinkedd? Mark: Għadni ma rċevejtx ir-riżultat tal-eżami. Maja: Ipprova strieħ ftit waqt li tistenna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you fretting? Mark: I still haven't received my exam result. Maja: Try to get some rest while you wait.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么这么忧心？马克：我还没有收到考试成绩。玛雅：等成绩的时候，试着休息一下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么忧心？
messages.en: Why are you fretting?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我还没有收到考试成绩。
messages.en: I still haven't received my exam result.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova strieħ ftit waqt li tistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova strieħ ftit waqt li tistenna.
messages.zh: 等成绩的时候，试着休息一下吧。
messages.en: Try to get some rest while you wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等成绩时反复看手机、皱眉难安的样子；这个词强调忧虑一直在心里打转。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official investigation, especially one conducted to establish the circumstances of a death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为查明事实而进行的正式调查，尤指调查死亡原因及相关情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Investigazzjoni uffiċjali biex jiġu stabbiliti l-fatti, speċjalment iċ-ċirkostanzi ta' mewt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为查明死亡原因及死亡情况而进行的正式调查。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Investigazzjoni uffiċjali li ssir biex jiġu stabbiliti l-kawża u ċ-ċirkostanzi ta' mewt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inquest is an official investigation into the cause and circumstances of someone's death.

formal.mt: L-inkjesta għandha tistabbilixxi ċ-ċirkostanzi tal-mewt u tiġbor ix-xhieda rilevanti.
formal.en: The inquest is intended to establish the circumstances of the death and collect the relevant testimony.
formal.zh: 这项死因调查旨在查明死亡情况，并收集相关证词。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex fetħu inkjesta? Pawlu: Biex isiru jafu kif seħħet il-mewt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did they open an inquest? Pawlu: To find out how the death occurred.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：他们为什么启动死因调查？保罗：为了查清死者是在什么情况下死亡的。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么启动死因调查？
messages.en: Why did they open an inquest?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex isiru jafu kif seħħet il-mewt.
messages.mt_standard: Biex isiru jafu kif seħħet il-mewt.
messages.zh: 为了查清死者是在什么情况下死亡的。
messages.en: To find out how the death occurred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkjesta 放进“启动调查—收集证词—查明死因”的场景中记忆，重点联想正式调查。

gloss_zh: 已结案且未作财务纠正的调查

teaching_sense.en_definition: An enquiry that has been closed without a financial correction being made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经结束并结案，且未作财务纠正的调查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inkjesta li tkun intemmet u ngħalqet mingħajr ma tkun saret korrezzjoni finanzjarja.

sense_translations.en_definition: enquiry closed without a financial correction
sense_translations.zh_definition: 已结案、未作财务纠正的调查。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Inkjesta li tkun ingħalqet mingħajr ma tkun saret korrezzjoni finanzjarja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An enquiry closed without a financial correction is one that has ended without such a correction being made.

collocations.mt: każ ta' inkjesta magħluqa mingħajr korrezzjoni finanzjarja
collocations.en: a case of an enquiry closed without a financial correction
collocations.zh: 一宗已结案且未作财务纠正的调查

collocations.mt: ir-reġistrazzjoni ta' inkjesta magħluqa mingħajr korrezzjoni finanzjarja
collocations.en: the recording of an enquiry closed without a financial correction
collocations.zh: 对已结案且未作财务纠正的调查的登记

formal.mt: Fir-rapport annwali, dan il-każ huwa elenkat bħala inkjesta magħluqa mingħajr korrezzjoni finanzjarja.
formal.en: In the annual report, this case is listed as an enquiry closed without a financial correction.
formal.zh: 在年度报告中，此案被列为已结案且未作财务纠正的调查。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu mniżżel il-każ fir-rapport? Mark: Bħala inkjesta magħluqa mingħajr korrezzjoni finanzjarja. Lara: Mela l-inkjesta ngħalqet u ma saret ebda korrezzjoni finanzjarja.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is the case recorded in the report? Mark: As an enquiry closed without a financial correction. Lara: So the enquiry was closed and no financial correction was made.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：报告里是怎么记录这个案件的？马克：记录为已结案且未作财务纠正的调查。拉拉：也就是说，调查已经结束，而且没有作财务纠正。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 报告里是怎么记录这个案件的？
messages.en: How is the case recorded in the report?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħala inkjesta magħluqa mingħajr korrezzjoni finanzjarja.
messages.mt_standard: Bħala inkjesta magħluqa mingħajr korrezzjoni finanzjarja.
messages.zh: 记录为已结案且未作财务纠正的调查。
messages.en: As an enquiry closed without a financial correction.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela l-inkjesta ngħalqet u ma saret ebda korrezzjoni finanzjarja.
messages.mt_standard: Mela l-inkjesta ngħalqet u ma saret ebda korrezzjoni finanzjarja.
messages.zh: 也就是说，调查已经结束，而且没有作财务纠正。
messages.en: So the enquiry was closed and no financial correction was made.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按语义分块记忆：inkjesta 是调查，magħluqa 是已关闭，mingħajr 是没有，korrezzjoni finanzjarja 是财务纠正；合起来就是调查结案且未作财务纠正。

gloss_zh: 如果不；如果回答是否定的

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression introducing what follows if something is not the case or if the answer is no.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出某条件不成立或对方作否定回答时的后续安排，意为“如果不”或“如果答案是否定的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tintroduċi x'jiġri jekk xi ħaġa ma tkunx hekk jew jekk it-tweġiba tkun le.

sense_translations.en_definition: if not, if the answer is no
sense_translations.zh_definition: 如果不是这样；如果回答是“不”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser jekk xi ħaġa ma tkunx hekk jew jekk it-tweġiba għal mistoqsija tkun le.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to introduce what happens if something is not the case or the answer is no.

collocations.en: if not, we will meet tomorrow
collocations.zh: 如果不行，我们就明天见

formal.mt: Jekk ikun possibbli, il-laqgħa ssir it-Tnejn; inklele, tiġi proposta data oħra.
formal.en: If possible, the meeting will take place on Monday; if not, another date will be proposed.
formal.zh: 如条件允许，会议将于周一举行；否则，将另行提出日期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tiġi llum? Inklele, niltaqgħu għada. David: Illum ma nistax, imma għada nista'.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you come today? If not, we will meet tomorrow. David: I cannot today, but I can tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天能来吗？如果不行，我们就明天见。戴维：今天不行，不过明天可以。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tiġi llum? Inklele, niltaqgħu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tiġi llum? Inklele, niltaqgħu għada.
messages.zh: 你今天能来吗？如果不行，我们就明天见。
messages.en: Can you come today? If not, we will meet tomorrow.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum ma nistax, imma għada nista'.
messages.mt_standard: Illum ma nistax, imma għada nista'.
messages.zh: 今天不行，不过明天可以。
messages.en: I cannot today, but I can tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inklele 记成对话里的“否定答案备用方案”：先问能不能，再接“如果不行，就……”，用完整情境帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression introducing an alternative when the preceding condition is not fulfilled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出前述条件未满足时的另一种安排或结果，意为“如果不”或“否则”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintroduċi alternattiva jew riżultat meta l-kundizzjoni msemmija qabel ma sseħħx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 如果不是这样；如果前述条件不成立。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser jekk il-kundizzjoni jew is-sitwazzjoni msemmija qabel ma tkunx hekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to introduce an alternative when a previously mentioned condition is not fulfilled.

collocations.zh: 如果不行，我们就等一等

collocations.en: if not, we will choose another place
collocations.zh: 如果不行，我们就另选一个地方

formal.mt: Jekk is-sala tkun disponibbli, il-laqgħa ssir hemm; inklelè, jintgħażel post ieħor.
formal.en: If the hall is available, the meeting will take place there; if not, another venue will be chosen.
formal.zh: 如果大厅可用，会议将在那里举行；否则，将另选场地。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Jekk hemm mejda ħielsa, nieklu hawn; inklelè, nagħżlu post ieħor. Anton: Hemm waħda ħdejn it-tieqa. Ejja noqogħdu hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: If there is a free table, we will eat here; if not, we will choose another place. Anton: There is one by the window. Let's sit there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：如果有空桌，我们就在这里吃；否则，就换一家。安东：窗边有一张。我们坐那里吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk hemm mejda ħielsa, nieklu hawn; inklelè, nagħżlu post ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk hemm mejda ħielsa, nieklu hawn; inklelè, nagħżlu post ieħor.
messages.zh: 如果有空桌，我们就在这里吃；否则，就换一家。
messages.en: If there is a free table, we will eat here; if not, we will choose another place.

messages.speaker: Anton (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm waħda ħdejn it-tieqa. Ejja noqogħdu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm waħda ħdejn it-tieqa. Ejja noqogħdu hemm.
messages.zh: 窗边有一张。我们坐那里吧。
messages.en: There is one by the window. Let's sit there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“有空桌就坐下，inklelè 就换地方”的画面记住“如果不、否则”；抄写时留意词尾 è，保留本词条的准确拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sloping rather than level, or tending towards a particular action or preference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体或表面倾斜，也可形容人倾向于某种行为、选择或偏好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun immejjel aktar milli orizzontali, jew li jkollu tendenza lejn xi għażla jew imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾斜的；与水平面形成一定角度的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun immejjel jew f'angolu mal-linja orizzontali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inclined surface slopes instead of being completely level.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于某事的；较容易表现出某种行为或偏好的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu tendenza jew predispożizzjoni lejn xi ħaġa jew lejn ċertu tip ta' mġiba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is inclined towards something, they tend to prefer it or behave in that way.

formal.mt: L-inġinier ikkonferma li l-wiċċ huwa inklinat u mhux orizzontali.
formal.en: The engineer confirmed that the surface is inclined rather than horizontal.
formal.zh: 工程师确认，该表面是倾斜的，而非水平的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ballun jibqa' jdur lejn il-bieb? Mark: Għax il-wiċċ huwa inklinat. Poġġih f'kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the ball keep rolling towards the door? Mark: Because the surface is sloping. Put it in a box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：球为什么总是往门口滚？马克：因为这个表面是斜的。把球放进盒子里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ballun jibqa' jdur lejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ballun jibqa' jdur lejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 球为什么总是往门口滚？
messages.en: Why does the ball keep rolling towards the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-wiċċ huwa inklinat. Poġġih f'kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-wiċċ huwa inklinat. Poġġih f'kaxxa.
messages.zh: 因为这个表面是斜的。把球放进盒子里吧。
messages.en: Because the surface is sloping. Put it in a box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项连成画面：斜面向一边倾，人的偏好也向某个选择倾；用“倾斜”和“倾向”一起记。

gloss_zh: 图线上直线或曲线的斜率

teaching_sense.en_definition: The measure of how steeply a line on a graph rises or falls as the horizontal value increases.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 图线上直线或曲线的倾斜程度，以纵坐标变化量与相应横坐标变化量的比值表示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kejl ta' kemm linja fuq graff titla' jew tinżel, espress bħala l-proporzjon bejn il-bidla fil-valur vertikali u l-bidla korrispondenti fil-valur orizzontali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斜率；图线上纵坐标变化量与相应横坐标变化量的比值，用于表示线的倾斜程度和方向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proporzjon bejn il-bidla fil-koordinata vertikali u l-bidla korrispondenti fil-koordinata orizzontali, li juri kemm linja fuq graff titla' jew tinżel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The slope of a line on a graph describes how much its vertical value changes for a given horizontal change.

collocations.en: a positive slope on a graph
to calculate the slope on a graph

formal.mt: Meta l-valur orizzontali jiżdied b'unità waħda u l-valur vertikali jiżdied b'żewġ unitajiet, l-inklinazzjoni grafika tal-linja dritta tkun tnejn.
formal.en: When the horizontal value increases by one unit and the vertical value increases by two units, the slope of the straight line on the graph is two.
formal.zh: 当横坐标增加一个单位、纵坐标增加两个单位时，图中这条直线的斜率为二。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif insib l-inklinazzjoni grafika ta' din il-linja dritta? Pawlu: Ħu żewġ punti fuqha u aqsam il-bidla vertikali bil-bidla orizzontali.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do I find the slope of this straight line on the graph? Pawlu: Take two points on it and divide the vertical change by the horizontal change.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：怎样求图中这条直线的斜率？保罗：在线上取两个点，用纵向变化量除以横向变化量。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif insib l-inklinazzjoni grafika ta' din il-linja dritta?
messages.mt_standard: Kif insib l-inklinazzjoni grafika ta' din il-linja dritta?
messages.zh: 怎样求图中这条直线的斜率？
messages.en: How do I find the slope of this straight line on the graph?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu żewġ punti fuqha u aqsam il-bidla vertikali bil-bidla orizzontali.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu żewġ punti fuqha u aqsam il-bidla vertikali bil-bidla orizzontali.
messages.zh: 在线上取两个点，用纵向变化量除以横向变化量。
messages.en: Take two points on it and divide the vertical change by the horizontal change.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条向右上方延伸的直线，默念“纵向变化除以横向变化”；把整个词组与图线斜率绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To contain someone or something as a part, or to make them part of a group, list, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人或某物作为整体的一部分包含在内，或将其列入群体、名单或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bħala parti minn ħaġa sħiħa, jew idaħħalhom fi grupp, lista jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包括；包含；将某人或某物纳入某个整体、名单或安排之中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollu xi ħaġa bħala parti minn ħaġa sħiħa, jew jagħmel lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa parti minn grupp jew arranġament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you include someone or something, you make them part of a larger group, arrangement, or whole.

collocations.zh: 他把所有费用都计入了

collocations.en: he included my name on the list
collocations.zh: 他把我的名字列入了名单

formal.mt: L-awtur inkluda tliet eżempji fir-rapport biex jiċċara l-proposta.
formal.en: The author included three examples in the report to clarify the proposal.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中加入了三个例子，以阐明这项提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark inkluda ismi fil-lista għall-ħarġa? Sara: Iva, inkluda ismek u bbukkja post għalik ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark include my name on the list for the outing? Sara: Yes, he included your name and booked a place for you too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克把我的名字列入出游名单了吗？萨拉：列入了，他还给你订了一个名额。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克把我的名字列入出游名单了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark include my name on the list for the outing?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inkluda ismek u bbukkja post għalik ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inkluda ismek u bbukkja post għalik ukoll.
messages.zh: 列入了，他还给你订了一个名额。
messages.en: Yes, he included your name and booked a place for you too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把名字写进名单的动作，用“他把名字列入了”记住 inkluda；例句中的这个形式表示他已经完成了列入动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Contained or counted as part of a larger whole, arrangement, or stated price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为整体或某项安排的一部分被包含在内的，也可指已经计入所报价格的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun jagħmel parti minn ħaġa sħiħa jew minn arranġament, jew li jkun diġà magħdud fil-prezz imsemmi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包括在内的；被纳入某个整体或安排的；费用已经计入的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun diġà parti minn grupp, pakkett jew arranġament, jew li l-ispiża tiegħu tkun diġà magħduda fil-prezz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is included, it forms part of the whole or is already covered by the stated price.

formal.mt: Il-materjal kollu meħtieġ huwa inkluż fil-miżata tal-kors.
formal.en: All the required material is included in the course fee.
formal.zh: 所有必需材料均已包含在课程费用中。

colloquial.mt: David: Il-kolazzjon huwa inkluż fil-prezz tal-kamra? Anna: Iva, huwa inkluż. Tista' tiekol mis-sebgħa sal-għaxra.
colloquial.en: David: Is breakfast included in the room price? Anna: Yes, it is included. You can eat from seven until ten.
colloquial.zh: 戴维：房价包含早餐吗？安娜：是的，包含早餐。你可以在七点到十点之间用餐。

messages.speaker: David (住客)
messages.zh: 房价包含早餐吗？
messages.en: Is breakfast included in the room price?

messages.speaker: Anna (酒店前台工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa inkluż. Tista' tiekol mis-sebgħa sal-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa inkluż. Tista' tiekol mis-sebgħa sal-għaxra.
messages.zh: 是的，包含早餐。你可以在七点到十点之间用餐。
messages.en: Yes, it is included. You can eat from seven until ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象房价旁边盖着“早餐已包含”的印章，把 inkluż 与“已经算在里面”的状态一起记；订房时可联想 inkluż fil-prezz。

gloss_zh: 停运安排的不相容；停运计划冲突

teaching_sense.en_definition: A conflict between outages or their planned timing that prevents the arrangements from working together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不同停运情况或其时间安排无法协调、因而不能共同实施的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni fejn waqfiet fis-servizz jew il-ħinijiet ippjanati tagħhom ma jkunux jistgħu jiġu kkombinati mingħajr kunflitt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不同停运情况之间存在无法协调的冲突。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kunflitt bejn waqfiet fis-servizz li ma jkunux jistgħu jseħħu flimkien mingħajr ma joħolqu problema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Outage incompatibility occurs when separate service interruptions cannot take place together without creating a conflict.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 停运计划之间在时间或其他安排上存在无法兼容的冲突。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kunflitt fl-ippjanar tal-waqfiet fis-servizz minħabba ħinijiet jew arranġamenti li ma jkunux jaqblu ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Outage planning incompatibility exists when proposed interruption schedules or arrangements cannot be coordinated successfully.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika inkompatibilità tal-indisponibilità bejn iż-żewġ waqfiet ippjanati, għax is-servizz ma jistax jieqaf fiż-żewġ postijiet fl-istess ħin.
formal.en: The report identifies outage incompatibility between the two planned interruptions because service cannot stop at both locations simultaneously.
formal.zh: 报告指出，两项计划停运存在冲突，因为两个地点不能同时停止服务。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex irridu nbiddlu l-ħin tal-waqfa? Pawlu: Hemm inkompatibilità tal-indisponibilità: jekk nieqfu t-tnejn fl-istess ħin, ma jibqa' ebda servizz.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why do we need to change the time of the interruption? Pawlu: There is an outage conflict: if both stop at the same time, there will be no service left.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：为什么要改停运时间？保罗：停运安排有冲突；如果两边同时停，就完全没有服务了。

messages.speaker: Marija (项目协调员)
messages.zh: 为什么要改停运时间？
messages.en: Why do we need to change the time of the interruption?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm inkompatibilità tal-indisponibilità: jekk nieqfu t-tnejn fl-istess ħin, ma jibqa' ebda servizz.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm inkompatibilità tal-indisponibilità: jekk nieqfu t-tnejn fl-istess ħin, ma jibqa' ebda servizz.
messages.zh: 停运安排有冲突；如果两边同时停，就完全没有服务了。
messages.en: There is an outage conflict: if both stop at the same time, there will be no service left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两张停运时间表重叠，导致备用服务也停了；用这个画面记住整个短语表示停运安排不相容。

gloss_zh: 继续做它；把那件事接着做下去

teaching_sense.en_definition: To continue working on or carrying out something that has already been started.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对已经开始的事情继续进行，或在暂停后接着做。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkompli taħdem fuq xi ħaġa li tkun diġà bdejt, jew terġa' taqbadha wara waqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把已经开始的事情继续做下去。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkompli tagħmel ix-xogħol jew l-attività li tkun diġà bdejt, minflok tieqaf jew tħalliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you carry on with something, you continue doing it after starting it or taking a break.

collocations.en: carry on with it after the break

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol li bdejt illum inkomplih għada, wara li nirċievi l-informazzjoni meħtieġa.
formal.en: I will continue tomorrow with the work I started today, after receiving the necessary information.
formal.zh: 收到所需信息后，我明天会接着做今天开始的工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Spiċċajt il-proġett? Mark: Għadni le. Inkomplih għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you finished the project? Mark: Not yet. I'll carry on with it tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：项目做完了吗？马克：还没有。我明天早上接着做。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 项目做完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 还没有。我明天早上接着做。
messages.en: Not yet. I'll carry on with it tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上放着尚未完成的项目，明天回来接着做；把 inkomplih 和“继续把它做下去”的场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To support someone or strengthen their confidence so that they are more willing to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某人支持或增强其信心，使其更愿意行动或继续努力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti appoġġ lil xi ħadd jew issaħħaħ il-fiduċja tiegħu biex ikun aktar lest jaġixxi jew ikompli jipprova.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以支持、肯定或劝勉鼓励某人，使其有信心去做某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel xi ħaġa billi turih appoġġ u ssaħħaħ il-fiduċja tiegħu fih innifsu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who encourages another person helps them feel more confident and willing to take action.

formal.mt: Il-kowċ inkoraġixxa lit-tim biex ikompli jitħarreġ b'mod regolari u jitgħallem mill-iżbalji tiegħu.
formal.en: The coach encouraged the team to continue training regularly and learn from its mistakes.
formal.zh: 教练鼓励团队继续定期训练，并从错误中学习。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex iddeċidejt tieħu sehem fit-tellieqa? Luqa: Missieri inkoraġixxa lili u qalli biex nipprova, anki jekk ma nirbaħx.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you decide to take part in the race? Luqa: My father encouraged me and told me to try, even if I don't win.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么决定参加比赛？卢卡：我爸爸鼓励了我，叫我试一试，就算赢不了也没关系。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么决定参加比赛？
messages.en: Why did you decide to take part in the race?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri inkoraġixxa lili u qalli biex nipprova, anki jekk ma nirbaħx.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri inkoraġixxa lili u qalli biex nipprova, anki jekk ma nirbaħx.
messages.zh: 我爸爸鼓励了我，叫我试一试，就算赢不了也没关系。
messages.en: My father encouraged me and told me to try, even if I don't win.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象父亲在起跑线旁说“试试看”，帮助孩子建立信心；用这个画面记住 inkoraġixxa 表示鼓励，并按本词条记住单个 ġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone confidence or support so that they feel able or willing to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过支持或肯定使某人更有信心、更愿意采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti lil xi ħadd appoġġ jew fiduċja biex iħossu kapaċi jew lest jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼓励某人，通过支持、肯定或劝勉增强其行动的信心和意愿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa billi tagħtih appoġġ u tgħinu jemmen fil-ħila tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you encourage someone, you give them support or confidence to help them do something.

formal.mt: L-għalliem inkoraġġixxa lill-istudenti biex jistaqsu mistoqsijiet u jesprimu l-ideat tagħhom waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher encouraged the students to ask questions and express their ideas during the lesson.
formal.zh: 老师鼓励学生们在课堂上提问并表达自己的想法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sibt il-kuraġġ tkanta quddiem kulħadd? Nina: Ħija inkoraġġixxa lili u qalli li kont ippreparata sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you find the courage to sing in front of everyone? Nina: My brother encouraged me and told me I was well prepared.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么鼓起勇气在大家面前唱歌的？妮娜：我哥哥鼓励了我，还说我准备得很充分。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sibt il-kuraġġ tkanta quddiem kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sibt il-kuraġġ tkanta quddiem kulħadd?
messages.zh: 你怎么鼓起勇气在大家面前唱歌的？
messages.en: How did you find the courage to sing in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija inkoraġġixxa lili u qalli li kont ippreparata sew.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija inkoraġġixxa lili u qalli li kont ippreparata sew.
messages.zh: 我哥哥鼓励了我，还说我准备得很充分。
messages.en: My brother encouraged me and told me I was well prepared.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师说“你能做到”，让学生敢于开口；把 inkoraġġixxa 与这个鼓励场景绑定，并留意词中的双写 ġġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely angry about someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人或某事而极其愤怒的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun irrabjat ħafna minħabba xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极其愤怒的；怒不可遏的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli rabja kbira minħabba xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is furious is extremely angry about something.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-impjegat stqarr li l-klijent kien inkorlat minħabba d-dewmien fis-servizz.
formal.en: In the report, the employee stated that the customer was furious because of the delay in service.
formal.zh: 员工在报告中表示，顾客因服务延误而怒不可遏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark kien daqshekk inkorlat? Lara: Xi ħadd kisser il-mowbajl tiegħu u ma qallu xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Mark so furious? Lara: Someone broke his phone and didn't tell him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么那么生气？拉拉：有人弄坏了他的手机，却没有告诉他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么那么生气？
messages.en: Why was Mark so furious?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd kisser il-mowbajl tiegħu u ma qallu xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd kisser il-mowbajl tiegħu u ma qallu xejn.
messages.zh: 有人弄坏了他的手机，却没有告诉他。
messages.en: Someone broke his phone and didn't tell him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkorlat 和气得拍桌子的画面联系起来：它表示强烈愤怒，记忆时用“怒不可遏”突出程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very difficult to believe, or so extraordinary that it causes great surprise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让人很难相信的，或因非同寻常而令人惊叹的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun diffiċli ħafna biex temmnu, jew tant straordinarju li jqanqal stagħġib kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难以置信的；非同寻常而令人惊叹的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun diffiċli ħafna biex temmnu jew li jkun tant straordinarju li jġiegħlek tistagħġeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is incredible, it is very difficult to believe or so extraordinary that it amazes you.

formal.mt: Fir-reċensjoni, il-kritiku ddeskriva l-wirja bħala esperjenza inkredibbli minħabba l-kwalità tal-mużika.
formal.en: In the review, the critic described the performance as an incredible experience because of the quality of the music.
formal.zh: 评论家在乐评中表示，音乐的高水准使这场演出成为一次令人惊叹的体验。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-filmat ta' Lara tkanta? Mark: Iva, għandha vuċi inkredibbli!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the video of Lara singing? Mark: Yes, she has an incredible voice!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看过拉拉唱歌的视频吗？马克：看过，她的嗓音太惊人了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过拉拉唱歌的视频吗？
messages.en: Did you see the video of Lara singing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看过，她的嗓音太惊人了！
messages.en: Yes, she has an incredible voice!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“听到消息瞪大眼”和“听到歌声惊叹”两个画面记 inkredibbli，分别对应难以置信与惊人出色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden, usually brief entry into another territory, especially by an armed force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然进入另一片领土的行动，尤指武装力量实施的短暂侵入或突袭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dħul għal għarrieda, ġeneralment għal żmien qasir, f'territorju ieħor, speċjalment minn forza armata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对另一片领土的突然侵入，尤指军队实施的短暂入侵或突袭。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni li fiha grupp, speċjalment forza armata, jidħol għal għarrieda u għal żmien qasir f'territorju ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An incursion is a sudden entry into another territory, especially a brief attack by an armed force.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-inkursjoni militari fit-territorju ġirien damet ftit sigħat biss.
formal.en: In the story, the military incursion into the neighbouring territory lasted only a few hours.
formal.zh: 故事中，对邻近领土的军事侵入只持续了几个小时。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara f'dik ix-xena tal-film? Mark: Is-suldati għamlu inkursjoni fit-territorju tal-għadu u mbagħad irtiraw.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened in that scene in the film? Mark: The soldiers made an incursion into enemy territory and then withdrew.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里那个场景发生了什么？马克：士兵们突入敌方领土，然后撤退了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里那个场景发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened in that scene in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-suldati għamlu inkursjoni fit-territorju tal-għadu u mbagħad irtiraw.
messages.mt_standard: Is-suldati għamlu inkursjoni fit-territorju tal-għadu u mbagħad irtiraw.
messages.zh: 士兵们突入敌方领土，然后撤退了。
messages.en: The soldiers made an incursion into enemy territory and then withdrew.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上一支箭头突然越过边界，短暂停留后撤回；用这个画面记 inkursjoni 的突然侵入含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having had a crown placed on the head, especially as part of becoming a monarch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头上已被戴上王冠的，尤指已通过加冕仪式成为君主的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tkun tqiegħdet kuruna fuq rasu, speċjalment waqt ċerimonja li fiha jsir monarka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已戴上王冠的；已接受加冕的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ingħata kuruna biex jilbisha fuq rasu, speċjalment bħala sinjal li sar monarka.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crowned person has had a crown placed on their head, usually in a ceremony making them a monarch.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-re li kien għadu kif ġie inkurunat indirizza lill-poplu għall-ewwel darba.
formal.en: In the novel, the newly crowned king addressed the people for the first time.
formal.zh: 小说中，刚刚加冕的国王首次向民众发表讲话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tifel liebes kuruna? Mark: Fid-dramm tal-iskola, ġie inkurunat bħala re.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the boy wearing a crown? Mark: In the school play, he was crowned as king.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩为什么戴着王冠？马克：在学校的话剧里，他被加冕为国王。

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么戴着王冠？
messages.en: Why is the boy wearing a crown?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fid-dramm tal-iskola, ġie inkurunat bħala re.
messages.mt_standard: Fid-dramm tal-iskola, ġie inkurunat bħala re.
messages.zh: 在学校的话剧里，他被加冕为国王。
messages.en: In the school play, he was crowned as king.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkurunat 配上王冠已经落在头上的定格画面，记住它描述“已加冕、已戴上王冠”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce the subject to which a statement refers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出某项说明、评论或信息所涉及的话题，表示“关于”或“就……而言”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika s-suġġett li dwaru qed isir kumment jew tingħata informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关于；用来标明话语所涉及的对象或话题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex torbot dak li jingħad mas-suġġett li għalih jirreferi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to identify the subject that your statement concerns.

formal.mt: Inkwantu għall-ispejjeż tal-proġett, se jingħataw aktar dettalji fir-rapport li jmiss.
formal.en: With regard to the project's expenses, further details will be provided in the next report.
formal.zh: 关于项目费用，将在下一份报告中提供更多细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Diġà għażilna l-post. Inkwantu għall-ħin, jaqbillek fis-sitta? Mark: Iva, fis-sitta tajjeb għalija.
colloquial.en: Maja: We've already chosen the place. As for the time, does six suit you? Mark: Yes, six works for me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们已经选好地点了。至于时间，六点你方便吗？Mark：方便，六点适合我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà għażilna l-post. Inkwantu għall-ħin, jaqbillek fis-sitta?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà għażilna l-post. Inkwantu għall-ħin, jaqbillek fis-sitta?
messages.zh: 我们已经选好地点了。至于时间，六点你方便吗？
messages.en: We've already chosen the place. As for the time, does six suit you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 方便，六点适合我。
messages.en: Yes, six works for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成话题前的小标签：先说“关于时间”，再补充安排；整块记住 inkwantu għall-ħin。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A picture or image, often displayed in a frame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供观看或陈列的图画或图像，常装在画框中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stampa jew xbieha, ħafna drabi mqiegħda f'qafas biex tintwera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 图画或图像，尤指供陈列、常带有画框的画。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stampa jew xbieha li turi persuna, post jew ħaġa, u li tista' titqiegħed f'qafas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inkwatru is a picture that shows a person, place, or thing and is often displayed in a frame.

formal.mt: Fuq il-ħajt prinċipali tas-sala hemm inkwatru li juri l-port.
formal.en: On the hall's main wall there is a picture showing the harbour.
formal.zh: 大厅的主墙上有一幅描绘港口的画。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se ndendlu dan l-inkwatru? Pawlu: Fuq is-sufan; hemm jidher sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we hang this picture? Pawlu: Above the sofa; it will look nice there.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这幅画我们挂在哪里？Pawlu：沙发上方吧，挂在那里会很好看。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这幅画我们挂在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we hang this picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 沙发上方吧，挂在那里会很好看。
messages.en: Above the sofa; it will look nice there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一幅画挂到沙发上方，边做动作边说 inkwatru；用“墙上有画”的场景记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling uneasy or worried because something may be wrong or may turn out badly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因觉得某事可能有问题或可能出现不良结果而感到不安、担心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss tħassib jew nuqqas ta' serħan il-moħħ għax jaħseb li hemm xi problema jew li xi ħaġa tista' tmur ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 心神不宁的；感到不踏实或难以安心的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jħossux għalkollox kalm jew komdu minħabba dubju jew tħassib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is inkwetat, they feel unsettled or unable to relax because something does not seem quite right.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 担心的；因某个问题或可能发生的坏事而忧虑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss tħassib dwar problema jew dwar xi ħaġa ħażina li jista' jkun li tiġri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are inkwetat about something, you keep thinking about a problem or an unwelcome possibility.

formal.mt: L-istudent qal li kien inkwetat dwar ir-riżultat tal-eżami u talab li jitkellem mal-għalliem.
formal.en: The student said that he was worried about the exam result and asked to speak to the teacher.
formal.zh: 这名学生说他担心考试结果，并请求与老师谈谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher inkwetat, Mark? Mark: Għada għandi eżami u għadni ma ħejjejtx biżżejjed. Maja: Ejja nirrevedu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look worried, Mark? Mark: I've got an exam tomorrow, and I haven't prepared enough yet. Maja: Let's revise together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark，你怎么看起来很担心？Mark：我明天有考试，还没准备充分。Maja：我们一起复习吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Mark，你怎么看起来很担心？
messages.en: Why do you look worried, Mark?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada għandi eżami u għadni ma ħejjejtx biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Għada għandi eżami u għadni ma ħejjejtx biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 我明天有考试，还没准备充分。
messages.en: I've got an exam tomorrow, and I haven't prepared enough yet.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我们一起复习吧。
messages.en: Let's revise together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把考前坐立不安的表情与 inkwetat 连起来：心里不踏实对应 uneasy，想着坏结果对应 worried。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who occupies a home and is responsible for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 居住在某处住宅并对该住家承担责任的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħix f'dar u tkun responsabbli għaliha bħala l-post fejn toqgħod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 住户；居住于一处住宅并负责该住家事务的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li toqgħod f'dar u tieħu ħsieb il-ħtiġijiet u l-affarijiet marbuta ma' dik id-dar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A householder is a person who occupies a home and has responsibility for that household.

formal.mt: L-inkwilin tad-dar għandu jinforma lill-kunsill jekk il-kontenitur tal-iskart ikun bil-ħsara.
formal.en: The householder should inform the council if the waste container is damaged.
formal.zh: 如果垃圾容器损坏，该住宅的住户应通知地方议会。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Int l-inkwilin il-ġdid ta' din id-dar? Mark: Iva, għadni kif mort noqgħod hawn. Rita: Merħba! Jien noqgħod ħdejk.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you the new householder here? Mark: Yes, I've just moved in. Rita: Welcome! I live next door.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你是这所房子的新住户吗？Mark：是的，我刚搬来。Rita：欢迎！我就住在隔壁。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Int l-inkwilin il-ġdid ta' din id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Int l-inkwilin il-ġdid ta' din id-dar?
messages.zh: 你是这所房子的新住户吗？
messages.en: Are you the new householder here?

messages.speaker: Mark (新住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kif mort noqgħod hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kif mort noqgħod hawn.
messages.zh: 是的，我刚搬来。
messages.en: Yes, I've just moved in.

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 欢迎！我就住在隔壁。
messages.en: Welcome! I live next door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新住户拿着家门钥匙迎接邻居，把 inkwilin 与“住在这里并照料住家的人”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heavy metal block on which metal is hammered into shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 锻打金属时用作承托面的厚重金属块，即铁砧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Blokka tqila tal-metall li fuqha jinħadem il-metall billi jintlaqat bil-martell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铁砧；锻打金属时承托工件的厚重金属块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Blokka tqila tal-metall b'wiċċ sod li fuqha jitqiegħed il-metall biex jinħadem bil-martell.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anvil is a heavy metal block that supports metal while someone hammers it into shape.

collocations.en: to work iron on the anvil

formal.mt: Il-ħaddied poġġa l-biċċa tal-ħadid fuq l-inkwina u beda jagħtiha l-forma bil-martell.
formal.en: The blacksmith placed the piece of iron on the anvil and began shaping it with a hammer.
formal.zh: 铁匠把铁料放在铁砧上，开始用锤子将它锻打成形。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi din il-biċċa tal-ħadid? Mark: Fuq l-inkwina, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put this piece of iron? Mark: On the anvil, please.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块铁放在哪里？Mark：请放在铁砧上。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 这块铁放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this piece of iron?

messages.speaker: Mark (铁匠)
messages.zh: 请放在铁砧上。
messages.en: On the anvil, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkwina 和铁匠锤打铁料的画面连起来：锤子下面承受敲击的厚重金属块，就是铁砧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal investigation or severe questioning, especially concerning religious beliefs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式调查或严厉盘问，尤指围绕宗教信仰进行的审查、审讯或裁判。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Investigazzjoni formali jew interrogazzjoni ħarxa, speċjalment dwar twemmin reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严厉的调查或审讯；在宗教语境中指对信仰问题进行的审查或宗教裁判。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stħarriġ jew interrogazzjoni dettaljata u ħarxa li tista' tkun marbuta ma' kwistjonijiet ta' twemmin reliġjuż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inquisition is a formal investigation or a severe series of questions, especially about religious beliefs.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, l-awtriċi teżamina kif l-inkwiżizzjoni reliġjuża taffettwa l-libertà tal-ħsieb.
formal.en: In her analysis of the text, the author examines how religious inquisition affects freedom of thought.
formal.zh: 作者在文本分析中探讨宗教裁判如何影响思想自由。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn kont, ma' min kont, u għaliex wasalt tard? Mark: Din inkwiżizzjoni? Ħallini nispjega!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where were you, who were you with, and why are you late? Mark: Is this an inquisition? Let me explain!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你去哪儿了，跟谁在一起，为什么迟到了？Mark：这是在审问我吗？让我解释一下！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn kont, ma' min kont, u għaliex wasalt tard?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn kont, ma' min kont, u għaliex wasalt tard?
messages.zh: 你去哪儿了，跟谁在一起，为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Where were you, who were you with, and why are you late?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是在审问我吗？让我解释一下！
messages.en: Is this an inquisition? Let me explain!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkwiżizzjoni 联想到一连串严厉追问：日常对话可比喻审问，宗教语境则联想到宗教裁判。

gloss_zh: 释义查询字符串；所列标签不足以确定马耳他语词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lookup string containing 'inlaqtu' and the English word 'meaning', without a securely specified Maltese lexical sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由 inlaqtu 和英语 meaning 组成的释义查询字符串；现有标签不足以把整个字符串确认为具有单一词义的马耳他语词条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sekwenza ta' tfittxija li fiha 'inlaqtu' u l-kelma Ingliża 'meaning', mingħajr tifsira lessikali Maltija stabbilita b'mod ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用英语；以英语表达。该标签本身没有说明查询字符串中的马耳他语形式是什么意思。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-frażi 'in english' tindika li xi ħaġa tingħad jew tinkiteb bl-Ingliż, iżda ma tispjegax it-tifsira tal-forma Maltija fit-tfittxija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The phrase 'in english' requests expression in English but does not establish the meaning of the Maltese item.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示肯定或同意的答复，即“是”或“同意”；现有信息没有确立它与查询字符串之间的词义对应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bħala nom, 'yes' jirreferi għal tweġiba affermattiva jew għal espressjoni ta' qbil, iżda r-rabta tiegħu mas-sekwenza tat-tfittxija mhix stabbilita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: As a noun, a yes is an affirmative answer or an expression of agreement, although its connection to this lookup string is unspecified.

formal.mt: Is-sekwenza 'inlaqtu meaning' għandha tiġi ttrattata bħala tfittxija; it-tikketti 'in english' u 'yes' ma jistabbilixxux waħedhom it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The string 'inlaqtu meaning' should be treated as a search; the labels 'in english' and 'yes' do not by themselves establish its meaning.
formal.zh: 应将“inlaqtu meaning”视为查询字符串；仅凭“in english”和“yes”这两个标签，无法确定它的词义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fittixt 'inlaqtu meaning', imma ma fhimtx ir-riżultat. Mark: It-tikketti mhumiex ċari; minn dawn biss ma nistgħux nikkonfermaw it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: I searched for 'inlaqtu meaning', but I did not understand the result. Mark: The labels are unclear; we cannot confirm the meaning from these alone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我查了“inlaqtu meaning”，但没看懂结果。Mark：标签不清楚，单凭这些还不能确认词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fittixt 'inlaqtu meaning', imma ma fhimtx ir-riżultat.
messages.mt_standard: Fittixt 'inlaqtu meaning', imma ma fhimtx ir-riżultat.
messages.zh: 我查了“inlaqtu meaning”，但没看懂结果。
messages.en: I searched for 'inlaqtu meaning', but I did not understand the result.

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tikketti mhumiex ċari; minn dawn biss ma nistgħux nikkonfermaw it-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: It-tikketti mhumiex ċari; minn dawn biss ma nistgħux nikkonfermaw it-tifsira.
messages.zh: 标签不清楚，单凭这些还不能确认词义。
messages.en: The labels are unclear; we cannot confirm the meaning from these alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 meaning 先想到“查询词义”；把查询字符串与真正的词条分开记，不能把 yes 标签直接背成 inlaqtu 的意思。

gloss_zh: 动词条目；所列 English 标签未给出具体词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb form listed as 'Innaddaf', whose specific meaning is not established by the supplied label 'English'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以 Innaddaf 形式列出的动词条目；English 只是现有释义标签，不能据此确定该动词所表示的具体动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma verbali mniżżla bħala 'Innaddaf', li t-tifsira speċifika tagħha mhix stabbilita mit-tikketta 'English'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: English 通常指英语或与英语相关的事物；此处该标签没有提供所列动词的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma 'English' normalment tirreferi għal-lingwa Ingliża jew għal xi ħaġa marbuta magħha, iżda hawn ma tagħtix tifsira speċifika tal-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The label 'English' refers to a language or an associated description, but it does not explain the meaning of this verb.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, il-forma 'Innaddaf' hija mmarkata bħala verb, iżda t-tikketta 'English' ma tipprovdix definizzjoni tal-azzjoni.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, the form 'Innaddaf' is marked as a verb, but the label 'English' does not provide a definition of the action.
formal.zh: 在词汇练习中，“Innaddaf”被标为动词，但“English”这一标签没有说明它表示什么动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħdejn 'Innaddaf' hemm miktub 'English'. Dik it-tifsira? Mark: Dik it-tikketta ma tispjegax il-verb; għandna bżonn definizzjoni ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: It says 'English' next to 'Innaddaf'. Is that the meaning? Mark: That label does not explain the verb; we need a clear definition.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“Innaddaf”旁边写着“English”，那就是它的意思吗？Mark：这个标签没有解释动词，我们需要明确的定义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “Innaddaf”旁边写着“English”，那就是它的意思吗？
messages.en: It says 'English' next to 'Innaddaf'. Is that the meaning?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik it-tikketta ma tispjegax il-verb; għandna bżonn definizzjoni ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Dik it-tikketta ma tispjegax il-verb; għandna bżonn definizzjoni ċara.
messages.zh: 这个标签没有解释动词，我们需要明确的定义。
messages.en: That label does not explain the verb; we need a clear definition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“语言标签不等于动作释义”：English 不能帮助确定这个动词的具体意思，先保留词形与动词词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To state that something is not true or that one did not do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某件事不是真的，或表示自己没有做过某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħid li xi ħaġa mhijiex vera jew li ma għamiltx xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 否认某种说法、指控或行为的真实性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħid li stqarrija jew akkuża mhijiex vera, jew li ma wettaqtx għemil partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone denies something, they state that it is untrue or that they did not do it.

formal.mt: Fl-istqarrija tiegħu, id-direttur innega li kien jaf bil-problema qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: In his statement, the director denied knowing about the problem before the meeting.
formal.zh: 主任在声明中否认自己在会议前就知道这个问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark qal li int ħadt il-ktieb? Lara: Iva, imma jien innegajt li ħadtu. Għadu fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark say you took the book? Lara: Yes, but I denied taking it. It's still on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark说是你拿了那本书吗？Lara：对，但我否认拿过。书还在架子上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark qal li int ħadt il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Mark qal li int ħadt il-ktieb?
messages.zh: Mark说是你拿了那本书吗？
messages.en: Did Mark say you took the book?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma jien innegajt li ħadtu. Għadu fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma jien innegajt li ħadtu. Għadu fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 对，但我否认拿过。书还在架子上。
messages.en: Yes, but I denied taking it. It's still on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inneġa 的字形记忆改为准确拼写 inneगा 并不合适；直接记住 innega，联想有人面对指控摇头说“不是我”，将整词与“否认”相连。

gloss_zh: 谈判；达成交易；办理交易；经商

teaching_sense.en_definition: To discuss terms in order to reach an agreement, or to carry out business dealings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过讨论条件来争取达成协议，或进行交易和商业往来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddiskuti l-kundizzjonijiet biex tasal għal ftehim, jew twettaq tranżazzjonijiet u attivitajiet kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就价格、条件或其他事项进行谈判，以争取达成协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddiskuti prezzijiet, kundizzjonijiet jew kwistjonijiet oħra ma' ħaddieħor biex tipprova tasal għal ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people negotiate, they discuss an issue or its terms in an attempt to reach an agreement.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与另一方商定交易条件并达成交易。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tasal għal ftehim ma' parti oħra dwar il-kundizzjonijiet ta' bejgħ, xiri jew skambju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone makes a deal, they reach an agreement with another person about a business arrangement or exchange.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办理或完成一项交易或商业事务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Twettaq jew tlesti tranżazzjoni jew biċċa xogħol kummerċjali ma' parti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone transacts business, they carry out a particular commercial operation or exchange.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事买卖，或与他人进行商业往来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieħu sehem fil-bejgħ u x-xiri, jew ikollok relazzjonijiet kummerċjali ma' nies jew kumpaniji oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone does business, they engage in commercial activities or have commercial dealings with others.

collocations.en: negotiated the terms of the contract
did business with a foreign company
collocations.zh: 与一家外国公司进行了商业往来

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant innegozja l-kundizzjonijiet tal-kuntratt mal-fornitur u kiseb prezz aktar baxx.
formal.en: The representative negotiated the terms of the contract with the supplier and obtained a lower price.
formal.zh: 代表与供应商商谈了合同条款，并争取到了更低的价格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xtrajt ir-rota bil-prezz li talab il-bejjiegħ? Mark: Le, innegozjajt miegħu u qbilna fuq prezz aktar baxx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you buy the bicycle at the seller's asking price? Mark: No, I negotiated with him and we agreed on a lower price.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你按卖家的开价买了自行车吗？Mark：没有，我跟他谈了价，最后商定了一个更低的价格。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xtrajt ir-rota bil-prezz li talab il-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Xtrajt ir-rota bil-prezz li talab il-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: 你按卖家的开价买了自行车吗？
messages.en: Did you buy the bicycle at the seller's asking price?

messages.speaker: Mark (买家)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, innegozjajt miegħu u qbilna fuq prezz aktar baxx.
