messages.mt_standard: Le, innegozjajt miegħu u qbilna fuq prezz aktar baxx.
messages.zh: 没有，我跟他谈了价，最后商定了一个更低的价格。
messages.en: No, I negotiated with him and we agreed on a lower price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 innegozja 放进“谈价格、定条件、做交易”的连续画面中记忆；读到具体语境时，再区分是在谈判、达成交易，还是进行商业往来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using new ideas or methods to improve something or solve a problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运用新想法或新方法来改进事物或解决问题的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża ideat jew metodi ġodda biex itejjeb xi ħaġa jew isolvi problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在想法、设计或做法上具有新意和创造性的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri kreattività billi jintroduċi ideat, disinji jew metodi ġodda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something innovative introduces new ideas or methods that offer a different way of doing things.

formal.mt: L-iskola introduċiet metodu innovattiv biex tgħin lill-istudenti jitgħallmu l-vokabularju.
formal.en: The school introduced an innovative method to help students learn vocabulary.
formal.zh: 学校引入了一种创新方法，帮助学生学习词汇。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-logħob jgħinna nitgħallmu kliem ġdid. Mark: X'metodu innovattiv! Nistgħu nippruvawh flimkien?
colloquial.en: Maja: This game helps us learn new words. Mark: What an innovative method! Can we try it together?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个游戏帮助我们学习新词。马克：这个方法真有新意！我们可以一起试试吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-logħob jgħinna nitgħallmu kliem ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-logħob jgħinna nitgħallmu kliem ġdid.
messages.zh: 这个游戏帮助我们学习新词。
messages.en: This game helps us learn new words.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 这个方法真有新意！我们可以一起试试吗？
messages.en: What an innovative method! Can we try it together?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 innovattiv 和“用新办法解决旧问题”的画面联系起来，再连读 metodu innovattiv，记住它可以修饰方法。

gloss_zh: 无辜的；清白的；天真无邪的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not guilty of wrongdoing, or showing a lack of experience of harmful or dishonest behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有做错事或没有犯下所指控的行为；也可表示天真无邪、不谙世事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx wettaq il-ħażen jew l-għemil li jkun akkużat bih, jew li jkun nieqes mill-esperjenza tal-ħażen u l-qerq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无辜的，未犯下所指控的过错的；也可指天真无邪、不熟悉恶意和欺骗的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx ħati ta' għemil ħażin jew ta' dak li jkun akkużat bih; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi lil min ma għandux esperjenza tal-ħażen u l-qerq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is innocent has not committed the wrongdoing in question, or has little experience of harmful or dishonest behaviour.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ikkonferma li l-impjegat kien innoċenti u li ma kellu ebda sehem fil-ħsara.
formal.en: The report confirmed that the employee was innocent and had played no part in causing the damage.
formal.zh: 报告证实该员工是无辜的，与造成损坏一事毫无关联。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Int waqqajt il-vażun? Pawlu: Le, jien innoċenti! Il-qattus qabeż fuq il-mejda u waqqgħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you knock over the vase? Pawlu: No, I'm innocent! The cat jumped onto the table and knocked it over.
colloquial.zh: Nina：是你碰倒了花瓶吗？Pawlu：不是，我是无辜的！猫跳上桌子，把它碰倒了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 是你碰倒了花瓶吗？
messages.en: Did you knock over the vase?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jien innoċenti! Il-qattus qabeż fuq il-mejda u waqqgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jien innoċenti! Il-qattus qabeż fuq il-mejda u waqqgħu.
messages.zh: 不是，我是无辜的！猫跳上桌子，把它碰倒了。
messages.en: No, I'm innocent! The cat jumped onto the table and knocked it over.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住人物举起双手说“我是无辜的”这一画面，把 innoċenti 与人的清白状态相连；换成孩子纯真的眼神，也能帮助记住“天真无邪”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of not being guilty of wrongdoing, or the quality of being free from knowledge of evil or deceit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有做错事或没有犯罪的清白状态；也指不谙恶意和欺骗的纯真。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' min ma jkunx ħati ta' għemil ħażin, jew il-kwalità ta' min ma jkunx jaf bil-ħażen u l-qerq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清白、无辜的状态；也指天真无邪的品质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istat ta' persuna li ma tkunx wettqet l-għemil ħażin li tkun akkużata bih, jew il-kwalità li tkun nieqsa mill-għarfien tal-ħażen u l-qerq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Innocence is the state of being free from guilt, or the quality of having little knowledge of evil or deceit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无辜的，没有犯下有关过错的；也可表示天真无邪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil min ma jkunx ħati ta' għemil ħażin, jew lil min ikun nieqes mill-esperjenza tal-ħażen u l-qerq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described as innocent has not done the wrong in question, or has little knowledge of evil or deceit.

formal.mt: Id-dokumenti l-ġodda kkonfermaw l-innoċenza tal-impjegata u wrew li l-akkuża kienet ibbażata fuq żball.
formal.en: The new documents confirmed the employee's innocence and showed that the accusation was based on a mistake.
formal.zh: 新文件证实了这名女员工的清白，并表明指控源于一个错误。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif se tipprova l-innoċenza tiegħek? Mark: Għandi ritratt li juri li kont id-dar meta nkisret it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: How are you going to prove your innocence? Mark: I have a photo showing that I was at home when the window was broken.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你打算怎么证明自己的清白？Mark：我有一张照片，能证明窗户被打破时我在家。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算怎么证明自己的清白？
messages.en: How are you going to prove your innocence?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ritratt li juri li kont id-dar meta nkisret it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ritratt li juri li kont id-dar meta nkisret it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 我有一张照片，能证明窗户被打破时我在家。
messages.en: I have a photo showing that I was at home when the window was broken.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“证明清白”这个搭配记住 innoċenza：把“清白”想成需要证据证明的一种状态；再用“孩子的纯真”补充记忆它的另一种常见含义。

gloss_zh: 输入数据；输入内容（计算机）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Data entered into a computer or program for processing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 输入计算机或程序、供其处理的数据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-data li tiddaħħal f'kompjuter jew fi programm biex tiġi pproċessata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在计算机使用中，已经输入系统或程序的数据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-kompjuters, id-data li tkun iddaħħlet f'sistema jew fi programm biex tintuża jew tiġi pproċessata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In computing, input is the data that has been entered into a system for it to process.

formal.mt: Il-programm jiċċekkja l-input tal-utent qabel ma jipproċessa d-data.
formal.en: The program checks the user's input before processing the data.
formal.zh: 程序在处理数据之前，会检查用户输入的内容。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-programm qed jagħti żball? Pawlu: L-input irid ikun numru; int daħħalt kelma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the program giving an error? Pawlu: The input has to be a number; you entered a word.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：程序为什么报错？保罗：输入内容必须是数字；你输入了一个词。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 程序为什么报错？
messages.en: Why is the program giving an error?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-input irid ikun numru; int daħħalt kelma.
messages.mt_standard: L-input irid ikun numru; int daħħalt kelma.
messages.zh: 输入内容必须是数字；你输入了一个词。
messages.en: The input has to be a number; you entered a word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把数字输入电脑：屏幕上刚输入的那串数字就是 input。这里记“输入的数据”，并用 input validu 练习“有效输入”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn onto another side or turn upside down, including when a boat overturns in water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 翻到另一面或底朝上；也指船只在水中翻覆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idur fuq naħa oħra jew jispiċċa bil-qiegħ 'il fuq; jista' jingħad ukoll għal bastiment li jinqaleb fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻到另一面，或翻成底朝上的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Idur minn naħa għal oħra jew jispiċċa bil-qiegħ 'il fuq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When something turns over, it moves onto another side or ends up upside down.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指船只在水中失去平衡而倾覆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal dgħajsa jew bastiment li jitlef il-bilanċ u jinqaleb fl-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a boat capsizes, it overturns in the water after losing its balance.

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, il-kontenitur inqaleb fuq ġenbu u l-ilma nfirex fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: During the experiment, the container turned onto its side and the water spread across the table.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，容器侧翻了，水流到了桌面上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt li bastiment inqaleb ħdejn il-port. Toni: Iva, imma fortunatament salvaw lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: I heard that a ship capsized near the harbour. Toni: Yes, but fortunately they rescued everyone.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我听说有艘船在港口附近倾覆了。托尼：是的，不过幸好所有人都获救了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li bastiment inqaleb ħdejn il-port.
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li bastiment inqaleb ħdejn il-port.
messages.zh: 我听说有艘船在港口附近倾覆了。
messages.en: I heard that a ship capsized near the harbour.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma fortunatament salvaw lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma fortunatament salvaw lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 是的，不过幸好所有人都获救了。
messages.en: Yes, but fortunately they rescued everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个翻转画面记 inqaleb：容器翻到侧面是“翻转”，船在水中翻过去是“倾覆”。看到船只语境就联想到 capsize。

gloss_zh: 自行取用；使用；利用、剥削

teaching_sense.en_definition: To help oneself to something, use something for a purpose, or exploit someone or something for personal advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自行取用所需之物；为某种目的使用事物；也可指为自身利益而利用他人或某种条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu għalih dak li jkollu bżonn, juża xi ħaġa għal skop, jew jieħu vantaġġ minn xi ħadd jew minn xi ħaġa għall-interess tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己动手取用食物或其他所需之物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu jew jipprovdi għalih innifsu l-ikel jew xi ħaġa oħra li jkollu bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you serve yourself, you take the food or other things you need without someone serving you.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用某物来完成事情或达到某种目的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Juża xi ħaġa biex jagħmel xogħol jew jilħaq skop.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you use something, you employ it to do a task or achieve a particular purpose.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为谋取自身利益而利用他人或某种条件，常含不公平或损害他人的意味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu vantaġġ minn persuna jew minn xi ħaġa għall-benefiċċju tiegħu, spiss b'mod inġust jew bi ħsara għal ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone exploits a person or situation, they use it for their own advantage, often unfairly.

collocations.en: helped himself to food from the buffet
collocations.zh: 自己从自助餐台取了食物

formal.mt: L-investigazzjoni sabet li l-maniġer inqeda bil-fiduċja tal-ħaddiema biex jikseb vantaġġ personali.
formal.en: The investigation found that the manager exploited the workers' trust to gain a personal advantage.
formal.zh: 调查发现，经理利用了员工的信任来谋取个人利益。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ta l-ikel lil Mark? Lara: Ħadd; inqeda waħdu mill-buffet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who gave Mark his food? Lara: Nobody; he helped himself at the buffet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁给马克拿了吃的？拉拉：没人；他自己从自助餐台取的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给马克拿了吃的？
messages.en: Who gave Mark his food?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 没人；他自己从自助餐台取的。
messages.en: Nobody; he helped himself at the buffet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inqeda 放进三个场景记忆：自助餐时“自行取用”，操作电脑时“使用”，借他人信任牟利时“利用”。靠宾语和情境区分语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To find yourself in a particular place, condition, or situation; this form refers to the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话者发现自己身处某地，或正处于某种状态、境况，相当于“我身处、我处于”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-verb li biha l-kelliem jgħid li qiegħed f'post partikolari jew f'ċerta kundizzjoni jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发现自己身处某地或处于某种境况；此词形表示“我身处、我处于”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkun f'post jew f'sitwazzjoni partikolari; il-forma 'insab' tintuża meta l-kelliem jitkellem dwaru nnifsu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you find yourself somewhere or in a particular situation, you are there or are experiencing that situation.

collocations.en: I find myself in a difficult situation

collocations.zh: 我身体很好；我状态不错

formal.mt: Bħalissa insab barra minn Malta u għalhekk nitlob li l-laqgħa ssir online.
formal.en: I am currently outside Malta and therefore request that the meeting be held online.
formal.zh: 我目前身处马耳他境外，因此请求在线举行会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qiegħed? Mark: Insab ħdejn il-bieb tal-istazzjon. Maja: Tajjeb, ġejja ħdejk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you? Mark: I am by the station entrance. Maja: Good, I am coming over to you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在哪里？马克：我在车站入口旁边。玛雅：好，我这就过去找你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在哪里？
messages.en: Where are you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在车站入口旁边。
messages.en: I am by the station entrance.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我这就过去找你。
messages.en: Good, I am coming over to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 insab 放在自己的定位气泡里记忆：“我在这里、我处于困境”。这个词形以说话者“我”为中心，既能定位地点，也能描述状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A helping: a portion of food served to one person at one time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次盛给一个人食用的一份食物，即一客或一份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Porzjon ta' ikel li jingħata lil persuna waħda f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次盛取或端给一个人的一份食物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwantità ta' ikel servuta lil persuna bħala porzjon wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A helping is an amount of food that is served to one person on a single occasion.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla, kull mistieden ingħata insalva ross mal-ħaxix.
formal.en: During the meal, each guest was served a helping of rice with vegetables.
formal.zh: 用餐时，每位宾客都获供一份配有蔬菜的米饭。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid insalva oħra? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma żgħira. Rita: Tajjeb, nagħtik ftit oħra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Would you like another helping? Pawlu: Yes, please, but a small one. Rita: All right, I will give you a little more.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你要再来一份吗？保罗：好的，谢谢，不过要小份的。丽塔：好，我再给你盛一点。

messages.speaker: Rita (主人)
messages.zh: 你要再来一份吗？
messages.en: Would you like another helping?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (客人)
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，不过要小份的。
messages.en: Yes, please, but a small one.

messages.speaker: Rita (主人)
messages.zh: 好，我再给你盛一点。
messages.en: All right, I will give you a little more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 insalva 与餐桌上“再盛一份”的画面一起记：一盘中的一份食物就是一个 helping，用 insalva oħra 练习表达“再来一份”。

gloss_zh: 词义待核实（所给释义为 maltes）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the gloss 'maltes'; the packet does not specify enough information to establish its precise meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词包将此词列为名词，并给出 maltes 这一释义，但未提供足以确定其具体所指的信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li ngħata bit-tifsira 'maltes', iżda l-informazzjoni mogħtija mhijiex biżżejjed biex jiġi stabbilit is-sens preċiż tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具体含义未明确；所给释义 maltes 本身不足以确定准确的中文对应词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija hija 'maltes', iżda mingħajr kuntest jew spjegazzjoni oħra ma jistax jiġi ddeterminat x'jindika eżattament dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun is glossed as 'maltes', but the supplied information does not establish what it specifically denotes.

formal.mt: Il-lista tagħti 'insatar' bħala nom bit-tifsira 'maltes', iżda hemm bżonn ta' aktar kuntest biex jiġi stabbilit is-sens tiegħu.
formal.en: The list gives 'insatar' as a noun with the gloss 'maltes', but more context is needed to establish its meaning.
formal.zh: 该词表将 insatar 列为名词，释义为 maltes，但仍需更多语境才能确定其含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'insatar' hawn? Toni: Il-lista tgħid 'maltes', imma ma tagħtix spjegazzjoni. Lara: Mela għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'insatar' mean here? Toni: The list says 'maltes', but gives no explanation. Lara: Then we need more context.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这里的 insatar 是什么意思？托尼：词表写的是 maltes，但没有解释。劳拉：那我们需要更多语境。
