messages.en: Then we need more context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 insatar 制作“名词，词义待核实”的双面卡片，背面原样保留 maltes；先记拼写与资料边界，避免用相似外形猜出未经证实的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The property of a system whose response changes little as frequency changes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 系统的响应对频率变化不敏感、即频率改变时响应变化较小的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proprjetà ta' sistema li r-rispons tagħha jinbidel ftit meta tinbidel il-frekwenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频率响应不敏感性，指系统的响应随频率改变而仅发生较小变化的特性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karatteristika li biha r-rispons ta' sistema ma jkunx sensittiv ħafna għal bidliet fil-frekwenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Frequency response insensitivity is the property of a system whose response varies little when the frequency changes.

collocations.zh: 频率响应不敏感性的测量
频率响应不敏感性的评估

collocations.mt: grad għoli ta' insensittività tar-rispons tal-frekwenza
collocations.en: a high degree of frequency response insensitivity
collocations.zh: 较高程度的频率响应不敏感性

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jevalwa l-insensittività tar-rispons tal-frekwenza billi jqabbel ir-rispons tas-sistema fi frekwenzi differenti.
formal.en: The report assesses frequency response insensitivity by comparing the system's response at different frequencies.
formal.zh: 该报告通过比较系统在不同频率下的响应，评估其频率响应不敏感性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-insensittività tar-rispons tal-frekwenza? Mark: Tfisser li r-rispons jinbidel ftit meta nbiddlu l-frekwenza. Maja: Mela nqabblu r-rispons fi frekwenzi differenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is frequency response insensitivity? Mark: It means that the response changes little when we change the frequency. Maja: Then we compare the response at different frequencies.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是频率响应不敏感性？马克：意思是我们改变频率时，响应变化很小。玛雅：那我们就比较不同频率下的响应。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是频率响应不敏感性？
messages.en: What is frequency response insensitivity?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li r-rispons jinbidel ftit meta nbiddlu l-frekwenza.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li r-rispons jinbidel ftit meta nbiddlu l-frekwenza.
messages.zh: 意思是我们改变频率时，响应变化很小。
messages.en: It means that the response changes little when we change the frequency.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nqabblu r-rispons fi frekwenzi differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nqabblu r-rispons fi frekwenzi differenti.
messages.zh: 那我们就比较不同频率下的响应。
messages.en: Then we compare the response at different frequencies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旋转频率旋钮时，响应曲线几乎不动：频率在变，响应少变。用这个画面记住整条术语，并按“不敏感性—响应—频率”分段复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Placed or added within something else, such as a text or document.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已被放入或加入其他事物之中的，如插入文本或文件中的内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun tqiegħed jew żdied ġewwa xi ħaġa oħra, bħal test jew dokument.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被插入、放入或添加到其他事物之中的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun iddaħħal f'xi ħaġa oħra jew żdied bħala parti minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is inserted has been put into something else or added within it.

collocations.en: a comment inserted between two paragraphs

formal.mt: It-test inserit fl-aħħar tar-rapport jagħti aktar dettalji dwar il-proġett.
formal.en: The text inserted at the end of the report provides more details about the project.
formal.zh: 插入报告末尾的文字提供了有关该项目的更多细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-kumment li żidt? Mark: Ara t-tieni paġna. Il-kumment inserit hemm jispjega kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the comment you added? Mark: Look at the second page. The comment inserted there explains everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你加的评注在哪里？马克：看第二页。插在那里的评注把一切都解释清楚了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你加的评注在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the comment you added?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara t-tieni paġna. Il-kumment inserit hemm jispjega kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Ara t-tieni paġna. Il-kumment inserit hemm jispjega kollox.
messages.zh: 看第二页。插在那里的评注把一切都解释清楚了。
messages.en: Look at the second page. The comment inserted there explains everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inserit 配上一张两段文字之间已插入评注的画面，记住它描述的是“已经插入”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To serve you by providing help, goods, or a service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为你提供帮助、商品或服务，常用于接待顾客。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nagħtik għajnuna jew nipprovdilek prodott jew servizz skont dak li jkollok bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某人提供服务；接待或招待某人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti lil xi ħadd l-għajnuna, il-prodott jew is-servizz li jkollu bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you serve someone, you provide them with help, goods, or a service.

collocations.zh: 我能为你提供什么服务？

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, indika liema servizz teħtieġ sabiex inkun nista' inservik aħjar.
formal.en: Please indicate which service you require so that I can serve you better.
formal.zh: 请说明你需要哪项服务，以便我更好地为你服务。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Bonġu! Kif nista' inservik? Mark: Bonġu! Nixtieq żewġ ħobżiet, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Rita: Good morning! How can I help you? Mark: Good morning! I'd like two loaves of bread, please.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：早上好！有什么可以帮你的吗？马克：早上好！请给我两条面包。

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 早上好！有什么可以帮你的吗？
messages.en: Good morning! How can I help you?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Bonġu! Nixtieq żewġ ħobżiet, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Bonġu! Nixtieq żewġ ħobżiet, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 早上好！请给我两条面包。
messages.en: Good morning! I'd like two loaves of bread, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inservik 放进店员迎客的整句 Kif nista' inservik? 中记忆，联想“我能怎样为你服务”。

gloss_zh: 徽章；标示身份或职级的徽记

teaching_sense.en_definition: A badge or emblem showing membership, official status, or rank.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示所属团体、正式身份或职级的徽章或标志。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sinjal jew emblema li turi s-sħubija f'għaqda, il-kariga jew il-grad ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表示组织归属、身份、职务或等级的徽章或徽记。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Emblema jew sinjal distintiv li jintlibes jew jintwera biex jindika għaqda, kariga jew grad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An insignia is a badge or symbol that identifies an organization, official position, or rank.

collocations.en: wear an insignia on the uniform

formal.mt: L-insinja fuq l-uniformi tindika l-grad tal-uffiċjal.
formal.en: The insignia on the uniform indicates the officer's rank.
formal.zh: 制服上的徽记标示了这位军官的军衔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tirrappreżenta dik l-insinja fuq il-ġakketta tiegħek? Pawlu: Hija l-insinja tal-għaqda tagħna. Nilbsuha waqt l-attivitajiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does that insignia on your jacket represent? Pawlu: It's our association's insignia. We wear it during activities.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你夹克上的那枚徽章代表什么？保罗：那是我们协会的徽章。我们参加活动时会佩戴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tirrappreżenta dik l-insinja fuq il-ġakketta tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: X'tirrappreżenta dik l-insinja fuq il-ġakketta tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你夹克上的那枚徽章代表什么？
messages.en: What does that insignia on your jacket represent?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (协会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-insinja tal-għaqda tagħna. Nilbsuha waqt l-attivitajiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-insinja tal-għaqda tagħna. Nilbsuha waqt l-attivitajiet.
messages.zh: 那是我们协会的徽章。我们参加活动时会佩戴。
messages.en: It's our association's insignia. We wear it during activities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 insinja 就想象制服胸前的一枚徽章：它让人看出所属团体或职级，把“徽记”和“身份”一起记。

gloss_zh: 淡而无味的；平淡乏味的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having little flavour, or lacking interest and liveliness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物味道很淡的；也可形容内容缺乏趣味或生气的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit togħma, jew li ma jqanqalx interess għax huwa nieqes mill-ħajja u mill-varjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 味道寡淡的；引申为缺乏趣味、生气或吸引力的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkollux togħma qawwija jew pjaċevoli, jew li jkun nieqes mill-interess u mill-ħajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something insipid has little flavour or is dull and fails to hold your interest.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ikel bħala insipidu u jirrakkomanda li jiżdiedu aktar ħwawar.
formal.en: The report describes the food as insipid and recommends adding more herbs and spices.
formal.zh: 报告指出食物味道寡淡，并建议增加香草和香料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif sibtu r-ross? Rita: Ftit insipidu. Nista' nżidlu ftit melħ? Mark: Iva, żidlu ftit u erġa' duqu.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did you find the rice? Rita: A little bland. Can I add a little salt to it? Mark: Yes, add a little and taste it again.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得这米饭怎么样？丽塔：有点淡。我可以加一点盐吗？马克：可以，加一点再尝尝。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得这米饭怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find the rice?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit insipidu. Nista' nżidlu ftit melħ?
messages.mt_standard: Ftit insipidu. Nista' nżidlu ftit melħ?
messages.zh: 有点淡。我可以加一点盐吗？
messages.en: A little bland. Can I add a little salt to it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żidlu ftit u erġa' duqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żidlu ftit u erġa' duqu.
messages.zh: 可以，加一点再尝尝。
messages.en: Yes, add a little and taste it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“嘴里没滋味，听着也没趣”记住 insipidu：食物可以寡淡，讲话也可以平淡乏味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To firmly maintain a demand or opinion, especially when others disagree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚定地提出或维持某项要求或意见，尤其是在别人不同意时仍不退让。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkompli titlob xi ħaġa jew issostni opinjoni b'mod sod, anki meta ħaddieħor ma jaqbilx miegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚持要求某事，或坚决主张某个意见。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titlob xi ħaġa jew tgħid li xi ħaġa għandha ssir b'mod sod, mingħajr ma ċċedi faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you insist on something, you say firmly that it must happen or that your opinion is correct.

collocations.zh: 坚持要求一个明确的答复

formal.mt: Il-kumitat insista li r-rapport jiġi ppreżentat qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The committee insisted that the report be submitted before the meeting.
formal.zh: 委员会坚持要求在会议前提交报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex insista Mark li jħallas hu? Paul: Ried jirringrazzjana tal-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark insist on paying? Paul: He wanted to thank us for our help.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么坚持要自己付钱？保罗：他想感谢我们的帮助。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex insista Mark li jħallas hu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex insista Mark li jħallas hu?
messages.zh: 马克为什么坚持要自己付钱？
messages.en: Why did Mark insist on paying?

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想感谢我们的帮助。
messages.en: He wanted to thank us for our help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友结账时反复说“我来付”，把 insista 与坚定坚持某项要求的动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Firm persistence in demanding something or maintaining an opinion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续而坚定地提出要求或维持意见的行为或态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-atteġġjament li tibqa' titlob xi ħaġa jew issostni opinjoni b'mod sod mingħajr ma ċċedi faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某项要求或主张的坚定坚持，常表现为反复提出而不轻易退让。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna tibqa' titlob xi ħaġa jew issostni li għandha ssir, anki jekk tiltaqa' ma' oppożizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's insistence is their firm determination that something should happen or that others should accept their view.

formal.mt: Minħabba l-insistenza tar-residenti, il-kunsill iddeċieda li jerġa' jeżamina l-proposta.
formal.en: Because of the residents' insistence, the council decided to reconsider the proposal.
formal.zh: 由于居民的坚持要求，议会决定重新审议该提案。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex din l-insistenza biex nitilqu issa? David: Għax jekk nistennew aktar, nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you insisting so much that we leave now? David: Because if we wait any longer, we'll miss the bus.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么这么坚持要现在出发？戴维：因为再等下去，我们就赶不上公交车了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din l-insistenza biex nitilqu issa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din l-insistenza biex nitilqu issa?
messages.zh: 你为什么这么坚持要现在出发？
messages.en: Why are you insisting so much that we leave now?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jekk nistennew aktar, nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jekk nistennew aktar, nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 因为再等下去，我们就赶不上公交车了。
messages.en: Because if we wait any longer, we'll miss the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 insistenza 记成可以被讨论的“那份坚持”：朋友反复催出发，你问的就是他的坚持要求。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unhappy with something because it does not meet your needs or expectations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某事没有达到自己的需要或期望而感到不满意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma tkunx kuntent b'xi ħaġa għax ma tkunx laħqet il-bżonnijiet jew l-aspettattivi tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某种情况、结果或服务感到不满意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tħoss li sitwazzjoni, riżultat jew servizz mhuwiex tajjeb biżżejjed jew ma jagħtikx dak li kont tistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are dissatisfied with something, you feel unhappy because it is not as good as you expected.

formal.mt: Il-klijent baqa' insodisfatt bis-servizz u talab spjegazzjoni bil-miktub.
formal.en: The customer remained dissatisfied with the service and requested a written explanation.
formal.zh: 顾客仍然对服务不满意，并要求提供书面解释。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int insodisfatt bl-ikel? Mark: Iva, wasal kiesaħ u kellna nistennew ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you dissatisfied with the food? Mark: Yes, it arrived cold, and we had to wait a long time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你对饭菜不满意吗？马克：是的，送来时已经凉了，而且我们等了很久。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你对饭菜不满意吗？
messages.en: Are you dissatisfied with the food?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wasal kiesaħ u kellna nistennew ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wasal kiesaħ u kellna nistennew ħafna.
messages.zh: 是的，送来时已经凉了，而且我们等了很久。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived cold, and we had to wait a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象期待热饭却收到冷饭的表情，把 insodisfatt 记为“现实没有达到期待，所以不满意”。

gloss_zh: 难以忍受的；令人无法忍耐的

teaching_sense.en_definition: So unpleasant, painful, or difficult that it cannot be tolerated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人极度不适、痛苦或为难，以至于难以忍受的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun tant spjaċevoli, ta' wġigħ jew diffiċli li ma tkunx tista' tissaportih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 程度严重到使人无法忍受或难以承受的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma tiflaħx tissaportih minħabba l-qawwa tal-uġigħ, l-iskumdità jew id-diffikultà li jġib miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is unbearable, it is so unpleasant or painful that you feel unable to tolerate it.

formal.mt: Minħabba s-sħana insopportabbli fis-sala, il-laqgħa ġiet posposta.
formal.en: Because of the unbearable heat in the hall, the meeting was postponed.
formal.zh: 由于大厅里热得令人难以忍受，会议被推迟了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-istorbju huwa insopportabbli! Adam: Ejja nagħlqu t-tieqa u naraw jekk jonqosx.
colloquial.en: Nina: This noise is unbearable! Adam: Let's close the window and see if it gets quieter.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这噪声真让人受不了！亚当：我们把窗户关上，看看会不会安静一点。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 这噪声真让人受不了！
messages.en: This noise is unbearable!

messages.speaker: Adam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nagħlqu t-tieqa u naraw jekk jonqosx.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nagħlqu t-tieqa u naraw jekk jonqosx.
messages.zh: 我们把窗户关上，看看会不会安静一点。
messages.en: Let's close the window and see if it gets quieter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象噪声大到必须捂耳关窗，把 insopportabbli 与“已经超过忍耐极限”的感觉联系起来。

gloss_zh: 有灵感的女性；受启发者（女性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman referred to as inspired because her ideas or actions show imagination or respond to a source of inspiration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指因获得启发或表现出想象力而被称为有灵感者的女性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tissejjaħ hekk għax l-ideat jew l-għemejjel tagħha juru immaġinazzjoni jew huma mqanqla minn xi ħaġa li tispiraha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有灵感者；受到启发的女性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara li għandha ideat imqanqla mill-immaġinazzjoni, minn emozzjoni jew minn esperjenza li tispiraha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A woman described as inspired develops ideas through imagination or through something that strongly stimulates her thoughts.

collocations.en: the inspired woman in the group
collocations.zh: 小组中那位有灵感的女性
那位有灵感的女性提出的方案

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-proġett, Marija ssemmiet bħala 'l-inspirata tal-grupp' għax ipproponiet soluzzjoni kreattiva għall-problema.
formal.en: In the project report, Marija was referred to as 'the inspired woman in the group' because she proposed a creative solution to the problem.
formal.zh: 项目报告将玛丽娅称为“小组中那位有灵感的女性”，因为她为问题提出了一个富有创意的解决方案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex issejħu lil Marija 'l-inspirata'? Pawlu: Għax dejjem toħroġ b'ideat kreattivi meta aħna ma nkunux nafu x'se nagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you call Marija 'the inspired one'? Pawlu: Because she always comes up with creative ideas when we don't know what to do.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们为什么叫玛丽娅“灵感达人”？保罗：因为我们不知道怎么办时，她总能想出有创意的点子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么叫玛丽娅“灵感达人”？
messages.en: Why do you call Marija 'the inspired one'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem toħroġ b'ideat kreattivi meta aħna ma nkunux nafu x'se nagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem toħroġ b'ideat kreattivi meta aħna ma nkunux nafu x'se nagħmlu.
messages.zh: 因为我们不知道怎么办时，她总能想出有创意的点子。
messages.en: Because she always comes up with creative ideas when we don't know what to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inspirata 放进“大家没主意，她突然想到办法”的画面里，按本条名词用法记作女性的“灵感达人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Put into position or set up so that equipment or software can be used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示设备或软件已经安置、设置妥当，可以投入使用的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imqiegħed f'postu jew imtella' u ssettjat sabiex tagħmir jew programm ikun jista' jintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已安装；已将设备或软件安置、设置好。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tqiegħed f'postu jew ġie ssettjat biex ikun jista' jintuża, bħal apparat jew programm tal-kompjuter.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If equipment or software is installed, it has been put in place or set up for use.

formal.mt: Il-programm il-ġdid ġie installat fuq il-kompjuters kollha tal-uffiċċju u issa jista' jintuża mill-impjegati.
formal.en: The new program has been installed on all the office computers and can now be used by the employees.
formal.zh: 新程序已安装在办公室的所有电脑上，员工现在可以使用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-programm diġà installat fuq il-kompjuter tiegħek? Mark: Iva, installat u qed jaħdem tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the program already installed on your computer? Mark: Yes, it's installed and working well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的电脑已经装好这个程序了吗？马克：对，装好了，而且运行正常。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-programm diġà installat fuq il-kompjuter tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Il-programm diġà installat fuq il-kompjuter tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的电脑已经装好这个程序了吗？
messages.en: Is the program already installed on your computer?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, installat u qed jaħdem tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, installat u qed jaħdem tajjeb.
messages.zh: 对，装好了，而且运行正常。
messages.en: Yes, it's installed and working well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电脑安装进度走到百分之百，屏幕显示完成：installat 就对应“已经装好”的结果状态。

gloss_zh: 安装；安装行为；分期付款中的一期款项

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or act of putting equipment or software in place for use; also, a single payment in a series of instalments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将设备或软件安置、设置到可以使用的过程或行为；也可指分期付款中的一期款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-att li tagħmir jitqiegħed f'postu jew programm jiġi ssettjat biex jintuża; tista' tfisser ukoll pagament wieħed minn sensiela ta' pagamenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安装；使设备或软件就位并具备使用条件的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih apparat jitqiegħed f'postu jew programm jitħejja fuq kompjuter sabiex ikun jista' jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The installation of equipment or software is the process of putting it in place and preparing it for use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安装这一行为；把设备或软件实际安置、设置好的操作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iqiegħed tagħmir f'postu jew jissettja programm sabiex ikun jista' jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The act of installing something involves placing or setting it up so that it can be used.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分期付款中的一期款项，即分多次支付的总金额中的一笔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pagament wieħed minn sensiela ta' pagamenti li bihom titħallas somma totali maqsuma fuq perjodu ta' żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An instalment is one of several payments made at different times until a total amount has been paid.

formal.mt: L-installazzjoni tat-tagħmir għandha titlesta sa nhar il-Ġimgħa, u l-ewwel installazzjoni tal-ħlas għandha titħallas skont il-kuntratt.
formal.en: The installation of the equipment must be completed by Friday, and the first payment instalment must be paid in accordance with the contract.
formal.zh: 设备安装须于星期五前完成，第一期款项须按照合同支付。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-installazzjoni tal-programm tieħu ħafna ħin? Toni: Le, madwar għaxar minuti. Wara tkun tista' tużah.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does installing the program take a long time? Toni: No, about ten minutes. You'll be able to use it afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：安装这个程序要很久吗？托尼：不用，大约十分钟。之后你就能用了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 安装这个程序要很久吗？
messages.en: Does installing the program take a long time?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, madwar għaxar minuti. Wara tkun tista' tużah.
messages.mt_standard: Le, madwar għaxar minuti. Wara tkun tista' tużah.
messages.zh: 不用，大约十分钟。之后你就能用了。
messages.en: No, about ten minutes. You'll be able to use it afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分别记忆：技术员装设备对应“安装”，账单分几次付对应“一期款项”；阅读时看周围是设备词还是付款词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A remark or action that expresses disrespect and offends or humiliates someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出不尊重、使他人受到冒犯或感到羞辱的言语或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kumment jew għemil li juri nuqqas ta' rispett u joffendi jew jumilja lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侮辱；贬损他人、使其受到冒犯或羞辱的话语或行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma, kumment jew għemil li jweġġa' d-dinjità ta' persuna billi juri disprezz jew nuqqas ta' rispett lejha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An insult is something that someone says or does which shows disrespect and causes another person to feel offended.

collocations.en: to take a comment as an insult

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, il-president tal-kumitat fakkar lill-membri li insult personali ma jikkontribwixxix għal dibattitu kostruttiv.
formal.en: During the discussion, the committee chair reminded members that a personal insult does not contribute to constructive debate.
formal.zh: 讨论期间，委员会主席提醒成员，人身侮辱无助于建设性的辩论。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dak li għedt kien insult personali. David: Skużani, ma kellix inkellmek hekk.
colloquial.en: Marija: What you said was a personal insult. David: I'm sorry, I shouldn't have spoken to you like that.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你刚才说的话是人身侮辱。戴维：对不起，我不该那样跟你说话。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li għedt kien insult personali.
messages.mt_standard: Dak li għedt kien insult personali.
messages.zh: 你刚才说的话是人身侮辱。
messages.en: What you said was a personal insult.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 对不起，我不该那样跟你说话。
messages.en: I'm sorry, I shouldn't have spoken to you like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 insult 和“话语伤人、对方要求道歉”的场景连起来记；insult personali 尤其强调针对个人的侮辱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: During the same period, often while another event or activity is taking place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在另一件事情发生或进行的同一段时间里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fl-istess ħin jew matul iż-żmien li fih tkun qed tiġri xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与此同时；在另一件事情进行或尚未结束的这段时间里。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Matul l-istess perjodu li fih tkun għaddejja azzjoni jew ġrajja oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Meanwhile introduces something happening during the time another activity is taking place.

collocations.zh: 与此同时，我们准备食物

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qed jeżamina l-proposta. Intant, it-tim qed jiġbor aktar informazzjoni.
formal.en: The committee is examining the proposal. Meanwhile, the team is gathering more information.
formal.zh: 委员会正在审议这项提案。与此同时，团队正在收集更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Is-soppa għadha qed tissajjar. Mark: Intant, inqiegħed il-platti fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: The soup is still cooking. Mark: Meanwhile, I'll put the plates on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：汤还在煮。马克：趁这会儿，我把盘子摆到桌上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 汤还在煮。
messages.en: The soup is still cooking.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 趁这会儿，我把盘子摆到桌上。
messages.en: Meanwhile, I'll put the plates on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把煮汤和摆盘想成同时播放的两个画面，连接这两个画面的“与此同时”就是 intant。

gloss_zh: 无形之物；不可触摸的事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that cannot be physically touched, considered as an abstract thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不能用身体触摸、作为抽象事物来理解的无形之物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa astratta li ma tistax tintmess fiżikament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无形之物，即不能通过身体触摸来感知的抽象事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li ma għandhiex forma fiżika li tista' tintmess, bħal idea jew sentiment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intangible is something abstract that you cannot physically touch.

collocations.en: the connection between the tangible and the intangible
collocations.zh: 有形之物与无形之物之间的联系

formal.mt: Dan l-esej jiddiskuti l-valur tal-intanġibbli, bħall-fiduċja u r-rispett, fil-ħajja tal-komunità.
formal.en: This essay discusses the value of the intangible, such as trust and respect, in community life.
formal.zh: 本文讨论信任、尊重等无形之物在社区生活中的价值。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tifhem b''l-intanġibbli'? Mark: Affarijiet li ma tistax tmiss, bħall-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you mean by 'the intangible'? Mark: Things you cannot touch, such as trust between friends.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说的“无形之物”是什么意思？马克：就是摸不到的东西，比如朋友之间的信任。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你说的“无形之物”是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by 'the intangible'?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Affarijiet li ma tistax tmiss, bħall-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb.
messages.mt_standard: Affarijiet li ma tistax tmiss, bħall-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb.
messages.zh: 就是摸不到的东西，比如朋友之间的信任。
messages.en: Things you cannot touch, such as trust between friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象伸手去摸“信任”却摸不到，用这个画面记住本条名词用法所指的无形之物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone information or make them aware of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人提供信息，使其知道某件事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti informazzjoni lil xi ħadd jew tagħmlu jaf b'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某件事情或有关信息告诉某人，使对方知情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Twassal tagħrif lil persuna biex tkun taf dwar fatt, ġrajja jew deċiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you inform someone, you give them information about something.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, il-verb 'intarraf' jingħata bit-tifsira li tagħti informazzjoni lil xi ħadd.
formal.en: In this list, the verb 'intarraf' is given the meaning of providing someone with information.
formal.zh: 在本词表中，动词 intarraf 被赋予“向某人提供信息”的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'intarraf' f'din il-lista? Mark: Ifisser li tagħti informazzjoni lil xi ħadd, pereżempju dwar bidla fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'intarraf' mean in this list? Mark: It means giving someone information, for example about a change of time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：intarraf 在这份词表里是什么意思？马克：意思是把信息告诉别人，例如告知时间有变。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: intarraf 在这份词表里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'intarraf' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tagħti informazzjoni lil xi ħadd, pereżempju dwar bidla fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tagħti informazzjoni lil xi ħadd, pereżempju dwar bidla fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 意思是把信息告诉别人，例如告知时间有变。
messages.en: It means giving someone information, for example about a change of time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条给定释义，想象把一张写有新时间的通知递给同学，用“让对方知情”的画面记忆。

gloss_zh: 词义未明确（所给释义为 eee）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry supplied as a noun whose meaning is not established by the provided gloss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本资料中标为名词的词条；所给释义 eee 无法明确说明其含义，因此暂不赋予具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom fil-materjal mogħti, iżda mingħajr tifsira ċara, għax il-glossa mogħtija hija 'eee'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给内容 eee 未明确表达词义，无法据此确定该名词条目的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa 'eee' ma tagħtix tifsira ċara li biha jista' jiġi spjegat dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss does not establish a clear meaning for this noun entry.

collocations.zh: 为 intebaħ 提供的释义

formal.mt: Il-lista timmarka l-entrata 'intebaħ' bħala nom, iżda l-glossa 'eee' ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita tifsira ċara.
formal.en: The list marks the entry 'intebaħ' as a noun, but the gloss 'eee' does not allow a clear meaning to be established.
formal.zh: 词表将 intebaħ 这一词条标为名词，但释义 eee 无法帮助确定明确的词义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'intebaħ' f'din il-lista? Mark: Hawn miktub biss 'eee', allura ma nistgħux nagħtuh tifsira ċara minn din il-lista.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'intebaħ' mean in this list? Mark: It only says 'eee' here, so we cannot give it a clear meaning from this list.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：intebaħ 在这份词表里是什么意思？马克：这里仅写着 eee，所以我们无法根据这份词表给出明确词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: intebaħ 在这份词表里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'intebaħ' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub biss 'eee', allura ma nistgħux nagħtuh tifsira ċara minn din il-lista.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub biss 'eee', allura ma nistgħux nagħtuh tifsira ċara minn din il-lista.
messages.zh: 这里仅写着 eee，所以我们无法根据这份词表给出明确词义。
messages.en: It only says 'eee' here, so we cannot give it a clear meaning from this list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这张词卡想成背面尚未填写的卡片：先识别拼写，标记“释义待核”，避免把 eee 当成已经学会的词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become larger or swollen because of injury or the accumulation of fluid or gas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受伤或液体、气体积聚而肿胀或膨大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdied fid-daqs jew fil-volum minħabba korriment jew l-akkumulazzjoni ta' likwidu jew gass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肿胀；因液体或气体积聚等原因而膨大。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiżdied fid-daqs jew fil-volum, pereżempju minħabba korriment jew għax jinġabar fih likwidu jew gass.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something swells, it becomes larger, often because of injury or a buildup of fluid or gas.

collocations.zh: 挨了一下之后肿了起来

formal.mt: Is-saba' intefaħ wara d-daqqa, u l-pazjent kellu diffikultà biex iċaqalqu.
formal.en: The finger swelled after the blow, and the patient had difficulty moving it.
formal.zh: 手指在受到撞击后肿了起来，患者活动手指时有困难。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex neħħejt iċ-ċurkett? Pawlu: Għax saba' tiegħi intefaħ u ċ-ċurkett beda jagħfas.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you take off your ring? Pawlu: Because my finger swelled up and the ring started to feel tight.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么把戒指摘了？保罗：因为我的手指肿了，戒指开始勒手。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把戒指摘了？
messages.en: Why did you take off your ring?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax saba' tiegħi intefaħ u ċ-ċurkett beda jagħfas.
messages.mt_standard: Għax saba' tiegħi intefaħ u ċ-ċurkett beda jagħfas.
messages.zh: 因为我的手指肿了，戒指开始勒手。
messages.en: Because my finger swelled up and the ring started to feel tight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指肿到戒指变紧，把 intefaħ 与“体积变大、肿起来”的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 不可或缺的；完整的；全麦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Essential to a whole; complete; or, of food, made with wholegrain flour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成整体所必需的；完整无删节的；用于食品时，指全麦或全谷物制作的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel parti essenzjali minn ħaġa sħiħa; li huwa sħiħ u mingħajr tnaqqis; jew, dwar ikel, magħmul minn dqiq li jinkludi l-partijiet kollha tal-qamħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 构成整体所必需的；不可或缺的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħmel parti essenzjali minn ħaġa sħiħa u li mingħajru dik il-ħaġa ma tkunx kompluta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is integral to a whole is an essential part of it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完整的；包含所有部分而没有删减的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinkludi l-partijiet kollha tiegħu, mingħajr ma tħalla barra jew tneħħa xejn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A whole text or object contains all its parts, with nothing omitted or removed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （食品）用保留谷粒全部组成部分的面粉制作的；全麦的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magħmul minn dqiq li jinkludi l-partijiet kollha tal-qamħa, inklużi n-nuħħala u r-raħs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Wholemeal food is made with flour that contains all parts of the grain.

collocations.en: an integral part of the project
collocations.zh: 项目不可或缺的一部分

formal.mt: Il-konsultazzjoni mar-residenti hija parti integrali mill-proċess, u t-test integrali tar-rapport se jiġi ppubblikat fuq is-sit tal-kunsill.
formal.en: Consultation with residents is an integral part of the process, and the complete text of the report will be published on the council's website.
formal.zh: 征询居民意见是这一流程不可或缺的一部分，报告全文将发布在地方议会网站上。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandkom ħobż integrali llum? Pawlu: Iva, għadu kif ħareġ mill-forn. Trid ħobża?
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have wholemeal bread today? Pawlu: Yes, it has just come out of the oven. Would you like a loaf?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你们今天有全麦面包吗？保罗：有，刚出炉。你要一个吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们今天有全麦面包吗？
messages.en: Do you have wholemeal bread today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (面包店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu kif ħareġ mill-forn. Trid ħobża?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu kif ħareġ mill-forn. Trid ħobża?
messages.zh: 有，刚出炉。你要一个吗？
messages.en: Yes, it has just come out of the oven. Would you like a loaf?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个搭配分开记：parti integrali 是必需部分，test integrali 是全文，ħobż integrali 是全麦面包。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of bringing people, parts, or systems together into a functioning whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将不同的人、组成部分或系统结合起来，使其成为能够共同运作的整体的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuni, partijiet jew sistemi differenti jingħaqdu biex jiffurmaw ħaġa sħiħa li taħdem flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 整合或融合，即使不同的人、部分或系统相互结合并共同运作的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih elementi, sistemi jew persuni differenti jinġiebu flimkien sabiex ikunu jistgħu jiffunzjonaw bħala parti minn ħaġa sħiħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Integration is the process of bringing different people or things together so that they function as a whole.

formal.mt: Il-programm jappoġġa l-integrazzjoni tar-residenti l-ġodda fil-komunità permezz ta' korsijiet tal-lingwa u attivitajiet kulturali.
formal.en: The programme supports the integration of new residents into the community through language courses and cultural activities.
formal.zh: 该计划通过语言课程和文化活动，帮助新居民融入社区。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Issa nista' nara l-ordnijiet kollha f'post wieħed? Pawlu: Iva, l-integrazzjoni taż-żewġ sistemi lesta, u kollox jidher hawn.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can I now see all the orders in one place? Pawlu: Yes, the integration of the two systems is complete, and everything appears here.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：现在我能在同一个地方看到所有订单了吗？保罗：能，两个系统已经整合好了，所有内容都显示在这里。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nista' nara l-ordnijiet kollha f'post wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: Issa nista' nara l-ordnijiet kollha f'post wieħed?
messages.zh: 现在我能在同一个地方看到所有订单了吗？
messages.en: Can I now see all the orders in one place?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-integrazzjoni taż-żewġ sistemi lesta, u kollox jidher hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-integrazzjoni taż-żewġ sistemi lesta, u kollox jidher hawn.
messages.zh: 能，两个系统已经整合好了，所有内容都显示在这里。
messages.en: Yes, the integration of the two systems is complete, and everything appears here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两套系统接到一起共同工作：integrazzjoni 表示整合的过程；换成人与社区，就是融合。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making a market more unified by reducing barriers to trade and exchange.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过减少贸易和交易壁垒，使市场内部各部分更加统一、相互连通的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitnaqqsu l-ostakli għall-kummerċ u l-iskambju sabiex il-partijiet ta' suq jaħdmu flimkien b'mod aktar magħqud.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场一体化，即减少市场内部的分隔和交易障碍，使各部分形成更加统一的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-integrazzjoni tas-suq hija l-proċess li bih jitnaqqsu l-firdiet u l-ostakli bejn il-partijiet ta' suq sabiex dawn jiffurmaw suq aktar magħqud.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market integration is the process through which separate parts of a market become more closely connected and operate together.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif regoli komuni jistgħu jiffaċilitaw l-integrazzjoni tas-suq.
formal.en: The study examines how common rules can facilitate market integration.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察共同规则如何促进市场一体化。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'tfisser integrazzjoni tas-suq? Pawlu: Tfisser li jitnaqqsu l-ostakli biex il-partijiet tas-suq jaħdmu aħjar flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does market integration mean? Pawlu: It means reducing barriers so that the parts of the market work better together.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：市场一体化是什么意思？保罗：就是减少障碍，让市场各部分更好地协同运作。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 市场一体化是什么意思？
messages.en: What does market integration mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li jitnaqqsu l-ostakli biex il-partijiet tas-suq jaħdmu aħjar flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li jitnaqqsu l-ostakli biex il-partijiet tas-suq jaħdmu aħjar flimkien.
messages.zh: 就是减少障碍，让市场各部分更好地协同运作。
messages.en: It means reducing barriers so that the parts of the market work better together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一个市场想成有隔板的大大厅：移开隔板、打通交易，就是市场一体化；tas-suq 对应单数的“市场”。

gloss_zh: 各市场一体化；多个市场的整合

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of connecting different markets more closely by reducing barriers between them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过减少不同市场之间的壁垒，使多个市场更加紧密联系、协调运作的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitnaqqsu l-ostakli bejn swieq differenti sabiex dawn ikunu marbuta aktar mill-qrib u jaħdmu aħjar flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各市场一体化，即减少多个市场之间的分隔和交易障碍，使它们更加相互连通。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-integrazzjoni tas-swieq hija l-proċess li bih swieq differenti jsiru aktar marbuta ma' xulxin permezz tat-tnaqqis tal-ostakli għall-kummerċ u l-iskambju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market integration occurs when different markets become more closely connected as barriers to trade and exchange are reduced.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-integrazzjoni tas-swieq u l-ostakli li għadhom jeżistu bejniethom.
formal.en: The report analyses market integration and the barriers that still exist between the markets.
formal.zh: 该报告分析各市场的一体化情况，以及市场之间仍然存在的障碍。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed nistudjaw l-integrazzjoni tas-swieq? David: Biex nifhmu kif swieq differenti jsiru aktar marbuta ma' xulxin.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are we studying market integration? David: To understand how different markets become more closely connected.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们为什么要学习各市场一体化？戴维：为了理解不同市场如何变得更加紧密相连。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要学习各市场一体化？
messages.en: Why are we studying market integration?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nifhmu kif swieq differenti jsiru aktar marbuta ma' xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nifhmu kif swieq differenti jsiru aktar marbuta ma' xulxin.
messages.zh: 为了理解不同市场如何变得更加紧密相连。
messages.en: To understand how different markets become more closely connected.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几座市场之间架起桥梁，交易往来越来越顺畅；swieq 是复数“市场”，帮助记住这里强调多个市场的整合。

gloss_zh: 智力的；思想的；涉及理性思考的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the mind and to activities that involve thought, reasoning, or the study of ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与心智、理性思考或思想研究有关的，常用于描述活动、工作、讨论或兴趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-moħħ u ma' attivitajiet li jinvolvu l-ħsieb, ir-raġunament jew l-istudju tal-ideat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 智力的；思想的；涉及思考、推理或思想研究的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa intellettwali tkun marbuta mal-użu tal-moħħ, mal-ħsieb jew mal-istudju u d-diskussjoni tal-ideat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intellectual activity or subject involves careful thought, reasoning, or the exploration of ideas.

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi attivitajiet li jħeġġu l-iżvilupp intellettwali tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The programme includes activities that encourage students' intellectual development.
formal.zh: 该课程包含促进学生智力发展的活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien id-dibattitu lbieraħ? Mark: Kien intellettwali ħafna, imma l-kelliema spjegaw l-ideat b'mod ċar.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was yesterday's debate? Mark: It was very intellectual, but the speakers explained the ideas clearly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：昨天的辩论怎么样？马克：很有思想深度，不过发言者把观点解释得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的辩论怎么样？
messages.en: How was yesterday's debate?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien intellettwali ħafna, imma l-kelliema spjegaw l-ideat b'mod ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Kien intellettwali ħafna, imma l-kelliema spjegaw l-ideat b'mod ċar.
messages.zh: 很有思想深度，不过发言者把观点解释得很清楚。
messages.en: It was very intellectual, but the speakers explained the ideas clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“动脑讨论思想”的画面记忆：intellettwali 强调与思考和思想有关；描述一个人聪明时，可联想到另一词 intelliġenti。

gloss_zh: 聪明的；理解力强的；机敏的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to understand and learn things well, reason effectively, and find good solutions to problems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够较好地理解和学习事物，善于推理并找到有效解决办法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħila jifhem u jitgħallem tajjeb, jirraġuna b'mod effettiv u jsib soluzzjonijiet tajbin għall-problemi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聪明的；具有良好的理解、学习和推理能力的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna intelliġenti jkollha kapaċità tajba biex tifhem, titgħallem u tuża r-raġunament f'sitwazzjonijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is intelligent can understand ideas, learn effectively, and reason well about different situations.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聪颖的；领悟快、学东西快的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna intelliġenti, f'dan is-sens, tifhem malajr u titgħallem affarijiet ġodda b'faċilità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is bright is quick to understand things and learns new ideas easily.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机灵的；善于动脑筋、想出巧妙办法的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna intelliġenti, f'dan is-sens, tkun kapaċi tuża moħħha biex issib modi għaqlin kif tagħmel xi ħaġa jew issolvi problema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is clever uses their mental ability to find effective or imaginative ways of doing things.

formal.mt: L-istudenta pproponiet soluzzjoni intelliġenti u spjegat ir-raġunament tagħha b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The student proposed a clever solution and explained her reasoning clearly.
formal.zh: 这名女学生提出了一个巧妙的解决办法，并清楚地解释了自己的推理过程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Lejla fehmet il-problema mill-ewwel u sabet soluzzjoni. Tom: Iva, hi intelliġenti ħafna!
colloquial.en: Nina: Lejla understood the problem straight away and found a solution. Tom: Yes, she's very clever!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：莱拉一下就理解了问题，还找到了解决办法。汤姆：是啊，她很聪明！

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Lejla fehmet il-problema mill-ewwel u sabet soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Lejla fehmet il-problema mill-ewwel u sabet soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 莱拉一下就理解了问题，还找到了解决办法。
messages.en: Lejla understood the problem straight away and found a solution.

messages.speaker: Tom (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，她很聪明！
messages.en: Yes, she's very clever!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项串成学习画面：理解能力好是 intelligent，领悟特别快是 bright，办法想得巧是 clever；都可用 intelliġenti 表达。

gloss_zh: 智力；理解和学习的能力

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intelligence is the ability to learn, understand things, and think about problems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 智力是学习知识、理解事物并思考问题的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-intelliġenza hija l-kapaċità li wieħed jitgħallem, jifhem l-affarijiet u jaħseb dwar il-problemi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 智力；学习、理解和思考问题的能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-intelliġenza hija l-ħila li wieħed jitgħallem, jifhem u juża l-ħsieb biex isolvi l-problemi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Intelligence is your ability to learn, understand ideas, and use your thinking to solve problems.

formal.mt: It-test ikejjel ċerti aspetti tal-intelliġenza, iżda ma jkejjelx il-ħiliet kollha tal-istudent.
formal.en: The test measures certain aspects of intelligence, but it does not measure all of the student's abilities.
formal.zh: 这项测验衡量智力的某些方面，但不能衡量学生的全部能力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-test ikejjel l-intelliġenza? Pawlu: Iva, imma ma jurix dak kollu li taf tagħmel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this test measure intelligence? Pawlu: Yes, but it doesn't show everything you can do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这项测验测的是智力吗？保罗：是的，但它不能反映你会做的所有事情。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这项测验测的是智力吗？
messages.en: Does this test measure intelligence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ma jurix dak kollu li taf tagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ma jurix dak kollu li taf tagħmel.
messages.zh: 是的，但它不能反映你会做的所有事情。
messages.en: Yes, but it doesn't show everything you can do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词联想到学习、理解、解题三个场景，连起来记住“智力”，并用“智力测验”这一搭配巩固。

gloss_zh: 词义待核实（所给释义为 il mamma）

teaching_sense.en_definition: This item is labelled as a verb, but the supplied gloss 'il mamma' does not establish a clear meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 此条目标注为动词，但所给释义“il mamma”不足以确定其含义；以下例句仅用于讨论这个词形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din il-forma hija mmarkata bħala verb, iżda t-tifsira tagħha ma tistax tiġi stabbilita b'mod ċar mill-glossa mogħtija 'il mamma'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义“il mamma”含义不清，无法据此提供可靠的中文动词释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija hija 'il mamma', iżda ma tipprovdix biżżejjed tagħrif biex jiġi ddeterminat xi jfisser dan il-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss does not provide enough information to determine what this verb means.

formal.mt: Il-forma 'intellqu' hija mmarkata bħala verb, iżda l-glossa 'il mamma' mhijiex biżżejjed biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The form 'intellqu' is labelled as a verb, but the gloss 'il mamma' is insufficient to establish its meaning.
formal.zh: “intellqu”这一词形被标注为动词，但释义“il mamma”不足以确定其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'intellqu' hawn? Pawlu: Ma nafx; il-glossa 'il mamma' mhijiex ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'intellqu' mean here? Pawlu: I don't know; the gloss 'il mamma' is unclear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“intellqu”是什么意思？保罗：我不知道；释义“il mamma”不清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“intellqu”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'intellqu' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; il-glossa 'il mamma' mhijiex ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; il-glossa 'il mamma' mhijiex ċara.
messages.zh: 我不知道；释义“il mamma”不清楚。
messages.en: I don't know; the gloss 'il mamma' is unclear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把词形与“动词、释义待核实”一起记在卡片上；不要把含义不清的 il mamma 强行背成中文词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: When a period expires, it reaches its end and no longer continues.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一段期限达到终点，不再继续，即到期、期满或结束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta perjodu jintemm, jasal fi tmiemu u ma jibqax għaddej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到期；期满，指规定的期限已经结束。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta ż-żmien stabbilit jintemm, jasal sal-aħħar tiegħu u ma jibqax għaddej.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a fixed period expires, it reaches its end and is no longer continuing.

formal.mt: Il-perjodu ta' prova intemm ilbieraħ, u minn illum japplikaw il-kundizzjonijiet il-ġodda.
formal.en: The trial period expired yesterday, and the new conditions apply from today.
formal.zh: 试用期已于昨天结束，新条件从今天起适用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad fadlilna ħin biex inwieġbu? Pawlu: Le, iż-żmien mogħti intemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we still have time to answer? Pawlu: No, the allotted time has expired.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还有时间作答吗？保罗：没有了，规定的时间已经到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我们还有时间作答吗？
messages.en: Do we still have time to answer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 没有了，规定的时间已经到了。
messages.en: No, the allotted time has expired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象考试计时归零，老师说 intemm：时间已到、期限结束。用“试用期已满”这个完整场景帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 词义与词性对应待核实（所给释义为 intensita）

teaching_sense.en_definition: This item is labelled as an adjective, but the supplied gloss 'intensita' does not establish a clear adjective meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 此条目标注为形容词，但所给释义“intensita”不足以确定相应的形容词含义；以下例句仅用于讨论条目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv, iżda l-glossa mogħtija 'intensita' ma tistabbilixxix b'mod ċar it-tifsira tagħha bħala aġġettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义为“intensita”；仅凭该释义无法可靠确定此处所标形容词的中文含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija hija 'intensita', iżda ma tagħtix biżżejjed tagħrif biex tiġi ddeterminata t-tifsira tal-entrata bħala aġġettiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss does not give enough information to determine the adjective meaning intended here.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'intensity' hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv, iżda l-glossa 'intensita' ma tipprovdix biżżejjed tagħrif biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira maħsuba.
formal.en: The entry 'intensity' is labelled as an adjective, but the gloss 'intensita' does not provide enough information to establish the intended meaning.
formal.zh: “intensity”这一条目被标注为形容词，但释义“intensita”未提供足够信息来确定其预期含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn 'intensity' hu mmarkat bħala aġġettiv? Pawlu: Iva, imma l-glossa 'intensita' ma tiċċarax it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is 'intensity' labelled as an adjective here? Pawlu: Yes, but the gloss 'intensita' does not clarify the meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里把“intensity”标成形容词了吗？保罗：是的，但释义“intensita”没有说明清楚它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里把“intensity”标成形容词了吗？
messages.en: Is 'intensity' labelled as an adjective here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-glossa 'intensita' ma tiċċarax it-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-glossa 'intensita' ma tiċċarax it-tifsira.
messages.zh: 是的，但释义“intensita”没有说明清楚它的含义。
messages.en: Yes, but the gloss 'intensita' does not clarify the meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这张词卡加上“形容词标签待核对”的提示，分别记住原词和原释义，避免仅凭熟悉的拼写猜测用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Planned or meant to happen or to be achieved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先计划使其发生或希望达成的，常用于描述效果或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħsub jew ippjanat li jseħħ jew li jinkiseb, speċjalment meta jkun effett jew riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先设想、计划或希望实现的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie maħsub jew ippjanat bħala dak li għandu jseħħ jew jinkiseb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intended result or effect is one that someone plans or wants to achieve.

formal.mt: L-effett intenzjonat tal-miżura huwa li jitnaqqas l-istorbju qrib l-iskola.
formal.en: The intended effect of the measure is to reduce noise near the school.
formal.zh: 这项措施的预期效果是减少学校附近的噪声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan kien ir-riżultat intenzjonat? Mark: Iva, ridna li l-kamra tidher iktar spazjuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this the intended result? Mark: Yes, we wanted the room to look more spacious.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这就是预期的结果吗？马克：是的，我们想让房间看起来更宽敞。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这就是预期的结果吗？
messages.en: Was this the intended result?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ridna li l-kamra tidher iktar spazjuża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ridna li l-kamra tidher iktar spazjuża.
messages.zh: 是的，我们想让房间看起来更宽敞。
messages.en: Yes, we wanted the room to look more spacious.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 intenzjonat 放在“预期结果”的画面里记：先在纸上画出目标，再看实际结果是否符合计划。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plan or purpose that someone has in mind when considering or doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人准备做某事时心中的打算，或采取行动时所抱的目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħsieb jew il-pjan li persuna jkollha biex tagħmel xi ħaġa, jew l-għan li jkollha meta taġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打算做某事的意愿，或行动背后的目的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li persuna tkun biħsiebha tagħmel, jew l-għan li tkun trid tilħaq permezz ta' azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your intention is what you plan to do or the purpose behind your actions.

formal.mt: L-intenzjoni tal-proġett hija li jtejjeb l-aċċess għall-informazzjoni għar-residenti kollha.
formal.en: The intention of the project is to improve access to information for all residents.
formal.zh: 该项目的目的是让所有居民都更方便地获取信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek l-intenzjoni li tmur il-laqgħa għada? Luqa: Iva, irrid nisma' x'se jipproponu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you intend to go to the meeting tomorrow? Luqa: Yes, I want to hear what they will propose.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你打算参加明天的会议吗？卢卡：是的，我想听听他们会提出什么建议。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek l-intenzjoni li tmur il-laqgħa għada?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek l-intenzjoni li tmur il-laqgħa għada?
messages.zh: 你打算参加明天的会议吗？
messages.en: Do you intend to go to the meeting tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，我想听听他们会提出什么建议。
messages.en: Yes, I want to hear what they will propose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 intenzjoni 想成行动前脑中的小计划：还没出门，已经想好要去哪里、为什么去。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Allowing people to participate actively and receive responses to what they do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让参与者能够主动操作、回答或交流，并得到相应回应的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jippermetti lill-parteċipanti jieħdu sehem attiv u jirċievu tweġibiet jew reazzjonijiet għal dak li jagħmlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 允许使用者或参与者主动参与，并与系统或他人相互回应的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi parteċipazzjoni attiva u skambju ta' tweġibiet jew reazzjonijiet bejn persuni jew bejn persuna u sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something interactive allows you to take part and receive a response to your actions.

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi eżerċizzju interattiv li jagħti tweġiba immedjata wara kull mistoqsija.
formal.en: The course includes an interactive exercise that provides an immediate response after each question.
formal.zh: 课程包含一项互动练习，每道题作答后都会立即给出回应。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-eżerċizzju huwa interattiv? Pawlu: Iva, tagħżel tweġiba u tara minnufih jekk hix tajba.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this exercise interactive? Pawlu: Yes, you choose an answer and immediately see whether it is correct.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个练习是互动式的吗？保罗：是的，你选好答案，马上就能看到答得对不对。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个练习是互动式的吗？
messages.en: Is this exercise interactive?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tagħżel tweġiba u tara minnufih jekk hix tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tagħżel tweġiba u tara minnufih jekk hix tajba.
messages.zh: 是的，你选好答案，马上就能看到答得对不对。
messages.en: Yes, you choose an answer and immediately see whether it is correct.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 interattiv 时想象“你点一下，屏幕答一下”：主动参与并得到回应，就是互动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To officially forbid an activity or the use of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由有权作出决定的人或机构正式禁止某种活动或某物的使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprojbixxi b'mod uffiċjali attività jew l-użu ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式禁止某种行为、活动或某物的使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ma jħallix li ssir attività jew li tintuża xi ħaġa permezz ta' deċiżjoni jew ordni uffiċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an authority bans something, it officially declares that people must not do or use it.

formal.mt: Il-kunsill interdixxa l-ipparkjar quddiem id-daħla tal-iskola biex jipproteġi lit-tfal.
formal.en: The council banned parking in front of the school entrance to protect children.
formal.zh: 地方议会为保护儿童，禁止在学校入口前停车。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma nistgħux nipparkjaw hawn? Rita: Il-kunsill interdixxa l-ipparkjar hawn; ejja nfittxu post ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why can't we park here? Rita: The council banned parking here; let's look for another space.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们为什么不能在这里停车？丽塔：地方议会禁止在这里停车；我们找别的车位吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能在这里停车？
messages.en: Why can't we park here?

messages.speaker: Rita (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kunsill interdixxa l-ipparkjar hawn; ejja nfittxu post ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kunsill interdixxa l-ipparkjar hawn; ejja nfittxu post ieħor.
messages.zh: 地方议会禁止在这里停车；我们找别的车位吧。
messages.en: The council banned parking here; let's look for another space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 interdixxa 和正式禁令连起来记：看到禁止停车牌，就想起“有关部门下令禁止了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of wanting to learn about something or give it your attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想了解某事物或愿意对其投入注意力的兴趣、关注。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħajra li tkun taf aktar dwar xi ħaġa jew li tagħtiha l-attenzjoni tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事物的兴趣或关注。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-interess huwa ħajra li tkun taf aktar dwar xi ħaġa jew li tagħtiha attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn more about it or give it your attention.

formal.mt: L-istudenti wrew interess kbir fl-istorja lokali waqt iż-żjara fil-mużew.
formal.en: The students showed great interest in local history during the museum visit.
formal.zh: 参观博物馆期间，学生们对当地历史表现出浓厚兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek interess fil-fotografija? Mark: Iva, inħobb nieħu ritratti meta noħroġ nimxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you interested in photography? Mark: Yes, I like taking photos when I go for a walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你对摄影有兴趣吗？马克：有，我喜欢散步时拍照。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你对摄影有兴趣吗？
messages.en: Are you interested in photography?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inħobb nieħu ritratti meta noħroġ nimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inħobb nieħu ritratti meta noħroġ nimxi.
messages.zh: 有，我喜欢散步时拍照。
messages.en: Yes, I like taking photos when I go for a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 interess 放进“我有兴趣”这个框架来记：għandi interess。想象自己看到喜欢的话题，主动凑近了解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something interesting attracts your attention and makes you want to know more.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能吸引注意力并让人想进一步了解的；有趣的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa interessanti tiġbed l-attenzjoni tiegħek u tqanqlek tkun taf aktar dwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有趣的；能引起兴趣、使人想进一步了解的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun interessanti meta tiġbed l-attenzjoni u tqanqal ix-xewqa li tkun taf aktar dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is interesting, it attracts your attention and makes you want to know more about it.

formal.mt: L-artiklu joffri analiżi interessanti tal-ħajja ta' kuljum f'Malta.
formal.en: The article offers an interesting analysis of everyday life in Malta.
formal.zh: 这篇文章对马耳他的日常生活作出了引人关注的分析。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt il-ktieb? Mark: Interessanti ħafna! Tgħallimt ħafna affarijiet ġodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you find the book? Mark: Very interesting! I learned lots of new things.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这本书怎么样？马克：很有趣！我学到了很多新东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得这本书怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find the book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Interessanti ħafna! Tgħallimt ħafna affarijiet ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Interessanti ħafna! Tgħallimt ħafna affarijiet ġodda.
messages.zh: 很有趣！我学到了很多新东西。
messages.en: Very interesting! I learned lots of new things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 interessanti 贴在吸引你的书或话题上，记成“它很有趣”；用 ktieb interessanti 联想一本让你舍不得合上的书。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone interested wants to know more about something or take part in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事物有兴趣、想进一步了解或愿意参与的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna interessata tkun tixtieq tkun taf aktar dwar xi ħaġa jew tieħu sehem fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感兴趣的；想了解某事或有意参与其中的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd ikun interessat f'xi ħaġa, ikun jixtieq ikun jaf aktar dwarha jew jieħu sehem fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are interested in something, you want to learn more about it or become involved in it.

formal.mt: Kull min hu interessat fil-kors jista' jitlob aktar informazzjoni mill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Anyone interested in the course can request further information from the office.
formal.zh: 凡对这门课程感兴趣的人，都可以向办公室索取更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int interessat fil-kors tal-Malti? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nitgħallem nitkellem aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you interested in the Maltese course? Mark: Yes, I would like to learn to speak better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你对马耳他语课程感兴趣吗？马克：是的，我想学着把马耳他语说得更好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你对马耳他语课程感兴趣吗？
messages.en: Are you interested in the Maltese course?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我想学着把马耳他语说得更好。
messages.en: Yes, I would like to learn to speak better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 interessat 放在人的感受上：Mark interessat，马克感兴趣；再配 il-kors interessanti，课程很有趣，成对记住两种表达。

gloss_zh: 非贸易方面的关切；非商业利益

teaching_sense.en_definition: Interests or concerns relating to matters other than trade or commercial activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贸易或商业活动之外的利益与关切，例如社区福祉或环境保护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Interessi jew kwistjonijiet li ma jirrigwardawx il-kummerċ, bħall-benesseri tal-komunità jew il-ħarsien tal-ambjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非贸易方面的关切；与贸易或商业活动以外的事项有关的利益和关注。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-interessi mhux kummerċjali huma interessi jew kwistjonijiet li għandhom x'jaqsmu ma' oqsma oħra għajr il-kummerċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Non-trade concerns are matters that people consider important for reasons other than trade or commercial activity.

collocations.zh: 将非贸易方面的关切纳入考虑

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza li d-deċiżjoni għandha tqis ukoll l-interessi mhux kummerċjali tal-komunità, bħall-ħarsien tal-ambjent.
formal.en: The report stresses that the decision should also take the community's non-trade concerns, such as environmental protection, into account.
formal.zh: 报告强调，这项决定也应考虑社区在环境保护等非贸易方面的关切。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fil-laqgħa tkellimtu biss dwar il-ħwienet? Mark: Le, tkellimna wkoll dwar interessi mhux kummerċjali, bħall-ħtieġa ta' aktar spazji għat-tfal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you only talk about the shops at the meeting? Mark: No, we also discussed non-trade concerns, such as the need for more spaces for children.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们开会时只谈了商店的事吗？马克：没有，我们还讨论了非贸易方面的关切，比如需要给孩子们提供更多活动空间。

messages.speaker: Maja (社区居民)
messages.zh: 你们开会时只谈了商店的事吗？
messages.en: Did you only talk about the shops at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (社区代表)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tkellimna wkoll dwar interessi mhux kummerċjali, bħall-ħtieġa ta' aktar spazji għat-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tkellimna wkoll dwar interessi mhux kummerċjali, bħall-ħtieġa ta' aktar spazji għat-tfal.
messages.zh: 没有，我们还讨论了非贸易方面的关切，比如需要给孩子们提供更多活动空间。
messages.en: No, we also discussed non-trade concerns, such as the need for more spaces for children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进社区会议场景：大家除了讨论生意，还关心儿童空间和环境；用这些画面记住“非贸易方面的关切”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The internal organs in the abdomen of a person or animal, especially the intestines.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或动物腹部的内部器官，尤指肠等脏器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organi li jinsabu fiż-żaqq ta' persuna jew annimal, speċjalment l-imsaren.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腹内脏器，尤指肠等内脏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-organi ta' ġewwa ż-żaqq ta' persuna jew annimal, b'mod speċjali l-imsaren.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The entrails of a person or animal are the organs inside the abdomen, especially the intestines.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, il-veterinarju ddeskriva l-kundizzjoni tal-interjuri tal-annimal.
formal.en: In his report, the veterinarian described the condition of the animal's entrails.
formal.zh: 兽医在报告中描述了这只动物内脏的状况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma interjuri hawn? Mark: Hawn tfisser l-organi ta' ġewwa ż-żaqq, speċjalment l-imsaren.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word interjuri mean here? Mark: Here it means the organs inside the abdomen, especially the intestines.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 interjuri 是什么意思？马克：这里指腹部里面的器官，尤其是肠。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 interjuri 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word interjuri mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser l-organi ta' ġewwa ż-żaqq, speċjalment l-imsaren.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser l-organi ta' ġewwa ż-żaqq, speċjalment l-imsaren.
messages.zh: 这里指腹部里面的器官，尤其是肠。
messages.en: Here it means the organs inside the abdomen, especially the intestines.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和腹部解剖图一起记：图中腹内的肠腑就是本义所指的内脏。

gloss_zh: 不平衡净额抵消功率交换

teaching_sense.en_definition: An interchange of electrical power used to offset opposing power imbalances through netting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于将方向相反的电力不平衡量进行净额抵消的功率交换。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skambju ta' qawwa elettrika li jintuża biex jiġu kkumpensati żbilanċi f'direzzjonijiet opposti permezz tan-nettjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为抵消方向相反的电力不平衡量而进行的功率交换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skambju ta' qawwa elettrika għall-kumpens ta' żbilanċi f'direzzjonijiet opposti permezz tan-nettjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An imbalance netting power interchange is an exchange of electrical power used to offset imbalances in opposite directions.

collocations.en: the calculation of the imbalance netting power interchange
collocations.zh: 不平衡净额抵消功率交换的计算

collocations.en: the value of the imbalance netting power interchange
collocations.zh: 不平衡净额抵消功率交换的数值

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta l-valur tal-interkambju tal-enerġija għan-nettjar tal-iżbilanċi għal kull perjodu ta' analiżi.
formal.en: The report presents the value of the imbalance netting power interchange for each analysis period.
formal.zh: 报告列出了每个分析时段的不平衡净额抵消功率交换数值。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser interkambju tal-enerġija għan-nettjar tal-iżbilanċi? Mark: Huwa skambju ta' qawwa biex żbilanċi f'direzzjonijiet opposti jikkumpensaw lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does imbalance netting power interchange mean? Mark: It is an exchange of power that allows imbalances in opposite directions to offset each other.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：不平衡净额抵消功率交换是什么意思？马克：就是通过功率交换，让方向相反的不平衡量相互抵消。

messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser interkambju tal-enerġija għan-nettjar tal-iżbilanċi?
messages.zh: 不平衡净额抵消功率交换是什么意思？
messages.en: What does imbalance netting power interchange mean?

messages.en: It is an exchange of power that allows imbalances in opposite directions to offset each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两支方向相反的箭头帮助记忆：先看不平衡量，再记通过功率交换让它们相互抵消。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An interchange of electrical power used to help restore the frequency of an electricity system to its target value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于帮助电力系统频率恢复至目标值的功率交换。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skambju ta' qawwa elettrika li jintuża biex jgħin lill-frekwenza tas-sistema tal-elettriku terġa' tilħaq il-valur fil-mira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为使电力系统频率恢复至目标值而进行的功率交换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skambju ta' qawwa elettrika li jgħin biex il-frekwenza tas-sistema tal-elettriku terġa' lura għall-valur fil-mira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A frequency restoration power interchange is an exchange of electrical power that helps return system frequency to its target value.

collocations.en: the monitoring of the frequency restoration power interchange
collocations.zh: 频率恢复功率交换的监测

collocations.en: the value of the frequency restoration power interchange
collocations.zh: 频率恢复功率交换的数值

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega r-rwol tal-interkambju tal-enerġija għar-restawr tal-frekwenza biex il-frekwenza terġa' lura għall-valur fil-mira.
formal.en: The document explains the role of the frequency restoration power interchange in returning frequency to its target value.
formal.zh: 该文件解释了频率恢复功率交换在使频率恢复至目标值方面的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex jintuża l-interkambju tal-enerġija għar-restawr tal-frekwenza? Mark: Biex jgħin lill-frekwenza tas-sistema terġa' lura għall-valur fil-mira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is frequency restoration power interchange used? Mark: To help the system frequency return to its target value.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么要进行频率恢复功率交换？马克：为了帮助系统频率恢复至目标值。

messages.speaker: Maja (实习生)

messages.mt_standard: Għaliex jintuża l-interkambju tal-enerġija għar-restawr tal-frekwenza?
messages.zh: 为什么要进行频率恢复功率交换？
messages.en: Why is frequency restoration power interchange used?

messages.speaker: Mark (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jgħin lill-frekwenza tas-sistema terġa' lura għall-valur fil-mira.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jgħin lill-frekwenza tas-sistema terġa' lura għall-valur fil-mira.
messages.zh: 为了帮助系统频率恢复至目标值。
messages.en: To help the system frequency return to its target value.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象频率指针回到目标刻度：把整条术语连成“交换功率，帮助频率恢复”的画面来记。

gloss_zh: 经净额抵消的功率交换

teaching_sense.en_definition: The resulting interchange of electrical power after exchanges in opposite directions have been offset against one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将方向相反的功率交换量相互抵消后得到的功率交换。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iskambju ta' qawwa elettrika li jirriżulta wara li skambji f'direzzjonijiet opposti jiġu kkumpensati bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过净额抵消处理后得到的功率交换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-iskambju ta' qawwa elettrika li jibqa' wara li jiġu kkumpensati skambji f'direzzjonijiet opposti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A netted power interchange is the resulting exchange of electrical power after opposing exchanges have been offset against each other.

collocations.en: the calculation of the netted power interchange
collocations.zh: 经净额抵消的功率交换的计算

collocations.en: the direction of the netted power interchange
collocations.zh: 经净额抵消的功率交换的方向

formal.mt: It-tabella turi l-valur u d-direzzjoni tal-interkambju tal-enerġija nett wara l-kumpens tal-iskambji f'direzzjonijiet opposti.
formal.en: The table shows the value and direction of the netted power interchange after exchanges in opposite directions have been offset.
formal.zh: 该表显示了方向相反的交换量相互抵消后，所得功率交换的数值和方向。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'juri l-interkambju tal-enerġija nett? Mark: Juri r-riżultat wara li l-iskambji f'direzzjonijiet opposti jkunu ġew ikkumpensati bejniethom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the netted power interchange show? Mark: It shows the result after exchanges in opposite directions have been offset against each other.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：经净额抵消的功率交换表示什么？马克：它表示方向相反的交换量相互抵消后的结果。

messages.speaker: Maja (实习生)
messages.zh: 经净额抵消的功率交换表示什么？
messages.en: What does the netted power interchange show?

messages.speaker: Mark (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Juri r-riżultat wara li l-iskambji f'direzzjonijiet opposti jkunu ġew ikkumpensati bejniethom.
messages.mt_standard: Juri r-riżultat wara li l-iskambji f'direzzjonijiet opposti jkunu ġew ikkumpensati bejniethom.
messages.zh: 它表示方向相反的交换量相互抵消后的结果。
messages.en: It shows the result after exchanges in opposite directions have been offset against each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两支相反箭头，抵消相同部分后看剩下的箭头；用这个画面记住净额处理后的功率交换。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An interchange of electrical power supplied to replace another power supply.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为替代另一电力供应而进行的电力交换。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skambju ta' enerġija elettrika li ssir disponibbli biex tieħu post provvista oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于替代另一电力供应的电力交换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skambju ta' enerġija elettrika bejn partijiet, fejn l-enerġija fornuta tieħu post provvista oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A replacement power interchange is an exchange in which electrical power is supplied to take the place of another supply.

collocations.mt: ftehim dwar l-interkambju tal-enerġija ta' rimpjazzament
collocations.en: an agreement on replacement power interchange
collocations.zh: 关于替代电力交换的协议
替代电力交换的时间安排

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jispeċifika l-kwantità u t-tul tal-interkambju tal-enerġija ta' rimpjazzament.
formal.en: The agreement specifies the quantity and duration of the replacement power interchange.
formal.zh: 协议规定了替代电力交换的数量和持续时间。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi jfisser interkambju tal-enerġija ta' rimpjazzament? Pawlu: Ifisser li jsir skambju ta' elettriku biex jieħu post provvista oħra.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does replacement power interchange mean? Pawlu: It means that electricity is exchanged to take the place of another supply.
colloquial.zh: Marija：替代电力交换是什么意思？Pawlu：就是说，通过交换电力来替代另一项供电。

messages.speaker: Marija (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser interkambju tal-enerġija ta' rimpjazzament?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser interkambju tal-enerġija ta' rimpjazzament?
messages.zh: 替代电力交换是什么意思？
messages.en: What does replacement power interchange mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jsir skambju ta' elettriku biex jieħu post provvista oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jsir skambju ta' elettriku biex jieħu post provvista oħra.
messages.zh: 就是说，通过交换电力来替代另一项供电。
messages.en: It means that electricity is exchanged to take the place of another supply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个长词组联想成“原有供电需要替代，于是安排电力交换”的场景，按“交换—电力—替代”三个意义块记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To explain or understand the meaning of something in a particular way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说明某事物的含义，或以某种方式理解其意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tispjega t-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa jew tifhimha b'mod partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解释某事物的意义，或对其作出某种理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tispjega xi jfisser test, kliem jew informazzjoni, jew tifhem it-tifsira tagħhom b'mod partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you interpret something, you explain its meaning or understand it in a particular way.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur interpreta r-riżultati fid-dawl tal-informazzjoni disponibbli.
formal.en: The researcher interpreted the results in light of the available information.
formal.zh: 研究员根据现有信息解读了这些结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif interpreta l-messaġġ tiegħek Mark? Luqa: Interpreta l-messaġġ bħala stedina, imma jien kont qed nagħtih biss l-informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Mark interpret your message? Luqa: He interpreted the message as an invitation, but I was only giving him the information.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark是怎么理解你的消息的？Luqa：他把那条消息理解成了邀请，但我只是把信息告诉他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark是怎么理解你的消息的？
messages.en: How did Mark interpret your message?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Interpreta l-messaġġ bħala stedina, imma jien kont qed nagħtih biss l-informazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Interpreta l-messaġġ bħala stedina, imma jien kont qed nagħtih biss l-informazzjoni.
messages.zh: 他把那条消息理解成了邀请，但我只是把信息告诉他。
messages.en: He interpreted the message as an invitation, but I was only giving him the information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“同一条消息，两个人读出不同意思”的画面记住“解读”；例句中的 interpreta 可以配合“他解读了……”一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having been explained or understood in a particular way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经得到解释，或已被以某种方式理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ngħatatlu tifsira jew li ġie mifhum b'mod partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经被解释或以某种方式解读的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li t-tifsira tiegħu ġiet spjegata jew li ġie mifhum b'mod partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as interpreted has had its meaning explained or has been understood in a particular way.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-kliem tal-awtur huwa interpretat fil-kuntest storiku tiegħu.
formal.en: In the report, the author's words are interpreted in their historical context.
formal.zh: 报告结合作者话语所处的历史背景对其加以解读。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Mark ħaseb li kont irrabjata? Lara: Il-messaġġ tiegħi ġie interpretat ħażin; kont biss għajjiena.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Mark think you were angry? Lara: My message was misinterpreted; I was just tired.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mark为什么觉得你生气了？Lara：我的消息被误解了；我只是累了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ħaseb li kont irrabjata?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ħaseb li kont irrabjata?
messages.zh: Mark为什么觉得你生气了？
messages.en: Why did Mark think you were angry?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-messaġġ tiegħi ġie interpretat ħażin; kont biss għajjiena.
messages.mt_standard: Il-messaġġ tiegħi ġie interpretat ħażin; kont biss għajjiena.
messages.zh: 我的消息被误解了；我只是累了。
messages.en: My message was misinterpreted; I was just tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份文本上已经写满解释批注，用“已被解读的”记住 interpretat 的状态意义；搭配 ħażin 时可记作“被错误解读的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An explanation or understanding of the meaning of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事物意义的说明，或对其形成的理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spjegazzjoni tat-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa jew il-mod kif wieħed jifhimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对文本、言语、信息或其他事物含义的解释或理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spjegazzjoni ta' xi jfisser test, kliem jew informazzjoni, jew il-mod kif wieħed jifhem it-tifsira tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An interpretation is an explanation of what something means or a particular way of understanding it.

formal.mt: L-istudju jippreżenta interpretazzjoni ġdida tat-test, ibbażata fuq analiżi dettaljata.
formal.en: The study presents a new interpretation of the text, based on a detailed analysis.
formal.zh: 该研究通过细致分析，对这篇文本提出了新的解读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-interpretazzjoni tiegħek ta' din il-poeżija? Toni: Għalija, titkellem dwar it-tama, imma nifhem li jista' jkun hemm interpretazzjoni oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is your interpretation of this poem? Toni: To me, it is about hope, but I understand that there may be another interpretation.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你对这首诗的解读是什么？Toni：我觉得它讲的是希望，不过我理解也可能有另一种解释。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-interpretazzjoni tiegħek ta' din il-poeżija?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-interpretazzjoni tiegħek ta' din il-poeżija?
messages.zh: 你对这首诗的解读是什么？
messages.en: What is your interpretation of this poem?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija, titkellem dwar it-tama, imma nifhem li jista' jkun hemm interpretazzjoni oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija, titkellem dwar it-tama, imma nifhem li jista' jkun hemm interpretazzjoni oħra.
messages.zh: 我觉得它讲的是希望，不过我理解也可能有另一种解释。
messages.en: To me, it is about hope, but I understand that there may be another interpretation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 interpretazzjoni 想成课堂上交出的一份“解读”：动作是解释，交出的理解就是“一种解释”；用“我的解读、另一种解读”反复搭配记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who translates spoken communication from one language into another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将一种语言的口头表达译成另一种语言的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tittraduċi diskors minn lingwa għal oħra biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jifhmu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口译员；在使用不同语言的人之间翻译口头交流内容的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Interpretu huwa persuna li tittraduċi dak li jingħad minn lingwa għal oħra waqt konversazzjoni, laqgħa jew attività oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An interpreter is someone who translates what people say so that speakers of different languages can understand one another.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, interpretu professjonali ttraduċa d-diskors mill-Malti għall-Ingliż.
formal.en: During the meeting, a professional interpreter translated the speech from Maltese into English.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名专业口译员将马耳他语发言译成了英语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se jkollna interpretu fil-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jifhem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will we have an interpreter at the meeting? Mark: Yes, so that everyone can understand.
colloquial.zh: Maja：会议上会有口译员吗？Mark：会，这样大家都能听懂。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 会议上会有口译员吗？
messages.en: Will we have an interpreter at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (会议组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jifhem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jifhem.
messages.zh: 会，这样大家都能听懂。
messages.en: Yes, so that everyone can understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议桌旁有人戴着耳机，把一方的话立即译给另一方；将 interpretu 与这个口译员画面绑定记忆。
