teaching_sense.en_definition: A process of asking someone detailed questions, especially in an official investigation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为查明情况而对某人进行详细提问的过程，尤指正式调查中的审问或讯问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li fih persuna ssirilha sensiela ta' mistoqsijiet dettaljati biex tinkiseb informazzjoni, speċjalment waqt investigazzjoni uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审问；讯问；为获取信息或查明事实而进行的一连串详细提问，常见于正式调查。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Interrogazzjoni hija sensiela ta' mistoqsijiet li jsiru lil persuna biex tinkiseb informazzjoni jew jiġu ċċarati fatti, ħafna drabi f'investigazzjoni uffiċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An interrogation is a process in which someone is asked detailed questions, often as part of an official investigation.

formal.mt: Waqt l-interrogazzjoni, l-uffiċjal talab aktar dettalji dwar dak li ġara.
formal.en: During the interrogation, the officer requested more details about what had happened.
formal.zh: 讯问期间，警员要求进一步说明事情经过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn kont? Ma' min kont? Għaliex wasalt tard? Mark: Bil-mod! Din konversazzjoni jew interrogazzjoni?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where were you? Who were you with? Why did you arrive late? Mark: Slow down! Is this a conversation or an interrogation?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你去哪儿了？跟谁在一起？为什么迟到？Mark：慢点儿！这是聊天还是审问呀？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn kont? Ma' min kont? Għaliex wasalt tard?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn kont? Ma' min kont? Għaliex wasalt tard?
messages.zh: 你去哪儿了？跟谁在一起？为什么迟到？
messages.en: Where were you? Who were you with? Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 慢点儿！这是聊天还是审问呀？
messages.en: Slow down! Is this a conversation or an interrogation?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 interrogazzjoni 想成一串连续追问的问号：谁、何时、何地、为何；正式场合是讯问，朋友间也可用来打趣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause speech or an activity to stop for a time before it is finished.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使尚未结束的说话或活动暂时停止；打断或使中断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaqqaf għal xi ħin lil xi ħadd milli jkompli jitkellem jew iwaqqaf attività qabel ma tkun intemmet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打断某人的讲话，或使正在进行的活动暂时中断。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tinterrompi diskors jew attività, twaqqaf il-kontinwazzjoni tiegħu jew tagħha għal xi ħin qabel it-tmiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something interrupts a speaker or an activity, they cause the speech or activity to stop for a time.

formal.mt: Ħoss qawwi interrompa l-laqgħa, iżda d-diskussjoni kompliet ftit wara.
formal.en: A loud noise interrupted the meeting, but the discussion resumed shortly afterwards.
formal.zh: 一声巨响使会议中断，但讨论不久后便继续了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaft titkellem? Mark: It-telefon interrompa l-konversazzjoni. Fejn konna wasalna?
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop talking? Mark: The phone interrupted the conversation. Where were we?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么不说了？Mark：电话打断了谈话。我们刚才说到哪儿了？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不说了？
messages.en: Why did you stop talking?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-telefon interrompa l-konversazzjoni. Fejn konna wasalna?
messages.mt_standard: It-telefon interrompa l-konversazzjoni. Fejn konna wasalna?
messages.zh: 电话打断了谈话。我们刚才说到哪儿了？
messages.en: The phone interrupted the conversation. Where were we?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象正在说话时电话突然响起，声音把句子截成两段；用这个画面记住 interrompa 的“打断、使中断”。

gloss_zh: 间性的；具有间性性征的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having sex characteristics that do not fit typical definitions of male or female.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述具有不完全符合典型男性或女性分类的身体性征的情况或人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li għandha karatteristiċi sesswali tal-ġisem li ma jaqgħux għalkollox fid-definizzjonijiet tipiċi ta' maskil jew femminil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 间性的；形容身体性征不完全符合典型男性或女性分类的人或情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aġġettiv intersess jintuża għal persuna li l-karatteristiċi sesswali tal-ġisem tagħha ma jaqgħux għalkollox fil-kategoriji tipiċi ta' maskil jew femminil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intersex person has physical sex characteristics that do not fit typical definitions of male or female.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza li kull persuna intersess għandha tiġi ttrattata b'dinjità u rispett.
formal.en: The report emphasizes that every intersex person should be treated with dignity and respect.
formal.zh: 报告强调，应维护每一位间性人士的尊严，并给予尊重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'intersess' f'dan it-test? Mark: Tiddeskrivi persuna b'karatteristiċi sesswali tal-ġisem li ma jaqgħux għalkollox fil-kategoriji tipiċi ta' maskil jew femminil.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'intersex' mean in this text? Mark: It describes a person whose physical sex characteristics do not fit entirely into typical male or female categories.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章里的“间性的”是什么意思？Mark：它形容一个人的身体性征不完全符合典型男性或女性的分类。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“间性的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'intersex' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiddeskrivi persuna b'karatteristiċi sesswali tal-ġisem li ma jaqgħux għalkollox fil-kategoriji tipiċi ta' maskil jew femminil.
messages.mt_standard: Tiddeskrivi persuna b'karatteristiċi sesswali tal-ġisem li ma jaqgħux għalkollox fil-kategoriji tipiċi ta' maskil jew femminil.
messages.zh: 它形容一个人的身体性征不完全符合典型男性或女性的分类。
messages.en: It describes a person whose physical sex characteristics do not fit entirely into typical male or female categories.

cognitive_memory_aid: 整组记忆 persuna intersess＝间性人士，把重点放在“身体性征”四字，帮助准确理解这个形容词所描述的内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where roads or lines cross, or the elements shared by sets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 道路或线条相交的位置，也可指不同集合共有的元素所组成的交集。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jiltaqgħu jew jaqsmu toroq jew linji, jew il-ġabra tal-elementi komuni għal settijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 道路或线条的交叉处、交点；数学中指集合的交集。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-intersezzjoni hija l-post fejn toroq jew linji jaqsmu lil xulxin, jew is-sett tal-elementi li huma komuni għal żewġ settijiet jew aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intersection is a place where roads or lines cross, or a set containing the elements that other sets share.

formal.mt: Is-sewwieqa għandhom inaqqsu l-veloċità meta joqorbu lejn l-intersezzjoni ta' dawn iż-żewġ toroq.
formal.en: Drivers should reduce their speed when approaching the intersection of these two roads.
formal.zh: 驾驶员接近这两条道路的交叉处时应减速。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn għandi ndur? Mark: Fl-intersezzjoni li jmiss, dur lejn il-lemin. Maja: Sewwa, se nnaqqas il-veloċità.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I turn? Mark: Turn right at the next intersection. Maja: All right, I'll slow down.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我该在哪里转弯？马克：在下一个交叉路口右转。玛雅：好，我会减速。

messages.speaker: Maja (驾驶员)
messages.zh: 我该在哪里转弯？
messages.en: Where should I turn?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-intersezzjoni li jmiss, dur lejn il-lemin.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-intersezzjoni li jmiss, dur lejn il-lemin.
messages.zh: 在下一个交叉路口右转。
messages.en: Turn right at the next intersection.

messages.speaker: Maja (驾驶员)
messages.zh: 好，我会减速。
messages.en: All right, I'll slow down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两条相交的道路，把 intersezzjoni 写在交叉点上；再画两个重叠的集合，把同一个词写在共有区域，用图像连起“交叉处”和“交集”。

gloss_zh: 间隔；间奏或穿插片段；幕间休息

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period between events, a short intervening passage, or a break during a performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个事件之间的一段时间，也可指穿插其间的短暂片段，或演出中的幕间休息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' żmien bejn żewġ ġrajjiet, parti qasira li tidħol bejn partijiet oħra, jew waqfa waqt spettaklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两个事件、动作或时间点之间的时间间隔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Intervall huwa perjodu ta' żmien bejn żewġ ġrajjiet, azzjonijiet jew mumenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An interval is a period of time between two events or between one event and its repetition.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿插在较长活动或作品之间的短暂片段，尤其指间奏或短小表演。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Intervall huwa silta mużikali, wirja qasira jew episodju qasir li jidħol bejn partijiet ta' attività jew xogħol itwal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An interlude is a short passage, performance, or episode that occurs between parts of something longer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戏剧、音乐会或其他演出中供观众休息的中场或幕间暂停。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Intervall huwa waqfa bejn il-partijiet ta' spettaklu jew kunċert li matulha l-udjenza tista' tistrieħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intermission is a scheduled break between parts of a performance when the audience can rest.

formal.mt: Wara l-ewwel att se jkun hemm intervall ta' għoxrin minuta, u mbagħad l-udjenza terġa' tidħol fis-sala.
formal.en: There will be a twenty-minute intermission after the first act, after which the audience will return to the auditorium.
formal.zh: 第一幕结束后将有二十分钟的幕间休息，随后观众将返回观众厅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm idum l-intervall? Pawlu: Għoxrin minuta. Trid immorru nieħdu kafè? Sara: Iva, imma ejja nerġgħu lura fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: How long is the intermission? Pawlu: Twenty minutes. Shall we go and get a coffee? Sara: Yes, but let's get back on time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：中场休息多久？保罗：二十分钟。我们去喝杯咖啡好吗？萨拉：好，不过我们要准时回来。

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.zh: 中场休息多久？
messages.en: How long is the intermission?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoxrin minuta. Trid immorru nieħdu kafè?
messages.mt_standard: Għoxrin minuta. Trid immorru nieħdu kafè?
messages.zh: 二十分钟。我们去喝杯咖啡好吗？
messages.en: Twenty minutes. Shall we go and get a coffee?

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja nerġgħu lura fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja nerġgħu lura fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 好，不过我们要准时回来。
messages.en: Yes, but let's get back on time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 intervall 放进“两段之间”的画面：两次铃声之间是时间间隔，两段节目之间可以有间奏，两幕戏之间则是幕间休息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An action taken to influence a situation, solve a problem, or prevent harm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了影响局势、解决问题或防止伤害而采取的介入或干预行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni li tittieħed biex tinfluwenza sitwazzjoni, issolvi problema jew tevita ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为改变某种局面、处理问题或避免不良后果而采取的介入或干预。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Intervent huwa azzjoni li biha persuna jew istituzzjoni tidħol f'sitwazzjoni biex tbiddel dak li jkun qed jiġri, tindirizza problema jew tipprevjeni ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intervention is an action taken by a person or organization to change a situation or prevent a problem from becoming worse.

formal.mt: L-intervent immedjat tal-għalliem waqqaf l-argument qabel ma s-sitwazzjoni marret għall-agħar.
formal.en: The teacher's immediate intervention stopped the argument before the situation became worse.
formal.zh: 老师立即介入，在局面恶化之前制止了争吵。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif waqaf l-argument? Ben: Bl-intervent tal-għalliem. Tkellem magħhom u kkalmaw. Lara: Tajjeb li kien hemm biex jgħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the argument stop? Ben: Through the teacher's intervention. He spoke to them and they calmed down. Lara: It's good that he was there to help.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：争吵是怎么停下来的？本：老师介入了。他跟他们谈了谈，他们就平静下来了。拉拉：幸好他在场帮忙。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 争吵是怎么停下来的？
messages.en: How did the argument stop?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bl-intervent tal-għalliem. Tkellem magħhom u kkalmaw.
messages.mt_standard: Bl-intervent tal-għalliem. Tkellem magħhom u kkalmaw.
messages.zh: 老师介入了。他跟他们谈了谈，他们就平静下来了。
messages.en: Through the teacher's intervention. He spoke to them and they calmed down.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb li kien hemm biex jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb li kien hemm biex jgħin.
messages.zh: 幸好他在场帮忙。
messages.en: It's good that he was there to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象争吵正在升级，老师走近并采取行动，把这个“介入改变局面”的动作标成 intervent，再搭配 immedjat 记住“立即介入”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A conversation in which someone asks questions to obtain information or assess a person's suitability for a job.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过提问获取信息的采访或访谈，也可指评估求职者是否适合某项工作的面试。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konverżazzjoni li fiha persuna tagħmel mistoqsijiet biex tikseb informazzjoni jew tevalwa jekk xi ħadd huwiex adattat għal xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一方通过提问了解另一方的经历、观点或资格的谈话，包括采访、访谈和求职面试。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Intervista hija laqgħa jew konverżazzjoni li fiha persuna tistaqsi lil oħra dwar l-esperjenzi, l-opinjonijiet jew il-kwalifiki tagħha, biex tiġbor informazzjoni jew tqis jekk hijiex adattata għal impjieg.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An interview is a conversation in which one person asks another questions to gather information or assess their suitability for a job.

formal.mt: Fl-intervista ppubblikata fir-rivista, il-kittieba spjegat kif għażlet is-suġġett tar-rumanz il-ġdid tagħha.
formal.en: In the interview published in the magazine, the writer explained how she chose the subject of her new novel.
formal.zh: 在杂志刊登的采访中，这位女作家解释了她如何选定新小说的主题。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi intervista tax-xogħol għada u ninsab ftit nervuża. Mark: Trid nipprattikaw xi mistoqsijiet flimkien? Nina: Iva, hekk inħossni aktar ippreparata.
colloquial.en: Nina: I have a job interview tomorrow and I'm a little nervous. Mark: Shall we practise some questions together? Nina: Yes, that will help me feel better prepared.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我明天有个求职面试，有点紧张。马克：我们一起练习回答几个问题好吗？妮娜：好，这样我会觉得准备得更充分。

messages.speaker: Nina (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi intervista tax-xogħol għada u ninsab ftit nervuża.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi intervista tax-xogħol għada u ninsab ftit nervuża.
messages.zh: 我明天有个求职面试，有点紧张。
messages.en: I have a job interview tomorrow and I'm a little nervous.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们一起练习回答几个问题好吗？
messages.en: Shall we practise some questions together?

messages.speaker: Nina (求职者)
messages.zh: 好，这样我会觉得准备得更充分。
messages.en: Yes, that will help me feel better prepared.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一人问、一人答”记住 intervista：记者提问时是采访，招聘人员提问时是面试；加上 tax-xogħol，就明确是求职面试。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heading in a tariff schedule under which a particular category of goods is classified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 税则中用于归类某一类货物的品目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Intestatura fi skeda ta' tariffi li taħtha tiġi kklassifikata kategorija partikolari ta' oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 税则中用于对货物进行分类的品目。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Intestatura fl-iskeda tat-tariffi li tintuża biex l-oġġetti jiġu mqiegħda fil-kategorija xierqa tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tariff heading is an entry in a tariff schedule that identifies a category of goods.

formal.mt: Qabel timla d-dokument, ivverifika li l-oġġetti huma kklassifikati taħt l-intestatura tariffarja korretta.
formal.en: Before completing the document, verify that the goods are classified under the correct tariff heading.
formal.zh: 填写文件前，请核实货物是否归入了正确的税则品目。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema intestatura tariffarja għandi nuża għal dawn l-oġġetti? Lara: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-deskrizzjoni tagħhom qabel nagħżlu l-intestatura.
colloquial.en: Mark: Which tariff heading should I use for these goods? Lara: Let's check their description before choosing the heading.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些货物应该用哪个税则品目？拉拉：我们先核对货物描述，再选择品目。

messages.speaker: Mark (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema intestatura tariffarja għandi nuża għal dawn l-oġġetti?
messages.mt_standard: Liema intestatura tariffarja għandi nuża għal dawn l-oġġetti?
messages.zh: 这些货物应该用哪个税则品目？
messages.en: Which tariff heading should I use for these goods?

messages.speaker: Lara (报关员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-deskrizzjoni tagħhom qabel nagħżlu l-intestatura.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-deskrizzjoni tagħhom qabel nagħżlu l-intestatura.
messages.zh: 我们先核对货物描述，再选择品目。
messages.en: Let's check their description before choosing the heading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报关时给货物找分类格子：整个短语就是税则中的品目，可连着“货物归类”一起记。

gloss_zh: 输入；输入的数据或信息

teaching_sense.en_definition: Data or information supplied to a system for processing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供给系统以供处理的数据或信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Data jew tagħrif li jiddaħħlu f'sistema biex jiġu pproċessati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 输入，即送入系统以供处理的数据或信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Data jew tagħrif li jiġu pprovduti lil sistema sabiex din tkun tista' tipproċessahom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Input is data or information that you supply to a system so that it can process it.

formal.mt: Is-sistema tivverifika l-inteġjament qabel ma tipproċessa d-data u toħloq ir-rapport.
formal.en: The system checks the input before processing the data and creating the report.
formal.zh: 系统在处理数据并生成报告之前，会先检查输入。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex is-sistema qed turi żball? Pawlu: Hemm żball fl-inteġjament; daħħalt ittra minflok numru.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is the system showing an error? Pawlu: There is an error in the input; I entered a letter instead of a number.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：系统为什么报错？保罗：输入有误；我把本该输入的数字输成了字母。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 系统为什么报错？
messages.en: Why is the system showing an error?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm żball fl-inteġjament; daħħalt ittra minflok numru.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm żball fl-inteġjament; daħħalt ittra minflok numru.
messages.zh: 输入有误；我把本该输入的数字输成了字母。
messages.en: There is an error in the input; I entered a letter instead of a number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inteġjament 放在“键盘→系统”的箭头旁记忆：沿箭头送进去的信息就是输入。

gloss_zh: 整个的；男式三件套西装

teaching_sense.en_definition: Whole or complete; when referring to a man's suit, consisting of a jacket, waistcoat, and trousers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示整个、完整的；用于男式西装时，表示由上衣、背心和长裤组成的三件套。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifisser sħiħ jew komplut; meta jintuża għal libsa ta' raġel, jindika libsa bi ġlekk, sidrija u qalziet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 整个的，完整的，没有缺少任何部分的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sħiħ jew komplut, mingħajr ma jkun jonqos xi parti minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is entire, it includes all of its parts or covers the whole period being described.

sense_translations.en_definition: three-piece (when used of a man's suit)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指男式西装为三件套，即包括上衣、背心和长裤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta jintuża għal libsa ta' raġel, ifisser li l-libsa tinkludi ġlekk, sidrija u qalziet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a man's suit is described as three-piece, it consists of a jacket, a waistcoat, and trousers.

formal.mt: Il-klijent ordna intier għat-tieġ, magħmul minn ġlekk, sidrija u qalziet tal-istess drapp.
formal.en: The client ordered a three-piece suit for the wedding, consisting of a jacket, waistcoat, and trousers in the same fabric.
formal.zh: 客户订了一套婚礼用的三件套西装，包括用同一种布料制作的上衣、背心和长裤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Domt jum intier tistudja? Pawlu: Iva, imma issa lestejt il-kapitlu kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you spend an entire day studying? Pawlu: Yes, but now I've finished the whole chapter.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你学了整整一天吗？保罗：是啊，不过现在我把整章都学完了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你学了整整一天吗？
messages.en: Did you spend an entire day studying?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma issa lestejt il-kapitlu kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma issa lestejt il-kapitlu kollu.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过现在我把整章都学完了。
messages.en: Yes, but now I've finished the whole chapter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分开记：日历涂满一天是“整天”，衣架挂着上衣、背心和长裤是“男式三件套”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this entry labelled as a verb, the term refers to making someone afraid through threats or pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条按所给动词标签，表示通过威胁或施压使某人害怕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata mmarkata bħala verb, it-terminu jfisser li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jibża' permezz ta' theddid jew pressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恐吓、威吓，即以威胁或压力使他人产生恐惧；本条保留所给的动词标签。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata mmarkata bħala verb, il-kelma tindika li tbeżża' lil xi ħadd jew tagħmel pressjoni fuqu permezz ta' theddid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this verb-labelled entry, intimidation refers to making someone feel afraid through threats or pressure.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'Intimidation' tirreferi għall-azzjoni li ġġiegħel lil persuna tibża' permezz ta' theddid jew pressjoni.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'Intimidation' refers to the action of making a person afraid through threats or pressure.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，Intimidation 指通过威胁或施压使人害怕的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser 'Intimidation' hawn? Lara: Tfisser li xi ħadd ibeżża' lil persuna oħra, pereżempju billi jheddidha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Intimidation' mean here? Lara: It means that someone frightens another person, for example by threatening them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 Intimidation 是什么意思？拉拉：就是有人让另一个人害怕，例如对那个人发出威胁。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 Intimidation 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Intimidation' mean here?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li xi ħadd ibeżża' lil persuna oħra, pereżempju billi jheddidha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li xi ħadd ibeżża' lil persuna oħra, pereżempju billi jheddidha.
messages.zh: 就是有人让另一个人害怕，例如对那个人发出威胁。
messages.en: It means that someone frightens another person, for example by threatening them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人拍桌子威胁，令对方害怕退缩，把这个场景与“恐吓”绑定；词性标签按本条给定内容保留。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving a very close personal relationship, or concerning private matters that a person shares with few people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人与人之间关系非常亲密，或形容只向少数人透露的私人事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi relazzjoni personali mill-qrib ħafna, jew affarijiet privati li persuna taqsam ma' ftit nies biss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲密的，关系十分密切的；也指涉及个人隐私、通常不向外人透露的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' relazzjoni personali mill-qrib ħafna jew ma' aspetti privati tal-ħajja ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intimate relationship is very close and personal, while intimate details concern someone's private life.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi l-karriera tal-awtur mingħajr ma jiżvela dettalji intimi tal-ħajja privata tiegħu.
formal.en: The article describes the author's career without revealing intimate details of his private life.
formal.zh: 这篇文章介绍了作者的职业生涯，没有披露他私人生活中的私密细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tafda lil Pawlu b'affarijiet personali? Lara: Iva, hu ħabib intimu tiegħi u nista' nitkellem miegħu bil-kumdità.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you trust Pawlu with personal matters? Lara: Yes, he's a close personal friend, and I feel comfortable talking to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你放心把私事告诉保罗吗？拉拉：放心，他是我的亲密朋友，跟他说话我很自在。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你放心把私事告诉保罗吗？
messages.en: Do you trust Pawlu with personal matters?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu ħabib intimu tiegħi u nista' nitkellem miegħu bil-kumdità.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu ħabib intimu tiegħi u nista' nitkellem miegħu bil-kumdità.
messages.zh: 放心，他是我的亲密朋友，跟他说话我很自在。
messages.en: Yes, he's a close personal friend, and I feel comfortable talking to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“亲密朋友能听私密心事”连成一句记忆：修饰朋友强调关系近，修饰细节强调内容私密。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having detailed knowledge or expertise in a particular subject or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个学科或活动领域拥有丰富知识或专门技能的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għarfien dettaljat jew ħila kbira f'qasam jew attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有专门知识或娴熟技能的；内行的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu livell għoli ta' għarfien jew ħila f'qasam partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is expert has a high level of knowledge or skill in a particular field.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事物或某领域相当熟悉、了解深入的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaf sew suġġett jew qasam u għandu għarfien wiesa' dwaru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is well-versed in something, they know a great deal about that subject.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab parir mingħand konsulent intiż fil-liġi.
formal.en: The committee sought advice from a consultant well-versed in law.
formal.zh: 委员会向一位精通法律的顾问征求了意见。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar dan il-ktieb tal-mużika? Pawlu: Staqsi lil Ġanni; hu intiż ħafna fil-mużika.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who can I ask about this music book? Pawlu: Ask Ġanni; he knows a lot about music.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这本音乐书里的问题，我可以问谁？Pawlu：问 Ġanni 吧，他很懂音乐。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar dan il-ktieb tal-mużika?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar dan il-ktieb tal-mużika?
messages.zh: 这本音乐书里的问题，我可以问谁？
messages.en: Who can I ask about this music book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Ġanni; hu intiż ħafna fil-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Ġanni; hu intiż ħafna fil-mużika.
messages.zh: 问 Ġanni 吧，他很懂音乐。
messages.en: Ask Ġanni; he knows a lot about music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 intiż 与“内行”一起记：想象一位熟悉专业知识的人，再用 intiż fil-liġi 练习表达“精通法律的”。

gloss_zh: 吟诵；以一定音调唱出；调音

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say or sing words with a sustained tone, or to adjust a musical instrument to the correct pitch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用持续而有一定音调的声音念出或唱出词句，或将乐器调整到正确音高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid jew ikanta kliem b'ton sostnut, jew jaġġusta strument mużikali biex jagħti n-noti fl-għoli korrett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以持续、庄重或近似吟唱的音调念出或唱出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħid jew ikanta kliem b'ton sostnut, spiss b'mod solenni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone intones words, they say or sing them in a sustained, often solemn tone.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给乐器调音，使其发出的音达到正确音高。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaġġusta strument mużikali sabiex in-noti tiegħu jkunu fl-għoli korrett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tune a musical instrument, you adjust it so that it produces notes at the correct pitch.

formal.mt: Fil-bidu taċ-ċerimonja, il-qassis intona talba b'leħen solenni.
formal.en: At the beginning of the ceremony, the priest intoned a prayer in a solemn voice.
formal.zh: 仪式开始时，神父以庄重的声音吟诵了一段祷文。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min intona l-pjanu qabel il-kunċert? Pawlu: Ġanni intona l-pjanu dalgħodu; issa jinstema' tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who tuned the piano before the concert? Pawlu: Ġanni tuned it this morning; it sounds very good now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：音乐会前是谁给钢琴调的音？Pawlu：Ġanni 今天早上调的，现在听起来很好。

messages.speaker: Marija (钢琴演奏者)
messages.zh: 音乐会前是谁给钢琴调的音？
messages.en: Who tuned the piano before the concert?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (音乐会工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġanni intona l-pjanu dalgħodu; issa jinstema' tajjeb ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ġanni intona l-pjanu dalgħodu; issa jinstema' tajjeb ħafna.
messages.zh: Ġanni 今天早上调的，现在听起来很好。
messages.en: Ġanni tuned it this morning; it sounds very good now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“声音的音调”串联两个义项：对祷文是吟诵，对钢琴是调音；分别记 intona talba 和 intona l-pjanu。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A difficulty or obstruction that interrupts progress or makes an activity harder to complete.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使进展中断或使某项活动更难完成的困难、障碍或意外问题。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diffikultà jew ostaklu li jwaqqaf il-progress jew jagħmel attività aktar diffiċli biex titlesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妨碍行动或进展的障碍、阻力，或过程中突然出现的难题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ostaklu, xkiel jew problema li tfixkel il-progress ta' xogħol, pjan jew attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An obstacle, hindrance, or snag is something that makes progress difficult or temporarily prevents it.

formal.mt: Intopp tekniku fil-proċess tal-istampar wassal għal dewmien fil-pubblikazzjoni tar-rapport.
formal.en: A technical snag in the printing process delayed the publication of the report.
formal.zh: 印刷过程中出现的一个技术问题导致报告推迟出版。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għadek ma bgħattx il-formola? Pawlu: Kien hemm intopp fis-sit, imma issa kollox qed jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why haven't you sent the form yet? Pawlu: There was a snag with the website, but everything is working now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你怎么还没提交表格？Pawlu：网站出了点问题，不过现在一切都正常了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么还没提交表格？
messages.en: Why haven't you sent the form yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm intopp fis-sit, imma issa kollox qed jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm intopp fis-sit, imma issa kollox qed jaħdem.
messages.zh: 网站出了点问题，不过现在一切都正常了。
messages.en: There was a snag with the website, but everything is working now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 intopp 想成前进路上突然出现的一块绊脚石：一个障碍让事情卡住，克服它就能继续前进。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Difficulties or problems that delay progress or interfere with the success of a plan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使进展延迟或妨碍计划顺利实现的多项困难、问题或挫折。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diffikultajiet jew problemi li jdewmu l-progress jew ifixklu s-suċċess ta' pjan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使原有进展受阻、推迟或倒退的挫折与不利情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Problemi jew ġrajjiet sfavorevoli li jfixklu l-progress jew idewmu t-twettiq ta' pjan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Setbacks are problems or unfavorable events that delay progress or make success harder to achieve.

formal.mt: Minkejja diversi intoppi fil-provvista tal-materjal, it-tim temm ix-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: Despite several setbacks in the supply of materials, the team completed the work on time.
formal.zh: 尽管材料供应接连受阻，团队仍按时完成了工作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sejjer il-proġett? Pawlu: Kellna xi intoppi, imma issa qed nerġgħu nimxu 'l quddiem.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is the project going? Pawlu: We've had a few setbacks, but we're making progress again now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：项目进展怎么样？Pawlu：我们遇到了一些挫折，不过现在又开始有进展了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 项目进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is the project going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellna xi intoppi, imma issa qed nerġgħu nimxu 'l quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Kellna xi intoppi, imma issa qed nerġgħu nimxu 'l quddiem.
messages.zh: 我们遇到了一些挫折，不过现在又开始有进展了。
messages.en: We've had a few setbacks, but we're making progress again now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 intoppi 配成“几次挫折”的画面：计划推进时接连卡了几次，再用 xi intoppi 记住“一些挫折”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Difficult to deal with or resolve, or stubborn and unwilling to change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容问题难以处理或解决，也形容人固执、不愿改变立场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi problema li mhix faċli biex tiġi indirizzata jew solvuta, jew persuna ta' ras iebsa li ma tkunx lesta tbiddel il-fehma tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难以应对或解决的；固执己见、不愿改变的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tkun diffiċli biex tiġi ttrattata jew solvuta, jew lil xi ħadd li jibqa' jinsisti fuq tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a problem is difficult to address, it resists attempts to solve it; a stubborn person similarly resists changing their views.

collocations.en: a problem that is difficult to solve

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tilwima diffiċli biex tissolva, għax iż-żewġ naħat għadhom jirrifjutaw kull kompromess.
formal.en: The report describes a dispute that is difficult to resolve because both sides still refuse any compromise.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一场难以解决的争端，因为双方仍然拒绝任何妥协。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadkom ma qbiltux? Mark: Għax it-tnejn ta' ras iebsa u ħadd ma jrid iċedi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why haven't you reached an agreement yet? Mark: Because they're both stubborn and neither wants to give way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们怎么还没达成一致？马克：因为他们两个都很固执，谁也不肯让步。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们怎么还没达成一致？
messages.en: Why haven't you reached an agreement yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax it-tnejn ta' ras iebsa u ħadd ma jrid iċedi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax it-tnejn ta' ras iebsa u ħadd ma jrid iċedi.
messages.zh: 因为他们两个都很固执，谁也不肯让步。
messages.en: Because they're both stubborn and neither wants to give way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个意思并排记：问题像打死的结，难以解决；人像不肯转弯的车，固执不改。依本条词性要求，练习时用“难处理的、固执的”理解。

gloss_zh: 锁定；难以退出或转换的受限状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: A situation in which someone is tied to an existing choice because leaving or switching is difficult or costly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于退出或转换存在困难、成本或其他障碍，使人被限制在原有选择中的锁定状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha persuna tibqa' marbuta ma' għażla eżistenti għax ikun diffiċli jew għali li titlaq jew taqleb għal għażla oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锁定状态，即因退出或转换的障碍而难以摆脱既有安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha persuna jew organizzazzjoni ssibha diffiċli titlaq minn arranġament jew taqleb għal ieħor minħabba spejjeż, kundizzjonijiet jew ostakli oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Lock-in occurs when an existing arrangement makes leaving or choosing an alternative difficult or expensive.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jiġi ffirmat il-kuntratt, għandhom jiġu evalwati l-ispejjeż tal-ħruġ sabiex jitnaqqas ir-riskju ta' intrappolament.
formal.en: Before the contract is signed, exit costs should be assessed to reduce the risk of lock-in.
formal.zh: 签订合同前，应评估退出成本，以降低被锁定的风险。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu nbiddlu s-servizz meta rridu? Pawlu: Le, hemm ħlas kbir jekk nitilqu kmieni; dan joħloq intrappolament.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we switch services whenever we want? Pawlu: No, there's a large fee if we leave early; that creates lock-in.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们想换服务就能换吗？保罗：不能，提前退出要付一大笔钱；这就造成了锁定。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们想换服务就能换吗？
messages.en: Can we switch services whenever we want?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hemm ħlas kbir jekk nitilqu kmieni; dan joħloq intrappolament.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hemm ħlas kbir jekk nitilqu kmieni; dan joħloq intrappolament.
messages.zh: 不能，提前退出要付一大笔钱；这就造成了锁定。
messages.en: No, there's a large fee if we leave early; that creates lock-in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象已经选好一扇门，离开却要付很高的费用：门并未真正上锁，人却难以退出。这幅画面帮助记住“锁定状态”。

gloss_zh: 客户锁定；客户难以转向其他供应商的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: A situation in which customers find it difficult or costly to stop using one supplier and move to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 客户因转换成本、合同条件或其他障碍，难以停止使用现有供应商并转向其他供应商的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha l-klijenti jsibuha diffiċli jew għalja biex jieqfu jużaw fornitur u jaqilbu għal fornitur ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 客户锁定，指客户受到转换障碍的限制，难以离开现有供应商。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha l-klijentela tibqa' marbuta ma' fornitur minħabba spejjeż biex taqleb, kundizzjonijiet tal-kuntratt jew ostakli oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customer lock-in exists when barriers to switching make customers dependent on their current supplier.

formal.mt: Il-kundizzjonijiet li jagħmlu l-bidla tal-fornitur għalja jistgħu joħolqu intrappolament tal-klijentela u jillimitaw l-għażla tal-klijenti.
formal.en: Terms that make switching suppliers expensive can create customer lock-in and limit customers' choices.
formal.zh: 使更换供应商变得昂贵的条款，可能造成客户锁定，并限制客户的选择。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma taqilbux għal fornitur irħas? David: Għax biex nitilqu rridu nħallsu ħafna. Dan hu eżempju ta' intrappolament tal-klijentela.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why don't you switch to a cheaper supplier? David: Because we'd have to pay a lot to leave. This is an example of customer lock-in.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你们为什么不换一家更便宜的供应商？戴维：因为退出要付很多钱。这就是客户锁定的一个例子。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma taqilbux għal fornitur irħas?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma taqilbux għal fornitur irħas?
messages.zh: 你们为什么不换一家更便宜的供应商？
messages.en: Why don't you switch to a cheaper supplier?

messages.speaker: David (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax biex nitilqu rridu nħallsu ħafna. Dan hu eżempju ta' intrappolament tal-klijentela.
messages.mt_standard: Għax biex nitilqu rridu nħallsu ħafna. Dan hu eżempju ta' intrappolament tal-klijentela.
messages.zh: 因为退出要付很多钱。这就是客户锁定的一个例子。
messages.en: Because we'd have to pay a lot to leave. This is an example of customer lock-in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“客户想换店，转换有门槛”的场景：客户留下可能是因为离开太难。把整个词组与“客户锁定”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 企业；创业项目或有风险的事业

teaching_sense.en_definition: A business organization, or a business project undertaken with effort and some risk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事商业活动的企业，也可指需要投入努力并承担一定风险的商业项目或事业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni li twettaq attività kummerċjali, jew proġett kummerċjali li jinbeda bi sforz u b'ċertu riskju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业，即从事商业活动、提供商品或服务的经营组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni kummerċjali li tipproduċi jew tbigħ prodotti, jew li tipprovdi servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An enterprise is a business organization that produces goods, sells products, or provides services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要投入资源并承担一定风险的商业项目或创业事业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proġett kummerċjali li persuna jew grupp jibda billi jinvesti ħin, flus jew riżorsi oħra, mingħajr ċertezza li jirnexxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A venture is a business project that people undertake despite uncertainty about whether it will succeed.

collocations.en: a new venture involving some risk
collocations.zh: 具有一定风险的新事业

formal.mt: L-intrapriża timpjega għoxrin persuna u qed tikkunsidra intrapriża ġdida fil-qasam tas-servizzi diġitali, minkejja r-riskju finanzjarju.
formal.en: The enterprise employs twenty people and is considering a new venture in digital services despite the financial risk.
formal.zh: 这家企业雇有二十名员工，尽管存在财务风险，仍在考虑开展一项数字服务领域的新事业。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed taħseb li tiftaħ ħanut? Ġużeppi: Iva, irrid nibda intrapriża żgħira, imma l-ewwel irrid nara kemm se tiswa. Sara: Hija intrapriża eċċitanti, iżda trid tippjana tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you thinking of opening a shop? Ġużeppi: Yes, I want to start a small enterprise, but first I need to see how much it will cost. Sara: It's an exciting venture, but you need to plan carefully.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在考虑开店吗？朱塞佩：是的，我想创办一家小企业，但得先看看要花多少钱。萨拉：这项事业很令人期待，不过你需要好好规划。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在考虑开店吗？
messages.en: Are you thinking of opening a shop?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (创业者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid nibda intrapriża żgħira, imma l-ewwel irrid nara kemm se tiswa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid nibda intrapriża żgħira, imma l-ewwel irrid nara kemm se tiswa.
messages.zh: 是的，我想创办一家小企业，但得先看看要花多少钱。
messages.en: Yes, I want to start a small enterprise, but first I need to see how much it will cost.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija intrapriża eċċitanti, iżda trid tippjana tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Hija intrapriża eċċitanti, iżda trid tippjana tajjeb.
messages.zh: 这项事业很令人期待，不过你需要好好规划。
messages.en: It's an exciting venture, but you need to plan carefully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一家新店记两个义项：看经营组织时是“企业”，看投入资金、面对成败的开店计划时是“创业事业”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An enterprise owned or controlled by the state that carries out commercial trading activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由国家拥有或控制、从事商品买卖等贸易活动的企业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Intrapriża li tkun proprjetà tal-istat jew taħt il-kontroll tiegħu u li twettaq attivitajiet ta' xiri u bejgħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由国家拥有或控制并从事贸易活动的企业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Intrapriżi li jkunu proprjetà tal-istat jew taħt il-kontroll tiegħu u li jwettqu attivitajiet kummerċjali ta' xiri u bejgħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: State-trading enterprises are businesses owned or controlled by the state that engage in commercial trade.

collocations.en: the management of a state-trading enterprise
the accounts of a state-trading enterprise

formal.mt: Ir-rapport annwali jiddeskrivi l-attivitajiet ta' xiri u bejgħ tal-intrapriża kummerċjali statali.
formal.en: The annual report describes the buying and selling activities of the state-trading enterprise.
formal.zh: 年度报告介绍了这家国营贸易企业的采购和销售活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din kumpanija privata? Pawlu: Le, hija intrapriża kummerċjali statali li tixtri u tbigħ il-qamħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a private company? Pawlu: No, it is a state-trading enterprise that buys and sells wheat.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这是一家私营公司吗？Pawlu：不是，它是一家买卖小麦的国营贸易企业。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这是一家私营公司吗？
messages.en: Is this a private company?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija intrapriża kummerċjali statali li tixtri u tbigħ il-qamħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija intrapriża kummerċjali statali li tixtri u tbigħ il-qamħ.
messages.zh: 不是，它是一家买卖小麦的国营贸易企业。
messages.en: No, it is a state-trading enterprise that buys and sells wheat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成一块企业招牌：intrapriża 表示企业，kummerċjali 提示贸易经营，statali 提示国家所有或控制，合起来记作“国营贸易企业”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entrance to a building, or the lobby immediately inside it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑物的入口，或进入建筑物后首先到达的门厅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post minn fejn tidħol f'bini, jew l-ispazju ta' ġewwa li ssib hekk kif tidħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人进入建筑物的入口或进门处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-post minn fejn persuna tidħol f'bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The entrance is the place through which people go into a building.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物入口内供人等候或通往其他房间的门厅、大堂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spazju ġewwa bini, qrib il-bieb ta' barra, fejn in-nies jistgħu jistennew jew jgħaddu lejn kmamar oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lobby is an area just inside a building where people can wait or reach other rooms.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi għandhom jidħlu mill-intrata prinċipali u jistennew fl-intrata sakemm jasal membru tal-persunal.
formal.en: Visitors should enter through the main entrance and wait in the lobby until a staff member arrives.
formal.zh: 访客应从主入口进入，并在门厅等候工作人员到来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Mark: Fl-intrata tal-lukanda, ħdejn is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we meet? Mark: In the hotel lobby, beside the sofa.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们在哪里碰面？Mark：在酒店大堂，沙发旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在酒店大堂，沙发旁边。
messages.en: In the hotel lobby, beside the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“进门前后”记住两个义项：跨进建筑物的那一处是入口，跨进去后可以等人的空间是门厅；两幅画面都配上 intrata。

gloss_zh: 身体松垮地坐着或站着；瘫坐

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sit or stand with the body relaxed and drooping instead of held upright.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坐着或站着时身体松垮、肩背下垂，没有保持挺直的姿势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed joqgħod bilqiegħda jew bilwieqfa b'ġismu mitluq u b'dahru jew spallejh imniżżlin, minflok iżomm ruħu dritt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐着或站着时身体松垮、弓背垂肩；瘫坐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wieħed joqgħod b'ġismu mitluq, b'dahru mgħawweġ jew bi spallejh imniżżlin, waqt li jkun bilqiegħda jew bilwieqfa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone slouches, they sit or stand with their shoulders drooping and their body held loosely.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-raġel intreħa fis-siġġu, b'dahru mgħawweġ u bi spallejh imniżżlin.
formal.en: During the meeting, the man slouched in his chair, with his back curved and his shoulders drooping.
formal.zh: 开会时，那名男子弓着背、垂着肩，松垮地坐在椅子上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Ben intreħa hekk fuq is-sufan? Nina: Għadu kif wasal mix-xogħol u jinsab għajjien ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is Ben slouching like that on the sofa? Nina: He has just got home from work and is very tired.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Ben 怎么那样瘫坐在沙发上？Nina：他刚下班到家，累得很。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Ben intreħa hekk fuq is-sufan?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Ben intreħa hekk fuq is-sufan?
messages.zh: Ben 怎么那样瘫坐在沙发上？
messages.en: Why is Ben slouching like that on the sofa?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kif wasal mix-xogħol u jinsab għajjien ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kif wasal mix-xogħol u jinsab għajjien ħafna.
messages.zh: 他刚下班到家，累得很。
messages.en: He has just got home from work and is very tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象下班后肩膀垂下、背部弯曲、整个人松进沙发的姿势，把这幅画面与 intreħa 连在一起；重点记身体姿态松垮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Because of the essential nature or qualities of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于某事物自身的本质或固有特性，而非外部因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Minħabba n-natura jew il-kwalitajiet essenzjali ta' xi ħaġa fiha nfisha, mhux minħabba fatturi esterni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本质上；就事物自身固有的性质而言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod li jirriżulta min-natura essenzjali ta' xi ħaġa fiha nfisha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is intrinsically valuable or interesting, it has that quality because of its own nature.

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju jqis it-tagħlim bħala attività intrinsikament siewja, anki meta ma jwassalx għal kwalifika.
formal.en: This study regards learning as an intrinsically worthwhile activity, even when it does not lead to a qualification.
formal.zh: 本研究认为，学习是一种本身就有价值的活动，即使它不能带来学历或资格证书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tibqa' ssolvi dawn il-problemi jekk m'hemmx premju? Luka: Għax għalija huma intrinsikament interessanti; nieħu gost naħseb dwarhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you keep solving these problems if there is no prize? Luka: Because I find them intrinsically interesting; I enjoy thinking about them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：既然没有奖品，你为什么还一直解这些题？卢卡：因为对我来说，这些题本身就很有趣；我喜欢思考它们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tibqa' ssolvi dawn il-problemi jekk m'hemmx premju?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tibqa' ssolvi dawn il-problemi jekk m'hemmx premju?
messages.zh: 既然没有奖品，你为什么还一直解这些题？
messages.en: Why do you keep solving these problems if there is no prize?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għalija huma intrinsikament interessanti; nieħu gost naħseb dwarhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għalija huma intrinsikament interessanti; nieħu gost naħseb dwarhom.
messages.zh: 因为对我来说，这些题本身就很有趣；我喜欢思考它们。
messages.en: Because I find them intrinsically interesting; I enjoy thinking about them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成回答“从什么层面来说”的副词：intrinsikament interessanti 就是“本身就有趣”，不需要奖品来增加吸引力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Belonging to the essential nature of something rather than depending on external factors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于事物自身本质的，不依赖外部条件而存在的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel parti min-natura essenzjali ta' xi ħaġa fiha nfisha u ma jiddependix minn fatturi esterni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内在的；由事物本身的性质所决定的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa marbut man-natura ta' xi ħaġa fiha nfisha, aktar milli maċ-ċirkostanzi ta' madwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intrinsic quality belongs to something itself and does not depend on outside circumstances.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-valur intrinsiku tal-edukazzjoni, lil hinn mill-benefiċċji ekonomiċi tagħha.
formal.en: The report emphasizes the intrinsic value of education beyond its economic benefits.
formal.zh: 报告强调，教育除了经济效益之外，还具有内在价值。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ktieb għandu valur biss għax hu rari? Mark: Le, għandu wkoll valur intrinsiku: l-ideat fih huma profondi u oriġinali.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this book valuable only because it is rare? Mark: No, it also has intrinsic value: its ideas are profound and original.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这本书只是因为稀有才有价值吗？马克：不是，它也有内在价值：书里的思想深刻而且有独创性。

messages.speaker: Sara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb għandu valur biss għax hu rari?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb għandu valur biss għax hu rari?
messages.zh: 这本书只是因为稀有才有价值吗？
messages.en: Is this book valuable only because it is rare?

messages.speaker: Mark (书店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandu wkoll valur intrinsiku: l-ideat fih huma profondi u oriġinali.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandu wkoll valur intrinsiku: l-ideat fih huma profondi u oriġinali.
messages.zh: 不是，它也有内在价值：书里的思想深刻而且有独创性。
messages.en: No, it also has intrinsic value: its ideas are profound and original.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“书的思想本身有价值”记住 valur intrinsiku；intrinsiku 修饰名词，表达事物自身固有的性质。

gloss_zh: 烘焙用杏仁粉；杏仁粉替代品

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ground almonds used in baking, or a substitute used in their place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于烘焙的磨碎杏仁，也可指代替这种杏仁粉使用的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lewż mitħun li jintuża fil-ħami, jew taħlita li tintuża minfloku bħala sostitut.

sense_translations.en_definition: ground almonds for use in baking (also refers to ground almond substitute)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供烘焙使用的杏仁粉；也指用于替代杏仁粉的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lewż mitħun għall-użu fil-ħami; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal sostitut tal-lewż mitħun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Intrita is ground almonds used in baking, or a substitute used for the same purpose.

collocations.en: one hundred grams of ground almonds or almond substitute
collocations.zh: 一百克杏仁粉或其替代品

collocations.en: add the ground almonds or almond substitute to the mixture
collocations.zh: 把杏仁粉或其替代品加入混合物

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob mitt gramma intrita; iċċekkja t-tikketta tal-prodott biex tara jekk fihx lewż mitħun jew sostitut.
formal.en: The recipe calls for one hundred grams of intrita; check the product label to see whether it contains ground almonds or a substitute.
formal.zh: 食谱要求使用一百克 intrita；请查看产品标签，确认其中是杏仁粉还是替代品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ir-riċetta tgħid li rridu l-intrita. Din lewż mitħun? Pawlu: Iċċekkja t-tikketta, għax intrita tista' tfisser ukoll sostitut tal-lewż mitħun.
colloquial.en: Nina: The recipe says we need intrita. Is this ground almonds? Pawlu: Check the label, because intrita can also mean a ground almond substitute.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：食谱说需要 intrita。这是杏仁粉吗？保罗：看看标签，因为 intrita 也可以指杏仁粉替代品。

messages.speaker: Nina (烘焙学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riċetta tgħid li rridu l-intrita. Din lewż mitħun?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riċetta tgħid li rridu l-intrita. Din lewż mitħun?
messages.zh: 食谱说需要 intrita。这是杏仁粉吗？
messages.en: The recipe says we need intrita. Is this ground almonds?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烘焙老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċekkja t-tikketta, għax intrita tista' tfisser ukoll sostitut tal-lewż mitħun.
messages.mt_standard: Iċċekkja t-tikketta, għax intrita tista' tfisser ukoll sostitut tal-lewż mitħun.
messages.zh: 看看标签，因为 intrita 也可以指杏仁粉替代品。
messages.en: Check the label, because intrita can also mean a ground almond substitute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烘焙时称出一百克粉状配料：intrita 可指杏仁粉，也可指替代品；把“看标签确认原料”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 错综复杂的细节；复杂之处

teaching_sense.en_definition: The complicated details or closely connected parts of something that require careful attention to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物中彼此关联、需要仔细研究才能理解的复杂细节或微妙之处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dettalji kumplessi jew il-partijiet marbutin ma' xulxin ta' xi ħaġa li jeħtieġu attenzjoni biex wieħed jifhimhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事物中错综复杂、相互关联而不易理解的细节或微妙之处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dettalji kumplessi u r-rabtiet bejn il-partijiet ta' xi ħaġa li jagħmluha diffiċli biex tinftiehem malajr.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The intricacies of something are its complicated details and connections, which require care to understand.

collocations.zh: 系统中错综复杂的细节

collocations.en: to understand the intricacies of the process
collocations.zh: 理解流程中的复杂之处

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega l-intriċċi tal-proċess u juri kif kull stadju jiddependi fuq dak ta' qablu.
formal.en: The manual explains the intricacies of the process and shows how each stage depends on the previous one.
formal.zh: 手册解释了流程中的复杂细节，并说明每个阶段如何依赖前一个阶段。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fhimt kif taħdem din il-logħba? Pawlu: Ir-regoli bażiċi iva, imma għadni qed nitgħallem l-intriċċi tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you understood how this game works? Pawlu: I understand the basic rules, but I am still learning its intricacies.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你弄懂这个游戏怎么玩了吗？Pawlu：基本规则懂了，不过其中的复杂细节我还在学。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弄懂这个游戏怎么玩了吗？
messages.en: Have you understood how this game works?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-regoli bażiċi iva, imma għadni qed nitgħallem l-intriċċi tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-regoli bażiċi iva, imma għadni qed nitgħallem l-intriċċi tagħha.
messages.zh: 基本规则懂了，不过其中的复杂细节我还在学。
messages.en: I understand the basic rules, but I am still learning its intricacies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 intriċċi 想成一张放大的流程图：大方向容易看懂，细小箭头却彼此交织；这些需要逐一理清的复杂细节就是这个词的重点。

gloss_zh: 被引入的；被推出的；经介绍的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Brought into use or made known in a particular setting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被引入某个环境、投入使用或介绍给他人认识的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ddaħħal f'xi qasam jew ambjent, beda jintuża, jew ġie ppreżentat lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被引入、被介绍或被推出使用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie mdaħħal għall-użu jew ippreżentat sabiex isir magħruf f'ambjent partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something introduced has been brought into use or made known in a particular setting.

collocations.en: a method introduced at the school

formal.mt: Is-servizz introdott f'Settembru jippermetti lir-residenti jagħmlu appuntament permezz tal-internet.
formal.en: The service introduced in September allows residents to make an appointment online.
formal.zh: 九月推出的这项服务允许居民在网上预约。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan hu s-servizz introdott ix-xahar li għadda? David: Iva, bih tista' tagħmel appuntament minn fuq it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the service introduced last month? David: Yes, you can use it to make an appointment on your phone.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这就是上个月推出的服务吗？戴维：是的，你可以用它在手机上预约。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu s-servizz introdott ix-xahar li għadda?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu s-servizz introdott ix-xahar li għadda?
messages.zh: 这就是上个月推出的服务吗？
messages.en: Is this the service introduced last month?

messages.speaker: David (服务中心职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bih tista' tagħmel appuntament minn fuq it-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bih tista' tagħmel appuntament minn fuq it-telefon.
messages.zh: 是的，你可以用它在手机上预约。
messages.en: Yes, you can use it to make an appointment on your phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 introdott 放在 servizz 后面记成“已经推出的服务”；它描述被引入后的状态，后接时间还可说明何时推出。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making a product available on the market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将产品投放市场，使其可供购买的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li prodott jitqiegħed fis-suq u jsir disponibbli għax-xiri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将产品投放市场，使其可供购买。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li prodott jitqiegħed fis-suq sabiex ikun jista' jinxtara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The introduction of a product onto the market is the act of making it available for people to buy.

collocations.en: the placing of a new product on the market

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħabbret li l-introduzzjoni fis-suq tal-prodott il-ġdid se ssir f'Marzu.
formal.en: The company announced that the new product would be placed on the market in March.
formal.zh: 公司宣布，新产品将于三月投放市场。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta se nkunu nistgħu nixtru l-prodott il-ġdid? Pawlu: L-introduzzjoni fis-suq hija ppjanata għal Marzu, allura għandna nkunu nistgħu nixtruh dak ix-xahar.
colloquial.en: Marija: When will we be able to buy the new product? Pawlu: Its market introduction is planned for March, so we should be able to buy it that month.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们什么时候能买到这款新产品？Pawlu：计划三月投放市场，所以我们应该那个月就能买到了。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se nkunu nistgħu nixtru l-prodott il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se nkunu nistgħu nixtru l-prodott il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 我们什么时候能买到这款新产品？
messages.en: When will we be able to buy the new product?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-introduzzjoni fis-suq hija ppjanata għal Marzu, allura għandna nkunu nistgħu nixtruh dak ix-xahar.
messages.mt_standard: L-introduzzjoni fis-suq hija ppjanata għal Marzu, allura għandna nkunu nistgħu nixtruh dak ix-xahar.
messages.zh: 计划三月投放市场，所以我们应该那个月就能买到了。
messages.en: Its market introduction is planned for March, so we should be able to buy it that month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新品从仓库进入商店货架：整组词记作“投放市场”，重点是开始可供购买。

gloss_zh: 拥堵收入；由拥堵产生的收入

teaching_sense.en_definition: Income that arises from congestion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因拥堵而产生的收入。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dħul li jirriżulta mill-konġestjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由拥堵产生的收入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dħul finanzjarju li jinħoloq minħabba l-konġestjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Congestion income is money received as a result of congestion.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport annwali jippreżenta l-introjtu mill-konġestjoni separatament minn sorsi oħra ta' dħul.
formal.en: The annual report presents congestion income separately from other sources of income.
formal.zh: 年度报告将拥堵收入与其他来源的收入分开列示。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-ammont fit-tabella minn fejn ġej? David: Dak huwa l-introjtu mill-konġestjoni; it-total qiegħed fl-aħħar ringiela.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where does this amount in the table come from? David: That is the congestion income; the total is in the last row.
colloquial.zh: Lara：表格里的这笔金额是从哪里来的？David：那是拥堵收入，总额在最后一行。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-ammont fit-tabella minn fejn ġej?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-ammont fit-tabella minn fejn ġej?
messages.zh: 表格里的这笔金额是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where does this amount in the table come from?

messages.speaker: David (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak huwa l-introjtu mill-konġestjoni; it-total qiegħed fl-aħħar ringiela.
messages.mt_standard: Dak huwa l-introjtu mill-konġestjoni; it-total qiegħed fl-aħħar ringiela.
messages.zh: 那是拥堵收入，总额在最后一行。
messages.en: That is the congestion income; the total is in the last row.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一张收入表，把“拥堵”连到“收入”这一栏，整组记成“由拥堵产生的收入”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An immediate feeling or understanding that does not come from conscious reasoning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经有意识的推理便直接产生的感觉或理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni jew fehma li tiġi minnufih mingħajr raġunament konxju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不经过有意识的分析或推理而直接获得的感觉、判断或理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħila li tħoss jew tifhem xi ħaġa mingħajr ma tasal għaliha permezz ta' analiżi jew raġunament konxju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Intuition is the ability to understand or feel something without consciously reasoning about it.

formal.mt: L-intuwizzjoni tar-riċerkatriċi wasslitha biex teżamina d-data mill-ġdid, iżda l-konklużjoni finali kienet ibbażata fuq l-evidenza.
formal.en: The researcher's intuition led her to examine the data again, but the final conclusion was based on evidence.
formal.zh: 研究人员的直觉促使她重新检查数据，但最终结论是以证据为依据的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi l-intuwizzjoni li ċ-ċwievet għadhom fil-karozza. Mark: Ejja niċċekkjaw hemm qabel infittxu fid-dar.
colloquial.en: Nina: I have an intuition that the keys are still in the car. Mark: Let's check there before we search the house.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我有种直觉，钥匙还在车里。Mark：我们先去那里看看，再找屋里。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-intuwizzjoni li ċ-ċwievet għadhom fil-karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-intuwizzjoni li ċ-ċwievet għadhom fil-karozza.
messages.zh: 我有种直觉，钥匙还在车里。
messages.en: I have an intuition that the keys are still in the car.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw hemm qabel infittxu fid-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw hemm qabel infittxu fid-dar.
messages.zh: 我们先去那里看看，再找屋里。
messages.en: Let's check there before we search the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“还没逐步推理，心里已有感觉”的场景，把 intuwizzjoni 与中文“直觉”一起回想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not needed, or unable to serve a useful purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不需要的，或不能发挥实际作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex meħtieġ jew li ma jaqdi ebda skop utli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没有必要的；并非所需的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex meħtieġ f'sitwazzjoni partikolari u li wieħed jista' jgħaddi mingħajru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is unnecessary is not needed in a particular situation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无用的；不能发挥所需作用或带来实际帮助的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jaqdi ebda skop utli jew ma jagħti ebda għajnuna biex jintlaħaq l-għan mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is useless cannot do what is needed or provide any practical help.

formal.mt: Il-kontroll addizzjonali tqies inutli għax l-istess verifika kienet diġà saret; l-apparat miksur, min-naħa l-oħra, kien inutli għax ma setax jaħdem.
formal.en: The additional check was considered unnecessary because the same verification had already been carried out; the broken device, on the other hand, was useless because it could not operate.
formal.zh: 额外的检查被认为没有必要，因为相同的核查已经完成；而损坏的设备则因无法运转而毫无用处。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se nipprintja kopja oħra tal-lista. Toni: Huwa inutli li tipprintja oħra; diġà għandna tnejn. Sara: U dan il-pinna nżommha? Toni: Le, hija inutli għax ma tikteb xejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'll print another copy of the list. Toni: There's no need to print another one; we already have two. Sara: And should I keep this pen? Toni: No, it's useless because it doesn't write at all.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我再打印一份清单。Toni：没必要再打印了，我们已经有两份。Sara：那这支笔要留着吗？Toni：不用，它没用了，完全写不出字。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我再打印一份清单。
messages.en: I'll print another copy of the list.

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa inutli li tipprintja oħra; diġà għandna tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa inutli li tipprintja oħra; diġà għandna tnejn.
messages.zh: 没必要再打印了，我们已经有两份。
messages.en: There's no need to print another one; we already have two.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 那这支笔要留着吗？
messages.en: And should I keep this pen?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija inutli għax ma tikteb xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija inutli għax ma tikteb xejn.
messages.zh: 不用，它没用了，完全写不出字。
messages.en: No, it's useless because it doesn't write at all.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图分清意思：多印一份清单是“不必要”，写不出字的笔是“无用”；两者都可用 inutli。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter a country, territory, or place by force, usually in order to take control of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以武力进入某个国家、领土或地方，通常意在夺取控制权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħal b'mod vjolenti f'pajjiż, territorju jew post, ġeneralment biex jieħu l-kontroll tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以武力入侵或侵占某个国家、领土或地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tidħol bil-forza f'pajjiż, territorju jew post, normalment biex taħkmu jew tokkupah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an army invades a country or territory, it enters by force in order to occupy it or gain control.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-eżerċtu invada l-pajjiż u ħa l-kontroll tal-belt ewlenija.
formal.en: In the novel, the army invaded the country and took control of its main city.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，军队入侵了这个国家，并控制了其主要城市。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara fil-film? Mark: L-eżerċtu invada raħal żgħir. Maja: U n-nies ħarbu? Mark: Iva, ħarbu lejn il-muntanji.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened in the film? Mark: The army invaded a small village. Maja: And did the people escape? Mark: Yes, they fled to the mountains.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里发生了什么？马克：军队入侵了一个小村庄。玛雅：那村民逃走了吗？马克：逃走了，他们逃到了山里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 军队入侵了一个小村庄。
messages.en: The army invaded a small village.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那村民逃走了吗？
messages.en: And did the people escape?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 逃走了，他们逃到了山里。
messages.en: Yes, they fled to the mountains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 invada 放进“军队越过边界”的画面中，记住它表达入侵这一动作；例句中的 invada 表示“入侵了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving entry into the body, or spreading into an environment in a way that disrupts what is already there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指涉及进入身体内部的；也指进入某个环境并扩散、干扰原有生态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi dħul fil-ġisem, jew li jinfirex f'ambjent u jfixkel il-ħajja li diġà hemm fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侵入性的，尤指医疗操作进入身体内部；也指物种进入环境后扩散并干扰原有生态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi proċedura li tidħol fil-ġisem, jew speċi li tinfirex f'ambjent u tfixkel il-bilanċ naturali tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An invasive procedure enters the body, while an invasive species spreads into an environment and disrupts the life already established there.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif speċi invażiva tista' tinfirex malajr u tagħmel ħsara lill-pjanti lokali.
formal.en: The report describes how an invasive species can spread rapidly and harm local plants.
formal.zh: 报告描述了入侵物种如何迅速扩散，并危害本地植物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-pjanta hija invażiva? Mark: Iva, qed tinfirex mal-ġnien kollu. Maja: Issa nifhem għaliex qed tieħu tant spazju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this plant invasive? Mark: Yes, it is spreading throughout the garden. Maja: Now I understand why it is taking up so much space.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种植物有入侵性吗？马克：有，它正在整个花园里蔓延。玛雅：现在我明白它为什么占了这么多地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 这种植物有入侵性吗？
messages.en: Is this plant invasive?

messages.speaker: Mark (园主)
messages.zh: 有，它正在整个花园里蔓延。
messages.en: Yes, it is spreading throughout the garden.

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem għaliex qed tieħu tant spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex qed tieħu tant spazju.
messages.zh: 现在我明白它为什么占了这么多地方。
messages.en: Now I understand why it is taking up so much space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“进入内部、向外蔓延”两个画面记住 invażiv：医疗中描述侵入性，生态中描述入侵性；修饰阴性名词时可见 invażiva。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of entering a country or territory by force, especially with an army, to occupy or control it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以武力进入某个国家或领土，尤其指军队为占领或控制该地而进行的入侵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dħul bil-forza f'pajjiż jew territorju, speċjalment minn armata, biex jiġi okkupat jew ikkontrollat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 入侵，尤指军队为占领或控制某个国家或领土而进行的武力进入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni li fiha armata jew forza oħra tidħol f'pajjiż jew territorju biex tokkupah jew tieħu l-kontroll tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An invasion is an event in which armed forces enter another country or territory to occupy it or take control.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja fittizja, l-invażjoni ġiegħlet lil ħafna familji jitilqu minn djarhom.
formal.en: In the fictional story, the invasion forced many families to leave their homes.
formal.zh: 在这个虚构故事中，入侵迫使许多家庭离开家园。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħarbu n-nies fl-istorja? Mark: Minħabba l-invażjoni. Maja: Allura telqu biex ifittxu post aktar sigur? Mark: Iva, hekk għamlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the people flee in the story? Mark: Because of the invasion. Maja: So they left to find somewhere safer? Mark: Yes, that is what they did.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的人为什么逃走了？马克：因为发生了入侵。玛雅：所以他们离开是为了找个更安全的地方？马克：对，他们就是这样做的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 故事里的人为什么逃走了？
messages.en: Why did the people flee in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为发生了入侵。
messages.en: Because of the invasion.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura telqu biex ifittxu post aktar sigur?
messages.mt_standard: Allura telqu biex ifittxu post aktar sigur?
messages.zh: 所以他们离开是为了找个更安全的地方？
messages.en: So they left to find somewhere safer?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 对，他们就是这样做的。
messages.en: Yes, that is what they did.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 invażjoni 记成新闻标题里的“一次入侵事件”：它是名词，用来给整件事命名；与表达动作的 invada 对照练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool containing a bubble in a liquid-filled tube, used to check whether a surface is horizontal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装有液体管和气泡、用来检查表面是否水平的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'tubu li fih likwidu u bużżieqa tal-arja, użata biex tiċċekkja jekk wiċċ huwiex orizzontali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 气泡水平尺，通过观察液体管内气泡的位置来检查物体表面是否水平的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li turi jekk wiċċ huwiex orizzontali permezz tal-pożizzjoni ta' bużżieqa tal-arja f'tubu li fih likwidu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spirit level is a tool that uses a bubble in liquid to show whether a surface is horizontal.

collocations.en: to check with a spirit level

formal.mt: Qabel ma waħħal l-ixkaffa mal-ħajt, il-ħaddiem uża invell biex jiċċekkja jekk kinitx orizzontali.
formal.en: Before fixing the shelf to the wall, the worker used a spirit level to check whether it was horizontal.
formal.zh: 工人在把搁板固定到墙上之前，用气泡水平尺检查了搁板是否水平。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek invell? Mark: Iva, hawn hu. Poġġih fuq l-ixkaffa. Maja: Il-bużżieqa qiegħda fin-nofs. Mark: Mela l-ixkaffa hija orizzontali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a spirit level? Mark: Yes, here it is. Put it on the shelf. Maja: The bubble is in the middle. Mark: Then the shelf is horizontal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有气泡水平尺吗？马克：有，给你。把它放在搁板上。玛雅：气泡在中间。马克：那搁板就是水平的。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你有气泡水平尺吗？
messages.en: Do you have a spirit level?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hu. Poġġih fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hu. Poġġih fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 有，给你。把它放在搁板上。
messages.en: Yes, here it is. Put it on the shelf.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 气泡在中间。
messages.en: The bubble is in the middle.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 那搁板就是水平的。
messages.en: Then the shelf is horizontal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 invell 就想象安装搁板时盯着小气泡：气泡对准中央刻线，帮助判断是否水平。用这个操作画面记住“气泡水平尺”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine a matter carefully or seek information about it in order to establish the facts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细查明某件事情，或通过询问和搜集资料来了解事实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeżamina kwistjoni bir-reqqa jew ifittex tagħrif dwarha sabiex jistabbilixxi l-fatti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对事件、问题或情况进行系统调查，以查明事实或原因。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jeżamina każ, problema jew sitwazzjoni b'mod sistematiku sabiex isib il-fatti jew il-kawżi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone investigates a matter, they examine it carefully to discover the facts or causes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就某件事情查问或寻求进一步资料，以获得更清楚的了解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ifittex aktar tagħrif dwar xi ħaġa billi jistaqsi jew jagħmel tiftix sabiex jifhimha aħjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone inquires about a matter, they seek further information in order to understand it better.

collocations.en: investigate the cause of the damage

formal.mt: Il-kumitat investiga l-ilment u ġabar tagħrif mingħand il-persuni involuti qabel ħareġ ir-rapport.
formal.en: The committee investigated the complaint and gathered information from the people involved before issuing its report.
formal.zh: 委员会调查了这项投诉，并在发布报告前向相关人员搜集了资料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma jaħdimx il-kompjuter? Mark: Għadni ma nafx. Se ninvestiga l-problema u ngħidlek x'insib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't the computer working? Mark: I don't know yet. I'll investigate the problem and tell you what I find.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电脑为什么不能用了？Mark：我还不知道。我会查一下这个问题，再告诉你查到了什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 电脑为什么不能用了？
messages.en: Why isn't the computer working?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Se ninvestiga l-problema u ngħidlek x'insib.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Se ninvestiga l-problema u ngħidlek x'insib.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。我会查一下这个问题，再告诉你查到了什么。
messages.en: I don't know yet. I'll investigate the problem and tell you what I find.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 investiga 记成一个动作画面：拿着问题去查证，边询问边搜集资料，最后查明事实。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A careful process of examining a matter and collecting information to establish the facts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过仔细审查和搜集资料来查明事实的调查活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess ta' eżami bir-reqqa u ġbir ta' tagħrif dwar kwistjoni sabiex jiġu stabbiliti l-fatti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为查明某个事件、问题或情况的事实及原因而进行的调查。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżami bir-reqqa ta' każ, problema jew sitwazzjoni, flimkien ma' ġbir ta' tagħrif, sabiex jinstabu l-fatti u l-kawżi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An investigation is a careful examination of a matter that aims to establish what happened and why.

formal.mt: L-awtorità fetħet investigazzjoni dwar l-inċident sabiex tistabbilixxi l-kawżi tiegħu u tipproponi miżuri ta' prevenzjoni.
formal.en: The authority opened an investigation into the incident to establish its causes and propose preventive measures.
formal.zh: 主管机构已就该事件展开调查，以查明原因并提出预防措施。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Sabu għaliex waqa' d-dawl? Pawlu: Għadha għaddejja l-investigazzjoni. Qalu li se jagħtu aktar tagħrif għada.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have they found out why the power went out? Pawlu: The investigation is still ongoing. They said they'll give more information tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他们查到停电的原因了吗？Pawlu：调查还在进行。他们说明天会提供更多消息。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 他们查到停电的原因了吗？
messages.en: Have they found out why the power went out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadha għaddejja l-investigazzjoni. Qalu li se jagħtu aktar tagħrif għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għadha għaddejja l-investigazzjoni. Qalu li se jagħtu aktar tagħrif għada.
messages.zh: 调查还在进行。他们说明天会提供更多消息。
messages.en: The investigation is still ongoing. They said they'll give more information tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 investigazzjoni 想成桌上的整份调查档案：里面有问题、证据和结论，用来记住它表示调查这件事或过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that puts money into a business or another asset in the hope of a financial return.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把资金投入企业或其他资产，期望获得财务回报的人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tqiegħed flus f'negozju jew f'assi oħra bit-tama li tikseb qligħ finanzjarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将资金投入企业、项目或其他资产，并期望取得收益的人或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tinvesti flus f'negozju, fi proġett jew f'assi oħra bit-tama li tikseb dħul jew qligħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An investor is a person or organization that commits money to something in the hope of earning a financial return.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ppreżentat il-pjan tan-negozju lil investitur privat li kien qed jikkunsidra li jiffinanzja l-espansjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The company presented its business plan to a private investor who was considering financing its expansion.
formal.zh: 公司向一位正在考虑为其扩张提供资金的私人投资者提交了商业计划。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jgħinna bil-flus biex niftħu l-ħanut? David: Għada se niltaqgħu ma' investitur. Irid jara l-pjan tagħna l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will help us with the money to open the shop? David: We're meeting an investor tomorrow. He wants to see our plan first.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁会出资帮助我们开店？David：我们明天要见一位投资者。他想先看看我们的计划。

messages.speaker: Lara (创业合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jgħinna bil-flus biex niftħu l-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jgħinna bil-flus biex niftħu l-ħanut?
messages.zh: 谁会出资帮助我们开店？
messages.en: Who will help us with the money to open the shop?

messages.speaker: David (创业合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada se niltaqgħu ma' investitur. Irid jara l-pjan tagħna l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Għada se niltaqgħu ma' investitur. Irid jara l-pjan tagħna l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 我们明天要见一位投资者。他想先看看我们的计划。
messages.en: We're meeting an investor tomorrow. He wants to see our plan first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 investitur 时想象一位查看商业计划并投入资金的人；把这个词牢牢对应到投资者这个角色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unhappy or resentful feeling caused by wanting an advantage, possession, or success that someone else has.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因渴望别人拥有的优势、财物或成就而产生的不快或怨意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' skuntentizza jew riżentiment li jinħass meta wieħed jixtieq vantaġġ, ġid jew suċċess li għandu ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因别人拥有自己想要的东西、优势或成就而感到不快的嫉妒心理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' skuntentizza għax persuna oħra għandha xi ħaġa, vantaġġ jew suċċess li wieħed jixtieq għalih innifsu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Envy is the unhappy feeling you have when someone else possesses something that you would like to have yourself.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, is-suċċess ta' ħabibu qanqal fih l-invidja, u dan is-sentiment beda jagħmel ħsara lill-ħbiberija tagħhom.
formal.en: In the story, his friend's success aroused envy in him, and this feeling began to damage their friendship.
formal.zh: 故事中，朋友的成功引起了他的嫉妒，而这种情绪开始损害他们的友谊。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta rajt il-karozza l-ġdida ta' ħija, ħassejt ftit invidja. Rita: Nifhmek. Int ilek tfaddal għal waħda, imma xorta tista' tifraħ għalih.
colloquial.en: Nina: When I saw my brother's new car, I felt a little envy. Rita: I understand. You've been saving for one, but you can still be happy for him.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看到哥哥的新车时，我有点嫉妒。Rita：我理解。你一直在攒钱买车，不过你也可以为他高兴。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta rajt il-karozza l-ġdida ta' ħija, ħassejt ftit invidja.
messages.mt_standard: Meta rajt il-karozza l-ġdida ta' ħija, ħassejt ftit invidja.
messages.zh: 看到哥哥的新车时，我有点嫉妒。
messages.en: When I saw my brother's new car, I felt a little envy.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmek. Int ilek tfaddal għal waħda, imma xorta tista' tifraħ għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmek. Int ilek tfaddal għal waħda, imma xorta tista' tifraħ għalih.
messages.zh: 我理解。你一直在攒钱买车，不过你也可以为他高兴。
messages.en: I understand. You've been saving for one, but you can still be happy for him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 invidja 连到这样一个心情画面：别人拥有自己很想要的东西，心里有点酸；用这份不快记住嫉妒的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling unhappy because someone else has something desirable that you wish you had.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因别人拥有自己也想得到的东西、优势或成就而感到嫉妒的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss għira għax ħaddieħor għandu xi ħaġa, vantaġġ jew suċċess li jixtieq ikollu hu wkoll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因别人拥有自己渴望的东西或取得成功而心生嫉妒的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss għira lejn xi ħadd minħabba xi ħaġa li għandu jew xi suċċess li kiseb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are envious, you feel unhappy because someone else has something that you would like to have.

formal.mt: L-istudent ħassu invidjuż meta sieħbu rebaħ il-premju, iżda feraħlu xorta waħda.
formal.en: The student felt envious when his classmate won the prize, but congratulated him nevertheless.
formal.zh: 那名学生看到同学获奖时心生嫉妒，但仍然向他表示祝贺。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex tidher imdejjaq? Pawlu: Jien ftit invidjuż għax ħija sejjer vaganza u jien irrid nibqa' naħdem.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why do you look upset? Pawlu: I'm a little envious because my brother is going on holiday and I have to keep working.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你怎么看起来不高兴？保罗：我有点眼红，因为我兄弟要去度假，而我还得继续工作。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么看起来不高兴？
messages.en: Why do you look upset?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ftit invidjuż għax ħija sejjer vaganza u jien irrid nibqa' naħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ftit invidjuż għax ħija sejjer vaganza u jien irrid nibqa' naħdem.
messages.zh: 我有点眼红，因为我兄弟要去度假，而我还得继续工作。
messages.en: I'm a little envious because my brother is going on holiday and I have to keep working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同学拿到奖杯，你也很想拥有，心里酸酸的：把这种眼红的感觉与 invidjuż 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat paper container used to enclose a letter or document, especially for posting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来装信件或文件的扁平纸袋，尤其用于邮寄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur ċatt tal-karta li fih titqiegħed ittra jew dokument, speċjalment biex jintbagħat bil-posta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装信件或文件用的扁平纸袋，通常可以封口并写上收件人地址。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontenitur ċatt tal-karta għall-ittri jew id-dokumenti, li normalment jista' jingħalaq u jinkiteb fuqu l-indirizz tar-riċevitur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An envelope is a flat paper container in which you put a letter or document, usually before sending it by post.

collocations.en: to write the address on the envelope

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jpoġġi d-dokumenti f'invilopp u jikteb ismu fuq quddiem.
formal.en: The applicant should place the documents in an envelope and write their name on the front.
formal.zh: 申请人应将文件放入信封，并在信封正面写上姓名。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek invilopp għal din l-ittra? Mark: Iva, hawn wieħed. Trid bolla wkoll?
