colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have an envelope for this letter? Mark: Yes, here's one. Do you need a stamp too?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有装这封信的信封吗？马克：有，这里有一个。你还需要邮票吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你有装这封信的信封吗？
messages.en: Do you have an envelope for this letter?

messages.speaker: Mark (文具店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed. Trid bolla wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed. Trid bolla wkoll?
messages.zh: 有，这里有一个。你还需要邮票吗？
messages.en: Yes, here's one. Do you need a stamp too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 按装信顺序记忆：先写 ittra，再放进 invilopp，最后贴 bolla；把信封放在这三个物件的中间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fastened or fitted into place by turning along a screw thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过沿螺纹旋转而装入、拧上或固定就位的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imwaħħal jew imqiegħed f'postu billi jiddawwar tul il-kamin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿螺纹旋转而拧入、拧上或固定好的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imdaħħal jew imwaħħal f'postu permezz tat-tidwir fuq il-kamin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is screwed into place has been fitted or fastened by turning it along a screw thread.

collocations.en: a cap screwed onto a bottle

formal.mt: Qabel ma jintuża l-apparat, għandu jiġi ċċekkjat li kull kamin ikun invitat sew.
formal.en: Before the device is used, each screw should be checked to ensure that it is securely screwed in.
formal.zh: 使用设备之前，应检查每颗螺丝，确保都已牢牢旋入。

colloquial.mt: Anna: L-għatu huwa invitat sew? David: Iva, dawwartu sakemm ingħalaq sew.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is the cap screwed on securely? David: Yes, I turned it until it was firmly closed.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：盖子拧紧了吗？戴维：拧紧了，我一直转到它牢牢盖好。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 盖子拧紧了吗？
messages.en: Is the cap screwed on securely?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 拧紧了，我一直转到它牢牢盖好。
messages.en: Yes, I turned it until it was firmly closed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 一边想象瓶盖沿螺纹转动，一边念 invitat；用已经拧上的瓶盖画面记住这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 参与其中的；牵涉其中的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Taking part in an activity or connected with a particular situation or matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与某项活动，或与某种情况、某件事情存在关联的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieħu sehem f'attività jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' sitwazzjoni jew kwistjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与某项活动或事务的；与某件事情有关联或受到牵涉的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jipparteċipa f'xi attività jew ħidma, jew li għandu rabta ma' xi ġrajja jew kwistjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is involved in an activity or situation, they take part in it or have a connection with it.

collocations.zh: 与该案件有关的；涉入该案件的

formal.mt: Kull min hu involut fil-proġett għandu jirċievi kopja tal-iskeda aġġornata.
formal.en: Everyone involved in the project should receive a copy of the updated schedule.
formal.zh: 所有参与该项目的人都应收到一份更新后的进度表。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int involut fil-festa tal-iskola? Ġużeppi: Iva, qed ngħin biex inżejnu s-sala.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you involved in the school celebration? Ġużeppi: Yes, I'm helping to decorate the hall.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有参与学校庆祝活动的筹备吗？朱塞佩：有，我正在帮忙装饰礼堂。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你有参与学校庆祝活动的筹备吗？
messages.en: Are you involved in the school celebration?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed ngħin biex inżejnu s-sala.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed ngħin biex inżejnu s-sala.
messages.zh: 有，我正在帮忙装饰礼堂。
messages.en: Yes, I'm helping to decorate the hall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个代表项目的圆，把参与者画在圆内并连上线：人在事情之中、有所关联，就用 involut 来描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To include something as part of an activity or cause someone to take part in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包含某项内容、涉及某事，或让某人参与一项活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkludi xi ħaġa bħala parti minn attività jew idaħħal lil xi ħadd biex jieħu sehem fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及或包含某事；使某人参与其中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jinkludi xi ħaġa f'ħidma jew attività, jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jieħu sehem fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an activity involves something or someone, it includes that thing or requires that person's participation.

formal.mt: Il-proġett involva lill-istudenti fil-ġbir ta' informazzjoni dwar l-ambjent.
formal.en: The project involved the students in collecting information about the environment.
formal.zh: 该项目让学生参与了环境信息的收集工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar il-proġett? Mark: Mar tajjeb, imma involva ħafna xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the project go? Mark: It went well, but it involved a lot of work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：项目进行得怎么样？马克：挺顺利的，不过涉及的工作很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 项目进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the project go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mar tajjeb, imma involva ħafna xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Mar tajjeb, imma involva ħafna xogħol.
messages.zh: 挺顺利的，不过涉及的工作很多。
messages.en: It went well, but it involved a lot of work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把项目想成一个圆圈：圈里放进工作，就是“涉及”；把学生请进圈里，就是“使参与”。用这两个画面记住 involva。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Participation in an activity or a connection with a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与某项活动，或与某种情况存在关联、介入其中的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parteċipazzjoni f'attività jew ir-rabta ma' sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对活动的参与，或对某件事情的介入、涉入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna tieħu sehem f'attività jew tkun marbuta ma' xi ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's involvement in an activity or situation is their participation in it or their connection with it.

formal.mt: L-involviment tal-ġenituri fl-attivitajiet tal-iskola jgħin biex tissaħħaħ ir-rabta bejn l-iskola u l-familji.
formal.en: Parental involvement in school activities helps strengthen the relationship between the school and families.
formal.zh: 家长参与学校活动，有助于加强学校与家庭之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tieħu sehem fil-proġett tal-lokal? Pawlu: Iva, imma l-involviment tiegħi se jkun limitat għax għandi ħafna xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you going to take part in the neighbourhood project? Pawlu: Yes, but my involvement will be limited because I have a lot of work.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你会参加社区项目吗？保罗：会，不过我工作很多，参与程度会比较有限。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你会参加社区项目吗？
messages.en: Are you going to take part in the neighbourhood project?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-involviment tiegħi se jkun limitat għax għandi ħafna xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-involviment tiegħi se jkun limitat għax għandi ħafna xogħol.
messages.zh: 会，不过我工作很多，参与程度会比较有限。
messages.en: Yes, but my involvement will be limited because I have a lot of work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报名表上的“参与程度”一栏：积极参加或有限参加，都可以用 involviment 来描述。把它当作可以讨论程度的“参与”来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone your word that you will do something or that something will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人作出保证，表示自己会做某事或某事会发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti kelmtek lil xi ħadd li se tagħmel xi ħaġa jew li xi ħaġa se sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承诺了；答应了，即已向某人保证会做某事或某事会发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkun tajt kelmtek lil xi ħadd li se tagħmel xi ħaġa jew li xi ħaġa se sseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone promised something, they gave their word that they would do it or that it would happen.

collocations.en: I promise to keep my word

formal.mt: F'din l-ittra, inwiegħed li nibgħat id-dokumenti kollha sal-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: In this letter, I promise to send all the documents by Friday.
formal.zh: 我在这封信中承诺，最迟于星期五寄出所有文件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tgħinni għada? Mark: Iva, inwiegħed li niġi fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you help me tomorrow? Mark: Yes, I promise to come at nine.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你明天能帮我吗？马克：能，我保证九点来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天能帮我吗？
messages.en: Can you help me tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 能，我保证九点来。
messages.en: Yes, I promise to come at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inwiegħed li 和具体行动连起来练：“我保证”之后接“来、帮助、寄文件”。想象在日历上郑重标记约定，就能记住承诺的语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smaller in size, especially when fabric or clothing is washed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸变小、发生收缩，尤其指布料或衣物洗后缩水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċkien fid-daqs, speċjalment meta drapp jew ilbies jinħasel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收缩，尺寸变小；尤指衣物或布料缩水。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isir iżgħar fid-daqs, bħal drapp jew ilbies li jiċkien wara l-ħasil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something shrinks, it becomes smaller than it was before, often as a result of washing or heat.

formal.mt: Wara l-ewwel ħasla, id-drapp inxtorob u l-qisien tiegħu nbidlu.
formal.en: After the first wash, the fabric shrank and its dimensions changed.
formal.zh: 第一次清洗后，布料发生了缩水，尺寸也随之改变。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-flokk jidher daqshekk żgħir? Sara: Inxtorob fil-ħasil, u issa ma jiġinix.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the top look so small? Sara: It shrank in the wash, and now it doesn't fit me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这件上衣怎么看起来这么小？萨拉：洗的时候缩水了，现在我穿不下了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这件上衣怎么看起来这么小？
messages.en: Why does the top look so small?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inxtorob fil-ħasil, u issa ma jiġinix.
messages.mt_standard: Inxtorob fil-ħasil, u issa ma jiġinix.
messages.zh: 洗的时候缩水了，现在我穿不下了。
messages.en: It shrank in the wash, and now it doesn't fit me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一件上衣洗前合身、洗后变小，把前后尺寸对比与 inxtorob 联系起来；每次想到“缩水了”，就复述衣物洗后变小的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unexpected connection between events that happens without being planned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有事先安排，却意外同时发生或彼此吻合的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja li fiha żewġ affarijiet jew aktar jaħbtu flimkien b'kumbinazzjoni, mingħajr ma jkunu ppjanati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巧合；两件或多件事情未经安排而意外相遇、同时发生或吻合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni fejn ġrajjiet ikunu marbutin jew iseħħu flimkien b'kumbinazzjoni u mhux bi pjan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coincidence occurs when events unexpectedly match or happen together without anyone arranging them.

formal.mt: Il-fatt li ż-żewġ laqgħat saru fl-istess jum kien sempliċi inzertatura.
formal.en: The fact that the two meetings took place on the same day was a mere coincidence.
formal.zh: 两场会议恰好在同一天举行，仅仅是巧合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Anki int għandek għeluq sninek illum? X'inzertatura! Pawlu: Iva! Mela nistgħu niċċelebraw flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is it your birthday today too? What a coincidence! Pawlu: Yes! Then we can celebrate together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天也是你的生日吗？真巧！Pawlu：是啊！那我们可以一起庆祝。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Anki int għandek għeluq sninek illum? X'inzertatura!
messages.mt_standard: Anki int għandek għeluq sninek illum? X'inzertatura!
messages.zh: 今天也是你的生日吗？真巧！
messages.en: Is it your birthday today too? What a coincidence!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊！那我们可以一起庆祝。
messages.en: Yes! Then we can celebrate together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个朋友没有约好，却在同一天生日聚会上相遇；用“真巧！”的反应记住 inzertatura。

gloss_zh: 尺寸标注过程中的意外事件

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unexpected incident occurring during the process of specifying dimensions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在确定或标注尺寸的过程中发生的意外事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja mhux mistennija li sseħħ waqt il-proċess li fih jiġu stabbiliti jew immarkati d-dimensjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尺寸确定或标注过程中发生的事件，通常指意外情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Inċident li jseħħ waqt ix-xogħol tal-istabbiliment jew tal-immarkar tad-dimensjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dimensioning incident is an unexpected event that occurs while dimensions are being specified or marked.

collocations.en: a report on a dimensioning incident
collocations.zh: 关于尺寸标注意外事件的报告

collocations.en: an investigation into a dimensioning incident
collocations.zh: 对尺寸标注意外事件的调查

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi inċident tad-dimensjonar li seħħ waqt it-tħejjija tat-tpinġija teknika.
formal.en: The report describes a dimensioning incident that occurred during the preparation of the technical drawing.
formal.zh: 报告描述了在准备技术图纸时发生的一起尺寸标注意外事件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaft taħdem fuq it-tpinġija? Mark: Kien hemm inċident tad-dimensjonar. Irrid niċċekkja d-dimensjonijiet qabel inkompli.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you stop working on the drawing? Mark: There was a dimensioning incident. I need to check the dimensions before continuing.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么停下画图了？Mark：尺寸标注时出了意外情况。我得先检查尺寸再继续。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么停下画图了？
messages.en: Why did you stop working on the drawing?

messages.speaker: Mark (制图员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm inċident tad-dimensjonar. Irrid niċċekkja d-dimensjonijiet qabel inkompli.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm inċident tad-dimensjonar. Irrid niċċekkja d-dimensjonijiet qabel inkompli.
messages.zh: 尺寸标注时出了意外情况。我得先检查尺寸再继续。
messages.en: There was a dimensioning incident. I need to check the dimensions before continuing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象技术图纸旁贴着“尺寸标注发生意外”的便签，把整个短语与这一工作场景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The idea of people or things being together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人或事物在一起、共同存在这一概念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kunċett li persuni jew affarijiet ikunu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “一起；共同”的概念，按本条所给词性作为名词理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bħala kunċett nominali f'din l-entrata, ifisser li persuni jew affarijiet ikunu flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this noun entry, the meaning is the idea of people or things being together.

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, il-kunċett ta' 'inċim' jiġi spjegat permezz ta' stampa ta' nies li qegħdin flimkien.
formal.en: In this lesson, the concept of being together is explained through a picture of people gathered together.
formal.zh: 本课用一幅人们聚在一起的图片来解释“一起”这一概念。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'inċim' f'din il-lezzjoni? Rita: Hawn qed nitkellmu fuq l-idea li nkunu flimkien, bħal meta noqogħdu lkoll madwar mejda waħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'inċim' mean in this lesson? Rita: Here we're talking about the idea of being together, like when we all sit around one table.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这课里的 inċim 是什么意思？Rita：这里说的是“在一起”这个概念，比如大家围坐在同一张桌子旁。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这课里的 inċim 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'inċim' mean in this lesson?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn qed nitkellmu fuq l-idea li nkunu flimkien, bħal meta noqogħdu lkoll madwar mejda waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn qed nitkellmu fuq l-idea li nkunu flimkien, bħal meta noqogħdu lkoll madwar mejda waħda.
messages.zh: 这里说的是“在一起”这个概念，比如大家围坐在同一张桌子旁。
messages.en: Here we're talking about the idea of being together, like when we all sit around one table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张大家围坐同桌的小图，把“一起”圈成一个概念，帮助记住本条给定的名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A raincoat worn to keep the body dry, or a piece of waterproof fabric used as a covering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于挡雨、保持身体干燥的雨衣，也指用于遮盖物品的一块防水布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies li jintlibes biex jipproteġi l-ġisem mix-xita, jew biċċa drapp li ma jgħaddix ilma minnha u tintuża biex tgħatti l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下雨时穿在身上、用于防止衣服和身体淋湿的雨衣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilbies li jintlibes fuq il-ħwejjeġ biex jipproteġi lil min jilbsu mix-xita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A raincoat is an outer garment that you wear to keep yourself dry when it rains.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块不透水的布料，常用于遮盖物品以防淋湿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li ma jgħaddix ilma minnha u li tista' tintuża biex tipproteġi l-affarijiet milli jixxarrbu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A piece of waterproof fabric is material that prevents water from passing through and can protect things from getting wet.

collocations.en: to cover the boxes with a piece of waterproof fabric
collocations.zh: 用一块防水布盖住箱子

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema għattew il-kaxxi b'inċirata biex jipproteġuhom mix-xita.
formal.en: The workers covered the boxes with a piece of waterproof fabric to protect them from the rain.
formal.zh: 工人们用一块防水布盖住箱子，防止它们被雨淋湿。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ħu l-inċirata miegħek, għax se tagħmel ix-xita. Pawlu: Tajjeb, nilbisha qabel noħroġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Take your raincoat with you, because it is going to rain. Pawlu: All right, I'll put it on before I go out.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：带上雨衣吧，要下雨了。保罗：好，我出门前就穿上。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu l-inċirata miegħek, għax se tagħmel ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu l-inċirata miegħek, għax se tagħmel ix-xita.
messages.zh: 带上雨衣吧，要下雨了。
messages.en: Take your raincoat with you, because it is going to rain.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，我出门前就穿上。
messages.en: All right, I'll put it on before I go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inċirata 放进两个挡雨画面记忆：穿在身上是雨衣，铺在箱子上是一块防水布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To urge or provoke someone to take an action, especially a harmful or disruptive one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语或行为鼓动、刺激他人采取行动，尤其指煽动有害或扰乱秩序的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħeġġeġ jew jipprovoka lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel xi ħaġa, speċjalment azzjoni ta' ħsara jew li tqajjem l-inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煽动或唆使他人采取某种行动，尤指引发冲突、伤害或骚乱的行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqanqal jew iħeġġeġ lil persuna jew grupp biex jieħdu azzjoni, speċjalment waħda li tista' twassal għall-ħsara jew għall-inkwiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone instigates an action, they urge or provoke other people to carry it out, often causing trouble.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif id-diskors inċita lill-folla biex tattakka l-bini.
formal.en: The report describes how the speech incited the crowd to attack the building.
formal.zh: 报告描述了那番讲话如何煽动人群袭击大楼。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-raġel inċita lin-nies biex jiġġieldu. Mark: Iva, kliemu kompla qajjem l-inkwiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: That man instigated people to fight. Mark: Yes, his words caused even more trouble.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个男人煽动大家打架。马克：是啊，他的话让事态更加混乱了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel inċita lin-nies biex jiġġieldu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel inċita lin-nies biex jiġġieldu.
messages.zh: 那个男人煽动大家打架。
messages.en: That man instigated people to fight.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他的话让事态更加混乱了。
messages.en: Yes, his words caused even more trouble.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 inċita 的情境链：有人出言挑动，别人受到鼓动，随后采取行动；核心是“煽动、唆使”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small sea fish that is eaten fresh or preserved, often used to give food a strong, salty flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种可鲜食或腌制食用的小型海鱼；腌制后常用于给食物增添浓郁的咸鲜味，即鳀鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta żgħira tal-baħar li tittiekel friska jew ippreservata, u li spiss tintuża mmellħa biex tagħti togħma qawwija lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鳀鱼，一种小型海鱼，常经盐腌或油浸后食用，也可用作调味配料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta żgħira tal-baħar li tista' tittiekel friska, immellħa jew miżmuma fiż-żejt, u li tintuża wkoll bħala ingredjent fit-tisjir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anchovy is a small sea fish that is often preserved in salt or oil and used to flavour food.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tissuġġerixxi li żżid flett tal-inċova maz-zalza biex tagħtiha togħma aktar qawwija.
formal.en: The recipe suggests adding an anchovy fillet to the sauce to give it a stronger flavour.
formal.zh: 食谱建议在酱汁中加入一片鳀鱼鱼柳，使味道更加浓郁。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid inċova fuq il-pizza? David: Iva, imma waħda biss, għax it-togħma tagħha qawwija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like an anchovy on the pizza? David: Yes, but just one, because it has a strong flavour.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：披萨上要放一条鳀鱼吗？戴维：要，不过放一条就好，因为它的味道很浓。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 披萨上要放一条鳀鱼吗？
messages.en: Would you like an anchovy on the pizza?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma waħda biss, għax it-togħma tagħha qawwija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma waħda biss, għax it-togħma tagħha qawwija.
messages.zh: 要，不过放一条就好，因为它的味道很浓。
messages.en: Yes, but just one, because it has a strong flavour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 inċova，想象披萨上一条味道浓郁的小鳀鱼，把“小海鱼、咸鲜配料”连成记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To describe something being cut into pieces by forceful chopping or hacking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物受到用力劈砍，被砍成多个碎块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tqattgħet f'biċċiet permezz ta' daqqiet qawwija b'għodda li taqta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反复用力劈砍，直至成为碎块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tqattgħet f'ħafna biċċiet b'daqqiet qawwija ta' għodda li taqta'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is hacked to pieces, it is cut apart by repeated forceful blows with a sharp tool.

collocations.en: hacked to pieces into small fragments
hacked to pieces with an axe

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-qari, il-kelma 'inġarthom' tindika qtugħ f'biċċiet permezz ta' daqqiet qawwija.
formal.en: In the reading exercise, the word 'inġarthom' indicates cutting something into pieces with forceful blows.
formal.zh: 在阅读练习中，inġarthom 一词表示通过用力劈砍将某物砍成碎块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'inġarthom' hawn? Mark: Tfisser li tqattgħu f'biċċiet b'daqqiet qawwija.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'inġarthom' mean here? Mark: It means they were cut into pieces with forceful blows.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 inġarthom 是什么意思？马克：意思是它们被用力劈砍成了碎块。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 inġarthom 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'inġarthom' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li tqattgħu f'biċċiet b'daqqiet qawwija.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li tqattgħu f'biċċiet b'daqqiet qawwija.
messages.zh: 意思是它们被用力劈砍成了碎块。
messages.en: It means they were cut into pieces with forceful blows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木板经过几次重重劈砍变成碎块，用“重砍加碎块”的画面记住这个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather together in a crowd at a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人们来到同一地点，聚集成一群。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li n-nies ġew flimkien u ffurmaw folla f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成群聚集到某处，形成一群人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li grupp ta' nies ġie flimkien f'post wieħed u fforma folla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When people throng a place, they gather there in large numbers.

collocations.en: gathered in front of the door

formal.mt: Qabel il-kunċert, il-pubbliku inġemgħa fil-pjazza quddiem il-palk.
formal.en: Before the concert, the public gathered in the square in front of the stage.
formal.zh: 音乐会开始前，观众聚集在舞台前的广场上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inġemgħa l-grupp? David: Quddiem il-knisja; ejja mmorru hemm.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did the group gather? David: In front of the church; let's go there.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：大家聚集在哪里了？戴维：在教堂前面，我们过去吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家聚集在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did the group gather?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 在教堂前面，我们过去吧。
messages.en: In front of the church; let's go there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广场上的人从四面八方走到一起，用“分散的人变成一群”记住聚集的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Considering something as a whole, describing what usually happens, or speaking without specific details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于总体评价、说明通常情况，或表示说话时不涉及具体细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex wieħed iqis xi ħaġa kollha kemm hi, jgħid x'jiġri s-soltu, jew jitkellem mingħajr dettalji speċifiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 总体而言；从整体情况来看，不逐一讨论个别情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta wieħed iqis is-suġġett kollu kemm hu, mingħajr ma jiffoka fuq kull każ għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use in general when considering a subject as a whole rather than examining every individual case.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常；在大多数情况下如此，但允许存在例外。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-biċċa l-kbira tal-każijiet jew f'dak li jiġri s-soltu, għalkemm jista' jkun hemm eċċezzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something generally happens, it happens in most cases, although there may be exceptions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笼统地；不明确指出具体对象或具体细节地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod li ma jidentifikax persuna, ħaġa jew dettall partikolari b'mod preċiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you speak non-specifically, you discuss something without identifying particular people, things, or details.

collocations.en: speak about the problem without specific details

formal.mt: Inġenerali, ir-riżultati kienu tajbin, għalkemm kien hemm xi eċċezzjonijiet.
formal.en: In general, the results were good, although there were some exceptions.
formal.zh: 总体而言，结果不错，不过也有一些例外。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inġenerali, kif sejjer il-kors? Luqa: Tajjeb; inġenerali nifhem il-lezzjonijiet, imma kultant ikolli bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Overall, how is the course going? Luqa: Well; I generally understand the lessons, but sometimes I need help.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：总体来说，课程学得怎么样？卢卡：挺好，我通常能听懂课，不过有时需要帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 总体来说，课程学得怎么样？
messages.en: Overall, how is the course going?

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb; inġenerali nifhem il-lezzjonijiet, imma kultant ikolli bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb; inġenerali nifhem il-lezzjonijiet, imma kultant ikolli bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 挺好，我通常能听懂课，不过有时需要帮助。
messages.en: Well; I generally understand the lessons, but sometimes I need help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个中文提示串起来记：看整体是“总体而言”，看频率是“通常”，不讲细节是“笼统地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A machine or device designed to perform a particular task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为完成某项特定任务而设计的机器或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna jew apparat magħmul biex iwettaq xogħol jew funzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过机械结构或动力运作、用来完成工作的机器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magna b'partijiet li jaħdmu flimkien biex iwettqu xogħol partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A machine is a piece of equipment whose parts work together to perform a particular task.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某种特定用途而制作的器具或装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat jew għodda magħmula biex taqdi skop speċifiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A device is an object or piece of equipment designed for a particular purpose.

formal.mt: Dan l-inġenju elettroniku jkejjel it-temperatura tal-ilma kull minuta.
formal.en: This electronic device measures the water temperature every minute.
formal.zh: 这台电子装置每分钟测量一次水温。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħmel dan l-inġenju? Mark: Ikejjel it-temperatura tal-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this device do? Mark: It measures the water temperature.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个装置是做什么的？Mark：它测量水温。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个装置是做什么的？
messages.en: What does this device do?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它测量水温。
messages.en: It measures the water temperature.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上一台会测水温的小机器，把 inġenju 同“执行特定任务的机器或装置”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause injury to someone or insult them through offensive words or treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使他人受伤，或用冒犯性的言语、行为侮辱他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikkawża ħsara lil xi ħadd jew offenda lil xi ħadd bi kliem jew b'imġiba ta' disprezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人受伤；对人的身体造成损伤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikkawża ferita jew ħsara lill-ġisem ta' xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone injures another person, they cause physical harm to that person's body.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以无礼、贬损或冒犯性的言语或行为侮辱他人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offenda jew umilja lil xi ħadd bi kliem jew b'imġiba li turi nuqqas ta' rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone insults another person, they say or do something offensive or disrespectful to them.

collocations.en: he insulted his colleague in front of everyone

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-klijent inġurja lill-impjegat quddiem diversi xhieda.
formal.en: According to the report, the customer insulted the employee in front of several witnesses.
formal.zh: 根据报告，这名顾客当着几名目击者的面侮辱了员工。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq Mark? Lara: Għax xi ħadd inġurja lil ħuh. Maja: Mela nifhem għaliex irrabja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave? Lara: Because someone insulted his brother. Maja: Then I understand why he got angry.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么走了？Lara：因为有人侮辱了他的兄弟。Maja：那我明白他为什么生气了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xi ħadd inġurja lil ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xi ħadd inġurja lil ħuh.
messages.zh: 因为有人侮辱了他的兄弟。
messages.en: Because someone insulted his brother.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我明白他为什么生气了。
messages.en: Then I understand why he got angry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“身体受伤”和“受到辱骂”两个画面分别记住所给义项；练习时看上下文区分伤害与侮辱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wrong or unfair because people are not treated as they deserve or on equal terms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因未按应有的原则或平等条件对待他人而显得不公正、不公平的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jittrattax lin-nies kif jixirqilhom jew li ma jagħtihomx opportunitajiet u kundizzjonijiet indaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 违背正义或公正原则的；使人受到不应有待遇的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jmur kontra l-ġustizzja jew jagħti lil xi ħadd trattament li ma jistħoqqlux.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A decision or action is unjust if it treats someone wrongly or violates principles of justice.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未平等对待各方、使某方无故占优或受损的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jittrattax lil kulħadd bl-istess mod jew jagħti vantaġġ mhux mistħoqq lil xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something is unfair if it gives people unequal treatment or an advantage they do not deserve.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qies il-kastig bħala inġust għax ma kienx hemm biżżejjed provi.
formal.en: The committee considered the punishment unjust because there was insufficient evidence.
formal.zh: 委员会认为这项惩罚不公正，因为证据不足。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kastig inġust! Mark: Għaliex qed tgħid hekk? Maja: Għax jien ma għamilt xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: This punishment is unfair! Mark: Why do you say that? Maja: Because I didn't do anything.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个惩罚不公平！Mark：你为什么这么说？Maja：因为我什么也没做。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个惩罚不公平！
messages.en: This punishment is unfair!

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么说？
messages.en: Why do you say that?

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 因为我什么也没做。
messages.en: Because I didn't do anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己没犯错却被处罚，脱口说“这个惩罚 inġust”；用受冤枉的场景记住不公正。

gloss_zh: 使自己受人喜爱；赢得好感

teaching_sense.en_definition: To win other people's affection through one's behavior or personal qualities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过自己的行为或品格赢得别人的喜爱与好感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikseb l-imħabba jew is-simpatija ta' ħaddieħor permezz tal-imġiba jew tal-kwalitajiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以自己的言行或品质使别人喜欢自己。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod li jqanqal l-imħabba jew is-simpatija ta' ħaddieħor lejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone endears themselves to other people, their behavior or qualities make those people feel affection for them.

collocations.zh: 因待人友善而赢得喜爱

formal.mt: Bil-paċenzja u l-ġenerożità tiegħu, il-voluntier inħabb fost ir-residenti tar-raħal.
formal.en: Through his patience and generosity, the volunteer endeared himself to the village residents.
formal.zh: 这位志愿者凭借耐心和慷慨赢得了村民们的喜爱。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif mar Pawlu mal-grupp il-ġdid? Luqa: Mar tajjeb ħafna. Għen lil kulħadd u malajr inħabb fost sħabu.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did Pawlu get on with the new group? Luqa: Really well. He helped everyone and quickly endeared himself to the others.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗和新小组相处得怎么样？卢卡：特别好。他帮助大家，很快就赢得了同伴们的喜爱。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗和新小组相处得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get on with the new group?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mar tajjeb ħafna. Għen lil kulħadd u malajr inħabb fost sħabu.
messages.mt_standard: Mar tajjeb ħafna. Għen lil kulħadd u malajr inħabb fost sħabu.
messages.zh: 特别好。他帮助大家，很快就赢得了同伴们的喜爱。
messages.en: Really well. He helped everyone and quickly endeared himself to the others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inħabb 和“热心帮忙后大家都喜欢他”的画面绑定，记住它强调赢得他人的喜爱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop working because of burning or excessive heat, as an electrical bulb or component does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指灯泡或电气部件等因燃烧或过热而损坏、停止工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieqaf taħdem minħabba ħruq jew sħana żejda, bħalma jiġri lil bozza jew lil biċċa tagħmir elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因烧损或过热而失效；烧坏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Issirilha ħsara minħabba ħruq jew sħana żejda u ma tibqax taħdem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a bulb or electrical component burns out, it becomes damaged by heat and stops working.

collocations.en: burned out because of excessive heat

formal.mt: Il-bozza tal-kuritur inħarqet waqt il-lejl u ġiet mibdula filgħodu.
formal.en: The corridor bulb burned out during the night and was replaced in the morning.
formal.zh: 走廊的灯泡夜里烧坏了，早晨已更换。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex id-dawl tal-kċina mhux jixgħel? Mark: Il-bozza inħarqet. Għandna oħra fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why isn't the kitchen light coming on? Mark: The bulb burned out. We have another one in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：厨房的灯怎么不亮了？马克：灯泡烧坏了。抽屉里还有一个。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 厨房的灯怎么不亮了？
messages.en: Why isn't the kitchen light coming on?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 灯泡烧坏了。抽屉里还有一个。
messages.en: The bulb burned out. We have another one in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象灯泡突然熄灭、需要换新的情景，用“灯泡烧坏了”整句记住 inħarqet。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clean one's own body using water, usually with soap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水清洗自己的身体，通常也使用肥皂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaddaf ġismu bl-ilma, ġeneralment bis-sapun ukoll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清洗自己的身体；给自己洗澡或擦洗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaħsel il-ġisem tiegħu stess bl-ilma u, jekk ikun hemm bżonn, bis-sapun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone washes themselves, they clean their own body with water, usually using soap as well.

formal.mt: Wara li temm ix-xogħol fil-ġnien, il-ħaddiem inħasel bl-ilma u bis-sapun.
formal.en: After finishing his work in the garden, the worker washed himself with water and soap.
formal.zh: 完成花园里的工作后，这位工人用水和肥皂清洗了身体。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu Ben? Wasal l-ikel. David: Għadu kemm inħasel wara l-logħba. Issa ġej.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where's Ben? The food is here. David: He's just washed himself after the game. He's coming now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：本在哪里？饭菜到了。戴维：他刚在比赛后洗完身子。这就过来。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 本在哪里？饭菜到了。
messages.en: Where's Ben? The food is here.

messages.speaker: David (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kemm inħasel wara l-logħba. Issa ġej.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kemm inħasel wara l-logħba. Issa ġej.
messages.zh: 他刚在比赛后洗完身子。这就过来。
messages.en: He's just washed himself after the game. He's coming now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“运动后自己洗干净”的画面：inħasel 的动作落在本人身上，可联想为“他洗了身子”。

gloss_zh: 周围地区；附近一带；周边环境

teaching_sense.en_definition: The places or area around a particular location.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地点周围的区域、附近一带或周边环境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-postijiet jew iż-żona li jinsabu madwar post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某处周围的地方或环境；附近地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-postijiet u l-ambjent li jdawru post partikolari jew li jinsabu qrib tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The surroundings of a place are the nearby areas and features that form the environment around it.

collocations.en: in the area around the city

formal.mt: L-inħawi tal-lukanda joffru diversi mogħdijiet għall-mixi u veduti tal-baħar.
formal.en: The area around the hotel offers several walking paths and views of the sea.
formal.zh: 酒店周边有几条步行小径，还可欣赏海景。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Hemm xi kafetterija f'dawn l-inħawi? Pawlu: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn il-pjazza, żewġ minuti bil-mixi minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is there a café around here? Pawlu: Yes, there's one next to the square, a two-minute walk from here.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：这一带有咖啡馆吗？保罗：有，广场旁边就有一家，从这里走两分钟就到。

messages.speaker: Elena (游客)
messages.zh: 这一带有咖啡馆吗？
messages.en: Is there a café around here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn il-pjazza, żewġ minuti bil-mixi minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn il-pjazza, żewġ minuti bil-mixi minn hawn.
messages.zh: 有，广场旁边就有一家，从这里走两分钟就到。
messages.en: Yes, there's one next to the square, a two-minute walk from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上围着一个地点画圈，圈内的周围一带就是 inħawi；把 dawn l-inħawi 整体记作“这一带”。

gloss_zh: 我爱；我喜欢（动词义）；名词义未明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun sense whose meaning is undetermined; distinguish it from the verb form inħobb, meaning 'I love'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词义尚不明确的名词义项；应与表示“我爱、我喜欢”的同形动词 inħobb 区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifsira ta' nom li mhijiex ċara; għandha tinżamm distinta mill-forma verbali inħobb, li tesprimi mħabba jew preferenza tal-kelliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含义无法确定的名词义项，暂不能给出可靠的中文释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifsira ta' nom li ma tistax tiġi identifikata b'mod ċar u li għalhekk ma tistax tingħata definizzjoni affidabbli tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun sense has no clearly identifiable meaning that can be explained reliably.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我爱某人或某物；也可表示我喜欢某项活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma verbali li biha l-kelliem jgħid li jħoss imħabba lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew li jieħu gost jagħmel xi attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you say inħobb, you mean that you love someone or something, or enjoy a particular activity.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħi ktibt: 'Inħobb lil pajjiżi u nixtieq naħdem għall-ġid tiegħu.'
formal.en: In my letter I wrote: 'I love my country and wish to work for its benefit.'
formal.zh: 我在信中写道：“我爱我的国家，并希望为它的福祉而努力。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tħobb tagħmel filgħaxija? Lara: Inħobb naqra ktieb qabel norqod.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you like doing in the evening? Lara: I like reading a book before I go to sleep.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你晚上喜欢做什么？拉拉：我喜欢睡前读书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你晚上喜欢做什么？
messages.en: What do you like doing in the evening?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢睡前读书。
messages.en: I like reading a book before I go to sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inħobb 整体记作“我爱／我喜欢”：接 lil ommi 练“我爱妈妈”，接 naqra 练“我喜欢阅读”；名词义暂不猜测。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of an aircraft coming down and reaching the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 飞机等航空器下降并到达地面的过程或动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ajruplan jew mezz ieħor tal-ajru jinżel u jasal fuq l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 着陆；航空器下降并接触地面的动作或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih ajruplan jinżel mill-ajru u jmiss mal-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A landing is the process in which an aircraft comes down and reaches the ground.

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri għandhom jibqgħu bilqiegħda waqt l-inżul l-art.
formal.en: Passengers should remain seated during landing.
formal.zh: 乘客在着陆过程中应保持就座。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien l-inżul l-art? Mark: Kien tajjeb ħafna, bilkemm ħassejt xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the landing? Mark: It was very good; I hardly felt anything.
colloquial.zh: Maja：着陆时怎么样？Mark：很平稳，我几乎没什么感觉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 着陆时怎么样？
messages.en: How was the landing?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien tajjeb ħafna, bilkemm ħassejt xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Kien tajjeb ħafna, bilkemm ħassejt xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 很平稳，我几乎没什么感觉。
messages.en: It was very good; I hardly felt anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上飞机轮子接触跑道的画面，记住它表示“着陆”这个过程。

gloss_zh: 已打包；已装入行李或容器

teaching_sense.en_definition: The completed state of belongings placed in bags, boxes, or other containers for travel or storage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品已经装入袋子、箱子等容器，准备运输、旅行或存放的完成状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' oġġetti li diġà tqiegħdu f'boroż, kaxxi jew bagalji biex jinġarru jew jinħażnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已打包的；物品已经装入袋子、箱子或行李中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun diġà tqiegħed f'borża, kaxxa jew bagalja biex jinġarr jew jinħażen.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When belongings are packed, they have been placed in bags or boxes for travel or storage.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, 'ipakjajt' hija marbuta ma' stampa ta' ħwejjeġ li diġà tqiegħdu f'bagalja.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, 'ipakjajt' is linked to a picture of clothes already placed in a suitcase.
formal.zh: 在词汇练习中，“ipakjajt”对应的是衣物已经装进行李箱的图片。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Liema stampa se torbot ma' 'ipakjajt'? David: Dik bil-ħwejjeġ diġà fil-bagalja, lesti għall-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Lina: Which picture will you associate with 'ipakjajt'? David: The one with the clothes already in the suitcase, ready for the trip.
colloquial.zh: Lina：你会把“ipakjajt”和哪张图片联系起来？David：衣服已经装进行李箱、准备好出发的那张。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 你会把“ipakjajt”和哪张图片联系起来？
messages.en: Which picture will you associate with 'ipakjajt'?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik bil-ħwejjeġ diġà fil-bagalja, lesti għall-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Dik bil-ħwejjeġ diġà fil-bagalja, lesti għall-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 衣服已经装进行李箱、准备好出发的那张。
messages.en: The one with the clothes already in the suitcase, ready for the trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用衣服已经装进箱子、拉链已经拉好的画面记住“已打包”，重点记住动作已经完成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move from one region to another as birds do with the changing seasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鸟类随着季节变化，从一个地区迁飞到另一个地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-għasafar meta jmorru minn reġjun għal ieħor skont l-istaġun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迁徙；指鸟类随季节变化在不同地区之间迁飞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-għasafar meta jiċċaqilqu minn post għal ieħor fi żminijiet differenti tas-sena.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When birds migrate, they travel between regions at different times of the year.

formal.mt: Xi għasafar ipassu lejn in-Nofsinhar fil-ħarifa biex iqattgħu x-xitwa f'postijiet aktar sħan.
formal.en: Some birds migrate south in autumn to spend the winter in warmer places.
formal.zh: 有些鸟在秋季向南迁徙，到更温暖的地方过冬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed naraw tant għasafar flimkien? Toni: Dawn ipassu f'dan iż-żmien tas-sena; qegħdin fi triqthom lejn post ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we seeing so many birds together? Toni: These birds migrate at this time of year; they are on their way somewhere else.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么我们会看到这么多鸟聚在一起？Toni：这些鸟每年这个时候会迁徙；它们正在飞往别的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed naraw tant għasafar flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed naraw tant għasafar flimkien?
messages.zh: 为什么我们会看到这么多鸟聚在一起？
messages.en: Why are we seeing so many birds together?

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn ipassu f'dan iż-żmien tas-sena; qegħdin fi triqthom lejn post ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn ipassu f'dan iż-żmien tas-sena; qegħdin fi triqthom lejn post ieħor.
messages.zh: 这些鸟每年这个时候会迁徙；它们正在飞往别的地方。
messages.en: These birds migrate at this time of year; they are on their way somewhere else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ipassu 和秋天鸟群向南飞的画面绑定，记住这里说的是鸟类随季节迁徙。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaviour in which someone claims to have moral principles that their own actions contradict.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 口头宣称遵守某种道德原则，实际行为却与之相反的虚伪表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ipokrezija hija mġiba ta' persuna li tgħid li tħaddan ċerti prinċipji morali iżda taġixxi kontrihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伪善；以言语表现出自己并未在实际行为中遵守的道德标准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ipokrezija hija l-imġiba ta' min jippreżenta ruħu bħala persuna bi prinċipji morali iżda ma jsegwihomx f'għemilu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hypocrisy is behaviour in which people claim to follow moral standards that their own actions fail to meet.

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkritika l-ipokrezija ta' dawk li jitolbu trasparenza iżda jaħbu d-deċiżjonijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The author criticizes the hypocrisy of those who demand transparency but conceal their own decisions.
formal.zh: 作者批评那些要求透明、却隐瞒自身决策的人的虚伪行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dejjem jgħidilna biex ma naħlux ikel, imma hu jarmi nofs l-ikla tiegħu. Lara: Dik ipokrezija; għandu jagħmel dak li jgħid.
colloquial.en: Maja: He always tells us not to waste food, but he throws away half his meal. Lara: That's hypocrisy; he should practise what he preaches.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他总叫我们别浪费食物，自己却把一半饭菜倒掉。Lara：这就是虚伪；他应该言行一致。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dejjem jgħidilna biex ma naħlux ikel, imma hu jarmi nofs l-ikla tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dejjem jgħidilna biex ma naħlux ikel, imma hu jarmi nofs l-ikla tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他总叫我们别浪费食物，自己却把一半饭菜倒掉。
messages.en: He always tells us not to waste food, but he throws away half his meal.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ipokrezija; għandu jagħmel dak li jgħid.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ipokrezija; għandu jagħmel dak li jgħid.
messages.zh: 这就是虚伪；他应该言行一致。
messages.en: That's hypocrisy; he should practise what he preaches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ipokrezija 配上“嘴上讲原则，行动却相反”的画面，记住它指言行不一的虚伪表现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of expressing moral beliefs or standards that one's own behaviour does not follow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宣扬某种道德信念或行为标准，自己却不遵守的伪善做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ipokrisija hija l-prattika li persuna tippriedka prinċipji morali li hija stess ma ssegwix fl-imġiba tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚伪；伪善；表面宣扬道德准则，而自身行为却违背这些准则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ipokrisija hija mġiba li fiha persuna turi bil-kliem li temmen f'ċerti valuri morali iżda tmur kontrihom bl-għemil tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hypocrisy occurs when someone publicly supports moral principles but behaves in ways that contradict those principles.

formal.mt: L-esej jeżamina l-ipokrisija soċjali ta' dawk li jitkellmu dwar l-ugwaljanza iżda jittrattaw lin-nies b'mod differenti skont il-ġid tagħhom.
formal.en: The essay examines the social hypocrisy of those who speak about equality but treat people differently according to their wealth.
formal.zh: 这篇文章探讨了一种社会伪善：有些人口头谈论平等，却根据他人的财富区别对待他们。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Jgħid li kulħadd għandu jkun puntwali, imma hu dejjem jasal tard. Nina: Dik ipokrisija. Ir-regola għandha tgħodd għalih ukoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: He says everyone should be punctual, but he always arrives late. Nina: That's hypocrisy. The rule should apply to him too.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他说每个人都应该守时，自己却总是迟到。Nina：这就是虚伪。规矩也应该适用于他。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħid li kulħadd għandu jkun puntwali, imma hu dejjem jasal tard.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħid li kulħadd għandu jkun puntwali, imma hu dejjem jasal tard.
messages.zh: 他说每个人都应该守时，自己却总是迟到。
messages.en: He says everyone should be punctual, but he always arrives late.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ipokrisija. Ir-regola għandha tgħodd għalih ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ipokrisija. Ir-regola għandha tgħodd għalih ukoll.
messages.zh: 这就是虚伪。规矩也应该适用于他。
messages.en: That's hypocrisy. The rule should apply to him too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“要求别人守规矩，自己却总破例”的情景记 ipokrisija，把注意力放在宣扬的标准与实际行为的矛盾上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who claims to have moral principles but acts against those principles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声称自己坚持某些道德原则，行为却违背这些原则的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ipokrita huwa persuna li tgħid li għandha ċerti prinċipji morali iżda ma timxix magħhom fl-għemil tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伪君子；表面宣扬道德原则，实际却不按这些原则行事的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ipokrita huwa min jippreżenta ruħu bħala persuna li tħaddan valuri morali iżda jaġixxi b'mod li jmur kontra dawk il-valuri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hypocrite is someone who claims to follow moral principles but acts in ways that contradict them.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru ewlieni jidher bħala ipokrita għax jipprietka l-onestà iżda jqarraq bil-kollegi tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character appears as a hypocrite because he preaches honesty but deceives his colleagues.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公显得是个伪君子，因为他宣扬诚实，却欺骗自己的同事。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qalli li l-gideb dejjem ħażin, u mbagħad gideb biex jevita x-xogħol. Lara: F'dik is-sitwazzjoni ġab ruħu ta' ipokrita.
colloquial.en: Mark: He told me lying is always wrong, and then he lied to get out of work. Lara: In that situation, he acted like a hypocrite.
colloquial.zh: Mark：他跟我说撒谎永远不对，随后却为了逃避工作而撒谎。Lara：在那件事上，他的表现就像个伪君子。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li l-gideb dejjem ħażin, u mbagħad gideb biex jevita x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li l-gideb dejjem ħażin, u mbagħad gideb biex jevita x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 他跟我说撒谎永远不对，随后却为了逃避工作而撒谎。
messages.en: He told me lying is always wrong, and then he lied to get out of work.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dik is-sitwazzjoni ġab ruħu ta' ipokrita.
messages.mt_standard: F'dik is-sitwazzjoni ġab ruħu ta' ipokrita.
messages.zh: 在那件事上，他的表现就像个伪君子。
messages.en: In that situation, he acted like a hypocrite.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ipokrita 时想象一个举着“诚实”标语却正在撒谎的人；这个词指做出虚伪行为的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A legal arrangement or right by which property serves as security for repayment of a loan or debt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以财产担保贷款或债务清偿的法律安排，或由此产生的抵押权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ipoteka hija arranġament jew dritt legali li bih proprjetà sservi bħala garanzija għall-ħlas lura ta' self jew dejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵押；通常以房屋等不动产担保贷款偿还的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ipoteka hija arranġament li fih proprjetà immobbli, bħal dar, tintuża bħala garanzija għall-ħlas lura ta' self.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mortgage is an arrangement in which property serves as security for a loan and may be claimed if repayment fails.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵押权；债权人就担保债务的财产享有的权利，而该财产仍由债务人占有。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ipoteka hija dritt ta' garanzija li jkollu kreditur fuq proprjetà għall-ħlas ta' dejn, waqt li l-proprjetà tibqa' fil-pussess tad-debitur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hypothec is a legal right over property securing a debt while possession of that property remains with the debtor.

collocations.en: a loan secured by a mortgage

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jiddeskrivi l-ipoteka fuq il-proprjetà bħala garanzija għall-ħlas lura tas-self.
formal.en: The contract describes the mortgage over the property as security for repayment of the loan.
formal.zh: 合同说明了该财产上用于担保贷款偿还的抵押权。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser ipoteka fuq id-dar? Mark: Tfisser li d-dar isservi bħala garanzija għas-self. Anna: Mela mhix l-istess ħaġa bħas-self innifsu. Mark: Eżatt, hija l-garanzija marbuta mal-proprjetà.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does a mortgage on the house mean? Mark: It means the house serves as security for the loan. Anna: So it isn't the same thing as the loan itself. Mark: Exactly, it's the security tied to the property.
colloquial.zh: Anna：房子上的抵押是什么意思？Mark：意思是用房子为贷款提供担保。Anna：所以它和贷款本身不是一回事。Mark：对，它是与财产相联系的担保。

messages.speaker: Anna (购房者)
messages.zh: 房子上的抵押是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a mortgage on the house mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li d-dar isservi bħala garanzija għas-self.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li d-dar isservi bħala garanzija għas-self.
messages.zh: 意思是用房子为贷款提供担保。
messages.en: It means the house serves as security for the loan.

messages.speaker: Anna (购房者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela mhix l-istess ħaġa bħas-self innifsu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela mhix l-istess ħaġa bħas-self innifsu.
messages.zh: 所以它和贷款本身不是一回事。
messages.en: So it isn't the same thing as the loan itself.

messages.speaker: Mark (银行职员)
messages.zh: 对，它是与财产相联系的担保。
messages.en: Exactly, it's the security tied to the property.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ipoteka 想成房屋图标旁的一张“债务担保”标签：mortgage 强调抵押安排，hypothec 强调财产仍由债务人占有时的担保权利。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a situation or idea that is imagined for discussion rather than established as fact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述为讨论或推理而设想、尚未确定为事实的情况或想法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi sitwazzjoni jew idea maħsuba għad-diskussjoni u mhux stabbilita bħala fatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 假设的；为讨论而设想、未被确认为事实的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ibbażat fuq sitwazzjoni immaġinata jew suppożizzjoni, aktar milli fuq fatt magħruf.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hypothetical situation is one that you imagine in order to discuss what might happen.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta każ ipotetiku biex jispjega l-effetti ta' żieda fil-prezzijiet.
formal.en: The report presents a hypothetical case to explain the effects of a rise in prices.
formal.zh: 报告提出一个假设案例，以说明价格上涨的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ġara tassew? Mark: Le, dan huwa biss eżempju ipotetiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did this really happen? Mark: No, this is just a hypothetical example.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这真的发生过吗？马克：没有，这只是一个假设性的例子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这真的发生过吗？
messages.en: Did this really happen?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan huwa biss eżempju ipotetiku.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan huwa biss eżempju ipotetiku.
messages.zh: 没有，这只是一个假设性的例子。
messages.en: No, this is just a hypothetical example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ipotetiku 和“先假设一个案例”一起记：看到 eżempju ipotetiku，就想到用来讨论的假想例子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as a noun in the supplied packet, with the gloss 'packed'; the form expresses 'I packed' in a sentence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条在所给数据中标为名词，释义为“打包好了”；该形式在句中表达“我打包了”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala nom fid-dejta mogħtija, iżda l-forma f'sentenza tesprimi li jien poġġejt affarijiet f'borża, f'bagalja jew f'kaxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打包好了；该形式在句中表示“我把东西装进了袋子、箱子或行李箱”。所给词性标签为名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma li tesprimi li jien poġġejt affarijiet f'borża, f'bagalja jew f'kaxxa; it-tikketta tal-kategorija grammatikali fid-dejta mogħtija hija nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This form expresses that I put belongings into a bag, suitcase, or box.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, ippakjajt id-dokumenti kollha f'borża separata.
formal.en: Before departure, I packed all the documents in a separate bag.
formal.zh: 出发前，我把所有文件装进了一个单独的袋子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek trid tippakkja l-bagalja? Mark: Le, ippakjajt kollox ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still need to pack your suitcase? Mark: No, I packed everything yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还需要收拾行李箱吗？马克：不用，我昨天已经把所有东西都打包好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还需要收拾行李箱吗？
messages.en: Do you still need to pack your suitcase?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不用，我昨天已经把所有东西都打包好了。
messages.en: No, I packed everything yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“我昨天打包好了”这句完整的话记住 ippakjajt；想象自己合上行李箱，帮助记住句中“我打包了”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Put clothes, belongings, or goods into a bag, suitcase, or box ready for carrying or storage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣服、随身物品或货物装进袋子、行李箱或箱子，以便携带或存放；所给释义表示已经打包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Poġġa ħwejjeġ, affarijiet personali jew prodotti f'borża, f'bagalja jew f'kaxxa biex ikunu lesti għall-ġarr jew għall-ħażna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把物品打包了，或装进了袋子、行李箱、箱子等容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Poġġa affarijiet f'borża, f'bagalja jew f'kaxxa sabiex ikunu jistgħu jinġarru jew jinħażnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone packed belongings, they put them into bags or containers ready to be moved or stored.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ippakkja l-prodotti f'kaxxi qabel it-trasport.
formal.en: The worker packed the products in boxes before transport.
formal.zh: 工人在运输前把产品装进了箱子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark lest għall-vjaġġ? Lara: Iva, ippakkja l-bagalja dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark ready for the trip? Lara: Yes, he packed his suitcase this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克准备好出行了吗？劳拉：好了，他今天早上已经收拾好行李箱了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克准备好出行了吗？
messages.en: Is Mark ready for the trip?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好了，他今天早上已经收拾好行李箱了。
messages.en: Yes, he packed his suitcase this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ippakkja 放进行李场景记忆：衣服入箱、拉上拉链，对应“他打包了”；搭配 l-bagalja 一起朗读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine two or more things together in order to identify their similarities and differences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把两个或多个事物放在一起考察，以找出它们的相同点和不同点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeżamina żewġ affarijiet jew aktar flimkien biex jara x'għandhom komuni u kif huma differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比较；对照考察两个或多个事物的相同点与不同点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jeżamina żewġ affarijiet jew aktar biex jagħraf ix-xebh u d-differenzi bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you compare things, you examine them together to see how they are similar or different.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ipparaguna r-riżultati taż-żewġ studji biex jidentifika d-differenzi.
formal.en: The researcher compared the results of the two studies to identify the differences.
formal.zh: 研究人员比较了两项研究的结果，以找出其中的差异。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark għażel dan it-telefon? Lara: Ipparaguna żewġ mudelli u dan għoġbu aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark choose this phone? Lara: He compared two models and liked this one more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么选了这部手机？劳拉：他比较了两款机型，更喜欢这一款。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么选了这部手机？
messages.en: Why did Mark choose this phone?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipparaguna żewġ mudelli u dan għoġbu aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Ipparaguna żewġ mudelli u dan għoġbu aktar.
messages.zh: 他比较了两款机型，更喜欢这一款。
messages.en: He compared two models and liked this one more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两部手机并排放着，逐项比较价格和功能；用这个画面把 ipparaguna 与“比较、对比”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put things together because they form a suitable or corresponding pair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据相同特征或对应关系，把物品配成合适的一对。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed affarijiet flimkien għax jaqblu ma' xulxin jew jiffurmaw par.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把相互对应或适合搭配的事物配成一对。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad żewġ affarijiet li jaqblu ma' xulxin biex jiffurmaw par.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you match things, you put them together because they correspond or belong together.

collocations.en: match each lid with its container
collocations.zh: 把每个盖子与对应的容器配好

formal.mt: Qabel l-ippakkjar, il-ħaddiem ippariġġa kull għatu mal-kontenitur tiegħu.
formal.en: Before packing, the worker matched each lid with its container.
formal.zh: 包装前，工人把每个盖子与对应的容器配好。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min ippariġġa l-kalzetti? Pawlu: Jien! Issa kull par qiegħed flimkien fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who paired up the socks? Pawlu: I did! Now each pair is together in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁把袜子配好对了？保罗：我呀！现在每双都放在抽屉里，成对放好了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把袜子配好对了？
messages.en: Who paired up the socks?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Issa kull par qiegħed flimkien fil-kexxun.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Issa kull par qiegħed flimkien fil-kexxun.
messages.zh: 我呀！现在每双都放在抽屉里，成对放好了。
messages.en: I did! Now each pair is together in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象整理袜子的画面：找出相配的两只，放成一对，用这个动作记住“配对”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put someone or something in danger of harm, damage, or loss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物面临受伤、损坏或遭受损失的危险。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa f'riskju ta' ħsara jew telf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 危及某人或某物，使其处于可能受到伤害或损害的境地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqiegħed lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa f'sitwazzjoni fejn tista' ssirilha ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone endangers a person or thing, they put that person or thing at risk of harm.

collocations.en: endanger the safety of the passengers

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq ipperikola s-sigurtà tal-passiġġieri meta saq b'veloċità eċċessiva.
formal.en: The driver endangered the safety of the passengers by driving at excessive speed.
formal.zh: 司机超速驾驶，危及乘客的安全。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt lil Mark jaqsam it-triq mingħajr ma ħares? Ġanni: Iva, ipperikola ħajtu għalxejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see Mark cross the road without looking? Ġanni: Yes, he put his life in danger for no reason.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看见马克没看路就过马路了吗？詹尼：看见了，他这样白白让自己的生命陷入危险。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil Mark jaqsam it-triq mingħajr ma ħares?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil Mark jaqsam it-triq mingħajr ma ħares?
messages.zh: 你看见马克没看路就过马路了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Mark cross the road without looking?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了，他这样白白让自己的生命陷入危险。
messages.en: Yes, he put his life in danger for no reason.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“危及”记成一个动作：鲁莽驾驶把别人推入危险，画面中的“制造危险”就是这个词的重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone permission to do something or to let something happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准许某人做某事，或允许某种行为、事情发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd il-permess li jagħmel xi ħaġa jew iħalli xi ħaġa ssir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予许可，让某人能够做某事或让某事得以进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti permess biex persuna tagħmel xi ħaġa jew biex attività tkun tista' ssir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone allows you to do something, they give you permission to do it.

collocations.en: allow the use of the computer

formal.mt: Id-direttur ippermetta lill-istudenti jużaw il-librerija wara l-ħin tal-iskola.
formal.en: The headteacher allowed the students to use the library after school hours.
formal.zh: 校长允许学生在放学后使用图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Missierek ippermetta li nużaw il-kompjuter tiegħu? Luqa: Iva, imma talabna noqogħdu attenti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did your father allow us to use his computer? Luqa: Yes, but he asked us to be careful.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你爸爸允许我们用他的电脑了吗？卢卡：允许了，不过他让我们小心使用。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missierek ippermetta li nużaw il-kompjuter tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Missierek ippermetta li nużaw il-kompjuter tiegħu?
messages.zh: 你爸爸允许我们用他的电脑了吗？
messages.en: Did your father allow us to use his computer?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 允许了，不过他让我们小心使用。
messages.en: Yes, but he asked us to be careful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先举手请求，再得到点头许可：把“得到允许后可以做”的场景与这个词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep trying to achieve something despite difficulties or delays.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尽管遇到困难或进展缓慢，仍持续努力，不轻易放弃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikompli jistinka biex jilħaq għan minkejja d-diffikultajiet jew id-dewmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在困难面前坚持努力，持续做下去而不放弃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikompli fl-isforzi tiegħu b'determinazzjoni u ma jaqtax qalbu meta jiltaqa' ma' diffikultajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone perseveres, they continue trying to achieve a goal despite difficulties or setbacks.

collocations.zh: 尽管困难重重仍坚持不懈

formal.mt: L-istudent ippersevera fl-istudju minkejja d-diffikultajiet u fl-aħħar għadda mill-eżami.
formal.en: The student persevered in his studies despite the difficulties and eventually passed the examination.
formal.zh: 这名学生尽管遇到困难仍坚持学习，最终通过了考试。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif irnexxielu Ben jitgħallem idoqq il-kitarra? Marija: Ipp ersevera anki meta kien diffiċli, u pprattika kuljum.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Ben manage to learn to play the guitar? Marija: He persevered even when it was difficult, and he practised every day.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：本是怎么学会弹吉他的？玛丽亚：即使觉得难，他也坚持了下来，每天都练习。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielu Ben jitgħallem idoqq il-kitarra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielu Ben jitgħallem idoqq il-kitarra?
messages.zh: 本是怎么学会弹吉他的？
messages.en: How did Ben manage to learn to play the guitar?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipp ersevera anki meta kien diffiċli, u pprattika kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Ipp ersevera anki meta kien diffiċli, u pprattika kuljum.
messages.zh: 即使觉得难，他也坚持了下来，每天都练习。
messages.en: He persevered even when it was difficult, and he practised every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象练吉他时反复弹错，却每天继续练习：用“遇到困难仍继续努力”的连续画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To decide in advance what to do and how to do it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先决定要做什么、如何进行，并安排相关步骤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeċiedi minn qabel x'se tagħmel u kif se tagħmlu, u torganizza l-passi meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计划；事先考虑并安排某项活动的内容、方法或步骤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħseb minn qabel dwar attività jew biċċa xogħol u tiddeċiedi kif se twettaqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you plan something, you decide beforehand what you will do and how you will do it.

formal.mt: Il-maniġer ippjana l-proġett fid-dettall qabel ma bdiet il-ħidma.
formal.en: The manager planned the project in detail before work began.
formal.zh: 经理在工作开始前详细规划了这个项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irridu mmorru Għawdex fi tmiem il-ġimgħa. Mark: Ippjana l-vjaġġ illum, u jien nara l-ħinijiet tal-vapur.
colloquial.en: Maja: We want to go to Gozo this weekend. Mark: Plan the trip today, and I'll check the ferry times.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们想这周末去戈佐岛。马克：你今天安排一下行程，我来查渡轮时刻。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irridu mmorru Għawdex fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Irridu mmorru Għawdex fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 我们想这周末去戈佐岛。
messages.en: We want to go to Gozo this weekend.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ippjana l-vjaġġ illum, u jien nara l-ħinijiet tal-vapur.
messages.mt_standard: Ippjana l-vjaġġ illum, u jien nara l-ħinijiet tal-vapur.
messages.zh: 你今天安排一下行程，我来查渡轮时刻。
messages.en: Plan the trip today, and I'll check the ferry times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ippjana 和出发前画路线、列步骤的画面绑定：先想清楚怎样做，就是“计划”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Decided, prepared, or arranged in advance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先已经决定、筹划或安排好的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie deċiż, imħejji jew organizzat minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计划好的；指某事已事先经过考虑、筹划或安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun sar pjan għalih u jkun ġie organizzat qabel ma jseħħ jew jitwettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is planned has been decided or arranged before it happens.

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol ippjanat fuq il-pont se jibda nhar it-Tnejn u jdum tlett ijiem.
formal.en: The planned work on the bridge will begin on Monday and last three days.
formal.zh: 预先安排的桥梁施工将于星期一开始，持续三天。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek xi ħaġa ippjanata għal għada? David: Iva, għandi vjaġġ ippjanat mal-familja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you got anything planned for tomorrow? David: Yes, I have a trip planned with my family.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你明天有什么安排吗？戴维：有，我已经安排好和家人去旅行。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi ħaġa ippjanata għal għada?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi ħaġa ippjanata għal għada?
messages.zh: 你明天有什么安排吗？
messages.en: Have you got anything planned for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我已经安排好和家人去旅行。
messages.en: Yes, I have a trip planned with my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ippjanat 想成日历上已经填好的行程：重点是“安排好了”的状态；搭配 vjaġġ ippjanat 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move an arranged event or activity to a later time or date.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把原定的活动或事项改到较晚的时间或日期进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tmexxi attività jew avveniment minn ħin jew data stabbilita għal ħin jew data aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推迟；将原定要进行的事情延后处理或举行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeċiedi li xi ħaġa li kienet se ssir f'ħin jew f'data partikolari ssir aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you postpone an event or activity, you arrange for it to happen later than originally intended.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ippospona l-laqgħa għall-ġimgħa d-dieħla sabiex il-membri jkollhom aktar ħin biex jistudjaw ir-rapport.
formal.en: The committee postponed the meeting until next week so that members would have more time to study the report.
formal.zh: 委员会把会议推迟到下周，以便成员有更多时间研究报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad għandi d-deni, imma l-vjaġġ hu għada. Ben: Ippospona l-vjaġġ għal ftit jiem, sakemm tħossok aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: I still have a fever, but the trip is tomorrow. Ben: Postpone the trip for a few days, until you feel better.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我还在发烧，可旅行就定在明天。本：把旅行推迟几天，等你好些再去。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandi d-deni, imma l-vjaġġ hu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandi d-deni, imma l-vjaġġ hu għada.
messages.zh: 我还在发烧，可旅行就定在明天。
messages.en: I still have a fever, but the trip is tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ippospona l-vjaġġ għal ftit jiem, sakemm tħossok aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ippospona l-vjaġġ għal ftit jiem, sakemm tħossok aħjar.
messages.zh: 把旅行推迟几天，等你好些再去。
messages.en: Postpone the trip for a few days, until you feel better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ippospona 时，想象把日历上的会议贴纸往后挪几格：日期向后移动，就是“推迟”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To own something or have it in one's possession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有某物，或将某物持有在自己手中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollok xi ħaġa bħala proprjetà tiegħek jew fil-pussess tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥有；持有某物，尤其指财物或其他归自己所有的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollok xi ħaġa li tkun tiegħek jew li tkun qiegħda fil-pussess tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you possess something, you own it or have it in your possession.

formal.mt: Skont id-dokumenti tal-familja, in-nannu ippossieda biċċa art qrib ir-raħal għal aktar minn tletin sena.
formal.en: According to the family documents, the grandfather possessed a plot of land near the village for more than thirty years.
formal.zh: 根据家族文件，祖父曾拥有村庄附近的一块土地，持有时间超过三十年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min kien sid din id-dar qabel? Pawlu: Iz-ziju tiegħi ippossieda din id-dar għal ħafna snin, imbagħad biegħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who owned this house before? Pawlu: My uncle possessed this house for many years, then sold it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这所房子以前是谁的？保罗：我叔叔拥有这所房子很多年，后来把它卖了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kien sid din id-dar qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Min kien sid din id-dar qabel?
messages.zh: 这所房子以前是谁的？
messages.en: Who owned this house before?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-ziju tiegħi ippossieda din id-dar għal ħafna snin, imbagħad biegħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iz-ziju tiegħi ippossieda din id-dar għal ħafna snin, imbagħad biegħha.
messages.zh: 我叔叔拥有这所房子很多年，后来把它卖了。
messages.en: My uncle possessed this house for many years, then sold it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ippossieda 与“房子归谁所有”的问题绑定，再配上手握房门钥匙的画面，记住“拥有、持有”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To repeat an activity or exercise in order to improve a skill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了提高某项技能而反复进行活动或训练。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel attività jew eżerċizzju ripetutament sabiex itejjeb il-ħila tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过反复练习来提高技能或熟练程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ħafna drabi sabiex jitgħallem jagħmilha aħjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you practice an activity, you do it repeatedly in order to become better at it.

formal.mt: L-istudent ipprattika l-pronunzja tal-kliem il-ġdid qabel il-preżentazzjoni.
formal.en: The student practiced pronouncing the new words before the presentation.
formal.zh: 学生在展示前练习了新词的发音。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadni nitħawwad meta ngħid din il-kelma. Mark: Ipprattika bil-mod, u mbagħad għidha f'sentenza.
colloquial.en: Lara: I still get mixed up when I say this word. Mark: Practice slowly, and then say it in a sentence.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我说这个词时还是会弄混。马克：慢慢练，然后把它放进句子里说。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nitħawwad meta ngħid din il-kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nitħawwad meta ngħid din il-kelma.
messages.zh: 我说这个词时还是会弄混。
messages.en: I still get mixed up when I say this word.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprattika bil-mod, u mbagħad għidha f'sentenza.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprattika bil-mod, u mbagħad għidha f'sentenza.
messages.zh: 慢慢练，然后把它放进句子里说。
messages.en: Practice slowly, and then say it in a sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ipprattika 和每天开口练发音的画面连起来：一次不熟就再练一次，重点记住“反复练习以提高技能”。

gloss_zh: 练习过的；经常实行的；惯常进行的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Done or made familiar through practice, or regularly carried out as a habit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过练习而熟悉或熟练的；也指经常实行、成为惯常做法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun sar jew tgħallem permezz tal-prattika, jew li jsir regolarment bħala drawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过练习的；通过反复操练而熟悉或熟练的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie ripetut fit-taħriġ sabiex ikun jista' jsir b'aktar ħila.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A practiced movement or skill is one that has become familiar or effective through repeated training.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯常进行的；作为习惯而经常实行的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jsir ta' spiss jew b'mod regolari bħala parti minn drawwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something habitually done is carried out regularly as part of an established routine.

formal.mt: Il-qari filgħaxija huwa ritwal ipprattikat regolarment f'din il-familja.
formal.en: Evening reading is a ritual regularly practiced in this family.
formal.zh: 晚间阅读是这个家庭惯常进行的一项仪式。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan jidher moviment ipprattikat sew! Pawlu: Iva, għamiltu ħafna drabi waqt it-taħriġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: That looks like a well-practiced movement! Paul: Yes, I did it many times during training.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个动作看起来练得很熟了！保罗：是啊，我训练时做过很多遍。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个动作看起来练得很熟了！
messages.en: That looks like a well-practiced movement!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (运动员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għamiltu ħafna drabi waqt it-taħriġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għamiltu ħafna drabi waqt it-taħriġ.
messages.zh: 是啊，我训练时做过很多遍。
messages.en: Yes, I did it many times during training.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 ipprattikat：训练中反复做熟的动作，以及每天照常进行的仪式；分别对应“练过的”和“惯常实行的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To like or choose one thing more than another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相比另一个选项，更喜欢或更愿意选择某人、某物或某种做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jogħġbu jew jagħżel persuna, ħaġa jew mod ta' kif jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar minn oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比较不同选项时更喜欢其中一个；优先选择。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħżel xi ħaġa minflok oħra għax togħġbu aktar jew jaħseb li hi aktar adattata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you prefer one thing to another, you like it more or consider it more suitable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更愿意选择某事物或做某事，而不是另一个选项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun aktar jixtieq ħaġa jew azzjoni minn oħra u jagħtiha l-ewwel għażla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you prefer to do something, you would rather do it than choose an alternative.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ipprefera l-ewwel proposta għax kienet aktar ċara u inqas għalja.
formal.en: The committee preferred the first proposal because it was clearer and less expensive.
formal.zh: 委员会更倾向于第一份提案，因为它更清楚，费用也更低。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex David ma ġiex magħna? Toni: Ipprefera jibqa' d-dar u jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maria: Why didn't David come with us? Tony: He preferred to stay at home and rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：戴维为什么没跟我们来？托尼：他更愿意待在家里休息。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 戴维为什么没跟我们来？
messages.en: Why didn't David come with us?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他更愿意待在家里休息。
messages.en: He preferred to stay at home and rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ipprefera 放进二选一的场景：面前有茶和咖啡，他把手伸向更喜欢的那杯；用“比较之后更愿意选”来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To favor one option over another; used here to tell someone which option to choose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相比其他选项更倾向于某一个；此形式可用于指示对方优先选择某物或某种做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħżel ħaġa minflok oħra għax togħġbok aktar jew tqisha aħjar; din il-forma tintuża biex tgħid lil xi ħadd jagħmel din l-għażla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更喜欢某个选项；认为其更合适而优先选择。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti l-ewwel għażla lil ħaġa jew azzjoni minflok oħra għax togħġbok aktar jew hi aktar adattata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you prefer an option, you favor it because you like it more or find it more suitable.

collocations.en: choose water in preference to other drinks

collocations.zh: 优先考虑质量而非数量

formal.mt: Meta tixtri materjal għall-kors, ippreferi kotba b'eżempji ċari u eżerċizzji utli.
formal.en: When buying materials for the course, give preference to books with clear examples and useful exercises.
formal.zh: 购买课程材料时，优先选择例子清楚、练习实用的书。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema flokk nixtri għal ġurnata sħuna? Marija: Ippreferi wieħed tal-qoton; ikun aktar komdu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which top should I buy for a hot day? Maria: Go for a cotton one; it will be more comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：天热时穿的上衣，我该买哪种？玛丽亚：优先选棉质的吧，穿起来会更舒服。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema flokk nixtri għal ġurnata sħuna?
messages.mt_standard: Liema flokk nixtri għal ġurnata sħuna?
messages.zh: 天热时穿的上衣，我该买哪种？
messages.en: Which top should I buy for a hot day?

messages.speaker: Marija (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ippreferi wieħed tal-qoton; ikun aktar komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Ippreferi wieħed tal-qoton; ikun aktar komdu.
messages.zh: 优先选棉质的吧，穿起来会更舒服。
messages.en: Go for a cotton one; it will be more comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店员指着更合适的棉质上衣说 ippreferi：把它记成对一个人说的“优先选这个吧”，将词形和选择建议连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange in advance for a room, seat, service, or appointment to be reserved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先安排并保留房间、座位、服务或预约时段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tirriżerva minn qabel kamra, post, servizz jew ħin għal appuntament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预订房间、座位或服务，或预约某个时段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel arranġament minn qabel biex kamra, post, servizz jew appuntament jinżamm għalik.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you book something, you arrange in advance for it to be reserved for you.

collocations.en: booked a room in a hotel

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant ipprenota kamra fil-lukanda għall-jumejn tal-konferenza.
formal.en: The participant booked a room at the hotel for the two days of the conference.
formal.zh: 该参会者为会议的两天预订了酒店客房。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ipprenota l-mejda għal-lejla? Mark: Jien ipprenotajt mejda għal tnejn fit-tmienja. Maja: Tajjeb, niltaqgħu hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who booked the table for tonight? Mark: I booked a table for two at eight. Maja: Great, let's meet there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚的餐桌是谁订的？Mark：我订了八点的双人桌。Maja：好，我们在那里见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚的餐桌是谁订的？
messages.en: Who booked the table for tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ipprenotajt mejda għal tnejn fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ipprenotajt mejda għal tnejn fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 我订了八点的双人桌。
messages.en: I booked a table for two at eight.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们在那里见。
messages.en: Great, let's meet there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上提前圈定日期，再把餐桌或客房留好：ipprenota 的重点是提前预订。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something ready for use or for an activity that will take place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物准备好，使其能够使用，或为即将进行的活动做好安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa lesta biex tintuża jew biex issir attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准备或安排某物，使其可以使用或用于接下来的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħejji xi ħaġa u tagħmilha lesta għall-użu jew għal attività li tkun se ssir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you prepare something, you make it ready for a particular use or occasion.

collocations.en: prepared the material for the lesson

formal.mt: L-għalliem ipprepara l-materjal kollu qabel il-bidu tal-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher prepared all the material before the lesson began.
formal.zh: 老师在上课前准备好了全部材料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ipprepara l-ikel? Pawlu: Jien. Kollox lest, nistgħu nieklu. Sara: Ħa nġib il-platti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who prepared the food? Pawlu: I did. Everything is ready; we can eat. Sara: I'll get the plates.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁准备的饭？Pawlu：我。都准备好了，可以吃了。Sara：我去拿盘子。
