messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁准备的饭？
messages.en: Who prepared the food?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我。都准备好了，可以吃了。
messages.en: I did. Everything is ready; we can eat.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 我去拿盘子。
messages.en: I'll get the plates.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把食材摆好、把讲义备齐，都可以联想到 ipprepara：让事情进入可以开始的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply physical force to something, or to pressure someone to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对物体施力挤压或压紧；也指向某人施加压力，促使其行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħfas xi ħaġa b'forza fiżika, jew tagħmel pressjoni fuq persuna biex taġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对物体施加压力，将其压紧、压平或压实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħfas xi ħaġa b'forza biex tiċċattjaha, tikkompattaha jew iżżommha magħfusa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you press something, you apply physical force to it to flatten or compress it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人施压，催促或迫使其采取行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel pressjoni fuq persuna biex tagħmel xi ħaġa jew tieħu deċiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you put pressure on someone, you try to make them act or decide as you want.

collocations.en: pressed the material into a mould
put pressure on the workers to hurry
collocations.zh: 向工人施压，催促他们加快速度

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ippressa l-materjal fil-forma sakemm ħa l-għamla mixtieqa.
formal.en: The worker pressed the material into the mould until it took the desired shape.
formal.zh: 工人将材料压入模具，直到材料形成所需的形状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kap ippressak biex tispiċċa llum? Mark: Iva, imma għedtlu li għandi bżonn ġurnata oħra. Lara: Sewwa għamilt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the boss put pressure on you to finish today? Mark: Yes, but I told him I need another day. Lara: You did the right thing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：老板向你施压，要你今天完成吗？Mark：是的，不过我告诉他，我还需要一天。Lara：你这样做是对的。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 老板向你施压，要你今天完成吗？
messages.en: Did the boss put pressure on you to finish today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għedtlu li għandi bżonn ġurnata oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għedtlu li għandi bżonn ġurnata oħra.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我告诉他，我还需要一天。
messages.en: Yes, but I told him I need another day.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你这样做是对的。
messages.en: You did the right thing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想双手把材料压紧，再想催促使人感到压力：用这两个画面区分实物的压和对人的施压。

gloss_zh: 提出主张；声称；期望；要求

teaching_sense.en_definition: To assert a claim, or to expect something as a requirement or entitlement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提出主张或声称自己具有某种权利；也指期望或要求某事发生、某人达到某种标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tressaq pretensjoni jew issostni li għandek dritt għal xi ħaġa, jew tistenna li ssir xi ħaġa jew jintlaħaq ċertu livell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提出主张或声称某事属实，尤其是声称自己享有某种权利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tressaq pretensjoni jew issostni li xi ħaġa hija vera, speċjalment li għandek dritt għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you make a claim, you state that something is true or that you have a particular right.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 期望或要求某人做某事，或认为某种结果、待遇或标准理应实现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tistenna li persuna tagħmel xi ħaġa jew li jingħata trattament jew jintlaħaq livell li tqis xieraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you expect something from someone, you consider that they should provide it or behave in that way.

collocations.en: claimed that he had a right to the land
collocations.zh: 声称自己对那块土地享有权利

collocations.en: expected everyone to arrive on time

formal.mt: Ir-raġel ippretenda li kellu dritt juża l-art, iżda ma ppreżenta ebda dokument biex isostni l-pretensjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The man claimed that he had a right to use the land, but presented no document to support his claim.
formal.zh: 该男子声称自己有权使用那块土地，但没有出示任何文件来支持这一主张。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kap ippretenda li tlestu kollox illum? Pawlu: Iva, imma għednielu li għandna bżonn aktar ħin. Nina: Nifhem, ix-xogħol irid isir sew.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did the boss expect you to finish everything today? Pawlu: Yes, but we told him we need more time. Nina: I understand; the work needs to be done properly.
colloquial.zh: Nina：老板要求你们今天把所有事情都做完吗？Pawlu：是的，不过我们告诉他，我们需要更多时间。Nina：我理解，工作得做好。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kap ippretenda li tlestu kollox illum?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kap ippretenda li tlestu kollox illum?
messages.zh: 老板要求你们今天把所有事情都做完吗？
messages.en: Did the boss expect you to finish everything today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għednielu li għandna bżonn aktar ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għednielu li għandna bżonn aktar ħin.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我们告诉他，我们需要更多时间。
messages.en: Yes, but we told him we need more time.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 我理解，工作得做好。
messages.en: I understand; the work needs to be done properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两句中文对应记忆：主张时说我有这个权利，期望时说你应该做到；看到 ippretenda 就根据语境选择。

gloss_zh: 预期之事；预料中的情况

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that has been expected or foreseen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先已经预料到或预计会出现的事物或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jkun ġie mistenni jew previst minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预料之中的事物；预计会发生的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li wieħed ikun stenna jew bassar qabel ma jseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something anticipated is something that people have expected or foreseen before it happens.

collocations.en: in accordance with what was anticipated

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel l-ipprevenut ma' dak li seħħ fil-fatt.
formal.en: The report compares what was anticipated with what actually happened.
formal.zh: 报告将预期情况与实际发生的情况进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak li seħħ kien jaqbel mal-ipprevenut? Pawlu: Iva, kollox mexa kif stennejna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did what happened match what was anticipated? Pawlu: Yes, everything went as we expected.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：实际情况符合预期吗？保罗：符合，一切都按我们预想的进行。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li seħħ kien jaqbel mal-ipprevenut?
messages.mt_standard: Dak li seħħ kien jaqbel mal-ipprevenut?
messages.zh: 实际情况符合预期吗？
messages.en: Did what happened match what was anticipated?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 符合，一切都按我们预想的进行。
messages.en: Yes, everything went as we expected.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本条名词义想成计划表里的“预期情况”，再与实际结果并排比较，记住它指预料中的事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pricing method in which prices change in response to demand, availability, or other conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据需求、供应情况或其他条件的变化调整价格的定价方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metodu ta' ffissar tal-prezzijiet li fih il-prezzijiet jinbidlu skont id-domanda, id-disponibbiltà jew kundizzjonijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动态定价，即随着需求、可供数量或其他条件的变化而调整商品或服务价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li biha l-prezz ta' prodott jew servizz jiġi aġġustat skont bidliet fid-domanda, fil-kwantità disponibbli jew f'kundizzjonijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dynamic pricing is a system in which the price of a product or service changes as demand or other conditions change.

formal.mt: Il-lukanda tuża sistema ta' pprezzar dinamiku biex taġġusta l-prezzijiet tal-kmamar skont id-domanda.
formal.en: The hotel uses a dynamic pricing system to adjust room prices according to demand.
formal.zh: 这家酒店采用动态定价系统，根据需求调整客房价格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kamra tiswa aktar illum milli lbieraħ? Mark: Il-lukanda tuża l-ipprezzar dinamiku; il-prezz jinbidel skont id-domanda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the room cost more today than yesterday? Mark: The hotel uses dynamic pricing; the price changes according to demand.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么这间客房今天比昨天贵？马克：酒店采用动态定价，价格会随着需求变化。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kamra tiswa aktar illum milli lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kamra tiswa aktar illum milli lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 为什么这间客房今天比昨天贵？
messages.en: Why does the room cost more today than yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lukanda tuża l-ipprezzar dinamiku; il-prezz jinbidel skont id-domanda.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lukanda tuża l-ipprezzar dinamiku; il-prezz jinbidel skont id-domanda.
messages.zh: 酒店采用动态定价，价格会随着需求变化。
messages.en: The hotel uses dynamic pricing; the price changes according to demand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把价格牌想成会随需求移动的滑块：需求变化，价格跟着调整，这就是“动态定价”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show or introduce something to an audience, or to submit something for consideration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向听众展示或介绍某事物，或将文件等提交给有关人员审阅或处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri jew jintroduċi xi ħaġa lil udjenza, jew iressaq dokument jew materjal ieħor biex jiġi eżaminat jew ikkunsidrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向他人展示、介绍某事物；将文件、申请等正式提交以供审阅或处理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Juri jew jispjega xi ħaġa quddiem oħrajn, jew iressaq dokument, talba jew applikazzjoni lil min għandu jeżaminaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you present something, you show or explain it to others, or formally submit it for consideration.

collocations.zh: 作了报告或提交了报告

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ippreżenta r-riżultati tiegħu waqt il-konferenza u mbagħad ippreżenta rapport lill-kumitat.
formal.en: The researcher presented his results at the conference and then submitted a report to the committee.
formal.zh: 研究人员在会议上展示了研究结果，随后向委员会提交了一份报告。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min ippreżenta l-proġett illum? Ġanni: Pawlu ppreżentah, u spjega kollox ċar ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who presented the project today? Ġanni: Pawlu presented it, and he explained everything very clearly.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：今天是谁介绍这个项目的？詹尼：保罗介绍的，他把所有内容都讲得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 今天是谁介绍这个项目的？
messages.en: Who presented the project today?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ppreżentah, u spjega kollox ċar ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ppreżentah, u spjega kollox ċar ħafna.
messages.zh: 保罗介绍的，他把所有内容都讲得很清楚。
messages.en: Pawlu presented it, and he explained everything very clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一份报告的两个动作：上台展示，再交给委员会；用这幅画面一起记住“展示”和“提交”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give a religious talk that explains beliefs or encourages people to follow religious teachings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过宗教讲说阐释信仰，或劝勉听众遵循宗教教导。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel diskors reliġjuż li jispjega t-twemmin jew iħeġġeġ lin-nies biex jimxu mat-tagħlim reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向听众宣讲宗教教义，通常通过讲道阐释信仰并给予劝勉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ixandar tagħlim reliġjuż quddiem udjenza, normalment permezz ta' prietka li tispjega t-twemmin u tagħti pariri dwar il-ħajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone preaches, they give a religious talk to explain beliefs and encourage people to follow those teachings.

formal.mt: Il-qassis ipprietka dwar il-maħfra u ħeġġeġ lill-komunità biex tgħin lil min hu fil-bżonn.
formal.en: The priest preached about forgiveness and encouraged the community to help those in need.
formal.zh: 神父以宽恕为主题讲道，并鼓励会众帮助有需要的人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fuq xiex ipprietka l-qassis illum? Luqa: Dwar il-maħfra; qal li għandna nagħtu ċans ieħor lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did the priest preach about today? Luqa: Forgiveness; he said we should give each other another chance.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：神父今天讲道的主题是什么？卢卡：宽恕；他说我们应该再给彼此一次机会。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 神父今天讲道的主题是什么？
messages.en: What did the priest preach about today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-maħfra; qal li għandna nagħtu ċans ieħor lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-maħfra; qal li għandna nagħtu ċans ieħor lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 宽恕；他说我们应该再给彼此一次机会。
messages.en: Forgiveness; he said we should give each other another chance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象神父站在讲台上向会众讲解宽恕：把“讲台、教义、劝勉”连成画面，记住“讲道”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put text or images onto paper using a printer or printing machine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用打印机或印刷设备将文字或图像印在纸上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel kopja ta' test jew stampa fuq il-karta permezz ta' printer jew magna tal-istampar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用打印机或印刷设备把文字或图像印到纸上。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Joħroġ test jew stampi fuq il-karta billi juża printer jew magna tal-istampar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you print a document or picture, you use a machine to make a copy of it on paper.

formal.mt: Is-segretarju ipprintja kopja tar-rapport għal kull membru tal-kumitat.
formal.en: The secretary printed a copy of the report for each committee member.
formal.zh: 秘书为每位委员会成员打印了一份报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ipprintja dawn ir-ritratti? Mark: Ħija ipprintjahom dalgħodu. Trid kopja?
colloquial.en: Lara: Who printed these photos? Mark: My brother printed them this morning. Would you like a copy?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些照片是谁打印的？马克：我哥哥今天早上打印的。你想要一份吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些照片是谁打印的？
messages.en: Who printed these photos?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥今天早上打印的。你想要一份吗？
messages.en: My brother printed them this morning. Would you like a copy?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ipprintja 与“文件从屏幕变成纸张”的画面绑定，再用 ipprintja dokument 整块记忆；词中的 print 可作为英语联想提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take something important away from someone or prevent them from having it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剥夺某人拥有或享有某种重要事物的机会，使其失去该事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċaħħad lil xi ħadd minn xi ħaġa importanti billi jeħodhielu jew ma jħallihx ikollu jew igawdiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥夺某人所拥有或应能享有的事物；使某人无法获得或享受某事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċaħħad lil persuna minn xi ħaġa li għandha, li teħtieġ jew li għandha dritt għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something deprives you of something, they take it away or prevent you from having or enjoying it.

collocations.mt: ippriva lil xi ħadd minn opportunità
collocations.zh: 使某人失去了一次机会

formal.mt: L-għeluq tal-librerija ippriva lill-istudenti minn post kwiet fejn jistudjaw.
formal.en: The closure of the library deprived students of a quiet place to study.
formal.zh: 图书馆关闭使学生失去了一个安静的学习场所。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex tidher daqshekk għajjien? Pawlu: L-istorbju tat-triq ipprivani mill-irqad il-lejl kollu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you look so tired? Pawlu: The street noise deprived me of sleep all night.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么看起来这么累？保罗：街上的噪声让我整晚都没睡成。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么看起来这么累？
messages.en: Why do you look so tired?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-istorbju tat-triq ipprivani mill-irqad il-lejl kollu.
messages.mt_standard: L-istorbju tat-triq ipprivani mill-irqad il-lejl kollu.
messages.zh: 街上的噪声让我整晚都没睡成。
messages.en: The street noise deprived me of sleep all night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“某人失去了什么”的场景：ippriva 后找被剥夺的人，再找以 minn 引出的事物；例如自由、机会或睡眠。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make or create something, or cause a result to occur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制造或创作某种事物，或使某种结果产生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel jew joħloq xi ħaġa permezz ta' xogħol jew proċess, jew iwassal għal riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生产、制作或创作某物；通过某种活动或过程产生结果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel prodotti jew joħloq xogħol, jew iġib riżultat permezz ta' attività jew proċess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a person, organization, or process produces something, they make it, create it, or cause it to exist.

formal.mt: L-impjant ipproduċa biżżejjed elettriku biex jissodisfa l-ħtiġijiet tal-fabbrika.
formal.en: The plant produced enough electricity to meet the factory's needs.
formal.zh: 该发电设施产生了足够的电力，满足了工厂的需求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ipproduċa dan il-filmat? David: Ħija ipproduċieh għall-proġett tal-iskola tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who produced this video? David: My brother produced it for his school project.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这段视频是谁制作的？戴维：我哥哥为他的学校项目制作的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这段视频是谁制作的？
messages.en: Who produced this video?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥为他的学校项目制作的。
messages.en: My brother produced it for his school project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“投入工作，出现产出”的画面记 ipproduċa：工厂产出商品，设备产出电力，创作者制作影片，都围绕“使某物产生”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say that something will happen in the future, especially as a prophecy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预先说出未来将发生的事情，尤指作出预言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħabbar minn qabel xi ħaġa li se tiġri fil-futur, speċjalment bħala profezija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预言或预先宣告未来会发生的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħid minn qabel x'se jiġri fil-futur, ħafna drabi fil-forma ta' profezija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone foretells an event, they say that it will happen before it actually takes place.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-profeta ipprofetizza li l-belt kienet se tinqered minn terremot.
formal.en: In the novel, the prophet foretold that the city would be destroyed by an earthquake.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，先知预言这座城市将被一场地震摧毁。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'ipprofetizza x-xiħ fl-istorja? Ġanni: Ipprofetizza li t-tifla kienet se ssalva r-raħal.
colloquial.en: Marta: What did the old man foretell in the story? Ġanni: He foretold that the girl would save the village.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：故事里的老人预言了什么？詹尼：他预言那个女孩会拯救村庄。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的老人预言了什么？
messages.en: What did the old man foretell in the story?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprofetizza li t-tifla kienet se ssalva r-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprofetizza li t-tifla kienet se ssalva r-raħal.
messages.zh: 他预言那个女孩会拯救村庄。
messages.en: He foretold that the girl would save the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ipprofetizza 放进故事中记忆：先知先说出未来事件，事件随后才发生；搭配 li 从句，练习表达“预言某事将发生”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop or move forward towards a better or more advanced stage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在学习、工作或发展过程中向前推进，达到更好或更高的阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel progress jew jimxi 'l quddiem lejn stadju aħjar jew aktar avvanzat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取得进步或进展；逐步发展到更高或更完善的阶段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Javvanza jew jitjieb maż-żmien f'attività, f'ħila jew fi proċess ta' żvilupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something progresses, they develop or move towards a better or more advanced stage.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-proġett ipprogredixxa sew matul l-aħħar tliet xhur.
formal.en: The report shows that the project progressed well over the last three months.
formal.zh: 报告显示，该项目在过去三个月中进展良好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer ħuk bil-Malti? Toni: Ipprogredixxa ħafna; issa jista' jitkellem mal-ġirien mingħajr għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your brother getting on with Maltese? Toni: He has made a lot of progress; now he can talk to the neighbours without help.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥的马耳他语学得怎么样？Toni：他进步很大，现在不用别人帮忙就能和邻居交谈了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥的马耳他语学得怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother getting on with Maltese?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprogredixxa ħafna; issa jista' jitkellem mal-ġirien mingħajr għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprogredixxa ħafna; issa jista' jitkellem mal-ġirien mingħajr għajnuna.
messages.zh: 他进步很大，现在不用别人帮忙就能和邻居交谈了。
messages.en: He has made a lot of progress; now he can talk to the neighbours without help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ipprogredixxa 配上学习进度条向前移动的画面：昨天还要人帮，今天能独立完成，就是取得了进步。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep delaying something that needs to be done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把应该做的事情一再推迟，迟迟不开始或不完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' jħalli għal aktar tard xi ħaġa li għandu jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖延应做的事情，反复推迟开始或完成的时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Idum biex jibda jew itemm xi ħaġa li għandu jagħmel, għax jibqa' jħalliha għal aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you procrastinate, you keep delaying something that you ought to do.

collocations.zh: 一连拖延了好几个星期
迟迟拖延，没有开始工作

formal.mt: L-istudent ipprokrastina għal diversi ġimgħat u beda jikteb l-esej lejlet id-data tal-għeluq.
formal.en: The student procrastinated for several weeks and began writing the essay the day before the deadline.
formal.zh: 这名学生拖延了几个星期，直到截止日期的前一天才开始写论文。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk lesta l-applikazzjoni? Mark: Le, ipprokrastina l-ġimgħa kollha u għadu lanqas beda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has your brother finished the application? Mark: No, he procrastinated all week and has not even started yet.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你哥哥填好申请了吗？Mark：没有，他拖了整整一周，到现在连开始都没有。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥填好申请了吗？
messages.en: Has your brother finished the application?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ipprokrastina l-ġimgħa kollha u għadu lanqas beda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ipprokrastina l-ġimgħa kollha u għadu lanqas beda.
messages.zh: 没有，他拖了整整一周，到现在连开始都没有。
messages.en: No, he procrastinated all week and has not even started yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 ipprokrastina 时想象作业旁的日历不断翻页，嘴里总说“明天再做”：重点是应做的事迟迟不做。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce the spoken sounds of a word or name in a particular way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用某种读音说出一个词或名字，强调发出各个语音的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilissen kelma jew isem b'mod partikolari, billi jipproduċi l-ħsejjes tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 读出一个词或名字；以某种方式发出其语音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħid kelma jew isem billi jagħti leħen lill-ħsejjes tagħhom b'mod partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you pronounce a word, you say it using a particular combination of speech sounds.

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliem ippronunzja kull kelma bil-mod sabiex l-istudenti jisimgħu l-ħsejjes kollha.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher pronounced each word slowly so that the students could hear all the sounds.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师慢慢地读出每个词，让学生听清所有语音。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif qal ismek l-għalliem il-ġdid? Pawlu: Ipp pronunzja? Le, ippronunzja ismi tajjeb mill-ewwel!
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the new teacher say your name? Pawlu: He pronounced my name correctly on the first try!
colloquial.zh: Lara：新老师是怎么念你名字的？Pawlu：他第一次就把我的名字念对了！

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 新老师是怎么念你名字的？
messages.en: How did the new teacher say your name?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 他第一次就把我的名字念对了！
messages.en: He pronounced my name correctly on the first try!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ippronunzja 和“看见名字后开口念出来”的场景绑定；练习时同时搭配“读得清楚”和“读错了”，突出发音方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put forward an idea, plan or possible action for others to consider.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一个想法、计划或可能采取的行动提出来，供别人考虑或讨论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iressaq idea, pjan jew azzjoni possibbli biex ħaddieħor jikkunsidraha jew jiddiskutiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提出计划、方案或行动主张，供他人讨论、审议或接受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iressaq pjan, miżura jew proposta biex tiġi diskussa, ikkunsidrata jew aċċettata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you propose a plan or action, you formally put it forward for others to consider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建议某种做法或选择，把它作为可考虑的办法提出来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti idea jew jindika xi ħaġa li tista' ssir bħala għażla li ħaddieħor jista' jikkunsidra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you suggest something, you mention an idea or possible action for someone to consider.

collocations.en: suggested that we go on foot

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, id-direttur ippropona pjan ġdid biex jitnaqqas il-ħin ta' stennija għall-klijenti.
formal.en: During the meeting, the director proposed a new plan to reduce waiting times for customers.
formal.zh: 会议期间，主管提出了一项新计划，以缩短顾客的等候时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se nagħmlu nhar il-Ħadd? David: Toni ippropona li mmorru l-baħar. Nina: Idea tajba! Nistgħu nieħdu xi ħaġa x'nieklu magħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: What shall we do on Sunday? David: Toni suggested that we go to the seaside. Nina: Good idea! We can take something to eat with us.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们星期天做什么？David：Toni 建议我们去海边。Nina：好主意！我们可以带点吃的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们星期天做什么？
messages.en: What shall we do on Sunday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni 建议我们去海边。
messages.en: Toni suggested that we go to the seaside.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Idea tajba! Nistgħu nieħdu xi ħaġa x'nieklu magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Idea tajba! Nistgħu nieħdu xi ħaġa x'nieklu magħna.
messages.zh: 好主意！我们可以带点吃的。
messages.en: Good idea! We can take something to eat with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ippropona 想成把想法放到讨论桌上：会议中是“提出方案”，朋友聊天时是“建议做什么”，都等待别人考虑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保护某人或某物，使其免受伤害、损坏或危险。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tħares lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa mill-ħsara jew mill-periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保护；采取措施使人或事物免受伤害、损坏或危险。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li żżomm lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa fis-sigurtà u tevita li ssirilhom ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you protect someone or something, you keep them safe from harm, damage, or danger.

formal.mt: L-ilbies protettiv ipproteġa lill-ħaddiema mis-sħana.
formal.en: The protective clothing protected the workers from the heat.
formal.zh: 防护服使工人免受高温伤害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ipproteġa l-kotba mix-xita? Lara: Mark ipproteġa l-kotba bil-ġakketta tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who protected the books from the rain? Lara: Mark protected the books with his jacket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁保护了那些书，让它们没被雨淋湿？拉拉：马克用自己的夹克护住了那些书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是谁保护了那些书，让它们没被雨淋湿？
messages.en: Who protected the books from the rain?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克用自己的夹克护住了那些书。
messages.en: Mark protected the books with his jacket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“撑伞护住书本”的画面绑定：重点是挡住伤害，记住“保护”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give or make available something that a person or group needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供或供应某人、某个群体所需的物品、帮助或服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħti jew tagħmel disponibbli affarijiet, għajnuna jew servizzi li persuna jew grupp ikollhom bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供；使所需的物品、帮助或服务可供使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tagħti jew tagħmel disponibbli xi ħaġa li tkun meħtieġa, bħal għajnuna, informazzjoni jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you provide something, you give it or make it available to someone who needs it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供应；向个人、机构或地点提供所需的物资或用品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tagħti jew twassal lil persuna, organizzazzjoni jew post il-materjali jew l-oġġetti li jkollhom bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you supply people with something, you give or deliver the goods or materials they need.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满足特定人群的需要；提供适合其需求的服务或安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tipprovdi servizzi jew tagħmel arranġamenti adattati għall-bżonnijiet ta' persuna jew ta' grupp partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you cater for a person or group, you provide services or arrangements that meet their particular needs.

collocations.en: provided services catering for children's needs
collocations.zh: 提供了满足儿童需求的服务

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru ipprovda ikel u akkomodazzjoni lill-parteċipanti matul il-kors.
formal.en: The centre provided food and accommodation for the participants during the course.
formal.zh: 该中心在课程期间为参加者提供了食宿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna biżżejjed ilma għall-mixja? Mark: Iva, il-klabb ipprovda żewġ fliexken għal kull persuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have enough water for the walk? Mark: Yes, the club provided two bottles for each person.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们徒步时喝的水够吗？马克：够，俱乐部给每个人提供了两瓶水。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步活动参加者)
messages.zh: 我们徒步时喝的水够吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough water for the walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-klabb ipprovda żewġ fliexken għal kull persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-klabb ipprovda żewġ fliexken għal kull persuna.
messages.zh: 够，俱乐部给每个人提供了两瓶水。
messages.en: Yes, the club provided two bottles for each person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象活动桌上备好水、食物和用品：有人需要，就有人“提供、供应”，再联想到满足具体需求。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a reaction or feeling, especially anger, through an action or remark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以言语或行为引起某种反应或情绪，尤指激怒他人或引发争议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tqanqal reazzjoni jew sentiment, speċjalment rabja, permezz ta' kliem jew azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激怒、挑衅某人，或引发某种情绪、反应或争论。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jirrabja jew jirreaġixxi, jew li tqanqal sentiment jew diskussjoni permezz ta' dak li tgħid jew tagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you provoke someone or a reaction, your words or actions cause anger, another strong feeling, or a response.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ipprovoka dibattitu pubbliku dwar il-kwalità tal-ilma.
formal.en: The report provoked a public debate about water quality.
formal.zh: 这份报告引发了有关水质的公众讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark irrabja? Maja: Pawlu ipprovoka lil Mark b'kumment fuq ix-xogħol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark get angry? Maja: Paul provoked Mark with a comment about his work.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么生气了？玛雅：保罗评论了马克的工作，把他惹怒了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why did Mark get angry?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ipprovoka lil Mark b'kumment fuq ix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ipprovoka lil Mark b'kumment fuq ix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.zh: 保罗评论了马克的工作，把他惹怒了。
messages.en: Paul provoked Mark with a comment about his work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一句话点燃情绪”的画面记忆：对人可以是激怒，对反应或讨论则可以是引发。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a book, article, or information available to the public in print or online.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以印刷或网络形式向公众提供书籍、文章或信息，即出版、发表或公布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel ktieb, artiklu jew informazzjoni disponibbli għall-pubbliku, f'forma stampata jew fuq l-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出版书籍、发表文章，或通过印刷品、网络等渠道向公众公布信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li toħroġ ktieb, artiklu jew informazzjoni biex ikunu jistgħu jinqraw mill-pubbliku, fuq il-karta jew fuq l-internet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you publish a book, article, or information, you make it available for the public to read.

formal.mt: L-istitut ippubblika r-riżultati tal-istudju fuq is-sit tiegħu.
formal.en: The institute published the results of the study on its website.
formal.zh: 该研究所在其网站上公布了这项研究的结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' naqra l-artiklu tiegħek? Mark: Il-ġurnal ippubblika l-artiklu lbieraħ; tista' taqrah fuq is-sit tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I read your article? Mark: The newspaper published the article yesterday; you can read it on its website.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在哪里可以读到你的文章？马克：报纸昨天发表了那篇文章，你可以在它的网站上阅读。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在哪里可以读到你的文章？
messages.en: Where can I read your article?

messages.speaker: Mark (文章作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġurnal ippubblika l-artiklu lbieraħ; tista' taqrah fuq is-sit tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġurnal ippubblika l-artiklu lbieraħ; tista' taqrah fuq is-sit tiegħu.
messages.zh: 报纸昨天发表了那篇文章，你可以在它的网站上阅读。
messages.en: The newspaper published the article yesterday; you can read it on its website.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文章从私人草稿变成人人可读的报纸或网页：抓住“向公众开放阅读”，串起出版、发表和公布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made available to readers as a book, article, or other written work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指书籍、文章等文字作品已经出版或发表，可供读者阅读。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ħareġ bħala ktieb, artiklu jew xogħol ieħor bil-miktub u jkun disponibbli għall-qarrejja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已出版或已发表、可供读者阅读的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie ppubblikat u jkun disponibbli biex jinqara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A published work has been made available for people to read.

collocations.en: an article published in a magazine

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ippubblikat din il-ġimgħa jippreżenta r-riżultati tar-riċerka.
formal.en: The report published this week presents the research findings.
formal.zh: 本周发表的报告介绍了研究结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ktieb tiegħek diġà ġie ppubblikat? Mark: Iva, issa huwa ktieb ippubblikat, u tista' ssibu fil-ħwienet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has your book been published already? Mark: Yes, it is now a published book, and you can find it in the shops.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的书已经出版了吗？Mark：是的，现在已经正式出版了，你可以在书店找到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的书已经出版了吗？
messages.en: Has your book been published already?

messages.speaker: Mark (作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa huwa ktieb ippubblikat, u tista' ssibu fil-ħwienet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa huwa ktieb ippubblikat, u tista' ssibu fil-ħwienet.
messages.zh: 是的，现在已经正式出版了，你可以在书店找到。
messages.en: Yes, it is now a published book, and you can find it in the shops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ippubblikat 和一本已经摆上书架的书联系起来，记住它描述的是“已出版”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that prepares and issues books or other written works for readers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责组织书籍或其他文字作品出版，供读者阅读的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tħejji u toħroġ kotba jew xogħlijiet oħra bil-miktub għall-qarrejja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出版者；负责出版书籍、杂志等作品的个人或企业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija responsabbli għall-pubblikazzjoni ta' kotba, rivisti jew xogħlijiet oħra bil-miktub.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A publisher is a person or company that arranges for books or other written works to be produced and made available to readers.

formal.mt: L-awtur bagħat il-manuskritt lill-ippublikatur biex jiġi kkunsidrat għall-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The author sent the manuscript to the publisher for consideration for publication.
formal.zh: 作者将手稿交给出版商，供其考虑是否出版。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Sibt ippublikatur għall-ktieb tiegħek? Daniel: Iva, u għada se niltaqa' miegħu biex nitkellmu dwar il-pubblikazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you found a publisher for your book? Daniel: Yes, and tomorrow I am meeting him to discuss publication.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为自己的书找到出版商了吗？Daniel：找到了，明天我会和他见面，讨论出版的事。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为自己的书找到出版商了吗？
messages.en: Have you found a publisher for your book?

messages.speaker: Daniel (作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għada se niltaqa' miegħu biex nitkellmu dwar il-pubblikazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għada se niltaqa' miegħu biex nitkellmu dwar il-pubblikazzjoni.
messages.zh: 找到了，明天我会和他见面，讨论出版的事。
messages.en: Yes, and tomorrow I am meeting him to discuss publication.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作者拿着手稿寻找出版商：ippublikatur 指负责把作品出版的人或公司，可与“已出版的”状态词对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expresses nausea or an unpleasant feeling of sickness in the stomach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示恶心、反胃或胃部不适的感觉；在例句中用于表达某物令人产生这种感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika sens ta' dardir jew skumdità fl-istonku; fl-eżempji jesprimi li xi ħaġa tqajjem dan is-sens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到恶心、反胃或胃部不适的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss dardir jew skumdità fl-istonku, bħallikieku se jirremetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you feel queasy, you have an unpleasant feeling in your stomach and think you might be sick.

collocations.en: food that makes you feel queasy
a sight that makes you feel queasy

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ikel b'riħa tant qawwija li jqażżeż lil min ikun qribu.
formal.en: The report describes food with a smell so strong that it makes people nearby feel queasy.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一种气味十分强烈、令附近的人感到反胃的食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-ikel iqażżeż; lanqas niflaħ ir-riħa tiegħu. Mark: Ejja nitbiegħdu ftit u nieħdu ftit arja friska.
colloquial.en: Maja: This food makes me feel queasy; I cannot even stand its smell. Mark: Let's move away a little and get some fresh air.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这食物让我反胃，连它的气味我都受不了。Mark：我们走远一点，呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-ikel iqażżeż; lanqas niflaħ ir-riħa tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-ikel iqażżeż; lanqas niflaħ ir-riħa tiegħu.
messages.zh: 这食物让我反胃，连它的气味我都受不了。
messages.en: This food makes me feel queasy; I cannot even stand its smell.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nitbiegħdu ftit u nieħdu ftit arja friska.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nitbiegħdu ftit u nieħdu ftit arja friska.
messages.zh: 我们走远一点，呼吸些新鲜空气吧。
messages.en: Let's move away a little and get some fresh air.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闻到强烈气味后捂住胃、想走开透气的画面，把 iqażżeż 与“恶心反胃”的身体感觉联系起来。

gloss_zh: 拉巴特；维多利亚（戈佐岛主要城镇）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place name referring either to Rabat in Malta or to Victoria, the main town in Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地名，可指马耳他北部地区的拉巴特，也可指戈佐岛的主要城镇维多利亚；具体所指需根据语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' post li jirreferi għar-Rabat fir-reġjun tat-Tramuntana ta' Malta jew għal Victoria, il-belt ewlenija ta' Għawdex, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.en_definition: Rabat, a town in the northern region of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉巴特，位于马耳他北部地区的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-Rabat huwa belt fir-reġjun tat-Tramuntana ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rabat is a town located in the northern region of Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Victoria, the main town in Gozo
sense_translations.zh_definition: 维多利亚，戈佐岛的主要城镇，也称拉巴特。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-Rabat huwa isem ieħor għal Victoria, il-belt ewlenija ta' Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In a Gozo context, Rabat refers to Victoria, the island's main town.

collocations.zh: 戈佐岛的拉巴特（维多利亚）

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jispeċifika r-Rabat ta' Malta, biex ma jkunx hemm konfużjoni mar-Rabat ta' Għawdex.
formal.en: The visit programme specifies Rabat in Malta to avoid confusion with Rabat in Gozo.
formal.zh: 参观行程明确写明目的地是马耳他的拉巴特，以免与戈佐岛的拉巴特混淆。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Meta tgħid ir-Rabat, qed tirreferi għal Malta jew għal Għawdex? Mark: Għal Għawdex, jiġifieri Victoria.
colloquial.en: Lina: When you say Rabat, do you mean Malta or Gozo? Mark: Gozo, meaning Victoria.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你说拉巴特，是指马耳他的，还是戈佐岛的？马克：戈佐岛的，也就是维多利亚。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid ir-Rabat, qed tirreferi għal Malta jew għal Għawdex?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid ir-Rabat, qed tirreferi għal Malta jew għal Għawdex?
messages.zh: 你说拉巴特，是指马耳他的，还是戈佐岛的？
messages.en: When you say Rabat, do you mean Malta or Gozo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 戈佐岛的，也就是维多利亚。
messages.en: Gozo, meaning Victoria.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把拉巴特记成同名双地点：听到这个名字，先确认是马耳他还是戈佐岛；戈佐岛那个也叫维多利亚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The country comprising England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰组成的国家，中文通常称为英国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż magħmul mill-Ingilterra, l-Iskozja, Wales u l-Irlanda ta' Fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 联合王国，通常称英国，由英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰组成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-Renju Unit huwa l-pajjiż li jiġbor fih l-Ingilterra, l-Iskozja, Wales u l-Irlanda ta' Fuq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The United Kingdom is the country consisting of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

collocations.en: to live in the United Kingdom
to travel to the United Kingdom

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi taqsima dwar l-edukazzjoni fir-Renju Unit.
formal.en: The report includes a section on education in the United Kingdom.
formal.zh: 报告包含一节关于英国教育的内容。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn tgħix oħtok? Lara: Tgħix fir-Renju Unit, imma ġejja żżurna x-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where does your sister live? Lara: She lives in the United Kingdom, but she is coming to visit us next month.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你姐姐住在哪里？拉拉：她住在英国，不过下个月会来看我们。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你姐姐住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your sister live?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħix fir-Renju Unit, imma ġejja żżurna x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħix fir-Renju Unit, imma ġejja żżurna x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 她住在英国，不过下个月会来看我们。
messages.en: She lives in the United Kingdom, but she is coming to visit us next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ir-Renju Unit 整体记作国家名“英国”；再成组记住 lejn ir-Renju Unit 表示“前往英国”，fir-Renju Unit 表示“在英国”。

gloss_zh: 里卡索利堡（位于马耳他南部卡尔卡拉的棱堡式要塞）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of Fort Ricasoli, a bastioned fort in Kalkara in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 里卡索利堡的专名，指位于马耳他南部卡尔卡拉的一座棱堡式要塞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju ta' fort bil-bastjuni fil-Kalkara, fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Fort Ricasoli, a bastioned fort in Kalkara, in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 里卡索利堡，位于马耳他南部卡尔卡拉的一座棱堡式要塞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-Rikażli huwa fort bil-bastjuni li jinsab fil-Kalkara, fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ir-Rikażli is the name of a bastioned fort situated in Kalkara, in the south of Malta.

collocations.zh: 一张里卡索利堡的照片

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi r-Rikażli bħala fort bil-bastjuni fil-Kalkara, fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The text describes Fort Ricasoli as a bastioned fort in Kalkara, in the south of Malta.
formal.zh: 这篇文字将里卡索利堡描述为位于马耳他南部卡尔卡拉的一座棱堡式要塞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan il-fort fir-ritratt? Mark: Ir-Rikażli. Jinsab fil-Kalkara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the name of this fort in the photograph? Mark: Fort Ricasoli. It is in Kalkara.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这座要塞叫什么？马克：里卡索利堡。它在卡尔卡拉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里的这座要塞叫什么？
messages.en: What is the name of this fort in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 里卡索利堡。它在卡尔卡拉。
messages.en: Fort Ricasoli. It is in Kalkara.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把专名和地点画成一张记忆卡：正面写 Ir-Rikażli，背面画棱堡，并标注卡尔卡拉、马耳他南部。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Romania, a country in Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 罗马尼亚，一个欧洲国家的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Ewropa li jissejjaħ ir-Rumanija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗马尼亚，欧洲的一个国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-Rumanija hija pajjiż fl-Ewropa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Romania is a country in Europe whose Maltese name is ir-Rumanija.

collocations.zh: 一次前往罗马尼亚的旅行

formal.mt: Id-delegazzjoni se żżur ir-Rumanija biex tieħu sehem f'laqgħa dwar l-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The delegation will visit Romania to participate in a meeting on education.
formal.zh: 代表团将访问罗马尼亚，参加一次教育会议。

colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Lara: I'm going to Romania. Maja: How long will you stay there? Lara: A week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要去哪里度假？Lara：我要去罗马尼亚。Maja：你会在那里待多久？Lara：一周。

messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.en: I'm going to Romania.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

messages.en: How long will you stay there?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 一周。
messages.en: A week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ir-Rumanija 写在“罗马尼亚”旅行卡上，再配对记忆 lejn ir-Rumanija“前往罗马尼亚”和 fir-Rumanija“在罗马尼亚”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Russia, a country extending across Europe and Asia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 俄罗斯，一个横跨欧洲和亚洲的国家的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż li jestendi fuq partijiet mill-Ewropa u mill-Asja u li jissejjaħ ir-Russja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 俄罗斯，地跨欧洲和亚洲的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-Russja hija pajjiż li jestendi fuq partijiet mill-Ewropa u mill-Asja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Russia is a country that extends across parts of Europe and Asia.

collocations.zh: 一次前往俄罗斯的旅行

formal.mt: L-istudju jinkludi kapitlu dwar ir-Russja u l-letteratura tagħha.
formal.en: The study includes a chapter on Russia and its literature.
formal.zh: 这项研究包含一个讨论俄罗斯及其文学的章节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn jgħix ħuk? Mark: Jgħix fir-Russja. Lara: Iżżuru spiss? Mark: Le, iżda nitkellmu kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where does your brother live? Mark: He lives in Russia. Lara: Do you visit him often? Mark: No, but we talk every week.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你兄弟住在哪里？Mark：他住在俄罗斯。Lara：你经常去看他吗？Mark：不常去，不过我们每周都聊天。

messages.zh: 你兄弟住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your brother live?

messages.en: He lives in Russia.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你经常去看他吗？
messages.en: Do you visit him often?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不常去，不过我们每周都聊天。
messages.en: No, but we talk every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“俄罗斯”地图卡记 ir-Russja，再把 Jgħix fir-Russja“他住在俄罗斯”整句朗读，连同常用地点表达一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 伊朗的；伊朗人的；来自伊朗的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Iran or relating to Iran, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指来自伊朗的，或与伊朗、伊朗人民及其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Iran jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Iran, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伊朗的；伊朗人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa tal-Iran jew li għandu x'jaqsam man-nies tal-Iran.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is Iranian comes from Iran or is connected with that country and its people.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Iran
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自伊朗的，或与伊朗有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mill-Iran jew li għandu rabta mal-Iran.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person, object, or activity described this way originates in Iran or has a connection with Iran.

formal.mt: Il-festival se juri film iranjan u jorganizza diskussjoni mad-direttur tiegħu.
formal.en: The festival will screen an Iranian film and organize a discussion with its director.
formal.zh: 电影节将放映一部伊朗电影，并举办与该片导演的讨论活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema film se naraw illejla? Daniel: Sibt film iranjan li jidher interessanti; narawh flimkien?
colloquial.en: Sara: Which film are we watching tonight? Daniel: I found an Iranian film that looks interesting; shall we watch it together?
colloquial.zh: Sara：今晚我们看哪部电影？Daniel：我找到一部看起来很有意思的伊朗电影，我们一起看吧？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚我们看哪部电影？
messages.en: Which film are we watching tonight?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt film iranjan li jidher interessanti; narawh flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt film iranjan li jidher interessanti; narawh flimkien?
messages.zh: 我找到一部看起来很有意思的伊朗电影，我们一起看吧？
messages.en: I found an Iranian film that looks interesting; shall we watch it together?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iranjan 放进“伊朗作家、伊朗电影”两个词组中记忆：它既能说明来自哪里，也能表示与伊朗有关。

gloss_zh: 开放（所给词义为 open，标注为名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun label associated with the meaning 'open' in this entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条中与“开放”这一含义对应的名词性标签；所给信息未进一步限定其具体指称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikketta nominali li f'din l-entrata tingħata bit-tifsira 'miftuħ', mingħajr aktar tagħrif dwar x'tirreferi għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开放；本义项标注为名词，但未说明具体指称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kunċett ta' 'miftuħ' kif mogħti f'din l-entrata bħala nom, mingħajr kuntest li jispeċifika r-referenza tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, the noun is associated with the meaning 'open', although its precise reference is not specified.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, 'irbaħt' huwa mmarkat bħala nom bit-tifsira 'open'; ma jingħatax kuntest li jiċċara t-tifsira aktar.
formal.en: In this list, 'irbaħt' is marked as a noun meaning 'open'; no context is provided to clarify the meaning further.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，“irbaħt”被标注为名词，词义为 open；词表没有提供进一步说明该含义的语境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'irbaħt' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Hawn miktub 'open', u l-kelma hija mmarkata bħala nom. Maja: Hemm eżempju li jiċċara t-tifsira? Pawlu: Le, hawn m'hemmx eżempju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'irbaħt' mean in this list? Pawlu: It says 'open' here, and the word is marked as a noun. Maja: Is there an example clarifying the meaning? Pawlu: No, there is no example here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份词表里的“irbaħt”是什么意思？保罗：这里写的是 open，而且把这个词标为名词。玛雅：有没有例句说明具体意思？保罗：没有，这里没有例句。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的“irbaħt”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'irbaħt' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)

messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'open', u l-kelma hija mmarkata bħala nom.

messages.en: It says 'open' here, and the word is marked as a noun.

messages.zh: 有没有例句说明具体意思？
messages.en: Is there an example clarifying the meaning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 没有，这里没有例句。
messages.en: No, there is no example here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irbaħt 写在“开放”词卡上，同时圈出“名词”标记；先记所给对应关系，不凭字形猜测其他词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of fastening or securing something by tying it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过打结、系住或绑扎，使物体固定在一起的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li torbot xi ħaġa biex iżżommha f'postha jew magħquda ma' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捆绑、系结或绑扎的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tagħmel għoqda jew tuża ħabel jew rabta biex iżżomm xi ħaġa marbuta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tying is the act of securing something by making a knot or fastening a cord around it.

formal.mt: L-irbit tal-pakketti għandu jsir b'attenzjoni sabiex ma jinfetħux waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The packages must be tied carefully so that they do not open during transport.
formal.zh: 包裹应仔细绑扎，以免在运输途中散开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-irbit sod biżżejjed? Pawlu: Le, il-ħabel għadu maħlul. Maja: Mela nerġa' norbtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this tying firm enough? Pawlu: No, the rope is still loose. Maja: Then I will tie it again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这样绑得够牢吗？保罗：不够，绳子还松着。玛雅：那我再绑一次。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这样绑得够牢吗？
messages.en: Is this tying firm enough?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不够，绳子还松着。
messages.en: No, the rope is still loose.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我再绑一次。
messages.en: Then I will tie it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用绳子给包裹打结，把“绑扎这个动作”贴上 irbit 标签；用 irbit sod 联想“绑得牢”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sound strongly through a space or to be heard again as an echo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声音在某个空间中响亮地回荡，或经反射后再次被听见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinstema' b'qawwa fi spazju jew jerġa' jinstema' bħala eku wara li l-ħoss jolqot wiċċ u jirritorna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 响亮地回荡；在空间中产生明显的回响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jinstema' b'qawwa u jinfirex fi spazju b'mod li jimlieh bil-ħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a sound resounds, it is heard strongly throughout a place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生回声；声音反射后再次传来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jerġa' jinstema' bħala eku meta l-ħoss jolqot wiċċ u jirritorna lejn min qed jisma'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a sound echoes, it is heard again after being reflected from a surface.

collocations.en: the sound resounded through the hall
the voice echoed in the cave
collocations.zh: 说话声在洞穴里产生回声

formal.mt: Il-ħoss tal-qanpiena irbombja fis-sala vojta, u nstema' saħansitra mill-kuritur.
formal.en: The sound of the bell resounded through the empty hall and could even be heard from the corridor.
formal.zh: 铃声在空荡的大厅里回响，连走廊里都能听见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt kif leħnek irbombja fl-għar? Pawlu: Iva, għedt kelma waħda u smajtha mill-ġdid. Maja: Ejja nippruvaw b'leħen aktar baxx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear how your voice echoed in the cave? Pawlu: Yes, I said one word and heard it again. Maja: Let us try speaking more quietly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见自己的声音在洞里回响了吗？保罗：听见了，我说了一个词，又听到了它。玛雅：我们试着小声一点说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见自己的声音在洞里回响了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how your voice echoed in the cave?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għedt kelma waħda u smajtha mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għedt kelma waħda u smajtha mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 听见了，我说了一个词，又听到了它。
messages.en: Yes, I said one word and heard it again.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们试着小声一点说。
messages.en: Let us try speaking more quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irbombja 配上两个声音画面：大厅里响声四处回荡，对应 resound；山洞里同一句再次传回，对应 echo。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression indicating that something has been received.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物已经收到或某项内容已经接收的表达；本条词性保留为 x。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa waslet għand min kellu jirċeviha; f'din l-entrata l-kategorija grammatikali hija mmarkata 'x'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已收到；表示接收已经完成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Indikazzjoni li dokument, messaġġ jew oġġett diġà wasal għand il-persuna jew il-post li kellu jasal għandu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression indicates that an item or communication has already reached its intended recipient.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, in-nota 'Ircieva' ħdejn id-dokument tindika li d-dokument wasal għand id-destinatarju.
formal.en: In this example, the note 'Received' beside the document indicates that the document has reached its recipient.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，文件旁的“已收到”备注表示文件已经送达接收人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħdejn il-messaġġ hemm miktub 'Ircieva'. Xi jfisser? Pawlu: F'dan l-eżempju, ifisser li l-messaġġ wasal. Maja: Mela wasal, imma mhux bilfors inqara.
colloquial.en: Maja: It says 'Received' beside the message. What does that mean? Pawlu: In this example, it means the message has arrived. Maja: So it has arrived, but it has not necessarily been read.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：消息旁边写着“已收到”。这是什么意思？保罗：在这个例子里，意思是消息已经送达。玛雅：也就是说已经送达，但不一定已经读过。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-messaġġ hemm miktub 'Ircieva'. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-messaġġ hemm miktub 'Ircieva'. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 消息旁边写着“已收到”。这是什么意思？
messages.en: It says 'Received' beside the message. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-eżempju, ifisser li l-messaġġ wasal.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżempju, ifisser li l-messaġġ wasal.
messages.zh: 在这个例子里，意思是消息已经送达。
messages.en: In this example, it means the message has arrived.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela wasal, imma mhux bilfors inqara.
messages.mt_standard: Mela wasal, imma mhux bilfors inqara.
messages.zh: 也就是说已经送达，但不一定已经读过。
messages.en: So it has arrived, but it has not necessarily been read.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件旁盖着“已收到”的印章，把 Ircieva 与 Received 一起记忆；记住收到表示送达，不自动表示已经阅读。

gloss_zh: 进入庇护处；安适地待着；庇护处

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go into shelter for protection, especially during a war.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入能够提供保护的地方躲避危险，尤其指战争期间避难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tidħol f'post li jagħtik kenn u protezzjoni mill-periklu, speċjalment waqt gwerra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进入庇护处避难，尤其指战争期间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tidħol f'post ta' kenn biex tkun protett mill-periklu waqt gwerra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you take shelter during a war, you enter a place where you can be protected from danger.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够遮护身体、让人感到温暖安适的栖身处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post li jagħti kenn u fejn wieħed iħossu komdu u għall-irdoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cosy shelter is a protected place where you can feel comfortable and at ease.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人躲避危险或风雨的庇护处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post li jipproteġi lil min ikun fih mill-periklu jew mit-temp ħażin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shelter is a place that protects people from danger or unpleasant weather.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于舒适、安稳而有遮护的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkun komdu u għall-kenn f'post fejn tħossok sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are cosy, you feel comfortable and protected in the place where you are.

formal.mt: Waqt il-maltemp, il-viżitaturi baqgħu għall-irdoss fil-bini sakemm għadda r-riħ qawwi.
formal.en: During the storm, the visitors remained sheltered inside the building until the strong wind had passed.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，访客们留在建筑物内避风，直到强风过去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn noqogħdu sakemm jgħaddi dan ir-riħ? Mark: Hawn, wara l-ħajt; inkunu għall-irdoss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we stay until this wind passes? Mark: Here, behind the wall; we'll be sheltered.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：风停之前我们待在哪里？马克：这里，墙后面；这里能避风。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn noqogħdu sakemm jgħaddi dan ir-riħ?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn noqogħdu sakemm jgħaddi dan ir-riħ?
messages.zh: 风停之前我们待在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we stay until this wind passes?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这里，墙后面；这里能避风。
messages.en: Here, behind the wall; we'll be sheltered.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面连起来记：走进避难处，身体得到遮护，心里感到安适；分别对应动作、处所和状态，注意词性边界。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a surface or slope that rises or falls at a sharp angle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容地面或斜坡倾斜角度大、上升或下降很陡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi wiċċ jew inklinazzjoni li titla' jew tinżel b'angolu qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陡峭的，指地面或斜坡的倾斜角度很大。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi inklinazzjoni qawwija, fejn l-art titla' jew tinżel b'mod wieqaf.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A steep slope rises or falls sharply over a short horizontal distance.

collocations.en: the use of 'irdumi' to describe steep terrain

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'irdumi' għandha t-tifsira ta' 'wieqaf ħafna' u tiddeskrivi l-inklinazzjoni tat-terren.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'irdumi' means 'very steep' and describes the slope of the terrain.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，“irdumi”意为“非常陡峭”，用于描述地形的坡度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'irdumi' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Tfisser 'wieqaf ħafna', bħal telgħa b'inklinazzjoni qawwija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'irdumi' mean in this list? Pawlu: It means 'very steep', like a sharply rising slope.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张词表里的“irdumi”是什么意思？保罗：意思是“非常陡峭”，就像坡度很大的上坡。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张词表里的“irdumi”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'irdumi' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser 'wieqaf ħafna', bħal telgħa b'inklinazzjoni qawwija.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser 'wieqaf ħafna', bħal telgħa b'inklinazzjoni qawwija.
messages.zh: 意思是“非常陡峭”，就像坡度很大的上坡。
messages.en: It means 'very steep', like a sharply rising slope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词表的义项，想象一段陡得需要放慢脚步的上坡，把词形与“坡度很大”的画面配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 有遮护的；舒适温暖的；安稳舒适的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protected from exposure or comfortably settled in a cosy, snug place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到遮护、免受风雨侵扰的，或处于舒适温暖、安稳惬意的环境中的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa li tkun għall-kenn, jew f'post komdu fejn wieħed iħossu sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有遮护的，受到保护而不直接暴露于风雨等外界影响的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab għall-kenn u protett mir-riħ, mix-xita jew minn influwenzi oħra minn barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sheltered place has protection that reduces exposure to wind, rain, or other outside conditions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舒适温暖的，使人感到放松而惬意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti sens ta' kumdità u sħana u jġiegħlek tħossok rilassat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cosy place feels pleasantly warm and comfortable, making it easy for you to relax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安稳舒适的，尤指在有遮护的小空间里感到暖和自在的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun komdu u għall-kenn, speċjalment fi spazju żgħir li jagħti sens ta' sħana u sigurtà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are snug, you feel warm, comfortable, and protected in the space around you.

formal.mt: Il-ġnien għandu post irdussat ħdejn il-ħajt, fejn il-viżitaturi jistgħu joqogħdu protetti mir-riħ.
formal.en: The garden has a sheltered spot beside the wall where visitors can sit protected from the wind.
formal.zh: 花园靠墙处有一个避风的位置，访客可以坐在那里，不受风吹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid noqogħdu barra? Mark: Iva, hemm post irdussat ħdejn il-ħajt; noqogħdu hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we sit outside? Mark: Yes, there's a sheltered spot beside the wall; let's sit there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们坐外面好吗？马克：好，墙边有个避风的地方；我们坐那里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐外面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we sit outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm post irdussat ħdejn il-ħajt; noqogħdu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm post irdussat ħdejn il-ħajt; noqogħdu hemm.
messages.zh: 好，墙边有个避风的地方；我们坐那里吧。
messages.en: Yes, there's a sheltered spot beside the wall; let's sit there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐进避风的小角落：外面有遮护，里面很暖和，身体很安稳；用这三个感受区分三个义项。

gloss_zh: 势利的人；自视高人一等的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who considers themselves superior to others because of status, taste, or social connections.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因社会地位、品味或交往圈子而自认为高人一等，并轻视他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqis lilha nnifisha aqwa minn ħaddieħor minħabba l-pożizzjoni soċjali, il-gosti jew in-nies li taf, u tħares lejn oħrajn minn fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 势利或自命高雅的人，因地位、品味等自认为优越而看不起别人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħseb li hija superjuri għal ħaddieħor minħabba l-istatus jew il-gosti tagħha, u li tistma inqas lil min tqis inferjuri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A snob believes that their social position or tastes make them better than other people.

collocations.en: a person described as a snob
the use of 'iridha' to describe a snobbish character

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-karattru deskritt bħala 'iridha' jiġġudika lin-nies skont il-pożizzjoni soċjali tagħhom u jittratta lil xi wħud b'disprezz.
formal.en: In this exercise, the character described as 'iridha' judges people by their social position and treats some of them with contempt.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，被描述为“iridha”的人物根据社会地位评判他人，并对其中一些人表现出轻蔑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'iridha' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Persuna li taħseb li hi aqwa minn ħaddieħor u tħares lejn in-nies minn fuq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'iridha' mean in this list? Pawlu: Someone who thinks they are better than others and looks down on people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张词表里的“iridha”是什么意思？保罗：就是觉得自己高人一等、看不起别人的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张词表里的“iridha”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'iridha' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li taħseb li hi aqwa minn ħaddieħor u tħares lejn in-nies minn fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li taħseb li hi aqwa minn ħaddieħor u tħares lejn in-nies minn fuq.
messages.zh: 就是觉得自己高人一等、看不起别人的人。
messages.en: Someone who thinks they are better than others and looks down on people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词表的义项，想象一个只看身份、总把下巴抬高的人；记忆重点是自认优越并轻视别人。

gloss_zh: 病情复发；病情在好转后再次恶化

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become ill again or get worse after a period of recovery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指病人在病情好转或康复一段时间后，再次发病或病情恶化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġa' mar għall-agħar wara perjodu li fih saħħtu kienet tjiebet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 病情好转或康复后再次发病，或再次恶化。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reġa' mar għall-agħar wara li kien beda jfiq minn marda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone relapses, they become ill again or their condition worsens after a period of improvement.

collocations.en: relapsed after a period of improvement
collocations.zh: 病情好转一段时间后再次恶化

formal.mt: It-tabib kiteb fir-rapport li l-pazjent irkada wara perjodu ta' titjib.
formal.en: The doctor wrote in the report that the patient had relapsed after a period of improvement.
formal.zh: 医生在报告中写道，患者的病情在好转一段时间后再次恶化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk kien qed jirkupra, hux? Pawlu: Iva, imma lbieraħ irkada u reġa' mar l-isptar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your brother was recovering, wasn't he? Pawlu: Yes, but yesterday he relapsed and went back to hospital.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥之前在康复，对吧？Pawlu：是的，可是昨天病情又恶化了，他又去了医院。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥之前在康复，对吧？
messages.en: Your brother was recovering, wasn't he?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (患者的弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma lbieraħ irkada u reġa' mar l-isptar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma lbieraħ irkada u reġa' mar l-isptar.
messages.zh: 是的，可是昨天病情又恶化了，他又去了医院。
messages.en: Yes, but yesterday he relapsed and went back to hospital.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irkada 配上“病情曲线先好转、随后又下降”的画面，重点记住好转之后再次恶化这一转折。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A public sale in which goods are sold to the person who offers the highest price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种公开出售物品的方式，由参与者竞价，通常由出价最高的人购得。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bejgħ pubbliku li fih ix-xerrejja joffru prezzijiet u l-oġġett jinbiegħ lil min joffri l-ogħla prezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍卖；让买家公开竞价，并将物品卖给出价最高者的销售活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bejgħ fejn diversi persuni joffru prezz għal oġġett u jixtrih min joffri l-ogħla somma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An auction is a sale in which people compete by offering prices, and the highest bidder buys the item.

formal.mt: Il-mużew ħabbar irkant pubbliku ta' għamara antika li se jsir is-Sibt.
formal.en: The museum announced a public auction of antique furniture to be held on Saturday.
formal.zh: 博物馆宣布将于星期六举行一场古董家具公开拍卖会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm xtrajtha dik il-mejda? Mark: Ħamsin ewro biss! Xtrajtha f'irkant ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much did you buy that table for? Mark: Only fifty euros! I bought it at an auction yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那张桌子你花了多少钱买的？Mark：才五十欧元！我昨天在拍卖会上买的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那张桌子你花了多少钱买的？
messages.en: How much did you buy that table for?

messages.speaker: Mark (买家)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħamsin ewro biss! Xtrajtha f'irkant ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħamsin ewro biss! Xtrajtha f'irkant ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 才五十欧元！我昨天在拍卖会上买的。
messages.en: Only fifty euros! I bought it at an auction yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 irkant，就想象大家举牌、报价不断上升的拍卖现场；用“最高出价者买走”记住它的核心含义。

gloss_zh: 拍卖行为；以拍卖方式出售的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of selling goods by auction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过竞价拍卖来出售物品的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess ta' bejgħ ta' oġġetti bl-irkant lil min joffri l-ogħla prezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍卖出售的行为或过程，强调通过竞价完成销售这一活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha oġġetti jitqiegħdu għall-bejgħ bl-irkant u jinbiegħu lil min joffri l-ogħla prezz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Auctioning is the activity of offering goods for sale and selling them to the people who bid the highest prices.

formal.mt: L-irkantar tal-għamara se jibda fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu, wara li x-xerrejja jkunu raw l-oġġetti.
formal.en: The auctioning of the furniture will begin at ten in the morning, after buyers have viewed the items.
formal.zh: 家具的拍卖出售将于上午十点开始，买家将在此之前查看物品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta se jibda l-irkantar tal-għamara? Toni: Fl-għaxra. Ejja mmorru qabel biex naraw il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Nina: When will the auctioning of the furniture begin? Toni: At ten. Let's go earlier so we can look at the table.
colloquial.zh: Nina：家具什么时候开始拍卖？Toni：十点。我们早点去，看看那张桌子吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (买家)
messages.zh: 家具什么时候开始拍卖？
messages.en: When will the auctioning of the furniture begin?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-għaxra. Ejja mmorru qabel biex naraw il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-għaxra. Ejja mmorru qabel biex naraw il-mejda.
messages.zh: 十点。我们早点去，看看那张桌子吧。
messages.en: At ten. Let's go earlier so we can look at the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irkantar 记成一段连续画面：展示物品、买家竞价、最后成交；这个词强调拍卖出售的行为和过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who conducts an auction, receives bids, and announces which bidder has bought each item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主持拍卖、接受竞价，并宣布物品由哪位出价者购得的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi irkant, tilqa' l-offerti tax-xerrejja u tħabbar lil min jinbiegħ kull oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍卖师；负责主持竞价拍卖并宣布成交结果的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi l-bejgħ bl-irkant billi tħabbar l-oġġetti, tilqa' l-offerti u tiddikjara lil min jinbiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An auctioneer is a person who leads an auction, takes bids from buyers, and announces the successful bidder.

formal.mt: L-irkantatur ħabbar li l-mejda nbiegħet lill-persuna li offriet mitejn ewro.
formal.en: The auctioneer announced that the table had been sold to the person who offered two hundred euros.
formal.zh: 拍卖师宣布，那张桌子已卖给出价两百欧元的人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak li qed iħabbar il-prezzijiet? David: Dak hu l-irkantatur. Hu qed imexxi l-irkant.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that man announcing the prices? David: That's the auctioneer. He's running the auction.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那个正在报价格的人是谁？David：那是拍卖师。这场拍卖由他主持。

messages.speaker: Sara (首次参加拍卖的买家)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed iħabbar il-prezzijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed iħabbar il-prezzijiet?
messages.zh: 那个正在报价格的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man announcing the prices?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-irkantatur. Hu qed imexxi l-irkant.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-irkantatur. Hu qed imexxi l-irkant.
messages.zh: 那是拍卖师。这场拍卖由他主持。
messages.en: That's the auctioneer. He's running the auction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irkantatur 对应到拍卖现场前方主持报价、宣布成交的那个人；与 irkant“拍卖”一起记，区分活动和主持者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft cheese used in sweet or savoury dishes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种质地柔软的奶酪，可用于制作甜食或咸食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ġobon artab li jintuża fi platti ħelwin jew mielħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 里科塔奶酪，一种可用作甜食或咸食配料的软质奶酪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-irkotta hija tip ta' ġobon artab li jista' jintuża bħala ingredjent fi platti ħelwin jew mielħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ricotta is a soft cheese that people use in both sweet and savoury dishes.

collocations.zh: 里科塔奶酪馅意式饺子

formal.mt: Għall-mili tat-torta, ħallat l-irkotta mal-bajd u żid ftit melħ.
formal.en: For the pie filling, mix the ricotta with the eggs and add a little salt.
formal.zh: 制作馅饼馅料时，将里科塔奶酪与鸡蛋混合，再加入少许盐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se npoġġu fir-ravjul? Pawlu: Irkotta u ftit tursin. Maja: Tajjeb, jien inħejji l-mili.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we put in the ravioli? Pawlu: Ricotta and a little parsley. Maja: Great, I'll prepare the filling.
colloquial.zh: Maja：意式饺子里放什么馅？Pawlu：里科塔奶酪和一点欧芹。Maja：好，我来准备馅料。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 意式饺子里放什么馅？
messages.en: What shall we put in the ravioli?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 里科塔奶酪和一点欧芹。
messages.en: Ricotta and a little parsley.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我来准备馅料。
messages.en: Great, I'll prepare the filling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irkotta 和软白奶酪馅的画面联系起来，再用“奶酪馅饼、奶酪饺子”两个搭配反复记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of returning to health, strength, or a normal condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重新获得健康、体力或正常状态的过程；本词条按名词义学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih persuna terġa' tikseb saħħitha jew xi ħaġa terġa' lura għall-qagħda normali tagħha; f'din il-lezzjoni l-kelma tintuża bħala nom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恢复或康复，指重新达到健康、有力或正常状态的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' ritorn għas-saħħa, għas-saħħa fiżika jew għal qagħda normali wara marda, ħsara jew diffikultà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Recovery is the process of becoming healthy, strong, or normal again after illness or difficulty.

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, in-nom 'irkupra' jiddeskrivi l-proċess li fih persuna terġa' tikseb saħħitha wara marda.
formal.en: In this lesson, the noun 'irkupra' describes the process by which a person regains their health after an illness.
formal.zh: 在本课中，名词 irkupra 表示一个人病后重新恢复健康的过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'irkupra' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Marija: Hawn tfisser il-proċess li fih terġa' tikseb saħħtek. Lara: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar il-proċess wara marda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'irkupra' mean in this exercise? Marija: Here it means the process of regaining your health. Lara: So we're talking about the process after an illness.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这道练习里的 irkupra 是什么意思？Marija：这里指重新恢复健康的过程。Lara：所以说的是生病之后的康复过程。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的 irkupra 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'irkupra' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Marija (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser il-proċess li fih terġa' tikseb saħħtek.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser il-proċess li fih terġa' tikseb saħħtek.
messages.zh: 这里指重新恢复健康的过程。
messages.en: Here it means the process of regaining your health.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar il-proċess wara marda.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar il-proċess wara marda.
messages.zh: 所以说的是生病之后的康复过程。
messages.en: So we're talking about the process after an illness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本条把 irkupra 当作名词记：想象病后从卧床到重新散步的过程，用“恢复过程”这张画面卡帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stiff and difficult to bend or move easily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于僵硬或硬挺的状态，不容易弯曲或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa iebsa jew riġida li ma titgħawwiġx jew ma tiċċaqlaqx faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 僵硬的或硬挺的，指不易弯曲、转动或活动的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi parti tal-ġisem jew materjal li jkun iebes u li jkun diffiċli biex jiċċaqlaq jew jitgħawweġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is stiff does not bend or move easily.

formal.mt: Id-drapp kien irmazzat u ma setax jintlewa faċilment.
formal.en: The fabric was stiff and could not be folded easily.
formal.zh: 这块布料很硬挺，不容易折叠。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed iddawwar ġismek kollu? Mark: Għonqi irmazzat u ma nistax indawwar rasi sew. Nina: Allura npoġġi s-siġġu quddiemek.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you turning your whole body? Mark: My neck is stiff, and I can't turn my head properly. Nina: Then I'll put the chair in front of you.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么整个身子一起转？Mark：我的脖子很僵，头不太转得动。Nina：那我把椅子放到你前面。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么整个身子一起转？
messages.en: Why are you turning your whole body?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għonqi irmazzat u ma nistax indawwar rasi sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għonqi irmazzat u ma nistax indawwar rasi sew.
messages.zh: 我的脖子很僵，头不太转得动。
messages.en: My neck is stiff, and I can't turn my head properly.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我把椅子放到你前面。
messages.en: Then I'll put the chair in front of you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 irmazzat 时想象两幅画：转不动的脖子、折不软的布料，共同抓住“僵硬、不易弯动”的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a plant, to begin forming buds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物开始形成或长出芽苞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li pjanta tibda tifforma jew toħroġ il-blanzuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萌芽，指植物开始长出芽苞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li pjanta tibda tiżviluppa blanzuni li minnhom jistgħu joħorġu weraq jew fjuri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a plant buds, it begins to develop buds that can grow into leaves or flowers.

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, 'irmiet' tirreferi għall-proċess li fih pjanta tibda tifforma blanzuni, bħal dawk li jidhru fuq il-friegħi fir-rebbiegħa.
formal.en: In this lesson, 'irmiet' refers to a plant beginning to form buds, such as those seen on branches in spring.
formal.zh: 在本课中，irmiet 表示植物开始形成芽苞，例如春天枝条上出现芽苞的过程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'irmiet' fil-lezzjoni dwar il-pjanti? Ġanni: Tfisser li pjanta tibda toħroġ il-blanzuni. Sara: Issa nifhem; nista' nimmaġina l-blanzuni żgħar fuq fergħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'irmiet' mean in the lesson about plants? Ġanni: It means that a plant begins to produce buds. Sara: Now I understand; I can picture the little buds on a branch.
colloquial.zh: Sara：植物这课里的 irmiet 是什么意思？Ġanni：意思是植物开始长出芽苞。Sara：现在我懂了，可以想象枝条上那些小小的芽苞。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 植物这课里的 irmiet 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'irmiet' mean in the lesson about plants?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li pjanta tibda toħroġ il-blanzuni.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li pjanta tibda toħroġ il-blanzuni.
messages.zh: 意思是植物开始长出芽苞。
messages.en: It means that a plant begins to produce buds.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem; nista' nimmaġina l-blanzuni żgħar fuq fergħa.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem; nista' nimmaġina l-blanzuni żgħar fuq fergħa.
messages.zh: 现在我懂了，可以想象枝条上那些小小的芽苞。
messages.en: Now I understand; I can picture the little buds on a branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irmiet 配上春天枝条冒出小芽苞的连续画面，重点记住“开始长芽”这个过程，避免只记成静态的芽。

teaching_sense.en_definition: You succeeded in doing something or managed to achieve a result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示你成功完成了某件事，或经过努力达到了目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li inti għamilt xi ħaġa b'suċċess jew wasalt għar-riżultat li xtaqt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你成功了；你完成了原本想做或需要做的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li inti rnexxejt f'dak li kont qed tipprova tagħmel u ksibt ir-riżultat mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are told this, you have succeeded in doing something you were trying to do.

collocations.en: you managed to solve the problem
you managed to pass the exam

formal.mt: Minkejja d-diffikultajiet, irnexxielek tlesti l-proġett fil-ħin u tilħaq l-għanijiet kollha.
formal.en: Despite the difficulties, you managed to complete the project on time and achieve all the objectives.
formal.zh: 尽管遇到困难，你仍成功按时完成了项目，并实现了所有目标。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Irnexxielek tiftaħ il-bieb? Pawlu: Iva, fl-aħħar! Iċ-ċavetta kienet fil-but l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you manage to open the door? Pawlu: Yes, finally! The key was in the other pocket.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你成功把门打开了吗？保罗：打开了，终于！钥匙原来在另一个口袋里。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你成功把门打开了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to open the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fl-aħħar! Iċ-ċavetta kienet fil-but l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fl-aħħar! Iċ-ċavetta kienet fil-but l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 打开了，终于！钥匙原来在另一个口袋里。
messages.en: Yes, finally! The key was in the other pocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irnexxielek 和终于打开门的画面一起记：重点是对着对方说“你做到了”，后接动作便说明成功做了什么。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of words that suggest the opposite of their literal meaning, or a situation whose outcome contrasts strikingly with expectations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用字面上相反的话表达真实意思的反讽，或事情的发展与预期明显相反而产生的讽刺意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod ta' espressjoni li fih il-kliem jissuġġerixxi l-kuntrarju tat-tifsira litterali tiegħu, jew sitwazzjoni li fiha jiġri l-kuntrarju ta' dak li kien mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反讽：通过字面意思与实际用意的反差，或实际结果与预期的反差，产生的表达效果或讽刺意味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-użu ta' kliem biex jinftiehem il-kuntrarju ta' dak li jingħad litteralment, jew il-kuntrast bejn dak li wieħed jistenna u dak li jiġri tassew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Irony occurs when words convey the opposite of their literal meaning or events turn out strikingly differently from what is expected.

formal.mt: L-ironija tas-sitwazzjoni kienet li l-espert fl-immaniġġjar tal-ħin wasal tard għal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The irony of the situation was that the time management expert arrived late for the meeting.
formal.zh: 这件事的讽刺之处在于，时间管理专家开会竟然迟到了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ironija! Xtrajt umbrella u ħallejtha d-dar proprju llum li qed tagħmel ix-xita. Nina: Ejja taħt tiegħi; hemm post għalina t-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What irony! I bought an umbrella and left it at home on the very day it is raining. Nina: Come under mine; there is room for both of us.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：真讽刺！我买了把伞，偏偏今天下雨却把它落在家里了。妮娜：到我的伞下面来吧，够咱们两个人撑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ironija! Xtrajt umbrella u ħallejtha d-dar proprju llum li qed tagħmel ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: X'ironija! Xtrajt umbrella u ħallejtha d-dar proprju llum li qed tagħmel ix-xita.
messages.zh: 真讽刺！我买了把伞，偏偏今天下雨却把它落在家里了。
messages.en: What irony! I bought an umbrella and left it at home on the very day it is raining.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja taħt tiegħi; hemm post għalina t-tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja taħt tiegħi; hemm post għalina t-tnejn.
messages.zh: 到我的伞下面来吧，够咱们两个人撑。
messages.en: Come under mine; there is room for both of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“时间管理专家偏偏迟到”记住 ironija：预期和现实发生反差，就容易产生讽刺意味；说反话也能形成反讽。

gloss_zh: 反讽的；带有讽刺意味的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using words to suggest the opposite of their literal meaning, or showing a striking contrast between expectations and reality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容话语通过字面意思与真实用意的反差表达反讽，或情况因现实与预期相反而具有讽刺意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża kliem biex jissuġġerixxi l-kuntrarju tat-tifsira litterali tiegħu, jew li juri kuntrast qawwi bejn dak li kien mistenni u dak li ġara.
