sense_translations.zh_definition: 反讽的；以反话表达真实用意的，或因实际情况与预期形成反差而显得具有讽刺意味的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jesprimi tifsira kuntrarja għal dik litterali tal-kliem, jew li jinvolvi sitwazzjoni fejn jiġri l-kuntrarju ta' dak li wieħed kien jistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something is ironic if it conveys an opposite meaning or reveals a striking contrast between what is expected and what actually happens.

formal.mt: L-awtur juża ton ironiku biex juri d-differenza bejn il-wegħdiet tal-karattru u l-imġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: The author uses an ironic tone to show the difference between the character's promises and his behaviour.
formal.zh: 作者运用反讽的语气，展现这个人物的承诺与其行为之间的差距。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta għedtli 'Prosit, wasalt kmieni!' kont qed tkun ironiku? Ġanni: Iva! Wasalt nofs siegħa tard.
colloquial.en: Mark: When you said to me, 'Well done, you arrived early!' were you being ironic? Ġanni: Yes! You arrived half an hour late.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你刚才对我说“真棒，你来得真早！”是在说反话吗？詹尼：是啊！你迟到了半个小时。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta għedtli 'Prosit, wasalt kmieni!' kont qed tkun ironiku?
messages.mt_standard: Meta għedtli 'Prosit, wasalt kmieni!' kont qed tkun ironiku?
messages.zh: 你刚才对我说“真棒，你来得真早！”是在说反话吗？
messages.en: When you said to me, 'Well done, you arrived early!' were you being ironic?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊！你迟到了半个小时。
messages.en: Yes! You arrived half an hour late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友迟到却被夸“来得真早”：这句话的语气就是 ironiku。把它放进 ton ironiku 一起记，表示“反讽的语气”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having little thickness, especially when compared with something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体厚度小，尤其用于与另一物体比较时表示较薄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħxuna żgħira, speċjalment meta mqabbel ma' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 薄的；厚度较小的，在比较语境中表示比另一物体更薄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu distanza żgħira bejn iż-żewġ uċuħ tiegħu, jew ħxuna inqas minn dik ta' xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way has little thickness, particularly in comparison with another object.

formal.mt: Għal dan il-mudell, uża karta irqaq minn dik li ntużat għall-qoxra, sabiex tkun tista' tintewa faċilment.
formal.en: For this model, use paper thinner than that used for the cover so that it can be folded easily.
formal.zh: 制作这个模型时，请使用比封面用纸更薄的纸，以便轻松折叠。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-kartun oħxon wisq. Għandek wieħed irqaq? Toni: Iva, ħu dan; ikun aktar faċli biex taqtgħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: This cardboard is too thick. Do you have a thinner one? Toni: Yes, take this one; it will be easier to cut.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张纸板太厚了。你有薄一点的吗？托尼：有，拿这张吧，剪起来会更容易。

messages.speaker: Sara (手工课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kartun oħxon wisq. Għandek wieħed irqaq?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kartun oħxon wisq. Għandek wieħed irqaq?
messages.zh: 这张纸板太厚了。你有薄一点的吗？
messages.en: This cardboard is too thick. Do you have a thinner one?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dan; ikun aktar faċli biex taqtgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dan; ikun aktar faċli biex taqtgħu.
messages.zh: 有，拿这张吧，剪起来会更容易。
messages.en: Yes, take this one; it will be easier to cut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两张纸板并排比较，挑出更容易折叠的薄片，默念 irqaq。借助“厚度更小”的画面记住它在比较中的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tell someone about an event or story, in speech or writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过口头或书面方式向别人讲述事件的经过或故事的内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħid jew tikteb x'ġara f'avveniment jew fi storja biex tgħaddih lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲述、复述某件事情的经过，尤其是经历过的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħid lil xi ħadd x'ġara f'avveniment jew f'esperjenza, u tagħti d-dettalji tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you recount an event or experience, you tell someone what happened.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叙述故事或一连串事件，可采用口头或书面形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħid jew tikteb storja billi tiddeskrivi l-ġrajjiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you narrate a story, you describe its events in speech or writing.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, il-parteċipant irrakkonta fid-dettall x'ġara matul iż-żjara.
formal.en: In his report, the participant recounted in detail what happened during the visit.
formal.zh: 这位参与者在报告中详细叙述了参观期间发生的事情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-vaganza? Pawlu: Għandi ħafna x'nirrakkonta! Nibda bl-ewwel jum?
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the holiday? Pawlu: I have so much to tell you! Shall I start with the first day?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：假期过得怎么样？保罗：有好多事可以讲！我从第一天开始讲好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 假期过得怎么样？
messages.en: How was the holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna x'nirrakkonta! Nibda bl-ewwel jum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna x'nirrakkonta! Nibda bl-ewwel jum?
messages.zh: 有好多事可以讲！我从第一天开始讲好吗？
messages.en: I have so much to tell you! Shall I start with the first day?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友问你假期如何，你从第一天开始往下讲；把这个词和讲经历、讲故事的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act or speak for a person or group, or to stand for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表某个人或群体行事、发言，或用某种事物表示、象征另一事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taġixxi jew titkellem f'isem persuna jew grupp, jew isservi bħala sinjal jew simbolu ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表某人或某个群体；也可指表示或象征某种事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taġixxi jew titkellem f'isem ħaddieħor, jew turi xi ħaġa permezz ta' sinjal jew simbolu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you represent a person or group, you act or speak for them; a sign can also represent something by standing for it.

formal.mt: Id-delegat irrappreżenta lill-istudenti fil-laqgħa u ppreżenta l-proposti tagħhom.
formal.en: The delegate represented the students at the meeting and presented their proposals.
formal.zh: 这名代表在会议上代表学生，并提出了他们的建议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jirrappreżenta lill-klassi fil-laqgħa? Mark: Jien. Għiduli x'tixtiequ li nsemmi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will represent the class at the meeting? Mark: I will. Tell me what you would like me to mention.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁会代表全班去开会？马克：我去。你们告诉我希望我提哪些事情。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 谁会代表全班去开会？
messages.en: Who will represent the class at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (班级代表)
messages.zh: 我去。你们告诉我希望我提哪些事情。
messages.en: I will. Tell me what you would like me to mention.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和英语 represent 配对记忆：班级代表替同学发言，地图上的符号代表地点，两种画面都抓住代表之意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become aware of a fact or understand something that you had not understood before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始意识到某个事实，或明白自己此前没有理解的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinduna b'fatt jew tifhem xi ħaġa li qabel ma kontx konxju tagħha jew ma kontx fhimtha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意识到、察觉到某个事实，或终于明白某件事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Issir konxju ta' fatt jew tifhem xi ħaġa li qabel ma kontx fhimtha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you realise something, you become aware of it or understand it after previously failing to do so.

collocations.en: to realise that he has made a mistake
to realise the importance of something

formal.mt: Wara li qara r-rapport, il-maniġer irrealizza li l-proġett kien jeħtieġ aktar ħin.
formal.en: After reading the report, the manager realised that the project needed more time.
formal.zh: 读完报告后，经理意识到这个项目需要更多时间。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex erġajt lura d-dar? Pawlu: Irrealizzajt li ħallejt il-kartiera fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why did you go back home? Pawlu: I realised that I had left my wallet on the table.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你怎么又回家了？保罗：我意识到自己把钱包落在桌上了。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么又回家了？
messages.en: Why did you go back home?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrealizzajt li ħallejt il-kartiera fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Irrealizzajt li ħallejt il-kartiera fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 我意识到自己把钱包落在桌上了。
messages.en: I realised that I had left my wallet on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和英语 realise 配对记忆：出门后突然想起钱包还在桌上，那一刻的意识到就是这个词的学习画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a sudden attack on a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然袭击某个地点，通常使对方来不及准备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel attakk għal għarrieda fuq post, normalment qabel ma dawk li jkunu hemm ikunu jistgħu jħejju ruħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某地发动突袭；进行突然袭击。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jattakka post għal għarrieda, ħafna drabi biex jaħtaf xi ħaġa jew jolqot lil min ikun hemm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a group raids a place, it attacks suddenly, often to seize something or strike those inside.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-grupp irredja l-kamp matul il-lejl u mbagħad irtira qabel ma waslet l-għajnuna.
formal.en: In the story, the group raided the camp during the night and then withdrew before help arrived.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，这支队伍夜间突袭了营地，并在援助到来之前撤退。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel il-grupp fil-kapitlu li qrajt? Pawlu: Irredja l-kamp matul il-lejl. Ma stennejtx dak l-attakk!
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the group do in the chapter you read? Pawlu: It raided the camp during the night. I wasn't expecting that attack!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你读的那一章里，那支队伍做了什么？Pawlu：他们夜间突袭了营地。我完全没料到那次袭击！

messages.speaker: Lara (读书伙伴)
messages.zh: 你读的那一章里，那支队伍做了什么？
messages.en: What did the group do in the chapter you read?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Irredja l-kamp matul il-lejl. Ma stennejtx dak l-attakk!
messages.mt_standard: Irredja l-kamp matul il-lejl. Ma stennejtx dak l-attakk!
messages.zh: 他们夜间突袭了营地。我完全没料到那次袭击！
messages.en: It raided the camp during the night. I wasn't expecting that attack!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事中的夜间营地来记忆：守卫尚未准备，袭击突然发生。把“突然发动袭击”的动作与这个词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of referring to something or citing a person, work, or bibliographic source.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提及某事、引用某人或某项资料，以及在文章中标注书目来源的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed isemmi xi ħaġa, jikkwota persuna jew xogħol, jew jagħti referenza biblijografika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事的提及或指涉，即说到某事或把注意力引向它。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed isemmi xi ħaġa jew jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejha waqt diskussjoni jew f'kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reference to something mentions it or directs someone's attention to it in speech or writing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人或某事物的引用，通常将其作为论据、依据或例证。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed isemmi persuna, kliem jew materjal bħala evidenza, awtorità jew eżempju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A citation names a person or source as evidence, authority, or an example supporting a statement.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作出书目引注，即提供足以识别所用书籍、文章或其他资料的出版信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħti d-dettalji ta' ktieb, artiklu jew sors ieħor sabiex il-qarrej ikun jista' jidentifikah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bibliographic citation provides identifying details of a publication so that readers can locate the source.

collocations.mt: irrefera għall-istudju f'nota ta' qiegħ il-paġna
collocations.en: cited the study in a footnote
collocations.zh: 在脚注中引用了该研究

formal.mt: Fl-artiklu tiegħu, l-awtur irrefera għal studju dwar it-tagħlim tal-lingwi u ta d-dettalji biblijografiċi tiegħu f'nota ta' qiegħ il-paġna.
formal.en: In his article, the author referred to a study on language learning and provided its bibliographic details in a footnote.
formal.zh: 作者在文章中引用了一项关于语言学习的研究，并在脚注中提供了该研究的书目信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal liema ktieb irrefera l-għalliem illum? Mark: Għall-ktieb li selliftek. Id-dettalji tiegħu jinsabu fl-aħħar tal-fuljett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which book did the teacher refer to today? Mark: The book I lent you. Its details are at the end of the handout.
colloquial.zh: Maja：老师今天提到的是哪本书？Mark：就是我借给你的那本。它的详细信息在讲义末尾。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal liema ktieb irrefera l-għalliem illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għal liema ktieb irrefera l-għalliem illum?
messages.zh: 老师今天提到的是哪本书？
messages.en: Which book did the teacher refer to today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ktieb li selliftek. Id-dettalji tiegħu jinsabu fl-aħħar tal-fuljett.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ktieb li selliftek. Id-dettalji tiegħu jinsabu fl-aħħar tal-fuljett.
messages.zh: 就是我借给你的那本。它的详细信息在讲义末尾。
messages.en: The book I lent you. Its details are at the end of the handout.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象阅读时用手指向另一页：谈话中指向某事是“提及”，论证中指向资料是“引用”，列出出版信息就是“书目引注”。

gloss_zh: 声称有权获得；为……做广告

teaching_sense.en_definition: To assert a claim to something or promote a product, service, or offer through advertising.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提出对某物的权利主张，或通过广告宣传产品、服务或优惠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tgħid li għandek dritt għal xi ħaġa jew tagħmel reklamar għal prodott, servizz jew offerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声称自己对某物享有权利；为产品、服务等做广告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tressaq pretensjoni li xi ħaġa hija tiegħek jew dovuta lilek, jew tippromwovi xi ħaġa permezz ta' reklami.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you claim something, you assert a right to it; if you advertise something, you promote it publicly to attract interest.

formal.mt: Il-ħanut irreklama l-offerta l-ġdida fil-gazzetta lokali.
formal.en: The shop advertised its new offer in the local newspaper.
formal.zh: 这家商店在当地报纸上刊登了新优惠的广告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se tirreklama l-ħanut il-ġdid? Pawlu: Se nirreklamah fuq l-internet u nqassam xi fuljetti.
colloquial.en: Sara: How will you advertise the new shop? Pawlu: I'll advertise it online and hand out some leaflets.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你打算怎样宣传新店？保罗：我会在网上做广告，再发一些传单。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算怎样宣传新店？
messages.en: How will you advertise the new shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nirreklamah fuq l-internet u nqassam xi fuljetti.
messages.mt_standard: Se nirreklamah fuq l-internet u nqassam xi fuljetti.
messages.zh: 我会在网上做广告，再发一些传单。
messages.en: I'll advertise it online and hand out some leaflets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 irreklama 配两张情境卡：一张写“提出权利主张”，另一张画“商店广告”，用上下文区分含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stored as sound or video so that it can be played again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声音或影像已被录下并保存、可以再次播放的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inħażen bħala ħoss jew vidjo sabiex ikun jista' jerġa' jindaqq jew jintwera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已录下并保存、可供播放的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie rrekordjat u miżmum f'forma li tippermetti li jinstema' jew jintwera aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is recorded has been stored as sound or video so that people can listen to it or watch it later.

formal.mt: Il-messaġġ irrekordjat jagħti informazzjoni dwar il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ tal-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The recorded message provides information about the office's opening hours.
formal.zh: 录好的语音信息说明了办公室的开放时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-programm huwa dirett jew irrekordjat? Toni: Huwa irrekordjat, allura nistgħu nwaqqfuh u nkomplu narawh aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this programme live or recorded? Toni: It's recorded, so we can pause it and carry on watching later.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个节目是直播的还是录好的？托尼：是录好的，所以我们可以暂停，晚点接着看。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-programm huwa dirett jew irrekordjat?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-programm huwa dirett jew irrekordjat?
messages.zh: 这个节目是直播的还是录好的？
messages.en: Is this programme live or recorded?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa irrekordjat, allura nistgħu nwaqqfuh u nkomplu narawh aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa irrekordjat, allura nistgħu nwaqqfuh u nkomplu narawh aktar tard.
messages.zh: 是录好的，所以我们可以暂停，晚点接着看。
messages.en: It's recorded, so we can pause it and carry on watching later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 irrekordjat，就想象播放器里已经保存好的节目：能暂停、能重播，帮助记住“已录制的”这一状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not connected with the subject being discussed or the matter being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与正在讨论的主题或正在考虑的问题没有关系的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkollux x'jaqsam mas-suġġett li jkun qed jiġi diskuss jew mal-kwistjoni li tkun qed tiġi kkunsidrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与当前话题、问题或判断无关的；不切题的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx marbut mal-kwistjoni preżenti u ma jgħinx biex din tinftiehem jew tiġi deċiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is irrelevant, it is not connected with the matter being discussed and does not help people consider it.

formal.mt: Dan id-dettall huwa irrelevanti għall-mistoqsija u għalhekk ma ġiex inkluż fir-rapport.
formal.en: This detail is irrelevant to the question and was therefore not included in the report.
formal.zh: 这个细节与问题无关，因此没有被写入报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna nsemmu l-kulur tal-karozza? Mark: Le, huwa irrelevanti. Qed nitkellmu dwar il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Maja: Should we mention the car's colour? Mark: No, it's irrelevant. We're talking about the price.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们要提一下汽车的颜色吗？马克：不用，这和话题无关。我们正在谈价格。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们要提一下汽车的颜色吗？
messages.en: Should we mention the car's colour?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa irrelevanti. Qed nitkellmu dwar il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa irrelevanti. Qed nitkellmu dwar il-prezz.
messages.zh: 不用，这和话题无关。我们正在谈价格。
messages.en: No, it's irrelevant. We're talking about the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irrelevanti 想成放错题目的一张资料卡：资料本身可能有用，但与眼前的问题没有关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring the contents of the stomach back up and out through the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将胃里的食物或液体经口吐出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ mill-ħalq l-ikel jew il-likwidu li jkun hemm fl-istonku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呕吐；在日常口语中指把胃里的东西吐出来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joħroġ mill-ħalq dak li jkun hemm fl-istonku; din it-tifsira tintuża wkoll fit-taħdit ta' kuljum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone throws up, food or liquid comes back out of their stomach through their mouth.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呕吐；以中性或较正式的说法指胃内容物经口排出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joħroġ mill-ħalq il-kontenut tal-istonku, kif jista' jiġi deskritt f'kuntest mediku jew formali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a person vomits, the contents of their stomach are expelled through their mouth.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-pazjent irremetta darbtejn matul il-lejl.
formal.en: According to the report, the patient vomited twice during the night.
formal.zh: 根据报告，患者夜间呕吐了两次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq kmieni Pawlu? Rita: Ma ħassux tajjeb u rremetta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu leave early? Rita: He felt unwell and threw up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么提前走了？丽塔：他觉得不舒服，还吐了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么提前走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave early?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他觉得不舒服，还吐了。
messages.en: He felt unwell and threw up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irremetta 和“饭后不舒服，胃里的东西吐出来”的画面相连；英语口语可对应 throw up，较正式可对应 vomit。

gloss_zh: 回报；以相应的行动回应

teaching_sense.en_definition: To respond to someone's action or feeling with a similar action or feeling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以相似的行动或感情回应对方，尤其指回报善意、帮助或情感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwieġeb għal azzjoni jew sentiment ta' persuna oħra b'azzjoni jew sentiment simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以相应的行动或感情回应；回报对方的善意或帮助。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iwieġeb għal ġest, għajnuna jew sentiment ta' ħaddieħor billi jagħmel jew iħoss xi ħaġa simili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you reciprocate someone's kindness or affection, you show similar kindness or affection towards them.

collocations.zh: 以相应的举动作了回报

formal.mt: Wara li rċieva għajnuna fit-tħejjija tal-wirja, l-artist irreċiproka l-ġest billi għen fl-organizzazzjoni ta' attività oħra.
formal.en: After receiving help with preparing the exhibition, the artist reciprocated the gesture by helping to organise another event.
formal.zh: 这位艺术家在筹备展览时得到帮助，随后协助组织了另一项活动，以此回报对方的善意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Paul għenni niċċaqlaq, u lbieraħ għentu jiżbogħ il-kamra. Lara: Mela rreċiprokajt il-ġest tiegħu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Paul helped me move, and yesterday I helped him paint his room. Lara: So you reciprocated his gesture!
colloquial.zh: Maja：保罗帮我搬了家，昨天我又帮他刷了房间。Lara：那你就是回报了他的善意呀！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Paul għenni niċċaqlaq, u lbieraħ għentu jiżbogħ il-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Paul għenni niċċaqlaq, u lbieraħ għentu jiżbogħ il-kamra.
messages.zh: 保罗帮我搬了家，昨天我又帮他刷了房间。
messages.en: Paul helped me move, and yesterday I helped him paint his room.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那你就是回报了他的善意呀！
messages.en: So you reciprocated his gesture!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两人互相递出一杯茶：你帮助我，我也帮助你。把这个双向回应的画面与“回报、回应”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To perform a role in a theatrical production.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在戏剧演出中扮演角色，通过台词、动作和表情进行表演。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinterpreta parti fi produzzjoni teatrali permezz tal-kliem, il-movimenti u l-espressjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在剧场演出中扮演角色；演戏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jinterpreta karattru fuq il-palk bħala parti minn rappreżentazzjoni teatrali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone acts in a theatre, they perform a character's part in a play before an audience.

formal.mt: Matul il-festival teatrali tal-iskola, Daniel irreċta f'kummiedja quddiem l-istudenti u l-ġenituri tagħhom.
formal.en: During the school's theatre festival, Daniel acted in a comedy before the students and their parents.
formal.zh: 在学校戏剧节期间，丹尼尔面向学生及其家长出演了一部喜剧。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajtu lil Daniel fuq il-palk ilbieraħ? Mark: Iva! Irreċta tajjeb ħafna, u daħħaq lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see Daniel on stage yesterday? Mark: Yes! He acted very well and made everyone laugh.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你昨天看到丹尼尔上台表演了吗？Mark：看到了！他演得很好，把大家都逗笑了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu lil Daniel fuq il-palk ilbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu lil Daniel fuq il-palk ilbieraħ?
messages.zh: 你昨天看到丹尼尔上台表演了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Daniel on stage yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Irreċta tajjeb ħafna, u daħħaq lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Irreċta tajjeb ħafna, u daħħaq lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 看到了！他演得很好，把大家都逗笑了。
messages.en: Yes! He acted very well and made everyone laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进舞台画面：幕布拉开，演员说出台词并扮演角色。记住这里的“演”是戏剧表演。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To preserve information in writing or capture sound or images so they can be consulted later.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把信息记下来，或录下声音、影像，以便日后查阅或播放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li żżomm informazzjoni bil-kitba jew taħżen ħsejjes jew immaġnijiet biex tkun tista' terġa' tużahom aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记录信息，或录制声音、影像以供日后使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tniżżel informazzjoni jew taħżen ħoss jew immaġnijiet sabiex jibqgħu disponibbli għal aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you record information, sounds, or images, you preserve them so that they can be consulted, heard, or viewed later.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur irreġistra l-intervista bil-permess tal-parteċipant.
formal.en: The researcher recorded the interview with the participant's permission.
formal.zh: 研究人员征得参与者同意后录下了访谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tirreġistra l-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, nirreġistraha biex inkunu nistgħu nerġgħu nisimgħuha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you record the meeting? Mark: Yes, I'll record it so we can listen to it again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能把会议录下来吗？马克：可以，我会录下来，方便我们再听一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你能把会议录下来吗？
messages.en: Can you record the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nirreġistraha biex inkunu nistgħu nerġgħu nisimgħuha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nirreġistraha biex inkunu nistgħu nerġgħu nisimgħuha.
messages.zh: 可以，我会录下来，方便我们再听一遍。
messages.en: Yes, I'll record it so we can listen to it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irreġistra 和按下录音键、写下实验结果两个画面联系起来：共同点都是把信息留下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To oppose something or withstand its pressure, force or attraction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事进行抵抗或抵制，或顶住压力、力量及诱惑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jopponi xi ħaġa jew jibqa' sod quddiem pressjoni, forza jew tentazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵抗、抵制某种力量或要求，也可指克制自己而抵挡诱惑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jċedix għal forza, pressjoni jew tentazzjoni, jew li jopponi xi ħaġa li tkun qed tiġi imposta fuqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you resist something, you oppose it or prevent it from making you act in a particular way.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irreżista l-pressjoni biex ibiddel id-deċiżjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The committee resisted the pressure to change its decision.
formal.zh: 委员会顶住了要求其改变决定的压力。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Pawlu xtara kejk ieħor? Mark: Le, din id-darba rreżista t-tentazzjoni!
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Pawlu buy another cake? Mark: No, this time he resisted the temptation!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗又买了一个蛋糕吗？马克：没有，这回他抵挡住了诱惑！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗又买了一个蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu buy another cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，这回他抵挡住了诱惑！
messages.en: No, this time he resisted the temptation!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irreżista 想成“站稳脚步不让步”：面对压力是顶住，面对诱惑是忍住；用“压力”和“蛋糕”两个画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something smaller or lower in amount, size, degree or cost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的数量、大小、程度或费用变少或降低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel xi ħaġa iżgħar jew inaqqas il-kwantità, il-livell jew l-ispiża tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减少、降低或缩减，使数量、规模、程度或费用低于原先水平。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jnaqqas l-ammont, id-daqs, il-grad jew l-ispiża ta' xi ħaġa meta mqabbla ma' qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you reduce something, you make its amount, size, degree or cost smaller than before.

formal.mt: Il-proġett irriduċa l-konsum tal-karta fl-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The project reduced paper consumption in the office.
formal.zh: 该项目减少了办公室的纸张消耗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ġakkett għadu jiswa sittin ewro? Ben: Le, il-ħanut irriduċa l-prezz għal erbgħin ewro.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this jacket still cost sixty euros? Ben: No, the shop reduced the price to forty euros.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这件夹克还是六十欧元吗？本：不是了，商店把价格降到了四十欧元。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ġakkett għadu jiswa sittin ewro?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ġakkett għadu jiswa sittin ewro?
messages.zh: 这件夹克还是六十欧元吗？
messages.en: Does this jacket still cost sixty euros?

messages.speaker: Ben (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-ħanut irriduċa l-prezz għal erbgħin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-ħanut irriduċa l-prezz għal erbgħin ewro.
messages.zh: 不是了，商店把价格降到了四十欧元。
messages.en: No, the shop reduced the price to forty euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irriduċa 配上价格标签从六十改成四十的画面，记住“让数值变小”；再扩展到减少用纸和削减费用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mention or direct attention to something, or to send someone to another person for advice or help.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提到某事或引导他人查阅相关资料；也指将某人转介给能够提供建议或帮助的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isemmi xi ħaġa jew jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejha, jew jibgħat lil xi ħadd għand persuna oħra għal parir jew għajnuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提及或指向某个对象、话题或资料；也可指把某人转介给其他专业人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isemmi persuna, suġġett jew sors ta' informazzjoni, jew jibgħat lil xi ħadd għand persuna oħra li tista' tagħtih għajnuna speċjalizzata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you refer to something, you mention it or direct attention to it; if you refer someone to a specialist, you send them there for expert help.

collocations.en: referred a patient to a specialist
collocations.zh: 将一名患者转介给专科医生

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur irrifera għal studju dwar it-tagħlim tal-lingwi.
formal.en: In his report, the researcher referred to a study on language learning.
formal.zh: 研究人员在报告中提及了一项关于语言学习的研究。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek appuntament ma' speċjalista? Mark: It-tabib irrifera lili għand speċjalista biex niċċekkja l-irkoppa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have an appointment with a specialist? Mark: The doctor referred me to a specialist to have my knee checked.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么预约了专科医生？Mark：医生把我转介给了专科医生，让我检查一下膝盖。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么预约了专科医生？
messages.en: Why do you have an appointment with a specialist?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tabib irrifera lili għand speċjalista biex niċċekkja l-irkoppa.
messages.mt_standard: It-tabib irrifera lili għand speċjalista biex niċċekkja l-irkoppa.
messages.zh: 医生把我转介给了专科医生，让我检查一下膝盖。
messages.en: The doctor referred me to a specialist to have my knee checked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词记成一个指向别处的箭头：写文章时指向资料，就是提及；看病时指向专科医生，就是转介。

gloss_zh: 拒绝；否认或拒不承认；拒绝给予

teaching_sense.en_definition: To refuse to accept or do something, reject a claim or responsibility, or deliberately refuse to give something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拒绝接受某事或做某事；否认某项说法或拒不承认某项责任；也可指有意拒绝提供某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jaċċettax xi ħaġa jew ma jkunx lest li jagħmilha, jiċħad stqarrija jew responsabbiltà, jew ma jkunx lest li jagħti xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拒绝接受某物、同意某项请求或执行某个行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ma jaċċettax offerta jew talba, jew jgħid li mhuwiex lest li jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you refuse something, you say that you will not accept it or agree to do what is requested.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明确否认某项说法，或拒不承认某项责任、义务或关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiċħad b'mod ċar stqarrija jew allegazzjoni, jew ma jaċċettax li għandu responsabbiltà, obbligu jew rabta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you repudiate a claim or responsibility, you firmly reject it or deny that it applies to you.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有意不提供或不交出某物，例如资料、许可或款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iżomm lura informazzjoni, permess, flus jew xi ħaġa oħra u ma jagħtihomx lil min jitlobhom jew jistenniehom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you withhold something, you deliberately do not give it to someone who requests or expects it.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irrifjuta l-proposta għax ma kinitx tinkludi biżżejjed informazzjoni dwar l-ispejjeż.
formal.en: The committee rejected the proposal because it did not include enough information about the costs.
formal.zh: 委员会拒绝了这项提案，因为其中没有提供足够的费用信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu aċċetta x-xogħol? Nina: Le, irrifjuta l-offerta għax il-ħinijiet ma kinux tajbin għalih.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu accept the job? Nina: No, he refused the offer because the working hours did not suit him.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu接受那份工作了吗？Nina：没有，他拒绝了那份工作邀约，因为工作时间不适合他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu接受那份工作了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu accept the job?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irrifjuta l-offerta għax il-ħinijiet ma kinux tajbin għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irrifjuta l-offerta għax il-ħinijiet ma kinux tajbin għalih.
messages.zh: 没有，他拒绝了那份工作邀约，因为工作时间不适合他。
messages.en: No, he refused the offer because the working hours did not suit him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人举手说不：对提议说不，是拒绝；对指控说不，是否认；对索取资料说不，是拒绝给予。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To send back light or an image, show a situation or feeling, or think carefully about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反射光线或映出影像；反映某种情况或感受；也指认真思考某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibgħat lura d-dawl jew juri xbieha, juri sitwazzjoni jew sentiment, jew jaħseb sew dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反射光线或映照影像；体现某种状况、特点或感受；也可指仔细思考或反省。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibgħat lura d-dawl jew juri xbieha fuq wiċċ bħal mera, jesprimi jew juri xi kundizzjoni jew sentiment, jew jaħseb fil-fond dwar xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something reflects light or an image, it sends it back; it can also show a condition or feeling, while a person who reflects thinks carefully.

formal.mt: Qabel ma ppreżenta r-rakkomandazzjonijiet tiegħu, l-espert irrifletta fuq ir-riżultati tal-istudju.
formal.en: Before presenting his recommendations, the expert reflected on the results of the study.
formal.zh: 专家在提出建议之前，认真思考了这项研究的结果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark għadu ma weġibx? Pawlu: Irrifletta fuq il-proposta lbieraħ, imma għadu jrid ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why hasn't Mark replied yet? Pawlu: He reflected on the proposal yesterday, but he still needs a little time.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark为什么还没回复？Pawlu：他昨天认真考虑了这个提议，但还需要一点时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: Mark为什么还没回复？
messages.en: Why hasn't Mark replied yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrifletta fuq il-proposta lbieraħ, imma għadu jrid ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Irrifletta fuq il-proposta lbieraħ, imma għadu jrid ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 他昨天认真考虑了这个提议，但还需要一点时间。
messages.en: He reflected on the proposal yesterday, but he still needs a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记忆：镜子把光照回来，报告把情况呈现出来，人把问题放在心里反复想。思考某事时可连用 fuq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To improve a system, institution, practice, or person's behaviour by making changes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过改变制度、机构、做法或个人行为，使其得到改善。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibiddel sistema, istituzzjoni, prattika jew l-imġiba ta' persuna bil-għan li jtejjibha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 改革或改良现有制度、组织或做法，以纠正问题；也可指改善人的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel bidliet f'sistema, organizzazzjoni jew mod ta' kif isiru l-affarijiet sabiex jikkoreġi n-nuqqasijiet, jew itejjeb l-imġiba ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you reform a system or practice, you change it to correct problems and make it work better; you can also reform someone's behaviour.

formal.mt: Il-gvern irriforma s-sistema edukattiva biex itejjeb l-aċċess għat-tagħlim u jnaqqas l-inugwaljanza.
formal.en: The government reformed the education system to improve access to learning and reduce inequality.
formal.zh: 政府改革了教育制度，以改善学习机会并减少不平等。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex issa l-applikazzjoni tieħu inqas ħin? Mark: Il-kunsill irriforma l-proċess. Issa nimlew formola waħda biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the application take less time now? Mark: The council reformed the process. Now we only fill in one form.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么现在申请花的时间更少了？Mark：地方议会改革了流程。现在我们只要填一张表。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex issa l-applikazzjoni tieħu inqas ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex issa l-applikazzjoni tieħu inqas ħin?
messages.zh: 为什么现在申请花的时间更少了？
messages.en: Why does the application take less time now?

messages.speaker: Mark (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kunsill irriforma l-proċess. Issa nimlew formola waħda biss.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kunsill irriforma l-proċess. Issa nimlew formola waħda biss.
messages.zh: 地方议会改革了流程。现在我们只要填一张表。
messages.en: The council reformed the process. Now we only fill in one form.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本要填五张表，改进流程后只填一张：抓住为改善而改变这个核心，就能记住改革与改良的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suggest a person, thing, or course of action as a good or suitable choice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为某人、某物或某种做法合适，而向他人推荐或建议采用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissuġġerixxi persuna, ħaġa jew mod ta' kif wieħed jaġixxi bħala għażla tajba jew adattata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向他人推荐合适的人或事物，或建议采取某种做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jipproponi lil xi ħadd persuna jew ħaġa bħala għażla tajba, jew jagħtih parir biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone recommends a person, thing, or action, they suggest that it would be a good choice.

collocations.en: recommended that we read every day

formal.mt: L-għalliem irrikkmanda dan il-ktieb lill-istudenti għax fih eżempji ċari.
formal.en: The teacher recommended this book to the students because it contains clear examples.
formal.zh: 老师向学生推荐了这本书，因为书中的例子很清楚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min irrikkmanda dan ir-ristorant? Mark: Pawlu. Qal li l-ikel tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who recommended this restaurant? Mark: Pawlu. He said the food is good.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁推荐了这家餐厅？马克：保罗。他说这里的饭菜不错。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁推荐了这家餐厅？
messages.en: Who recommended this restaurant?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗。他说这里的饭菜不错。
messages.en: Pawlu. He said the food is good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把一本好书递给学生，说值得读；用“推荐书、推荐餐厅、建议每天阅读”三个搭配一起记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To advise someone that a particular person, thing, or action would be suitable or beneficial.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人推荐适合的人或事物，或建议采取有益、合适的行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti parir lil xi ħadd biex jagħżel persuna jew ħaġa adattata, jew biex jieħu azzjoni li tista' tkun ta' ġid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推荐值得选择的人或事物；建议采取适当的行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jissuġġerixxi persuna jew ħaġa bħala għażla xierqa, jew jagħti parir dwar dak li jkun tajjeb li jsir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone recommends something, they advise another person to choose it or to follow a particular course of action.

collocations.zh: 推荐了一门马耳他语课程

formal.mt: Il-konsulent irrikomanda li l-grupp jiġbor aktar informazzjoni qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The adviser recommended that the group gather more information before making a decision.
formal.zh: 顾问建议小组先收集更多信息，再作决定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min irrikomanda din il-lukanda? David: Ħija. Qal li l-kmamar huma komdi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who recommended this hotel? David: My brother. He said the rooms are comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁推荐了这家旅馆？戴维：我兄弟。他说房间很舒适。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁推荐了这家旅馆？
messages.en: Who recommended this hotel?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija. Qal li l-kmamar huma komdi.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija. Qal li l-kmamar huma komdi.
messages.zh: 我兄弟。他说房间很舒适。
messages.en: My brother. He said the rooms are comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“朋友推荐旅馆、顾问建议等一等”建立两个记忆画面：后面接事物时理解为推荐，接行动内容时理解为建议。

gloss_zh: 求助于；采用某种办法；到访商店等营业场所

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn to someone or something for help, or to visit a shop or another commercial outlet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了获得帮助或解决问题而求助于某人、采用某种办法；也可指到访商店等营业场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfittex l-għajnuna ta' xi ħadd jew tuża mezz biex issolvi problema; tista' wkoll tmur f'ħanut jew fi stabbiliment kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 求助于某人或某种资源；为应对困难而采用某种办法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfittex l-għajnuna ta' persuna jew tuża mezz partikolari biex tlaħħaq ma' diffikultà jew issolvi problema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you resort to someone or something, you turn to them for help or use a particular method to deal with a difficulty.

sense_translations.en_definition: to visit (e.g. a shop or other commercial outlet)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 到访商店或其他营业场所，以购买商品或使用服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tmur f'ħanut jew fi stabbiliment kummerċjali biex tixtri xi ħaġa jew tuża servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you visit a commercial outlet, you go there to buy goods or make use of its services.

formal.mt: Meta l-apparat ma baqax jaħdem, id-direttur irrikorra għall-għajnuna ta' tekniku.
formal.en: When the equipment stopped working, the director turned to a technician for help.
formal.zh: 设备停止运作后，主管向一名技术人员求助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għand min irrikorrejt biex tixtri d-drapp? Mark: Irrikorrejt għand bejjiegħ lokali u sibt eżatt dak li ridt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which seller did you visit to buy the fabric? Mark: I visited a local seller and found exactly what I wanted.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你去找哪家商家买布料了？马克：我去了一家当地商家，正好找到了想要的布料。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għand min irrikorrejt biex tixtri d-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Għand min irrikorrejt biex tixtri d-drapp?
messages.zh: 你去找哪家商家买布料了？
messages.en: Which seller did you visit to buy the fabric?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrikorrejt għand bejjiegħ lokali u sibt eżatt dak li ridt.
messages.mt_standard: Irrikorrejt għand bejjiegħ lokali u sibt eżatt dak li ridt.
messages.zh: 我去了一家当地商家，正好找到了想要的布料。
messages.en: I visited a local seller and found exactly what I wanted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成“有事便去找”：遇到困难去找帮助，购物时去找商家，用两个场景区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become less tense or worried and allow yourself to rest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让身体或心情从紧张状态中放松下来，使自己得到休息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqas it-tensjoni fil-ġisem jew fil-ħsieb u tħalli lilek innifsek tistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放松身体或心情，减轻紧张、忧虑或压力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Issir aktar kalm u inqas imħasseb jew tħalli l-ġisem jistrieħ wara tensjoni jew għeja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you relax, you become calmer and less tense, often by resting or doing something pleasant.

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata ta' taħriġ intensiv, il-parteċipant irrilassa għal ftit minuti fil-ġnien.
formal.en: After a day of intensive training, the participant relaxed in the garden for a few minutes.
formal.zh: 经过一天的密集培训后，这位参与者在花园里放松了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ħassejtek wara l-eżami? Pawlu: Għall-ewwel kont nervuż, imma mbagħad irrilassajt ftit bil-mużika.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you feel after the exam? Pawlu: At first I was nervous, but then I relaxed a little with some music.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：考完试后你感觉怎么样？保罗：起初我很紧张，不过后来听了点音乐，放松了一些。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 考完试后你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did you feel after the exam?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ewwel kont nervuż, imma mbagħad irrilassajt ftit bil-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ewwel kont nervuż, imma mbagħad irrilassajt ftit bil-mużika.
messages.zh: 起初我很紧张，不过后来听了点音乐，放松了一些。
messages.en: At first I was nervous, but then I relaxed a little with some music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象考完试后放下书包、松开肩膀、听音乐，把这个词和“身心放松”的画面绑定。

gloss_zh: 放弃；正式声明不再拥有或接受

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally give up a right, claim, possession, or belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 明确或正式地放弃某项权利、要求、财物或信念，表示不再拥有、主张或接受它。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddikjara b'mod ċar jew formali li qed iċċedi dritt, pretensjoni, xi ħaġa li għandek jew twemmin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明确或正式地宣布放弃某种权利、资格、要求、所有物或信念。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħid b'mod ċar jew uffiċjali li m'intix se tibqa' żżomm dritt, tagħmel pretensjoni għal xi ħaġa jew tħaddan twemmin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you renounce something, you formally declare that you are giving it up or no longer accepting it.

formal.mt: F'ittra lill-kumitat, ir-rebbieħ irrinunzja għall-premju u spjega r-raġunijiet tad-deċiżjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: In a letter to the committee, the winner renounced the prize and explained the reasons for his decision.
formal.zh: 获奖者在致委员会的信中声明放弃奖项，并解释了作出这一决定的原因。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ismek ma baqax fil-lista tar-rebbieħa? Toni: Irrinunzjajt għall-premju u ktibt lill-kumitat biex ngħarrafhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is your name no longer on the winners' list? Toni: I renounced the prize and wrote to the committee to let them know.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么获奖名单上没有你的名字了？托尼：我放弃了奖项，还写信通知了委员会。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ismek ma baqax fil-lista tar-rebbieħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ismek ma baqax fil-lista tar-rebbieħa?
messages.zh: 为什么获奖名单上没有你的名字了？
messages.en: Why is your name no longer on the winners' list?

messages.speaker: Toni (获奖者)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrinunzjajt għall-premju u ktibt lill-kumitat biex ngħarrafhom.
messages.mt_standard: Irrinunzjajt għall-premju u ktibt lill-kumitat biex ngħarrafhom.
messages.zh: 我放弃了奖项，还写信通知了委员会。
messages.en: I renounced the prize and wrote to the committee to let them know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把写着“我的权利”或“我的奖项”的卡片交回，并明确说“我放弃”，记住主动声明的意味。

gloss_zh: 重复；再说一遍；再做一次

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say or do something again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把已经说过的话再说一遍，或把已经做过的事情再做一次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terġa' tgħid kliem li jkun diġà ntqal jew terġa' tagħmel xi ħaġa li tkun diġà saret.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重复说出同样的话，或再次进行同一动作、活动或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħid l-istess kliem għal darba oħra jew tagħmel mill-ġdid azzjoni, attività jew proċess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you repeat something, you say it again or do the same action another time.

formal.mt: L-għalliem irripeta l-istruzzjonijiet bil-mod biex l-istudenti kollha jkunu jistgħu jifhmuhom.
formal.en: The teacher repeated the instructions slowly so that all the students could understand them.
formal.zh: 老师慢慢地重复了一遍指示，以便所有学生都能听懂。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tirrepeti l-aħħar kelma, jekk jogħġbok? David: Iva, il-kelma hi 'tieqa'. Tridni ngħidha aktar bil-mod?
colloquial.en: Nina: Could you repeat the last word, please? David: Yes, the word is 'tieqa'. Would you like me to say it more slowly?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：请你把最后一个词再说一遍，好吗？戴维：好的，那个词是“tieqa”，意思是“窗户”。要我说慢一点吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tirrepeti l-aħħar kelma, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tirrepeti l-aħħar kelma, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请你把最后一个词再说一遍，好吗？
messages.en: Could you repeat the last word, please?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kelma hi 'tieqa'. Tridni ngħidha aktar bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kelma hi 'tieqa'. Tridni ngħidha aktar bil-mod?
messages.zh: 好的，那个词是“tieqa”，意思是“窗户”。要我说慢一点吗？
messages.en: Yes, the word is 'tieqa'. Would you like me to say it more slowly?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和播放器的“重复”按钮联系起来：一句话再听一遍，一个动作再做一次。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a copy of something or present it again in a similar form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作某物的副本，或以相似形式重新呈现原有的内容、形象或声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel kopja ta' xi ħaġa jew terġa' tippreżentaha f'għamla simili għall-oriġinal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复制某物，或重新呈现原有的内容、形象或声音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel kopja ta' xi ħaġa jew terġa' toħloq id-dehra jew il-ħoss tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you reproduce something, you make a copy of it or create its appearance or sound again.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport irriproduċa t-tabella oriġinali biex il-qarrejja setgħu jqabblu r-riżultati.
formal.en: The report reproduced the original table so that readers could compare the results.
formal.zh: 报告复制了原始表格，以便读者比较结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min irriproduċa din l-istampa? Pawlu: Jien. Użajt l-istess kuluri biex tkun tixbah lill-oriġinal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who reproduced this picture? Pawlu: I did. I used the same colours so it would look like the original.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁复制了这幅图片？Pawlu：是我。我用了相同的颜色，让它看起来像原图。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁复制了这幅图片？
messages.en: Who reproduced this picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Użajt l-istess kuluri biex tkun tixbah lill-oriġinal.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Użajt l-istess kuluri biex tkun tixbah lill-oriġinal.
messages.zh: 是我。我用了相同的颜色，让它看起来像原图。
messages.en: I did. I used the same colours so it would look like the original.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原图旁边出现一张相同的副本，把 irriproduċa 与“复制、再现”的画面一起记住。

gloss_zh: 冒险；冒着失去或受损的风险；大胆尝试

teaching_sense.en_definition: To expose someone or something to possible harm or loss, or dare to do something uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物面临受伤、受损或失去的可能，或冒险尝试结果不确定的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa fil-periklu, jew tazzarda tagħmel xi ħaġa minkejja li r-riżultat mhux ċert.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒着某人受伤或某物受损、失去的风险；使其处于危险之中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa f'sitwazzjoni fejn jista' jkun hemm ħsara, telf jew periklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you risk something, you put it in a situation where it could be harmed or lost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尽管存在困难、危险或不确定性，仍大胆尝试或采取行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tazzarda tagħmel xi ħaġa minkejja d-diffikultà, il-periklu jew l-inċertezza dwar ir-riżultat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you venture to do something, you dare to attempt it despite uncertainty or possible difficulty.

collocations.mt: irriskja u pprova xi ħaġa ġdida

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem irriskja ħajtu biex isalva persuna li kienet maqbuda fil-bini.
formal.en: The worker risked his life to save a person trapped in the building.
formal.zh: 这名工人冒着生命危险，救出了一名被困在楼内的人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark veru fetaħ ħanut waħdu? Luqa: Iva, irriskja u beda n-negozju tiegħu, għalkemm ma kienx jaf jekk kienx se jirnexxi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark really open a shop on his own? Luqa: Yes, he ventured to start his own business, although he did not know whether it would succeed.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark真的独自开了一家店吗？Luqa：是的，他大胆创业了，虽然当时并不知道能否成功。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark真的独自开了一家店吗？
messages.en: Did Mark really open a shop on his own?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irriskja u beda n-negozju tiegħu, għalkemm ma kienx jaf jekk kienx se jirnexxi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irriskja u beda n-negozju tiegħu, għalkemm ma kienx jaf jekk kienx se jirnexxi.
messages.zh: 是的，他大胆创业了，虽然当时并不知道能否成功。
messages.en: Yes, he ventured to start his own business, although he did not know whether it would succeed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irriskja 放进两个画面：拿生命冒险，以及鼓起勇气开店；分别记住“承担风险”和“大胆尝试”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat someone with consideration or give proper importance to their rights, wishes, or decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以体谅、重视的态度对待他人，认真看待其权利、意愿或决定，也可指尊重并遵守规则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tittratta lil xi ħadd b'ġieħ u konsiderazzjoni, tqis id-drittijiet, ix-xewqat jew id-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu, jew tosserva r-regoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尊重他人，重视其权利、意愿或决定；对规则等予以尊重并遵守。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti ġieħ u konsiderazzjoni lil xi ħadd, tqis dak li jixtieq jew jiddeċiedi, jew tosserva regola.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you respect someone or something, you treat them with consideration or recognize their rights, wishes, or importance.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irrispetta d-deċiżjoni tal-istudent li ma jiħux sehem fl-istudju.
formal.en: The committee respected the student's decision not to participate in the study.
formal.zh: 委员会尊重了这名学生不参加该研究的决定。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif ħadha Mark meta għedtlu li ma stajtx immur? Lara: Irrispetta d-deċiżjoni tiegħek u qal li nistgħu niltaqgħu darba oħra.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did Mark take it when I told him I could not come? Lara: He respected your decision and said we could meet another time.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我告诉Mark我去不了时，他是什么反应？Lara：他尊重了你的决定，说我们可以改天再见。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħadha Mark meta għedtlu li ma stajtx immur?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħadha Mark meta għedtlu li ma stajtx immur?
messages.zh: 我告诉Mark我去不了时，他是什么反应？
messages.en: How did Mark take it when I told him I could not come?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrispetta d-deċiżjoni tiegħek u qal li nistgħu niltaqgħu darba oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Irrispetta d-deċiżjoni tiegħek u qal li nistgħu niltaqgħu darba oħra.
messages.zh: 他尊重了你的决定，说我们可以改天再见。
messages.en: He respected your decision and said we could meet another time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友说“不”，你认真听完并接受他的决定；用这个动作画面记住 irrispetta 的“尊重”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Held in high regard by other people because of one's qualities, conduct, or achievements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因品格、行为或成就而受到他人尊重和敬重的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgawdi r-rispett u l-istima ta' ħaddieħor minħabba l-kwalitajiet, l-imġiba jew il-kisbiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到他人尊重、认可或敬重的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa meqjus b'rispett u stima minn ħaddieħor għall-kwalitajiet, l-imġiba jew ix-xogħol tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is respected is regarded highly by other people because of their qualities, behaviour, or achievements.

formal.mt: Il-professur huwa riċerkatur irrispettat għall-preċiżjoni tax-xogħol tiegħu u għall-onestà tiegħu.
formal.en: The professor is a researcher respected for the precision of his work and his honesty.
formal.zh: 这位教授是一名因研究严谨和为人诚实而受敬重的研究人员。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex kulħadd jitlob parir lil Ġużeppi? Toni: Għax hu bniedem irrispettat ħafna hawn; dejjem jisma' u jgħin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does everyone ask Ġużeppi for advice? Toni: Because he is highly respected here; he always listens and helps.
colloquial.zh: Nina：为什么大家都向Ġużeppi请教？Toni：因为他在这里备受尊重；他总是愿意倾听并帮助别人。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd jitlob parir lil Ġużeppi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd jitlob parir lil Ġużeppi?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都向Ġużeppi请教？
messages.en: Why does everyone ask Ġużeppi for advice?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu bniedem irrispettat ħafna hawn; dejjem jisma' u jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu bniedem irrispettat ħafna hawn; dejjem jisma' u jgħin.
messages.zh: 因为他在这里备受尊重；他总是愿意倾听并帮助别人。
messages.en: Because he is highly respected here; he always listens and helps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位老师走进教室，大家认真听他讲话；把 irrispettat 贴在老师身上，记成“受敬重的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause physical discomfort or make someone feel annoyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使身体某个部位受到刺激而不适，或使某人感到烦躁、恼火。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikkawża skumdità f'parti tal-ġisem jew ġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss dwejjaq jew rabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺激皮肤等身体部位，使其不适；也指使人烦躁。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikkawża skumdità jew ħakk f'parti tal-ġisem, jew ġiegħel lil persuna tiddejjaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something irritates you, it makes part of your body uncomfortable or makes you feel annoyed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人烦恼或恼火，尤指因令人不快的行为或情况而心烦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss dwejjaq jew rabja minħabba mġiba jew sitwazzjoni li ma togħġbux.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something vexes you, they cause you to feel annoyed, troubled, or frustrated.

formal.mt: Is-sapun il-ġdid irrita l-ġilda ta' xi parteċipanti, u għalhekk waqfu jużawh.
formal.en: The new soap irritated the skin of some participants, so they stopped using it.
formal.zh: 新肥皂刺激了部分参与者的皮肤，因此他们停止使用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex tlaqt mill-kamra? Pawlu: L-istorbju irritani, u kelli bżonn ftit kwiet.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you leave the room? Pawlu: The noise annoyed me, and I needed some quiet.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你为什么离开房间？Pawlu：噪声让我心烦，我需要安静一会儿。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开房间？
messages.en: Why did you leave the room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-istorbju irritani, u kelli bżonn ftit kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: L-istorbju irritani, u kelli bżonn ftit kwiet.
messages.zh: 噪声让我心烦，我需要安静一会儿。
messages.en: The noise annoyed me, and I needed some quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两种刺激画面连起来记：肥皂刺激皮肤，噪声刺激情绪；irrita 都表示让人不舒服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make information or something previously hidden known to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使原先未知、隐瞒或未公开的信息为他人所知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għarraf lil ħaddieħor b'informazzjoni jew b'xi ħaġa li qabel kienet moħbija jew mhux magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 透露或揭示先前不为人知的信息、事实或秘密。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kixef fatt, sigriet jew informazzjoni li qabel ma kinux magħrufa jew kienu miżmuma moħbija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you reveal something, you make information or facts known that were previously hidden or unknown.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport irrivela li diversi familji ma kellhomx aċċess regolari għall-ilma.
formal.en: The report revealed that several families did not have regular access to water.
formal.zh: 报告揭示，有几户家庭无法定期获得供水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min irrivela s-sigriet tal-festa? Luqa: Ħija qallu kollox, u issa jaf bis-sorpriża.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who revealed the secret about the party? Luqa: My brother told him everything, and now he knows about the surprise.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁把派对的秘密说出去了？Luqa：我哥哥把一切都告诉他了，现在他知道那个惊喜了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把派对的秘密说出去了？
messages.en: Who revealed the secret about the party?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija qallu kollox, u issa jaf bis-sorpriża.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija qallu kollox, u issa jaf bis-sorpriża.
messages.zh: 我哥哥把一切都告诉他了，现在他知道那个惊喜了。
messages.en: My brother told him everything, and now he knows about the surprise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把盖住信息的布揭开：别人原来不知道，现在知道了，这个动作就对应 irrivela。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To refuse to accept something, or to bring food or liquid back up from the stomach through the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拒绝接受某事物；也可指将胃中的食物或液体经口吐出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jaċċettax xi ħaġa, jew itella' mill-istonku u joħroġ mill-ħalq ikel jew likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拒绝接受某项建议、请求或其他事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ma jaċċettax proposta, talba jew xi ħaġa oħra li tiġi offruta jew ippreżentata lilu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone rejects something, they refuse to accept or approve it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呕吐；将胃中的食物或液体经口吐出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Itella' ikel jew likwidu mill-istonku u joħorġu minn ħalqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone throws up, food or liquid comes back out of their stomach through their mouth.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irriġetta l-proposta għax l-ispejjeż kienu għoljin wisq.
formal.en: The committee rejected the proposal because the costs were too high.
formal.zh: 委员会因费用过高而拒绝了这项提议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq kmieni Pawlu? Lara: Ma ħassux tajjeb u rriġetta wara l-ikla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu leave early? Lara: He felt unwell and threw up after the meal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么提前走了？拉拉：他身体不舒服，饭后还吐了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么提前走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave early?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma ħassux tajjeb u rriġetta wara l-ikla.
messages.mt_standard: Ma ħassux tajjeb u rriġetta wara l-ikla.
messages.zh: 他身体不舒服，饭后还吐了。
messages.en: He felt unwell and threw up after the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景配对记忆：委员会拒绝提议，身体不适的人吐出食物；遇到这个词，先看上下文是在谈决定还是身体反应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally give up a job or an official position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式辞去工作或所担任的职务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla impjieg jew kariga b'deċiżjoni tiegħu u għarraf uffiċjalment lil min kien responsabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式提出辞职，放弃所任工作或职位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iddikjara uffiċjalment li kien se jħalli l-impjieg jew il-kariga li kellu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you resign, you formally state that you are leaving your job or giving up an official position.

formal.mt: Id-direttur irriżenja mill-kariga tiegħu għal raġunijiet personali u informa lill-bord bil-miktub.
formal.en: The director resigned from his position for personal reasons and informed the board in writing.
formal.zh: 该董事因个人原因辞去职务，并以书面形式通知了董事会。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex irriżenja Pawlu? Mark: Għax sab xogħol ieħor eqreb lejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did Pawlu resign? Mark: Because he found another job closer to home.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Pawlu 为什么辞职了？Mark：因为他找到了另一份离家更近的工作。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么辞职了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu resign?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax sab xogħol ieħor eqreb lejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax sab xogħol ieħor eqreb lejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 因为他找到了另一份离家更近的工作。
messages.en: Because he found another job closer to home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用递交辞职信的画面记 irriżenja：本人正式提出离开工作或职位，再连同 mill-kariga 一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say no to something offered or requested, or decide not to accept it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人的提议或请求表示拒绝，或决定不予接受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qal le għal xi ħaġa li ġiet offruta jew mitluba, jew iddeċieda li ma jaċċettahiex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拒绝接受所提供的事物，或拒绝答应他人的请求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ma aċċettax xi ħaġa li ġiet offruta lilu jew ma tax il-kunsens tiegħu għal talba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you refuse something, you say that you will not accept it or agree to what someone requests.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 否决或不接受某项提议、申请等，认为其不合适或不符合要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iddeċieda li ma jaċċettax proposta, applikazzjoni jew xi ħaġa oħra għax ma qishiex xierqa jew aċċettabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you reject a proposal or application, you decide not to accept it because you consider it unsuitable or unacceptable.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irrofta t-talba għax ma kinitx tissodisfa l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa.
formal.en: The committee rejected the request because it did not meet the required conditions.
formal.zh: 委员会因该请求不符合必要条件而予以驳回。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Mark irrofta l-offerta tax-xogħol? David: Iva, għax il-ħlas kien baxx wisq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Mark refuse the job offer? David: Yes, because the pay was too low.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mark 拒绝那份工作邀约了吗？David：是的，因为薪酬太低了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 拒绝那份工作邀约了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark refuse the job offer?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax il-ħlas kien baxx wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax il-ħlas kien baxx wisq.
messages.zh: 是的，因为薪酬太低了。
messages.en: Yes, because the pay was too low.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象对工作邀约摇头，再把不合要求的申请退回；两个画面都用 irrofta 练习，记住拒绝与驳回。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage something badly or cause a plan, experience, or situation to fail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 严重损坏某物，或使计划、体验或局面遭到破坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsara kbira lil xi ħaġa jew iġiegħel pjan jew esperjenza jispiċċaw ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毁坏某物，或使原本可能顺利的事情失败、变糟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsara kbira lil xi ħaġa jew iħassar pjan, esperjenza jew sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something ruins something, they damage it badly or prevent it from being successful or enjoyable.

formal.mt: It-temp ħażin irrovina l-attività li kienet ippjanata fil-beraħ.
formal.en: The bad weather ruined the activity that had been planned outdoors.
formal.zh: 恶劣天气毁掉了原定在户外举行的活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar il-piknik? Mark: Ħażin! Ix-xita rrovinat kollox. Maja: Mela t-temp irrovina l-ġurnata tagħkom.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the picnic go? Mark: Badly! The rain ruined everything. Maja: So the weather ruined your day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：野餐怎么样？Mark：糟透了！雨把一切都搞砸了。Maja：看来天气毁了你们这一天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 野餐怎么样？
messages.en: How did the picnic go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 糟透了！雨把一切都搞砸了。
messages.en: Badly! The rain ruined everything.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看来天气毁了你们这一天。
messages.en: So the weather ruined your day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irrovina 和“雨把野餐搞砸了”的画面绑定，记住它既能表示毁坏实物，也能表示破坏计划或体验。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Erysipelas, a bacterial skin infection that causes redness and swelling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 丹毒，一种引起皮肤发红和肿胀的细菌感染。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infezzjoni tal-ġilda kkawżata minn batterji, li ġġib magħha ħmura u nefħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丹毒，一种表现为皮肤红肿的细菌感染。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-irsipla hija infezzjoni tal-ġilda kkawżata minn batterji u kkaratterizzata minn ħmura u nefħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Erysipelas is a bacterial infection of the skin that causes an affected area to become red and swollen.

formal.mt: It-tabib iddokumenta każ ta' irsipla fir-rapport mediku.
formal.en: The doctor documented a case of erysipelas in the medical report.
formal.zh: 医生在医疗报告中记录了一例丹毒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qal it-tabib dwar il-ħmura f'sieqek? Mark: Qal li hija irsipla. Maja: Spjegalek x'inhi? Mark: Iva, qal li hija infezzjoni tal-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the doctor say about the redness in your leg? Mark: He said it is erysipelas. Maja: Did he explain what it is? Mark: Yes, he said it is a skin infection.
colloquial.zh: Maja：医生怎么说你腿上发红的情况？Mark：他说是丹毒。Maja：他解释这是什么了吗？Mark：解释了，他说是一种皮肤感染。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生怎么说你腿上发红的情况？
messages.en: What did the doctor say about the redness in your leg?

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.zh: 他说是丹毒。
messages.en: He said it is erysipelas.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他解释这是什么了吗？
messages.en: Did he explain what it is?

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal li hija infezzjoni tal-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal li hija infezzjoni tal-ġilda.
messages.zh: 解释了，他说是一种皮肤感染。
messages.en: Yes, he said it is a skin infection.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irsipla 放进“医生说明皮肤红肿”的对话卡，配对记住中文“丹毒”和英文 erysipelas；这是病名，适合结合医疗语境记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a determined effort to achieve something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为实现某个目标而付出坚定、持续的努力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel sforz qawwi u jibqa' jipprova biex jilħaq għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 努力争取；为达到目标而奋力尝试。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel sforz kbir biex jikseb xi ħaġa jew jilħaq għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone strives to achieve something, they make a strong and determined effort to succeed.

collocations.zh: 为获得更好的结果而努力

formal.mt: Matul is-sena skolastika, Pawlu irsista biex itejjeb ir-riżultati tiegħu.
formal.en: Throughout the school year, Pawlu strove to improve his results.
formal.zh: 整个学年里，保罗都努力提高自己的成绩。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif għadda Pawlu mill-eżami? Lara: Irsista u studja kuljum, anki meta kien għajjien.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did Pawlu pass the exam? Lara: He worked hard and studied every day, even when he was tired.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗是怎么通过考试的？拉拉：他很努力，每天都学习，即使累了也坚持。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗是怎么通过考试的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu pass the exam?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Irsista u studja kuljum, anki meta kien għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Irsista u studja kuljum, anki meta kien għajjien.
messages.zh: 他很努力，每天都学习，即使累了也坚持。
messages.en: He worked hard and studied every day, even when he was tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irsista 与“为目标持续用力”的画面联系起来：学生累了仍坚持学习，记住它强调努力争取，并不保证已经成功。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To accept responsibility for carrying out a task or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受完成某项任务或行动的责任，承诺负责执行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaċċetta r-responsabbiltà li jagħmel xogħol jew iwettaq azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承担某项工作或责任；承诺执行某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu fuqu r-responsabbiltà li jwettaq biċċa xogħol jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone undertakes a task, they accept responsibility for doing it.

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur irtabat li jlesti x-xogħol sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The contractor undertook to complete the work by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 承包商承诺在月底前完成工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jorganizza l-laqgħa? Mark: David irtabat li jorganizzaha u javża lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is going to organize the meeting? Mark: David undertook to organize it and let everyone know.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁来组织会议？马克：戴维承诺负责组织，并通知所有人。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁来组织会议？
messages.en: Who is going to organize the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: David irtabat li jorganizzaha u javża lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: David irtabat li jorganizzaha u javża lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 戴维承诺负责组织，并通知所有人。
messages.en: David undertook to organize it and let everyone know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irtabat 放进“这项工作我来负责”的场景记忆：接过任务清单并作出承诺，核心是承担执行责任，不表示任务已经完成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop working permanently, or to withdraw from an activity or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结束职业生涯而退休；或从某项活动、竞争或处境中退出，也可指撤回某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieqaf jaħdem b'mod permanenti, jew joħroġ minn attività jew sitwazzjoni jew ineħħi xi ħaġa minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退休；结束职业生涯，不再从事日常职业工作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieqaf jaħdem b'mod permanenti wara perjodu ta' xogħol fil-ħajja tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone retires, they leave their job and end their working career.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退出某项活动或处境；撤回已经提出或投入的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Joħroġ minn attività jew sitwazzjoni, jew ineħħi xi ħaġa li kien ippreżenta jew daħħal fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone withdraws, they stop taking part in something or remove something they previously put forward.

formal.mt: Il-kandidat irtira l-applikazzjoni tiegħu qabel ma bdew l-intervisti.
formal.en: The candidate withdrew his application before the interviews began.
formal.zh: 这名候选人在面试开始前撤回了申请。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Pawlu għadu jaħdem fl-iskola? Toni: Le, irtira s-sena li għaddiet. Issa għandu aktar ħin għall-familja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does Pawlu still work at the school? Toni: No, he retired last year. Now he has more time for his family.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗还在学校工作吗？托尼：不，他去年退休了。现在他有更多时间陪家人。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还在学校工作吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu still work at the school?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irtira s-sena li għaddiet. Issa għandu aktar ħin għall-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irtira s-sena li għaddiet. Issa għandu aktar ħin għall-familja.
messages.zh: 不，他去年退休了。现在他有更多时间陪家人。
messages.en: No, he retired last year. Now he has more time for his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个离开场景记住 irtira：离开职业岗位是“退休”，离开比赛是“退出”；若后面直接接申请等对象，则可表示“撤回”。

gloss_zh: 撤出市场；产品撤回；撤回；退出

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of withdrawing something or leaving an activity, including removing a product from the market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 撤回某物或退出某项活动的行为，也包括将产品撤出市场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li titneħħa xi ħaġa jew li wieħed joħroġ minn attività, inkluża t-tneħħija ta' prodott mis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撤出市场；停止在某个市场提供或销售某物的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li prodott jew offerta jitneħħew minn suq u ma jibqgħux jiġu offruti fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market withdrawal is the act of removing something from sale or availability in a particular market.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品撤回；停止供应或销售某项产品的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li prodott jitneħħa mill-bejgħ jew mill-provvista u ma jibqax jiġi offrut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Product withdrawal occurs when a product is removed from sale or supply.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撤回或退出；移除某物或停止参与某事的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li titneħħa xi ħaġa jew li wieħed jieqaf jieħu sehem f'attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Withdrawal is the act of removing something or ending participation in an activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从市场撤出；将某物移出市场，使其不再在该市场销售或供应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tneħħija ta' xi ħaġa mis-suq sabiex ma tibqax tinbiegħ jew tiġi offruta fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Withdrawal from the market means removing something so that it is no longer sold or offered there.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħabbret l-irtirar tal-prodott mis-suq u informat lill-ħwienet bid-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The company announced the withdrawal of the product from the market and informed shops of the decision.
formal.zh: 公司宣布将该产品撤出市场，并将这一决定通知了各家商店。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex dan il-prodott m'għadux għall-bejgħ? Mark: Il-kumpanija ħabbret l-irtirar tiegħu mis-suq.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is this product no longer for sale? Mark: The company announced its withdrawal from the market.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：为什么这款产品不再卖了？马克：公司宣布将它撤出市场。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 为什么这款产品不再卖了？
messages.en: Why is this product no longer for sale?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 公司宣布将它撤出市场。
messages.en: The company announced its withdrawal from the market.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irtirar 记作“撤回这件事”的名称：产品从货架退出对应撤出市场，申请被收回对应撤回申请；结合后面的对象判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The removal of a product from sale or its withdrawal from a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某种产品停止销售并从市场撤出的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija ta' prodott mill-bejgħ jew il-waqfien tat-tqegħid tiegħu fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品或企业退出某一市场的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-waqfien tal-preżenza ta' prodott jew kumpanija f'suq partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market withdrawal occurs when a product or company stops participating in a particular market.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某种产品从销售渠道中撤下并停止供应的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tneħħija ta' prodott mill-kanali tal-bejgħ u l-waqfien tal-provvista tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Product withdrawal involves removing a particular product from sale and ending its supply.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撤出或撤回；在本词组中，指从市场撤下产品或停止市场供应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li xi ħaġa titneħħa jew tinġibed lura; f'din l-espressjoni, prodott jitneħħa mis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Withdrawal is the act of taking something back or removing it from an activity or place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从市场撤出，结束某种产品在该市场的销售。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' prodott mis-suq billi jintemm il-bejgħ tiegħu f'dak is-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Withdrawal from the market means ending a product's availability for sale in that market.

collocations.en: withdrawal of a product from the market
withdrawal from the market with immediate effect

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħabbret l-irtirar mis-suq tal-prodott u waqqfet il-bejgħ tiegħu minnufih.
formal.en: The company announced the product's withdrawal from the market and stopped selling it immediately.
formal.zh: 该公司宣布产品撤市，并立即停止销售。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex m'għadkomx tbigħu dan il-prodott? Mark: Il-kumpanija ħabbret l-irtirar tiegħu mis-suq, allura m'għadniex inbigħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you sell this product anymore? Mark: The company announced its withdrawal from the market, so we no longer sell it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们为什么不再卖这个产品了？Mark：公司宣布它撤市了，所以我们已经不卖了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们为什么不再卖这个产品了？
messages.en: Why don't you sell this product anymore?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija ħabbret l-irtirar tiegħu mis-suq, allura m'għadniex inbigħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija ħabbret l-irtirar tiegħu mis-suq, allura m'għadniex inbigħuh.
messages.zh: 公司宣布它撤市了，所以我们已经不卖了。
messages.en: The company announced its withdrawal from the market, so we no longer sell it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组联想成商品从货架撤走：irtirar 表示撤出，mis-suq 表示从市场，合起来记作“撤市”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shake involuntarily because of cold, fear, or a strong emotional reaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因寒冷、恐惧或强烈的情绪反应而不由自主地发抖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitheżżeż bla ma jrid minħabba l-bard, il-biża' jew reazzjoni emozzjonali qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因恐惧、厌恶、寒冷等突然全身一颤或打一个寒战。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitheżżeż f'daqqa bla ma jrid minħabba l-biża', id-disgust jew il-bard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you shudder, your body shakes suddenly because you are frightened, disgusted, or cold.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体或身体某一部分因寒冷、恐惧等而不由自主地颤抖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li l-ġisem jew parti minnu jitheżżeż bla kontroll minħabba l-bard, il-biża' jew emozzjoni qawwija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tremble, your body or part of it shakes involuntarily, often because of cold or fear.

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-ħoss qawwi, it-tifel irtogħod bil-biża' u qabad id ommu.
formal.en: When he heard the loud noise, the boy trembled with fear and took his mother's hand.
formal.zh: 听到那声巨响时，男孩吓得发抖，抓住了母亲的手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Leo irtogħod hekk? Mark: Kien għadu kif ħareġ mill-baħar u kellu ħafna bard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Leo shiver like that? Mark: He had just come out of the sea and was very cold.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Leo 刚才为什么抖得那么厉害？Mark：他刚从海里出来，冷得很。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Leo 刚才为什么抖得那么厉害？
messages.en: Why did Leo shiver like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien għadu kif ħareġ mill-baħar u kellu ħafna bard.
messages.mt_standard: Kien għadu kif ħareġ mill-baħar u kellu ħafna bard.
messages.zh: 他刚从海里出来，冷得很。
messages.en: He had just come out of the sea and was very cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚从冷海水里出来的人肩膀直抖，把 irtogħod 和“冷得发抖、吓得发颤”的身体动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cosmetics applied to the face, or the appearance created by applying them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂抹在脸上的化妆品，或使用这些化妆品形成的妆容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kożmetiċi applikati fuq il-wiċċ, jew id-dehra li tinħoloq bl-użu tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于修饰面部的化妆品及其形成的妆容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodotti kożmetiċi li jitpoġġew fuq il-wiċċ biex ibiddlu jew isebbħu d-dehra tiegħu, u d-dehra li jagħtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Make-up consists of cosmetics applied to the face to enhance or change someone's appearance.

formal.mt: Għas-sessjoni tar-ritratti, l-irtokk kien ħafif biex id-dehra tal-mudella tibqa' naturali.
formal.en: For the photo session, the make-up was light so that the model's appearance would remain natural.
formal.zh: 这次摄影采用了淡妆，以保持模特外观的自然感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jidher l-irtokk tiegħi? Sara: Jidher sabiħ ħafna; huwa ħafif u naturali.
colloquial.en: Maja: How does my make-up look? Sara: It looks lovely; it's light and natural.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的妆看起来怎么样？Sara：很好看，清淡又自然。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的妆看起来怎么样？
messages.en: How does my make-up look?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher sabiħ ħafna; huwa ħafif u naturali.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher sabiħ ħafna; huwa ħafif u naturali.
messages.zh: 很好看，清淡又自然。
messages.en: It looks lovely; it's light and natural.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irtokk 贴在脑海里的化妆镜上，看到镜中的整体妆容就想起这个词；用 irtokk ħafif 连记“淡妆”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The made-up appearance resulting from the application of cosmetics to the face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸上涂抹化妆品后呈现出的上妆状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dehra tal-wiċċ wara li jkunu ġew applikati fuqu prodotti kożmetiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在脸上涂抹化妆品，完成上妆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-applikazzjoni ta' prodotti kożmetiċi fuq il-wiċċ biex tinbidel jew tissebbaħ id-dehra tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone has put on make-up, they have applied cosmetics to their face.

formal.mt: L-attur deher fuq il-palk b'wiċċ irtukkjat skont il-ħtiġijiet tal-karattru tiegħu.
formal.en: The actor appeared on stage with his face made up according to the requirements of his character.
formal.zh: 演员登台时，脸上已经按照角色需要化好了妆。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark diġà irtukkjat għall-ispettaklu? Maja: Iva, lest; jonqsu biss jilbes il-kostum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Mark already got his make-up on for the show? Maja: Yes, he's ready; he only needs to put on his costume.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 已经化好演出的妆了吗？Maja：是的，妆已经好了，只差换上戏服。

messages.speaker: Sara (演员)
messages.zh: Mark 已经化好演出的妆了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark already got his make-up on for the show?

messages.speaker: Maja (化妆师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lest; jonqsu biss jilbes il-kostum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lest; jonqsu biss jilbes il-kostum.
messages.zh: 是的，妆已经好了，只差换上戏服。
messages.en: Yes, he's ready; he only needs to put on his costume.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演员化好妆等待登台，用 wiċċ irtukkjat“化了妆的脸”记住已经上妆的状态，并与 irtokk“妆容”对照复习。

gloss_zh: 被救活；复生，重新活过来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be brought back to life or to become alive again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被抢救后恢复生命，或原本已经死亡而重新活过来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jieħu l-ħajja wara li jkun miet, jew jerġa' juri sinjali ta' ħajja wara tentattiv ta' salvataġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抢救过来；经急救恢复生命迹象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jerġa' juri sinjali ta' ħajja wara li persuni oħra jagħtuh l-għajnuna biex isalvawh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is resuscitated, they are made to breathe or show signs of life again through emergency treatment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复生；原本已经死亡而重新活过来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jerġa' jkun ħaj wara li jkun miet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a person or creature comes back to life, they become alive again after being dead.

collocations.en: was resuscitated after receiving first aid
