formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-prinċep irxoxta u reġa' lura għand il-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the prince came back to life and returned to his family.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，王子复生，并回到了家人身边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-prinċep miet fl-aħħar tal-istorja? Nina: Le, irxoxta! Wara reġa' mar id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the prince die at the end of the story? Nina: No, he came back to life! Afterwards he went home again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：王子在故事结尾死了吗？Nina：没有，他又活过来了！后来还回家了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 王子在故事结尾死了吗？
messages.en: Did the prince die at the end of the story?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irxoxta! Wara reġa' mar id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irxoxta! Wara reġa' mar id-dar.
messages.zh: 没有，他又活过来了！后来还回家了。
messages.en: No, he came back to life! Afterwards he went home again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irxoxta 放进“故事人物又活过来”的画面中记忆；遇到急救语境译为“被救活”，遇到死亡后复生的叙述译为“复生”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Areas of land and their buildings used for growing crops or raising animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于种植农作物或饲养动物的多处农场，包括相关土地和建筑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Postijiet li jinkludu art u bini fejn jitkabbru l-uċuħ tar-raba' jew jitrabbew l-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 农场；用于种植作物或饲养动物的农业经营场所，表示复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Postijiet agrikoli bl-art u l-bini tagħhom, użati għat-tkabbir tal-uċuħ tar-raba' jew għat-trobbija tal-annimali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Farms are places where people use land and buildings to grow crops or raise animals.

formal.mt: L-istudenti żaru tliet irziezet biex jitgħallmu kif jitkabbar il-ħaxix u kif jitrabbew l-annimali.
formal.en: The students visited three farms to learn how vegetables are grown and how animals are raised.
formal.zh: 学生们参观了三处农场，学习蔬菜种植和动物饲养的方法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm irziezet qrib ir-raħal? Mark: Iva, hemm tnejn. F'waħda jkabbru l-ħaxix u fl-oħra jrabbu l-baqar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are there any farms near the village? Mark: Yes, there are two. They grow vegetables on one and raise cattle on the other.
colloquial.zh: Lara：村子附近有农场吗？Mark：有，有两处。一处种蔬菜，另一处养牛。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 村子附近有农场吗？
messages.en: Are there any farms near the village?

messages.speaker: Mark (村民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm tnejn. F'waħda jkabbru l-ħaxix u fl-oħra jrabbu l-baqar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm tnejn. F'waħda jkabbru l-ħaxix u fl-oħra jrabbu l-baqar.
messages.zh: 有，有两处。一处种蔬菜，另一处养牛。
messages.en: Yes, there are two. They grow vegetables on one and raise cattle on the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 irziezet 就想象地图上标出的好几处农场：一处种菜，一处养牛。用多个农场的画面提醒自己，这里表达复数。

gloss_zh: 萨利尼，马耳他的村庄名

teaching_sense.en_definition: Salini, a village in Malta bordering Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq, St Paul's Bay and Naxxar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 萨利尼，马耳他的一个村庄，与 Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq、圣保罗湾和 Naxxar 接壤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raħal f'Malta li jmiss ma' Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq, San Pawl il-Baħar u n-Naxxar.

sense_translations.en_definition: Salini, a village in Malta bordering Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq, St Paul's Bay and Naxxar
sense_translations.zh_definition: 萨利尼，马耳他的村庄，毗邻 Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq、圣保罗湾和 Naxxar。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-Salina hija raħal f'Malta li jmiss ma' Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq, San Pawl il-Baħar u n-Naxxar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Is-Salina is the Maltese name for Salini, a village bordering Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq, St Paul's Bay and Naxxar.

formal.mt: Is-Salina hija raħal f'Malta li jmiss ma' Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq, San Pawl il-Baħar u n-Naxxar.
formal.en: Salini is a village in Malta bordering Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq, St Paul's Bay and Naxxar.
formal.zh: 萨利尼是马耳他的一个村庄，与 Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq、圣保罗湾和 Naxxar 接壤。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada? Ġanni: Fis-Salina, fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu. Marija: Tajjeb, ibgħatli l-post eżatt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where shall we meet tomorrow? Ġanni: In Salini, at ten in the morning. Marija: All right, send me the exact location.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们明天在哪里见？詹尼：在萨利尼，上午十点。玛丽亚：好，把具体位置发给我。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里见？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 在萨利尼，上午十点。
messages.en: In Salini, at ten in the morning.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，把具体位置发给我。
messages.en: All right, send me the exact location.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Is-Salina 当作地图上的专名标签来记：中文对应萨利尼；再用 fis-Salina 练习表达“在萨利尼”。

gloss_zh: 塞尔维亚；塞尔维亚共和国

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Europe, officially called the Republic of Serbia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 塞尔维亚，欧洲的一个国家，正式名称为塞尔维亚共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Ewropa li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika tas-Serbja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞尔维亚，欧洲国家的通用名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-Serbja hija pajjiż fl-Ewropa, u dan huwa l-isem qasir tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Serbia is the usual short name of a country in Europe.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞尔维亚共和国，塞尔维亚这一国家的正式名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-Repubblika tas-Serbja hija l-isem uffiċjali tal-pajjiż magħruf bħala s-Serbja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Republic of Serbia is the official name of the country commonly called Serbia.

collocations.zh: 到塞尔维亚访问或游览

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juża l-isem uffiċjali 'ir-Repubblika tas-Serbja' meta jirreferi għas-Serbja.
formal.en: The report uses the official name 'the Republic of Serbia' when referring to Serbia.
formal.zh: 报告在提及塞尔维亚时，使用正式名称“塞尔维亚共和国”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qatt żort is-Serbja? Mark: Iva, żort is-Serbja s-sena l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you ever visited Serbia? Mark: Yes, I visited Serbia last year.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你去过塞尔维亚吗？Mark：去过，我去年去的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你去过塞尔维亚吗？
messages.en: Have you ever visited Serbia?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 去过，我去年去的。
messages.en: Yes, I visited Serbia last year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Serbja 与英语 Serbia 对照记忆，再把 is-Serbja 整体放进“去塞尔维亚游览”的场景中练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The day of the week after Friday and before Sunday.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 星期六，即星期五之后、星期日之前的那一天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum tal-ġimgħa li jiġi wara l-Ġimgħa u qabel il-Ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 星期六，位于星期五与星期日之间的一天。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-Sibt huwa l-jum tal-ġimgħa bejn il-Ġimgħa u l-Ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir is-Sibt fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will take place on Saturday at ten in the morning.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期六上午十点举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int liberu s-Sibt? Mark: Iva, nistgħu niltaqgħu s-Sibt waranofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you free on Saturday? Mark: Yes, we can meet on Saturday afternoon.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你星期六有空吗？Mark：有，我们可以星期六下午见面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你星期六有空吗？
messages.en: Are you free on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我们可以星期六下午见面。
messages.en: Yes, we can meet on Saturday afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在周历上把星期六圈出来写上 is-Sibt，再配合“周六上午”和“每周六”两个时间短语反复记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of the country known in English as Syria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国家名称，指叙利亚，英语通常写作 Syria。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tal-pajjiż magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Syria.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叙利亚，国家名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-Sirja hija l-pajjiż li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ Syria.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Siria refers to the country known in English as Syria.

formal.mt: Għall-proġett tal-ġeografija, l-istudenti għandhom jiġbru informazzjoni dwar is-Sirja u jindikaw il-pajjiż fuq mappa.
formal.en: For the geography project, students should gather information about Syria and locate the country on a map.
formal.zh: 在地理课项目中，学生应收集有关叙利亚的信息，并在地图上标出这个国家。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar liema pajjiż qed tagħmel il-proġett? Pawlu: Dwar is-Sirja. Tista' tgħinni nsibha fuq il-mappa?
colloquial.en: Lara: Which country are you doing your project on? Pawlu: Syria. Can you help me find it on the map?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的项目研究哪个国家？保罗：叙利亚。你能帮我在地图上找到它吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar liema pajjiż qed tagħmel il-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar liema pajjiż qed tagħmel il-proġett?
messages.zh: 你的项目研究哪个国家？
messages.en: Which country are you doing your project on?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar is-Sirja. Tista' tgħinni nsibha fuq il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar is-Sirja. Tista' tgħinni nsibha fuq il-mappa?
messages.zh: 叙利亚。你能帮我在地图上找到它吗？
messages.en: Syria. Can you help me find it on the map?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把地图上的“叙利亚”与 Is-Sirja 配成一张词卡，再用“关于叙利亚”练习 dwar is-Sirja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The person or thing occupying position six in an ordered sequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在有序排列中处于第六位的人或事物，位于第五之后、第七之前。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuna jew il-ħaġa li tiġi wara l-ħames u qabel is-seba' f'sensiela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第六；按顺序处于第六位的人或事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika l-persuna jew il-ħaġa li tokkupa l-pożizzjoni wara l-ħames u qabel is-seba'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The sixth person or thing comes after the fifth and before the seventh.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'is-sitta' tindika l-pożizzjoni wara l-ħames u qabel is-seba'.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'is-sitta' indicates the position after the fifth and before the seventh.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，is-sitta 表示第五之后、第七之前的位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema wieħed imiss fil-lista? Toni: Is-sitta; il-ħames diġà lestejnieh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which one is next on the list? Toni: The sixth; we've already finished the fifth.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：名单上接下来轮到哪一个？托尼：第六个；第五个我们已经完成了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 名单上接下来轮到哪一个？
messages.en: Which one is next on the list?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 第六个；第五个我们已经完成了。
messages.en: The sixth; we've already finished the fifth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条的“第六”义，想象六张卡片排成一行，指出第五张之后的那张来记住顺序位置。

gloss_zh: 锡杰维（马耳他南部城镇）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Is-Siġġiewi is a town in the southern region of Malta, also known as Città Ferdinand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 锡杰维是马耳他南部的一座城镇，也称 Città Ferdinand。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-Siġġiewi huwa belt fir-reġjun tan-Nofsinhar ta' Malta, magħrufa wkoll bħala Città Ferdinand.

sense_translations.en_definition: Siggiewi, known as Città Ferdinand, a town in the southern region of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 锡杰维，又称 Città Ferdinand，是马耳他南部地区的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-Siġġiewi huwa belt fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta li hija magħrufa wkoll bl-isem Città Ferdinand.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Is-Siġġiewi is the name of a town in southern Malta that is also known as Città Ferdinand.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir fis-Siġġiewi nhar il-Ġimgħa filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Siġġiewi on Friday morning.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期五上午在锡杰维举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn toqgħod? Pawlu: Noqgħod fis-Siġġiewi. Trid tiġi żżurni nhar is-Sibt?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you live? Pawlu: I live in Siġġiewi. Would you like to visit me on Saturday?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你住在哪里？保罗：我住在锡杰维。星期六想来找我玩吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Noqgħod fis-Siġġiewi. Trid tiġi żżurni nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Noqgħod fis-Siġġiewi. Trid tiġi żżurni nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 我住在锡杰维。星期六想来找我玩吗？
messages.en: I live in Siġġiewi. Would you like to visit me on Saturday?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把锡杰维想成地图上的一个地点，再连读 ngħix fis-Siġġiewi，整块记住“我住在锡杰维”的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go after someone or act according to instructions or guidance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 跟在某人后面行动，或按照指示、指导采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxu wara xi ħadd jew jagħmlu dak li jgħidu l-istruzzjonijiet jew il-gwida mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跟随某人前行；遵循指示或指导行事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imorru wara persuna jew jimxu skont l-istruzzjonijiet jew il-pariri li jingħatawlhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people follow someone or something, they go after that person or act according to the guidance provided.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom isegwu l-istruzzjonijiet tal-għalliem matul l-attività kollha.
formal.en: Participants should follow the teacher's instructions throughout the activity.
formal.zh: 参与者在整个活动过程中都应遵循老师的指示。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tfal jafu fejn għandhom imorru? Paul: Iva, isegwu lil Marija. Hi taf it-triq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do the children know where to go? Paul: Yes, they follow Marija. She knows the way.
colloquial.zh: Sara：孩子们知道该往哪里走吗？Paul：知道，他们跟着 Marija。她认得路。

messages.speaker: Sara (家长)
messages.zh: 孩子们知道该往哪里走吗？
messages.en: Do the children know where to go?

messages.speaker: Paul (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, isegwu lil Marija. Hi taf it-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, isegwu lil Marija. Hi taf it-triq.
messages.zh: 知道，他们跟着 Marija。她认得路。
messages.en: Yes, they follow Marija. She knows the way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 isegwu 与“一群人跟着导游走”联系起来，再把路线换成操作指示：跟着人走是“跟随”，跟着指示做是“遵循”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of staying alert and keeping watch to protect a person or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为保护人或地点而保持警觉、持续看守的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha persuni jibqgħu attenti u jżommu għassa biex jipproteġu lil xi ħadd jew xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 守卫；保持警觉并看守，以防有人闯入或发生危险。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żamma tal-għassa b'attenzjoni biex jiġi mħares post jew biex jiġu protetti persuni minn periklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Keeping guard involves watching a person or place carefully so that danger or unauthorized entry can be detected.

formal.mt: Il-kmandant qal lill-gwardji: 'Ishru mal-bieb matul il-lejl u rrappurtaw kull moviment suspettuż.'
formal.en: The commander told the guards: 'Keep guard at the door during the night and report any suspicious movement.'
formal.zh: 指挥官对守卫说：“你们夜间在门口守卫，并报告任何可疑动静。”

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ishru hawn sakemm nerġa' niġi, jekk jogħġobkom. Lara: Tajjeb, noqogħdu attenti. Int iddum?
colloquial.en: Mark: Keep guard here until I get back, please. Lara: All right, we'll keep watch. Will you be long?
colloquial.zh: Mark：请你们在这里守着，等我回来。Lara：好的，我们会留意。你要去很久吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (值班负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ishru hawn sakemm nerġa' niġi, jekk jogħġobkom.
messages.mt_standard: Ishru hawn sakemm nerġa' niġi, jekk jogħġobkom.
messages.zh: 请你们在这里守着，等我回来。
messages.en: Keep guard here until I get back, please.

messages.speaker: Lara (值班同事)
messages.zh: 好的，我们会留意。你要去很久吗？
messages.en: All right, we'll keep watch. Will you be long?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ishru 放进门口交接值班的场景：负责人叮嘱大家“守着这里，保持警觉”。用守门和观察动静的画面记住“守卫、警戒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Makes a blade sharper or gives an object a sharper point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把刀刃磨得更锋利，或把物体的一端削得更尖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xafra aktar taqta' jew jagħmel il-ponta ta' oġġett aktar fina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把刀刃磨快；把物体的尖端削尖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel it-tarf ta' għodda aktar jaqta' jew il-ponta ta' oġġett aktar fina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who sharpens a tool makes its edge or point sharper.

formal.mt: Il-kok isinn is-sikkina qabel jibda jaqta' l-ħaxix.
formal.en: The cook sharpens the knife before starting to cut the vegetables.
formal.zh: 厨师开始切蔬菜之前，先把刀磨快。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed jagħmel Pawlu fil-kċina? Rita: Qed isinn is-sikkina biex jaqta' l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is Pawlu doing in the kitchen? Rita: He's sharpening the knife to cut the bread.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗在厨房做什么？丽塔：他在磨刀，准备切面包。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在厨房做什么？
messages.en: What is Pawlu doing in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed isinn is-sikkina biex jaqta' l-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Qed isinn is-sikkina biex jaqta' l-ħobż.
messages.zh: 他在磨刀，准备切面包。
messages.en: He's sharpening the knife to cut the bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一把钝刀经过打磨变得锋利，把 isinn 和“把刀磨快”的动作一起记；也可用削尖铅笔的画面巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Refers to events or activities taking place or coming about.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示事件发生或活动举行；学习时结合句子判断时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jindika li avvenimenti jew attivitajiet iseħħu jew jiġu organizzati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （事件）发生了；（活动）举行了。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li ġrajjiet seħħew jew li attivitajiet saru f'xi żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If events happened, they took place at a particular time.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħat tal-kumitat isiru kull nhar ta' Tnejn fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The committee meetings take place every Monday in the main hall.
formal.zh: 委员会会议每周一在主厅举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-lezzjonijiet isiru hawn? Mark: Iva, isiru f'din il-kamra kull nhar ta' Sibt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do the lessons take place here? Mark: Yes, they take place in this room every Saturday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：课程在这里上吗？马克：是的，每周六在这个房间上。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 课程在这里上吗？
messages.en: Do the lessons take place here?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, isiru f'din il-kamra kull nhar ta' Sibt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, isiru f'din il-kamra kull nhar ta' Sibt.
messages.zh: 是的，每周六在这个房间上。
messages.en: Yes, they take place in this room every Saturday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 isiru 放进日历画面记忆：多场会议或多节课程在某时某地举行；不要只凭英文 happened 判断马耳他语句子的时态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone ideas, creative energy, or encouragement to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人产生想法、获得创作灵感，或受到鼓舞而采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem ideat jew ħeġġa f'xi ħadd u jinkoraġġih joħloq jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 启发某人的思想或创作；鼓舞某人去做某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd ideat ġodda jew ħeġġa biex joħloq xi ħaġa jew jaġixxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something inspires you, they give you ideas or encouragement.

formal.mt: Il-proġett ispira lill-istudenti biex ifittxu soluzzjonijiet ġodda għall-problemi ambjentali.
formal.en: The project inspired the students to seek new solutions to environmental problems.
formal.zh: 这个项目启发学生寻找解决环境问题的新方法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex bdejt tikteb poeżiji? Adam: Dak il-ktieb ispira l-ewwel poeżija tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you start writing poems? Adam: That book inspired my first poem.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么开始写诗？亚当：那本书给了我写第一首诗的灵感。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么开始写诗？
messages.en: Why did you start writing poems?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-ktieb ispira l-ewwel poeżija tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-ktieb ispira l-ewwel poeżija tiegħi.
messages.zh: 那本书给了我写第一首诗的灵感。
messages.en: That book inspired my first poem.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读完一本书，脑中亮起灯泡，随即开始写诗；用这个“受到启发并行动”的画面记住动词 ispira。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An idea, feeling, or influence that encourages creative work or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促使人创作或行动的灵感、启发或鼓舞，也可指带来这种影响的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idea, sentiment jew influwenza li tħeġġeġ il-kreattività jew l-azzjoni, jew persuna jew ħaġa li tqajjem din il-ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激发创作或行动的灵感、启发或鼓舞；也指灵感或鼓舞的来源。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hija idea jew ħeġġa li tgħin lil persuna toħloq jew taġixxi, jew is-sors li jagħtiha din l-idea jew il-ħeġġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Inspiration is a feeling or influence that gives you ideas and encourages you to create or act.

formal.mt: Il-pajsaġġ tal-gżira kien sors ta' ispirazzjoni għall-artista waqt il-ħolqien ta' din il-pittura.
formal.en: The island's landscape was a source of inspiration for the artist while creating this painting.
formal.zh: 艺术家创作这幅画时，岛上的风景是其灵感来源。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn ġiet l-ispirazzjoni għal din il-pittura? Ben: Minn mixja ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did the inspiration for this painting come from? Ben: From a walk by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这幅画的灵感是从哪里来的？本：来自一次海边散步。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġiet l-ispirazzjoni għal din il-pittura?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġiet l-ispirazzjoni għal din il-pittura?
messages.zh: 这幅画的灵感是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did the inspiration for this painting come from?

messages.speaker: Ben (画家)
messages.zh: 来自一次海边散步。
messages.en: From a walk by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ispirazzjoni 想成画家随身携带的“灵感本”：海边散步带来一个创作念头。它是名词，可搭配“来源”或“寻找”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prepare food for eating by heating it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加热把食材制成可食用的饭菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tipprepara l-ikel biex jittiekel billi ssaħħnu, tgħallih, taqlih jew taħmih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烹调食物；通过加热做饭或制作菜肴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tipprepara l-ikel permezz tas-sħana sabiex ikun lest biex jittiekel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who cooks prepares food for eating by heating it.

formal.mt: Meta issajjar is-soppa, ħalliha fuq nar baxx u ħawwadha minn żmien għal żmien.
formal.en: When you cook the soup, keep it over a low heat and stir it from time to time.
formal.zh: 煮汤时，请保持小火，并不时搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'se ssajjar illejla? Pawlu: Se nsajjar l-għaġin bil-ħaxix. Marta: Tajjeb, jien inħejji l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Marta: What are you going to cook tonight? Pawlu: I'm going to cook pasta with vegetables. Marta: Great, I'll set the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：今晚你要做什么？保罗：我要做蔬菜意面。玛尔塔：好，那我来摆餐桌。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 今晚你要做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to cook tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 我要做蔬菜意面。
messages.en: I'm going to cook pasta with vegetables.

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 好，那我来摆餐桌。
messages.en: Great, I'll set the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 issajjar 和锅中加热食材的画面绑定：看到锅、炉火和晚饭，就练习说“做饭、烹饪”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join metal parts by soldering or welding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用钎焊或熔焊的方法连接金属部件；具体工艺由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad biċċiet tal-metall bis-sħana, jew billi ddewweb metall ieħor fil-ġonta, jew billi ddewweb it-truf tal-biċċiet infushom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钎焊；熔化熔点较低的填充金属，使其连接金属部件，而不熔化部件本身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad biċċiet tal-metall billi ddewweb metall ieħor b'punt tat-tidwib aktar baxx fil-ġonta, mingħajr ma ddewweb il-biċċiet infushom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you solder metal parts, you join them using a melted filler metal without melting the parts themselves.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熔焊；通过加热熔化金属部件的接合处，使其连接成一体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad biċċiet tal-metall billi ssaħħan u ddewweb it-truf tagħhom sabiex jingħaqdu f'biċċa waħda meta jibred il-metall.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you weld metal parts, you join them by heating and melting their adjoining edges.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tibda ssalda l-pjanċi tal-azzar, naddaf it-truf tagħhom u żommhom fil-pożizzjoni korretta.
formal.en: Before you begin welding the steel plates, clean their edges and hold them in the correct position.
formal.zh: 开始焊接钢板之前，请清洁其边缘，并将其固定在正确位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' ssalda dawn iż-żewġ wajers flimkien? Toni: Iva, imma l-ewwel trid tintefa l-provvista tal-elettriku. Lara: Tajjeb, nitfiha issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you solder these two wires together? Toni: Yes, but the power supply must be switched off first. Lara: All right, I'll switch it off now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能把这两根电线焊在一起吗？托尼：可以，不过得先切断电源。拉拉：好，我现在就关掉。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' ssalda dawn iż-żewġ wajers flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' ssalda dawn iż-żewġ wajers flimkien?
messages.zh: 你能把这两根电线焊在一起吗？
messages.en: Can you solder these two wires together?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修技师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel trid tintefa l-provvista tal-elettriku.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel trid tintefa l-provvista tal-elettriku.
messages.zh: 可以，不过得先切断电源。
messages.en: Yes, but the power supply must be switched off first.

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我现在就关掉。
messages.en: All right, I'll switch it off now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 issalda 放进金属连接的画面：电线接点联想 solder，钢板接缝联想 weld，用材料和工艺区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To endure something unpleasant or tolerate someone's behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承受不愉快的处境、痛苦或烦扰，或容忍某人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibqa' tiflaħ għal xi ħaġa diffiċli jew spjaċevoli, jew taċċetta l-imġiba ta' xi ħadd minkejja li ddejqek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承受；忍受痛苦、困境或其他令人不适的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiflaħ għall-uġigħ, għad-diffikultajiet jew għal xi ħaġa oħra li ġġiblek tbatija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you bear something unpleasant, you endure the difficulty or suffering that it causes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忍受；受得了令人烦恼、厌烦或不适的人或事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiflaħ għal persuna jew sitwazzjoni li ddejqek jew tirritak.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you can stand someone or something, you can endure the annoyance or discomfort involved.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容忍某人；忍受某人的在场或令人不快的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiflaħ għall-preżenza jew għall-imġiba ta' xi ħadd li jdejqek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you suffer someone, you tolerate their presence or behaviour even though you find them unpleasant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容忍；对不喜欢或不赞同的行为或情况予以忍耐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taċċetta jew tħalli għaddejja mġiba jew sitwazzjoni li ma togħġbokx jew li ma taqbilx magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tolerate something, you accept or allow it despite disliking or disagreeing with it.

formal.mt: Matul ix-xogħlijiet, ir-residenti kellhom jissaportu l-istorbju għal diversi sigħat kuljum.
formal.en: During the works, residents had to endure the noise for several hours each day.
formal.zh: 施工期间，居民每天都得忍受数小时的噪声。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma nistax nissaporti dan l-istorbju aktar. Luqa: Trid immorru f'post aktar kwiet? Sara: Iva, ejja noħorġu ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: I can't stand this noise any longer. Luqa: Shall we go somewhere quieter? Sara: Yes, let's go out for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这噪声我再也受不了了。卢卡：我们去个安静一点的地方好吗？萨拉：好，我们出去一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax nissaporti dan l-istorbju aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax nissaporti dan l-istorbju aktar.
messages.zh: 这噪声我再也受不了了。
messages.en: I can't stand this noise any longer.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去个安静一点的地方好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go somewhere quieter?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们出去一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go out for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“忍”把 issaporta 的义项串起来：疼痛要忍受，噪声要忍耐，讨厌的人及其行为要容忍；按宾语选择中文表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a determined effort against difficulty or to grapple physically with an opponent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对困难时奋力应对；也指与对手相互抓抱、角力或摔跤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel sforz qawwi biex tegħleb diffikultà, jew titqabad fiżikament ma' avversarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面对困难、阻力或不利处境时奋力挣扎或抗争。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel sforz kbir biex tegħleb diffikultajiet jew tirreżisti xi ħaġa li qed tfixklek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you struggle, you make a great effort to overcome something difficult or resist something that holds you back.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与对手相互抓抱、推拉和角力，尤其指进行摔跤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titqabad ma' persuna oħra billi taqbadha u tipprova twaqqagħha jew iżżommha taħt kontroll.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you wrestle with someone, you grapple with them and try to throw them down or control their movements.

formal.mt: Minkejja n-nuqqas ta' riżorsi, it-tim issara kontra d-diffikultajiet u temm il-proġett fil-ħin.
formal.en: Despite a lack of resources, the team struggled against the difficulties and completed the project on time.
formal.zh: 尽管资源不足，团队仍奋力克服困难，按时完成了项目。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu ma' min issara llum? Toni: Ma' atleta ġdid fil-klabb. Kienet taqbida diffiċli, imma rebaħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who did Pawlu wrestle with today? Toni: A new athlete at the club. It was a difficult bout, but he won.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu今天和谁摔跤了？Toni：和俱乐部的一名新运动员。那场较量很艰难，不过他赢了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu今天和谁摔跤了？
messages.en: Who did Pawlu wrestle with today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' atleta ġdid fil-klabb. Kienet taqbida diffiċli, imma rebaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ma' atleta ġdid fil-klabb. Kienet taqbida diffiċli, imma rebaħ.
messages.zh: 和俱乐部的一名新运动员。那场较量很艰难，不过他赢了。
messages.en: A new athlete at the club. It was a difficult bout, but he won.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成“用力较量”：和困难较量是抗争，和对手抓抱较量是摔跤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exchange a cheque or redeemable voucher for cash.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将支票或可以兑换的凭券兑现，换取现金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikseb flus kontanti billi tbiddel ċekk jew vawċer li jista' jissarraf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将支票、凭券等可以兑现的票据兑换成现金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tibdel ċekk, vawċer jew dokument simili fi flus kontanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you cash in a cheque or redeemable voucher, you exchange it for the money it represents.

collocations.en: a cheque that can be cashed

formal.mt: Skont il-kundizzjonijiet tal-offerta, dan il-vawċer jista' jissarraf fi flus kontanti sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: Under the terms of the offer, this voucher can be redeemed for cash until the end of the month.
formal.zh: 根据优惠活动的条款，这张凭券可在本月底之前兑换成现金。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-vawċer jista' jissarraf fi flus kontanti? Rita: Iva, mur bil-vawċer għand il-kaxxier u jagħtik il-flus.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can this voucher be redeemed for cash? Rita: Yes, take the voucher to the cashier, and he will give you the money.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这张凭券可以兑换成现金吗？Rita：可以，把凭券拿给收银员，他就会把钱给你。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-vawċer jista' jissarraf fi flus kontanti?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-vawċer jista' jissarraf fi flus kontanti?
messages.zh: 这张凭券可以兑换成现金吗？
messages.en: Can this voucher be redeemed for cash?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mur bil-vawċer għand il-kaxxier u jagħtik il-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mur bil-vawċer għand il-kaxxier u jagħtik il-flus.
messages.zh: 可以，把凭券拿给收银员，他就会把钱给你。
messages.en: Yes, take the voucher to the cashier, and he will give you the money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“票据进去，现金出来”的柜台画面：核心动作是把可兑现的凭证换成钱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use charm or deliberate attention to attract someone romantically or sexually.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用魅力或有意的示好吸引某人，使对方产生爱情或性方面的兴趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tuża s-seħer personali jew attenzjoni apposta biex tqajjem interess romantiku jew sesswali f'persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过魅力、示好等方式诱惑或勾引某人，使其产生爱情或性方面的兴趣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiġbed persuna lejk b'mod romantiku jew sesswali permezz tas-seħer personali, tal-kliem jew tal-imġiba tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone seduces another person, they use charm or deliberate attention to attract that person romantically or sexually.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist isseduċa lil mara miżżewġa permezz ta' ittri mimlijin tifħir u wegħdiet.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist seduced a married woman through letters filled with praise and promises.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，主人公通过充满赞美和承诺的书信勾引了一名已婚女子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fil-film, kif isseduċa lil Anna? Nina: Bi kliem ħelu u ħafna attenzjoni. Hi ħasbet li kien iħobbha.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did he seduce Anna in the film? Nina: With sweet words and lots of attention. She thought he loved her.
colloquial.zh: Lara：电影里，他是怎么诱惑Anna的？Nina：靠甜言蜜语和无微不至的关注。她以为他爱她。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里，他是怎么诱惑Anna的？
messages.en: How did he seduce Anna in the film?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bi kliem ħelu u ħafna attenzjoni. Hi ħasbet li kien iħobbha.
messages.mt_standard: Bi kliem ħelu u ħafna attenzjoni. Hi ħasbet li kien iħobbha.
messages.zh: 靠甜言蜜语和无微不至的关注。她以为他爱她。
messages.en: With sweet words and lots of attention. She thought he loved her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想小说里的甜言蜜语和刻意示好，把“有意吸引对方动情”作为记忆中心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put things or people apart, divide something into parts, or break a connection completely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或物彼此分开，将整体分成若干部分，或彻底切断某种联系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed affarijiet jew persuni 'l bogħod minn xulxin, taqsam ħaġa f'partijiet, jew taqta' rabta kompletament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使原本在一起或混在一起的人或物彼此分开。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqiegħed persuni jew affarijiet li kienu flimkien f'postijiet jew gruppi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you separate people or things, you move them apart so that they are no longer together.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把一个整体分成两个或更多部分或群组。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqsam ħaġa sħiħa jew grupp wieħed f'żewġ partijiet jew aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you divide something, you split a whole into two or more parts or groups.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 彻底切断或断开原有的连接、联系或关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqta' kompletament konnessjoni jew rabta li kienet tgħaqqad żewġ affarijiet jew persuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you sever a connection or relationship, you break it completely so that the previous link no longer remains.

collocations.en: separated the paper from the plastic
divided the class into two groups

collocations.mt: issepara ż-żewġ partijiet billi qata' l-ħabel
collocations.en: severed the connection between the two parts by cutting the rope
collocations.zh: 通过割断绳子切断了两部分之间的连接

formal.mt: Qabel l-attività, l-għalliem issepara l-klassi f'żewġ gruppi u ta kompitu differenti lil kull grupp.
formal.en: Before the activity, the teacher divided the class into two groups and gave each group a different task.
formal.zh: 活动开始前，老师把全班分成两组，并给每组布置了不同的任务。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min issepara l-karti mill-plastik? Pawlu: Jien. Poġġejt il-karti f'din il-kaxxa u l-plastik fl-oħra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who separated the paper from the plastic? Pawlu: I did. I put the paper in this box and the plastic in the other one.
colloquial.zh: Marija：谁把纸和塑料分开了？Pawlu：我分的。我把纸放进这个箱子，把塑料放进另一个箱子了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把纸和塑料分开了？
messages.en: Who separated the paper from the plastic?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Poġġejt il-karti f'din il-kaxxa u l-plastik fl-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Poġġejt il-karti f'din il-kaxxa u l-plastik fl-oħra.
messages.zh: 我分的。我把纸放进这个箱子，把塑料放进另一个箱子了。
messages.en: I did. I put the paper in this box and the plastic in the other one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面串记：纸塑分开放、全班分成组、连接彻底切断，核心都是使原本相连者分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put or adjust something into a chosen position, state, or configuration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物放置或调整到选定的位置、状态或配置，尤其指设定设备的时间、数值或选项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed jew taġġusta xi ħaġa f'pożizzjoni, stat jew konfigurazzjoni mixtieqa, speċjalment billi tagħżel ħin, valur jew għażla fuq apparat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设置或调整，使某物处于指定的位置、状态或配置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqiegħed jew taġġusta xi ħaġa sabiex tkun fil-pożizzjoni jew fl-istat mixtieq, jew taħdem skont il-valuri magħżula.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you set something, you put or adjust it into the position, state, or configuration that you want.

formal.mt: Qabel tibda, issettja t-temperatura tal-apparat għal għoxrin grad.
formal.en: Before you begin, set the device's temperature to twenty degrees.
formal.zh: 开始之前，请将设备温度设定为二十度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Issettja l-allarm għas-sebgħa, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Tajjeb, issa l-allarm issettjat għas-sebgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Set the alarm for seven, please. Mark: All right, the alarm is now set for seven.
colloquial.zh: Maja：请把闹钟设到七点。Mark：好，现在闹钟已经设到七点了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 请把闹钟设到七点。
messages.en: Set the alarm for seven, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，现在闹钟已经设到七点了。
messages.en: All right, the alarm is now set for seven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己在闹钟上选定七点，把 issettja 与“设好一个具体数值”的动作一起记忆，再替换成温度练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To argue at length with someone over a disputed matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕有分歧的事情与某人反复争辩或长时间争执。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Targumenta fit-tul ma' xi ħadd dwar kwistjoni li fuqha ma jkunx hemm qbil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就某个争议问题反复争论，尤其指双方长时间争执不下。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tidħol f'argument twil ma' xi ħadd dwar xi ħaġa li fuqha ma taqblux, u tibqa' tinsisti fuq il-pożizzjoni tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people wrangle over something, they argue about it for a long time because they cannot agree.

collocations.en: wrangle with the committee over the terms
collocations.zh: 就条款与委员会反复争论

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant issielet mal-kumitat dwar il-kundizzjonijiet tal-ftehim.
formal.en: The representative wrangled with the committee over the terms of the agreement.
formal.zh: 代表就协议条款与委员会反复争论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex bqajt tissielet mal-bejjiegħ? Mark: Ma qbilniex dwar il-prezz tal-karozza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you keep wrangling with the seller? Mark: We couldn't agree on the price of the car.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么一直跟卖家争论？Mark：我们对汽车的价格谈不拢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么一直跟卖家争论？
messages.en: Why did you keep wrangling with the seller?

messages.speaker: Mark (买家)
messages.zh: 我们对汽车的价格谈不拢。
messages.en: We couldn't agree on the price of the car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买家与卖家为价格来回争论，把 issielet 记成“意见不合，争执很久”的场景，而不只是说出一次不同意见。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something tighter, squeeze it firmly, or put pressure on someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变紧，紧握或挤压某物，也可指向某人施加压力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar stretta, tagħfasha sew, jew tagħmel pressjoni fuq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变紧；把螺丝、带子等拧紧或收紧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa, bħal kamin jew ċinturin, aktar stretta jew imwaħħla sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tighten something, you make it firmer or less loose.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力挤压；紧紧握住。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħfas xi ħaġa jew iżżommha b'saħħa bejn idejk jew subgħajk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you squeeze something, you press it firmly with your hands or fingers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人施压，促使其行动或满足某项要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel pressjoni fuq xi ħadd biex jaġixxi jew jagħmel dak li jkun mitlub minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you put pressure on someone, you try to make them act by making firm or repeated demands.

formal.mt: Waqt il-manutenzjoni, it-tekniku għandu jissikka l-viti kollha qabel ma jerġa' juża l-apparat.
formal.en: During maintenance, the technician must tighten all the screws before using the device again.
formal.zh: 维护时，技术人员必须先拧紧所有螺丝，再重新使用设备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kamin għadu maħlul. Pawlu: Għaddili t-tornavit u nissikkah.
colloquial.en: Maja: This screw is still loose. Pawlu: Pass me the screwdriver and I'll tighten it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这颗螺丝还是松的。保罗：把螺丝刀递给我，我来拧紧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这颗螺丝还是松的。
messages.en: This screw is still loose.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 把螺丝刀递给我，我来拧紧。
messages.en: Pass me the screwdriver and I'll tighten it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个动作串联记忆：拧紧螺丝、紧握手掌、催人办事；从物体变紧联想到对人施压，分别搭配练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fitting closely around the body, with little spare room.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容衣物紧贴身体、穿着时余量很小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lbies li joqgħod qrib ħafna tal-ġisem u ma jħallix wisq spazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧身的；衣物紧贴身体而没有多少余量的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta lbies ikun issikkat, joqgħod qrib ħafna tal-ġisem u ftit iħalli spazju għall-moviment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tight-fitting clothing fits very closely around your body and leaves little extra room.

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju, agħżel flokk li ma jkunx issikkat wisq sabiex tkun tista' tiċċaqlaq bil-kumdità.
formal.en: For exercise, choose a top that is not too tight so that you can move comfortably.
formal.zh: 运动时应选择不太紧身的上衣，以便舒适地活动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-flokk issikkat wisq. Għandek wieħed ikbar? Rita: Iva, ġibtillek wieħed daqs ikbar biex tipprovah.
colloquial.en: Mark: This top is too tight. Do you have a bigger one? Rita: Yes, I've brought you one in the next size up to try on.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这件上衣太紧了。有大一点的吗？丽塔：有，我给你拿了一件大一号的试穿。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-flokk issikkat wisq. Għandek wieħed ikbar?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-flokk issikkat wisq. Għandek wieħed ikbar?
messages.zh: 这件上衣太紧了。有大一点的吗？
messages.en: This top is too tight. Do you have a bigger one?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġibtillek wieħed daqs ikbar biex tipprovah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġibtillek wieħed daqs ikbar biex tipprovah.
messages.zh: 有，我给你拿了一件大一号的试穿。
messages.en: Yes, I've brought you one in the next size up to try on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象试衣时上衣紧贴身体，边做拉衣角的动作边说 flokk issikkat，把这个形容词和“衣服紧身”的感觉联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To understand someone's difficulties or sadness and feel concern for them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 理解他人的困难或悲伤，并对其产生同情和关切。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifhem id-diffikultajiet jew id-dwejjaq ta' xi ħadd u tħoss mogħdrija lejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同情、体谅某人，理解其困境或悲伤并感到关切。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħoss mogħdrija għal xi ħadd għax tifhem it-tbatija, id-dwejjaq jew id-diffikultajiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you sympathise with someone, you understand their difficulties and feel sorry for what they are experiencing.

collocations.zh: 我同情这个家庭的遭遇

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, id-direttur qal li jissimpatizza mal-ħaddiema li tilfu l-impjieg tagħhom.
formal.en: In his letter, the director said that he sympathised with the workers who had lost their jobs.
formal.zh: 主任在信中表示，他对失去工作的员工深感同情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma ħadtx l-impjieg li ridt u ninsab diżappuntata. Pawlu: Nissimpatizza miegħek. Naf kemm ħdimt biex tħejji ruħek għall-intervista.
colloquial.en: Maja: I didn't get the job I wanted, and I'm disappointed. Pawlu: I sympathise with you. I know how hard you worked to prepare for the interview.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我没得到想要的工作，心里很失望。保罗：我能体谅你的心情。我知道你为准备面试下了多少功夫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma ħadtx l-impjieg li ridt u ninsab diżappuntata.
messages.mt_standard: Ma ħadtx l-impjieg li ridt u ninsab diżappuntata.
messages.zh: 我没得到想要的工作，心里很失望。
messages.en: I didn't get the job I wanted, and I'm disappointed.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nissimpatizza miegħek. Naf kemm ħdimt biex tħejji ruħek għall-intervista.
messages.mt_standard: Nissimpatizza miegħek. Naf kemm ħdimt biex tħejji ruħek għall-intervista.
messages.zh: 我能体谅你的心情。我知道你为准备面试下了多少功夫。
messages.en: I sympathise with you. I know how hard you worked to prepare for the interview.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把朋友倾诉失望的场景当作记忆画面，练说 Nissimpatizza miegħek，将整句与“我理解并体谅你的心情”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make events happen together or make information match across devices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事件在时间上协调一致，或使不同设备上的信息保持一致。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel ċerti attivitajiet iseħħu flimkien jew tqabbel l-informazzjoni fuq apparati differenti sabiex tkun l-istess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使时间、动作或信息协调一致；使同步。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel żewġ affarijiet jew aktar jaqblu fil-ħin, fil-moviment jew fl-informazzjoni li jkun fihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you synchronize things, you make their timing or information agree.

collocations.zh: 校准各个时钟，使其同步

collocations.en: synchronize the sound with the picture

formal.mt: Qabel tibda r-reġistrazzjoni, issinkronizza l-ħoss mal-istampa sabiex il-kliem jaqbel mal-moviment tax-xufftejn.
formal.en: Before recording begins, synchronize the sound with the picture so that the words match the movement of the lips.
formal.zh: 开始录制前，请同步声音与画面，使话语与嘴唇的动作一致。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kalendarju fuq it-telefon ma jaqbilx ma' dak fuq il-kompjuter. Mark: Issinkronizza l-kalendarji, u mbagħad erġa' ċċekkja l-appuntamenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: The calendar on my phone doesn't match the one on my computer. Mark: Synchronize the calendars, then check the appointments again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我手机上的日历和电脑上的对不上。马克：同步一下日历，然后再检查预约。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kalendarju fuq it-telefon ma jaqbilx ma' dak fuq il-kompjuter.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kalendarju fuq it-telefon ma jaqbilx ma' dak fuq il-kompjuter.
messages.zh: 我手机上的日历和电脑上的对不上。
messages.en: The calendar on my phone doesn't match the one on my computer.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issinkronizza l-kalendarji, u mbagħad erġa' ċċekkja l-appuntamenti.
messages.mt_standard: Issinkronizza l-kalendarji, u mbagħad erġa' ċċekkja l-appuntamenti.
messages.zh: 同步一下日历，然后再检查预约。
messages.en: Synchronize the calendars, then check the appointments again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手机和电脑上的日历一起更新：把两边调成一致，就记住 issinkronizza 表示“使同步”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To meet someone's needs or expectations, or to fulfil a requirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 满足某人的需要或期望，使其满意；也指达到某项要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tilħaq il-ħtiġijiet jew l-aspettattivi ta' xi ħadd, jew twettaq dak li jitlob rekwiżit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满足需要、期望或要求；使某人感到满意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti lil xi ħadd dak li jeħtieġ jew jistenna, jew tilħaq kundizzjoni jew rekwiżit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something satisfies a person or requirement, it provides what is wanted or needed.

formal.mt: Il-proġett issodisfa r-rekwiżiti kollha stabbiliti fil-ftehim u ġie approvat.
formal.en: The project satisfied all the requirements set out in the agreement and was approved.
formal.zh: 该项目达到了协议中规定的全部要求，并获得批准。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-ikel għoġbok? Mark: Iva, issodisfa l-aspettattivi tiegħi. Nerġa' niġi hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you like the food? Mark: Yes, it met my expectations. I'll come here again.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你喜欢这里的食物吗？马克：喜欢，达到了我的期望。我还会再来。

messages.speaker: Nina (服务员)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这里的食物吗？
messages.en: Did you like the food?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issodisfa l-aspettattivi tiegħi. Nerġa' niġi hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issodisfa l-aspettattivi tiegħi. Nerġa' niġi hawn.
messages.zh: 喜欢，达到了我的期望。我还会再来。
messages.en: Yes, it met my expectations. I'll come here again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象顾客的愿望清单逐项打勾，最后满意地点头：issodisfa 把“满足要求”和“使人满意”连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dare to do something uncertain or dangerous, or to expose something valuable to possible loss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敢于做存在不确定性或危险的事，或使有价值的东西面临损失的风险。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu l-kuraġġ jagħmel xi ħaġa minkejja l-periklu jew l-inċertezza, jew iqiegħed xi ħaġa ta' valur f'riskju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敢于做令人害怕、犹豫或需要勇气的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollu l-kuraġġ jagħmel xi ħaġa li tqanqal biża' jew li wieħed jista' joqgħod lura milli jagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you dare to do something, you have enough courage to do it despite feeling afraid or uncertain.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人或某物面临危险或损失的可能；冒着某种风险行事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa fil-periklu, jew jaċċetta l-possibbiltà ta' ħsara jew telf meta jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you risk something valuable, you do something that could cause you to lose it or damage it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒险尝试某种行动，或鼓起勇气进入陌生、可能有危险的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jipprova jagħmel xi ħaġa inċerta jew jidħol f'post mhux magħruf minkejja li jista' jkun hemm periklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you venture somewhere or venture to do something, you proceed despite uncertainty about what might happen.

formal.mt: L-imprenditur issogra parti mill-flus tiegħu biex jiftaħ ħanut ġdid.
formal.en: The entrepreneur risked part of his money to open a new shop.
formal.zh: 这位创业者拿出自己的部分资金冒险开了一家新店。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi ħadd staqsa għaliex il-biljetti kienu daqshekk għoljin? Mark: Iva, Pawlu issogra jistaqsi, u tawh spjegazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did anyone ask why the tickets were so expensive? Mark: Yes, Pawlu dared to ask, and they gave him an explanation.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：有人问票价为什么那么贵了吗？马克：有，保罗鼓起勇气问了，他们给他解释了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd staqsa għaliex il-biljetti kienu daqshekk għoljin?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd staqsa għaliex il-biljetti kienu daqshekk għoljin?
messages.zh: 有人问票价为什么那么贵了吗？
messages.en: Did anyone ask why the tickets were so expensive?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu issogra jistaqsi, u tawh spjegazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu issogra jistaqsi, u tawh spjegazzjoni.
messages.zh: 有，保罗鼓起勇气问了，他们给他解释了。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu dared to ask, and they gave him an explanation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项串成小故事：敢于提问是 dare，拿钱冒险是 risk，冒险进入洞穴是 venture；共同画面是明知结果不确定，仍迈出一步。

gloss_zh: 扶助；支援；提供维持所需的帮助

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sustain someone by providing the help or resources they need.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过提供必要的帮助或物资，扶助某人维持生活或渡过困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd l-għajnuna jew ir-riżorsi meħtieġa biex ikun jista' jgħix jew ilaħħaq ma' diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予必要的支持或援助，使某人能够维持生活或应付困难。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isostni lil xi ħadd billi jipprovdilu għajnuna jew mezzi meħtieġa biex ikompli jgħix jew jegħleb diffikultà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone sustains a person in difficulty, they provide the support or resources that person needs to keep going.

collocations.zh: 向这家人提供食物以维持其生活

collocations.en: provided support to those in need

formal.mt: Il-fond issokkorra lill-familja bl-ikel u bi ħwejjeġ matul il-perjodu ta' diffikultà.
formal.en: The fund sustained the family with food and clothing during the period of hardship.
formal.zh: 该基金在这家人遭遇困难期间，为他们提供了食物和衣物以维持生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif għaddiet il-familja meta l-missier tilef ix-xogħol? Maja: Il-ġar issokkorra lill-familja bl-ikel sakemm il-missier sab xogħol ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the family get by when the father lost his job? Maja: The neighbour sustained the family with food until the father found another job.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：父亲失业后，这家人是怎么过日子的？玛雅：邻居一直给这家人提供食物，直到父亲找到了另一份工作。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għaddiet il-familja meta l-missier tilef ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għaddiet il-familja meta l-missier tilef ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 父亲失业后，这家人是怎么过日子的？
messages.en: How did the family get by when the father lost his job?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġar issokkorra lill-familja bl-ikel sakemm il-missier sab xogħol ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġar issokkorra lill-familja bl-ikel sakemm il-missier sab xogħol ieħor.
messages.zh: 邻居一直给这家人提供食物，直到父亲找到了另一份工作。
messages.en: The neighbour sustained the family with food until the father found another job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“困难中有人送来食物”的场景记忆：issokkorra 表示给予实际扶助，使人能够支撑下去；把动作和得到帮助的人一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To continue an activity or proceed with its next stage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 继续已经开始的活动，或接着进行下一步。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikompli attività li tkun diġà bdiet jew jgħaddi għall-pass li jmiss fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继续做已经开始的事情，或在中断后接着做。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikompli jagħmel xi ħaġa li jkun diġà beda, mingħajr ma jieqaf jew wara waqfa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you continue an activity, you keep doing it or begin doing it again after a pause.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接着进行某项活动，或按顺序进入下一阶段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jimxi 'l quddiem b'attività jew jgħaddi għall-istadju li jmiss wara dak li jkun sar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you proceed with something, you carry it forward or move on to the next stage.

formal.mt: Wara l-waqfa, il-kumitat issokta bid-diskussjoni dwar il-proposta.
formal.en: After the break, the committee proceeded with the discussion of the proposal.
formal.zh: 休息过后，委员会继续讨论该提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu waqaf jaqra meta daqq it-telefon? Mark: Iva, wieġeb it-telefon u mbagħad issokta jaqra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu stop reading when the phone rang? Mark: Yes, he answered the phone and then continued reading.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电话响的时候，保罗停下阅读了吗？马克：停了，他接了电话，然后继续读。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu waqaf jaqra meta daqq it-telefon?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu waqaf jaqra meta daqq it-telefon?
messages.zh: 电话响的时候，保罗停下阅读了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu stop reading when the phone rang?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wieġeb it-telefon u mbagħad issokta jaqra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wieġeb it-telefon u mbagħad issokta jaqra.
messages.zh: 停了，他接了电话，然后继续读。
messages.en: Yes, he answered the phone and then continued reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 issokta 想成按下“继续播放”：阅读停了一下再读，会议休息后再讨论；两个义项都围绕把已开始的事情接着做。

gloss_zh: 假设；推定；想当然地认为

teaching_sense.en_definition: To consider something possible or accept it as true without having complete proof.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在证据不充分时，假设某种情况成立，或推定某件事是真的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qies xi ħaġa bħala possibbli jew vera mingħajr ma kellu prova sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 假设；认为某种情况可能成立，但并不确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaseb li xi ħaġa setgħet kienet vera, mingħajr ma kien ċert minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you suppose that something is true, you think it may be true although you are not certain.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推定；在尚未核实的情况下，将某事视为真实或理所当然。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qies xi ħaġa bħala vera jew mistennija qabel ma kkonfermaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you presume something, you accept it as true or expected before you have checked it.

collocations.en: he supposed that everything was ready
collocations.zh: 他以为一切都准备好了

collocations.en: he presumed that he had permission
collocations.zh: 他未经核实便认为自己已获许可

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur issopona li l-parteċipanti kollha kienu fehmu l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: In his analysis, the researcher assumed that all participants had understood the instructions.
formal.zh: 研究者在分析中假设，所有参与者都已理解说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma ċempilx qabel ġie? Lara: Issopona li konna d-dar. Maja: Imissu staqsa qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Mark call before coming? Lara: He assumed we were at home. Maja: He should have asked first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克来之前怎么没打电话？拉拉：他以为我们在家。玛雅：他应该先问一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma ċempilx qabel ġie?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma ċempilx qabel ġie?
messages.zh: 马克来之前怎么没打电话？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark call before coming?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他以为我们在家。
messages.en: He assumed we were at home.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他应该先问一下。
messages.en: He should have asked first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“他没问就以为我们在家”的场景：证据不足时是“假设”，直接当真时是“推定”。

gloss_zh: 使惊讶；使吃惊；使突然受惊

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel surprised or suddenly frightened by something unexpected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因出乎意料的事情使人惊讶，或因突如其来的刺激使人受惊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jistagħġeb jew jinħasad minħabba xi ħaġa li ma kienx jistenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使惊讶；让人因意料之外的事情而感到吃惊。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jistagħġeb billi għamel jew wera xi ħaġa li dak li jkun ma kienx jistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something surprises you, it makes you feel astonished because you did not expect it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使突然受惊；以突如其来的声音或动作吓人一跳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jinħasad f'daqqa minħabba ħoss, moviment jew ġrajja mhux mistennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something startles you, it makes you suddenly jump or feel frightened because it happens unexpectedly.

collocations.en: he surprised his friends with a gift
collocations.zh: 他送礼物给朋友们一个惊喜

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat tal-istħarriġ issorprenda lill-kumitat, għax kien differenti ħafna minn dak mistenni.
formal.en: The survey result surprised the committee because it was very different from what had been expected.
formal.zh: 调查结果与预期相差很大，令委员会感到惊讶。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qbiżt hekk? Mark: Il-ħoss tal-bieb issorprenda lili wkoll! Lara: Ma stennejtx daqqa daqshekk qawwija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you jump like that? Mark: The sound of the door startled me too! Lara: I wasn't expecting such a loud bang.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么吓得跳了一下？马克：门的声音也吓了我一跳！拉拉：我没想到会有那么响的一声。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么吓得跳了一下？
messages.en: Why did you jump like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 门的声音也吓了我一跳！
messages.en: The sound of the door startled me too!

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我没想到会有那么响的一声。
messages.en: I wasn't expecting such a loud bang.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个意外画面记忆：收到礼物是“惊讶”，门突然砰响是“受惊”；共同点都是事先没料到。

gloss_zh: 暂停；中止；压制；阻止发表或传播

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop something temporarily or prevent an activity, expression, or publication from continuing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂时停止某项活动，或压制某种活动、表达及出版传播，使其不能继续。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waqqaf xi ħaġa għal xi żmien jew żamm attività, espressjoni jew pubblikazzjoni milli tkompli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暂停；暂时中止活动、程序或安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waqqaf attività, proċedura jew arranġament għal xi żmien, mingħajr ma neċessarjament temmu għal dejjem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you suspend an activity or arrangement, you stop it for a period of time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压制；阻止某种活动、表达或出版传播继续进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żamm attività, espressjoni jew pubblikazzjoni milli tkompli jew tasal għand in-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone suppresses an activity or publication, they prevent it from continuing or reaching other people.

collocations.zh: 他叫停了该报纸的出版

formal.mt: Il-president issospenda l-laqgħa għal nofs siegħa sabiex il-membri jkunu jistgħu jeżaminaw id-dokument il-ġdid.
formal.en: The chair suspended the meeting for half an hour so that members could examine the new document.
formal.zh: 主席暂停会议半小时，让成员们查阅新文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqfet il-logħba? Mark: Ir-referee issospenda l-logħba minħabba x-xita. Maja: Mela nistennew hawn sakemm jerġgħu jibdew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has the match stopped? Mark: The referee suspended the match because of the rain. Maja: Then let's wait here until they start again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：比赛怎么停了？马克：裁判因为下雨暂停了比赛。玛雅：那我们就在这里等他们重新开始吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 比赛怎么停了？
messages.en: Why has the match stopped?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 裁判因为下雨暂停了比赛。
messages.en: The referee suspended the match because of the rain.

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nistennew hawn sakemm jerġgħu jibdew.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nistennew hawn sakemm jerġgħu jibdew.
messages.zh: 那我们就在这里等他们重新开始吧。
messages.en: Then let's wait here until they start again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象比赛被按下暂停键，再想象出版被叫停：前者帮助记“暂停”，后者帮助记“压制、阻止传播”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike something with a hammer, usually to drive it in or change its shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锤子敲打物体，通常为了将其打入某处或改变其形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqat xi ħaġa b'martell, ġeneralment biex idaħħalha f'xi ħaġa oħra jew ibiddlilha l-għamla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锤子敲打；以锤击的方式打入、加工或整形。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ta daqqiet b'martell lil xi ħaġa biex idaħħalha, jaħdimha jew ibiddlilha l-għamla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you hammer something, you hit it with a hammer to drive it in or shape it.

collocations.en: he hammered a nail into the wood
collocations.zh: 他把一枚钉子锤进木头

collocations.en: he hammered a piece of metal
collocations.zh: 他用锤子敲打一块金属

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem issossa l-biċċa tal-metall b'attenzjoni biex jagħtiha l-għamla meħtieġa.
formal.en: The worker carefully hammered the piece of metal to give it the required shape.
formal.zh: 工人小心地锤打那块金属，使其形成所需的形状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min għamel dak il-ħoss kollu? Mark: Pawlu issossa musmar fl-injam biex idendel l-istampa. Lara: Tajjeb, issa nista' nara fejn se tkun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who made all that noise? Mark: Pawlu hammered a nail into the wood to hang the picture. Lara: Good, now I can see where it will go.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：刚才那么大的声音是谁弄的？马克：保罗为了挂画，把一枚钉子锤进了木头。拉拉：好，现在我知道画要挂在哪里了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才那么大的声音是谁弄的？
messages.en: Who made all that noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu issossa musmar fl-injam biex idendel l-istampa.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu issossa musmar fl-injam biex idendel l-istampa.
messages.zh: 保罗为了挂画，把一枚钉子锤进了木头。
messages.en: Pawlu hammered a nail into the wood to hang the picture.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa nista' nara fejn se tkun.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa nista' nara fejn se tkun.
messages.zh: 好，现在我知道画要挂在哪里了。
messages.en: Good, now I can see where it will go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“举起锤子、敲下去、钉子进入木头”的连续动作绑定，记住它表示锤击动作。

gloss_zh: 替换；用另一人或物代替

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put one person or thing in the place of another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让另一人或物取代原来的人或物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed persuna jew ħaġa minflok persuna jew ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以另一人或物替代原来的人或物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Juża persuna jew ħaġa minflok oħra biex taqdi l-istess funzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you substitute one person or thing for another, you use the first in place of the second.

formal.mt: Il-kok issostitwixxa z-zokkor bl-għasel fir-riċetta l-ġdida.
formal.en: The cook replaced the sugar with honey in the new recipe.
formal.zh: 厨师在新食谱中用蜂蜜替换了糖。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kejk fih zokkor? Pawlu: Le, il-kok issostitwixxa z-zokkor bl-għasel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this cake contain sugar? Pawlu: No, the cook replaced the sugar with honey.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个蛋糕里放糖了吗？保罗：没有，厨师用蜂蜜替换了糖。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕里放糖了吗？
messages.en: Does this cake contain sugar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (服务员)
messages.zh: 没有，厨师用蜂蜜替换了糖。
messages.en: No, the cook replaced the sugar with honey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把糖罐换成蜂蜜罐：issostitwixxa 表示替换；记住例句中糖是被换掉的，蜂蜜是换上来的。

gloss_zh: 摄取营养维持自身；自食其力

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep oneself nourished or provide for one's own needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过饮食维持自身营养，或靠自己的收入、劳动等维持生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm lilu nnifsu mitmugħ jew jipprovdi għalih innifsu dak li jeħtieġ biex jgħix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过摄取食物和营养维持自身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiekol u jieħu n-nutriment meħtieġ biex iżomm lilu nnifsu b'saħħtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you nourish yourself, you eat food that gives your body the nutrients it needs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自行承担生活所需，维持自己的生计。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jipprovdi għall-bżonnijiet tiegħu stess permezz tad-dħul, tax-xogħol jew tar-riżorsi tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you support yourself, you provide the money or other resources needed for your own living expenses.

collocations.zh: 靠营养充足的食物维持自身

formal.mt: Matul l-istudji tiegħu, l-istudent issostna b'xogħol part-time f'ħanut tal-kotba.
formal.en: During his studies, the student supported himself through part-time work in a bookshop.
formal.zh: 求学期间，这名学生靠在书店做兼职维持生活。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif għadda l-ġurnata kollha jimxi mingħajr ma waqaf f'ristorant? Ġanni: Issostna bil-ħobż, bil-ġobon u bil-frott li ħa miegħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did he spend the whole day walking without stopping at a restaurant? Ġanni: He kept himself nourished with the bread, cheese and fruit he brought along.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他走了一整天，也没去餐馆，是怎么吃东西补充体力的？詹尼：他靠随身带的面包、奶酪和水果补充营养。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għadda l-ġurnata kollha jimxi mingħajr ma waqaf f'ristorant?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għadda l-ġurnata kollha jimxi mingħajr ma waqaf f'ristorant?
messages.zh: 他走了一整天，也没去餐馆，是怎么吃东西补充体力的？
messages.en: How did he spend the whole day walking without stopping at a restaurant?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issostna bil-ħobż, bil-ġobon u bil-frott li ħa miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Issostna bil-ħobż, bil-ġobon u bil-frott li ħa miegħu.
messages.zh: 他靠随身带的面包、奶酪和水果补充营养。
messages.en: He kept himself nourished with the bread, cheese and fruit he brought along.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两幅画连起来记：饭盒让自己吃得饱，工资让自己过得下去；issostna 的两个义项都围绕维持自身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange to receive a publication or service regularly, usually by paying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常通过付费，安排定期接收刊物或使用某项服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiftiehem li jirċievi pubblikazzjoni jew juża servizz regolarment, normalment bi ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 订阅刊物或服务，通常按约定定期付费。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jirreġistra biex jirċievi pubblikazzjoni jew ikollu aċċess għal servizz għal perjodu ta' żmien, normalment bi ħlas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you subscribe to a publication or service, you arrange to receive or use it regularly, usually in return for payment.

formal.mt: Id-dipartiment issottoskriva għal rivista xjentifika għal sena biex l-istaff ikollu aċċess għall-artikli tagħha.
formal.en: The department subscribed to a scientific journal for a year so that staff could access its articles.
formal.zh: 该部门订阅了一年的科学期刊，供员工查阅其中的文章。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif qed taqra din ir-rivista fuq it-tablet? Mark: Ħija issottoskriva għall-verżjoni diġitali għalija bħala rigal.
colloquial.en: Nina: How are you reading this magazine on your tablet? Mark: My brother subscribed to the digital version for me as a gift.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么能在平板上读这份杂志？马克：我哥哥给我订阅了电子版，作为礼物。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed taqra din ir-rivista fuq it-tablet?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed taqra din ir-rivista fuq it-tablet?
messages.zh: 你怎么能在平板上读这份杂志？
messages.en: How are you reading this magazine on your tablet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija issottoskriva għall-verżjoni diġitali għalija bħala rigal.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija issottoskriva għall-verżjoni diġitali għalija bħala rigal.
messages.zh: 我哥哥给我订阅了电子版，作为礼物。
messages.en: My brother subscribed to the digital version for me as a gift.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象订阅按钮旁边排着十二期杂志：issottoskriva 表示办好订阅，之后按期收到内容或使用服务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something undergo a process, experience, or form of control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物接受某种处理、经历某种处境，或处于某种控制之下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa jgħaddi minn proċess jew esperjenza, jew ikun taħt kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人或某物经受某种处理、条件或影响，或使其受到控制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa taħt kontroll jew iġiegħlu jgħaddi minn trattament, kundizzjonijiet jew esperjenza partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone subjects a person or thing to something, they make that person or thing undergo it or come under its influence.

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju issoġġetta l-materjal għal testijiet bir-reqqa biex jevalwa s-saħħa tiegħu.
formal.en: The laboratory subjected the material to thorough tests to assess its strength.
formal.zh: 实验室对材料进行了细致的测试，以评估其强度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark kien daqshekk imdejjaq wara l-laqgħa? Lara: Il-maniġer issoġġetta lit-tim kollu għal ħafna pressjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Mark so upset after the meeting? Lara: The manager subjected the whole team to a lot of pressure.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克开完会后为什么那么难过？拉拉：经理给整个团队施加了很大的压力。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark kien daqshekk imdejjaq wara l-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark kien daqshekk imdejjaq wara l-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 马克开完会后为什么那么难过？
messages.en: Why was Mark so upset after the meeting?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maniġer issoġġetta lit-tim kollu għal ħafna pressjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Il-maniġer issoġġetta lit-tim kollu għal ħafna pressjoni.
messages.zh: 经理给整个团队施加了很大的压力。
messages.en: The manager subjected the whole team to a lot of pressure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“让某人经受某事”的画面记忆：工人承受压力，材料接受测试；重点记住 issoġġetta 后常用 għal 引出所经受的事情。

gloss_zh: 升华；使固体直接变为气体

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change directly from a solid into a gas, or cause a substance to undergo this change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由固态直接变成气态，或使某种物质发生这种变化，中间不经过液态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi direttament mill-istat solidu għall-istat gassuż, jew iġiegħel sustanza tgħaddi minn din il-bidla, mingħajr ma ssir likwida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 升华，即由固态直接转变为气态；也指使物质发生这种转变。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jinbidel minn solidu direttament f'gass mingħajr ma jgħaddi mill-istat likwidu, jew iwettaq din il-bidla fuq sustanza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a solid sublimates, or someone sublimates it, it changes directly into a gas without first becoming a liquid.

collocations.zh: 未变成液体便发生了升华

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, il-kampjun solidu issublima direttament f'gass mingħajr ma għadda mill-istat likwidu.
formal.en: During the experiment, the solid sample sublimated directly into a gas without passing through the liquid state.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，固体样品直接升华成气体，没有经过液态。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kampjun inħall qabel sar gass? David: Le, issublima: għadda direttament minn solidu għal gass.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the sample melt before becoming a gas? David: No, it sublimated: it went directly from a solid to a gas.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：样品变成气体之前先熔化了吗？戴维：没有，它升华了，也就是直接从固体变成气体。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 样品变成气体之前先熔化了吗？
messages.en: Did the sample melt before becoming a gas?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issublima: għadda direttament minn solidu għal gass.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issublima: għadda direttament minn solidu għal gass.
messages.zh: 没有，它升华了，也就是直接从固体变成气体。
messages.en: No, it sublimated: it went directly from a solid to a gas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条从固体直接指向气体的箭头，跳过液体这一站，用这幅图记住 issublima 的升华含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To draw liquid into the mouth, or hold something in the mouth and suck it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过口腔的吸力吸入液体，或把某物含在嘴里吸吮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġbed likwidu għal ġo ħalqek, jew iżżomm xi ħaġa f'ħalqek u tiġbed fuqha bix-xufftejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用嘴吮吸液体，或含住某物吸吮。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiġbed likwidu għal ġo ħalqek jew tiġbed fuq xi ħaġa li żżomm bejn ix-xufftejn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone sucks, they draw liquid into their mouth or draw on something held between their lips.

formal.mt: It-tarbija bdiet tissuga l-ħalib mill-flixkun u ftit wara waqfet tibki.
formal.en: The baby began sucking milk from the bottle and soon stopped crying.
formal.zh: 婴儿开始从奶瓶里吸奶，不久就停止了哭泣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tarbija qed tibki? Rita: Forsi għandha l-ġuħ; ara kif qed tissuga subgħajha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the baby crying? Rita: Maybe she's hungry; look how she's sucking her fingers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：宝宝为什么在哭？丽塔：也许她饿了；你看她正在吮吸自己的手指。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 宝宝为什么在哭？
messages.en: Why is the baby crying?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi għandha l-ġuħ; ara kif qed tissuga subgħajha.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi għandha l-ġuħ; ara kif qed tissuga subgħajha.
messages.zh: 也许她饿了；你看她正在吮吸自己的手指。
messages.en: Maybe she's hungry; look how she's sucking her fingers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与婴儿吸奶、吮手指的画面绑定，记住动作重点是用嘴产生吸力。

gloss_zh: 使某人惊讶得说不出话；使某人一时无言

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave someone unable to speak because of surprise or strong emotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因惊讶或强烈情绪而使某人一时说不出话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħalli lil xi ħadd bla kliem minħabba stagħġib jew emozzjoni qawwija.

sense_translations.en_definition: render someone speechless; tħalli 'l xi ħadd bla kliem
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人因震惊、惊喜或强烈感受而一时无言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħalli lil persuna bla kliem għax tkun sorpriża ħafna jew milquta minn emozzjoni qawwija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something renders someone speechless, it surprises or affects them so strongly that they cannot immediately respond.

collocations.zh: 消息使他一时说不出话

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat tal-kompetizzjoni issummah, u għal mument ma setax iwieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tal-ġurnalisti.
formal.en: The competition result left him speechless, and for a moment he could not answer the journalists' questions.
formal.zh: 比赛结果使他惊讶得说不出话，一时间无法回答记者的提问。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Kif irreaġixxa Pawlu għall-aħbar? Sara: L-aħbar issummah; għal ftit ma qal xejn.
colloquial.en: Luca: How did Pawlu react to the news? Sara: It left him speechless; he said nothing for a while.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：保罗听到消息后有什么反应？萨拉：消息让他一时说不出话；他好一会儿什么也没说。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗听到消息后有什么反应？
messages.en: How did Pawlu react to the news?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-aħbar issummah; għal ftit ma qal xejn.
messages.mt_standard: L-aħbar issummah; għal ftit ma qal xejn.
messages.zh: 消息让他一时说不出话；他好一会儿什么也没说。
messages.en: It left him speechless; he said nothing for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人听到意外消息后张着嘴却说不出话，用这幅画面记住“使人一时无言”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To think that something may be true, or that someone may have done something wrong, without being certain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在尚未确定的情况下，认为某事可能属实，或认为某人可能做了不当的事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħseb li xi ħaġa tista' tkun vera jew li xi ħadd seta' għamel xi ħaġa ħażina, mingħajr ma tkun ċert.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀疑某事可能属实，或猜疑某人做了某事，但尚无把握。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħseb, mingħajr ċertezza, li xi ħaġa ġrat jew hija vera, jew li persuna għamlet xi ħaġa ħażina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you suspect something, you think it is probably true even though you do not have definite proof.

collocations.mt: issuspetta li xi ħaġa kienet ħażina

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal issuspetta frodi wara li sab differenzi bejn il-fatturi u r-rekords tal-ħlas.
formal.en: The officer suspected fraud after finding discrepancies between the invoices and the payment records.
formal.zh: 该官员发现发票与付款记录之间存在出入后，怀疑其中有欺诈行为。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Mark kien jaf bis-sorpriża? Lara: Naħseb li issuspetta xi ħaġa meta ra l-kejk.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Mark know about the surprise? Lara: I think he suspected something when he saw the cake.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克知道我们准备的惊喜吗？拉拉：我想他看到蛋糕时就有所察觉了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克知道我们准备的惊喜吗？
messages.en: Did Mark know about the surprise?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li issuspetta xi ħaġa meta ra l-kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li issuspetta xi ħaġa meta ra l-kejk.
messages.zh: 我想他看到蛋糕时就有所察觉了。
messages.en: I think he suspected something when he saw the cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“看见线索、心里起疑、尚未证实”连成三个步骤，帮助区分怀疑与已经知道。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Newspapers and magazines, or the journalists and organizations that produce news for publication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 报纸、杂志等新闻出版物，也可统指从事新闻报道的记者和机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-gazzetti u r-rivisti li jippubblikaw aħbarijiet, jew il-ġurnalisti u l-organizzazzjonijiet li jipproduċuhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 报刊媒体；统称新闻出版机构及其记者的新闻界。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mezzi tal-aħbarijiet bħall-gazzetti u r-rivisti, kif ukoll il-ġurnalisti u l-organizzazzjonijiet li jaħdmu fihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The press consists of newspapers and magazines, together with the journalists and organizations that prepare their news reports.

collocations.zh: 记者招待会；新闻发布会

formal.mt: Il-kunsill organizza konferenza tal-istampa biex jippreżenta l-pjan il-ġdid għat-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: The council organized a press conference to present the new public transport plan.
formal.zh: 议会组织了一场新闻发布会，介绍新的公共交通方案。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn qrajt dwar il-proġett? David: Fl-istampa; illum kien hemm artiklu fil-gazzetta.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you read about the project? David: In the press; there was an article in the newspaper today.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你在哪里读到这个项目的消息？戴维：在报刊上；今天报纸里有一篇相关文章。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在哪里读到这个项目的消息？
messages.en: Where did you read about the project?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-istampa; illum kien hemm artiklu fil-gazzetta.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-istampa; illum kien hemm artiklu fil-gazzetta.
messages.zh: 在报刊上；今天报纸里有一篇相关文章。
messages.en: In the press; there was an article in the newspaper today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象记者拿着报纸参加新闻发布会，把“报刊、记者、新闻界”放进同一幅记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A grammatical construction in which a noun is linked directly to a following noun to express possession or another relationship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种语法结构：前面的名词与后面的名词直接连接，表达所属或其他关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kostruzzjoni grammatikali li fiha nom jintrabat direttament ma' nom li jiġi warajh biex jesprimi pussess jew relazzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 构造态，又称名词连接结构，指名词与其后名词直接结合以表达所属或其他关系的语法形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istat kostrutt huwa struttura grammatikali li tgħaqqad nom ma' nom ieħor warajh biex turi pussess jew rabta oħra bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The construct state is a grammatical construction in which a noun is directly linked to a following noun to express possession or another relationship.

collocations.en: a noun in the construct state
the use of the construct state

formal.mt: F'dan il-kapitlu, l-istudenti jistudjaw l-istat kostrutt u r-relazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ nomi fil-kostruzzjoni.
formal.en: In this chapter, students study the construct state and the relationship between the two nouns in the construction.
formal.zh: 本章中，学生学习构造态，以及这一结构中两个名词之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'istat kostrutt'? Pawlu: Huwa meta nom jintrabat direttament ma' nom ieħor warajh biex juri pussess jew relazzjoni oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'construct state' mean? Pawlu: It is when a noun is linked directly to another noun after it to show possession or another relationship.
colloquial.zh: Maja：构造态是什么意思？Pawlu：就是一个名词直接连接后面的另一个名词，表示所属或其他关系。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 构造态是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'construct state' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa meta nom jintrabat direttament ma' nom ieħor warajh biex juri pussess jew relazzjoni oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa meta nom jintrabat direttament ma' nom ieħor warajh biex juri pussess jew relazzjoni oħra.
messages.zh: 就是一个名词直接连接后面的另一个名词，表示所属或其他关系。
messages.en: It is when a noun is linked directly to another noun after it to show possession or another relationship.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个名词想成前后连接的车厢：前一个直接接上后一个，用这种连接表达所属或其他关系，帮助记住“构造态”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surgical operation in which the uterus is removed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过外科手术切除子宫的医疗操作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Operazzjoni kirurġika li fiha jitneħħa l-utru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 子宫切除术，即通过外科手术将子宫切除。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isterektomija hija intervent kirurġiku li fih jitneħħa l-utru tal-pazjenta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hysterectomy is a surgical operation in which a patient's uterus is removed.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett għall-pazjenti jispjega x'inhi l-isterektomija u jagħti informazzjoni dwar il-kura wara l-operazzjoni.
formal.en: The patient leaflet explains what a hysterectomy is and provides information about care after the operation.
formal.zh: 患者说明册解释了什么是子宫切除术，并提供术后护理信息。
