colloquial.mt: Lara: Fil-fuljett hemm il-kelma 'isterektomija'. Xi tfisser? Rita: Hija operazzjoni li fiha jitneħħa l-utru.
colloquial.en: Lara: The leaflet has the word 'hysterectomy'. What does it mean? Rita: It is an operation in which the uterus is removed.
colloquial.zh: Lara：说明册上有“子宫切除术”这个词，是什么意思？Rita：就是切除子宫的手术。

messages.speaker: Lara (患者)
messages.zh: 说明册上有“子宫切除术”这个词，是什么意思？
messages.en: The leaflet has the word 'hysterectomy'. What does it mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija operazzjoni li fiha jitneħħa l-utru.
messages.mt_standard: Hija operazzjoni li fiha jitneħħa l-utru.
messages.zh: 就是切除子宫的手术。
messages.en: It is an operation in which the uterus is removed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时把这个长词写在“子宫切除手术”的图示旁，并与“术后恢复”搭配复习，将完整词形和具体手术含义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A natural tendency to act or react without conscious reasoning, or an immediate feeling about what to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无需有意识推理便会行动或反应的天然倾向，也可指对应该如何行动产生的直觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tendenza naturali li ġġiegħel persuna jew annimal jaġixxi mingħajr ħsieb konxju, jew sens immedjat dwar x'għandu jsir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本能，即无需有意识思考的天然行为倾向；也指不经过明确推理而产生的直觉判断。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istint huwa tendenza naturali li twassal għal azzjoni mingħajr raġunament konxju, jew sens li jgħidlek x'għandek tagħmel mingħajr ma taħseb fit-tul.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An instinct is a natural tendency or immediate feeling that guides behaviour without conscious reasoning.

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-għajta, ir-raġel mexa bl-istint u ġera lejn it-tifel biex jgħinu.
formal.en: When he heard the cry, the man acted on instinct and ran towards the boy to help him.
formal.zh: 听到喊声后，那名男子本能地跑向男孩，想要帮助他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kont taf li kien hemm xi ħaġa ħażina? Mark: Ma nafx eżatt. Imxejt fuq l-istint tiegħi u ċempiltlek.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you know something was wrong? Mark: I do not know exactly. I followed my instinct and called you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么知道有事情不对劲？Mark：我也说不清。我凭直觉给你打了电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kont taf li kien hemm xi ħaġa ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kont taf li kien hemm xi ħaġa ħażina?
messages.zh: 你怎么知道有事情不对劲？
messages.en: How did you know something was wrong?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx eżatt. Imxejt fuq l-istint tiegħi u ċempiltlek.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx eżatt. Imxejt fuq l-istint tiegħi u ċempiltlek.
messages.zh: 我也说不清。我凭直觉给你打了电话。
messages.en: I do not know exactly. I followed my instinct and called you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到突响时身体先缩一下、脑中随后才分析原因：这种“反应先于思考”的画面，可以帮助记住 istint 的本能和直觉含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ordinal numeral used for someone or something that comes immediately after the first.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示顺序在第一之后的位置，即第二或第二个。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Numru ordinali li jindika persuna jew ħaġa li tiġi wara l-ewwel f'ordni jew f'sensiela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第二，表示在顺序中紧接第一的位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Numru ordinali li juri l-pożizzjoni li tiġi eżatt wara l-ewwel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is second comes immediately after the first in an ordered sequence.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok aqra t-tieni paragrafu qabel twieġeb il-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: Please read the second paragraph before answering the questions.
formal.zh: 请先阅读第二段，再回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema ktieb trid? Pawlu: Irrid it-tieni wieħed fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which book do you want? Pawlu: I want the second one on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想要哪本书？Pawlu：我想要书架上的第二本。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想要哪本书？
messages.en: Which book do you want?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想要书架上的第二本。
messages.en: I want the second one on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画三个位置，把 it-tieni 写在第二格；每次指着第二格读词，记住它表示顺序而非数量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The day of the week that comes after Monday and before Wednesday.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 星期一之后、星期三之前的日子，即星期二。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum tal-ġimgħa li jiġi wara t-Tnejn u qabel l-Erbgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 星期二，位于星期一与星期三之间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-Tlieta huwa l-jum tal-ġimgħa bejn it-Tnejn u l-Erbgħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tuesday is the day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa tal-kumitat se ssir it-Tlieta fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The committee meeting will take place on Tuesday at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 委员会会议将于星期二上午九点举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu niltaqgħu it-Tlieta wara x-xogħol? Mark: Iva, niltaqgħu fis-sitta ħdejn il-kafetterija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we meet on Tuesday after work? Mark: Yes, let's meet at six near the café.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们星期二下班后可以见面吗？Mark：可以，六点在咖啡馆附近见。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们星期二下班后可以见面吗？
messages.en: Can we meet on Tuesday after work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 可以，六点在咖啡馆附近见。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet at six near the café.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 it-Tlieta 写进日历的星期二栏，再配上固定活动如喝咖啡；用整句约时间来记忆，并留意星期名称中的大写 T。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The day of the week that comes after Sunday and before Tuesday.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 星期日之后、星期二之前的日子，即星期一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum tal-ġimgħa li jiġi wara l-Ħadd u qabel it-Tlieta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 星期一，位于星期日与星期二之间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-Tnejn huwa l-jum tal-ġimgħa bejn il-Ħadd u t-Tlieta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Monday is the day of the week after Sunday and before Tuesday.

formal.mt: Il-kors il-ġdid se jibda t-Tnejn fit-tmienja ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The new course will begin on Monday at eight in the morning.
formal.zh: 新课程将于星期一上午八点开始。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta terġa' tiftaħ il-librerija? Toni: It-Tnejn filgħodu. Nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: When does the library reopen? Toni: On Monday morning. We can go together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：图书馆什么时候重新开放？Toni：星期一上午。我们可以一起去。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 图书馆什么时候重新开放？
messages.en: When does the library reopen?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 星期一上午。我们可以一起去。
messages.en: On Monday morning. We can go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 it-Tnejn 固定写在日历的星期一栏，并联想周一上课的画面；与星期二 it-Tlieta 并排朗读，避免把两个日期混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Christian feast of Epiphany, associated with the visit of the Magi to Jesus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教的主显节，也称三王节，与贤士朝拜耶稣的故事相关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-festa Nisranija tal-Epifanija, marbuta maż-żjara tas-slaten maġi lil Ġesù.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主显节，又称三王节，是与贤士朝拜耶稣相关的基督教节日。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Festa fil-kalendarju Nisrani li tfakkar id-dehra ta' Ġesù lill-ġnus, irrappreżentati mis-slaten maġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The feast of the Epiphany is a Christian celebration associated with the visit of the Magi to Jesus.

collocations.en: a Mass for the feast of Epiphany

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-parroċċa jinkludi quddiesa għall-festa tat-Tre Re.
formal.en: The parish programme includes a Mass for the feast of Epiphany.
formal.zh: 堂区的活动安排包括一场主显节弥撒。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Se tmur il-knisja għall-festa tat-Tre Re? Mark: Iva, se mmur mal-familja tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you going to church for Epiphany? Mark: Yes, I'm going with my family.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：主显节你会去教堂吗？马克：会，我会和家人一起去。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur il-knisja għall-festa tat-Tre Re?
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur il-knisja għall-festa tat-Tre Re?
messages.zh: 主显节你会去教堂吗？
messages.en: Are you going to church for Epiphany?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，我会和家人一起去。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going with my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 it-Tre Re 与“三位贤士来到耶稣面前”的节日画面相连，整体记成“主显节／三王节”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The country of Turkey, situated mainly in western Asia and partly in southeastern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 土耳其，主要位于亚洲西部、部分位于欧洲东南部的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż li jinsab prinċipalment fil-Punent tal-Asja u parzjalment fix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 土耳其，横跨亚洲西部和欧洲东南部的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pajjiż li t-territorju tiegħu jestendi mill-Punent tal-Asja sa parti mix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Turkey is a country whose territory lies mainly in western Asia and partly in southeastern Europe.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi żjara ta' studju fit-Turkija u l-attivitajiet li saru matulha.
formal.en: The report describes a study visit to Turkey and the activities carried out during it.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了一次赴土耳其的考察访问及访问期间开展的活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganzi? Daniel: Se mmur it-Turkija ma' ħabib tiegħi. Sara: Kemm se ddumu hemm? Daniel: Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going on holiday? Daniel: I'm going to Turkey with a friend. Sara: How long will you stay there? Daniel: A week.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你打算去哪里度假？丹尼尔：我打算和一位朋友去土耳其。萨拉：你们会在那里待多久？丹尼尔：一周。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur it-Turkija ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur it-Turkija ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我打算和一位朋友去土耳其。
messages.en: I'm going to Turkey with a friend.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们会在那里待多久？
messages.en: How long will you stay there?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.zh: 一周。
messages.en: A week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 it-Turkija 写在土耳其地图旁，再配对记忆 fit-Turkija“在土耳其”和 mit-Turkija“从土耳其”。

gloss_zh: 学吧；去学；学会（命令或劝告）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A command or piece of advice telling someone to gain knowledge or acquire a skill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于命令或劝告对方去学习知识或掌握技能的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' kmand jew parir li tħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd jikseb għarfien jew ħila permezz tat-tagħlim jew tal-prattika.

sense_translations.en_definition: learn - as in an order or advice to go and learn something.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 学吧；去学习；学会。用于命令或劝告对方学习某项知识或技能。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tordna jew tagħti parir lil xi ħadd biex jitgħallem xi ħaġa jew jakkwista ħila.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this form to tell or advise someone to gain knowledge or acquire a particular skill.

formal.mt: Itgħallem it-tifsira ta' kull kelma ġdida u mbagħad użaha f'sentenza sħiħa.
formal.en: Learn the meaning of each new word and then use it in a complete sentence.
formal.zh: 学会每个生词的含义，然后用它造一个完整的句子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Irrid inkellem lin-nanna bil-Malti, imma naf ftit kliem biss. Pawlu: Itgħallem ftit frażijiet kuljum u pprattikahom magħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: I want to speak to Grandma in Maltese, but I only know a few words. Pawlu: Learn a few phrases every day and practise them with her.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我想用马耳他语和奶奶说话，但我只会几个词。Pawlu：每天学几个短语，再和她一起练习。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid inkellem lin-nanna bil-Malti, imma naf ftit kliem biss.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid inkellem lin-nanna bil-Malti, imma naf ftit kliem biss.
messages.zh: 我想用马耳他语和奶奶说话，但我只会几个词。
messages.en: I want to speak to Grandma in Maltese, but I only know a few words.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Itgħallem ftit frażijiet kuljum u pprattikahom magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Itgħallem ftit frażijiet kuljum u pprattikahom magħha.
messages.zh: 每天学几个短语，再和她一起练习。
messages.en: Learn a few phrases every day and practise them with her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 itgħallem 想成老师指着课本说“去学吧！”的提示语：记忆重点是它在催促或鼓励对方学习，而不是单纯陈述学习这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To taste food or drink in order to experience or check its flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品尝食物或饮料，感受或检查其味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id uq jew jipprova ikel jew xorb biex jagħraf jew jiċċekkja t-togħma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 品尝食物或饮料，感受其味道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jipprova ftit ikel jew xorb biex jagħraf it-togħma tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who tastes food or drink tries some of it to discover its flavour.

formal.mt: Il-kok itiegħem is-soppa biex jiċċekkja jekk għandhiex bżonn aktar melħ.
formal.en: The cook tastes the soup to check whether it needs more salt.
formal.zh: 厨师尝一尝汤，检查是否还需要加盐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min itiegħem is-soppa qabel ma nservuha? Mark: Pawlu. Hu jgħidilna jekk għandhiex bżonn aktar melħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who tastes the soup before we serve it? Mark: Paul. He tells us whether it needs more salt.
colloquial.zh: Lara：上桌前谁来尝汤？Mark：Pawlu。他会告诉我们是否还需要加盐。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min itiegħem is-soppa qabel ma nservuha?
messages.mt_standard: Min itiegħem is-soppa qabel ma nservuha?
messages.zh: 上桌前谁来尝汤？
messages.en: Who tastes the soup before we serve it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu. Hu jgħidilna jekk għandhiex bżonn aktar melħ.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu. Hu jgħidilna jekk għandhiex bżonn aktar melħ.
messages.zh: Pawlu。他会告诉我们是否还需要加盐。
messages.en: Paul. He tells us whether it needs more salt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 itiegħem 和厨师尝汤的画面绑定：先尝一口，再判断咸淡；这是场景记忆，不是词源分析。

gloss_zh: 词义待核实：所给名词释义为“zobb”，形容词释义为“tttt”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied unexplained label "zobb".
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料将该项标为名词，但仅给出未解释的“zobb”，无法据此确定具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din il-kelma hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda t-tikketta "zobb" mhijiex spjegata u ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名词义未能确定；所给释义只有未解释的“zobb”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan is-sens huwa mmarkat bħala nom, iżda t-tikketta "zobb" mhijiex spjegata, għalhekk it-tifsira tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita minn din l-informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun has the unexplained label "zobb", which does not establish its meaning in the supplied material.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容词义未能确定；所给释义只有无法解释的“tttt”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan is-sens huwa mmarkat bħala aġġettiv, iżda t-tikketta "tttt" ma tagħtix tifsira ċara li tista' tiġi mgħallma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This adjective has the unexplained label "tttt", so the supplied material does not establish what it describes.

formal.mt: Il-materjal jagħti żewġ sensi għal "ittabba", wieħed bħala nom u ieħor bħala aġġettiv, iżda t-tifsiriet mogħtija mhumiex ċari.
formal.en: The material gives two senses for "ittabba", one as a noun and another as an adjective, but the supplied meanings are unclear.
formal.zh: 资料为“ittabba”列出名词和形容词两个义项，但所给释义均不明确。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser "ittabba" hawn? Mark: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din l-informazzjoni. In-nom u l-aġġettiv għandhom bżonn spjegazzjoni separata.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does "ittabba" mean here? Mark: We cannot be sure from this information. The noun and the adjective each need a separate explanation.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“ittabba”是什么意思？Mark：仅凭这些资料还不能确定。名词和形容词需要分别解释。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“ittabba”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "ittabba" mean here?

messages.en: We cannot be sure from this information. The noun and the adjective each need a separate explanation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 ittabba 没有末尾撇号，再分开保留名词、形容词两张卡片；释义待核实，不把不明标签硬背成词义。

gloss_zh: 词义待核实：所给名词释义仅为“hhhh”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied unexplained label "hhhh".
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料将该项标为名词，但仅给出未解释的“hhhh”，无法据此确定具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din il-kelma hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda t-tikketta "hhhh" ma tagħtix tifsira ċara li tista' tiġi stabbilita minn dan il-materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名词义未能确定；所给释义只有无法解释的“hhhh”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan is-sens huwa mmarkat bħala nom, iżda t-tikketta "hhhh" mhijiex spjegata, għalhekk ma hemmx biżżejjed informazzjoni biex tingħata tifsira preċiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun has the unexplained label "hhhh", so its meaning cannot be established from the supplied material.

formal.mt: L-entrata "ittabba'" hija mmarkata bħala nom; it-tikketta "hhhh" ma tagħtix biżżejjed informazzjoni biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira.
formal.en: The entry "ittabba'" is marked as a noun; the label "hhhh" does not provide enough information to establish its meaning.
formal.zh: 词条“ittabba'”被标为名词；“hhhh”这一标签提供的信息不足以确定其含义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi nżomm l-apostrofu fl-aħħar ta' "ittabba'"? Pawlu: Iva, żommu kif jidher fl-entrata. It-tifsira għad għandha bżonn tiġi ċċarata.
colloquial.en: Sara: Should I keep the apostrophe at the end of "ittabba'"? Pawlu: Yes, keep it as it appears in the entry. The meaning still needs clarification.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我应该保留“ittabba'”末尾的撇号吗？Pawlu：应该，照词条原样保留。它的含义还需要澄清。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我应该保留“ittabba'”末尾的撇号吗？
messages.en: Should I keep the apostrophe at the end of "ittabba'"?

messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żommu kif jidher fl-entrata. It-tifsira għad għandha bżonn tiġi ċċarata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żommu kif jidher fl-entrata. It-tifsira għad għandha bżonn tiġi ċċarata.
messages.zh: 应该，照词条原样保留。它的含义还需要澄清。
messages.en: Yes, keep it as it appears in the entry. The meaning still needs clarification.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把末尾撇号看作核对词形的小标记：ittabba' 单独建卡，与 ittabba 分开保存；这只是辨形技巧，不推断词源或含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become less intense or severe, especially of pain, worry, or another unpleasant condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指疼痛、忧虑等不适或紧张状态的程度减轻、缓和。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir inqas qawwi jew inqas gravi, speċjalment meta jkun hemm uġigħ, tħassib jew skumdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指疼痛、忧虑等逐渐减轻或趋于平息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jonqos fil-qawwa jew fil-gravità, bħalma jiġri meta l-uġigħ jew it-tħassib jibda jgħaddi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If pain, worry, or another unpleasant condition subsides, it becomes less intense or severe.

formal.mt: Wara li waslet l-informazzjoni l-ġdida, it-tħassib tal-parteċipanti ittaffa.
formal.en: After the new information arrived, the participants' concern subsided.
formal.zh: 新信息传来后，参与者的忧虑缓和了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-uġigħ ittaffa? Mark: Iva, ittaffa ftit wara li striħajt, imma għad inħossu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the pain eased? Mark: Yes, it eased a little after I rested, but I can still feel it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：疼痛减轻了吗？Mark：是的，休息后轻了一点，但我还是感觉得到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 疼痛减轻了吗？
messages.en: Has the pain eased?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ittaffa ftit wara li striħajt, imma għad inħossu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ittaffa ftit wara li striħajt, imma għad inħossu.
messages.zh: 是的，休息后轻了一点，但我还是感觉得到。
messages.en: Yes, it eased a little after I rested, but I can still feel it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ittaffa 配上疼痛刻度逐渐下降的画面：程度变轻就用“减轻、缓和”来理解，不必理解为完全消失。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fly high in the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 飞到高处或在高空翱翔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li ttir fl-arja f'għoli kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高飞；在高空翱翔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li ttir fl-arja f'għoli kbir, bħal għasfur li jogħla ħafna 'l fuq mill-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a bird soars, it flies high in the air.

formal.mt: L-ajkla bdiet tittajjar fil-għoli fuq il-muntanji.
formal.en: The eagle began to soar above the mountains.
formal.zh: 那只鹰开始在群山上空翱翔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik l-ajkla! Qed tittajjar fil-għoli. Pawlu: Iva, bilkemm nista' naraha issa!
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that eagle! It's soaring high. Pawlu: Yes, I can barely see it now!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那只鹰！它正在高空翱翔。保罗：是啊，我现在几乎看不见它了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik l-ajkla! Qed tittajjar fil-għoli.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik l-ajkla! Qed tittajjar fil-għoli.
messages.zh: 看那只鹰！它正在高空翱翔。
messages.en: Look at that eagle! It's soaring high.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我现在几乎看不见它了！
messages.en: Yes, I can barely see it now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上一只鹰在群山上空盘旋的画面，记住这里强调的是飞得高、在高空翱翔。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter letters or text using a keyboard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用键盘输入字母或文字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li ddaħħal ittri jew kliem permezz ta' tastiera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打字；用键盘键入文字。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li tikteb kliem jew test billi tagħfas it-tasti ta' tastiera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you type, you use a keyboard to enter letters and words.

formal.mt: L-istudent ittajpja r-rapport fuq il-kompjuter u bagħtu lill-għalliem.
formal.en: The student typed the report on the computer and sent it to the teacher.
formal.zh: 那名学生在电脑上打好报告，并将其发给了老师。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ittajpja ismek hawn, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Tajjeb. Għandi ndaħħal il-kunjom ukoll?
colloquial.en: Sara: Type your name here, please. Mark: Okay. Should I enter my surname too?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：请在这里键入你的名字。马克：好的。姓也要输入吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (接待员)
messages.zh: 请在这里键入你的名字。
messages.en: Type your name here, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 好的。姓也要输入吗？
messages.en: Okay. Should I enter my surname too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指逐个按键、屏幕逐字出现文字的过程，把 ittajpja 与“键盘输入”这一动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To want something to happen and believe that it is possible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希望某事发生，并认为它有可能实现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li tixtieq li tiġri xi ħaġa u temmen li tista' sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；怀着某件事可能如愿发生的期待。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li jkollok ix-xewqa li sseħħ xi ħaġa tajba u temmen li hemm il-possibbiltà li sseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you hope that something will happen, you want it to happen and think it is possible.

formal.mt: Wara l-intervista, Pawlu ttama li jirċievi offerta ta' xogħol.
formal.en: After the interview, Pawlu hoped to receive a job offer.
formal.zh: 面试结束后，保罗希望能收到录用通知。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nittama li għada ma tagħmilx xita. Lara: Jien ukoll! Nixtieq immur il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow. Lara: Me too! I'd like to go to the beach.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我希望明天别下雨。拉拉：我也是！我想去海边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nittama li għada ma tagħmilx xita.
messages.mt_standard: Nittama li għada ma tagħmilx xita.
messages.zh: 我希望明天别下雨。
messages.en: I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也是！我想去海边。
messages.en: Me too! I'd like to go to the beach.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“希望明天晴天”的心情与 Nittama li… 一起练习：心里期待好结果，但结果还没有确定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone want to have or do something, especially something they might otherwise avoid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人想得到某物或做某事，尤指原本可能会克制或避免的事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li tqanqal f'xi ħadd ix-xewqa li jkollu jew jagħmel xi ħaġa, speċjalment xi ħaġa li normalment jipprova jevita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诱惑；引诱；使人产生想要某物或做某事的欲望。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li tħajjar lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel jew jieħu xi ħaġa billi tqanqal fih ix-xewqa għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something tempts you, it makes you want to have it or do it, even if you have reasons to resist.

formal.mt: Ir-reklam ittanta lill-klijenti bi skont kbir fuq il-prodotti kollha.
formal.en: The advertisement tempted customers with a large discount on all products.
formal.zh: 这则广告以全场商品的大幅折扣吸引顾客。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-kejk qed jittantani, imma diġà kilt biżżejjed. Mark: Nistgħu nħallu biċċa għal għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: That cake is tempting me, but I've already eaten enough. Mark: We can save a slice for tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个蛋糕真让我心动，可我已经吃够了。马克：我们可以留一块明天吃。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kejk qed jittantani, imma diġà kilt biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kejk qed jittantani, imma diġà kilt biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 那个蛋糕真让我心动，可我已经吃够了。
messages.en: That cake is tempting me, but I've already eaten enough.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们可以留一块明天吃。
messages.en: We can save a slice for tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象已经吃饱却仍被蛋糕吸引的场景，把 ittanta 记成“让人心动、忍不住想要”的诱惑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look briefly through an opening or from behind something, sometimes without being noticed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从开口、缝隙或遮挡物后短暂地向外看，有时带有不让别人察觉的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan ifisser li wieħed iħares għal ftit minn fetħa jew minn wara xi ħaġa, xi drabi mingħajr ma ħaddieħor jinduna bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从缝隙、开口或遮挡物后探头看；窥看。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan ifisser li wieħed iħares għal ftit minn fetħa jew minn wara xi ħaġa biex jara x'hemm, spiss mingħajr ma jidher.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you peep, you look briefly through an opening or from behind something, often trying not to be noticed.

formal.mt: It-tifel ittawwal minn wara l-bieb biex jara min kien wasal.
formal.en: The boy peeped from behind the door to see who had arrived.
formal.zh: 男孩从门后探头看，想知道是谁来了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ittawwal minn wara l-bieb? Pawlu: Ħija ż-żgħir. Ried jara min ġie.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who peeped from behind the door? Pawlu: My little brother. He wanted to see who had come.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：刚才是谁从门后探头看？保罗：我弟弟。他想看看是谁来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才是谁从门后探头看？
messages.en: Who peeped from behind the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ż-żgħir. Ried jara min ġie.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ż-żgħir. Ried jara min ġie.
messages.zh: 我弟弟。他想看看是谁来了。
messages.en: My little brother. He wanted to see who had come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ittawwal 和“门后露出一双眼睛”的画面绑定：重点记住从遮挡处短暂探看，而不是长时间观看。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To check something by trying it or examining it to find out how well it works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过试用、检查或测量，判断某事物是否正常、有效或符合要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan ifisser li wieħed jipprova jew jeżamina xi ħaġa biex jara jekk taħdimx tajjeb jew tissodisfax ċerti rekwiżiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过试验、检查或测量来测试、检验某事物的性能、质量或状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan ifisser li wieħed jagħmel prova jew eżami ta' xi ħaġa biex isir jaf il-kwalità tagħha, kif taħdem jew jekk għandhiex xi problema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you test something, you try it or examine it carefully to find out how well it works or whether it meets particular requirements.

formal.mt: It-tekniku ittestja s-sistema qabel ma bdiet tintuża fl-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The technician tested the system before it began to be used in the office.
formal.zh: 技术人员在办公室开始使用该系统之前，对它进行了测试。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tekniku ittestja l-apparat? Mark: Iva, u qal li kollox jaħdem tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the technician test the equipment? Mark: Yes, and he said everything works properly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：技术人员测试过设备了吗？马克：测过了，他说一切都运转正常。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 技术人员测试过设备了吗？
messages.en: Did the technician test the equipment?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u qal li kollox jaħdem tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u qal li kollox jaħdem tajjeb.
messages.zh: 测过了，他说一切都运转正常。
messages.en: Yes, and he said everything works properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ittestja 放进“先测试设备，再正式使用”的步骤中记忆；词中的 test 也可以作为联系英语 test 的拼写提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of trying a product or service with potential customers to assess their response before a wider launch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在更大范围推出产品或服务之前，向潜在顾客试行展示或销售，以评估市场反应的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan huwa proċess li fih prodott jew servizz jiġi ppruvat ma' klijenti potenzjali biex titkejjel ir-reazzjoni tagħhom qabel ma jiġi offrut fuq skala akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场测试：在有限范围内向潜在顾客试推产品或服务，以评估需求和反应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa l-proċess li bih negozju jipprova prodott jew servizz ma' grupp ta' klijenti potenzjali biex jifhem id-domanda u r-reazzjoni tagħhom qabel tnedija usa'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market testing is the process of offering a product or service to a limited group of potential customers to assess demand and reactions before a wider launch.

formal.mt: L-ittestjar tas-suq għen lill-kumpanija tifhem ir-reazzjoni tal-klijenti qabel it-tnedija tal-prodott fuq skala akbar.
formal.en: Market testing helped the company understand customer reactions before launching the product on a larger scale.
formal.zh: 市场测试帮助公司在更大范围推出产品之前了解顾客的反应。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sejjer l-ittestjar tas-suq? David: Tajjeb. Il-klijenti għoġobhom il-prodott, imma xi wħud qalu li l-prezz għoli.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is the market testing going? David: Well. Customers liked the product, but some said the price was high.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：市场测试进展如何？戴维：挺好。顾客喜欢这个产品，不过有些人说价格偏高。

messages.speaker: Marija (项目负责人)
messages.zh: 市场测试进展如何？
messages.en: How is the market testing going?

messages.speaker: David (市场部同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb. Il-klijenti għoġobhom il-prodott, imma xi wħud qalu li l-prezz għoli.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb. Il-klijenti għoġobhom il-prodott, imma xi wħud qalu li l-prezz għoli.
messages.zh: 挺好。顾客喜欢这个产品，不过有些人说价格偏高。
messages.en: Well. Customers liked the product, but some said the price was high.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进“小范围试推产品，观察顾客反应”的场景中记忆：ittestjar 是测试，tas-suq 把测试限定到市场。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To open your mouth wide and take a deep breath involuntarily, often because you are tired or bored.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不由自主地张大嘴并深吸一口气，即打哈欠，常见于疲倦或无聊时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan ifisser li wieħed jiftaħ ħalqu beraħ u jieħu nifs twil mingħajr ma jkun irid, spiss għax ikun għajjien jew imdejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打哈欠：不由自主地张大嘴并深吸气，通常出现在困倦、疲劳或无聊时。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan ifisser li wieħed jiftaħ ħalqu beraħ u jieħu nifs twil b'mod involontarju, ġeneralment meta jkun għajjien, bi ngħas jew imdejjaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you yawn, you open your mouth wide and take a deep breath involuntarily, usually because you feel tired, sleepy, or bored.

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-istudent ittewweb għax ma kienx raqad biżżejjed il-lejl ta' qabel.
formal.en: During the lesson, the student yawned because he had not slept enough the night before.
formal.zh: 上课时，这名学生打了个哈欠，因为他前一晚睡得不够。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex it-tifel ittewweb? Mark: Għax hu għajjien. Wasal il-ħin li jorqod.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the boy yawn? Mark: Because he is tired. It is time for him to go to sleep.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：孩子为什么打哈欠？马克：因为他累了。该睡觉了。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子为什么打哈欠？
messages.en: Why did the boy yawn?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu għajjien. Wasal il-ħin li jorqod.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu għajjien. Wasal il-ħin li jorqod.
messages.zh: 因为他累了。该睡觉了。
messages.en: Because he is tired. It is time for him to go to sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 ittewweb 时，想象困倦的孩子张大嘴打哈欠；用“疲倦—张嘴—深吸气”的动作顺序帮助记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To accept or put up with behaviour or conditions that you dislike or find unpleasant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对于自己不喜欢、不赞同或感到不适的行为或状况，仍予以容忍或忍受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taċċetta jew tissaporti mġiba jew sitwazzjoni anke jekk idejqek jew ma taqbilx magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容忍或忍受不喜欢、不赞同或令人不适的行为、事物或状况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tissaporti mġiba, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni li ma togħġbokx, mingħajr ma twaqqafha jew tipprotesta kontriha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tolerate something, you allow it to continue or put up with it despite finding it unpleasant or disagreeable.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ittollera dewmien qasir minħabba problema teknika.
formal.en: The committee tolerated a short delay because of a technical problem.
formal.zh: 由于出现技术问题，委员会容忍了短暂的延误。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kien hemm ħafna storbju fil-klassi lbieraħ? David: Iva, iżda l-għalliem ittollera l-istorbju għal ftit minuti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was there a lot of noise in class yesterday? David: Yes, but the teacher tolerated the noise for a few minutes.
colloquial.zh: Nina：昨天班里很吵吗？David：是的，不过老师容忍了几分钟的吵闹。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna storbju fil-klassi lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna storbju fil-klassi lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 昨天班里很吵吗？
messages.en: Was there a lot of noise in class yesterday?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda l-għalliem ittollera l-istorbju għal ftit minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda l-għalliem ittollera l-istorbju għal ftit minuti.
messages.zh: 是的，不过老师容忍了几分钟的吵闹。
messages.en: Yes, but the teacher tolerated the noise for a few minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师听着吵闹声仍暂时忍耐，把画面配上 ittollera l-istorbju；记住容忍并不表示喜欢，例句中的 ittollera 表示他容忍了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone severe physical pain or mental distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人遭受强烈的身体痛苦或精神折磨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikkawża lil xi ħadd uġigħ fiżiku qawwi jew tbatija mentali kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人遭受强烈的肉体痛苦或精神折磨。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd ibati ħafna, fiżikament jew mentalment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something torments a person, they cause that person severe physical pain or mental suffering.

formal.mt: L-uġigħ fid-dahar ittormenta lill-pazjent għal diversi ġimgħat u fixkillu l-irqad.
formal.en: The back pain tormented the patient for several weeks and disturbed his sleep.
formal.zh: 背痛折磨了这名患者好几个星期，影响了他的睡眠。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher daqshekk għajjien? Pawlu: L-uġigħ fis-snien ittormentani l-lejl kollu. Maja: Nispera li tħossok aħjar illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look so tired? Pawlu: The toothache tormented me all night. Maja: I hope you feel better today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么看起来这么累？保罗：牙痛折磨了我一整夜。玛雅：希望你今天能好受一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么看起来这么累？
messages.en: Why do you look so tired?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 牙痛折磨了我一整夜。
messages.en: The toothache tormented me all night.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 希望你今天能好受一些。
messages.en: I hope you feel better today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ittormenta 配上一幅“牙痛让人整夜睡不着”的画面，记住它表示折磨，可用于身体疼痛，也可用于精神痛苦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act disloyally towards someone or violate the trust they have placed in you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做出不忠于某人的行为，辜负对方的信任或出卖对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taġixxi mingħajr lealtà lejn xi ħadd jew tikser il-fiduċja li jkun qiegħed fik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 背叛某人，违背其信任或将其出卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tikser il-fiduċja ta' xi ħadd billi taġixxi kontrih jew tagħti informazzjoni dwaru lil min jista' jagħmillu l-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you betray someone, you act disloyally towards them or break the trust they have placed in you.

formal.mt: L-impjegat ittradixxa l-fiduċja tal-kollegi tiegħu meta għadda l-informazzjoni kunfidenzjali lil kumpanija rivali.
formal.en: The employee betrayed his colleagues' trust when he passed confidential information to a rival company.
formal.zh: 这名员工把机密信息交给竞争公司，辜负了同事们的信任。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex m'għadekx tafda lil Mark? Nina: Ittradixxa l-fiduċja tiegħi u qal is-sigriet tiegħi lil kulħadd. Lara: Issa nifhem għaliex int imweġġgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you trust Mark anymore? Nina: He betrayed my trust and told everyone my secret. Lara: Now I understand why you're hurt.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不再信任马克了？妮娜：他辜负了我的信任，把我的秘密告诉了所有人。拉拉：现在我明白你为什么这么受伤了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不再信任马克了？
messages.en: Why don't you trust Mark anymore?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ittradixxa l-fiduċja tiegħi u qal is-sigriet tiegħi lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ittradixxa l-fiduċja tiegħi u qal is-sigriet tiegħi lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 他辜负了我的信任，把我的秘密告诉了所有人。
messages.en: He betrayed my trust and told everyone my secret.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在我明白你为什么这么受伤了。
messages.en: Now I understand why you're hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ittradixxa 与“把朋友托付的秘密说出去”联系起来，抓住“破坏信任、背叛对方”的核心意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To trade or transport goods or people illegally, including moving goods secretly across borders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非法交易或运送货物、人员，也可指秘密将货物运过边境以逃避检查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinnegozja jew tittrasporta merkanzija jew persuni illegalment, jew tgħaddi merkanzija bil-moħbi minn fruntiera biex tevita l-kontrolli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非法贩卖或运送货物、人员；从事非法贩运。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tinnegozja jew tittrasporta merkanzija jew persuni b'mod illegali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone traffics in goods or people, they take part in the illegal trade or movement of them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秘密将货物或人员带入、带出某地，尤其指逃避边境或海关检查的走私行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iddaħħal jew toħroġ merkanzija jew persuni bil-moħbi minn pajjiż jew post ieħor, bi ksur tal-liġi jew biex tevita l-kontrolli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone smuggles goods or people, they move them secretly into or out of a place in violation of the law.

collocations.mt: ittraffika s-sigaretti minn pajjiż għal ieħor
collocations.en: smuggled cigarettes from one country to another
collocations.zh: 将香烟从一个国家走私到另一个国家

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-grupp ittraffika s-sigaretti minn pajjiż għal ieħor mingħajr ma ddikjarahom lid-dwana.
formal.en: According to the report, the group smuggled cigarettes from one country to another without declaring them to customs.
formal.zh: 据报告，该团伙将香烟从一个国家走私到另一个国家，没有向海关申报。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex arrestawh? Toni: Skont l-aħbarijiet, ittraffika d-droga. Maja: Dik hi akkuża serja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did they arrest him? Toni: According to the news, he trafficked drugs. Maja: That's a serious accusation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么逮捕他？托尼：据新闻报道，他贩运了毒品。玛雅：那可是很严重的指控。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么逮捕他？
messages.en: Why did they arrest him?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 据新闻报道，他贩运了毒品。
messages.en: According to the news, he trafficked drugs.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那可是很严重的指控。
messages.en: That's a serious accusation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记 ittraffika：非法交易对应“贩运”，偷偷越境对应“走私”；读句子时留意交易与过境的语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move a plant to a new growing place or transfer an organ or tissue to another part of the body or another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把植物移到另一处栽种，或把器官、组织移入另一身体部位或另一个人的体内。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċċaqlaq pjanta biex tħawwelha f'post ieħor, jew tittrasferixxi organu jew tessut għal parti oħra tal-ġisem jew għal ġisem ta' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移栽植物；通过手术将器官或组织移植到另一部位或另一个人的体内。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tneħħi pjanta minn fejn tkun qed tikber u tħawwelha band'oħra, jew tittrasferixxi organu jew tessut minn post għal ieħor fil-ġisem jew bejn persuni permezz ta' operazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you transplant a plant, organ, or tissue, you move it to a new place where it can continue to grow or function.

collocations.en: transplanted a tree into the garden
collocations.zh: 把一棵树移栽到了花园里

formal.mt: It-tim kirurġiku ittrapjanta kilwa mingħand donatur fil-ġisem tal-pazjent.
formal.en: The surgical team transplanted a kidney from a donor into the patient's body.
formal.zh: 外科团队将捐献者的一枚肾脏移植到了患者体内。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn marret is-siġra li kienet fil-borma? Mark: Il-ġardinar ittrapjantaha fil-ġnien dalgħodu. Sara: Issa għandha aktar spazju biex tikber.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did the tree that was in the pot go? Mark: The gardener transplanted it into the garden this morning. Sara: Now it has more room to grow.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：原来盆里的那棵树去哪儿了？马克：园丁今天早上把它移栽到花园里了。萨拉：现在它有更大的生长空间了。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn marret is-siġra li kienet fil-borma?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn marret is-siġra li kienet fil-borma?
messages.zh: 原来盆里的那棵树去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the tree that was in the pot go?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 园丁今天早上把它移栽到花园里了。
messages.en: The gardener transplanted it into the garden this morning.

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa għandha aktar spazju biex tikber.
messages.mt_standard: Issa għandha aktar spazju biex tikber.
messages.zh: 现在它有更大的生长空间了。
messages.en: Now it has more room to grow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把盆里的小树搬到花园继续生长，用这个画面记住 ittrapjanta 的“移植”；再联系医院里的器官移植。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move someone or something from one place, position, or account to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或事物从一个地点、职位或账户转到另一个。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed persuna jew ħaġa f'post, kariga jew kont ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将人或事物转移至另一地点、岗位或账户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq persuna jew ħaġa minn post, kariga jew kont għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone transfers a person or thing, they move that person or thing from one place or position to another.

collocations.en: transferred an employee to another office
collocations.zh: 把一名员工调到了另一个办公室

formal.mt: L-amministratur ittrasferixxa l-fajls kollha għal kompjuter ġdid.
formal.en: The administrator transferred all the files to a new computer.
formal.zh: 管理员把所有文件转移到了一台新电脑上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn huma l-fajls tar-ritratti? Mark: Pawlu ittrasferixxa l-fajls għal kompjuter ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are the photo files? Mark: Pawlu transferred the files to another computer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片文件在哪里？Mark：Pawlu把文件转移到另一台电脑上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片文件在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the photo files?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ittrasferixxa l-fajls għal kompjuter ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ittrasferixxa l-fajls għal kompjuter ieħor.
messages.zh: Pawlu把文件转移到另一台电脑上了。
messages.en: Pawlu transferred the files to another computer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把文件从旧电脑拖到新电脑，用“原处→新处”的箭头记住转移义；例句中的 ittrasferixxa 表示他已经转移了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move something from one location or account to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物从一处转到另一处，或把资金转入另一个账户。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq xi ħaġa minn post għal ieħor jew jgħaddi flus minn kont għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某物转至另一处，或将资金转至另一个账户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħaddi xi ħaġa minn post għal ieħor, jew flus minn kont għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone transfers something, they move it to a different location or account.

collocations.en: transferred the documents to another office
collocations.zh: 把文件转送到了另一个办公室

formal.mt: Il-kaxxier ittrasfiera l-flus fil-kont tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The cashier transferred the money into the company's account.
formal.zh: 出纳把钱转入了公司的账户。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-flus għadhom fil-kont il-qadim? Toni: Le, Pawlu ittrasfiera l-flus fil-kont il-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the money still in the old account? Toni: No, Pawlu transferred the money into the new account.
colloquial.zh: Lara：钱还在旧账户里吗？Toni：不，Pawlu把钱转进新账户了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 钱还在旧账户里吗？
messages.en: Is the money still in the old account?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Pawlu ittrasfiera l-flus fil-kont il-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Pawlu ittrasfiera l-flus fil-kont il-ġdid.
messages.zh: 不，Pawlu把钱转进新账户了。
messages.en: No, Pawlu transferred the money into the new account.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用旧账户和新账户画两个方框，再画资金流向的箭头；把 ittrasfiera l-flus 整块记成“他转了款”，帮助记住转移义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry people or goods from one place to another, usually in a vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常借助车辆等交通工具，把人员或货物从一地运送到另一地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġorr nies jew merkanzija minn post għal ieħor, normalment permezz ta' vettura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用交通工具等把人或货物运送至另一地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġorr persuni jew oġġetti minn post għal ieħor bl-użu ta' mezz ta' trasport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone transports people or goods, they carry them from one place to another, usually in a vehicle.

formal.mt: Ix-xufier ittrasporta l-merkanzija mill-port sal-maħżen.
formal.en: The driver transported the goods from the port to the warehouse.
formal.zh: 司机把货物从港口运到了仓库。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif waslu l-kaxxi fil-ħanut? Samwel: Toni ittrasporta l-kaxxi bil-vann tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did the boxes get to the shop? Samwel: Toni transported the boxes in his van.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些箱子是怎么运到店里的？Samwel：Toni用他的面包车把箱子运来了。

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.zh: 这些箱子是怎么运到店里的？
messages.en: How did the boxes get to the shop?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.zh: Toni用他的面包车把箱子运来了。
messages.en: Toni transported the boxes in his van.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一辆装满箱子的货车从港口驶向仓库，把“车辆＋货物＋目的地”连成画面，记住 ittrasporta 的运送义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave towards someone in a particular way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以某种态度或方式对待某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu ma' xi ħadd b'mod partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以某种方式对待某人，体现出相应的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Juri attitudni partikolari lejn persuna permezz tal-mod kif iġib ruħu magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone treats a person in a particular way, they behave towards that person in that way.

collocations.en: treated everyone in the same way
collocations.zh: 以同样的方式对待了所有人

formal.mt: Il-maniġer ittratta lill-impjegati kollha b'rispett waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The manager treated all the employees with respect during the meeting.
formal.zh: 经理在会议期间尊重地对待了所有员工。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret fil-ħanut? Lara: Tajjeb ħafna. Il-bejjiegħ ittratta lili u lil ommi b'rispett.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did it go at the shop? Lara: Very well. The shop assistant treated me and my mother with respect.
colloquial.zh: Maja：在店里怎么样？Lara：很好。售货员对我和我妈妈都很尊重。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 在店里怎么样？
messages.en: How did it go at the shop?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna. Il-bejjiegħ ittratta lili u lil ommi b'rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna. Il-bejjiegħ ittratta lili u lil ommi b'rispett.
messages.zh: 很好。售货员对我和我妈妈都很尊重。
messages.en: Very well. The shop assistant treated me and my mother with respect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ittratta 放进“他怎样对待别人”的情景，再接 b'rispett“带着尊重”；用“对待谁＋怎样对待”记住句子结构。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move at a steady trotting pace, especially of a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指马等动物以小跑的步态前进，速度通常介于步行和奔跑之间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi bit-trott, speċjalment żiemel, b'pass regolari aktar mgħaġġel mill-mixi u aktar bil-mod mill-galopp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小跑；尤指马以比步行快、比奔跑慢的规则步态前进。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jimxi b'pass regolari bit-trott, kif jagħmel żiemel meta jimxi aktar malajr mill-mixi iżda aktar bil-mod mill-galopp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a horse trots, it moves with regular steps at a pace faster than a walk but slower than a gallop.

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, iż-żiemel ittrottja tul il-mogħdija taħt is-superviżjoni tal-għalliem.
formal.en: During training, the horse trotted along the path under the instructor's supervision.
formal.zh: 训练时，马在教练的监督下沿着小路小跑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Iż-żiemel ġera sal-bieb? Toni: Le, ittrottja biss. Ma kienx sejjer malajr ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the horse run to the gate? Toni: No, it only trotted. It wasn't going very fast.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：那匹马是跑到大门口的吗？托尼：不是，只是小跑过去，速度并不很快。

messages.speaker: Lara (骑马学员)
messages.zh: 那匹马是跑到大门口的吗？
messages.en: Did the horse run to the gate?

messages.speaker: Toni (骑马教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ittrottja biss. Ma kienx sejjer malajr ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ittrottja biss. Ma kienx sejjer malajr ħafna.
messages.zh: 不是，只是小跑过去，速度并不很快。
messages.en: No, it only trotted. It wasn't going very fast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ittrottja 时想象马蹄有节奏地轻快落地，把这个词固定在“马小跑”的动作画面上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electronic message sent from one email address to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子邮件系统从一个邮箱地址发送到另一个邮箱地址的电子信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Messaġġ elettroniku li jintbagħat minn indirizz tal-posta elettronika għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子邮件；通过电子邮件系统收发的信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Messaġġ li jintbagħat jew jiġi riċevut permezz ta' sistema tal-posta elettronika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An email is an electronic message that you send to someone using an email address.

formal.mt: Biex titlob aktar informazzjoni dwar il-kors, tista' tibgħat ittrè lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: To request more information about the course, you can send an email to the office.
formal.zh: 如需了解课程的更多信息，可以向办公室发送电子邮件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nibgħatlek ir-ritratti? Pawlu: Ibgħatli ittrè u ehmeż ir-ritratti miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How should I send you the photos? Pawlu: Send me an email and attach the photos to it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片怎么发给你？保罗：给我发封电子邮件，把照片作为附件加上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片怎么发给你？
messages.en: How should I send you the photos?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibgħatli ittrè u ehmeż ir-ritratti miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ibgħatli ittrè u ehmeż ir-ritratti miegħu.
messages.zh: 给我发封电子邮件，把照片作为附件加上。
messages.en: Send me an email and attach the photos to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ittrè 放进“写邮件、发邮件、收邮件”三个连续画面中记忆，并特别留意词尾的 è。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force someone to leave their country or home as a punishment, or to remove someone officially from a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强迫某人离开其国家或家园，作为放逐的惩罚；也指由当局将某人驱逐出境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlaq minn pajjiżu jew minn daru bħala kastig, jew tneħħih uffiċjalment minn pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放逐；强迫某人离开其国家或家园，通常作为惩罚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil persuna titlaq minn pajjiżha jew minn darha u tgħix 'il bogħod bħala kastig.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an authority exiles someone, it forces that person to leave their country or home as a punishment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驱逐出境；由当局正式将某人遣送出某个国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tneħħi persuna uffiċjalment minn pajjiż u ġġegħelha titlaq lejn pajjiż ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an authority deports someone, it officially removes that person from the country.

collocations.en: deported the person from the country

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif ir-reġim itturufna lill-avversarju politiku u ġiegħlu jgħix barra minn pajjiżu.
formal.en: The report describes how the regime exiled its political opponent and forced him to live outside his country.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该政权如何放逐政治对手，迫使他在国外生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma setax jibqa' f'pajjiżu? Mark: Għax ir-reġim itturufna lil dak ir-raġel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why couldn't he stay in his country? Mark: Because the regime exiled that man.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么不能留在自己的国家？马克：因为那个政权把那个人放逐了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么不能留在自己的国家？
messages.en: Why couldn't he stay in his country?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ir-reġim itturufna lil dak ir-raġel.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ir-reġim itturufna lil dak ir-raġel.
messages.zh: 因为那个政权把那个人放逐了。
messages.en: Because the regime exiled that man.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“被迫离开国境”的画面记忆：着重惩罚时理解为放逐，着重当局遣送出境时理解为驱逐出境。

gloss_zh: 所给释义为“我当时正试图弄清楚”；与所标形容词词性不一致

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied gloss expresses a speaker's past attempt to find something out, although it does not provide an adjective meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给释义表达说话者过去正在尝试查明某事；该释义是完整的动词性表达，不能据此确定所标形容词的含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija tesprimi li l-kelliem kien qed jipprova jsir jaf xi ħaġa, iżda ma tagħtix tifsira ta' aġġettiv.

sense_translations.en_definition: I was trying to find out
sense_translations.zh_definition: 我当时正试图弄清楚或查明某事；这一释义本身不表示形容词意义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelliem jgħid li f'dak il-ħin kien qed jipprova jsir jaf jew jiskopri xi ħaġa; din hija espressjoni verbali u mhux tifsira ta' aġġettiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A speaker who says this means that they were making an effort to discover some information.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'itturufnati' hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv, iżda t-tifsira mogħtija, 'I was trying to find out', tesprimi tentattiv tal-kelliem biex isir jaf xi ħaġa.
formal.en: The entry 'itturufnati' is marked as an adjective, but its supplied gloss, 'I was trying to find out', expresses the speaker's attempt to obtain information.
formal.zh: 词条“itturufnati”被标为形容词，但所给释义“I was trying to find out”表达的是说话者试图获取信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nuża 'itturufnati' bħala aġġettiv skont din it-tifsira? Pawlu: Din it-tifsira ma turix kif jintuża bħala aġġettiv; għandna bżonn eżempju ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I use 'itturufnati' as an adjective based on this meaning? Pawlu: This meaning doesn't show how it is used as an adjective; we need a clear example.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：根据这个释义，我能把“itturufnati”当形容词用吗？保罗：这个释义没有展示它怎样作形容词使用；我们需要一个清楚的例句。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża 'itturufnati' bħala aġġettiv skont din it-tifsira?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża 'itturufnati' bħala aġġettiv skont din it-tifsira?
messages.zh: 根据这个释义，我能把“itturufnati”当形容词用吗？
messages.en: Can I use 'itturufnati' as an adjective based on this meaning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tifsira ma turix kif jintuża bħala aġġettiv; għandna bżonn eżempju ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tifsira ma turix kif jintuża bħala aġġettiv; għandna bżonn eżempju ċar.
messages.zh: 这个释义没有展示它怎样作形容词使用；我们需要一个清楚的例句。
messages.en: This meaning doesn't show how it is used as an adjective; we need a clear example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把所给英文理解为“我当时正试图查明”，并记下词性与释义不一致；不要把整句英文直接套成形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hard, pale material that forms elephants' tusks and is used to make decorative objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成大象长牙的坚硬、浅色材料，可用于制作装饰物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal iebes u ta' lewn ċar li jifforma s-snien twal tal-iljunfanti u jintuża biex isiru oġġetti dekorattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 象牙；构成大象长牙的坚硬、浅色材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal iebes u ta' lewn ċar mis-snien twal tal-iljunfanti, li jista' jinħadem f'oġġetti dekorattivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ivory is the hard, pale substance in elephants' tusks, which can be carved into decorative objects.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi oġġett tal-ivorju b'tinqix fin fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum catalogue describes an ivory object with fine carving on its surface.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录描述了一件表面带有精细雕刻的象牙制品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-figura tal-injam? Mark: Le, skont it-tikketta hija tal-ivorju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this figure made of wood? Mark: No, according to the label, it's made of ivory.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个小雕像是木头做的吗？马克：不是，标签上说它是象牙做的。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这个小雕像是木头做的吗？
messages.en: Is this figure made of wood?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，标签上说它是象牙做的。
messages.en: No, according to the label, it's made of ivory.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ivorju 与英文 ivory 配对记忆，再想象博物馆里浅色的象牙雕件；这里记的是材料名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To allow fresh air to enter and circulate through a room or another enclosed space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使新鲜空气进入房间或其他封闭空间并流通，从而通风换气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħalli arja friska tidħol u tiċċirkola f'kamra jew fi spazju magħluq ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使通风；让新鲜空气进入某个空间并流通。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iddaħħal arja friska f'kamra jew fi spazju magħluq u tħalliha tiċċirkola biex l-arja tinbidel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you ventilate a room, you allow fresh air to enter it and circulate.

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, il-ħaddiem ivventila s-sala billi fetaħ it-twieqi biex tidħol arja friska.
formal.en: Before the meeting, the worker ventilated the hall by opening the windows to let fresh air in.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，工作人员打开窗户，让新鲜空气进入，给大厅通风。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min fetaħ it-twieqi kollha? Mark: Pawlu fetaħhom u ivventila l-kamra; issa hawn arja friska.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who opened all the windows? Mark: Pawlu opened them and ventilated the room; there's fresh air in here now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把窗户全打开了？马克：保罗打开的，他给房间通了风；现在这里有新鲜空气了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把窗户全打开了？
messages.en: Who opened all the windows?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu fetaħhom u ivventila l-kamra; issa hawn arja friska.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu fetaħhom u ivventila l-kamra; issa hawn arja friska.
messages.zh: 保罗打开的，他给房间通了风；现在这里有新鲜空气了。
messages.en: Pawlu opened them and ventilated the room; there's fresh air in here now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ivventila 与英文 ventilate 并排记忆，脑中配上“打开窗户，让空气流动”的动作画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To check whether information or a claim is correct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过检查资料或证据，确认信息或说法是否正确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċekkja informazzjoni jew stqarrija biex jikkonferma jekk hijiex korretta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 核实信息、说法或事实是否正确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jeżamina informazzjoni, stqarrija jew fatt biex jikkonferma jekk huwiex korrett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you verify something, you check it carefully to establish whether it is correct.

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal ivverifika d-dettalji kollha qabel approva l-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The officer verified all the details before approving the application.
formal.zh: 工作人员在批准申请之前核实了所有细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ivverifika l-indirizz qabel titlaq. Mark: Tajjeb, se niċċekkjah mal-messaġġ li bagħtuli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Check the address before you leave. Mark: Okay, I'll check it against the message they sent me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：出发前核实一下地址。马克：好，我会对照他们发给我的消息核对。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 出发前核实一下地址。
messages.en: Check the address before you leave.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se niċċekkjah mal-messaġġ li bagħtuli.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se niċċekkjah mal-messaġġ li bagħtuli.
messages.zh: 好，我会对照他们发给我的消息核对。
messages.en: Okay, I'll check it against the message they sent me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ivverifika 和“出发前核对地址”的画面绑定：拿出消息逐项检查，就是“核实”。

gloss_zh: 使养成习惯；使自己养成习惯

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone, including oneself, to develop a habit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或自己通过反复的行为或经历养成某种习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lilu nnifsu jidra jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jistenna xi ħaġa regolarment.

sense_translations.en_definition: to inculcate a habit in sb. or oneself
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使他人或自己养成某种习惯。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Idaħħal drawwa f'xi ħadd jew fih innifsu permezz ta' mġiba jew esperjenzi ripetuti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you inculcate a habit in someone or yourself, you cause that habit to develop through repetition.

collocations.en: get the boy into the habit of having sweets
collocations.zh: 使男孩养成吃糖果的习惯

collocations.en: get himself into the habit of drinking coffee
collocations.zh: 使自己养成喝咖啡的习惯

formal.mt: Billi tah rigal kuljum, il-missier ivvizzja lit-tifel jistenna rigal għal kull biċċa xogħol li jagħmel.
formal.en: By giving him a present every day, the father got the boy into the habit of expecting a present for every task he completed.
formal.zh: 父亲每天都给男孩礼物，使他养成了每做完一件事就期待礼物的习惯。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex it-tifel dejjem jitlob il-ħelu meta jiġi hawn? Pawlu: In-nannu ivvizzjah; jagħtih biċċa ħelwa kull darba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the boy always ask for sweets when he comes here? Pawlu: His grandfather got him into the habit; he gives him a sweet every time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么这孩子每次来这里都要糖吃？保罗：爷爷让他养成了这个习惯，每次都给他一颗糖。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tifel dejjem jitlob il-ħelu meta jiġi hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tifel dejjem jitlob il-ħelu meta jiġi hawn?
messages.zh: 为什么这孩子每次来这里都要糖吃？
messages.en: Why does the boy always ask for sweets when he comes here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu ivvizzjah; jagħtih biċċa ħelwa kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu ivvizzjah; jagħtih biċċa ħelwa kull darba.
messages.zh: 爷爷让他养成了这个习惯，每次都给他一颗糖。
messages.en: His grandfather got him into the habit; he gives him a sweet every time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“每次来都给糖，后来每次来都要糖”的连续画面记 ivvizzja，重点是让习惯逐渐形成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring food or liquid from the stomach out through the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃里的食物或液体经口排出，即呕吐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ mill-ħalq ikel jew likwidu li jkun fl-istonku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呕吐，使胃内的食物或液体经口排出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Joħroġ mill-ħalq il-kontenut tal-istonku, bħal ikel jew likwidu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone vomits, food or liquid from their stomach comes out through their mouth.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吐了；把胃里的东西吐出来，是“呕吐”的日常说法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Itella' u joħroġ mill-ħalq dak li jkun fl-istonku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone throws up, they bring the contents of their stomach out through their mouth.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent ivvomta darbtejn matul il-lejl, skont ir-rapport tal-infermier.
formal.en: According to the nurse's report, the patient vomited twice during the night.
formal.zh: 根据护士的报告，患者夜间呕吐了两次。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu ħuk issa? Ben: Aħjar, imma dalgħodu ivvomta fuq ix-xarabank.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is your brother now? Ben: Better, but he threw up on the bus this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你哥哥现在怎么样？本：好些了，不过他今天早上在公交车上吐了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥现在怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother now?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar, imma dalgħodu ivvomta fuq ix-xarabank.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar, imma dalgħodu ivvomta fuq ix-xarabank.
messages.zh: 好些了，不过他今天早上在公交车上吐了。
messages.en: Better, but he threw up on the bus this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ivvomta 放进“坐车不舒服，最后吐了”的场景；英语 vomit 和 throw up 都对应这里的呕吐动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express a choice formally in an election or a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在选举或集体决策中，通过投票正式表达自己的选择。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi l-għażla tiegħu b'vot f'elezzjoni jew meta tittieħed deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在选举或表决中投票，表达支持、反对或其他选择。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti vot biex jagħżel kandidat jew jesprimi l-pożizzjoni tiegħu dwar proposta jew deċiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you vote, you formally express your choice in an election or a decision.

collocations.en: vote in favour of the proposal

formal.mt: Wara d-diskussjoni, kull membru tal-kumitat ivvota favur jew kontra l-proposta.
formal.en: After the discussion, each committee member voted for or against the proposal.
formal.zh: 讨论结束后，委员会每位成员都就该提议投了赞成票或反对票。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Missierek mar jivvota llum? Mark: Iva, ivvota dalgħodu qabel mar għax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did your father go to vote today? Mark: Yes, he voted this morning before going to work.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你爸爸今天去投票了吗？马克：去了，他今天早上上班前就投了票。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸今天去投票了吗？
messages.en: Did your father go to vote today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ivvota dalgħodu qabel mar għax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ivvota dalgħodu qabel mar għax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 去了，他今天早上上班前就投了票。
messages.en: Yes, he voted this morning before going to work.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe something dreadful that causes strong fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述十分可怕、使人产生强烈恐惧的事物。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十分可怕的；令人感到恐惧的。

formal.zh: 黑暗中的声音令人恐惧，因为没有人知道它来自哪里。

gloss_zh: 沙拉村（戈佐岛上的村庄）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a village on the island of Gozo.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' raħal li jinsab fuq il-gżira ta' Għawdex.

sense_translations.en_definition: Xagħra, a village on the island of Gozo
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙拉村，位于戈佐岛上的一座村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-Xagħra hija raħal li jinsab fuq il-gżira ta' Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Xagħra is the name of a village situated on the island of Gozo.

formal.mt: Ix-Xagħra hija raħal fuq il-gżira ta' Għawdex; fil-programm taż-żjara hemm waqfa f'dan ir-raħal.
formal.en: Xagħra is a village on the island of Gozo; the visit programme includes a stop in this village.
formal.zh: 沙拉村是戈佐岛上的一座村庄；参观行程安排了在这个村庄停留。

gloss_zh: 谢姆希贾，马耳他北部圣保罗湾的一处地区

teaching_sense.en_definition: Xemxija, an area of St Paul's Bay in northern Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谢姆希贾，位于马耳他北部圣保罗湾的一处地区的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' żona ta' San Pawl il-Baħar fit-Tramuntana ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Xemxija, a region of St Paul's Bay in the north of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 谢姆希贾，马耳他北部圣保罗湾的一处地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-Xemxija hija żona ta' San Pawl il-Baħar, fit-Tramuntana ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Xemxija is the name of an area within St Paul's Bay in the northern part of Malta.

collocations.zh: 到谢姆希贾的一次游览

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-ħarġa jinkludi żjara fix-Xemxija, żona ta' San Pawl il-Baħar fit-Tramuntana ta' Malta.
formal.en: The outing programme includes a visit to Xemxija, an area of St Paul's Bay in northern Malta.
formal.zh: 此次出游的行程包括参观谢姆希贾，这是马耳他北部圣保罗湾的一处地区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu nhar il-Ħadd? Mark: Fix-Xemxija. Nistgħu mmorru għal mixja flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet on Sunday? Mark: In Xemxija. We can go for a walk together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们星期天在哪里见面？马克：在谢姆希贾。我们可以一起去散步。

gloss_zh: 谢乌基亚，戈佐岛的一个村庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of a village in Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戈佐岛上一个村庄的专名，中文可音译为“谢乌基亚”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju ta' raħal f'Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛上的一个村庄，名为谢乌基亚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-Xewkija huwa l-isem ta' raħal li jinsab f'Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ix-Xewkija is the name of a village situated in Gozo.

collocations.zh: 到谢乌基亚的一次游览

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara fir-raħal tax-Xewkija f'Għawdex.
formal.en: The travel programme includes a visit to the village of Ix-Xewkija in Gozo.
formal.zh: 行程安排包括参观戈佐岛上的谢乌基亚村。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid iżżur ix-Xewkija għada? Lara: Iva, ejja mmorru filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to visit Ix-Xewkija tomorrow? Lara: Yes, let's go in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天想去谢乌基亚看看吗？拉拉：想，我们上午去吧。

messages.zh: 你明天想去谢乌基亚看看吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.en: Yes, let's go in the morning.

gloss_zh: 沙伊拉，马耳他东南地区的一个村庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of a village in the South Eastern region of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他东南地区一个村庄的专名，中文可音译为“沙伊拉”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju ta' raħal fir-reġjun tax-Xlokk ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: A village in the South Eastern region of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他东南地区的一个村庄，名为沙伊拉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-Xgħajra huwa l-isem ta' raħal li jinsab fir-reġjun tax-Xlokk ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ix-Xgħajra is the name of a village in the South Eastern region of Malta.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara fir-raħal tax-Xgħajra, fir-reġjun tax-Xlokk ta' Malta.
formal.en: The travel programme includes a visit to the village of Ix-Xgħajra, in the South Eastern region of Malta.
formal.zh: 行程安排包括参观位于马耳他东南地区的沙伊拉村。

gloss_zh: 什伦迪，戈佐岛西南部的一个村庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of a village in the southwest of Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戈佐岛西南部一个村庄的专名，中文可音译为“什伦迪”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju ta' raħal fil-Lbiċ ta' Għawdex.

sense_translations.en_definition: A village in the south-west of Gozo
sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛西南部的一个村庄，名为什伦迪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-Xlendi huwa l-isem ta' raħal li jinsab fil-Lbiċ ta' Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ix-Xlendi is the name of a village situated in the southwest of Gozo.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara fir-raħal tax-Xlendi, fil-Lbiċ ta' Għawdex.
formal.en: The travel programme includes a visit to the village of Ix-Xlendi, in the southwest of Gozo.
formal.zh: 行程安排包括参观位于戈佐岛西南部的什伦迪村。

colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Ix-Xlendi? Lara: In the southwest of Gozo. We can go tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什伦迪在哪里？拉拉：在戈佐岛西南部。我们明天可以去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 什伦迪在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Ix-Xlendi?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在戈佐岛的学习示意图西南角贴上“什伦迪 Ix-Xlendi”，用“岛名＋方位＋村名”三个信息一起回忆这个专名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A movement from one side to the other, such as the sway of a boat or branches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体从一侧向另一侧来回移动的摇摆或晃动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment minn naħa għal oħra, bħat-tbandil ta' dgħajsa jew tal-fergħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 左右来回的摇摆；从一侧向另一侧的晃动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tbandil jew il-moviment ta' xi ħaġa minn naħa għal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The sway of something is its movement from one side to the other.

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-vjaġġ, il-kelma 'ixellel' tindika l-moviment tad-dgħajsa minn naħa għal oħra.
formal.en: In the account of the journey, the word 'ixellel' denotes the boat's movement from side to side.
formal.zh: 在这篇旅行记述中，ixellel 一词表示小船左右摇晃的运动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'ixellel' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: It-tbandil tad-dgħajsa minn naħa għal oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'ixellel' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: The boat's swaying from side to side.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这句话里的 ixellel 是什么意思？保罗：就是小船左右来回摇晃。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 ixellel 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ixellel' mean in this sentence?

messages.mt_standard: It-tbandil tad-dgħajsa minn naħa għal oħra.
messages.zh: 就是小船左右来回摇晃。
messages.en: The boat's swaying from side to side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小船向左、向右反复摇晃，把整个摇摆动作当作一个名词画面，与 ixellel 联系记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move upwards on something by using your hands and feet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借助手和脚沿着某物向上移动；攀爬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titla' ma' xi ħaġa billi tuża jdejk u saqajk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用手和脚攀附着物体向上爬。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titla' 'l fuq ma' siġra, sellum jew xi ħaġa oħra bl-għajnuna ta' jdejk u saqajk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you climb something, you move upwards using your hands and feet.

formal.mt: Ixxabbat mas-sellum biss meta jkun stabbli, u żomm sod waqt li titla'.
formal.en: Climb the ladder only when it is stable, and hold on firmly as you go up.
formal.zh: 只有在梯子稳固时才攀爬，上爬时要抓牢。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif nasal sal-fergħa ta' fuq? Toni: Ixxabbat bil-mod mas-siġra u żomm sod.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do I reach the upper branch? Toni: Climb the tree slowly and hold on firmly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我怎么才能够到上面的树枝？托尼：沿着树慢慢往上爬，抓牢。

messages.speaker: Nina (妹妹)
messages.zh: 我怎么才能够到上面的树枝？
messages.en: How do I reach the upper branch?

messages.speaker: Toni (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Ixxabbat bil-mod mas-siġra u żomm sod.
messages.mt_standard: Ixxabbat bil-mod mas-siġra u żomm sod.
messages.zh: 沿着树慢慢往上爬，抓牢。
messages.en: Climb the tree slowly and hold on firmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 ixxabbat 时想象双手抓牢、双脚交替上移的爬梯动作；边做动作边说“攀爬”，帮助建立词义联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enjoy yourself freely and enthusiastically, especially during a celebration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尽情享受欢乐，尤指在庆祝活动中兴高采烈地玩乐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeverti u jgawdi ħafna, speċjalment waqt festa jew ċelebrazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纵情欢乐；尽情参加庆祝和娱乐活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgawdi u jiddeverti bil-kbir waqt festa jew attività ferrieħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone revels, they enjoy themselves enthusiastically, especially while celebrating with other people.

collocations.zh: 在庆祝活动中尽情欢乐

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċerimonja, Pawlu ixxala ma' sħabu waqt iċ-ċelebrazzjoni fil-pjazza.
formal.en: After the ceremony, Pawlu revelled with his friends during the celebration in the square.
formal.zh: 仪式结束后，保罗和朋友们在广场的庆祝活动中尽情欢乐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-festa lbieraħ? Mark: Kienet sabiħa! Pawlu ixxala u żifen sa tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the party yesterday? Mark: It was lovely! Pawlu had a great time and danced until late.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：昨天的聚会怎么样？马克：很棒！保罗玩得特别开心，一直跳舞到很晚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的聚会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet sabiħa! Pawlu ixxala u żifen sa tard.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet sabiħa! Pawlu ixxala u żifen sa tard.
messages.zh: 很棒！保罗玩得特别开心，一直跳舞到很晚。
messages.en: It was lovely! Pawlu had a great time and danced until late.
