messages.en: Right, now I see the difference.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本条当作拼写讨论卡来记：jgerbu 中只有一个 b；材料末尾是在请求确认，因此不要把其中提出的解释直接背成通用规则。

gloss_zh: 花哨醒目的；色彩俗艳刺眼的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very bright or showy in appearance, sometimes in a way that seems unpleasant or excessive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观、颜色或装饰十分鲜艳抢眼的，有时带有过度花哨、俗艳刺眼的贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġbed ħafna l-għajn b'kuluri qawwija jew b'dehra apparixxenti, xi drabi b'mod esaġerat jew mhux pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花哨抢眼的；以鲜艳颜色或显眼外观引人注意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra apparixxenti u jiġbed l-attenzjoni permezz ta' kuluri qawwija jew tiżjin li jidher ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something flashy attracts attention through bright colours or a very showy appearance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 俗艳刺眼的；颜色或装饰过分鲜艳、显得不协调或缺乏品位的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu kuluri jew tiżjin tant qawwija u esaġerati li d-dehra tiegħu tidher mhux pjaċevoli jew mingħajr togħma tajba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something garish has excessively bright colours or decoration that people may find unpleasant or tasteless.

formal.mt: Għall-qoxra tal-ktieb intgħażel kulur jgħajjat biex it-titlu jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: A bright, eye-catching colour was chosen for the book cover so that the title would attract attention.
formal.zh: 书籍封面选用了鲜艳醒目的颜色，以便让标题引人注意。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Jogħġbok dan il-kulur għall-ħajt? David: Għalija jgħajjat wisq; nippreferi kulur aktar kalm. Nina: Mela naraw wieħed aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you like this colour for the wall? David: It's too garish for me; I prefer a calmer colour. Nina: Let's look at a lighter one, then.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你喜欢用这个颜色刷墙吗？戴维：我觉得太刺眼了，我更喜欢柔和一点的颜色。妮娜：那我们看看浅一点的吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢用这个颜色刷墙吗？
messages.en: Do you like this colour for the wall?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija jgħajjat wisq; nippreferi kulur aktar kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija jgħajjat wisq; nippreferi kulur aktar kalm.
messages.zh: 我觉得太刺眼了，我更喜欢柔和一点的颜色。
messages.en: It's too garish for me; I prefer a calmer colour.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 那我们看看浅一点的吧。
messages.en: Let's look at a lighter one, then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一面亮得让人立刻注意到的墙：只是抢眼可记作 flashy，亮得俗艳刺眼则记作 garish；用这个画面区分本条的两种评价。

gloss_zh: 令人疲倦的；使人劳累的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing someone to feel tired through physical or mental effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因需要体力或脑力付出而使人感到疲倦、劳累的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu għajjien minħabba sforz fiżiku jew mentali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人疲倦的；消耗体力或脑力、令人感到劳累的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jikkawża għeja lil min jagħmlu jew jgħaddi minnu, għax jitlob sforz fiżiku jew mentali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An activity or experience that is tiring makes you feel tired because it requires physical or mental effort.

formal.mt: Dan ix-xogħol jgħajji, għalhekk huwa importanti li jsiru pawżi regolari matul il-ġurnata.
formal.en: This work is tiring, so it is important to take regular breaks throughout the day.
formal.zh: 这项工作令人劳累，因此在一天中定时休息很重要。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien il-vjaġġ? Toni: Kien twil u jgħajji, imma fl-aħħar wasalna. Sara: Ejja oqgħod bilqiegħda u strieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was the journey? Toni: It was long and tiring, but we finally arrived. Sara: Come and sit down and rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：旅途怎么样？托尼：又长又累，不过我们终于到了。萨拉：来，坐下休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 旅途怎么样？
messages.en: How was the journey?

messages.speaker: Toni (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien twil u jgħajji, imma fl-aħħar wasalna.
messages.mt_standard: Kien twil u jgħajji, imma fl-aħħar wasalna.
messages.zh: 又长又累，不过我们终于到了。
messages.en: It was long and tiring, but we finally arrived.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja oqgħod bilqiegħda u strieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja oqgħod bilqiegħda u strieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 来，坐下休息一会儿。
messages.en: Come and sit down and rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象长途旅行把人的电量一点点耗光：jgħajji 描述让人变累的事情，记住“这件事使我累”，就能抓住 tiring 的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something to him.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某样东西交给他，或给予他某样东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti xi ħaġa lil persuna msemmija bħala 'hu'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某样东西给他。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti xi ħaġa lil persuna msemmija bħala 'hu'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To give him something means to provide him with it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某样东西给予他。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaddi jew tipprovdi xi ħaġa lil persuna msemmija bħala 'hu'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone gives him an item, that person passes it to him.

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, id-direttur jgħatih kopja tar-rapport biex jaqraha bir-reqqa.
formal.en: After the meeting, the director gives him a copy of the report to read carefully.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，主任给他一份报告副本，让他仔细阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħmel Mark meta ħuh ma jifhimx il-lezzjoni? Lara: Jgħatih eżempju sempliċi u jispjegalu kollox bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does Mark do when his brother does not understand the lesson? Lara: He gives him a simple example and explains everything slowly.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：弟弟听不懂课时，马克会怎么做？拉拉：他会给弟弟举个简单的例子，再慢慢解释清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jagħmel Mark meta ħuh ma jifhimx il-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: X'jagħmel Mark meta ħuh ma jifhimx il-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 弟弟听不懂课时，马克会怎么做？
messages.en: What does Mark do when his brother does not understand the lesson?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħatih eżempju sempliċi u jispjegalu kollox bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħatih eżempju sempliċi u jispjegalu kollox bil-mod.
messages.zh: 他会给弟弟举个简单的例子，再慢慢解释清楚。
messages.en: He gives him a simple example and explains everything slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jgħatih 连同“给他一本书”的画面一起记：手里拿着书，动作朝向“他”，同时记住给予和接受者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Enchanting in a way that gives great pleasure or admiration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以美感或魅力使人愉悦、着迷或陶醉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti pjaċir kbir u jqanqal ammirazzjoni bis-sbuħija jew bil-ħlewwa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迷人的；令人欣喜或陶醉的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġbed l-attenzjoni u jagħti pjaċir kbir bis-sbuħija jew bil-faxxinu tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something enchanting is so charming or beautiful that it gives you great pleasure.

formal.mt: Il-ġnien storiku jgħaxxaq lill-viżitaturi bil-fjuri mlewna u bil-mogħdijiet kwieti tiegħu.
formal.en: The historic garden enchants visitors with its colourful flowers and peaceful paths.
formal.zh: 这座历史悠久的花园以缤纷的花朵和幽静的小径令游客陶醉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok il-ġnien? Mark: Iva, jgħaxxaq! Nixtieq nerġa' niġi meta jiftħu aktar fjuri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the garden? Mark: Yes, it is enchanting! I would like to come again when more flowers are in bloom.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：你喜欢这个花园吗？马克：喜欢，太迷人了！等更多花开了，我还想再来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个花园吗？
messages.en: Did you like the garden?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jgħaxxaq! Nixtieq nerġa' niġi meta jiftħu aktar fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jgħaxxaq! Nixtieq nerġa' niġi meta jiftħu aktar fjuri.
messages.zh: 喜欢，太迷人了！等更多花开了，我还想再来。
messages.en: Yes, it is enchanting! I would like to come again when more flowers are in bloom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jgħaxxaq 和“走进花园后舍不得离开”的画面联想：重点记住美景带来的欣喜与陶醉感。

gloss_zh: 香甜诱人的；美味可口的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Luscious, especially through a rich, sweet, and very pleasing taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尤指食物滋味浓郁、香甜可口，令人十分喜爱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħtik pjaċir kbir, speċjalment b'togħma ħelwa, rikka u tajba ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香甜可口、滋味浓郁而诱人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma rikka u ħelwa li tagħti pjaċir kbir lil min iduqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Food that is luscious has a rich, pleasantly sweet taste that makes it especially enjoyable.

formal.mt: Dan il-kejk jgħaxxik bit-togħma rikka taċ-ċikkulata u bil-krema ħelwa tiegħu.
formal.en: This luscious cake delights the palate with its rich chocolate flavour and sweet cream.
formal.zh: 这款蛋糕香甜可口，浓郁的巧克力风味和甜美的奶油令人回味。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu l-ħawħ illum? Mark: Ħelu u mimli meraq. Duqu, jgħaxxik!
colloquial.en: Lara: What are the peaches like today? Mark: Sweet and juicy. Try them; they are luscious!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天的桃子怎么样？马克：又甜又多汁。尝尝吧，特别好吃！

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天的桃子怎么样？
messages.en: What are the peaches like today?

messages.speaker: Mark (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħelu u mimli meraq. Duqu, jgħaxxik!
messages.mt_standard: Ħelu u mimli meraq. Duqu, jgħaxxik!
messages.zh: 又甜又多汁。尝尝吧，特别好吃！
messages.en: Sweet and juicy. Try them; they are luscious!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jgħaxxik 放进“咬一口熟桃，香甜果汁满口”的画面中，记住它强调令人享受的浓郁美味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To start an activity or enter the first stage of an event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始进行某项活动，或进入某个事件的起始阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibdew jagħmlu xi ħaġa jew jidħlu fl-ewwel stadju ta' attività jew ġrajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他开始；他着手进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hu jibda jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jidħol fl-ewwel stadju ta' attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When he begins an activity, he starts doing it.

formal.mt: Il-lezzjonijiet jibdew fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu, u l-istudenti għandhom jaslu għaxar minuti qabel.
formal.en: The lessons begin at nine in the morning, and students should arrive ten minutes earlier.
formal.zh: 课程于上午九点开始，学生应提前十分钟到达。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta jibdew il-lezzjonijiet għada? Lara: Fid-disgħa. Ejja niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola fid-disgħa neqsin kwart.
colloquial.en: Maja: When do the lessons begin tomorrow? Lara: At nine. Let's meet outside the school at a quarter to nine.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：明天几点开始上课？拉拉：九点。我们八点四十五分在学校门口见吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 明天几点开始上课？
messages.en: When do the lessons begin tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fid-disgħa. Ejja niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola fid-disgħa neqsin kwart.
messages.mt_standard: Fid-disgħa. Ejja niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola fid-disgħa neqsin kwart.
messages.zh: 九点。我们八点四十五分在学校门口见吧。
messages.en: At nine. Let's meet outside the school at a quarter to nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jibdew 与“上课铃响，大家翻开书开始学习”的画面联想，牢牢记住从准备进入行动的起点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a very large appetite and eating greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容胃口很大、吃东西十分贪急的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni ta' min għandu aptit kbir ħafna u jiekol b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪食的；胃口极大、进食贪急的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Min hu deskritt hekk għandu aptit kbir ħafna u jiekol ħafna b'regħba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is voracious has a very large appetite and eats greedily.

collocations.zh: 把所有东西都狼吞虎咽地吃掉

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla, it-tifel jibla' l-ikel b'għaġla u jitlob porzjon ieħor.
formal.en: During the meal, the boy devours his food and asks for another portion.
formal.zh: 吃饭时，男孩狼吞虎咽地吃完食物，又要了一份。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kif jibla' l-ikel! Mark: Kellu ħafna ġuħ wara l-mixja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how he devours his food! Mark: He was very hungry after the walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看他吃得多急！马克：他散步回来后饿坏了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看他吃得多急！
messages.en: Look how he devours his food!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他散步回来后饿坏了。
messages.en: He was very hungry after the walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想一个饿极的人飞快吃光整盘食物，用“狼吞虎咽”的画面记住贪食之意。

gloss_zh: 所给材料未说明具体词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry whose meaning is not specified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中列为名词的词条；释义仅重复词形，无法据此确定具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din hija entrata mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-materjal mogħti jirrepeti biss il-forma tagħha mingħajr ma jispjega t-tifsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释义栏仅提供“jibqaghlha”这一词形，未给出可确定的中文意义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma mogħtija fid-definizzjoni hija l-istess bħall-entrata, għalhekk it-tifsira tagħha mhix spjegata fil-materjal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss repeats the entry itself, so its meaning cannot be determined from this material.

formal.mt: Il-materjal mogħti ma jispjegax it-tifsira tal-forma 'jibqaghlha'; għalhekk ma nistgħux nagħtu traduzzjoni preċiża.
formal.en: The supplied material does not explain the meaning of the form 'jibqaghlha'; therefore, we cannot provide a precise translation.
formal.zh: 所给材料没有解释“jibqaghlha”的含义，因此无法给出准确译文。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'jibqaghlha' hawn? Pawlu: Il-lista ma tispjegahiex; għandna bżonn sentenza sħiħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'jibqaghlha' mean here? Pawlu: The list does not explain it; we need a complete sentence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“jibqaghlha”是什么意思？保罗：词表没有解释；我们需要一个完整的句子。

messages.zh: 这里的“jibqaghlha”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'jibqaghlha' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lista ma tispjegahiex; għandna bżonn sentenza sħiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lista ma tispjegahiex; għandna bżonn sentenza sħiħa.
messages.zh: 词表没有解释；我们需要一个完整的句子。
messages.en: The list does not explain it; we need a complete sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词形暂放进“等待语境”的记忆格：先认准拼写，获得完整例句后再连接具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression indicating that a male person feels afraid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“他感到害怕”的表达；所给词条将其列为名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tindika li persuna maskili tħoss il-biża'; fil-materjal mogħti hija mniżżla bħala nom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他感到害怕；他处于恐惧或受惊的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuna maskili li qed issir referenza għaliha tħoss il-biża' jew tinsab imbeżżgħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression says that a male person is feeling afraid or frightened.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, l-espressjoni 'Jibza' tindika li persuna maskili tinsab imbeżżgħa.
formal.en: In this list, the expression 'Jibza' indicates that a male person is frightened.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，“Jibza”表示一名男性正感到害怕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'Jibza' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Tfisser li hu qed iħoss il-biża'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Jibza' mean in this list? Pawlu: It means that he is feeling afraid.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份词表里的“Jibza”是什么意思？保罗：意思是他感到害怕。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的“Jibza”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Jibza' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li hu qed iħoss il-biża'.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li hu qed iħoss il-biża'.
messages.zh: 意思是他感到害怕。
messages.en: It means that he is feeling afraid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词表中的这个表达与一个男孩害怕时的表情配对，整句记成“他害怕”，同时保留原表词性标注。

gloss_zh: 容易感到恶心；见到令人不适的事物就反胃

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is squeamish easily feels sick when seeing or thinking about something unpleasant, especially blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指容易因看到或想到令人不适的事物，尤其是血，而感到恶心或反胃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jħoss dardir malajr meta jara jew jaħseb fuq xi ħaġa li tqanqallu stmerrija, speċjalment id-demm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易因血、伤口或其他令人不适的事物而感到恶心的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li faċilment tħoss dardir quddiem demm, ġrieħi jew affarijiet oħra li jqanqlu stmerrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is squeamish easily feels sick at the sight or thought of unpleasant things.

collocations.en: feels queasy when he sees blood

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jiddardar meta jara d-demm u jdawwar wiċċu.
formal.en: In the story, the character feels queasy when he sees blood and turns his face away.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物一看到血就感到恶心，把脸转向一边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħija jiddardar meta jara d-demm. Lara: Mela aħjar ma nuruhx dawk l-istampi.
colloquial.en: Maja: My brother feels queasy when he sees blood. Lara: Then we'd better avoid showing him those pictures.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我哥哥一见到血就反胃。拉拉：那我们最好别给他看那些图片。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥一见到血就反胃。
messages.en: My brother feels queasy when he sees blood.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela aħjar ma nuruhx dawk l-istampi.
messages.mt_standard: Mela aħjar ma nuruhx dawk l-istampi.
messages.zh: 那我们最好别给他看那些图片。
messages.en: Then we'd better avoid showing him those pictures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想“看到血，胃里一阵翻腾，赶紧转开脸”的画面，把 jiddardar 和容易恶心、反胃的反应一起记住。

gloss_zh: 含义；意思（对应所给 meaning 名词义项）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied noun sense 'meaning' is the idea or sense expressed by a word, phrase, or statement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给名词义项 meaning 指词语、短语或陈述所表达的含义或意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sens nominali mogħti, 'meaning', huwa t-tifsira jew l-idea li tesprimi kelma, frażi jew stqarrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词语、短语或陈述所表达的含义、意思。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira hija l-idea jew il-kontenut li tesprimi kelma, frażi jew stqarrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of a word or statement is the idea that it expresses.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jispjegaw it-tifsira tal-kelma 'jiddedikaw' skont il-kuntest tas-sentenza.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should explain the meaning of the word 'jiddedikaw' according to the context of the sentence.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应根据句子语境解释“jiddedikaw”这个词的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn insib it-tifsira ta' 'jiddedikaw'? Mark: Fittex il-kelma fid-dizzjunarju u aqra wkoll is-sentenza kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I find the meaning of 'jiddedikaw'? Mark: Look the word up in the dictionary and read the whole sentence too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在哪里能查到“jiddedikaw”的意思？马克：查一下词典，也要读完整个句子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我在哪里能查到“jiddedikaw”的意思？
messages.en: Where can I find the meaning of 'jiddedikaw'?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fittex il-kelma fid-dizzjunarju u aqra wkoll is-sentenza kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Fittex il-kelma fid-dizzjunarju u aqra wkoll is-sentenza kollha.
messages.zh: 查一下词典，也要读完整个句子。
messages.en: Look the word up in the dictionary and read the whole sentence too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这个词是什么意思？”记住所给 meaning 义项；例句把 jiddedikaw 作为被讨论的词引用，不据此把它本身判定为表示“含义”的名词。

gloss_zh: 神志混乱；说胡话；处于谵妄状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is delirious is very confused and may speak without making sense, for example because of a high fever.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人处于明显的神志混乱状态，可能说出不连贯或没有意义的话，例如高烧时的表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jinsab fi stat ta' konfużjoni qawwija u jista' jitkellem bla sens, pereżempju minħabba deni għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神志混乱、可能说胡话的，尤指因发热等身体状况而出现的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li ma taħsibx b'mod ċar u tista' tgħid kliem bla sens, speċjalment meta jkollha deni għoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is delirious is very confused and may say things that do not make sense.

collocations.zh: 因发烧而神志混乱、说胡话

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-pazjent jiddelirja bid-deni u ma jagħrafx lin-nies ta' madwaru.
formal.en: In the novel, the patient is delirious with fever and does not recognize the people around him.
formal.zh: 小说中，病人烧得神志混乱，认不出身边的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-karattru qed jiddelirja f'din ix-xena? Maja: Għandu deni għoli, u kliemu ma jagħmilx sens.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the character delirious in this scene? Maja: He has a high fever, and what he says does not make sense.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个人物在这一幕里为什么神志混乱、说胡话？玛雅：他发着高烧，说的话也没有条理。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru qed jiddelirja f'din ix-xena?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru qed jiddelirja f'din ix-xena?
messages.zh: 这个人物在这一幕里为什么神志混乱、说胡话？
messages.en: Why is the character delirious in this scene?

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu deni għoli, u kliemu ma jagħmilx sens.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu deni għoli, u kliemu ma jagħmilx sens.
messages.zh: 他发着高烧，说的话也没有条理。
messages.en: He has a high fever, and what he says does not make sense.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想小说里的人物高烧后认不清人、说话没有条理的场景，将 jiddelirja 与“神志混乱、说胡话”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 辩论；正式讨论（对应所给 Debate 名词义项）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied noun sense 'Debate' is a discussion in which people present and examine different views on a particular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给名词义项 Debate 指围绕某一议题提出、比较和讨论不同观点的辩论或正式讨论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sens nominali mogħti, 'Debate', huwa diskussjoni li fiha n-nies jippreżentaw u jeżaminaw fehmiet differenti dwar suġġett partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 围绕特定议题陈述和交锋不同观点的辩论，或对该议题进行的正式讨论。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dibattitu huwa diskussjoni dwar suġġett partikolari li fiha jiġu ppreżentati u diskussi argumenti u fehmiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A debate is a discussion in which people present different opinions and arguments about a subject.

collocations.en: the use of 'Jiddibatti' in a debate

formal.mt: Waqt id-dibattitu fil-klassi, l-għalliema talbet lill-istudenti jiddiskutu l-użu tal-kelma 'Jiddibatti' fit-test.
formal.en: During the classroom debate, the teacher asked the students to discuss the use of the word 'Jiddibatti' in the text.
formal.zh: 在课堂辩论中，老师请学生讨论文章中“Jiddibatti”一词的用法。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nistgħu niddiskutu l-kelma 'Jiddibatti' waqt id-dibattitu? Lara: Iva, imma ejja naqraw is-sentenza l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can we discuss the word 'Jiddibatti' during the debate? Lara: Yes, but let's read the sentence first.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们能在辩论时讨论“Jiddibatti”这个词吗？拉拉：可以，不过先读一下那个句子吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 我们能在辩论时讨论“Jiddibatti”这个词吗？
messages.en: Can we discuss the word 'Jiddibatti' during the debate?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja naqraw is-sentenza l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja naqraw is-sentenza l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 可以，不过先读一下那个句子吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's read the sentence first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“两队围绕同一议题轮流提出论点”的画面记住所给 Debate 名词义项；例句引用 Jiddibatti 讨论词语用法，不把引用形式当作名词用法的证据。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to say that you regret something or feel sorry about another person's difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示自己对某事感到抱歉、后悔，或对别人的不幸感到遗憾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tuża biex turi li tħoss dispjaċir għal xi ħaġa li ġrat jew għal diffikultà li għaddej minnha xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱歉；遗憾，用于道歉或表达同情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' dispjaċir li tintuża biex titlob skuża jew turi mogħdrija lejn xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You say this when you want to apologize or express regret about an unfortunate situation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我感到抱歉；我感到遗憾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża meta l-kelliem irid jgħid li jħoss dispjaċir dwar xi ħaġa li għamel jew li ġrat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you use this expression, you say that you personally feel regret or sorrow about something.

collocations.en: I am sorry for the delay.

formal.mt: Jiddispjaċini li ma nistax nattendi l-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: I am sorry that I cannot attend tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: 很抱歉，我无法参加明天的会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jiddispjaċini li wasalt tard. Mark: Ma jimpurtax, għadna fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Sorry I arrived late. Mark: It doesn't matter; we're still on time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：对不起，我来晚了。Mark：没关系，我们还来得及。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 对不起，我来晚了。
messages.en: Sorry I arrived late.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没关系，我们还来得及。
messages.en: It doesn't matter; we're still on time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和迟到后说“对不起”的画面绑定，再整句记住 Jiddispjaċini li wasalt tard；用情境记整词，不必猜测词根。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that something is visible and can be seen from a particular position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物显露出来，能够从某个位置被看见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jgħid li xi ħaġa tista' tidher bl-għajnejn minn post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可见的；看得见的，指能够用眼睛看到。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jintlemaħ jew jingħaraf bl-għajnejn għax mhuwiex moħbi jew barra mill-vista.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something is visible when you can see it from where you are.

collocations.en: can be seen from far away
can be seen through the window

formal.mt: It-torri jidher mill-bogħod meta t-temp ikun ċar.
formal.en: The tower can be seen from far away when the weather is clear.
formal.zh: 天气晴朗时，从远处就能看见这座塔。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-baħar jidher minn hawn? Pawlu: Iva, jidher bejn dawk iż-żewġ djar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you see the sea from here? Pawlu: Yes, you can see it between those two houses.
colloquial.zh: Sara：从这里能看见海吗？Pawlu：能，从那两栋房子之间就能看见。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 从这里能看见海吗？
messages.en: Can you see the sea from here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher bejn dawk iż-żewġ djar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher bejn dawk iż-żewġ djar.
messages.zh: 能，从那两栋房子之间就能看见。
messages.en: Yes, you can see it between those two houses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在窗边，远处的塔进入视野；把 jidher 和“看得见”绑定，再用“从这里看得见吗”反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Going into a place or gaining access to a system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入某个地方，或取得对某个系统的访问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dħul ġewwa post jew il-kisba ta' aċċess għal sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进入；走进某处，或访问某个系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dħul minn barra għal ġewwa post, jew l-aċċess għal sistema biex tkun tista' tużaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To enter means to go inside a place or gain access to a system.

formal.mt: Kull viżitatur għandu jirreġistra qabel ma jidħol fil-bini.
formal.en: Every visitor must register before entering the building.
formal.zh: 每位访客都必须在进入大楼之前登记。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark jista' jidħol issa? Nina: Iva, jista' jidħol. Qed nistennewh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can Mark come in now? Nina: Yes, he can come in. We're waiting for him.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 现在可以进来吗？Nina：可以，让他进来吧。我们正等着他。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: Mark 现在可以进来吗？
messages.en: Can Mark come in now?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 可以，让他进来吧。我们正等着他。
messages.en: Yes, he can come in. We're waiting for him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用跨过门槛的动作记住“进入”：先想象他走进房间，再朗读 jidħol fil-kamra；把动作和整个短语一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He makes someone feel unhappy because he does not meet that person's hopes or expectations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 他没有达到某人的希望或期待，因此使对方感到失望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hu jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss dispjaċir għax ma jilħaqx dak li dik il-persuna kienet tittama jew tistenna minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他使人失望；他的行为或表现未达到别人的期待。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hu ma jilħaqx l-aspettattivi ta' xi ħadd u b'hekk iġiegħlu jħossu diżappuntat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: He disappoints someone when his actions or performance fail to meet what that person hoped for.

formal.mt: Il-plejer jiddiżappunta lill-partitarji meta ma jagħmilx l-almu tiegħu waqt il-logħba.
formal.en: The player disappoints the fans when he does not do his best during the match.
formal.zh: 这名球员在比赛中不尽全力时，会让球迷失望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu dejjem jgħid li ġej, imma mbagħad ma jiġix. Lara: Iva, jiddiżappunta lil sħabu kull darba li jagħmel hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu always says he's coming, but then he doesn't come. Lara: Yes, he disappoints his friends every time he does that.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 总说要来，结果又不来。Lara：是啊，他每次这样都会让朋友们失望。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu dejjem jgħid li ġej, imma mbagħad ma jiġix.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu dejjem jgħid li ġej, imma mbagħad ma jiġix.
messages.zh: Pawlu 总说要来，结果又不来。
messages.en: Pawlu always says he's coming, but then he doesn't come.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jiddiżappunta lil sħabu kull darba li jagħmel hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jiddiżappunta lil sħabu kull darba li jagħmel hekk.
messages.zh: 是啊，他每次这样都会让朋友们失望。
messages.en: Yes, he disappoints his friends every time he does that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友答应赴约却没有出现，大家从期待变成失望；用这个画面记住“他让人失望”，再搭配“朋友”或“球迷”练习。

gloss_zh: 词义未明确；所列形容词义待确认

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective entry whose specific meaning has not been established here.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条按形容词保留，但尚无明确词义可供解释或实际套用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv, iżda t-tifsira speċifika tagħha għadha mhix stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义尚未明确的形容词条目；暂不能据此确定其描述的性质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din hija entrata ta' aġġettiv li għad m'għandhiex tifsira ċara biżżejjed biex jiġi spjegat x'kwalità tiddeskrivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This adjective entry does not yet have an established meaning that can be taught reliably.

formal.mt: It-tifsira ta' 'jiforma' trid tiġi ċċarata qabel il-kelma tintuża f'eżempju għat-tagħlim.
formal.en: The meaning of 'jiforma' must be clarified before the word is used in a teaching example.
formal.zh: 在教学例句中使用“jiforma”之前，必须先明确它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'tfisser il-kelma 'jiforma'? Pawlu: It-tifsira għadha mhix ċara; ejja niċċekkjawha qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does the word 'jiforma' mean? Pawlu: The meaning is still unclear; let's check it before using it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：“jiforma”这个词是什么意思？保罗：意思还不明确，我们先查清楚再用吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: “jiforma”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'jiforma' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifsira għadha mhix ċara; ejja niċċekkjawha qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifsira għadha mhix ċara; ejja niċċekkjawha qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 意思还不明确，我们先查清楚再用吧。
messages.en: The meaning is still unclear; let's check it before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jiforma 暂放进“待确认词义”的学习卡：先认准拼写，再补可靠释义，不靠外形猜出形容词含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spread across a wider area or reach additional places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向更大的区域扩散，或逐渐蔓延到其他地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinfirxu fuq żona akbar jew jaslu f'postijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扩散；蔓延；从原有范围向更多地方延伸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jinfirxu lil hinn mill-post fejn kienu u jibdew jidhru f'żona usa'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When things spread, they extend beyond their original location and begin to appear in a wider area.

formal.mt: Dawn il-pjanti jikattru malajr fil-ġnien u jistgħu jgħattu żona kbira.
formal.en: These plants spread quickly through the garden and can cover a large area.
formal.zh: 这些植物在花园里迅速蔓延，能够覆盖很大一片区域。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara kemm jikattru dawn il-pjanti! Toni: Iva, issa qed jikbru ħdejn il-bieb ukoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look how much these plants are spreading! Toni: Yes, now they're growing beside the door too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：看这些植物蔓延得多厉害！托尼：是啊，现在连门旁边也长出来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 看这些植物蔓延得多厉害！
messages.en: Look how much these plants are spreading!

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qed jikbru ħdejn il-bieb ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qed jikbru ħdejn il-bieb ukoll.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在连门旁边也长出来了。
messages.en: Yes, now they're growing beside the door too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 jikattru 时画一小片植物向四周延伸：从一个角落铺向更大范围，帮助联想“扩散、蔓延”。

gloss_zh: 词义未明确；所列名词义待确认

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun entry whose specific meaning has not been established here.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条按名词保留，但尚无明确释义，无法确定其所指的人、事物或概念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda għad mhuwiex ċar għal liema persuna, ħaġa jew kunċett tirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未知；尚不能为这个名词条目提供确定的中文对应词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' din l-entrata ta' nom għadha mhix magħrufa, għalhekk ma tistax tingħata definizzjoni lessikali preċiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun entry has no established meaning here, so a precise lexical translation cannot yet be supplied.

formal.mt: Għall-kelma 'jikkapparra' hemm bżonn definizzjoni ċara qabel ma tkun tista' tingħata traduzzjoni preċiża.
formal.en: The word 'jikkapparra' requires a clear definition before a precise translation can be provided.
formal.zh: 必须先明确“jikkapparra”的定义，才能给出准确的译法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif nittraduċu 'jikkapparra'? David: L-ewwel irridu nkunu nafu x'tfisser; il-kitba waħedha mhix biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do we translate 'jikkapparra'? David: First we need to know what it means; the spelling alone isn't enough.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“jikkapparra”怎么翻译？戴维：我们得先知道它是什么意思，光看拼写还不够。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: “jikkapparra”怎么翻译？
messages.en: How do we translate 'jikkapparra'?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu nkunu nafu x'tfisser; il-kitba waħedha mhix biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu nkunu nafu x'tfisser; il-kitba waħedha mhix biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 我们得先知道它是什么意思，光看拼写还不够。
messages.en: First we need to know what it means; the spelling alone isn't enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 jikkapparra 做一张“释义待补”卡，特别圈出双写 kk、pp、rr；先记准确字形，确认词义后再配图记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely hot, with heat that feels scorching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容气温或热感极高，令人感觉灼热难耐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi sħana qawwija ħafna li tagħti sensazzjoni ta' ħruq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酷热的；热得令人有灼烧感的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi temp jew riħ b'sħana tant qawwija li tinħass taħraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Torrid conditions are extremely hot and can feel scorching.

formal.mt: F'temp jikwi, huwa importanti li wieħed jixrob biżżejjed ilma u jistrieħ fid-dell.
formal.en: In scorching weather, it is important to drink enough water and rest in the shade.
formal.zh: 天气酷热时，应饮用足够的水，并在阴凉处休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'riħ jikwi llum! Mark: Ejja noqogħdu fid-dell u nixorbu ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What a scorching wind today! Mark: Let's sit in the shade and drink some water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天这风真灼热！马克：我们到阴凉处坐坐，喝点水吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天这风真灼热！
messages.en: What a scorching wind today!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu fid-dell u nixorbu ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu fid-dell u nixorbu ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 我们到阴凉处坐坐，喝点水吧。
messages.en: Let's sit in the shade and drink some water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jikwi 和热风扑面、急着找树荫的画面联系起来，记住它表示灼热难耐。

gloss_zh: 他们／她们玩耍；他们／她们进行游戏或运动

teaching_sense.en_definition: They take part in a game, sport, or playful activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他们或她们玩耍，或参加游戏、体育等娱乐活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huma jieħdu sehem f'logħba, fi sport jew f'attività ta' divertiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们或她们玩耍、做游戏或参加体育活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huma jieħdu sehem f'logħba jew f'attività biex jieħdu gost.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If they play, they take part in a game, sport, or enjoyable activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们或她们玩耍、做游戏或参加体育活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huma jqattgħu l-ħin f'logħba, fi sport jew f'attività ta' divertiment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When they play, they spend time enjoying a game or another recreational activity.

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħin tal-mistrieħ, it-tfal jilagħbu flimkien fil-bitħa tal-iskola.
formal.en: During the break, the children play together in the school playground.
formal.zh: 课间休息时，孩子们在学校操场上一起玩耍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn huma t-tfal? Pawlu: Qegħdin barra. Jilagħbu l-futbol ma' sħabhom kull nhar ta' Sibt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are the children? Pawlu: They're outside. They play football with their friends every Saturday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：孩子们在哪儿？保罗：在外面。他们每周六都和朋友们踢足球。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子们在哪儿？
messages.en: Where are the children?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qegħdin barra. Jilagħbu l-futbol ma' sħabhom kull nhar ta' Sibt.
messages.mt_standard: Qegħdin barra. Jilagħbu l-futbol ma' sħabhom kull nhar ta' Sibt.
messages.zh: 在外面。他们每周六都和朋友们踢足球。
messages.en: They're outside. They play football with their friends every Saturday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 jilagħbu 就想象一群孩子一起踢球，把整个词组记成“他们一起玩”。

gloss_zh: 他们／她们抱怨了；他们／她们曾表示不满

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express dissatisfaction about a situation, problem, or treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指多人对某种情况、问题或所受待遇表示不满、提出抱怨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimu nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon dwar sitwazzjoni, problema jew il-mod kif ġew trattati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们或她们曾抱怨，对某事表示了不满。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huma esprimew nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon dwar xi ħaġa li ma għoġbithomx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If they complained, they expressed dissatisfaction about something they considered wrong or unpleasant.

formal.mt: Wara dewmien ta' sagħtejn, il-passiġġieri bdew jilmentaw mal-persunal dwar in-nuqqas ta' informazzjoni.
formal.en: After a two-hour delay, the passengers began complaining to the staff about the lack of information.
formal.zh: 延误两小时后，乘客们开始向工作人员抱怨没有得到相关信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lbieraħ fir-ristorant? Pawlu: Il-klijenti bdew jilmentaw għax l-ikel wasal kiesaħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened at the restaurant yesterday? Pawlu: The customers started complaining because the food arrived cold.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天餐馆里发生什么事了？保罗：顾客们开始抱怨，因为端上来的饭菜是凉的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天餐馆里发生什么事了？
messages.en: What happened at the restaurant yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-klijenti bdew jilmentaw għax l-ikel wasal kiesaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-klijenti bdew jilmentaw għax l-ikel wasal kiesaħ.
messages.zh: 顾客们开始抱怨，因为端上来的饭菜是凉的。
messages.en: The customers started complaining because the food arrived cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几位顾客指着凉饭菜表达不满，把 jilmentaw 与“他们抱怨”的场景绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reply rudely or defiantly to someone who is correcting or instructing you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在受到纠正、管教或指示时，以无礼或不服气的态度回嘴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwieġeb b'mod insolenti jew bi sfida lil xi ħadd li jkun qed jikkoreġih jew jagħtih struzzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 顶嘴；以无礼或抗拒的态度回应别人的管教或指示。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iwieġeb b'mod insolenti jew bi sfida lil min ikun qed iwiddbu jew jagħtih struzzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone talks back, they answer another person rudely instead of accepting a correction or instruction.

formal.mt: Meta student jilsen lill-għalliem, huwa importanti li d-diskussjoni terġa' ssir bil-kalma u bir-rispett.
formal.en: When a student talks back to the teacher, it is important to restore a calm and respectful discussion.
formal.zh: 当学生跟老师顶嘴时，重要的是让讨论重新恢复平静与尊重。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Pawlu jilsen lil ommu kull darba li tgħidlu jistudja? Lara: Għax jirrabja, imma xorta għandu jwieġeb bir-rispett.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why does Pawlu talk back to his mother every time she tells him to study? Lara: Because he gets angry, but he should still answer respectfully.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：为什么保罗每次听到妈妈叫他学习就顶嘴？拉拉：因为他会生气，但他还是应该有礼貌地回答。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu jilsen lil ommu kull darba li tgħidlu jistudja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu jilsen lil ommu kull darba li tgħidlu jistudja?
messages.zh: 为什么保罗每次听到妈妈叫他学习就顶嘴？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu talk back to his mother every time she tells him to study?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jirrabja, imma xorta għandu jwieġeb bir-rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jirrabja, imma xorta għandu jwieġeb bir-rispett.
messages.zh: 因为他会生气，但他还是应该有礼貌地回答。
messages.en: Because he gets angry, but he should still answer respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jilsen 放进“妈妈提醒学习，孩子不服气地回嘴”的场景，记住它强调顶嘴的态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Quick to understand situations and find effective ways to act, sometimes craftily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容理解快、善于想办法的人；随语境可表示聪明、机灵，也可带有狡黠之意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tifhem malajr u taf issib soluzzjonijiet, xi drabi billi tuża l-makakkerija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聪明的；理解能力强且善于解决问题的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tifhem malajr u taf issolvi l-problemi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clever person understands things quickly and finds effective solutions to problems.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狡黠的；善于巧妙算计，以达到自己目的的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tuża l-makakkerija biex tikseb dak li trid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cunning person uses clever tricks or careful planning to achieve personal aims.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机灵的；反应敏捷，善于理解情况并作出恰当判断的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li taħseb malajr, tifhem is-sitwazzjoni u tagħraf kif għandha taġixxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A smart person thinks quickly and judges how to handle situations effectively.

collocations.en: clever enough to find a solution
collocations.zh: 有足够的才智找到解决办法

formal.mt: Moħħu jilħaqlu, u għalhekk seta' jsib soluzzjoni għall-problema mingħajr għajnuna.
formal.en: He is clever, so he was able to find a solution to the problem without help.
formal.zh: 他头脑聪明，因此能够独立找到解决这个问题的办法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sab it-tweġiba daqshekk malajr? Mark: Moħħu jilħaqlu! Dejjem isib xi mod kif isolvi l-problema.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he find the answer so quickly? Mark: He's quick-witted! He always finds some way to solve the problem.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他怎么这么快就找到答案了？马克：他脑子灵啊！他总能想出解决问题的办法。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 他怎么这么快就找到答案了？
messages.en: How did he find the answer so quickly?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Moħħu jilħaqlu! Dejjem isib xi mod kif isolvi l-problema.
messages.mt_standard: Moħħu jilħaqlu! Dejjem isib xi mod kif isolvi l-problema.
messages.zh: 他脑子灵啊！他总能想出解决问题的办法。
messages.en: He's quick-witted! He always finds some way to solve the problem.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“难题刚出现，他就想到办法”的画面记 jilħaqlu；再按语境区分聪明机灵与狡黠算计。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become accustomed to something through repeated experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过反复接触或经历，逐渐适应某种环境、情况或日常安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidra xi ħaġa ftit ftit wara li jesperjenzaha jew jiltaqa' magħha ripetutament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐习惯某事物；经过一段时间后适应新的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibda jħossu aktar komdu ma' xi ħaġa li għall-ewwel tkun ġdida jew mhux tas-soltu għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone gets used to something, they gradually become familiar and comfortable with it.

collocations.en: get used to the new routine
collocations.zh: 逐渐适应新的日常安排

formal.mt: Impjegat ġdid jista' jkollu bżonn ftit żmien biex jindargha għar-rutina tal-uffiċċju.
formal.en: A new employee may need some time to get used to the office routine.
formal.zh: 新员工可能需要一些时间来适应办公室的日常安排。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sejjer ħuk fid-dar il-ġdida? Mark: Għadu jindargha għall-istorbju tat-triq, imma qed jorqod aħjar.
colloquial.en: Nina: How is your brother getting on in the new house? Mark: He is still getting used to the street noise, but he is sleeping better.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你哥哥在新家住得怎么样？马克：他还在适应街上的噪声，不过已经睡得好一些了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥在新家住得怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother getting on in the new house?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu jindargha għall-istorbju tat-triq, imma qed jorqod aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu jindargha għall-istorbju tat-triq, imma qed jorqod aħjar.
messages.zh: 他还在适应街上的噪声，不过已经睡得好一些了。
messages.en: He is still getting used to the street noise, but he is sleeping better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jindargha 联想成搬家后逐渐睡得安稳的过程：从陌生不适到慢慢习惯。

gloss_zh: 释义未明确的名词，原释义为 jinderha

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not specified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料标注为名词，但释义仅重复词形，无法据此确定其具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex speċifikata fil-materjal ipprovdut, għax id-definizzjoni tirrepeti biss il-kelma nnifisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅为 jinderha，未提供可以确定具体词义的信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal ipprovdut jagħti biss 'jinderha' bħala definizzjoni ta' dan in-nom u ma jispjegax x'ifisser.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied material identifies this as a noun but does not explain its meaning.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'jinderha' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-materjal ipprovdut ma jagħtix definizzjoni li tiċċara t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'jinderha' is listed as a noun, but the supplied material gives no definition that clarifies its meaning.
formal.zh: jinderha 被列为名词，但所给材料没有提供能够明确其含义的定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'jinderha' f'din il-lista? Toni: Ma nafux minn din l-entrata; id-definizzjoni tirrepeti biss il-kelma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'jinderha' mean in this list? Toni: We cannot tell from this entry; the definition only repeats the word.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份词表里的 jinderha 是什么意思？托尼：单看这个词条无法确定；释义只是把词重复了一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的 jinderha 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'jinderha' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafux minn din l-entrata; id-definizzjoni tirrepeti biss il-kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafux minn din l-entrata; id-definizzjoni tirrepeti biss il-kelma.
messages.zh: 单看这个词条无法确定；释义只是把词重复了一遍。
messages.en: We cannot tell from this entry; the definition only repeats the word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 jinderha 放在“词义待确认”的学习卡上，先辨认词形和名词标签，避免凭相似拼写猜义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A low sound expressing pain, distress, or unhappiness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示疼痛、难受或悲伤的低沉声音；本词条按所给材料的名词标签讲解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss baxx li jesprimi wġigħ, tbatija jew dwejjaq; f'din l-entrata l-kelma hija trattata bħala nom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟声；因疼痛、痛苦或不快而发出的低沉哀声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tnehida jew ħoss baxx li persuna tagħmel minħabba wġigħ, tbatija jew dwejjaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A moan is a low sound that someone makes when they are in pain or unhappy.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, 'jingħi' huwa ppreżentat bħala nom għat-tnehida jew għall-ħoss baxx li jesprimi wġigħ jew dwejjaq.
formal.en: In this list, 'jingħi' is presented as a noun for a moan or low sound expressing pain or distress.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，jingħi 被作为名词介绍，指表示疼痛或难受的呻吟声或低沉哀声。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'jingħi' f'din il-lista? Ben: Aħseb f'persuna b'uġigħ li tagħmel ħoss baxx, bħal tnehida.
colloquial.en: Sara: How can I remember the meaning of 'jingħi' in this list? Ben: Think of someone in pain making a low sound, like a moan.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：怎样记住这份词表中 jingħi 的意思？本：想象一个疼痛的人发出低低的声音，像呻吟一样。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'jingħi' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Kif niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'jingħi' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 怎样记住这份词表中 jingħi 的意思？
messages.en: How can I remember the meaning of 'jingħi' in this list?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb f'persuna b'uġigħ li tagħmel ħoss baxx, bħal tnehida.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb f'persuna b'uġigħ li tagħmel ħoss baxx, bħal tnehida.
messages.zh: 想象一个疼痛的人发出低低的声音，像呻吟一样。
messages.en: Think of someone in pain making a low sound, like a moan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习本词条时，把 jingħi 与疼痛中发出的低低呻吟声联系起来，并记住材料给出的名词标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sent or dispatched to a person or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被寄送或发送给某人，或被送往某个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun mibgħut lil xi ħadd jew lejn xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被寄出、发送或送往某处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun mibgħut minn xi ħadd lil persuna oħra jew lejn post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is sent, someone arranges for it to reach another person or place.

formal.mt: Id-dokument għandu jintbagħat lill-uffiċċju qabel il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The document must be sent to the office before Friday.
formal.zh: 该文件必须在星期五之前寄送至办公室。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Meta se jintbagħat il-pakkett? Pawlu: Għada filgħodu, bil-posta.
colloquial.en: Marta: When will the parcel be sent? Pawlu: Tomorrow morning, by post.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：包裹什么时候寄出？保罗：明天早上，通过邮寄。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 包裹什么时候寄出？
messages.en: When will the parcel be sent?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 明天早上，通过邮寄。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning, by post.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把包裹放在画面中央，记住这里说的是“包裹被寄出”；例句用标准拼写 jintbagħat。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give off a strong and unpleasant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散发出强烈而令人不快的气味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu riħa qawwija u ħażina li ddejjaq lil min ixommha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 气味恶臭的；散发难闻气味的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollu riħa ħażina ħafna li tqanqal sens ta' stmerrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is foul in smell gives off an odour that people find very unpleasant.

formal.mt: Iż-żibel li jinten għandu jitneħħa mill-kamra biex titjieb il-kwalità tal-arja.
formal.en: The rubbish that smells bad should be removed from the room to improve the air quality.
formal.zh: 应把发臭的垃圾从房间里清走，以改善空气质量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ħut jinten ħafna! Mark: Mela ma nikluhx; narmuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: This fish smells really bad! Mark: Then let's not eat it; let's throw it away.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这鱼臭得很厉害！马克：那就别吃了，把它扔掉吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这鱼臭得很厉害！
messages.en: This fish smells really bad!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 那就别吃了，把它扔掉吧。
messages.en: Then let's not eat it; let's throw it away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开垃圾桶后立刻捂住鼻子，把 jinten 与“闻到臭味”的动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break the continuity of someone's speech or an ongoing activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人的讲话或正在进行的活动暂时停止或失去连续性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaqqaf għal xi ħin lil xi ħadd milli jitkellem jew iwaqqaf il-mixja ta' attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打断讲话或干扰活动的进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jidħol waqt li xi ħadd ikun qed jitkellem jew jagħmel xi ħaġa u jwaqqfu għal xi ħin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who interrupts breaks into another person's speech or causes an activity to stop temporarily.

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant għandu jistenna sakemm il-kelliem jispiċċa qabel ma jinterrompi d-diskussjoni b'mistoqsija.
formal.en: Each participant should wait until the speaker has finished before interrupting the discussion with a question.
formal.zh: 每位参与者都应等发言者讲完，再提出问题打断讨论。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Karl dejjem jinterrompi meta nitkellem? Sara: Għidlu jħallik tispiċċa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does Karl always interrupt when I speak? Sara: Tell him to let you finish.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么卡尔总在我说话时打断我？萨拉：告诉他，让你把话说完。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Karl dejjem jinterrompi meta nitkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Karl dejjem jinterrompi meta nitkellem?
messages.zh: 为什么卡尔总在我说话时打断我？
messages.en: Why does Karl always interrupt when I speak?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 告诉他，让你把话说完。
messages.en: Tell him to let you finish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句话说到一半被别人插话截断，用这个场景记住 jinterrompi 的“打断”。

gloss_zh: 盛气凌人的；自命不凡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Overbearing or self-important in the way someone treats other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容待人时盛气凌人，或自视高人一等、摆出优越姿态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'mod prepotenti jew jaħseb li hu aqwa minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛气凌人的；以强硬态度欺压他人、强迫他人服从的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'mod prepotenti u jipprova jġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jagħmel dak li jrid hu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is overbearing tries to control other people through an intimidating or forceful manner.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自命高人一等的；因自觉身份或品位优越而看不起他人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqis lilu nnifsu aqwa minn ħaddieħor minħabba l-pożizzjoni jew il-gosti tiegħu u jħares lejn l-oħrajn minn fuq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is snobbish considers their own status or tastes superior and looks down on other people.

collocations.en: put on airs because of his position
collocations.zh: 因自己的职位而摆架子

formal.mt: Mexxej li jippretendiha mal-kollegi u jħares lejhom minn fuq jagħmilha diffiċli biex it-tim jaħdem flimkien.
formal.en: A leader who acts overbearingly towards colleagues and looks down on them makes it difficult for the team to work together.
formal.zh: 对同事盛气凌人、看不起同事的领导，会使团队难以协作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx taħdem ma' Ruben? Toni: Għax jippretendiha: jagħti l-ordnijiet u jaħseb li hu aqwa minn kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to work with Ruben? Toni: Because he acts so superior: he orders people around and thinks he's better than everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不想和鲁本一起工作？托尼：因为他太盛气凌人了：对人发号施令，还觉得自己比谁都强。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx taħdem ma' Ruben?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx taħdem ma' Ruben?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想和鲁本一起工作？
messages.en: Why don't you want to work with Ruben?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jippretendiha: jagħti l-ordnijiet u jaħseb li hu aqwa minn kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jippretendiha: jagħti l-ordnijiet u jaħseb li hu aqwa minn kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他太盛气凌人了：对人发号施令，还觉得自己比谁都强。
messages.en: Because he acts so superior: he orders people around and thinks he's better than everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画区分义项：指着别人发号施令是“盛气凌人”，抬高下巴看人是“自命不凡”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make books, articles, or other written material available to readers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指出版书籍、发表文章，或将其他文字材料公开提供给读者；此形式用于复数主语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħorġu kotba, artikli jew materjal miktub ieħor biex ikun disponibbli għall-qarrejja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出版或发表，使书籍、文章等文字材料可供公众阅读。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Joħorġu xogħol miktub u jagħmluh disponibbli għall-pubbliku biex jinqara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When people publish written material, they make it available for others to read.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkaturi jippublikaw ir-riżultati tal-istudju f'rivista akkademika.
formal.en: The researchers publish the results of the study in an academic journal.
formal.zh: 研究人员在学术期刊上发表研究结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se jippublikaw il-ktieb il-ġdid? Mark: Ix-xahar id-dieħel, u nixtieq nixtrih.
colloquial.en: Maja: When will they publish the new book? Mark: Next month, and I'd like to buy it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们什么时候出版那本新书？马克：下个月，我想买一本。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们什么时候出版那本新书？
messages.en: When will they publish the new book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 下个月，我想买一本。
messages.en: Next month, and I'd like to buy it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整词放进“他们出版一本书”的画面中记忆，再把书换成文章，练习表达“他们发表文章”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of farm animals feeding on grass in a field or pasture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指牲畜在田野或牧场取食青草的活动，即吃草或放牧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha l-bhejjem jieklu l-ħaxix f'għalqa jew f'mergħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牲畜在草地上取食青草的活动；放牧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività tal-bhejjem meta jieklu l-ħaxix li jikber fl-għelieqi jew fil-mergħat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Grazing is the activity of animals feeding on grass growing in fields or pastures.

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, il-kelma 'jirgħa' tirreferi għall-attività tal-bhejjem li jieklu l-ħaxix fil-mergħa.
formal.en: In this lesson, the word 'jirgħa' refers to the activity of farm animals eating grass in a pasture.
formal.zh: 在本课中，jirgħa 指牲畜在牧场吃草的活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'jirgħa' f'din il-lezzjoni? Pawlu: Tfisser l-attività tan-nagħaġ jew ta' bhejjem oħra meta jieklu l-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'jirgħa' mean in this lesson? Pawlu: It means the activity of sheep or other farm animals eating grass.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这节课里的 jirgħa 是什么意思？保罗：指绵羊或其他牲畜吃草的活动。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这节课里的 jirgħa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'jirgħa' mean in this lesson?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser l-attività tan-nagħaġ jew ta' bhejjem oħra meta jieklu l-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser l-attività tan-nagħaġ jew ta' bhejjem oħra meta jieklu l-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 指绵羊或其他牲畜吃草的活动。
messages.en: It means the activity of sheep or other farm animals eating grass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群羊低头吃青草，把这个完整活动画面与词条相连，记住本条名词义为“吃草、放牧”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become greedy and begin wanting more than one needs or deserves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指变得贪婪，开始想要超过自己所需或应得的东西，侧重贪念的产生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir rgħib u jibda jixtieq aktar milli jeħtieġ jew milli jistħoqqlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得贪婪，开始产生想多占、多得的欲望。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibda jkollu xewqa eċċessiva li jikseb aktar flus, affarijiet jew vantaġġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone becomes greedy, they begin wanting more than they need or deserve.

formal.mt: Meta wieħed jibda jirgħeb għall-flus, jista' jinsa l-bżonnijiet ta' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: When someone begins to become greedy for money, they may forget other people's needs.
formal.zh: 当一个人开始贪图金钱时，便可能忘记他人的需要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jitlob aktar, meta diġà ħa sehmu? Mark: Naħseb li qed jibda jirgħeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is he asking for more when he's already had his share? Mark: I think he's starting to get greedy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他已经拿了自己那份，为什么还要更多？马克：我觉得他开始起贪念了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jitlob aktar, meta diġà ħa sehmu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jitlob aktar, meta diġà ħa sehmu?
messages.zh: 他已经拿了自己那份，为什么还要更多？
messages.en: Why is he asking for more when he's already had his share?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我觉得他开始起贪念了。
messages.en: I think he's starting to get greedy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“本来够了，却开始想多拿”的转变来记忆；本条重点是“变得贪婪”，突出贪念刚刚产生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Being greedy by wanting more money, possessions, or advantages than is reasonable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指处于贪婪的状态或表现出贪心，想得到过多的钱财、物品或好处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun rgħib u juri xewqa eċċessiva għal flus, affarijiet jew vantaġġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪婪的状态或表现，即一味想要更多钱财、物品或好处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun f'qagħda ta' regħba u jkun irid aktar milli jeħtieġ jew milli hu xieraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is being greedy wants more money, possessions, or benefits than is reasonable.

formal.mt: Min jirheb u jrid kollox għalih jista' jagħmel ħsara lir-relazzjonijiet tiegħu ma' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: Someone who is greedy and wants everything for themselves may damage their relationships with others.
formal.zh: 贪心而且想把一切据为己有的人，可能会损害自己与他人的关系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħalla xi kejk għall-oħrajn? Mark: Le, ħadu kollu. Illum qed jirheb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did he leave any cake for the others? Mark: No, he took it all. He's being greedy today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他给其他人留蛋糕了吗？马克：没有，他全拿走了。他今天可真贪心。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他给其他人留蛋糕了吗？
messages.en: Did he leave any cake for the others?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħadu kollu. Illum qed jirheb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħadu kollu. Illum qed jirheb.
messages.zh: 没有，他全拿走了。他今天可真贪心。
messages.en: No, he took it all. He's being greedy today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把整盘蛋糕都拿走，记住本条强调“正在表现得贪心”的状态，并单独记牢词形 jirheb。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He says or does the same thing again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 他把已经说过的话再说一次，或把已经做过的事情再做一次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hu jerġa' jgħid jew jagħmel l-istess ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他再次说出或做出前面提到的那件事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hu jerġa' jgħid jew jagħmel dak li jkun diġà ntqal jew sar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone repeats it, he says or does the same thing again.

formal.mt: L-għalliem jaqra l-eżempju u jirrepetih bil-mod biex l-istudenti jifhmuh.
formal.en: The teacher reads the example and repeats it slowly so that the students understand it.
formal.zh: 老师读出例句，再慢慢重复一遍，让学生理解。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma smajtx in-numru. Mark jirrepetih? Lina: Iva, jirrepetih issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: I didn't hear the number. Will Mark repeat it? Lina: Yes, he'll repeat it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我没听清那个号码。Mark会再说一遍吗？Lina：会，他现在就再说一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我没听清那个号码。Mark会再说一遍吗？
messages.en: I didn't hear the number. Will Mark repeat it?

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，他现在就再说一遍。
messages.en: Yes, he'll repeat it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师读完例句又读一次，把整个词连同宾语记成“他把它再重复一遍”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He opposes something or refuses to give in to it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 他抵抗某种力量、压力或诱惑，不轻易屈服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hu jopponi forza, pressjoni jew tentazzjoni u ma jċedix għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他抵抗或抗拒某事，不向其屈服。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hu ma jċedix għal xi ħaġa li tagħmel pressjoni fuqu jew tħajru jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he resists something, he opposes it or refuses to give in to it.

formal.mt: L-istudent jirreżisti l-pressjoni minn sħabu u jagħżel li jgħid il-verità.
formal.en: The student resists pressure from his peers and chooses to tell the truth.
formal.zh: 这名学生顶住同伴的压力，选择说出真相。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Mark se jiekol biċċa kejk oħra? Maja: Le, illum jirreżisti t-tentazzjoni!
colloquial.en: Lina: Is Mark going to have another piece of cake? Maja: No, today he's resisting the temptation!
colloquial.zh: Lina：Mark还要再吃一块蛋糕吗？Maja：不了，今天他要抵制诱惑！

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark se jiekol biċċa kejk oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Mark se jiekol biċċa kejk oħra?
messages.zh: Mark还要再吃一块蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Is Mark going to have another piece of cake?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 不了，今天他要抵制诱惑！
messages.en: No, today he's resisting the temptation!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把蛋糕放在眼前却坚持不伸手的画面，与“他抵制诱惑”一起记住，再迁移到“顶住压力”。

gloss_zh: 英语（本条名词释义；用法未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The English language, taken as the noun meaning specified for this entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条按名词处理，释为“英语”；现有信息未明确其具体用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Ingliża, bħala t-tifsira mogħtija għal dan in-nom; l-użu preċiż tiegħu mhuwiex ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英语；此处保留名词义，具体用法尚未明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Ingliża; din hija t-tifsira nominali indikata, iżda l-użu preċiż tal-kelma mhuwiex speċifikat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this noun entry, the term is assigned the meaning of the English language.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'jirrimetti' hija elenkata bħala nom bit-tifsira 'il-lingwa Ingliża', iżda l-użu preċiż tagħha mhuwiex speċifikat.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'jirrimetti' is listed as a noun meaning 'the English language', but its precise usage is not specified.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“jirrimetti”列作名词，释为“英语”，但未说明其具体用法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tifsira għandha 'jirrimetti' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Hawn tfisser 'il-lingwa Ingliża', iżda l-użu tagħha mhuwiex ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'jirrimetti' mean in this exercise? Mark: Here it means 'the English language', but its usage is unclear.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个练习里的“jirrimetti”是什么意思？Mark：这里释为“英语”，不过它的用法还不明确。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个练习里的“jirrimetti”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'jirrimetti' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser 'il-lingwa Ingliża', iżda l-użu tagħha mhuwiex ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser 'il-lingwa Ingliża', iżda l-użu tagħha mhuwiex ċar.
messages.zh: 这里释为“英语”，不过它的用法还不明确。
messages.en: Here it means 'the English language', but its usage is unclear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张标有“名词：英语；用法待明确”的学习卡，暂按此义识记，不凭词形推断其他词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He or it shows something or makes it known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 他或它展示、揭示某事，使其变得可见或为人所知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hu juri xi ħaġa jew jagħmilha magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 展示；显露；使人看见或知道某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa tidher jew isir magħruf dak li ma kienx ċar qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something reveals something, they show it or make it known.

collocations.en: he or it reveals new details

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrivela dettalji ġodda dwar il-proġett.
formal.en: The report reveals new details about the project.
formal.zh: 这份报告披露了有关该项目的新细节。

colloquial.mt: Lina: It-trejler jirrivela t-tmiem tal-film? Mark: Le, juri biss ftit xeni mill-bidu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Does the trailer reveal the ending of the film? Mark: No, it only shows a few scenes from the beginning.
colloquial.zh: Lina：预告片会透露电影的结局吗？Mark：不会，它只展示了开头的几个场景。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 预告片会透露电影的结局吗？
messages.en: Does the trailer reveal the ending of the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, juri biss ftit xeni mill-bidu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, juri biss ftit xeni mill-bidu.
messages.zh: 不会，它只展示了开头的几个场景。
messages.en: No, it only shows a few scenes from the beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报告翻开后，新细节出现在眼前，把“展示出来”和“揭示信息”连成同一个记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to show regret or to offer an apology.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示遗憾或向别人道歉时使用的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex turi dispjaċir jew biex titlob skuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱歉；对不起，用于表达歉意或遗憾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li biha persuna turi li jiddispjaċiha għal xi ħaġa jew titlob skuża lil xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when you want to apologize or express regret about something.

formal.mt: Jisgħobija, iżda ma nistax nattendi għal-laqgħa minħabba impenn ieħor.
formal.en: I am sorry, but I cannot attend the meeting because of another commitment.
formal.zh: 很抱歉，由于另有安排，我无法出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jisgħobija, insejt il-ktieb tiegħek id-dar. Mark: Ma jimpurtax, ġibu għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Sorry, I left your book at home. Mark: Never mind, bring it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：对不起，我把你的书忘在家里了。马克：没关系，明天带来吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 对不起，我把你的书忘在家里了。
messages.en: Sorry, I left your book at home.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没关系，明天带来吧。
messages.en: Never mind, bring it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jisgħobija 放进“忘带朋友的书，先说抱歉”的场景中，连同后面的道歉原因一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word or group of words used to identify a person, place, or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来识别或称呼某个人、地方或事物的词语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma jew grupp ta' kliem li bihom tissejjaħ jew tingħaraf persuna, post jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名字或名称，即用于称呼和识别某个人、地方或事物的词语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem huwa kelma jew grupp ta' kliem li jintużaw biex persuna, post jew ħaġa jingħarfu u jissejħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A name is the word or group of words by which a person, place, or thing is known.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'Jisimgha' tingħata t-tifsira 'isem': kelma li biha tingħaraf persuna, post jew ħaġa.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'Jisimgha' is given the meaning 'name': a word by which a person, place, or thing is identified.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，Jisimgha 的释义是“名字或名称”，即用于识别某个人、地方或事物的词语。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser 'Jisimgha' f'din il-lista? Mark: Tfisser 'isem', bħal 'Anna' jew 'Mark'.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'Jisimgha' mean in this list? Mark: It means 'name', such as 'Anna' or 'Mark'.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这份词表里的 Jisimgha 是什么意思？马克：意思是“名字”，比如“安娜”或“马克”。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的 Jisimgha 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Jisimgha' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 意思是“名字”，比如“安娜”或“马克”。
messages.en: It means 'name', such as 'Anna' or 'Mark'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词包将 Jisimgha 与写着自己名字的姓名卡联系起来，再用 isem sħiħ 练习“全名”的表达。

gloss_zh: 到期；应在规定日期履行

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used when a payment or obligation reaches the date on which it must be fulfilled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示款项或义务到了规定的支付或履行日期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża meta jasal iż-żmien stabbilit biex jitħallas ammont jew jitwettaq obbligu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到期的；到了规定支付或履行日期的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li waslet id-data stabbilita biex isir ħlas jew jitwettaq obbligu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a payment is due, it must be made by the date that has been specified.

collocations.en: the bill is due at the end of the month

formal.mt: Il-ħlas jiskadi fil-ħmistax ta' Novembru u għandu jsir permezz ta' trasferiment bankarju.
formal.en: The payment is due on the fifteenth of November and should be made by bank transfer.
formal.zh: 款项于十一月十五日到期，应通过银行转账支付。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Meta jiskadi l-kont? Pawlu: Jiskadi għada. Inħallsu llum.
colloquial.en: Marta: When is the bill due? Pawlu: It is due tomorrow. Let's pay it today.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：账单什么时候到期？保罗：明天到期。我们今天付吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 账单什么时候到期？
messages.en: When is the bill due?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 明天到期。我们今天付吧。
messages.en: It is due tomorrow. Let's pay it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jiskadi 和日历上的付款日连起来记：日期一到，就该付款；用“账单明天到期”整句帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 闭嘴；停止说话；安静下来

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to express that someone stops talking or becomes quiet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人停止说话或安静下来；汉语中的“闭嘴”语气可能较强。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jesprimi li xi ħadd jieqaf jitkellem jew jibqa' sieket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闭嘴；停止讲话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ifisser li persuna tieqaf titkellem u ma tkomplix tagħmel kummenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone shuts up, they stop talking, often because another person wants silence.

collocations.en: to stop talking for a while
to be quiet during the lesson

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant għandu jiskot waqt li jkun qed jitkellem ħaddieħor.
formal.en: Each participant should remain quiet while another person is speaking.
formal.zh: 其他人发言时，每位参与者都应保持安静。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ma jitkellimx? Nina: Għandu bżonn jiskot għal ftit u jisma'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why isn't Mark talking? Nina: He needs to stop talking for a while and listen.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克怎么不说话了？妮娜：他需要暂时安静下来，听一听。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么不说话了？
messages.en: Why isn't Mark talking?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu bżonn jiskot għal ftit u jisma'.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu bżonn jiskot għal ftit u jisma'.
messages.zh: 他需要暂时安静下来，听一听。
messages.en: He needs to stop talking for a while and listen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 jiskot 时想象把说话音量降到零：嘴巴停下来，耳朵开始听；把“停止说话”和“保持安静”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liquid seeps when it passes slowly through small openings or porous material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体通过细小缝隙或有孔隙的材料缓慢渗出或渗透。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likwidu jiskula meta jgħaddi bil-mod minn fetħiet żgħar jew minn materjal poruż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 液体通过细小缝隙或孔隙缓慢渗出、渗入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi likwidu li jgħaddi bil-mod minn toqob żgħar, xquq jew materjal li jħallih jgħaddi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a liquid seeps through something, it moves slowly through small holes or spaces.

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, l-ilma jiskula bil-mod mix-xquq fil-ħajt u jxarrab l-art.
formal.en: After the rain, water seeps slowly through the cracks in the wall and wets the floor.
formal.zh: 雨后，水从墙上的裂缝中缓慢渗出，弄湿了地板。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex hemm l-ilma ħdejn il-ħajt? Toni: L-ilma jiskula minn din ix-xaqq. Inġib xugaman.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is there water beside the wall? Toni: Water is seeping through this crack. I'll get a towel.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：墙边怎么有水？托尼：水正从这条裂缝里渗出来。我去拿条毛巾。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 墙边怎么有水？
messages.en: Why is there water beside the wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma jiskula minn din ix-xaqq. Inġib xugaman.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma jiskula minn din ix-xaqq. Inġib xugaman.
messages.zh: 水正从这条裂缝里渗出来。我去拿条毛巾。
messages.en: Water is seeping through this crack. I'll get a towel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jiskula 配上一幅慢镜头：水一点点穿过墙缝，留下湿痕；用“细缝、慢慢、水渗出”三个画面记住意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone or something stands out when they are easily noticed among others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人或事物在周围的人或事物之中容易被注意到，显得突出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jispicca meta jkun faċli li tinduna bih fost oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在人群、环境或同类事物中显得突出，容易引起注意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ifisser li persuna jew ħaġa tidher b'mod ċar fost oħrajn u tiġbed l-attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something stands out, you notice them easily because they differ from their surroundings.

collocations.en: to stand out among the others
collocations.zh: 在其他人或事物中显得突出

collocations.en: to stand out against a white background
collocations.zh: 在白色背景上显得醒目

formal.mt: It-titlu aħmar jispicca fuq l-isfond abjad u jiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-qarrej.
formal.en: The red title stands out against the white background and attracts the reader's attention.
formal.zh: 红色标题在白色背景上十分醒目，吸引了读者的注意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema sinjal nista' nara l-ewwel? Luka: Dak is-sinjal isfar jispicca fost l-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which sign can I spot first? Luka: That yellow sign stands out among the others.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：哪个标志最容易先看到？卢卡：那个黄色标志在其他标志中很显眼。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 哪个标志最容易先看到？
messages.en: Which sign can I spot first?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak is-sinjal isfar jispicca fost l-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Dak is-sinjal isfar jispicca fost l-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 那个黄色标志在其他标志中很显眼。
messages.en: That yellow sign stands out among the others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 jispicca 时想象白纸中央一个鲜红标题，目光一下就被吸引；把“背景中的醒目一点”作为词义记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Representation of ideas, qualities, or feelings through particular objects, signs, or images.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借助特定事物、符号或图像来表达某种观念、特质或情感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rappreżentazzjoni ta' ideat, kwalitajiet jew sentimenti permezz ta' oġġetti, sinjali jew stampi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 象征；以事物、符号或图像代表某种意义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rappreżentazzjoni ta' xi ħaġa permezz ta' simboli li jesprimu idea jew tifsira partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When objects or images symbolize something, they represent an idea, quality, or feeling associated with it.

formal.mt: F'din il-pittura, iż-żewġ idejn magħqudin jissimboliżżaw l-għaqda bejn il-popli.
formal.en: In this painting, the two joined hands symbolize unity between peoples.
formal.zh: 在这幅画中，两只相握的手象征各民族之间的团结。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn il-fjuri bojod jissimboliżżaw il-paċi? Toni: Iva, u għalhekk għażilniehom għall-kartolina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do these white flowers symbolize peace? Toni: Yes, and that is why we chose them for the card.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些白花象征和平吗？托尼：对，所以我们选了它们来装饰贺卡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些白花象征和平吗？
messages.en: Do these white flowers symbolize peace?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，所以我们选了它们来装饰贺卡。
messages.en: Yes, and that is why we chose them for the card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把白花与和平连成一幅画面，记住 jissimboliżżaw 表示多个事物共同象征某种意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Continuation of an activity, event, or process without bringing it to an end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项活动、事件或过程继续进行，尚未结束的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkomplija ta' attività, ġrajja jew proċess mingħajr ma jasal fi tmiemu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继续进行；某项活动或过程仍在延续。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tkomplija ta' xi ħaġa li tkun għaddejja u li tkun għadha ma waqfitx jew ma spiċċatx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an activity or process continues, it goes on rather than stopping or ending.

formal.mt: Wara l-waqfa, il-kumitat jissokta bid-diskussjoni dwar il-proposta.
formal.en: After the break, the committee continues its discussion of the proposal.
formal.zh: 休息之后，委员会继续讨论该提案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu għadu jissokta bix-xogħol? Mark: Iva, irid ilesti qabel l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Pawlu still continuing with the work? Mark: Yes, he wants to finish before lunch.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗还在继续工作吗？马克：是的，他想在午饭前完成。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗还在继续工作吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still continuing with the work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，他想在午饭前完成。
messages.en: Yes, he wants to finish before lunch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象休息铃响过后讨论仍在进行，把 jissokta 和“接着做、继续下去”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take the place of someone or something, or to put another person or thing in their place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取代某人或某物，或用另一个人或物替换原来的人或物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu post xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew iqiegħed persuna jew ħaġa oħra minflok dik ta' qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 替换；代替；使另一个人或物接替原来的人或物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu post persuna jew ħaġa, jew juża persuna jew ħaġa oħra minflok dik li kien hemm qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone replaces a person or thing, they take its place or put another person or thing in its place.

formal.mt: It-tekniku jissostitwixxi l-batterija l-qadima b'waħda ġdida qabel ma jerġa' jittestja l-apparat.
formal.en: The technician replaces the old battery with a new one before testing the device again.
formal.zh: 技术员先用新电池替换旧电池，再次测试设备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min jissostitwixxi lil Marija fil-ħanut għada? Ben: Jien, għax hi għandha appuntament.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is replacing Marija at the shop tomorrow? Ben: I am, because she has an appointment.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：明天谁在店里替玛丽娅上班？本：我，因为她有个预约。

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jissostitwixxi lil Marija fil-ħanut għada?
messages.mt_standard: Min jissostitwixxi lil Marija fil-ħanut għada?
messages.zh: 明天谁在店里替玛丽娅上班？
messages.en: Who is replacing Marija at the shop tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Ben (店员)
messages.zh: 我，因为她有个预约。
messages.en: I am, because she has an appointment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象取出旧电池、装入新电池：jissostitwixxi 的核心是让新的接替原来的位置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become angry in response to something upsetting, frustrating, or unwelcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因令人不快、受挫或不合心意的事情而产生愤怒情绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jħoss rabja minħabba xi ħaġa li ddejqu, tfixklu jew ma tiġix kif jixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生气；动怒；由原先的情绪转为愤怒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jirrabja minħabba xi ħaġa li tiġri jew minħabba kliem jew imġiba ta' xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone gets angry, they begin to feel strong displeasure about something that has happened.

collocations.en: gets angry because of the noise

formal.mt: Meta l-istudent jissupervja minħabba kumment, l-għalliem jagħtih ħin biex jikkalma.
formal.en: When the student gets angry because of a comment, the teacher gives him time to calm down.
formal.zh: 当学生因一句评论而生气时，教师给他一些时间平静下来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Karl jissupervja meta nmisslu l-affarijiet? Luqa: Għax iridna nistaqsuh l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does Karl get angry when I touch his things? Luqa: Because he wants us to ask him first.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么我一碰卡尔的东西，他就生气？卢卡：因为他希望我们先问过他。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Karl jissupervja meta nmisslu l-affarijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Karl jissupervja meta nmisslu l-affarijiet?
messages.zh: 为什么我一碰卡尔的东西，他就生气？
messages.en: Why does Karl get angry when I touch his things?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他希望我们先问过他。
messages.en: Because he wants us to ask him first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jissupervja 与人物从平静变得皱眉的情景配对，重点记住“开始生气”的情绪变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To set up something or formally determine a rule, condition, or arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设立某事物，或正式确立规则、条件及安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħloq jew iwaqqaf xi ħaġa, jew jiffissa regola, kundizzjoni jew arranġament b'mod formali.
