sense_translations.en_definition: set, establish [in: Nru. 642 Att dwar l-Ilsien Malti (Kap . 470) Emendi fl-Ortografija tal-Malti]
sense_translations.zh_definition: 设定；建立；正式确立规则、制度或安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iwaqqaf xi ħaġa jew jiddetermina b'mod ċar u formali regoli, kundizzjonijiet jew arranġamenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone establishes something, they bring it into existence or formally decide how it will operate.

formal.mt: Ir-regolament jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet għall-parteċipazzjoni fil-programm.
formal.en: The regulation establishes the conditions for participation in the programme.
formal.zh: 该规章规定了参加这一项目的条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jistabbilixxi l-ħin tal-laqgħa? Mark: Il-kap tat-tim jistabbilixxi l-ħin wara li jkellimna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who sets the meeting time? Mark: The team leader sets the time after speaking to us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁来定开会时间？Mark：组长跟我们商量后定时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 谁来定开会时间？
messages.en: Who sets the meeting time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kap tat-tim jistabbilixxi l-ħin wara li jkellimna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kap tat-tim jistabbilixxi l-ħin wara li jkellimna.
messages.zh: 组长跟我们商量后定时间。
messages.en: The team leader sets the time after speaking to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和“正式定下来”的画面绑定：立规则、定条件、排时间，都可用这个词帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied form expresses that they have the ability or opportunity to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给形式表达“他们、她们或它们能够做某事”；本条保留所给的 noun 词性标签。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma mogħtija tesprimi li huma għandhom il-ħila jew l-opportunità li jagħmlu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们、她们或它们有能力或有条件做某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li huma għandhom il-ħila jew il-possibbiltà li jwettqu azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If they can do something, they have the ability or opportunity to do it.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti jistaw jagħżlu bejn żewġ attivitajiet edukattivi.
formal.en: The participants can choose between two educational activities.
formal.zh: 参与者可以在两项教育活动中选择一项。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sħabek jistaw jgħinuna għada? Mark: Iva, jistaw jiġu wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can your friends help us tomorrow? Mark: Yes, they can come after work.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的朋友们明天能帮我们吗？Mark：能，他们下班后可以来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的朋友们明天能帮我们吗？
messages.en: Can your friends help us tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 能，他们下班后可以来。
messages.en: Yes, they can come after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群朋友一起举手说“我们能帮忙”，从旁观者角度记成“他们能”；词性标签按所给资料保留。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He makes a determined effort to achieve a goal or complete a difficult task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他为实现目标或完成困难的任务而付出努力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel sforz qawwi biex jilħaq għan jew iwettaq biċċa xogħol diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他努力奋斗，尽力实现某个目标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħiltu kollha biex jilħaq għan jew jikseb riżultat mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When he strives, he makes a serious and determined effort to achieve something.

collocations.en: he strives for a better life
collocations.zh: 他为更好的生活而奋斗

formal.mt: L-istudent jistinka biex itejjeb il-ħiliet tiegħu fil-kitba u jikseb riżultati aħjar.
formal.en: The student strives to improve his writing skills and achieve better results.
formal.zh: 这名学生努力提高自己的写作能力，争取取得更好的成绩。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu jistudja kuljum? Anna: Għax jistinka biex jgħaddi mill-eżami.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does Pawlu study every day? Anna: Because he is working hard to pass the exam.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗为什么每天都学习？安娜：因为他在努力争取通过考试。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么每天都学习？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu study every day?

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 因为他在努力争取通过考试。
messages.en: Because he is working hard to pass the exam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jistinka 放进“他每天努力备考”的画面中，连着记 jistinka biex jirnexxi，表示他努力争取成功。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing or produce musical notes that are not at the correct pitch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 唱歌或演奏时发出的音高不准确，出现走调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikanta jew idoqq noti li ma jkunux fil-pitch it-tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唱歌或演奏时音高不准，偏离应有的音调。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikanta jew idoqq b'mod li n-noti ma jkunux fil-pitch it-tajjeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone sings out of tune, the notes they sing are not at the correct pitch.

collocations.en: he goes out of tune on the high notes

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, l-għalliem innota li l-kantant jistona fin-noti għoljin u talbu jirrepeti s-silta.
formal.en: During the rehearsal, the teacher noticed that the singer went out of tune on the high notes and asked him to repeat the passage.
formal.zh: 排练时，老师注意到这名歌手唱高音时走调，便请他把那一段再唱一遍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark jistona ftit f'din il-kanzunetta, hux? Ben: Iva, speċjalment meta jkanta n-noti għoljin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Mark is a little out of tune in this song, isn't he? Ben: Yes, especially when he sings the high notes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克唱这首歌有点走调，是吧？本：是啊，尤其是唱高音的时候。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark jistona ftit f'din il-kanzunetta, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Mark jistona ftit f'din il-kanzunetta, hux?
messages.zh: 马克唱这首歌有点走调，是吧？
messages.en: Mark is a little out of tune in this song, isn't he?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta jkanta n-noti għoljin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta jkanta n-noti għoljin.
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是唱高音的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when he sings the high notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象唱高音时音符偏离谱线，用 jistona 标记“走调”的瞬间，再把它与 fin-noti għoljin 连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop working or being active for a time in order to relax and recover energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂时停止工作或活动，以放松身心并恢复精力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieqaf għal xi żmien mix-xogħol jew mill-attività biex jirrilassa u jerġa' jikseb l-enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 停止工作或活动一段时间，让身体或精神得到休息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu ħin mingħajr xogħol jew sforz biex inaqqas l-għeja u jirkupra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone rests, they stop working or being active for a while so that they can recover.

formal.mt: Wara diversi sigħat ta' xogħol fiżiku, il-ħaddiem jistrieħ għal ftit qabel ikompli.
formal.en: After several hours of physical work, the worker rests for a while before continuing.
formal.zh: 经过数小时的体力劳动后，这名工人先休息一会儿，再继续工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu missierek? Luqa: Qiegħed jistrieħ fuq is-sufan wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is your father? Luqa: He's resting on the sofa after work.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你爸爸在哪儿？卢卡：他下班后正在沙发上休息。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is your father?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed jistrieħ fuq is-sufan wara x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed jistrieħ fuq is-sufan wara x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 他下班后正在沙发上休息。
messages.en: He's resting on the sofa after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“工作结束，坐上沙发歇一会儿”的画面记 jistrieħ；再复述 jistrieħ wara x-xogħol，把休息与下班情境连接。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deserve or be due something because it is appropriate or has been earned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因表现、价值或具体情况而应得某事物，或理应获得某种对待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun ħaqqu xi ħaġa minħabba l-imġiba, l-isforz jew il-valur tiegħu, jew għax hekk ikun xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应得的；按情理或付出应当给予的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħaġa għandha tingħata lil xi ħadd għax tkun ħaqqu jew għax ikun xieraq li jirċeviha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is due to a person should be given to them because they deserve it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理应；应当，侧重某人或某事应获得相称的评价或对待。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jesprimi li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa għandu jirċievi ċertu trattament jew rikonoxximent għax dan ikun xieraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone ought to receive particular treatment, that treatment is appropriate or deserved in the circumstances.

formal.mt: Dan ir-rapport jistħoqq attenzjoni speċjali minħabba l-importanza tas-suġġett.
formal.en: This report deserves special attention because of the importance of its subject.
formal.zh: 由于主题重要，这份报告值得特别关注。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-proġett jistħoqq premju, hux? Mark: Iva, kulħadd ħadem ħafna fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: This project deserves an award, doesn't it? Mark: Yes, everyone worked very hard on it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个项目值得获奖，对吧？Mark：是啊，大家都为它付出了很多努力。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个项目值得获奖，对吧？
messages.en: This project deserves an award, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，大家都为它付出了很多努力。
messages.en: Yes, everyone worked very hard on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“付出之后应得回报”来串联词义：好工作值得表扬，重要报告值得关注，核心都是“配得上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expresses that a person or thing is worthy of something and deserves to receive it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人或某事物配得上某种评价、奖励或对待，因而应当获得它。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi li persuna jew ħaġa tkun denja ta' xi ħaġa u jkun ħaqqha li tirċeviha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 值得的；配得上的；应当获得相应肯定或对待的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li persuna jew ħaġa għandha kwalitajiet jew merti li jagħmluha denja ta' ċertu rikonoxximent jew trattament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is worthy of recognition has qualities or achievements that deserve it.

formal.mt: Dan il-voluntier jistħoqqlu rikonoxximent għall-għajnuna kontinwa tiegħu lill-komunità.
formal.en: This volunteer deserves recognition for his continuing assistance to the community.
formal.zh: 这位志愿者持续帮助社区，值得受到表彰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għen lil kulħadd illum. Mark: Veru, jistħoqqlu grazzi kbira mingħandna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu helped everyone today. Mark: That's true; he deserves a big thank-you from us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 今天帮了所有人。Mark：确实，我们应该好好谢谢他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 今天帮了所有人。
messages.en: Pawlu helped everyone today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 确实，我们应该好好谢谢他。
messages.en: That's true; he deserves a big thank-you from us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把奖杯递给一位热心朋友，同时说“这是他应得的”；把整个词与“他值得获得”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 暖和起来；取暖；保持暖和

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become warm or to keep oneself warm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得暖和，或通过取暖使自己保持暖和。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar sħun jew iżomm ruħu sħun, pereżempju billi joqgħod qrib sors ta' sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取暖，使自己暖和起来或保持暖和。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isir sħun wara li jkun ħass il-bard, jew jagħmel xi ħaġa biex iżomm ruħu sħun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone does this, they become warm or take steps to keep themselves warm.

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja fil-kesħa, il-parteċipant jista' jidħol ġewwa biex jisħon.
formal.en: After walking in the cold, the participant can go indoors to warm up.
formal.zh: 在寒冷天气中步行后，参与者可以进入室内取暖。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Pawlu qiegħed ħdejn in-nar? Rita: Għax qed iħoss il-bard u jrid jisħon.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is Paul beside the fire? Rita: Because he feels cold and wants to warm up.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗为什么待在火边？丽塔：因为他觉得冷，想暖和一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么待在火边？
messages.en: Why is Paul beside the fire?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed iħoss il-bard u jrid jisħon.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed iħoss il-bard u jrid jisħon.
messages.zh: 因为他觉得冷，想暖和一下。
messages.en: Because he feels cold and wants to warm up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“他从冷风中走进屋，在火边暖和起来”的画面，把 jisħon 与身体逐渐变暖联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With firm conviction when emphasizing an idea or point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强调某个观点或要点时，带着坚定而确信的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jenfasizza idea jew punt b'qawwa u b'konvinzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以坚定、确信的态度着重强调。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod li juri konvinzjoni soda waqt li tingħata importanza speċjali lil idea jew lil punt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When people emphasize something with conviction, they stress it firmly because they strongly believe it matters.

collocations.en: firmly emphasize the importance of education
collocations.zh: 坚定地强调教育的重要性

collocations.en: firmly stress that everyone should listen
collocations.zh: 坚定地强调每个人都应该认真听

formal.mt: L-awturi tar-rapport jisħqu fuq l-importanza ta' komunikazzjoni ċara bejn l-għalliema u l-ġenituri.
formal.en: The authors of the report firmly emphasize the importance of clear communication between teachers and parents.
formal.zh: 报告作者着重强调，教师与家长之间的清晰沟通十分重要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-għalliema jisħqu daqshekk fuq il-qari kuljum? Luqa: Għax jgħinna nifhmu aħjar u nitgħallmu kliem ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do the teachers put so much emphasis on reading every day? Luke: Because it helps us understand better and learn new words.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：老师们为什么这么强调每天阅读？卢卡：因为这能帮助我们更好地理解内容，还能学到新词。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-għalliema jisħqu daqshekk fuq il-qari kuljum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-għalliema jisħqu daqshekk fuq il-qari kuljum?
messages.zh: 老师们为什么这么强调每天阅读？
messages.en: Why do the teachers put so much emphasis on reading every day?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jgħinna nifhmu aħjar u nitgħallmu kliem ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jgħinna nifhmu aħjar u nitgħallmu kliem ġdid.
messages.zh: 因为这能帮助我们更好地理解内容，还能学到新词。
messages.en: Because it helps us understand better and learn new words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师坚定地重复“每天都要阅读”，用语气上的着重帮助记住 jisħqu 所表达的强调。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wear away gradually through the action of water, wind, or other external forces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在水、风或其他外力的作用下逐渐受到侵蚀，失去原有的物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittiekel jew jintlibes bil-mod bl-azzjoni tal-ilma, tar-riħ jew ta' forzi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因水流、风等外力作用而逐渐磨损或流失。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitlef bil-mod materjal minn wiċċu minħabba l-effett tal-ilma, tar-riħ jew ta' forzi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When rock or soil erodes, water, wind, or other forces gradually wear it away.

collocations.en: the rock is eroded by the waves
the soil is eroded by the rain

formal.mt: Il-blat tul il-kosta jitherra bil-mod minħabba l-azzjoni kontinwa tal-mewġ.
formal.en: The rock along the coast gradually erodes because of the continuous action of the waves.
formal.zh: 沿海的岩石由于海浪的持续作用而逐渐受到侵蚀。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan il-blat għandu daqshekk ħofor? Toni: Għax jitherra bil-mewġ maż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does this rock have so many hollows? Toni: Because the waves gradually erode it over time.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这块岩石为什么有这么多凹坑？托尼：因为海浪长年累月地侵蚀它。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-blat għandu daqshekk ħofor?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-blat għandu daqshekk ħofor?
messages.zh: 这块岩石为什么有这么多凹坑？
messages.en: Why does this rock have so many hollows?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为海浪长年累月地侵蚀它。
messages.en: Because the waves gradually erode it over time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象海浪一次次拍打岩石，岩石表面慢慢流失，用 jitherra 记“逐渐受侵蚀”；搭配 bil-mewġ 记住海浪这个作用因素。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Staying somewhere longer than necessary or moving about without a clear purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指在某处迟迟不离开，或没有明确目的地闲逛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed idum f'post bla bżonn jew idur minn post għal ieħor mingħajr għan ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某处逗留不走，或漫无目的地徘徊、闲逛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wieħed jibqa' f'post aktar milli hemm bżonn jew idur bla skop minflok ikompli fi triqtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who lingers or loiters stays around instead of leaving or moving on.

formal.mt: Wara li jispiċċa x-xogħol, Mark jitlajja ħdejn l-uffiċċju minflok imur id-dar.
formal.en: After finishing work, Mark lingers near the office instead of going home.
formal.zh: 下班后，马克在办公室附近逗留，没有回家。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għadu ma wasalx Leo? Nina: Qed jitlajja mal-ħwienet; għedtlu biex iħaffef.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why hasn't Leo arrived yet? Nina: He's hanging around the shops; I told him to hurry up.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：利奥怎么还没到？妮娜：他还在商店附近闲逛；我已经叫他快点了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 利奥怎么还没到？
messages.en: Why hasn't Leo arrived yet?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jitlajja mal-ħwienet; għedtlu biex iħaffef.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jitlajja mal-ħwienet; għedtlu biex iħaffef.
messages.zh: 他还在商店附近闲逛；我已经叫他快点了。
messages.en: He's hanging around the shops; I told him to hurry up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友已经催你出发，你却还在街边东看西看；用这幅“逗留闲逛”的画面记住 jitlajja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this entry, a read is an act of reading a written text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条目按所给名词义理解，指阅读文字的行为或一次阅读。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata, it-tifsira mogħtija hija l-qari ta' test, jiġifieri l-att li wieħed jaqra kliem miktub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阅读这一行为；对某篇文字的一次阅读。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jaqra test, jew darba waħda li fiha jaqra dak it-test.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A read is an occasion when someone reads a particular piece of writing.

formal.mt: Għall-entrata 'jitqarac', uża t-tifsira nominali mogħtija: il-qari ta' test.
formal.en: For the entry 'jitqarac', use the supplied noun sense: a read of a text.
formal.zh: 对于词条 jitqarac，采用所给的名词义：对一篇文字的阅读。

colloquial.mt: Mei: Kif nifhem 'read' taħt 'jitqarac' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Hawnhekk huwa nom: qari ta' test, bħal meta taqra artiklu darba.
colloquial.en: Mei: How should I understand 'read' under 'jitqarac' in this list? Pawlu: It's a noun here: a read of a text, like reading an article once.
colloquial.zh: 梅：这份表里 jitqarac 下面的 read 应该怎么理解？保罗：这里是名词，指对文字的一次阅读，比如把一篇文章读一遍。

messages.speaker: Mei (学生)
messages.zh: 这份表里 jitqarac 下面的 read 应该怎么理解？
messages.en: How should I understand 'read' under 'jitqarac' in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk huwa nom: qari ta' test, bħal meta taqra artiklu darba.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk huwa nom: qari ta' test, bħal meta taqra artiklu darba.
messages.zh: 这里是名词，指对文字的一次阅读，比如把一篇文章读一遍。
messages.en: It's a noun here: a read of a text, like reading an article once.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本包把 jitqarac 标为名词，可用“一次阅读”作记忆标签，联想把一篇文章从头读到尾的完整过程。

gloss_zh: 在线轻点；点按网上界面

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the supplied sense, to tap a button or item while using an online interface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按所给词义，指使用网上界面时轻点按钮或项目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont it-tifsira mogħtija, wieħed imiss buttuna jew għażla fuq skrin waqt li juża servizz fuq l-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在网上操作时轻点屏幕上的按钮或项目。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wieħed imiss fil-qosor buttuna jew għażla fuq l-iskrin biex jagħmel xi ħaġa fuq l-internet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this supplied sense, someone taps an onscreen item while using an online service.

collocations.en: tap an option in the website menu
collocations.zh: 轻点网站菜单中的选项

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, it-tifsira mogħtija għal 'jittajpja' hija li wieħed imiss buttuna fuq l-iskrin waqt li juża sit tal-internet.
formal.en: In this exercise, the supplied meaning of 'jittajpja' is to tap an onscreen button while using a website.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，jittajpja 的所给词义是在使用网站时轻点屏幕上的按钮。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'għandi nimmaġina għat-tifsira 'to tap online' ta' 'jittajpja'? Mark: Immaġina li qed tuża sit fuq il-mowbajl u tmiss buttuna fuq l-iskrin.
colloquial.en: Lina: What should I picture for the supplied meaning 'to tap online' of 'jittajpja'? Mark: Imagine using a website on your phone and tapping an onscreen button.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：要记住 jittajpja 所给的“在线轻点”这个意思，我该想象什么？马克：想象你正在手机上使用网站，然后轻点屏幕上的一个按钮。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandi nimmaġina għat-tifsira 'to tap online' ta' 'jittajpja'?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandi nimmaġina għat-tifsira 'to tap online' ta' 'jittajpja'?
messages.zh: 要记住 jittajpja 所给的“在线轻点”这个意思，我该想象什么？
messages.en: What should I picture for the supplied meaning 'to tap online' of 'jittajpja'?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Immaġina li qed tuża sit fuq il-mowbajl u tmiss buttuna fuq l-iskrin.
messages.mt_standard: Immaġina li qed tuża sit fuq il-mowbajl u tmiss buttuna fuq l-iskrin.
messages.zh: 想象你正在手机上使用网站，然后轻点屏幕上的一个按钮。
messages.en: Imagine using a website on your phone and tapping an onscreen button.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本包给出的义项，把 jittajpja 和“手机打开网站，手指轻点按钮”的画面绑定，记住在线点按的动作。

gloss_zh: 会传染的；具有传染性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to spread from one person to another through infection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指疾病或感染能够从一个人传播给另一个人，即具有传染性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi marda jew infezzjoni li tista' tgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会传染的；指疾病或感染能够在人与人之间传播。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi mard jew infezzjoni li jistgħu jgħaddu minn persuna għal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an illness is contagious, it can spread from one person to another.

formal.mt: Dan il-mard jittieħed faċilment minn persuna għal oħra. Il-fuljett jispjega kif titnaqqas il-firxa tiegħu.
formal.en: This disease spreads easily from one person to another. The leaflet explains how to reduce its spread.
formal.zh: 这种疾病很容易在人与人之间传播。宣传单说明了如何减少其传播。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mard jittieħed? Rita: Iva, jista' jgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this disease contagious? Rita: Yes, it can spread from one person to another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种病会传染吗？丽塔：会，可能从一个人传给另一个人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这种病会传染吗？
messages.en: Is this disease contagious?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jista' jgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jista' jgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra.
messages.zh: 会，可能从一个人传给另一个人。
messages.en: Yes, it can spread from one person to another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jittieħed 放进“这种病会传染吗”的问句中，联想人与人之间的传播箭头，记住“会传染”。

gloss_zh: 马鞍（本数据包给定的名词释义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the supplied packet, a seat placed on a horse or another riding animal for a rider.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按所给数据包的名词标注，指放在马等坐骑背上、供骑乘者乘坐的鞍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont it-tikketta ta' nom f'dan il-pakkett, ifisser sarġ: sedil li jitqiegħed fuq dahar żiemel jew annimal ieħor biex persuna tirkeb fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马鞍；置于马等坐骑背部、供人骑乘的座具。此为本数据包给定的名词释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan il-pakkett jingħata bħala nom li jfisser sarġ, jiġifieri sedil fuq dahar annimal li jintuża għall-irkib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied packet labels this entry as a noun meaning a seat fitted to an animal for riding.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'jitwekkek' huwa mmarkat bħala nom bil-glossa Ingliża 'Saddle'. L-istudent għandu jifhem il-kunċett ta' sarġ u jżomm din l-assoċjazzjoni marbuta mal-pakkett mogħti.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'jitwekkek' is marked as a noun with the English gloss 'Saddle'. The learner should understand the concept of a saddle and keep this association tied to the supplied packet.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，“jitwekkek”被标为名词，英语释义为“Saddle”。学习者应理解马鞍这一概念，并将这个对应关系限定在所给数据包内。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tifsira jagħti l-pakkett għal 'jitwekkek'? Mark: Jagħti 'Saddle', jiġifieri sarġ, u jimmarkah bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What meaning does the packet give for 'jitwekkek'? Mark: It gives 'Saddle', meaning a riding seat, and marks it as a noun.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：数据包给“jitwekkek”的释义是什么？马克：它给的是“Saddle”，也就是马鞍，并把它标为名词。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 数据包给“jitwekkek”的释义是什么？
messages.en: What meaning does the packet give for 'jitwekkek'?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jagħti 'Saddle', jiġifieri sarġ, u jimmarkah bħala nom.
messages.mt_standard: Jagħti 'Saddle', jiġifieri sarġ, u jimmarkah bħala nom.
messages.zh: 它给的是“Saddle”，也就是马鞍，并把它标为名词。
messages.en: It gives 'Saddle', meaning a riding seat, and marks it as a noun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张画有马鞍的练习卡，将 jitwekkek 与包内标签 Saddle 并排写，并注明“仅为本包给定对应”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone goes in when they move from outside a place to its inside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某人从一个地方的外面走到里面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tgħaddi minn barra għal ġewwa ta' post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从外面进去；进入某个地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna tgħaddi minn barra għal ġewwa ta' kamra, bini jew post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone goes in, they move from outside a place to the inside.

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur jitħol fil-bini mid-daħla prinċipali u jmur għand ir-receptionist.
formal.en: The visitor goes into the building through the main entrance and approaches the receptionist.
formal.zh: 访客从正门进入大楼，然后走向接待员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer Pawlu? Lara: Jitħol fil-ħanut biex jixtri l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Pawlu going? Lara: He's going into the shop to buy bread.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗要去哪儿？拉拉：他要进商店买面包。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗要去哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu going?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他要进商店买面包。
messages.en: He's going into the shop to buy bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jitħol 配上一个跨过门槛的动作：原先在门外，现在走进门内，记住“进去”的方向。

gloss_zh: 他们感到厌烦；他们受够了

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become fed up with something annoying, repetitive, or prolonged, referring to more than one person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示多个人因某事令人烦恼、反复发生或持续太久而感到厌烦、受够了。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi kif diversi persuni jaslu biex ma jifilħux aktar għal xi ħaġa li ddejjaqhom, tirrepeti ruħha jew iddum wisq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到厌烦、受够了；这里表示多个人对某种情况失去耐心或不愿再忍受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li diversi persuni ma jibqgħux jifilħu għal sitwazzjoni jew imġiba li tkun qed iddejjaqhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When people become fed up with something, they feel annoyed and no longer want to tolerate it.

collocations.zh: 等得不耐烦；受够了等待

collocations.en: get fed up with hearing the same excuses

formal.mt: Il-klijenti jixbgħu jistennew meta t-tweġibiet idumu wisq biex jaslu. Għalhekk, l-uffiċċju għandu jagħtihom aġġornamenti regolari.
formal.en: Customers get fed up with waiting when replies take too long to arrive. The office should therefore give them regular updates.
formal.zh: 回复迟迟不来时，顾客会等得不耐烦。因此，办公室应定期向他们通报进展。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħbieb tagħna jridu jitilqu? Mark: Jixbgħu jistennew. Ilna hawn siegħa!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do our friends want to leave? Mark: They get fed up with waiting. We've been here an hour!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们的朋友为什么想走？马克：他们等得不耐烦了。我们都在这里待了一个小时了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们的朋友为什么想走？
messages.en: Why do our friends want to leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们等得不耐烦了。我们都在这里待了一个小时了！
messages.en: They get fed up with waiting. We've been here an hour!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群朋友排队太久，一起说“受够了等待”；用 jixbgħu jistennew 整块记住多人厌烦的情境。

gloss_zh: 是；表示肯定（本数据包给定释义，词性标为动词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the supplied packet, an affirmative meaning expressed by the English gloss 'yes'; the entry is labelled as a verb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本数据包给出的意义是“是”，用于表达肯定或同意；其给定词性标注为动词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dan il-pakkett jingħata s-sens ta' tweġiba affermattiva li tesprimi qbil jew konferma, bil-glossa Ingliża 'yes' u bit-tikketta ta' verb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 是；表示肯定、确认或同意。此为本数据包给定释义，原词性标注为动词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skont il-glossa f'dan il-pakkett, jesprimi tweġiba affermattiva, qbil jew konferma; il-pakkett jimmarka l-entrata bħala verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied packet assigns this entry the affirmative meaning used to express agreement or confirmation.

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jagħti lil 'jixraqlek' il-glossa Ingliża 'yes' u jimmarkah bħala verb. F'din l-attività, l-istudent jirreġistra dawn iż-żewġ elementi bħala informazzjoni tal-pakkett.
formal.en: The packet gives 'jixraqlek' the English gloss 'yes' and labels it as a verb. In this activity, the learner records both elements as information supplied by the packet.
formal.zh: 数据包为“jixraqlek”提供英语释义“yes”，并将其标为动词。在这项活动中，学习者将这两项内容记录为数据包提供的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm miktub ħdejn 'jixraqlek' fil-lista? Mark: Hemm 'yes' u t-tikketta 'verb'. Hekk jagħtihom il-pakkett.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is written next to 'jixraqlek' in the list? Mark: It says 'yes' and has the label 'verb'. That is how the packet presents them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：列表里“jixraqlek”旁边写着什么？马克：写着“yes”，还有“verb”这个标签。数据包就是这样提供的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 列表里“jixraqlek”旁边写着什么？
messages.en: What is written next to 'jixraqlek' in the list?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm 'yes' u t-tikketta 'verb'. Hekk jagħtihom il-pakkett.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm 'yes' u t-tikketta 'verb'. Hekk jagħtihom il-pakkett.
messages.zh: 写着“yes”，还有“verb”这个标签。数据包就是这样提供的。
messages.en: It says 'yes' and has the label 'verb'. That is how the packet presents them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 jixraqlek、yes 和动词标签写在同一张资料卡上，注明“本包给定”，用打勾图案记住肯定概念，不自行推定日常答句用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He wants something or wishes for something to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他想得到某物，或希望某件事情发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri li hu jrid xi ħaġa jew jixtieq li jiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他希望；他想要，表示他的愿望或意愿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jintuża meta hu jkollu xewqa għal xi ħaġa jew ikun irid jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he wishes for something or wants to do something, he would like to have it or do it.

formal.mt: L-istudent jixtieq ikompli l-istudji tiegħu fl-università.
formal.en: The student wishes to continue his studies at university.
formal.zh: 这名学生希望继续在大学深造。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jixtieq Pawlu għal għeluq sninu? Rita: Jixtieq ktieb dwar il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What would Pawlu like for his birthday? Rita: He would like a book about the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗生日想要什么？丽塔：他想要一本关于大海的书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗生日想要什么？
messages.en: What would Pawlu like for his birthday?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想要一本关于大海的书。
messages.en: He would like a book about the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jixtieq 放进生日许愿的画面：他指着一本书，说自己想要它，记住“他希望、他想要”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes something shocking that causes you strong surprise or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某事令人震惊，会使你强烈惊讶、不安或难过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tqanqal fik sorpriża qawwija, skumdità jew niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人震惊的，使人因意外、严重或令人不安的内容而受到强烈触动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tħallik maħsud minħabba li tkun mhux mistennija, serja jew ta' niket.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something shocking makes you feel very surprised, upset, or disturbed.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta każ li jixxukkjak u juri l-ħtieġa ta' azzjoni immedjata.
formal.en: The report presents a shocking case and demonstrates the need for immediate action.
formal.zh: 这份报告呈现了一个令人震惊的案例，并表明有必要立即采取行动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ta' min narah dan il-film? Lara: Iva, imma fih tmiem li jixxukkjak.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this film worth watching? Lara: Yes, but it has a shocking ending.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这部电影值得看吗？拉拉：值得，不过它的结局会让你震惊。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影值得看吗？
messages.en: Is this film worth watching?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma fih tmiem li jixxukkjak.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma fih tmiem li jixxukkjak.
messages.zh: 值得，不过它的结局会让你震惊。
messages.en: Yes, but it has a shocking ending.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看到电影结局后惊得说不出话，用 tmiem li jixxukkjak 整块记住“令人震惊的结局”。

gloss_zh: 妈妈（源释义为 mamma；词类未标明）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A familiar or affectionate reference to one's mother, corresponding to the supplied gloss 'mamma'; the grammatical category is unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对应所给释义 mamma，表示亲昵或日常称呼中的“妈妈”；材料未明确词类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mogħtija bit-tifsira 'mamma', jiġifieri mod familjari jew affettiv kif wieħed jirreferi għal ommu; il-klassi grammatikali mhix speċifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妈妈，用于日常或亲昵的称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod familjari jew affettiv kif wieħed isejjaħ lil ommu jew jirreferi għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mamma is a familiar or affectionate name used for one's mother.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'jizen' jingħata bit-tifsira 'mamma', iżda l-klassi grammatikali tiegħu mhix speċifikata.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'jizen' is given the meaning 'mamma', but its grammatical category is not specified.
formal.zh: 本练习将“jizen”释为“妈妈”，但未标明它的词类。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'jizen' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Hawn għandha t-tifsira 'mamma', jiġifieri 'omm'. Maja: Tajjeb, hekk niftakarha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'jizen' mean in this list? Pawlu: Here it means 'mamma', that is, 'mother'. Maja: Okay, that helps me remember it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张表里的“jizen”是什么意思？保罗：这里释为“mamma”，也就是“妈妈”。玛雅：好，这样我就记住了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张表里的“jizen”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'jizen' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 这里释为“mamma”，也就是“妈妈”。
messages.en: Here it means 'mamma', that is, 'mother'.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 好，这样我就记住了。
messages.en: Okay, that helps me remember it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“jizen—mamma—妈妈”写在同一张记忆卡上，联想亲切呼唤妈妈的场景；词类暂记为未标明，不自行补充语法规则。

gloss_zh: 源释义为 ji；具体词义未明确

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the gloss 'ji', which does not provide enough information to establish a precise meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料标为名词，所给释义仅为“ji”，不足以确定其具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mniżżla bħala nom bil-glossa 'ji', li ma tagħtix biżżejjed informazzjoni biex tiġi stabbilita tifsira preċiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: ji（材料所给释义，含义未获说明，无法确定准确的中文对应词）。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija hija 'ji', iżda ma hemmx spjegazzjoni li tippermetti li tiġi identifikata t-tifsira tal-kelma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss is 'ji', which leaves the noun's specific meaning undetermined.

formal.mt: Il-lista tikklassifika 'jizgura' bħala nom u tagħtih il-glossa 'ji', iżda din l-informazzjoni mhix biżżejjed biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The list classifies 'jizgura' as a noun and gives it the gloss 'ji', but this information is insufficient to establish its meaning.
formal.zh: 该表将“jizgura”列为名词，释义写作“ji”，但这些信息不足以确定其含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'jizgura' hawn? Mark: Il-lista tgħid biss 'ji', allura ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira. Lara: Mela nħalli nota li t-tifsira għadha mhix ċara.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'jizgura' mean here? Mark: The list only says 'ji', so we cannot be sure of the meaning. Lara: Then I will leave a note saying the meaning is still unclear.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的“jizgura”是什么意思？马克：表里只写了“ji”，所以还不能确定含义。拉拉：那我就注明词义尚不明确。

messages.en: What does 'jizgura' mean here?

messages.mt_standard: Il-lista tgħid biss 'ji', allura ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be or become clear and easier to understand or perceive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得清楚、明朗，或达到容易理解和辨认的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun jew issir ċara, b'mod li wieħed ikun jista' jifhimha jew jagħrafha aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清楚；变得明确、明朗或容易理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun ċara jew issir aktar faċli biex tinftiehem jew tingħaraf.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When something becomes clear, it is easier to understand, recognize, or perceive.

formal.mt: Wara li jingħata eżempju ieħor, il-punt prinċipali jibda jiċċara.
formal.en: After another example is given, the main point begins to become clear.
formal.zh: 再给出一个例子后，主要观点开始变得清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-punt għadu mhux ċar għalik? Mark: Issa qed jiċċara; agħtini eżempju ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the point still unclear to you? Mark: It is becoming clear now; give me another example.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还是不明白这个要点吗？马克：现在开始清楚了；再给我一个例子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你还是不明白这个要点吗？
messages.en: Is the point still unclear to you?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa qed jiċċara; agħtini eżempju ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Issa qed jiċċara; agħtini eżempju ieħor.
messages.zh: 现在开始清楚了；再给我一个例子。
messages.en: It is becoming clear now; give me another example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想雾气散去后景物逐渐清楚的画面，再把同一画面用于听完例子后终于明白一个要点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to explain a meaning, restate something more clearly, or specify exactly what is meant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于说明某句话的意思、换一种更明确的说法，或具体指出所指内容，意为“也就是说、即”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tispjega t-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa, terġa' tgħidha b'mod aktar ċar jew tispeċifika eżatt x'inhu maħsub.

sense_translations.en_definition: meaning; that is to say; namely
sense_translations.zh_definition: 意思是；也就是说；即。用于解释前文、重新表述，或明确指出具体内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tintuża biex tiċċara dak li jkun intqal jew biex tagħti t-tifsira jew id-dettall preċiż tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when you explain what something means or state more precisely what you are referring to.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir fl-ewwel jum tax-xahar, jiġġifieri fl-1 ta' Mejju.
formal.en: The meeting will take place on the first day of the month, namely 1 May.
formal.zh: 会议将在该月的第一天举行，即五月一日。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut jagħlaq fis-sitta. Mark: Jiġġifieri rridu mmorru qabel is-sitta? Maja: Iva, aħjar immorru fil-ħamsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: The shop closes at six. Mark: So you mean we need to go before six? Maja: Yes, we'd better go at five.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：商店六点关门。马克：也就是说，我们得在六点前去？玛雅：对，最好五点去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店六点关门。
messages.en: The shop closes at six.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 也就是说，我们得在六点前去？
messages.en: So you mean we need to go before six?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，最好五点去。
messages.en: Yes, we'd better go at five.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jiġġifieri 想成口语中的“解释箭头”：前面先说一件事，后面接“也就是说”来讲清楚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a surface that is slippery and difficult to walk on safely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容表面很滑，行走时不容易站稳，可能使人滑倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi wiċċ li fuqu jkun faċli li wieħed jitlef il-qabda ta' saqajh u jaqa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑的，指表面不易踩稳或抓牢，容易使人滑倒或使物体滑动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi wiċċ li ma jagħtix qabda tajba u li fuqu persuna jew oġġett jistgħu jiżolqu faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A slippery surface is difficult to walk on or hold because it provides little grip.

formal.mt: Il-paviment jiżloq meta jkun imxarrab, għalhekk il-viżitaturi għandhom jimxu b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The floor is slippery when wet, so visitors should walk carefully.
formal.zh: 地板沾水后很滑，因此访客应小心行走。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Oqgħod attent, dan il-madum jiżloq! Pawlu: Sewwa, nimxi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Rita: Be careful, these tiles are slippery! Pawlu: All right, I'll walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：小心，这些瓷砖很滑！保罗：好，我慢慢走。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 小心，这些瓷砖很滑！
messages.en: Be careful, these tiles are slippery!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我慢慢走。
messages.en: All right, I'll walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jiżloq 和雨后瓷砖联系起来：脚底抓不住地面，就提醒自己“很滑，要慢走”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To crumble into small pieces or slip away from a position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体碎裂、散成小块，或从原来的位置滑脱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifisser li xi ħaġa titfarrak f'biċċiet żgħar jew tiżloq minn fejn tkun.

sense_translations.en_definition: to crumble, to slip away, to fall into small pieces
sense_translations.zh_definition: 碎裂、碎散成小块；也可指从原处滑脱或滑走。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ifisser li oġġett jew materjal jitfarrak u jaqa' f'biċċiet żgħar, jew li jiżloq minn postu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something crumbles or slips away, it breaks into small pieces or moves out of its position.

formal.mt: Il-ġibs qadim beda jiżvara f'biċċiet żgħar waqt ix-xogħol ta' restawr.
formal.en: The old plaster began to crumble into small pieces during the restoration work.
formal.zh: 在修复工作期间，旧灰泥开始碎裂成小块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm dawn il-biċċiet kollha mal-art? Toni: Il-ġibs ta' dan il-ħajt qed jiżvara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are all these pieces on the floor? Toni: The plaster on this wall is crumbling.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：地上怎么有这么多碎块？托尼：这面墙上的灰泥正在碎裂脱落。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawn il-biċċiet kollha mal-art?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawn il-biċċiet kollha mal-art?
messages.zh: 地上怎么有这么多碎块？
messages.en: Why are all these pieces on the floor?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġibs ta' dan il-ħajt qed jiżvara.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġibs ta' dan il-ħajt qed jiżvara.
messages.zh: 这面墙上的灰泥正在碎裂脱落。
messages.en: The plaster on this wall is crumbling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旧墙灰泥逐渐碎成小块、从墙上掉落，用这个画面记住 jiżvara 的“碎散、滑脱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of drinking a large amount of alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量饮用酒精饮料的行为；此处作为名词理解，不表示实施这一行为的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li wieħed jixrob kwantità kbira ta' xorb alkoħoliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量饮酒的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jikkonsma kwantità kbira ta' xorb alkoħoliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Heavy drinking is the activity of consuming a large amount of alcohol.

collocations.en: 'Jlegilgu' in the sense of excessive drinking
'Jlegilgu' as the name of an activity

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, in-nom 'Jlegilgu' jindika l-attività li wieħed jixrob ħafna alkoħol, u mhux il-persuna li tagħmel dan.
formal.en: In this list, the noun 'Jlegilgu' denotes the activity of drinking heavily, rather than the person who does so.
formal.zh: 在这张表中，名词“Jlegilgu”表示大量饮酒的行为，而不是做出这种行为的人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: 'Jlegilgu' hawn tfisser persuna li tixrob ħafna? David: Le, tfisser l-attività stess, jiġifieri li wieħed jixrob ħafna alkoħol. Nina: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar l-imġiba.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does 'Jlegilgu' here mean a person who drinks heavily? David: No, it means the activity itself, namely drinking a lot of alcohol. Nina: So we are talking about the behavior.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里的“Jlegilgu”是指大量喝酒的人吗？戴维：不是，它指行为本身，也就是大量饮酒。妮娜：所以说的是这种行为。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Jlegilgu' hawn tfisser persuna li tixrob ħafna?
messages.mt_standard: 'Jlegilgu' hawn tfisser persuna li tixrob ħafna?
messages.zh: 这里的“Jlegilgu”是指大量喝酒的人吗？
messages.en: Does 'Jlegilgu' here mean a person who drinks heavily?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tfisser l-attività stess, jiġifieri li wieħed jixrob ħafna alkoħol.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tfisser l-attività stess, jiġifieri li wieħed jixrob ħafna alkoħol.
messages.zh: 不是，它指行为本身，也就是大量饮酒。
messages.en: No, it means the activity itself, namely drinking a lot of alcohol.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 所以说的是这种行为。
messages.en: So we are talking about the behavior.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给“Jlegilgu”配一张酒杯接连出现的画面，记作“大量饮酒这一行为”；在卡片上标明名词，避免误记成“喝酒的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very noticeable or showy in appearance, sometimes excessively bright or decorative in a way judged unattractive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观显眼、花哨的；也可带贬义，指色彩或装饰过分张扬而显得俗艳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġbed ħafna l-attenzjoni bid-dehra tiegħu, u kultant ikollu kuluri jew tiżjin tant esaġerati li jidher bla togħma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花哨抢眼的；以显眼的外观吸引注意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġbed l-attenzjoni minħabba dehra li tispikka ħafna, bħal kuluri qawwija jew tiżjin evidenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something flashy attracts attention because its appearance is conspicuous or showy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 俗艳的；因颜色或装饰过分张扬而显得缺乏品味的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu kuluri jew tiżjin esaġerati u għalhekk jidher bla togħma jew mhux sabiħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something gaudy has excessively bright colors or decoration that make it look unattractive.

collocations.zh: 被形容为花哨抢眼的风格

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-dehra, 'jlellex' jista' jfisser li stil jiġbed ħafna l-attenzjoni; fit-tifsira aktar kritika, jindika kuluri jew tiżjin esaġerati li jidhru bla togħma.
formal.en: In an analysis of appearance, 'jlellex' can mean that a style is highly attention-grabbing; in its more critical sense, it indicates excessive colors or decoration judged tasteless.
formal.zh: 分析外观时，“jlellex”可以表示某种风格十分抢眼；在批评意味更强的义项中，它指颜色或装饰过分张扬，显得俗艳。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nuża 'jlellex' biex niddeskrivi din il-ġakketta? Mark: Iva, jekk trid tgħid li tiġbed ħafna l-attenzjoni. Sara: U jekk it-tiżjin jidher bla togħma? Mark: Imbagħad tkun qed tuża t-tifsira aktar negattiva.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I use 'jlellex' to describe this jacket? Mark: Yes, if you mean that it attracts a lot of attention. Sara: And if the decoration looks tasteless? Mark: Then you would be using the more negative sense.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以用“jlellex”形容这件夹克吗？马克：可以，如果你想说它很抢眼。萨拉：如果装饰显得很俗气呢？马克：那你用的就是贬义更强的那个意思。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża 'jlellex' biex niddeskrivi din il-ġakketta?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża 'jlellex' biex niddeskrivi din il-ġakketta?
messages.zh: 我可以用“jlellex”形容这件夹克吗？
messages.en: Can I use 'jlellex' to describe this jacket?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk trid tgħid li tiġbed ħafna l-attenzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk trid tgħid li tiġbed ħafna l-attenzjoni.
messages.zh: 可以，如果你想说它很抢眼。
messages.en: Yes, if you mean that it attracts a lot of attention.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: U jekk it-tiżjin jidher bla togħma?
messages.mt_standard: U jekk it-tiżjin jidher bla togħma?
messages.zh: 如果装饰显得很俗气呢？
messages.en: And if the decoration looks tasteless?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Imbagħad tkun qed tuża t-tifsira aktar negattiva.
messages.mt_standard: Imbagħad tkun qed tuża t-tifsira aktar negattiva.
messages.zh: 那你用的就是贬义更强的那个意思。
messages.en: Then you would be using the more negative sense.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件颜色鲜亮、装饰很多的夹克：第一眼“抢眼”对应 flashy，觉得装饰过头而“俗艳”对应 gaudy；用同一画面区分两个义项的评价程度。

gloss_zh: 明亮的；有光泽的；闪亮的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something bright or shiny gives off or reflects light and may have a smooth, glossy surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体明亮、反光或表面具有光泽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti jew jirrifletti d-dawl, jew li għandu wiċċ lixx u tleqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明亮的；发出或反射较强光线的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti jew jirrifletti ħafna dawl u għalhekk jidher imdawwal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is bright gives off or reflects a noticeable amount of light.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有光泽的；表面平滑并呈现亮泽的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ lixx b'leqq li jidher meta jaqa' d-dawl fuqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is glossy has a smooth surface that reflects light.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪亮的；表面反光而显得亮晃晃的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrifletti d-dawl minn wiċċu u għalhekk jidher ileqq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is shiny reflects light so that its surface looks noticeably bright.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu ġie stampat fuq karta b'wiċċ jleqq biex ir-ritratti jidhru aktar ċari.
formal.en: The catalogue was printed on paper with a glossy surface to make the photographs look clearer.
formal.zh: 这本目录采用表面有光泽的纸张印刷，使照片看起来更加清晰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-metall daqshekk jleqq? Mark: Għadni kif naddaftu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this metal so shiny? Mark: I've just cleaned it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块金属怎么这么亮？马克：我刚把它擦干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块金属怎么这么亮？
messages.en: Why is this metal so shiny?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我刚把它擦干净。
messages.en: I've just cleaned it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚擦亮的金属：光线强是明亮，表面滑是光泽，反光明显是闪亮，用同一画面记住三个义项。

gloss_zh: 下一个的；接触着的；所列名词义未明确

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied material lists a noun sense but does not provide an identifiable meaning for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将一个义项标为名词，但释义仅为“idk”，因此无法确定该名词义的具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-materjal mogħti jelenka sens bħala nom, iżda ma jagħtix tifsira ċara li tippermetti li dan is-sens jiġi definit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名词义未明确；材料中的“idk”未提供可确定的词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan is-sens huwa mniżżel bħala nom, iżda l-indikazzjoni mogħtija ma tispeċifikax xi jfisser.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun sense listed here has no identifiable definition in the supplied material.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下一个的；紧接着的；或处于接触状态的，具体取决于语境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġi wara fil-ħin jew fl-ordni, jew li jkun f'kuntatt ma' xi ħaġa oħra, skont il-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way comes next in a sequence or is in contact with something else.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa li jmiss se ssir il-ġimgħa li jmiss.
formal.en: The next meeting will take place next week.
formal.zh: 下一次会议将于下周举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se nerġgħu niltaqgħu? Mark: Il-ġimgħa li jmiss, jekk jaqbillek.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are we meeting again? Mark: Next week, if that works for you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们什么时候再见面？马克：下周吧，如果你方便的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候再见面？
messages.en: When are we meeting again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 下周吧，如果你方便的话。
messages.en: Next week, if that works for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 li jmiss 和日历上的下一格联系起来，记住下周、下个月；名词栏只有未明释义，暂不替它猜词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He does what someone tells him to do or follows a rule or instruction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“他服从、他听从”，即按照他人的要求、指示或规则行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa jagħmel dak li jgħidulu jagħmel, jew jimxi ma' regola jew struzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他服从；他遵从命令、规则或他人的指示。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa jagħmel dak li jintalab jew jiġi ordnat jagħmel, jew jimxi mar-regoli mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he obeys, he does what he is told or follows the rules given to him.

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant għandu jobbdi r-regoli tas-sigurtà matul l-attività.
formal.en: Every participant must obey the safety rules during the activity.
formal.zh: 每位参与者都必须在活动期间遵守安全规则。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb tiegħek jobbdik? Mark: Iva, jobbdini meta ngħidlu joqgħod bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your dog obey you? Mark: Yes, he obeys me when I tell him to sit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的狗听你的话吗？马克：听，我叫它坐下，它就听从。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗听你的话吗？
messages.en: Does your dog obey you?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jobbdini meta ngħidlu joqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jobbdini meta ngħidlu joqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 听，我叫它坐下，它就听从。
messages.en: Yes, he obeys me when I tell him to sit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jobbdi 配上“听到指令就照做”的画面：人遵守规则，狗听从主人，核心都是按照要求行动。

gloss_zh: 可能表示兴奋或欣喜；具体释义待确认

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied material tentatively associates this verb with feeling very excited or happy, but its exact meaning is uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料暂将该动词与非常兴奋或欣喜的状态联系起来，但带有疑问标记，具体词义尚不能确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-materjal mogħti jorbot dan il-verb b'mod proviżorju ma' sens ta' eċċitament jew ferħ qawwi, iżda t-tifsira eżatta mhix ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能表示感到十分兴奋、欣喜；原释义带有疑问，不能视为已经确认的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jista' jirreferi għal sens ta' eċċitament jew ferħ kbir, iżda l-indikazzjoni mogħtija tħalli din it-tifsira inċerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This verb may describe feeling very excited and happy, although the supplied meaning remains uncertain.

collocations.en: the use of 'joghxa' in a sentence

formal.mt: F'dan il-materjal, 'joghxa' huwa mniżżel bħala verb b'tifsira possibbli ta' eċċitament jew ferħ qawwi; din it-tifsira għadha mhix ikkonfermata.
formal.en: In this material, 'joghxa' is listed as a verb possibly expressing excitement or great happiness; this meaning has not yet been confirmed.
formal.zh: 在这份材料中，“joghxa”被列为动词，可能表达兴奋或强烈的喜悦；这一含义尚未得到确认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'taħseb li tfisser 'joghxa' hawn? Mark: Forsi għandha x'taqsam ma' ferħ kbir, imma t-tifsira mhix ċerta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you think 'joghxa' means here? Mark: Perhaps it has something to do with great happiness, but the meaning is uncertain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这里的“joghxa”是什么意思？马克：也许和非常开心有关，不过词义还不确定。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你觉得这里的“joghxa”是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you think 'joghxa' means here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi għandha x'taqsam ma' ferħ kbir, imma t-tifsira mhix ċerta.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi għandha x'taqsam ma' ferħ kbir, imma t-tifsira mhix ċerta.
messages.zh: 也许和非常开心有关，不过词义还不确定。
messages.en: Perhaps it has something to do with great happiness, but the meaning is uncertain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 joghxa 画一张开心表情旁带问号的记忆卡：开心提示暂定方向，问号提醒词义尚待确认，不把猜测背成定论。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He spends money on something or pays for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他花钱购买某物、支付费用或承担某项开支。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa juża l-flus biex jixtri xi ħaġa jew iħallas għal xi servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他花钱；他支付某项费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa juża ammont ta' flus biex jixtri xi ħaġa jew iħallas għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he spends money, he uses it to buy something or pay for a service.

formal.mt: Kull xahar, Mark jonfoq parti mis-salarju tiegħu fuq it-trasport.
formal.en: Every month, Mark spends part of his salary on transport.
formal.zh: 马克每个月把一部分工资花在交通上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark jonfoq ħafna fuq il-kafè? Nina: Iva, jixtri kafè kuljum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does Mark spend a lot on coffee? Nina: Yes, he buys coffee every day.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克在咖啡上花很多钱吗？妮娜：是啊，他每天都买咖啡。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在咖啡上花很多钱吗？
messages.en: Does Mark spend a lot on coffee?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他每天都买咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, he buys coffee every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象马克每天买咖啡，把 jonfoq 和“他花钱”一起记；再用 fuq 接上钱花在哪一项。

gloss_zh: 他们花费；支出（所给名词义项）

teaching_sense.en_definition: They spend money to buy things or pay for services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他们花钱购买物品或支付服务费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huma jużaw il-flus biex jixtru affarijiet jew iħallsu għal servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们花钱；他们支付费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huma jużaw ammont ta' flus biex jixtru xi ħaġa jew iħallsu għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When people spend money, they use it to buy things or pay for services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给名词义项表示支出，即为某事花费的金钱数额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan is-sens nominali mogħti, it-tifsira hija l-ammont ta' flus li jintefaq għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In the supplied noun sense, spend means the amount of money used for a particular purpose.

formal.mt: Il-familji jonfqu parti mid-dħul tagħhom fuq l-ikel u t-trasport.
formal.en: Families spend part of their income on food and transport.
formal.zh: 各个家庭把一部分收入用于食物和交通。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sħabek jonfqu ħafna fuq il-ħwejjeġ? Lara: Le, jixtru biss dak li għandhom bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do your friends spend a lot on clothes? Lara: No, they only buy what they need.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的朋友们在衣服上花很多钱吗？拉拉：不，他们只买需要的东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的朋友们在衣服上花很多钱吗？
messages.en: Do your friends spend a lot on clothes?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jixtru biss dak li għandhom bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jixtru biss dak li għandhom bżonn.
messages.zh: 不，他们只买需要的东西。
messages.en: No, they only buy what they need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jonfoq“他花钱”和 jonfqu“他们花钱”配对朗读；所给名词标签另记为“支出”，不要与动词句法混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Ionic style in architecture, or to ions in chemistry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于建筑时表示爱奥尼亚式的；用于化学时表示与离子有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istil Joniku fl-arkitettura jew mal-joni fil-kimika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱奥尼亚式的，指一种建筑风格；或离子的，指与离子有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li jirreferi għall-istil Joniku fl-arkitettura jew għal dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-joni fil-kimika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as Ionic relates to the Ionic architectural style or, in chemistry, to ions.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istil joniku tal-kolonni fil-faċċata.
formal.en: The report describes the Ionic style of the columns on the façade.
formal.zh: 报告描述了建筑正面柱子的爱奥尼亚式风格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-istil jissejjaħ joniku? Pawlu: Iva, hawnhekk qed nitkellmu dwar l-arkitettura.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this style called Ionic? Pawlu: Yes, here we are talking about architecture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种风格叫爱奥尼亚式吗？保罗：对，这里我们说的是建筑。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这种风格叫爱奥尼亚式吗？
messages.en: Is this style called Ionic?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawnhekk qed nitkellmu dwar l-arkitettura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawnhekk qed nitkellmu dwar l-arkitettura.
messages.zh: 对，这里我们说的是建筑。
messages.en: Yes, here we are talking about architecture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 joniku 配两张学习卡：柱子对应“爱奥尼亚式”，化学中的离子对应“离子的”；看搭配词判断含义。

gloss_zh: Joseph Mercieca（人名；本条所给释义为“一位教宗”）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A personal-name entry associated here with the description 'a pope'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人名条目，在本条材料中与“一位教宗”这一描述相联系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata ta' isem ta' persuna li f'dan il-materjal hija marbuta mad-deskrizzjoni 'papa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一位教宗，即天主教会的最高领袖；这是本条材料给该人名的释义标签。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Papa, jiġifieri l-mexxej suprem tal-Knisja Kattolika; hawn din hija d-deskrizzjoni mogħtija lill-isem fl-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry associates this personal name with a pope, the supreme leader of the Catholic Church.

collocations.zh: 关于 Joseph Mercieca 的词条

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-isem Joseph Mercieca huwa marbut mad-deskrizzjoni 'papa'.
formal.en: In this exercise, the name Joseph Mercieca is associated with the description 'pope'.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，Joseph Mercieca 这个人名与“教宗”这一描述相联系。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema isem jidher f'din l-entrata? Mark: Joseph Mercieca. Anna: U x'deskrizzjoni tagħti l-entrata? Mark: Tagħti d-deskrizzjoni 'papa'.
colloquial.en: Anna: Which name appears in this entry? Mark: Joseph Mercieca. Anna: And what description does the entry give? Mark: It gives the description 'pope'.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个词条里出现了哪个名字？马克：Joseph Mercieca。安娜：词条给出的描述是什么？马克：给出的描述是“教宗”。

messages.speaker: Anna (教师)
messages.zh: 这个词条里出现了哪个名字？
messages.en: Which name appears in this entry?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: Joseph Mercieca。
messages.en: Joseph Mercieca.

messages.speaker: Anna (教师)
messages.zh: 词条给出的描述是什么？
messages.en: And what description does the entry give?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 给出的描述是“教宗”。
messages.en: It gives the description 'pope'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Joseph Mercieca 整体写在人名卡上；将“教宗”单列为本材料的释义标签，不据此推断人物的真实履历。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thick, slightly sour milk product made by fermentation, eaten plain or with other ingredients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由牛奶发酵制成、质地较稠且略带酸味的食品，可以直接食用或搭配其他食材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott tal-ħalib magħmul bil-fermentazzjoni, kemxejn qares u ta' konsistenza magħquda, li jista' jittiekel waħdu jew ma' ingredjenti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酸奶；由牛奶发酵制成的略酸食品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul mill-ħalib bil-fermentazzjoni, b'togħma kemxejn qarsa u konsistenza magħquda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Yoghurt is a thick, slightly sour food made by fermenting milk.

formal.mt: Għall-kolazzjon, jista' jiġi servut jowgurt naturali ma' frott frisk.
formal.en: For breakfast, plain yoghurt can be served with fresh fruit.
formal.zh: 早餐可以供应搭配新鲜水果的原味酸奶。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid jowgurt bil-frott? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ħallih fil-friġġ sakemm nieklu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like yoghurt with fruit? Pawlu: Yes, please. Leave it in the fridge until we eat.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想吃水果酸奶吗？保罗：想，谢谢。先放在冰箱里，等我们吃饭时再拿出来。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你想吃水果酸奶吗？
messages.en: Would you like yoghurt with fruit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ħallih fil-friġġ sakemm nieklu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ħallih fil-friġġ sakemm nieklu.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。先放在冰箱里，等我们吃饭时再拿出来。
messages.en: Yes, please. Leave it in the fridge until we eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jowgurt 和早餐酸奶杯联系起来，连着记 jowgurt naturali（原味酸奶）与 jowgurt bil-frott（水果酸奶），用两种口味巩固词义。

gloss_zh: 南斯拉夫的；来自原南斯拉夫的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone or something from, or connected with, the former Yugoslavia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或事物来自原南斯拉夫，或与原南斯拉夫有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn dik li kienet il-Jugoslavja jew li għandu x'jaqsam magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 南斯拉夫的；具有南斯拉夫关联的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Jugoslavja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as Jugoslav is associated with the former Yugoslavia.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to the former republic of Jugoslavia
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自原南斯拉夫共和国的，或与该共和国有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mir-repubblika li kienet magħrufa bħala l-Jugoslavja jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dik ir-repubblika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described this way comes from, or relates to, the former republic of Yugoslavia.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi film jugoslav li se jintwera waqt il-festival.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a Yugoslav film that will be screened during the festival.
formal.zh: 目录收录了一部将在电影节期间放映的南斯拉夫电影。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-film jugoslav rajtu qabel? Mark: Le, għadni ma rajtux. Narawh flimkien illejla?
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen this Yugoslav film before? Mark: No, I haven't seen it yet. Shall we watch it together tonight?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这部南斯拉夫电影你以前看过吗？马克：没有，我还没看过。今晚一起看好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部南斯拉夫电影你以前看过吗？
messages.en: Have you seen this Yugoslav film before?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadni ma rajtux. Narawh flimkien illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadni ma rajtux. Narawh flimkien illejla?
messages.zh: 没有，我还没看过。今晚一起看好吗？
messages.en: No, I haven't seen it yet. Shall we watch it together tonight?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影目录上写着 film jugoslav：film 告诉你是什么，jugoslav 补充它与原南斯拉夫的关系。把整组理解为“南斯拉夫电影”。

gloss_zh: 词义未确定的动词形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form classified as a verb in the supplied material, whose meaning is not established there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将其归为动词，但没有提供可确定的词义；学习时应保留其形式并暂不赋予具体译义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma kklassifikata bħala verb fil-materjal mogħti, iżda li t-tifsira tagħha mhix stabbilita f'dak il-materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未明；问号表示所给材料没有确定该动词形式的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' din il-forma verbali mhix magħrufa mill-materjal mogħti, fejn tidher biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The question mark indicates that the supplied material does not establish this verb form's meaning.

formal.mt: Il-forma 'jugżawh' hija kklassifikata bħala verb, iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The form 'jugżawh' is classified as a verb, but the supplied material does not specify its meaning.
formal.zh: “jugżawh”这一形式被归为动词，但所给材料没有说明其含义。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'jugżawh'? David: Il-materjal ma jagħtix it-tifsira tagħha. Għalissa niktbu li t-tifsira mhix magħrufa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'jugżawh' mean? David: The material does not give its meaning. For now, let's write that the meaning is unknown.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“jugżawh”是什么意思？戴维：材料没有给出它的含义。我们先标注为词义未明吧。

messages.mt_standard: Il-materjal ma jagħtix it-tifsira tagħha. Għalissa niktbu li t-tifsira mhix magħrufa.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The seventh month of the year, represented here by the supplied form 'july'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一年中的第七个月，即七月；本词条保留所给形式“july”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-seba' xahar tas-sena, jiġifieri Lulju; il-forma mogħtija f'din l-entrata hija 'july'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七月；一年中的第七个月。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xahar ta' Lulju, li huwa s-seba' xahar tas-sena u jiġi wara Ġunju u qabel Awwissu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: July is the seventh month of the year, following June and preceding August.

formal.mt: Fil-kalendarju pprovdut, 'july' tindika x-xahar ta' Lulju, is-seba' xahar tas-sena.
formal.en: In the calendar provided, 'july' indicates July, the seventh month of the year.
formal.zh: 在所提供的日历中，“july”表示七月，即一年中的第七个月。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn miktub 'july'. Liema xahar hu? Toni: Lulju, is-seba' xahar tas-sena. Sara: Mela l-vaganza tagħna hi f'Lulju!
colloquial.en: Sara: It says 'july' here. Which month is that? Toni: July, the seventh month of the year. Sara: So our holiday is in July!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里写着“july”。这是几月？托尼：七月，一年中的第七个月。萨拉：那我们的假期就是在七月！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这里写着“july”。这是几月？
messages.en: It says 'july' here. Which month is that?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 七月，一年中的第七个月。
messages.en: July, the seventh month of the year.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们的假期就是在七月！
messages.en: So our holiday is in July!

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历第七格同时写上 july、Lulju 和“七月”，把三个形式连到数字七；看到本词条的 july，就回想日历上的第七个月。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A day when business is conducted, or a session during which trading takes place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开展营业活动的一天，也可指进行交易的一个时段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jum li fih isiru attivitajiet kummerċjali, jew sessjoni li matulha jsir il-kummerċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 营业日，即企业或机构开展正常业务的一天。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jum li fih negozju jew istituzzjoni jkunu miftuħa u jwettqu l-attivitajiet normali tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A business day is a day on which a business or institution carries out its normal activities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交易时段，即市场开放并进行买卖的一段时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Perjodu li matulu suq ikun miftuħ u jsiru fih operazzjonijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trading session is a period during which a market is open and buying and selling take place.

collocations.en: at the end of the trading session

formal.mt: It-talba tiġi pproċessata fil-jum ta' negozju li jmiss.
formal.en: The request will be processed on the next business day.
formal.zh: 该申请将在下一个营业日处理。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta se tipproċessaw it-talba tiegħi? Lara: Fil-jum ta' negozju li jmiss. Mark: Tajjeb, grazzi tal-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Mark: When will you process my request? Lara: On the next business day. Mark: All right, thanks for your help.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们什么时候处理我的申请？Lara：下一个营业日。Mark：好的，谢谢你的帮助。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们什么时候处理我的申请？
messages.en: When will you process my request?

messages.speaker: Lara (客服人员)
messages.zh: 下一个营业日。
messages.en: On the next business day.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢你的帮助。
messages.en: All right, thanks for your help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上一张营业日历来记；遇到市场买卖语境，再联想开市到收市的交易时段。

gloss_zh: 原释义为 Maltese；具体名词义未明确

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as a noun with the gloss 'Maltese'; its intended referent is not specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给定资料中标为名词、释义写作“Maltese”的词条；资料未明确该名词具体指什么。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mmarkata bħala nom bit-tifsira 'Maltese', iżda l-materjal ma jispeċifikax għal xiex tirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原文释义为“Maltese”；现有资料未明确具体所指，不能确定为马耳他语或其他名词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija hija 'Maltese', iżda mingħajr kuntest ma jistax jiġi stabbilit għal xiex jirreferi dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied noun gloss is 'Maltese', but the material does not identify its intended referent.

formal.mt: Il-lista timmarka 'jxidd' bħala nom u tagħtih it-tifsira 'Maltese', iżda ma tipprovdix kuntest li jiċċara din it-tifsira.
formal.en: The list labels 'jxidd' as a noun and gives it the gloss 'Maltese', but provides no context to clarify that meaning.
formal.zh: 该列表将“jxidd”标为名词，并给出“Maltese”这一释义，但没有提供可澄清该含义的语境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'jxidd' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Hawn miktub 'Maltese', imma ma hemmx kuntest biżżejjed. Maja: Mela se nħalli nota li t-tifsira mhix ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'jxidd' mean in this list? Pawlu: It says 'Maltese' here, but there is not enough context. Maja: Then I will leave a note that the meaning is unclear.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张列表里的“jxidd”是什么意思？Pawlu：这里写着“Maltese”，但语境不够。Maja：那我就注明含义尚不明确。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张列表里的“jxidd”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'jxidd' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'Maltese', imma ma hemmx kuntest biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'Maltese', imma ma hemmx kuntest biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 这里写着“Maltese”，但语境不够。
messages.en: It says 'Maltese' here, but there is not enough context.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela se nħalli nota li t-tifsira mhix ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Mela se nħalli nota li t-tifsira mhix ċara.
messages.zh: 那我就注明含义尚不明确。
messages.en: Then I will leave a note that the meaning is unclear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这张词卡画一个问号，连同原释义 Maltese 一起记；具体名词义暂留空，避免把未明确的信息背成定论。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make fun of someone or something in an unkind or insulting way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不友善或带有侮辱意味的言语、行为嘲笑某人或某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddu lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa biż-żmien b'mod li jweġġa' jew jinsulta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘲笑、讥弄，以言语或行为使某人或某事显得可笑，通常带有轻蔑或伤害意味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Juru disprezz lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa billi jgħaddu kummenti jew jagħmlu ġesti li jġegħluhom jidhru redikoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people mock someone or something, they make fun of them in an unkind or insulting way.

formal.mt: Studenti li jżebilħu lil sħabhom jistgħu jagħmlu ħsara lill-fiduċja tagħhom fihom infushom.
formal.en: Students who mock their peers can damage their peers' self-confidence.
formal.zh: 嘲笑同伴的学生可能会损害同伴的自信心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dawk it-tfal jżebilħu lil Samwel? Lara: Għax żbalja waqt il-qari. Maja: Mhux sew. Kulħadd jiżbalja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are those children mocking Samwel? Lara: Because he made a mistake while reading. Maja: That is not right. Everyone makes mistakes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那些孩子为什么嘲笑 Samwel？Lara：因为他朗读时出了错。Maja：这样不好。每个人都会犯错。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dawk it-tfal jżebilħu lil Samwel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dawk it-tfal jżebilħu lil Samwel?
messages.zh: 那些孩子为什么嘲笑 Samwel？
messages.en: Why are those children mocking Samwel?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 因为他朗读时出了错。
messages.en: Because he made a mistake while reading.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这样不好。每个人都会犯错。
messages.en: That is not right. Everyone makes mistakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想有人朗读出错后被同伴讥笑的画面，把这个词和带有伤害意味的嘲弄动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small enclosed room or compartment, especially on a ship or in another vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 较小的封闭房间或隔间，尤其指船只或其他交通工具上的舱室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra żgħira jew kompartiment magħluq, speċjalment fuq vapur jew f'vettura oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舱室或小隔间，尤指船上供人住宿或交通工具内供人使用的封闭空间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spazju żgħir u magħluq, bħal kamra fuq vapur fejn jistgħu joqogħdu jew jorqdu l-passiġġieri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cabin is a small enclosed room or compartment, especially one used by passengers on a ship.

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri jistgħu jirriżervaw kabina b'żewġ sodod għall-vjaġġ ta' billejl.
formal.en: Passengers can reserve a cabin with two beds for the overnight journey.
formal.zh: 乘客可以为夜间航程预订一间有两张床的舱室。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-kabina tagħna għandha tieqa? Lara: Iva, u għandha żewġ sodod ukoll. Mark: Tajjeb, nistgħu nistrieħu matul il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does our cabin have a window? Lara: Yes, and it has two beds as well. Mark: Good, we can rest during the journey.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们的舱室有窗户吗？Lara：有，而且还有两张床。Mark：太好了，我们可以在旅途中休息。

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们的舱室有窗户吗？
messages.en: Does our cabin have a window?

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandha żewġ sodod ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandha żewġ sodod ukoll.
messages.zh: 有，而且还有两张床。
messages.en: Yes, and it has two beds as well.

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.zh: 太好了，我们可以在旅途中休息。
messages.en: Good, we can rest during the journey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kabina 写在一幅船舱小房间的图上，画出窗户和两张床，用具体空间记住舱室义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small enclosed space containing a telephone for public use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设有供公众使用的电话、通常可供一人进入的小亭子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kabina żgħira li fiha jkun hemm telefon għall-użu tal-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话亭，即装有公用电话、供人进入打电话的小亭子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kabina li persuna tidħol fiha biex tagħmel telefonata minn telefon pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A telephone booth is a small enclosed space where people can use a public telephone.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公用电话亭，内设供公众拨打电话的电话设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post żgħir magħluq li fih ikun hemm telefon disponibbli għall-pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A phone booth is a small structure containing a telephone that members of the public can use.

collocations.en: to make a call from a telephone booth

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-karattru jidħol f'kabina tat-telefon biex iċempel lill-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: In the text, the character enters a telephone booth to call his family.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，人物走进电话亭给家人打电话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-telefon tiegħi ma jaħdimx. Hemm kabina tat-telefon hawn viċin? Mark: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: My phone isn't working. Is there a telephone booth nearby? Mark: Yes, there's one beside the square.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的手机坏了。这附近有公用电话亭吗？Mark：有，广场旁边有一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-telefon tiegħi ma jaħdimx. Hemm kabina tat-telefon hawn viċin?
messages.mt_standard: It-telefon tiegħi ma jaħdimx. Hemm kabina tat-telefon hawn viċin?
messages.zh: 我的手机坏了。这附近有公用电话亭吗？
messages.en: My phone isn't working. Is there a telephone booth nearby?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，广场旁边有一个。
messages.en: Yes, there's one beside the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上一幅“走进小亭子打电话”的画面，连读 kabina tat-telefon，记住它指电话亭这一设施。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of furniture with doors, used for storing things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带柜门、用于存放餐具、食品或其他物品的柜子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamara bil-bibien li tintuża biex jinżammu fiha affarijiet bħal platti, ikel jew oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橱柜；有柜门、用于收纳物品的柜子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamara magħluqa bil-bibien, ħafna drabi bi xkafef ġewwa, fejn jitqiegħdu u jinżammu diversi affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors in which you store things such as dishes or food.

formal.mt: Wara l-użu, il-platti għandhom jitnaddfu u jitqiegħdu fil-kabord tal-kċina.
formal.en: After use, the plates should be cleaned and placed in the kitchen cupboard.
formal.zh: 盘子使用后应清洗干净，并放入厨房橱柜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn huma t-tazzi? Omm: Fil-kabord ta' fuq, ħdejn il-platti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are the cups? Mum: In the upper cupboard, beside the plates.
colloquial.zh: Lara：杯子在哪里？妈妈：在上面的橱柜里，盘子旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 杯子在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the cups?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 在上面的橱柜里，盘子旁边。
messages.en: In the upper cupboard, beside the plates.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开柜门拿杯子的动作，把 kabord 和“有门的储物柜”一起记；再用 fil-kabord 练习表达“在柜子里”。

gloss_zh: 义未明的名词；所给材料未提供具体释义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not established in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将其列为名词，但未说明其具体意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex stabbilita fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不知道；此处表示所给材料未能确定该词的意义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal mogħti ma jagħtix tifsira magħrufa għal dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry indicates that this noun's meaning is unknown.

formal.mt: Il-kelma kajikk hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word kajikk is listed as a noun, but the supplied material does not specify its meaning.
formal.zh: kajikk 被列为名词，但所给材料未说明其词义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser kajikk? Mark: Ma nafx; hawn ma hemmx tifsira ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does kajikk mean? Mark: I don't know; there isn't a clear definition here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：kajikk 是什么意思？Mark：我不知道；这里没有清楚的释义。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: kajikk 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does kajikk mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; hawn ma hemmx tifsira ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; hawn ma hemmx tifsira ċara.
messages.zh: 我不知道；这里没有清楚的释义。
messages.en: I don't know; there isn't a clear definition here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kajikk 暂记在“词义待确认”卡片上：先认识拼写与名词标签，不把“不知道”误记成这个词的实际意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kind of American crocodile, or a person who is slow in acting or moving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种美洲鳄类，即凯门鳄；也指行动或做事迟缓的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' kukkudrill Amerikan; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal persuna li ddum biex taġixxi jew timxi.

sense_translations.en_definition: kind of American crocodile ... a slow person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种美洲鳄类，指凯门鳄；也可指行动或做事迟缓的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kajman huwa tip ta' kukkudrill Amerikan, jew persuna li taġixxi jew timxi bil-mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kajman is a kind of American crocodile; the word can also describe someone who acts or moves slowly.

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-kajman bħala tip ta' kukkudrill Amerikan u jsemmi wkoll l-użu tal-kelma għal persuna li taġixxi bil-mod.
formal.en: The text describes the caiman as a kind of American crocodile and also mentions the word's use for a person who acts slowly.
formal.zh: 这篇文字将凯门鳄描述为一种美洲鳄类，并提到该词也用于指做事迟缓的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ejja, Mark, kemm int kajman illum! Mark: Stenna ftit, qed nilbes iż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Maja: Come on, Mark, you're such a slowcoach today! Mark: Wait a moment, I'm putting my shoes on.
colloquial.zh: Maja：快点，Mark，你今天可真是个慢性子！Mark：等一下，我正在穿鞋。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja, Mark, kemm int kajman illum!
messages.mt_standard: Ejja, Mark, kemm int kajman illum!
messages.zh: 快点，Mark，你今天可真是个慢性子！
messages.en: Come on, Mark, you're such a slowcoach today!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 等一下，我正在穿鞋。
messages.en: Wait a moment, I'm putting my shoes on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡记 kajman：一张画凯门鳄，一张画出门时仍在穿鞋的慢性子。两幅画对应两个用法，不表示动物一定行动迟缓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cacao, the substance used to give chocolate and related foods or drinks their characteristic flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可可，用于制作巧克力以及给食品或饮品提供可可风味的原料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex isir iċ-ċikkulata u biex tagħti t-togħma lill-ikel jew lix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可可，制作巧克力及可可食品、饮品所用的原料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kakaw huwa sustanza li tintuża fil-produzzjoni taċ-ċikkulata u fit-tħejjija ta' diversi tipi ta' ikel u xorb.
