sense_translations.en_explanation: Cacao is the substance used to make chocolate and to flavour various foods and drinks.

formal.mt: Għal dan il-kejk, żid żewġ mgħaref trab tal-kakaw mad-dqiq u ħallat sew.
formal.en: For this cake, add two spoonfuls of cocoa powder to the flour and mix well.
formal.zh: 制作这款蛋糕时，将两勺可可粉加入面粉中并充分拌匀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna kakaw għall-kejk? Mark: Iva, it-trab tal-kakaw qiegħed fl-armarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have cocoa for the cake? Mark: Yes, the cocoa powder is in the cupboard.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们有做蛋糕用的可可吗？Mark：有，可可粉在橱柜里。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我们有做蛋糕用的可可吗？
messages.en: Do we have cocoa for the cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 有，可可粉在橱柜里。
messages.en: Yes, the cocoa powder is in the cupboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kakaw，就联想厨房里标着“可可”的罐子；再把 trab tal-kakaw 连成“可可粉”整块记忆，方便读食谱。

gloss_zh: 卡拉布里亚的；来自卡拉布里亚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Calabria or connected with Calabria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自卡拉布里亚的，或与卡拉布里亚有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Calabria jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Calabria.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Calabria
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自卡拉布里亚的；属于卡拉布里亚或与该地有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kalabriż jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li ġej minn Calabria jew xi ħaġa li għandha x'taqsam ma' Calabria.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something described as Calabrian comes from Calabria or has a connection with that place.

collocations.zh: 一名来自卡拉布里亚的男子

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-avveniment jinkludi taħdita dwar l-ikel kalabriż u r-rabta tiegħu mal-ħajja ta' kuljum f'Calabria.
formal.en: The event programme includes a talk about Calabrian food and its connection with everyday life in Calabria.
formal.zh: 活动安排包括一场讲座，介绍卡拉布里亚食物及其与当地日常生活的联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tip ta' ikel iservu hawn? Mark: Ikel kalabriż. Trid nippruvawh?
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of food do they serve here? Mark: Calabrian food. Shall we try it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里供应哪种食物？Mark：卡拉布里亚食物。我们尝尝好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这里供应哪种食物？
messages.en: What kind of food do they serve here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 卡拉布里亚食物。我们尝尝好吗？
messages.en: Calabrian food. Shall we try it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalabriż 当作“卡拉布里亚的”地域标签，分别贴在人和食物旁：raġel kalabriż、ikel kalabriż，记住它修饰后面的中文中心概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large, deep pot used for boiling or cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于煮沸液体或烹煮食物的深而大的锅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borma kbira u fonda li tintuża biex jitgħalla l-ilma jew jissajjar l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于煮沸液体或烹煮食物的大型深锅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kaldarun huwa borma kbira u fonda li fiha jista' jitgħalla l-ilma jew jissajjar l-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cauldron is a large, deep pot in which liquids or food are boiled.

collocations.en: boil the water in the cauldron

formal.mt: Għall-ikla tal-komunità, il-koki sajru s-soppa f'kaldarun kbir.
formal.en: For the community meal, the cooks prepared the soup in a large cauldron.
formal.zh: 为准备社区聚餐，厨师们用一口大锅煮了汤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fiex se nsajru s-soppa għal dawn in-nies kollha? Pawlu: Fil-kaldarun il-kbir; hemm biżżejjed spazju fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we cook the soup in for all these people? Pawlu: In the big cauldron; it has enough room.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：给这么多人煮汤，我们用什么锅？保罗：用那口大锅，里面的空间够大。

messages.speaker: Maja (社区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fiex se nsajru s-soppa għal dawn in-nies kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Fiex se nsajru s-soppa għal dawn in-nies kollha?
messages.zh: 给这么多人煮汤，我们用什么锅？
messages.en: What shall we cook the soup in for all these people?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaldarun il-kbir; hemm biżżejjed spazju fih.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaldarun il-kbir; hemm biżżejjed spazju fih.
messages.zh: 用那口大锅，里面的空间够大。
messages.en: In the big cauldron; it has enough room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaldarun 和全村聚餐的大汤锅画面配对：锅深、容量大，记住它表示大锅或大釜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The internal diameter of a gun barrel, or the level of quality or ability of someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 枪管内部的直径；也指人或事物在质量、能力等方面达到的水准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dijametru ta' ġewwa tal-kanna ta' arma tan-nar, jew il-livell ta' kwalità jew ħila ta' persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口径，尤指枪管内部的直径；也可表示人的才干或事物的品质水平。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kalibru jista' jkun id-dijametru ta' ġewwa tal-kanna ta' arma tan-nar, jew il-livell ta' ħila jew kwalità ta' persuna jew ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Calibre can refer to the internal diameter of a gun barrel or to the quality or ability of someone or something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人或事物在能力、质量或表现方面达到的水准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kalibru huwa l-livell ta' kwalità, ħila jew prestazzjoni li jkollha persuna jew ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The standard of someone or something is the level of quality, ability, or performance they achieve.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat faħħar il-kalibru għoli tal-kandidati u l-kwalità tax-xogħol tagħhom.
formal.en: The committee praised the high calibre of the candidates and the quality of their work.
formal.zh: 委员会赞扬了候选人的高水平及其作品的质量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien il-kunċert ilbieraħ? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna! Il-mużiċisti kienu ta' kalibru għoli.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the concert yesterday? Mark: Very good! The musicians were of high calibre.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天的音乐会怎么样？马克：非常好！那些音乐家的水平很高。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的音乐会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the concert yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Il-mużiċisti kienu ta' kalibru għoli.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Il-mużiċisti kienu ta' kalibru għoli.
messages.zh: 非常好！那些音乐家的水平很高。
messages.en: Very good! The musicians were of high calibre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记 kalibru：枪管旁标直径表示口径，音乐家旁标水平表示才干；根据上下文选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to calculate coordinated capacity from the data provided.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据输入数据计算协调容量的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex tiġi kkalkulata l-kapaċità koordinata abbażi tad-data mdaħħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于根据所提供的数据求出协调容量的计算工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kalkolatur tal-kapaċità koordinata huwa għodda li tipproċessa d-data pprovduta biex tagħti riżultat għall-kapaċità koordinata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coordinated capacity calculator is a tool that uses supplied data to calculate coordinated capacity.

collocations.en: the result from the coordinated capacity calculator
collocations.zh: 协调容量计算器给出的结果

formal.mt: Qabel ma inkludiet ir-riżultat fir-rapport, it-tim ivverifika d-data mdaħħla fil-kalkolatur tal-kapaċità koordinata.
formal.en: Before including the result in the report, the team checked the data entered into the coordinated capacity calculator.
formal.zh: 在将结果写入报告之前，团队核查了输入协调容量计算器的数据。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Daħħalt id-data fil-kalkolatur tal-kapaċità koordinata? Karl: Iva, u issa nistgħu niċċekkjaw ir-riżultat flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you entered the data into the coordinated capacity calculator? Karl: Yes, and now we can check the result together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你把数据输入协调容量计算器了吗？卡尔：输入了，现在我们可以一起核查结果。

messages.speaker: Nina (项目同事)
messages.zh: 你把数据输入协调容量计算器了吗？
messages.en: Have you entered the data into the coordinated capacity calculator?

messages.speaker: Karl (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u issa nistgħu niċċekkjaw ir-riżultat flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u issa nistgħu niċċekkjaw ir-riżultat flimkien.
messages.zh: 输入了，现在我们可以一起核查结果。
messages.en: Yes, and now we can check the result together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块记忆：kalkolatur 是计算工具，tal-kapaċità koordinata 说明它计算协调容量；联想输入数据、读取结果的操作。

gloss_zh: 容量计算；容量计算过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The calculation of how much a container, space, or system can hold or handle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 计算容器、空间或系统能够容纳或处理多少的运算或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kalkolu ta' kemm jista' jesa' f'kontenitur jew spazju, jew ta' kemm tista' timmaniġġja sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为求出容器、空间或系统的容纳量或处理能力而进行的计算。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kalkolu tal-kapaċità huwa kalkolu li jsir biex tinstab il-kwantità li jista' jesa' kontenitur jew spazju, jew li tista' timmaniġġja sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A capacity calculation determines how much a container, space, or system can hold or handle.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 求出容量或处理能力的过程，包括使用相关数据并完成所需的计算步骤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess tal-kalkolu tal-kapaċità huwa s-sekwenza ta' passi li fihom tintuża d-data rilevanti u jsiru l-operazzjonijiet meħtieġa biex tinstab il-kapaċità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The capacity calculation process consists of the steps used to determine how much something can hold or handle.

collocations.en: the steps in the capacity calculation process

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi kalkolu tal-kapaċità tat-tank u jispjega l-passi u l-kejl użati.
formal.en: The report includes a calculation of the tank's capacity and explains the steps and measurements used.
formal.zh: 报告包含水箱容量的计算，并说明了采用的步骤和测量数据。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għamilna l-kalkolu tal-kapaċità tat-tank? David: Għad le; l-ewwel irridu nkejlu t-tul, il-wisa' u l-għoli tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have we calculated the tank's capacity? David: Not yet; first we need to measure its length, width, and height.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们计算过水箱的容量了吗？戴维：还没有，得先测量它的长、宽和高。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我们计算过水箱的容量了吗？
messages.en: Have we calculated the tank's capacity?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad le; l-ewwel irridu nkejlu t-tul, il-wisa' u l-għoli tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għad le; l-ewwel irridu nkejlu t-tul, il-wisa' u l-għoli tiegħu.
messages.zh: 还没有，得先测量它的长、宽和高。
messages.en: Not yet; first we need to measure its length, width, and height.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalkolu tal-kapaċità 配上测量水箱、代入数据、求出容量的连续画面，既记住容量计算，也记住整个计算过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electronic device used to perform mathematical calculations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于进行加减乘除等数学运算的电子设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat elettroniku li jintuża biex isiru kalkoli matematiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计算器；用于进行数学运算的电子设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat elettroniku li jagħmel operazzjonijiet matematiċi, bħaż-żieda, it-tnaqqis, il-multiplikazzjoni u d-diviżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A calculator is an electronic device that you use to work out mathematical calculations.

formal.mt: L-istudenti jistgħu jużaw kalkulatur xjentifiku biex jiċċekkjaw it-tweġibiet tagħhom waqt l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: Students may use a scientific calculator to check their answers during the exercise.
formal.zh: 学生可以在练习时使用科学计算器检查自己的答案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek kalkulatur? Irrid niċċekkja t-total. Mark: Iva, hawn wieħed. Tista' tużah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a calculator? I want to check the total. Mark: Yes, here's one. You can use it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有计算器吗？我想核对一下总数。马克：有，这里有一个。你可以用。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你有计算器吗？我想核对一下总数。
messages.en: Do you have a calculator? I want to check the total.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 有，这里有一个。你可以用。
messages.en: Yes, here's one. You can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalkulatur 和英语 calculator 对照记忆，想象按下计算器按键核对总数的画面；这是拼写联想，不是词源分析。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Peaceful or relaxed, without agitation, anxiety, or disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人镇定、不慌乱，或环境宁静、没有扰动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun fi stat ta' paċi jew serħan, mingħajr aġitazzjoni, ansjetà jew taqlib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安详的；宁静的；呈现平和、安宁状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri jew jagħti sens ta' paċi u serħan, mingħajr inkwiet jew taqlib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is serene has a peaceful quality that seems free from worry or disturbance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镇定的；平静的；没有激动、慌乱或明显扰动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx aġitat jew imħawwad, jew li ma jkollux moviment qawwi jew taqlib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person who is calm is not agitated, while a calm place or sea has little disturbance.

formal.mt: Il-kelliem baqa' kalm u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha b'ton ċar u rispettuż.
formal.en: The speaker remained calm and answered all the questions in a clear and respectful tone.
formal.zh: 发言者保持镇定，以清晰而尊重的语气回答了所有问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark, kif qed tibqa' daqshekk kalm qabel l-eżami? Mark: Studjajt sew, u issa qed nieħu ftit nifs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark, how are you staying so calm before the exam? Mark: I've studied well, and now I'm taking a little breather.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克，考试前你怎么还能这么镇定？马克：我已经认真复习过了，现在稍微歇口气。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark, kif qed tibqa' daqshekk kalm qabel l-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Mark, kif qed tibqa' daqshekk kalm qabel l-eżami?
messages.zh: 马克，考试前你怎么还能这么镇定？
messages.en: Mark, how are you staying so calm before the exam?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Studjajt sew, u issa qed nieħu ftit nifs.
messages.mt_standard: Studjajt sew, u issa qed nieħu ftit nifs.
messages.zh: 我已经认真复习过了，现在稍微歇口气。
messages.en: I've studied well, and now I'm taking a little breather.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalm 放进 baħar kalm（平静的海面）这幅画面里，再联想考试前镇定的人；它是描述状态的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of peacefulness or composure without agitation or disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有激动、慌乱或扰动的平静、镇定或宁静状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' paċi jew serħan li fih ma jkunx hemm aġitazzjoni, paniku jew taqlib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平静；安静；没有喧闹、混乱或扰动的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat li fih ma jkunx hemm storbju, taħwid jew taqlib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Calm is a state in which there is little noise, confusion, or disturbance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镇定；沉着；面对压力时不慌乱、不激动的状态或特质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew l-istat ta' persuna li tibqa' serena u ma titħawwadx, anki taħt pressjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Calmness is the quality of remaining composed and untroubled, especially when a situation is difficult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宁静；安宁；令人感到平和、没有烦扰的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' paċi u serħan profond, mingħajr inkwiet jew tfixkil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Serenity is a peaceful state in which you feel free from worry and disturbance.

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju ta' evakwazzjoni, l-għalliema żammew il-kalma u mexxew lill-istudenti lejn il-ħruġ.
formal.en: During the evacuation drill, the teachers kept calm and led the students towards the exit.
formal.zh: 疏散演练期间，教师们保持镇定，带领学生走向出口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nafx minn fejn se nibda b'dan ix-xogħol kollu! Mark: Ħu kollox bil-kalma. Nibdew bl-ewwel ħaġa flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I don't know where to start with all this work! Mark: Take it calmly. Let's start with the first thing together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这么多活儿，我都不知道从哪里开始了！马克：慢慢来，别着急。我们一起从第一件事开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx minn fejn se nibda b'dan ix-xogħol kollu!
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx minn fejn se nibda b'dan ix-xogħol kollu!
messages.zh: 这么多活儿，我都不知道从哪里开始了！
messages.en: I don't know where to start with all this work!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu kollox bil-kalma. Nibdew bl-ewwel ħaġa flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu kollox bil-kalma. Nibdew bl-ewwel ħaġa flimkien.
messages.zh: 慢慢来，别着急。我们一起从第一件事开始。
messages.en: Take it calmly. Let's start with the first thing together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 il-kalma 记成可以“保持”的镇定，把 bil-kalma 记成“从容地”；本词条学名词，勿与形容词的同形形式混淆。

gloss_zh: 镇静药；安定药；抗抑郁药

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medicine used to reduce agitation or anxiety, or, in a separate sense, to treat depression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于减轻激动或焦虑的药物；另一个义项指治疗抑郁症的药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mediċina li tintuża biex tnaqqas l-aġitazzjoni jew l-ansjetà, jew, f'sens ieħor, biex tikkura d-dipressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镇静药；用于降低兴奋或激动程度、可能使人困倦的药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina li tnaqqas l-eċċitament jew l-aġitazzjoni u li tista' ġġib in-ngħas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sedative is a medicine that reduces agitation and may make a person feel sleepy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安定药；用于减轻焦虑或紧张、使人平静的药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina li tintuża biex tnaqqas l-ansjetà jew it-tensjoni u tgħin lil persuna tikkalma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tranquillizer is a medicine used to reduce anxiety or tension and help a person feel calmer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抗抑郁药；用于治疗抑郁症的药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina li tintuża fit-trattament tad-dipressjoni biex tgħin ittaffi s-sintomi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anti-depressive is a medicine used to treat depression and help relieve its symptoms.

collocations.en: to take a sedative or tranquillizer
to prescribe a sedative or tranquillizer
the effect of the sedative or tranquillizer
collocations.zh: 镇静药或安定药的作用

formal.mt: Qabel il-proċedura, it-tabib spjega lill-pazjent għaliex kien se jingħata kalmant u x'effetti seta' jkollu.
formal.en: Before the procedure, the doctor explained to the patient why a sedative would be given and what effects it might have.
formal.zh: 操作开始前，医生向患者解释了为何要使用镇静药，以及它可能产生哪些作用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tabib qalli li se jagħtini kalmant qabel il-proċedura. Maja: Spjegalek x'effett se jkollu? Mark: Iva, qalli li jista' jġibli n-ngħas.
colloquial.en: Mark: The doctor told me I'll be given a sedative before the procedure. Maja: Did the doctor explain what effect it will have? Mark: Yes, the doctor said it might make me sleepy.
colloquial.zh: 马克：医生说，操作前会给我用镇静药。玛雅：医生解释它会有什么作用了吗？马克：解释了，说可能会让我犯困。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tabib qalli li se jagħtini kalmant qabel il-proċedura.
messages.mt_standard: It-tabib qalli li se jagħtini kalmant qabel il-proċedura.
messages.zh: 医生说，操作前会给我用镇静药。
messages.en: The doctor told me I'll be given a sedative before the procedure.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生解释它会有什么作用了吗？
messages.en: Did the doctor explain what effect it will have?

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qalli li jista' jġibli n-ngħas.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qalli li jista' jġibli n-ngħas.
messages.zh: 解释了，说可能会让我犯困。
messages.en: Yes, the doctor said it might make me sleepy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“医生解释药物作用”的场景记 kalmant：先联想镇静药、安定药，再单独记抗抑郁药义；三个义项要依语境区分，不能据词义认定药物可以互换。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A false accusation or statement that damages someone's reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以损害他人名誉为内容的虚假指控或言论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Akkuża jew stqarrija falza li tagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 损害他人名誉的虚假言论或指控；诽谤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kliem jew akkuża falza li tagħmel ħsara lill-isem tajjeb ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Slander is a false spoken statement that damages another person's reputation.

formal.mt: Fl-istqarrija tiegħu, id-direttur ċaħad il-kalunnja u talab li jiġu kkoreġuti l-allegazzjonijiet foloz.
formal.en: In his statement, the director denied the slanderous allegation and asked for the false allegations to be corrected.
formal.zh: 主任在声明中否认了诽谤性指控，并要求纠正这些虚假指控。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qalu li ħadt il-flus tal-grupp. Lara: Dik kalunnja! Għidilhom x'ġara tassew.
colloquial.en: Maja: They said I took the group's money. Lara: That's slander! Tell them what really happened.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们说我拿了小组的钱。拉拉：那是诽谤！把实际发生的事告诉他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们说我拿了小组的钱。
messages.en: They said I took the group's money.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是诽谤！把实际发生的事告诉他们。
messages.en: That's slander! Tell them what really happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalunnja 配上“凭空指控、名誉受损”的画面记忆：核心是虚假中伤，不是普通批评。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has been found guilty of a crime, especially one serving a prison sentence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经认定犯有罪行的人，尤指正在监狱服刑的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li nstabet ħatja ta' reat, speċjalment waħda li qed tiskonta sentenza fil-ħabs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被认定有罪的人，尤指正在服刑的囚犯。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li nstabet ħatja ta' reat u li tista' tkun qed tiskonta piena ta' priġunerija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A convict is someone who has been found guilty of a crime, especially someone serving a prison sentence.

collocations.zh: 对该服刑犯的改造与重返社会支持

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-kalzrat qed jipparteċipa fi programm ta' edukazzjoni waqt li jiskonta s-sentenza tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes how the convict is participating in an education programme while serving his sentence.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这名服刑犯在服刑期间参加教育项目的情况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min hu r-raġel fl-istorja? Nina: Hu kalzrat li qed jistudja fil-ħabs.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is the man in the story? Nina: He's a convict who is studying in prison.
colloquial.zh: 马克：故事里的那个男人是谁？妮娜：他是一名正在监狱里学习的服刑犯。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the man in the story?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu kalzrat li qed jistudja fil-ħabs.
messages.mt_standard: Hu kalzrat li qed jistudja fil-ħabs.
messages.zh: 他是一名正在监狱里学习的服刑犯。
messages.en: He's a convict who is studying in prison.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalzrat 放进“法院已定罪、监狱中服刑”的人物画面里记忆；这里是表示人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written financial instrument that orders or promises payment of a specified sum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 载明支付一定金额的命令或承诺的书面票据，可指汇票或本票。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument finanzjarju bil-miktub li jkun fih ordni jew wegħda biex titħallas somma speċifikata ta' flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汇票：由出票人签发，指示另一方向指定收款人支付一定金额的票据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li bih min joħorġu jordna lil parti oħra tħallas somma speċifikata ta' flus lil benefiċjarju indikat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bill of exchange is a written order directing another party to pay a specified sum to a named recipient.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本票：由出票人书面承诺向指定收款人支付一定金额的票据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li fih min joħorġu jwiegħed bil-miktub li jħallas somma speċifikata ta' flus lil benefiċjarju indikat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A promissory note is a written promise by its issuer to pay a specified sum to a named recipient.

collocations.en: issue a bill of exchange or promissory note
the maturity date of the bill or note

formal.mt: Il-kambjala f'dan l-eżempju fiha wegħda bil-miktub mill-emittent li jħallas elf ewro lill-benefiċjarju fid-data indikata.
formal.en: The promissory note in this example contains a written promise by the issuer to pay the recipient one thousand euros on the stated date.
formal.zh: 本例中的本票载有出票人的书面承诺，约定在注明日期向收款人支付一千欧元。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-kambjala fiha wegħda ta' ħlas jew ordni lil xi ħadd ieħor biex iħallas? Pawlu: Hawnhekk fiha wegħda ta' ħlas minn min ħariġha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this document contain a promise to pay or an order for someone else to pay? Pawlu: Here it contains a promise to pay by the person who issued it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张票据写的是付款承诺，还是要求别人付款的命令？保罗：这里写的是出票人自己的付款承诺。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kambjala fiha wegħda ta' ħlas jew ordni lil xi ħadd ieħor biex iħallas?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kambjala fiha wegħda ta' ħlas jew ordni lil xi ħadd ieħor biex iħallas?
messages.zh: 这张票据写的是付款承诺，还是要求别人付款的命令？
messages.en: Does this document contain a promise to pay or an order for someone else to pay?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk fiha wegħda ta' ħlas minn min ħariġha.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk fiha wegħda ta' ħlas minn min ħariġha.
messages.zh: 这里写的是出票人自己的付款承诺。
messages.en: Here it contains a promise to pay by the person who issued it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kambjala 想成写明金额的付款票据：汇票是“请对方付”，本票是“我承诺付”，结合上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exchange or market where futures contracts are traded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行期货合约交易的交易所或市场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża jew suq fejn jiġu nnegozjati kuntratti tal-futuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 期货交易所：组织期货合约交易的交易机构或平台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża organizzata li tipprovdi pjattaforma u regoli għan-negozjar ta' kuntratti tal-futuri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A futures exchange is an organized trading venue where participants buy and sell standardized futures contracts.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 期货市场：买卖约定未来履约的期货合约的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suq li fih jinxtraw u jinbiegħu kuntratti tal-futuri bi prezz miftiehem għal żmien futur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A futures market is a market in which participants trade contracts for transactions at an agreed future time.

collocations.en: trade on the futures exchange or market
collocations.zh: 在期货交易所或期货市场交易

collocations.en: prices on the futures exchange or market
collocations.zh: 期货交易所或期货市场上的价格

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel il-prezzijiet tal-kuntratti tal-qamħ fil-kambju tal-futuri għal xhur differenti ta' kunsinna.
formal.en: The report compares prices of wheat contracts on the futures market for different delivery months.
formal.zh: 报告比较了期货市场上不同交割月份的小麦合约价格。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jinnegozjaw fil-kambju tal-futuri? Mark: Kuntratti tal-futuri; pereżempju, kuntratti għall-kunsinna tal-qamħ f'xahar speċifikat.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do they trade on the futures exchange? Mark: Futures contracts; for example, contracts for wheat delivery in a specified month.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：期货交易所里交易什么？马克：期货合约，比如约定在指定月份交割小麦的合约。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 期货交易所里交易什么？
messages.en: What do they trade on the futures exchange?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kuntratti tal-futuri; pereżempju, kuntratti għall-kunsinna tal-qamħ f'xahar speċifikat.
messages.mt_standard: Kuntratti tal-futuri; pereżempju, kuntratti għall-kunsinna tal-qamħ f'xahar speċifikat.
messages.zh: 期货合约，比如约定在指定月份交割小麦的合约。
messages.en: Futures contracts; for example, contracts for wheat delivery in a specified month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kambju tal-futuri 整体配上“今天交易合约、约定未来履约”的画面；强调交易机构时译交易所，强调交易活动整体时译市场。

gloss_zh: 岩羚羊；擦拭用的麂皮布

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chamois is a wild mountain animal resembling a goat; the same word can also refer to a soft cleaning cloth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指生活在山地、外形像山羊的岩羚羊，也可指用于擦拭和清洁的柔软麂皮布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kamoxxa hija annimal selvaġġ tal-muntanji li jixbah mogħża; l-istess kelma tista' tfisser ukoll biċċa materjal artab li tintuża għat-tindif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 岩羚羊，一种生活在山地、外形像山羊的野生动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ li jixbah mogħża u jgħix fil-muntanji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chamois is a wild animal resembling a goat that lives in mountainous areas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麂皮擦拭布，用柔软皮革或类似材料制成，用于清洁或擦干物体表面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ġilda ratba jew materjal simili li tintuża biex tnaddaf jew tnixxef l-uċuħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chamois cleaning cloth is a soft piece of leather or similar material used to clean or dry surfaces.

collocations.en: to dry glass with a chamois cloth

formal.mt: Il-gwida spjegat lill-viżitaturi li l-kamoxxa hija annimal selvaġġ li jgħix fil-muntanji.
formal.en: The guide explained to the visitors that the chamois is a wild animal that lives in the mountains.
formal.zh: 导游向游客解释说，岩羚羊是一种生活在山地的野生动物。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandek kamoxxa biex nixxef il-ħġieġ? Pawlu: Iva, ħu din; hija ratba u nadifa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have a chamois cloth so I can dry the glass? Pawlu: Yes, take this one; it is soft and clean.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你有麂皮布吗？我想把玻璃擦干。保罗：有，拿这块吧，又软又干净。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 你有麂皮布吗？我想把玻璃擦干。
messages.en: Do you have a chamois cloth so I can dry the glass?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din; hija ratba u nadifa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din; hija ratba u nadifa.
messages.zh: 有，拿这块吧，又软又干净。
messages.en: Yes, take this one; it is soft and clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kamoxxa 配成两幅学习图：山上站着岩羚羊，手里拿着麂皮布。看到山地语境想动物，看到擦洗语境想清洁布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A camp is a place where people stay temporarily, often in tents or simple buildings, for a shared purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们为共同活动或其他目的暂时居住的营地，常设有帐篷或简易建筑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn grupp ta' nies joqgħod għal żmien qasir, spiss fit-tined jew f'bini sempliċi, għal skop komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 营地，供一群人为某种共同目的暂时驻留或住宿的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn grupp ta' nies joqgħod temporanjament, pereżempju fit-tined, biex jieħu sehem f'attivitajiet jew għal skop ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A camp is a place where people live temporarily, usually in tents or simple accommodation.

formal.mt: Il-kamp tas-sajf se jdum ġimgħa u se joffri attivitajiet sportivi u edukattivi għaż-żgħażagħ.
formal.en: The summer camp will last a week and will offer sporting and educational activities for young people.
formal.zh: 夏令营将持续一周，为青少年提供体育和教育活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se norqdu waqt il-kamp? Mark: Fit-tined, ħdejn il-bini prinċipali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where will we sleep during camp? Mark: In the tents, next to the main building.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：参加营地活动时，我们睡在哪里？马克：睡在主楼旁边的帐篷里。

messages.speaker: Lara (营员)
messages.zh: 参加营地活动时，我们睡在哪里？
messages.en: Where will we sleep during camp?

messages.speaker: Mark (营员)
messages.zh: 睡在主楼旁边的帐篷里。
messages.en: In the tents, next to the main building.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kamp 记成地图上画着几顶帐篷的营地标记，再用 kamp tas-sajf 联想夏令营，用 kamp tat-taħriġ 联想训练营。

gloss_zh: 运动；宣传活动；乡间；农村地区

teaching_sense.en_definition: A campaign is an organized series of activities aimed at a goal; the same Maltese word also means the countryside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指为实现某个目标而组织的一系列活动，如宣传运动；也可指城镇以外的乡间或农村地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' attivitajiet organizzati biex jintlaħaq għan; l-istess kelma tfisser ukoll l-art u l-inħawi rurali barra l-ibliet u l-irħula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为达到特定目标而有组织地开展的一系列活动，如竞选、宣传或公益运动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' attivitajiet organizzati u marbuta ma' xulxin biex jintlaħaq għan partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A campaign is a planned series of activities intended to achieve a particular aim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乡间、农村地区，指城镇以外以田野和开阔土地为主的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-inħawi barra l-ibliet u l-irħula fejn ikun hemm għelieqi, art miftuħa u spazji naturali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The countryside consists of rural areas outside towns and cities, including fields and open land.

formal.mt: L-iskola nediet kampanja biex tħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jaqraw kuljum.
formal.en: The school launched a campaign to encourage students to read every day.
formal.zh: 学校发起了一项活动，鼓励学生每天阅读。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid immorru nimxu fil-kampanja nhar il-Ħadd? David: Iva, nixtieq ngħaddi ftit ħin barra mill-belt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we go for a walk in the countryside on Sunday? David: Yes, I would like to spend some time outside the city.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：星期天我们去乡间散步好吗？戴维：好，我想去城外待一会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid immorru nimxu fil-kampanja nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Trid immorru nimxu fil-kampanja nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 星期天我们去乡间散步好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go for a walk in the countryside on Sunday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq ngħaddi ftit ħin barra mill-belt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq ngħaddi ftit ħin barra mill-belt.
messages.zh: 好，我想去城外待一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, I would like to spend some time outside the city.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kampanja 建两个场景：一张竞选宣传海报代表有目标的活动，一片乡间田野代表农村。用搭配判断当句是在说活动还是地点。

gloss_zh: 农民；乡下人；乡巴佬（贬义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A peasant is a person who lives in the countryside and works the land; this word can also disparagingly describe someone as an unsophisticated rural person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指住在乡间、从事耕作的人；带贬义使用时，则把人说成缺乏见识或不懂世故的乡巴佬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħix fil-kampanja u taħdem l-art; il-kelma tista' tintuża wkoll b'mod dispreġġjattiv għal persuna meqjusa nieqsa mill-esperjenza jew mir-raffinament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 农民，指生活在乡村并以耕种土地为生的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħix fil-kampanja u taqla' l-għajxien tagħha billi taħdem l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A peasant is a person who lives in a rural area and earns a living by farming.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乡巴佬，对被认为缺乏见识或不懂世故的乡下人的贬称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma dispreġġjattiva għal persuna mill-kampanja li titqies bla esperjenza jew nieqsa mir-raffinament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A yokel is a person from the countryside whom someone describes insultingly as unsophisticated or inexperienced.

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi l-ħajja ta' kampanjol li jaħdem l-art biex imantni lill-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: The story describes the life of a peasant who works the land to support his family.
formal.zh: 这个故事描写了一位靠耕种土地养家的农民的生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex sejjaħtlu kampanjol? Għax ma jafx din il-belt? Toni: Għandek raġun, ma kellix nuża dik il-kelma bħala insult.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you call him a yokel? Because he does not know this city? Toni: You are right; I should not have used that word as an insult.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么叫他乡巴佬？就因为他不熟悉这座城市？托尼：你说得对，我不该用这个词侮辱他。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejjaħtlu kampanjol? Għax ma jafx din il-belt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejjaħtlu kampanjol? Għax ma jafx din il-belt?
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他乡巴佬？就因为他不熟悉这座城市？
messages.en: Why did you call him a yokel? Because he does not know this city?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, ma kellix nuża dik il-kelma bħala insult.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, ma kellix nuża dik il-kelma bħala insult.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我不该用这个词侮辱他。
messages.en: You are right; I should not have used that word as an insult.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kampanjol 放进两句学习台词：故事描写耕田者时记作农民，嘲笑别人没见识时理解为乡巴佬；同时记住后一义带贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who rings bells, especially church bells.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责敲响钟，尤其是教堂钟的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddoqq il-qniepen, speċjalment dawk ta' knisja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敲钟人；负责敲响教堂等场所的钟的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha jew dmirha hu li ddoqq il-qniepen.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bellringer is someone whose job or duty is to ring bells.

formal.mt: Il-kampanologo daqq il-qniepen tal-knisja qabel ma bdiet iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The bellringer rang the church bells before the ceremony began.
formal.zh: 仪式开始前，敲钟人敲响了教堂的钟。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min qed idoqq il-qniepen? Pawlu: Il-kampanologo tal-knisja. Dalwaqt tibda l-quddiesa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is ringing the bells? Pawlu: The church bellringer. Mass will begin soon.
colloquial.zh: Marija：谁在敲钟？Pawlu：教堂的敲钟人。弥撒很快就要开始了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁在敲钟？
messages.en: Who is ringing the bells?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 教堂的敲钟人。弥撒很快就要开始了。
messages.en: The church bellringer. Mass will begin soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kampanologo 和钟楼里负责敲钟的人连成一幅画面：这个词指人，画面中的钟则是他操作的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sporting competition held to decide who wins a championship title.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过比赛决出某项运动冠军的赛事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni sportiva li fiha plejers jew timijiet jikkompetu biex jintgħażel ir-rebbieħ tat-titlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锦标赛；为决出冠军而举行的体育赛事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni sportiva magħmula minn logħba jew sensiela ta' logħbiet li tiddetermina min jirbaħ it-titlu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A championship is a sporting competition that determines which player or team wins the title.

formal.mt: It-tim rebaħ il-kampjonat nazzjonali wara staġun ta' riżultati tajbin.
formal.en: The team won the national championship after a season of good results.
formal.zh: 经过一个赛季的出色表现，该队赢得了全国锦标赛冠军。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min rebaħ il-kampjonat din is-sena? Mark: It-tim tagħna! Irbaħna l-aħħar logħba lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who won the championship this year? Mark: Our team! We won the last match yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今年谁赢得了锦标赛冠军？Mark：我们队！我们昨天赢了最后一场比赛。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今年谁赢得了锦标赛冠军？
messages.en: Who won the championship this year?

messages.speaker: Mark (球队队员)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tim tagħna! Irbaħna l-aħħar logħba lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: It-tim tagħna! Irbaħna l-aħħar logħba lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 我们队！我们昨天赢了最后一场比赛。
messages.en: Our team! We won the last match yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kampjonat 时想象赛程表最后通向冠军奖杯，再把 jirbaħ il-kampjonat 整块记成“赢得锦标赛冠军”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small quantity or representative example used to examine or understand something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供检查、研究或了解某事物而取出的一小部分，或能代表某类事物的实例。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont żgħir jew eżempju rappreżentattiv ta' xi ħaġa, użat biex tiġi eżaminata jew mifhuma aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 样品；样本；从整体中取出供检验、试用或比较的一小部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti żgħira minn prodott, materjal jew kwantità akbar, meħuda biex tiġi ttestjata, ippruvata jew imqabbla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sample is a small amount taken from something so that its qualities can be examined.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标本；供观察、研究或展示的单个生物、物体或材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organiżmu, oġġett jew materjal individwali magħżul jew miġbur għall-osservazzjoni, għall-istudju jew għall-wiri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A specimen is an individual organism, object, or piece of material kept for study or display.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 类型；种类；按共同特征区分的一类人或事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip jew kategorija ta' persuni jew affarijiet li għandhom ċerti karatteristiċi komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A type is a category of people or things that share particular characteristics.

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju analizza kampjun tal-ilma biex jivverifika l-kwalità tiegħu.
formal.en: The laboratory analysed a water sample to check its quality.
formal.zh: 实验室分析了一份水样，以检查水质。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nieħu kampjun ta' dan id-drapp? Rita: Iva, ħudu miegħek biex tara jekk il-kulur jaqbilx mal-purtieri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I take a sample of this fabric? Rita: Yes, take it with you to see whether the colour matches the curtains.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我可以拿一块这种布料的样品吗？Rita：可以，带回去看看颜色是否与窗帘相配。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nieħu kampjun ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nieħu kampjun ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.zh: 我可以拿一块这种布料的样品吗？
messages.en: Can I take a sample of this fabric?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħudu miegħek biex tara jekk il-kulur jaqbilx mal-purtieri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħudu miegħek biex tara jekk il-kulur jaqbilx mal-purtieri.
messages.zh: 可以，带回去看看颜色是否与窗帘相配。
messages.en: Yes, take it with you to see whether the colour matches the curtains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张学习卡区分 kampjun：布料小片对应“样品”，供研究的植物对应“标本”，按共同特征分组对应“类型”；读句子时靠语境选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unoccupied room that is available for someone to use or stay in.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未被占用、可供使用或入住的房间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra li mhix okkupata u li hija disponibbli biex tintuża jew biex xi ħadd joqgħod fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空房；住宿场所中尚未被占用、可供入住的房间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra disponibbli f'lukanda jew f'post ieħor ta' akkomodazzjoni, li għadha mhix okkupata u tista' tingħata lil mistieden.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vacancy is an available room in a hotel or another place where people can stay.

collocations.en: a room available for the night

formal.mt: Il-lukanda kkonfermat li għandha kamra libera għal żewġ persuni għal-lejl tas-Sibt.
formal.en: The hotel confirmed that it has a room available for two people for Saturday night.
formal.zh: 酒店确认星期六晚上有一间可供两人入住的空房。

colloquial.mt: David: Għandkom kamra libera għal-lejla? Elena: Iva, għandna waħda għal żewġ persuni. Trid taraha?
colloquial.en: David: Do you have a room available for tonight? Elena: Yes, we have one for two people. Would you like to see it?
colloquial.zh: David：今晚有空房吗？Elena：有，我们有一间双人房。您想看看吗？

messages.speaker: David (旅客)
messages.zh: 今晚有空房吗？
messages.en: Do you have a room available for tonight?

messages.speaker: Elena (酒店前台接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna waħda għal żewġ persuni. Trid taraha?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna waħda għal żewġ persuni. Trid taraha?
messages.zh: 有，我们有一间双人房。您想看看吗？
messages.en: Yes, we have one for two people. Would you like to see it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kamra libera 配上一扇等待客人入住的房门，整组记成“有空房可入住”；在酒店问空房时可套用 Għandkom kamra libera?。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room where the bodies of people who have died are kept temporarily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂时存放死者遗体的房间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra fejn jinżammu temporanjament l-iġsma ta' persuni li mietu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供暂时存放死者遗体使用的房间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra użata biex jinżammu fiha temporanjament l-iġsma ta' persuni mejta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mortuary is a room where the bodies of people who have died are kept temporarily.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi għandhom jistaqsu fir-riċeviment qabel jidħlu fil-kamra mortwarja.
formal.en: Visitors should ask at reception before entering the mortuary.
formal.zh: 访客进入停尸房前应先向接待处询问。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hi l-kamra mortwarja? Pawlu: Ma nafx eżatt. Ejja nistaqsu fir-riċeviment.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the mortuary? Pawlu: I don't know exactly. Let's ask at reception.
colloquial.zh: Marija：停尸房在哪里？Pawlu：我不太清楚。我们去接待处问问吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (访客)
messages.zh: 停尸房在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the mortuary?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (陪同者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx eżatt. Ejja nistaqsu fir-riċeviment.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx eżatt. Ejja nistaqsu fir-riċeviment.
messages.zh: 我不太清楚。我们去接待处问问吧。
messages.en: I don't know exactly. Let's ask at reception.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与医院里安静、庄重的遗体暂存室画面联系，记住它表示停尸房。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room intended to accommodate one person, especially in a hotel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供一人入住的房间，尤指旅馆中的单人房。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra maħsuba biex toqgħod fiha persuna waħda, speċjalment f'lukanda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为一位住客提供住宿的单人房间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra għall-akkomodazzjoni ta' persuna waħda, bħal f'lukanda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A single room is a room intended for one person to stay in, especially at a hotel.

collocations.en: a single room for one night

formal.mt: Nixtieq nibbukkja kamra singola għal żewġt iljieli, jekk jogħġbok.
formal.en: I would like to book a single room for two nights, please.
formal.zh: 我想预订一间单人房，住两晚，谢谢。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom kamra singola għal-lejla? Lara: Iva, għandna waħda. Trid tibbukkjaha?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a single room for tonight? Lara: Yes, we have one. Would you like to book it?
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们今晚有单人房吗？Lara：有，我们有一间。你想预订吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (住客)
messages.zh: 你们今晚有单人房吗？
messages.en: Do you have a single room for tonight?

messages.speaker: Lara (前台接待员)
messages.zh: 有，我们有一间。你想预订吗？
messages.en: Yes, we have one. Would you like to book it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预订页面上一间房只对应一位住客，把整个短语与单人入住的画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room containing a bath or shower where people wash themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设有浴缸或淋浴设施、供人洗澡的房间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra li fiha banju jew doċċa u fejn in-nies jinħaslu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供洗浴使用、通常设有浴缸或淋浴设施的浴室。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra użata għall-ħasil tal-ġisem, li normalment ikollha banju jew doċċa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bathroom is a room where you wash yourself, usually containing a bath or shower.

formal.mt: Il-kamra tal-banju għandha tinżamm nadifa u ventilata tajjeb.
formal.en: The bathroom should be kept clean and well ventilated.
formal.zh: 浴室应保持清洁，并维持良好通风。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hi l-kamra tal-banju? Sara: Fl-aħħar tal-kuritur, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the bathroom? Sara: At the end of the corridor, on the left.
colloquial.zh: Nina：浴室在哪里？Sara：在走廊尽头，左手边。

messages.speaker: Nina (来访的朋友)
messages.zh: 浴室在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bathroom?

messages.speaker: Sara (主人)
messages.zh: 在走廊尽头，左手边。
messages.en: At the end of the corridor, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语贴在脑海中的浴室门上，门后想象浴缸、淋浴和毛巾，帮助记住洗浴用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A symbol used in this exercise to refer to a dog belonging to them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本练习中表示“他们的狗”的符号，指属于他们的狗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Simbolu li f'dan l-eżerċizzju jirreferi għal kelb li jappartjeni lilhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们的狗，即属于他们的狗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelb tagħhom, jiġifieri kelb li jappartjeni lilhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Their dog is a dog that belongs to them.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, is-simbolu 'Kamrithom' jirreferi għall-kelb tagħhom.
formal.en: In this exercise, the symbol 'Kamrithom' refers to their dog.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，符号“Kamrithom”指他们的狗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser is-simbolu 'Kamrithom' hawn? Toni: F'dan l-eżerċizzju jfisser 'il-kelb tagħhom'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the symbol 'Kamrithom' mean here? Toni: In this exercise, it means 'their dog'.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的符号“Kamrithom”是什么意思？Toni：在本练习中，它表示“他们的狗”。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的符号“Kamrithom”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the symbol 'Kamrithom' mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.zh: 在本练习中，它表示“他们的狗”。
messages.en: In this exercise, it means 'their dog'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本题给定对应关系，把这个符号与几位主人身旁的一只狗配成记忆卡，记作“他们的狗”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A passage through which water flows, or a medium through which information or programmes are transmitted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供水流通过的通道，或用于传递信息、播放节目的渠道或频道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Passaġġ li minnu jgħaddi l-ilma, jew mezz li bih titwassal informazzjoni jew jixxandru programmi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供水流通过的水道，或传递信息、播送节目的渠道或频道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kanal huwa passaġġ għall-ilma jew mezz li jintuża biex titwassal informazzjoni jew jixxandru programmi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A channel is a passage carrying water or a medium through which information or programmes are transmitted.

formal.mt: Il-kanal iwassal l-ilma mix-xmara lejn l-għelieqi.
formal.en: The channel carries water from the river to the fields.
formal.zh: 这条水道把河水引向田地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq liema kanal hemm il-film? Mark: Fuq il-kanal li konna qed naraw ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which channel is the film on? Mark: On the channel we were watching yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影在哪个频道播？马克：就在我们昨天看的那个频道。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影在哪个频道播？
messages.en: Which channel is the film on?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-kanal li konna qed naraw ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-kanal li konna qed naraw ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 就在我们昨天看的那个频道。
messages.en: On the channel we were watching yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kanal 想成一条供东西通过的通道：水从水道流过，节目从频道传来，再用两个搭配分别记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A comfortable upholstered seat with a back, usually large enough for two or more people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带靠背和软垫、通常可供两人或多人坐的沙发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamara b'dahar u b'kuxxini, magħmula biex żewġ persuni jew aktar ikunu jistgħu joqogħdu bilqiegħda komdi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常可供两人或多人坐的软垫长沙发。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kanapè huwa għamara b'dahar u b'kuxxini li fuqha jistgħu joqogħdu bilqiegħda żewġ persuni jew aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A couch is a comfortable padded seat on which two or more people can sit.

formal.mt: Fis-sala ta' stennija hemm kanapè komdu għall-viżitaturi.
formal.en: There is a comfortable couch for visitors in the waiting room.
formal.zh: 候客室里有一张供访客使用的舒适沙发。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kuxxini? Pawlu: Poġġihom fuq il-kanapè, ħdejja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put these cushions? Pawlu: Put them on the couch, next to me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些靠垫放在哪里？保罗：放在沙发上，我旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这些靠垫放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these cushions?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 放在沙发上，我旁边。
messages.en: Put them on the couch, next to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象回家后坐进柔软沙发的画面，把 kanapè 与靠垫、靠背一起记住；抄写时特别留意末尾的 è。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bird, often yellow, that is known for its song and is commonly kept as a pet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种以鸣唱著称、常被作为宠物饲养的小鸟，羽毛常呈黄色，即金丝雀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir, spiss isfar, magħruf għall-għana tiegħu u li ħafna nies iżommu bħala annimal domestiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金丝雀，一种常为黄色、以悦耳鸣唱闻名的小型鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kanarin huwa għasfur żgħir li spiss ikollu rix isfar u li huwa magħruf għall-għana tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A canary is a small bird, often yellow, which people commonly keep for its pleasant song.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw kanarin isfar u semgħu l-għana tiegħu.
formal.en: The students observed a yellow canary and listened to its song.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一只黄色的金丝雀，并聆听了它的鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tisma' dak l-għasfur? Ninu: Iva, dak il-kanarin ta' oħti. Kull filgħodu jgħanni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you hear that bird? Ninu: Yes, that's my sister's canary. It sings every morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见那只鸟的叫声了吗？尼努：听见了，那是我姐姐的金丝雀。它每天早上都唱歌。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那只鸟的叫声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that bird?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak il-kanarin ta' oħti. Kull filgħodu jgħanni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak il-kanarin ta' oħti. Kull filgħodu jgħanni.
messages.zh: 听见了，那是我姐姐的金丝雀。它每天早上都唱歌。
messages.en: Yes, that's my sister's canary. It sings every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kanarin 配上一只黄色小鸟清晨唱歌的画面，同时记住 kanarin isfar 和金丝雀的鸣唱，形成颜色与声音的双重联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who applies for a position or is proposed or stands for election to an office.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 申请某个职位，或被提名、参加选举以争取某项职务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tapplika għal impjieg jew li tiġi proposta jew toħroġ għal elezzjoni biex tokkupa kariga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 职位申请人、应聘者，或某项职务选举中的候选人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kandidat huwa persuna li tkun qed titqies għal impjieg jew kariga, jew li toħroġ għal elezzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A candidate is someone who applies for a position or competes in an election for an office.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat se jintervista lil kull kandidat qabel jagħżel persuna għall-impjieg.
formal.en: The committee will interview every candidate before choosing someone for the job.
formal.zh: 委员会将在选定该职位的人选之前面试每一位应聘者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak li qed jistenna barra? Mark: Dak kandidat għall-impjieg. Għandu intervista fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that waiting outside? Mark: He's a candidate for the job. He has an interview at ten.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：外面等着的那个人是谁？马克：他是这个职位的应聘者，十点有面试。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jistenna barra?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jistenna barra?
messages.zh: 外面等着的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that waiting outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kandidat għall-impjieg. Għandu intervista fl-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kandidat għall-impjieg. Għandu intervista fl-għaxra.
messages.zh: 他是这个职位的应聘者，十点有面试。
messages.en: He's a candidate for the job. He has an interview at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kandidat 放进两幅画面：等候面试的人和参加选举的人。两者都在争取一个职位，借此记住应聘者与候选人两个用法。

gloss_zh: 未获接纳的候选人；未获录取或未能当选者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A candidate whose application was rejected or who was not selected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 申请未获接纳，或在选拔过程中未被选中的候选人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ressqet kandidatura jew applikazzjoni iżda ma ġietx aċċettata jew magħżula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 申请或候选资格遭到拒绝的候选人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li l-applikazzjoni jew il-kandidatura tagħha ġiet miċħuda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rejected candidate is someone whose application or candidacy has been turned down.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加选拔但最终未获录取、任用或当选的候选人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ħadet sehem fi proċess ta' għażla iżda ma kisbitx il-post jew il-kariga li xtaqet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An unsuccessful candidate is someone who takes part in a selection process but does not obtain the position.

collocations.mt: kandidat li ma ġiex aċċettat għall-impjieg
collocations.en: a candidate who was not accepted for the job
collocations.zh: 未获该职位录用的候选人

collocations.mt: rispons lil kandidat li ma ġiex aċċettat
collocations.zh: 给未获录取候选人的反馈

formal.mt: Kull kandidat li ma ġiex aċċettat jista' jitlob spjegazzjoni bil-miktub dwar id-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: Every unsuccessful candidate may request a written explanation of the decision.
formal.zh: 每位未获录取的候选人均可要求获得有关该决定的书面说明。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien kandidat li ma ġiex aċċettat. Taħseb li għandi nitlob rispons? Lara: Iva, jista' jgħinek tipprepara aħjar għall-intervista li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm an unsuccessful candidate. Do you think I should ask for feedback? Lara: Yes, it could help you prepare better for your next interview.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我是未获录取的候选人。你觉得我该要求反馈吗？Lara：该啊，这能帮你更好地准备下一次面试。

messages.speaker: Mark (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien kandidat li ma ġiex aċċettat. Taħseb li għandi nitlob rispons?
messages.mt_standard: Jien kandidat li ma ġiex aċċettat. Taħseb li għandi nitlob rispons?
messages.zh: 我是未获录取的候选人。你觉得我该要求反馈吗？
messages.en: I'm an unsuccessful candidate. Do you think I should ask for feedback?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jista' jgħinek tipprepara aħjar għall-intervista li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jista' jgħinek tipprepara aħjar għall-intervista li jmiss.
messages.zh: 该啊，这能帮你更好地准备下一次面试。
messages.en: Yes, it could help you prepare better for your next interview.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组短语分成“候选人＋未被接纳”来记，想象申请名单上没有获得录取标记的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slender candle or a stick of tallow used as a candle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细长的照明蜡烛，或用兽脂制成、可作蜡烛燃烧的烛条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xemgħa rqiqa u twila, jew biċċa xaħam tal-annimali magħmula f'għamla ta' stikka biex tinxtegħel bħal xemgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细长的蜡烛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xemgħa rqiqa u twila li tinxtegħel biex tagħti d-dawl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A taper is a long, thin candle that you burn to provide light.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用兽脂制成、供点燃照明的烛条。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stikka magħmula mix-xaħam tal-annimali u maħsuba biex tinxtegħel bħal xemgħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tallow stick is a piece of animal fat formed into a candle for lighting.

formal.mt: Għad-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliem poġġa kandiletta f'gandlier u xegħelha biex juri kif tagħti d-dawl.
formal.en: For the demonstration, the teacher placed a taper in a candlestick and lit it to show how it provides light.
formal.zh: 演示时，老师把一支细长蜡烛放进烛台，点燃后展示它如何照明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi din il-kandiletta? Pawlu: Poġġiha fil-gandlier, u nġib is-sulfarini biex nixegħluha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put this taper? Pawlu: Put it in the candlestick, and I'll get the matches so we can light it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这支细长蜡烛放哪里？Pawlu：放进烛台吧，我去拿火柴来点燃它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这支细长蜡烛放哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this taper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fil-gandlier, u nġib is-sulfarini biex nixegħluha.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fil-gandlier, u nġib is-sulfarini biex nixegħluha.
messages.zh: 放进烛台吧，我去拿火柴来点燃它。
messages.en: Put it in the candlestick, and I'll get the matches so we can light it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一支细烛插进烛台”的画面记住 kandiletta；两个义项分别关注细长外形和兽脂材料。

gloss_zh: 供藤蔓攀附的格架；棚架

teaching_sense.en_definition: A framework of crossing strips or rods used to support climbing plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用交叉排列的条材或杆材搭成、供攀缘植物附着生长的格架。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura magħmula minn strixxi jew vireg imsallba li sservi ta' appoġġ għall-pjanti li jitilgħu magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由交叉条材或杆材组成、用来支撑藤蔓等攀缘植物的格架。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qafas ta' strixxi jew vireg imsallba li fuqu jistgħu jitilgħu u jistrieħu pjanti bħad-dwieli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trellis is a framework that supports climbing plants as they grow upwards or spread.

collocations.en: to attach a trellis to the wall
collocations.zh: 把攀藤格架固定在墙上

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar waħħal kanizzata mal-ħajt biex il-pjanta jkollha appoġġ waqt li tikber.
formal.en: The gardener attached a trellis to the wall to support the plant as it grows.
formal.zh: 园丁把攀藤格架固定在墙上，为植物生长提供支撑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-pjanta għandha bżonn kanizzata? Toni: Iva, poġġi waħda warajha biex tkun tista' titla' magħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this plant need a trellis? Toni: Yes, put one behind it so it can climb up it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这株植物需要攀藤架吗？Toni：需要，在它后面放一个，让它能沿着架子往上爬。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺初学者)
messages.zh: 这株植物需要攀藤架吗？
messages.en: Does this plant need a trellis?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, poġġi waħda warajha biex tkun tista' titla' magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, poġġi waħda warajha biex tkun tista' titla' magħha.
messages.zh: 需要，在它后面放一个，让它能沿着架子往上爬。
messages.en: Yes, put one behind it so it can climb up it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象藤蔓沿着交叉格架逐格向上爬，把 kanizzata 与“植物攀爬用的格架”整幅画面联结。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The zodiac sign represented by a crab.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以螃蟹为象征的黄道十二星座之一，即巨蟹座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed mis-sinjali taż-żodijaku, irrappreżentat minn granċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巨蟹座，即以螃蟹为象征的黄道星座。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sinjal taż-żodijaku li għandu l-granċ bħala s-simbolu tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cancer is the sign of the zodiac that is represented by a crab.

collocations.en: born under the sign of Cancer

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tas-sinjali taż-żodijaku, il-Kankru huwa rrappreżentat minn granċ.
formal.en: In the chart of zodiac signs, Cancer is represented by a crab.
formal.zh: 在黄道十二星座图表中，巨蟹座以螃蟹表示。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu s-sinjal tiegħek? Mark: Is-sinjal tiegħi huwa l-Kankru. Nina: Mela s-simbolu tiegħu huwa granċ!
colloquial.en: Nina: What's your zodiac sign? Mark: My sign is Cancer. Nina: So its symbol is a crab!
colloquial.zh: Nina：你是什么星座？Mark：我是巨蟹座。Nina：那它的符号就是螃蟹啦！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是什么星座？
messages.en: What's your zodiac sign?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我是巨蟹座。
messages.en: My sign is Cancer.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那它的符号就是螃蟹啦！
messages.en: So its symbol is a crab!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kankru 写在十二星座图里的螃蟹旁，建立“Kankru—Cancer—巨蟹座”的三语图像联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hollow pipe or tube through which something can pass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内部中空、可让水、空气或其他物质通过的管子或管状物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett tawwali u vojt minn ġewwa li minnu jistgħu jgħaddu l-ilma, l-arja jew materjali oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于输送水、气体等物质的管道或管子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pajp vojt minn ġewwa li jintuża biex iwassal l-ilma, il-gass jew sustanzi oħra minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pipe is a hollow object that carries water, gas, or another substance from one place to another.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内部中空的细长管状物，可用于容纳或传送物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett tawwali, ġeneralment ċilindriku u vojt minn ġewwa, li jista' jintuża biex iżomm jew jgħaddi sustanza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tube is a long hollow object that can contain a substance or allow it to pass through.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, instabet toqba fil-kanna tal-ilma u ġiet irrakkomandata t-tiswija tagħha.
formal.en: During the inspection, a hole was found in the water pipe, and its repair was recommended.
formal.zh: 检查时发现水管上有一个孔，因此建议进行维修。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm l-ilma mal-art? Pawlu: Il-kanna qed tnixxi. Se nċempel lill-plamer.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there water on the floor? Pawlu: The pipe is leaking. I'll call the plumber.
colloquial.zh: Lara：地上怎么有水？Pawlu：管子漏水了。我会打电话叫水管工。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 地上怎么有水？
messages.en: Why is there water on the floor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kanna qed tnixxi. Se nċempel lill-plamer.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kanna qed tnixxi. Se nċempel lill-plamer.
messages.zh: 管子漏水了。我会打电话叫水管工。
messages.en: The pipe is leaking. I'll call the plumber.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kanna 配上一根中空管子的图：强调输送用途时记作管道，强调中空形状时记作管状物。

gloss_zh: 板条箱；运输用的坚固箱子（复数）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong containers used for carrying, storing, or transporting goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于搬运、储存或运输货物的坚固箱子，通常指板条箱等运输箱；此处为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxi b'saħħithom li jintużaw biex jinġarru, jinħażnu jew jiġu ttrasportati prodotti u oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于包装、储存或运输货物的坚固箱子，常为板条箱；复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kaxxi b'saħħithom, spiss magħmula minn twavel tal-injam, li jintużaw għall-ippakkjar, għall-ħażna jew għat-trasport tal-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Crates are strong containers in which goods are packed, stored, or transported.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema poġġew il-ħaxix fil-kannestri tal-injam u għabbewhom fuq it-trakk għat-trasport.
formal.en: The workers placed the vegetables in wooden crates and loaded them onto the truck for transport.
formal.zh: 工人把蔬菜放进木制板条箱，再将箱子装上卡车运输。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kannestri vojta? Mark: Poġġihom ħdejn il-bieb. Se nużawhom għall-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where should I put these empty crates? Mark: Put them by the door. We'll use them for the vegetables.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这些空箱子放在哪里？Mark：放在门边吧。我们要用它们装蔬菜。

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 这些空箱子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these empty crates?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġihom ħdejn il-bieb. Se nużawhom għall-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġihom ħdejn il-bieb. Se nużawhom għall-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 放在门边吧。我们要用它们装蔬菜。
messages.en: Put them by the door. We'll use them for the vegetables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kannestri 和一排装蔬菜的运输箱一起记，看到 dawn il-kannestri 就联想到这些箱子，牢记此处是复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chamber or building used for burial or for keeping human remains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于安葬死者或存放遗骨的墓室、地下空间或建筑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra jew binja li tintuża għad-dfin tal-mejtin jew biex jinżammu fiha l-għadam u fdalijiet umani oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于安放棺木或安葬死者的墓室。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra magħluqa li tintuża għad-dfin jew biex jitqiegħdu fiha t-twiebet tal-mejtin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A burial vault is a chamber in which coffins or the bodies of dead people are placed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常位于教堂下方、用于安葬死者的地下墓室。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra taħt l-art, spiss taħt knisja, li tintuża għad-dfin tal-mejtin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crypt is an underground chamber, often beneath a church, where dead people are buried.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于集中存放死者骨骸的建筑或藏骨所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Binja jew post fejn jinġabru u jinżammu l-għadam u l-fdalijiet tal-mejtin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A charnel house is a building where human bones and other remains of dead people are kept.

collocations.en: the bones in the charnel house

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kannierja taħt il-knisja u l-fdalijiet umani li nstabu fiha.
formal.en: The report describes the crypt beneath the church and the human remains found inside it.
formal.zh: 报告描述了教堂下方的地下墓室，以及在其中发现的人类遗骸。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'hemm wara dak il-bieb? Ġużi: Hemm taraġ li jinżel għall-kannierja taħt il-knisja.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's behind that door? Ġużi: There are stairs leading down to the crypt beneath the church.
colloquial.zh: Anna：那扇门后面有什么？Ġużi：有一道楼梯，通往教堂下面的地下墓室。

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 那扇门后面有什么？
messages.en: What's behind that door?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm taraġ li jinżel għall-kannierja taħt il-knisja.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm taraġ li jinżel għall-kannierja taħt il-knisja.
messages.zh: 有一道楼梯，通往教堂下面的地下墓室。
messages.en: There are stairs leading down to the crypt beneath the church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用安放遗骸的空间串联 kanna 以外的这个词 kannierja：棺木对应墓室，教堂地下对应地下墓室，集中存骨对应藏骨所。

gloss_zh: 格栅；凉棚；大型捕鱼浮具（尤用于捕鲯鳅）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lattice or garden arbour, or a large fishing float used especially when fishing for dorado.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指格栅、花园中的凉棚，也可指大型捕鱼浮具，尤其用于捕捞鲯鳅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura bi strixxi li jaqsmu lil xulxin, għarix li jagħti d-dell fil-ġnien, jew struttura kbira li żżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma u tintuża speċjalment għas-sajd tal-lampuki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由交叉条材组成、其间留有规则空隙的格栅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura magħmula minn strixxi li jaqsmu lil xulxin u jħallu fetħiet regolari bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lattice is a framework of crossing strips with regular spaces between them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花园中供人乘凉或休息的小凉棚，常有攀缘植物覆盖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għarix żgħir fil-ġnien li jagħti d-dell u post fejn wieħed jista' jistrieħ, spiss miksi bi pjanti li jitilgħu miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An arbour is a sheltered place in a garden, often covered with climbing plants, where people can sit.

sense_translations.en_definition: large fishing float (used especially during fishing for dorado)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鱼用的大型漂浮装置，尤其用于捕捞鲯鳅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura kbira li żżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma u tintuża fis-sajd, speċjalment meta jinqabdu l-lampuki.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This kind of fishing float is a large floating structure used especially when fishing for dorado.

collocations.en: a large float for dorado fishing
collocations.zh: 捕捞鲯鳅用的大型浮具

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-ġnien jinkludi kannizzata miksija bi pjanti li jitilgħu magħha biex toffri d-dell lill-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The garden plan includes an arbour covered with climbing plants to provide shade for visitors.
formal.zh: 花园规划中设有一座覆盖攀缘植物的凉棚，为访客提供遮阴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se noqogħdu nieħdu kafè? Toni: Taħt il-kannizzata fil-ġnien. Hemm id-dell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we sit and have coffee? Toni: Under the arbour in the garden. It's shady there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们坐在哪里喝咖啡？Toni：坐在花园的凉棚下面吧。那里有阴凉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐在哪里喝咖啡？
messages.en: Where shall we sit and have coffee?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 坐在花园的凉棚下面吧。那里有阴凉。
messages.en: Under the arbour in the garden. It's shady there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kannizzata 配三张情境卡：交叉条材是格栅，花园遮阴处是凉棚，海上捕鱼装置是大型浮具；靠场景分别记住三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An optical instrument with a separate viewing tube for each eye, used to see distant objects more clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供双眼同时观察、使远处物体显得更近更清楚的光学仪器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument ottiku b'żewġ tubi, wieħed għal kull għajn, li jintuża biex wieħed jara oġġetti fil-bogħod aktar ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双筒望远镜；供双眼同时观察远处物体的光学仪器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument ottiku li wieħed iħares minnu biż-żewġ għajnejn biex jara aħjar affarijiet li jinsabu fil-bogħod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Binoculars are an optical instrument that you look through with both eyes to see distant things more clearly.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkaturi użaw il-kannokkjali biex josservaw l-għasafar mingħajr ma jersqu qrib tagħhom.
formal.en: The researchers used binoculars to observe the birds without approaching them.
formal.zh: 研究人员用双筒望远镜观察鸟类，无须走近它们。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ġibt il-kannokkjali? Hemm għasfur fuq dik is-siġra. Mark: Iva, ħares minnhom. Issa tista' tarah aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you bring the binoculars? There's a bird in that tree. Mark: Yes, look through them. Now you can see it better.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你带双筒望远镜了吗？那棵树上有只鸟。Mark：带了，你用它看看。现在能看得更清楚了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibt il-kannokkjali? Hemm għasfur fuq dik is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Ġibt il-kannokkjali? Hemm għasfur fuq dik is-siġra.
messages.zh: 你带双筒望远镜了吗？那棵树上有只鸟。
messages.en: Did you bring the binoculars? There's a bird in that tree.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħares minnhom. Issa tista' tarah aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħares minnhom. Issa tista' tarah aħjar.
messages.zh: 带了，你用它看看。现在能看得更清楚了。
messages.en: Yes, look through them. Now you can see it better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kannokkjali 和双眼贴住两个镜筒、观察远处小鸟的画面绑定，整词记作“双筒望远镜”。

gloss_zh: 甜里科塔乳酪脆皮卷；小管

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pastry with a hard, rounded shell filled with sweet ricotta cheese; also a small pipe or tube.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种硬脆圆筒外壳内填甜里科塔乳酪的糕点；也指小管或细管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġina ħelwa b'qoxra iebsa f'forma ta' tubu mimlija bl-irkotta ħelwa; il-kelma tfisser ukoll pajp jew tubu żgħir.

sense_translations.en_definition: pastry with a hard round shell filled with sweet ricotta cheese
sense_translations.zh_definition: 甜里科塔乳酪脆皮卷；以硬脆圆筒状外壳包裹甜里科塔乳酪馅的糕点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaġina ħelwa li għandha qoxra iebsa u tonda f'forma ta' tubu, mimlija bl-irkotta ħelwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kannol is a pastry whose hard, rounded shell contains a filling of sweet ricotta cheese.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小管；细管；中间有通道的小型管状物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pajp jew tubu żgħir b'passaġġ minn ġewwa li minnu jista' jgħaddi likwidu, arja jew materjal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kannol is a small hollow pipe or tube through which something can pass.

formal.mt: Il-menu jiddeskrivi l-kannol bħala deżerta b'qoxra tqarmeċ u mili tal-irkotta ħelwa.
formal.en: The menu describes the kannol as a dessert with a crisp shell and a sweet ricotta filling.
formal.zh: 菜单将这种乳酪卷描述为外壳酥脆、内填甜里科塔乳酪的甜点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek kannol żgħir tal-plastik għal dan il-proġett? Pawlu: Iva, hawn wieħed fil-kaxxa tal-għodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a small plastic tube for this project? Pawlu: Yes, there's one here in the toolbox.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你有做这个项目用的塑料小管吗？Pawlu：有，工具箱里这里有一根。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek kannol żgħir tal-plastik għal dan il-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek kannol żgħir tal-plastik għal dan il-proġett?
messages.zh: 你有做这个项目用的塑料小管吗？
messages.en: Do you have a small plastic tube for this project?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 有，工具箱里这里有一根。
messages.en: Yes, there's one here in the toolbox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面记 kannol：甜点柜里的乳酪脆皮卷、工具箱里的小管；这是双义联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small medical tube inserted into the body to introduce or remove fluid or gas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 置入身体、用于输入或引出液体或气体的小型医用管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tubu mediku żgħir li jiddaħħal fil-ġisem biex jgħaddi likwidu jew gass lejn il-ġisem jew 'il barra minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 医用套管或插管；置入身体以输入或引出液体或气体的小管。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tubu żgħir użat fil-kura medika li jiddaħħal fil-ġisem sabiex jidħol jew joħroġ likwidu jew gass.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cannula is a small medical tube placed in the body so that fluid or gas can be introduced or removed.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li ntużat kannula biex il-pazjent jirċievi l-likwidu.
formal.en: The report states that a cannula was used to give the patient fluid.
formal.zh: 报告指出，使用了套管为患者输入液体。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi kannula? Marija: Hija tubu mediku żgħir. F'dan il-każ tintuża biex jingħata l-likwidu.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is a cannula? Marija: It's a small medical tube. In this case, it's used to give fluid.
colloquial.zh: Anna：套管是什么？Marija：是一根医用小管。在这里，它用来输入液体。

messages.speaker: Anna (患者)
messages.zh: 套管是什么？
messages.en: What is a cannula?

messages.speaker: Marija (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija tubu mediku żgħir. F'dan il-każ tintuża biex jingħata l-likwidu.
messages.mt_standard: Hija tubu mediku żgħir. F'dan il-każ tintuża biex jingħata l-likwidu.
messages.zh: 是一根医用小管。在这里，它用来输入液体。
messages.en: It's a small medical tube. In this case, it's used to give fluid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kannula 放进医院场景记忆：护士提到的一根医用小管，用于让液体或气体通过。

gloss_zh: 符合教会法规的；属于正典的；被公认为权威的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to church rules, belonging to an accepted canon, or recognized as authoritative within a tradition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与教会法规有关的、属于获认可正典的，或在某一传统中被公认为权威的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mar-regoli tal-Knisja, li jagħmel parti minn ġabra rikonoxxuta ta' testi, jew li jitqies bħala awtorevoli fi tradizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教会法规的或符合教会法规的；属于正典的；在某一传统中获认可并具有权威地位的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda r-regoli tal-Knisja jew jaqbel magħhom, jew li huwa aċċettat bħala parti minn ġabra ta' testi rikonoxxuti u awtorevoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is canonical follows church rules or belongs to a body of works accepted as authoritative within a tradition.

collocations.zh: 正典文本；获公认的权威文本

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza test kanoniku u jispjega l-importanza tiegħu fit-tradizzjoni reliġjuża.
formal.en: The study analyses a canonical text and explains its importance within the religious tradition.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了一部正典文本，并解释了它在该宗教传统中的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser li test huwa kanoniku? David: Hawn ifisser li t-tradizzjoni reliġjuża taċċettah bħala parti mill-ġabra ta' testi awtorevoli tagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does it mean for a text to be canonical? David: Here it means that the religious tradition accepts it as part of its collection of authoritative texts.
colloquial.zh: Sara：说一篇文本属于正典，是什么意思？David：这里是说，该宗教传统认可它属于自身的权威文本集。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li test huwa kanoniku?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li test huwa kanoniku?
messages.zh: 说一篇文本属于正典，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean for a text to be canonical?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li t-tradizzjoni reliġjuża taċċettah bħala parti mill-ġabra ta' testi awtorevoli tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li t-tradizzjoni reliġjuża taċċettah bħala parti mill-ġabra ta' testi awtorevoli tagħha.
messages.zh: 这里是说，该宗教传统认可它属于自身的权威文本集。
messages.en: Here it means that the religious tradition accepts it as part of its collection of authoritative texts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kanoniku 与“获认可的规范或正典”联系起来；看到 dritt 想教会法，看到 test 想正典文本。

gloss_zh: 咏礼司铎；座堂教士会成员

teaching_sense.en_definition: A priest who belongs to the chapter of a cathedral or collegiate church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于座堂或协同教堂教士会的司铎，称为咏礼司铎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saċerdot li jagħmel parti mill-kapitlu ta' katidral jew ta' knisja kolleġġjata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咏礼司铎，即座堂或协同教堂教士会的成员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kanonku huwa saċerdot li jagħmel parti mill-kapitlu ta' katidral jew ta' knisja kolleġġjata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A canon is a priest who belongs to the chapter of a cathedral or collegiate church.

formal.mt: Il-programm taċ-ċerimonja jindika li l-kanonku se jmexxi t-talb tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: The ceremony programme indicates that the canon will lead the opening prayers.
formal.zh: 典礼程序表注明，咏礼司铎将带领开场祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jmexxi t-talb illum? Pawlu: Il-kanonku tal-katidral se jmexxih.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will lead the prayers today? Pawlu: The canon of the cathedral will lead them.
colloquial.zh: Marija：今天谁带领祈祷？Pawlu：由座堂的咏礼司铎带领。

messages.speaker: Marija (教友)
messages.zh: 今天谁带领祈祷？
messages.en: Who will lead the prayers today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教堂工作人员)
messages.zh: 由座堂的咏礼司铎带领。
messages.en: The canon of the cathedral will lead them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kanonku 放进座堂祈祷的画面：记住它指教士会中的司铎，是人的身份名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An underground room used for storing wine, food, or other supplies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于地下、用于存放酒、食物或其他物品的储藏室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra taħt l-art li tintuża biex jinħażnu nbid, ikel jew affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地窖，即房屋地下用于储藏酒、食物或其他物品的房间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kantina hija kamra taħt l-art fejn jinżammu nbid, ikel jew affarijiet oħra għall-ħażna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cellar is an underground room where people store wine, food, or other supplies.

formal.mt: L-inbid jinżamm fil-kantina, fejn it-temperatura tibqa' stabbli.
formal.en: The wine is stored in the cellar, where the temperature remains stable.
formal.zh: 葡萄酒存放在地窖中，那里的温度保持稳定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt il-kaxxa tal-fliexken? Mark: Poġġejtha fil-kantina, ħdejn it-taraġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the box of bottles? Mark: I put it in the cellar, beside the stairs.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你把那箱瓶子放在哪里了？Mark：我把它放在地窖里，楼梯旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你把那箱瓶子放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the box of bottles?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我把它放在地窖里，楼梯旁边。
messages.en: I put it in the cellar, beside the stairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沿楼梯下去取酒：kantina 就是地下储藏空间；连着 fil-kantina“在地窖里”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A portable container used as a toilet in a room.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在房间内、供人大小便使用的可移动容器，即夜壶或便盆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jista' jinġarr u li jintuża fil-kamra biex wieħed jagħmel l-awrina jew il-ħmieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夜壶或便盆，指在房间内代替厕所使用的便溺容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kantru huwa reċipjent li jintuża għall-awrina jew għall-ħmieġ fil-kamra, minflok it-tojlit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chamber-pot is a portable container that someone uses as a toilet in a room.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jinkludi kantru taċ-ċeramika fost l-oġġetti tad-dar esposti.
formal.en: The museum catalogue includes a ceramic chamber-pot among the household objects on display.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录将一件陶瓷便盆列入展出的家居用品之中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak ir-reċipjent taħt is-sodda? Pawlu: Dak kantru, reċipjent li jintuża bħala tojlit fil-kamra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that container under the bed? Pawlu: That is a chamber-pot, a container used as a toilet in a room.
colloquial.zh: Lara：床下面那个容器是什么？Pawlu：那是便盆，是在房间里当作厕所使用的容器。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 床下面那个容器是什么？
messages.en: What is that container under the bed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kantru, reċipjent li jintuża bħala tojlit fil-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kantru, reċipjent li jintuża bħala tojlit fil-kamra.
messages.zh: 那是便盆，是在房间里当作厕所使用的容器。
messages.en: That is a chamber-pot, a container used as a toilet in a room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“床下放着一个便盆”的画面记 kantru，重点记用途是便溺，避免只记成普通盆罐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large building brick used with others to construct walls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑中与其他砖块一起砌成墙体的大块砌砖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Blokka kbira tal-bini li titqiegħed ma' oħrajn biex jinbnew il-ħitan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 砖，即用于砌筑墙体等结构的块状建筑材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kantun huwa blokka ta' materjal tal-bini li titqiegħed ma' oħrajn biex jinbnew ħitan jew strutturi oħra.
